title: 稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路案例中比較輸入與專家張量與top-k門控route，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate inputs and expert tensors and top-k gated routing within the Sparse mixture-of-experts network case.

steps.title: 閘控與稀疏專家：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Gating and sparse experts: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對輸入與專家張量提出可反駁的閘控與稀疏專家模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gating and sparse experts model and evidence record for inputs and expert tensors.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識輸入與專家張量。router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 建立閘控與稀疏專家的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify inputs and expert tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gating and sparse experts, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。
steps.observationEn: List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every model parameter activates on every token.
steps.check: 提交輸入與專家張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inputs and expert tensors.

knowledge.title: 閘控與稀疏專家
knowledge.text: router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 本課架構對應：輸入與專家張量
knowledge.textEn: Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. Course architecture correspondence: Inputs and expert tensors

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every model parameter activates on every token.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設一次 FP32 矩陣乘法 A(64×32)B(32×48)，以乘加計2 FLOP，成本=196608 FLOP。只讀A、B及寫C一次最低流量=26624 byte，算術強度=7.3846 FLOP/byte；未含反傳、快取與模型其他層。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one FP32 product A(64x32)B(32x48), counting multiply-add as 2 FLOP: 196608 FLOP. Single reads/writes need at least 26624 bytes, intensity 7.3846 FLOP/byte; backward pass, caches and other layers are excluded.

quiz.question: 就輸入與專家張量的「閘控與稀疏專家」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for gating and sparse experts in inputs and expert tensors?
options: router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。
所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ.
Every model parameter activates on every token.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。
quiz.explanationEn: Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing.

steps.title: 閘控與稀疏專家：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Gating and sparse experts: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對輸入與專家張量提出可反駁的閘控與稀疏專家模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable gating and sparse experts model and evidence record for inputs and expert tensors.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「閘控與稀疏專家」模型，檢查輸入與專家張量的兩個假想案例。對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分router選擇部分專家並組合其輸出；total參數與每token啟動參數不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous gating and sparse experts model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving inputs and expert tensors. List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Routers select/combine a subset of experts; total and per-token active parameters differ." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對四專家top-2的小例列出選擇、權重與啟動計數。
steps.observationEn: List choices, weights and active counts for four experts with top-2 routing.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有模型參數都會在每個token上同時啟動。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every model parameter activates on every token.
steps.check: 提交輸入與專家張量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for inputs and expert tensors.

steps.title: 容量與路由負載：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Capacity and routing load: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對top-k門控route提出可反駁的容量與路由負載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable capacity and routing load model and evidence record for top-k gated routing.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識top-k門控route。專家容量限制可能丟棄或重路由token；相同平均負載不表示無局部overflow。 建立容量與路由負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify top-k gated routing in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Expert capacity can drop/reroute tokens; equal mean load does not imply no local overflow. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of capacity and routing load, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 將一批假想token分配到專家並計算峰值及overflow。
steps.observationEn: Assign assumed tokens and compute peaks/overflow.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：平均token量低於容量就排除所有專家超載。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Mean token load below capacity rules out every expert overload.
steps.check: 提交top-k門控route的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for top-k gated routing.

steps.title: 專家資料搬運：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Expert data movement: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對稀疏梯度路徑提出可反駁的專家資料搬運模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable expert data movement model and evidence record for sparse gradient paths.
steps.instruction: 在「稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts 網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識稀疏梯度路徑。分散專家需搬運token與輸出；all-to-all通信會影響端到端成本及負載平衡。 建立專家資料搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控路由、專家容量與負載平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定token數比較本地與跨裝置專家路由bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sparse gradient paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sparse mixture-of-experts network. Distributed experts move tokens/results; all-to-all traffic affects cost/load balance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of expert data movement, focusing on gated routing, expert capacity and load balancing. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare local/cross-device routing bytes at fixed token count. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 固定token數比較本地與跨裝置專家路由bytes。

steps.objective: 針對HBM3與L2重用提出可反駁的HBM 與資料重用模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable hbm and data reuse model and evidence record for hbm3 and l2 reuse.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識HBM3與L2重用。算術強度決定頻寬或計算瓶頸；緩存命中會改變實際外部流量。 建立HBM 與資料重用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify hbm3 and l2 reuse in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. Arithmetic intensity distinguishes bandwidth/compute limits; cache reuse changes actual external traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of hbm and data reuse, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。
steps.observationEn: Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：HBM容量與HBM頻寬是同一個規格。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: HBM capacity and bandwidth are the same specification.
steps.check: 提交HBM3與L2重用的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hbm3 and l2 reuse.

knowledge.title: HBM 與資料重用
knowledge.text: 算術強度決定頻寬或計算瓶頸；緩存命中會改變實際外部流量。 本課架構對應：HBM3與L2重用
knowledge.textEn: Arithmetic intensity distinguishes bandwidth/compute limits; cache reuse changes actual external traffic. Course architecture correspondence: HBM3 and L2 reuse

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；HBM容量與HBM頻寬是同一個規格。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: HBM capacity and bandwidth are the same specification.

quiz.question: 就HBM3與L2重用的「HBM 與資料重用」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for hbm and data reuse in hbm3 and l2 reuse?
options: HBM容量與HBM頻寬是同一個規格。
算術強度決定頻寬或計算瓶頸；緩存命中會改變實際外部流量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: HBM capacity and bandwidth are the same specification.
Arithmetic intensity distinguishes bandwidth/compute limits; cache reuse changes actual external traffic.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 算術強度決定頻寬或計算瓶頸；緩存命中會改變實際外部流量。 畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。
quiz.explanationEn: Arithmetic intensity distinguishes bandwidth/compute limits; cache reuse changes actual external traffic. Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes.

steps.title: HBM 與資料重用：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: HBM and data reuse: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對HBM3與L2重用提出可反駁的HBM 與資料重用模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable hbm and data reuse model and evidence record for hbm3 and l2 reuse.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「HBM 與資料重用」模型，檢查HBM3與L2重用的兩個假想案例。畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分算術強度決定頻寬或計算瓶頸；緩存命中會改變實際外部流量。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous hbm and data reuse model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving hbm3 and l2 reuse. Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Arithmetic intensity distinguishes bandwidth/compute limits; cache reuse changes actual external traffic." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 畫理想roofline並另計讀寫的最小bytes。
steps.observationEn: Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：HBM容量與HBM頻寬是同一個規格。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: HBM capacity and bandwidth are the same specification.
steps.check: 提交HBM3與L2重用的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 非同步搬運與同步：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous transfer and synchronization: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對TMA與barrier提出可反駁的非同步搬運與同步模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable asynchronous transfer and synchronization model and evidence record for tma and barriers.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識TMA與barrier。計算與搬運重疊需正確依賴；缺少同步可能表現更快但產生錯結果。 建立非同步搬運與同步的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。將依賴圖與時間線並排檢驗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify tma and barriers in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. Overlapping compute/transfers needs dependencies; missing synchronization may run faster while producing wrong results. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of asynchronous transfer and synchronization, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check dependency graphs beside execution timelines. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 晶片與互連層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Chip and interconnect hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對NVLink層級提出可反駁的晶片與互連層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable chip and interconnect hierarchy model and evidence record for nvlink hierarchy.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識NVLink層級。die、GPU、節點與機架有不同通信邊界；規格需按方向及端點界定。 建立晶片與互連層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。核對單向、雙向、每GPU及總系統的單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify nvlink hierarchy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. Dies, GPUs, nodes and racks have different communication boundaries; rates need direction/endpoint labels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of chip and interconnect hierarchy, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check unidirectional/bidirectional and per-GPU/system units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 核對單向、雙向、每GPU及總系統的單位。
steps.observationEn: Check unidirectional/bidirectional and per-GPU/system units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：機架總頻寬可直接當作每線程可用頻寬。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rack bandwidth directly equals per-thread bandwidth.
steps.check: 提交NVLink層級的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for nvlink hierarchy.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable energy and workload model and evidence record for job energy and precision.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Hopper GPU 架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識工作能耗與精度。利用率、傳輸與數值精度共同決定每項工作能量；額定功率不等於平均能耗。 建立能耗與工作負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是SIMT、Transformer Engine 與非同步記憶體。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify job energy and precision in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. Utilization, transfers and precision affect task energy; power rating is not average energy. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of energy and workload, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。
steps.observationEn: Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：較低瞬時功率必然使整項工作耗能更少。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Lower instantaneous power guarantees lower task energy.
steps.check: 提交工作能耗與精度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for job energy and precision.

knowledge.title: 能耗與工作負載
knowledge.text: 利用率、傳輸與數值精度共同決定每項工作能量；額定功率不等於平均能耗。 本課架構對應：工作能耗與精度
knowledge.textEn: Utilization, transfers and precision affect task energy; power rating is not average energy. Course architecture correspondence: Job energy and precision

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較相同結果質量的耗時與積分能量。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；較低瞬時功率必然使整項工作耗能更少。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Lower instantaneous power guarantees lower task energy.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設算術強度 I=7 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=1.0 TB/s、計算峯值 37 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(37,I×B)=7.0 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume I=7 FLOP/byte, B=1.0 TB/s and compute peak 37 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(37,I×B)=7.0 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.

quiz.question: 就工作能耗與精度的「能耗與工作負載」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for energy and workload in job energy and precision?
options: 較低瞬時功率必然使整項工作耗能更少。
利用率、傳輸與數值精度共同決定每項工作能量；額定功率不等於平均能耗。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Lower instantaneous power guarantees lower task energy.
Utilization, transfers and precision affect task energy; power rating is not average energy.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 能耗與工作負載：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy and workload: evidence validation

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable energy and workload model and evidence record for job energy and precision.

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous energy and workload model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving job energy and precision. Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Utilization, transfers and precision affect task energy; power rating is not average energy." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.title: SIMT 與執行羣：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對Blackwell SM與調度提出可反駁的SIMT 與執行羣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable simt and execution groups model and evidence record for blackwell sms and scheduling.
steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA Blackwell 多晶粒 GPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Blackwell SM與調度。GPU 以線程羣執行指令；分支分歧及記憶存取模式影響利用率。 建立SIMT 與執行羣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是多晶粒互連、低精度矩陣與機架擴充。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify blackwell sms and scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Blackwell multi-die GPU. GPU thread groups execute instructions; divergence and access patterns affect utilization. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of simt and execution groups, focusing on die interconnects, low-precision matrices and rack scaling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對兩種索引模式比較活躍lane與存取筆數。
steps.observationEn: Compare active lanes/accesses for two indexing patterns.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有線程數加倍必然使吞吐量加倍。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling threads necessarily doubles throughput.
steps.check: 提交Blackwell SM與調度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

title: AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統案例中比較NeuronCore算術路徑與vector與稀疏算子，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate neuroncore arithmetic paths and vector/sparse operators within the AWS Trainium and Neuron system case.

steps.title: 矩陣核心與精度：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Matrix cores and precision: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對NeuronCore算術路徑提出可反駁的矩陣核心與精度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable matrix cores and precision model and evidence record for neuroncore arithmetic paths.
steps.instruction: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識NeuronCore算術路徑。專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。 建立矩陣核心與精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify neuroncore arithmetic paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of matrix cores and precision, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。
steps.observationEn: Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：FP8、FP32、FP64 的峯值可不加標示直接比較。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unlabeled FP8, FP32 and FP64 peaks are directly comparable.
steps.check: 提交NeuronCore算術路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for neuroncore arithmetic paths.

steps.title: 矩陣核心與精度：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Matrix cores and precision: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對NeuronCore算術路徑提出可反駁的矩陣核心與精度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable matrix cores and precision model and evidence record for neuroncore arithmetic paths.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「矩陣核心與精度」模型，檢查NeuronCore算術路徑的兩個假想案例。固定矩陣工作量比較計算誤差及各精度路徑。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分專用矩陣單元以特定精度及shape執行；低精度吞吐量不能當成FP64能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous matrix cores and precision model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving neuroncore arithmetic paths. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.check: 提交NeuronCore算術路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for neuroncore arithmetic paths.

steps.objective: 針對Neuron圖編譯提出可反駁的編譯與分割模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable compilation and partitioning model and evidence record for neuron graph compilation.
steps.instruction: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Neuron圖編譯。圖編譯與張量分片決定數據佈局；相同數學表達可形成不同通訊量。 建立編譯與分割的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較複製、資料分片及模型分片的bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify neuron graph compilation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compilation and partitioning, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識集體傳輸與並行。all-reduce同步更新或統計；通信可部分重疊但仍有尾端依賴。 建立集體通訊與計算重疊的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較全串行與可重疊時間線。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and overlapping timelines. steps.title: 排程隔離與復原：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Scheduling, isolation and recovery: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對EC2資源與device分配提出可反駁的排程隔離與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for ec2 resources and allocation.
steps.instruction: 在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EC2資源與device分配。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify ec2 resources and allocation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
steps.observationEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.

knowledge.textEn: Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Adding systems linearly speeds every model.

quiz.question: 就多CS系統梯度的「叢集擴充與參數同步」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for cluster scaling and synchronization in multi-cs system gradients?
options: 增加系統必然線性加速所有模型。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
多個系統共享參數與同步梯度，擴充效率還取決於網絡和批次。
optionsEn: Adding systems linearly speeds every model.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Systems share parameters/synchronize gradients; network and batches still limit scaling.
quiz.explanation: 多個系統共享參數與同步梯度，擴充效率還取決於網絡和批次。 固定全局批次比較單系統與多系統效率。
quiz.explanationEn: Systems share parameters/synchronize gradients; network and batches still limit scaling. Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch.

steps.title: 叢集擴充與參數同步：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Cluster scaling and synchronization: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對多CS系統梯度提出可反駁的叢集擴充與參數同步模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable cluster scaling and synchronization model and evidence record for multi-cs system gradients.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「叢集擴充與參數同步」模型，檢查多CS系統梯度的兩個假想案例。固定全局批次比較單系統與多系統效率。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分多個系統共享參數與同步梯度，擴充效率還取決於網絡和批次。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous cluster scaling and synchronization model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving multi-cs system gradients. Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Systems share parameters/synchronize gradients; network and batches still limit scaling." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 固定全局批次比較單系統與多系統效率。
steps.observationEn: Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加系統必然線性加速所有模型。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Adding systems linearly speeds every model.
steps.check: 提交多CS系統梯度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for multi-cs system gradients.

steps.objective: 針對晶圓與設施散熱提出可反駁的冷卻與工作能量模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Identify wafer/facility cooling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Chip, power delivery and cooling have separate efficiencies; chip performance is not system energy efficiency. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cooling and job energy, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List compute, communication and facility energy separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate graded-spike events and membrane-state microcode within the Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform case.

steps.title: 脈衝與時間編碼：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Spikes and temporal encoding: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對graded spike事件提出可反駁的脈衝與時間編碼模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable spikes and temporal encoding model and evidence record for graded-spike events.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識graded spike事件。神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。 建立脈衝與時間編碼的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify graded-spike events in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform. Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of spikes and temporal encoding, focusing on asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare rate and event-time representations for one input. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。
steps.observationEn: Compare rate and event-time representations for one input.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Spiking networks can use only fixed rate codes.
steps.check: 提交graded spike事件的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for graded-spike events.

knowledge.textEn: Assume 1000 neurons at 10 events/s with 20 nJ/event: event power is 0.2 mW. Idle, encoding, readout and supply are excluded; this is neither Loihi measurement nor end-to-end power.

CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識BMC與作業復原。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instructionEn: Identify grace/blackwell memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack system. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 工作分割與平行效率：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對機架模型分割提出可反駁的工作分割與平行效率模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 機架系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識機架模型分割。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是Grace–Blackwell、機架 NVLink 與液冷。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify rack-scale model partition in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack system. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for rack-scale model partition.

steps.title: 工作分割與平行效率：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Work partition and parallel efficiency: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對機架模型分割提出可反駁的工作分割與平行效率模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「工作分割與平行效率」模型，檢查機架模型分割的兩個假想案例。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous work partition and parallel efficiency model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving rack-scale model partition. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.

steps.check: 提交機架模型分割的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

title: Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦案例中比較GH200相干記憶與node內與Slingshot，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate gh200 coherent memory and intranode and slingshot within the Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer case.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對GH200相干記憶提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for gh200 coherent memory.
steps.instruction: 在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識GH200相干記憶。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gh200 coherent memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. steps.instruction: 在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識A100與EPYC拓撲。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify a100/epyc topology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交A100與EPYC拓撲的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for a100/epyc topology.

steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識InfiniBand層級。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. steps.title: 工作分割與平行效率：架構分析

steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識partition工作流。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify partition workflows in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「JUPITER 模組超算系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識GH200與CPU模塊。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是Booster、Cluster 與多層儲存協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of power, cooling and facilities, focusing on booster, cluster and tiered-storage cooperation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 排程隔離與復原：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Scheduling, isolation and recovery: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對模塊排程與故障恢復提出可反駁的排程隔離與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for module scheduling/recovery.
steps.instruction: 在「JUPITER 模組超算系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模塊排程與故障恢復。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是Booster、Cluster 與多層儲存協作。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify module scheduling/recovery in the mentor diagram and primary sources for JUPITER modular supercomputing system. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on booster, cluster and tiered-storage cooperation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
steps.observationEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對雙Xeon與八V100提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for dual xeon and eight v100.
steps.instruction: 在「臺灣杉二號歷史架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識雙Xeon與八V100。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是V100 節點、AI 平臺與溫水冷卻。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify dual xeon and eight v100 in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Taiwania 2 historical architecture. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on v100 nodes, ai platforms and warm-water cooling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for dual xeon and eight v100.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for slurm and kubernetes.
steps.instruction: 在「臺灣杉二號歷史架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Slurm與Kubernetes。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是V100 節點、AI 平臺與溫水冷卻。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify slurm and kubernetes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Taiwania 2 historical architecture. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on v100 nodes, ai platforms and warm-water cooling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對sled與主機拓撲提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for sled/host topology.
steps.instruction: 在「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識sled與主機拓撲。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sled/host topology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for OCP Yosemite V3 modular server. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交sled與主機拓撲的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Low PUE guarantees minimum compute energy for a task.

quiz.question: 就共用供電與冷卻的「供電冷卻與設施」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for power, cooling and facilities in shared power/cooling?
options: 低PUE保證相同任務計算能耗最低。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
設施功率包含IT與輔助；PUE不能單獨判定計算結果每單位能耗。
optionsEn: Low PUE guarantees minimum compute energy for a task.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result.
quiz.explanation: 設施功率包含IT與輔助；PUE不能單獨判定計算結果每單位能耗。 覈對IT、總設施及作業時間的能量邊界。

steps.title: 供電冷卻與設施：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Power, cooling and facilities: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對共用供電與冷卻提出可反駁的供電冷卻與設施模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable power, cooling and facilities model and evidence record for shared power/cooling.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「供電冷卻與設施」模型，檢查共用供電與冷卻的兩個假想案例。覈對IT、總設施及作業時間的能量邊界。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分設施功率包含IT與輔助；PUE不能單獨判定計算結果每單位能耗。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous power, cooling and facilities model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving shared power/cooling. Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 覈對IT、總設施及作業時間的能量邊界。
steps.observationEn: Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：低PUE保證相同任務計算能耗最低。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Low PUE guarantees minimum compute energy for a task.
steps.check: 提交共用供電與冷卻的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for shared power/cooling.

steps.title: 排程隔離與復原：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Scheduling, isolation and recovery: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對維護邊界與隔離提出可反駁的排程隔離與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for maintenance boundaries and isolation.
steps.instruction: 在「OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識維護邊界與隔離。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify maintenance boundaries and isolation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for OCP Yosemite V3 modular server. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
steps.observationEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.
steps.check: 提交維護邊界與隔離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for maintenance boundaries and isolation.

summary: 以開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面解析OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore OCP Yosemite V3 modular server through open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 公開伺服器與超算架構的離線工作流、通信、儲存及能量模型；非機櫃接線、供電施工或實體維護SOP，也不表示學員取得廠商／研究中心設備存取。
scopeEn: Offline workflow, fabric, storage and energy models of public servers/HPC. No rack-wiring, power-installation or physical-maintenance SOP and no vendor/research-center hardware access is implied.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.020，使用 8 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=7.0175。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
workedExample.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.020 and 8 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=7.0175. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

title: AP1000 壓水式發電架構

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在AP1000 壓水式發電架構案例中比較壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器與汽輪島淨電，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate pwr heat source/steam generators and turbine-island net power within the AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for pwr heat source/steam generators.
steps.instruction: 在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify pwr heat source/steam generators in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for pwr heat source/steam generators.

knowledge.textEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Course architecture correspondence: PWR heat source/steam generators

knowledge.textEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設民用熱源 500 MWth、熱電效率 0.30、輔機 11 MWe，淨電=500×0.30−11=139.0 MWe；循環排熱約350.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 500 MWth, efficiency 0.30 and auxiliaries 11 MWe: net power 139.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 350.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。

All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「核島與汽輪機島邊界」模型，檢查壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器的兩個假想案例。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving pwr heat source/steam generators. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 500 MWth, efficiency 0.30 and auxiliaries 11 MWe: net power 139.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 350.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual heat and sustained cooling model and evidence record for residual heat/capacitance.
steps.instruction: 在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱與熱容。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開設計與建造驗證。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 500 MWth, efficiency 0.30 and auxiliaries 11 MWe: net power 139.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 350.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

summary: 以主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據解析AP1000 壓水式發電架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture through primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

title: ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構案例中比較沸水與直接蒸汽路與汽輪轉換與輔機，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate bwr/direct steam paths and turbine conversion/auxiliaries within the ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對沸水與直接蒸汽路提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for bwr/direct steam paths.
steps.instruction: 在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識沸水與直接蒸汽路。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify bwr/direct steam paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交沸水與直接蒸汽路的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for bwr/direct steam paths.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for bwr/direct steam paths.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「核島與汽輪機島邊界」模型，檢查沸水與直接蒸汽路的兩個假想案例。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving bwr/direct steam paths. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.title: 熱循環與淨電效率：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Thermal cycles and net efficiency: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對汽輪轉換與輔機提出可反駁的熱循環與淨電效率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable thermal cycles and net efficiency model and evidence record for turbine conversion/auxiliaries.
steps.instruction: 在「ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識汽輪轉換與輔機。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify turbine conversion/auxiliaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。
steps.observationEn: Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：熱功率增加量必然等於可送電增加量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Added thermal power necessarily equals added export power.
steps.check: 提交汽輪轉換與輔機的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for turbine conversion/auxiliaries.

steps.objective: 針對主動與被動支援提出可反駁的被動與主動支援模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable passive and active support model and evidence record for active/passive support.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「被動與主動支援」模型，檢查主動與被動支援的兩個假想案例。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous passive and active support model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving active/passive support. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。
steps.observationEn: Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：被動系統表示無需邊界或失效分析。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.
steps.check: 提交主動與被動支援的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for active/passive support.

knowledge.title: 被動與主動支援
knowledge.text: 重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 本課架構對應：主動與被動支援
knowledge.textEn: Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Course architecture correspondence: Active/passive support

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；被動系統表示無需邊界或失效分析。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.

quiz.question: 就主動與被動支援的「被動與主動支援」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for passive and active support in active/passive support?
options: 被動系統表示無需邊界或失效分析。
繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.
Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison.

stages.title: 獨立驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 在巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島案例中比較多機組共用界面與工程QA與運行證據，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate multiplant shared interfaces and engineering qa/operation evidence within the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island case.

steps.title: 模組化與共用系統：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Modularity and shared systems: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對多機組共用界面提出可反駁的模組化與共用系統模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable modularity and shared systems model and evidence record for multiplant shared interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在「巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多機組共用界面。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型壓水式電廠的熱電與支援邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify multiplant shared interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。
steps.observationEn: Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：模塊數增加就自動消除所有共同故障。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More modules automatically eliminate common failures.
steps.check: 提交多機組共用界面的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for multiplant shared interfaces.

steps.title: 建造證據與生命週期：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Construction evidence and lifecycle: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對工程QA與運行證據提出可反駁的建造證據與生命週期模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable construction evidence and lifecycle model and evidence record for engineering qa/operation evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識工程QA與運行證據。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型壓水式電廠的熱電與支援邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify engineering qa/operation evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。
steps.observationEn: Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：取得設計批准等同每個電廠已商轉。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.
steps.check: 提交工程QA與運行證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for engineering qa/operation evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設民用熱源 700 MWth、熱電效率 0.32、輔機 8 MWe，淨電=700×0.32−8=216.0 MWe；循環排熱約476.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 700 MWth, efficiency 0.32 and auxiliaries 8 MWe: net power 216.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 476.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程案例中比較EPR核島與蒸汽迴路與常規島熱電效率，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate epr nuclear/steam loops and conventional-island conversion within the Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對EPR核島與蒸汽迴路提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for epr nuclear/steam loops.
steps.instruction: 在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EPR核島與蒸汽迴路。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify epr nuclear/steam loops in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交EPR核島與蒸汽迴路的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for epr nuclear/steam loops.

knowledge.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設民用熱源 400 MWth、熱電效率 0.30、輔機 9 MWe，淨電=400×0.30−9=111.0 MWe；循環排熱約280.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 400 MWth, efficiency 0.30 and auxiliaries 9 MWe: net power 111.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 280.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

options: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。
所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries.
All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「核島與汽輪機島邊界」模型，檢查EPR核島與蒸汽迴路的兩個假想案例。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving epr nuclear/steam loops. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instruction: 在「Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識常規島熱電效率。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是複製設計、分離安全支援與工程驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify conventional-island conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on design replication, separated safety support and validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

title: Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構

steps.instructionEn: Identify pressure-tube heat-transfer boundary in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable residual heat and sustained cooling model and evidence record for residual heat/support.

Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。

steps.instructionEn: Identify units/refurbishment interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

summary: 以壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程解析Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture through pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

title: NuScale US600 模組設計研究

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在NuScale US600 模組設計研究案例中比較整合模組熱流體邊界與模組與淨髮電，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate integral-module fluid boundaries and modules/net generation within the NuScale US600 modular design study case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對整合模組熱流體邊界提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for integral-module fluid boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識整合模組熱流體邊界。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify integral-module fluid boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NuScale US600 modular design study. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交整合模組熱流體邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for integral-module fluid boundaries.

knowledge.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界
knowledge.text: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 本課架構對應：整合模組熱流體邊界

Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on integral pwr modules and a shared pool. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「NuScale US600 模組設計研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識池內餘熱路徑。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是整合式壓水模組與共用水池。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instructionEn: Identify small-bwr steam boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
