knowledge.textEn: Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Course architecture correspondence: Heat-transfer/support dependencies

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；被動系統表示無需邊界或失效分析。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.

quiz.question: 就傳熱與支持依賴的「被動與主動支援」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for passive and active support in heat-transfer/support dependencies?
options: 重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。
被動系統表示無需邊界或失效分析。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths.
Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison.

steps.title: 被動與主動支援：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Passive and active support: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對傳熱與支持依賴提出可反駁的被動與主動支援模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable passive and active support model and evidence record for heat-transfer/support dependencies.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「被動與主動支援」模型，檢查傳熱與支持依賴的兩個假想案例。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous passive and active support model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving heat-transfer/support dependencies. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。
steps.observationEn: Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：被動系統表示無需邊界或失效分析。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Passive systems require no boundary or failure analysis.
steps.check: 提交傳熱與支持依賴的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for heat-transfer/support dependencies.

stages.title: 獨立驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 在HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統案例中比較雙模組接口與公開架構與階段證據，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate twin-module interfaces and public architecture/stage evidence within the HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation case.

steps.title: 模組化與共用系統：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Modularity and shared systems: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對雙模組接口提出可反駁的模組化與共用系統模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable modularity and shared systems model and evidence record for twin-module interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在「HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識雙模組接口。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify twin-module interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。
steps.observationEn: Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：模塊數增加就自動消除所有共同故障。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More modules automatically eliminate common failures.
steps.check: 提交雙模組接口的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for twin-module interfaces.

steps.title: 建造證據與生命週期：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Construction evidence and lifecycle: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對公開架構與階段證據提出可反駁的建造證據與生命週期模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable construction evidence and lifecycle model and evidence record for public architecture/stage evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開架構與階段證據。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify public architecture/stage evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。
steps.observationEn: Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：取得設計批准等同每個電廠已商轉。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.
steps.check: 提交公開架構與階段證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public architecture/stage evidence.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設民用熱源 400 MWth、熱電效率 0.31、輔機 8 MWe，淨電=400×0.31−8=116.0 MWe；循環排熱約276.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 400 MWth, efficiency 0.31 and auxiliaries 8 MWe: net power 116.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 276.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

summaryEn: Explore HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation through helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在ITER 國際磁約束研究工程案例中比較tokamak真空與磁場與plasma與設施Q邊界，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields and plasma/facility q boundaries within the ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對tokamak真空與磁場提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields.
steps.instruction: 在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識tokamak真空與磁場。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
steps.check: 提交tokamak真空與磁場的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。 是本單元要排除的誤解。

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.

兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。

A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 磁體或光學精度：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對超導coil公差提出可反駁的磁體或光學精度模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識超導coil公差。磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。 建立磁體或光學精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 在「ITER 國際磁約束研究工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識研究裝置與電廠差距。可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 建立研究裝置與電廠差距的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

summaryEn: Explore ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering through large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate tokamak magnets/vacuum and heating/energy boundaries within the JT-60SA superconducting tokamak case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析

steps.instruction: 在「JT-60SA 超導 tokamak」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識tokamak磁體與vacuum。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是超導磁體、低溫屏蔽與支援系統。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous research-to-power-plant gaps model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving experiment/plant integration gaps. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance." from an alternative cause with similar output. summary: 以超導磁體、低溫屏蔽與支援系統解析JT-60SA 超導 tokamak：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore JT-60SA superconducting tokamak through superconducting magnets, thermal shielding and support systems: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

summaryEn: Explore SPARC high-field tokamak research through hts magnets and compact-device energy boundaries: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

steps.instruction: 在「NIF 慣性融合能量邊界」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識慣性約束系統邊界。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假想單次脈衝：到target的雷射能量2 MJ、融合輸出3 MJ，Qtarget=1.5。若wall-plug雷射效率2%，電網驅動需100 MJ；僅回收融合熱且熱電效率35%，輸出1.05 MJ；另有5 MJ輔助輸入，淨能量=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ。未回收雷射熱，皆為假想而非NIF實測；target gain不等於電廠淨電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one pulse with laser energy 2 MJ at the target and fusion output 3 MJ: Qtarget=1.5. At assumed wall-plug laser efficiency 2%, driver input is 100 MJ. Recovering only fusion heat at 35% gives 1.05 MJ; auxiliaries consume 5 MJ, so net=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ. Laser-heat recovery is omitted; values are hypothetical, not NIF measurements. Target gain is not plant net electricity.

steps.objective: 針對重複率與發電差距提出可反駁的研究裝置與電廠差距模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable research-to-power-plant gaps model and evidence record for repetition/plant gaps.
steps.instruction: 在「NIF 慣性融合能量邊界」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識重複率與發電差距。可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 建立研究裝置與電廠差距的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify repetition/plant gaps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.textEn: List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假想單次脈衝：到target的雷射能量2 MJ、融合輸出3 MJ，Qtarget=1.5。若wall-plug雷射效率2%，電網驅動需100 MJ；僅回收融合熱且熱電效率35%，輸出1.05 MJ；另有5 MJ輔助輸入，淨能量=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ。未回收雷射熱，皆為假想而非NIF實測；target gain不等於電廠淨電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume one pulse with laser energy 2 MJ at the target and fusion output 3 MJ: Qtarget=1.5. At assumed wall-plug laser efficiency 2%, driver input is 100 MJ. Recovering only fusion heat at 35% gives 1.05 MJ; auxiliaries consume 5 MJ, so net=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ. Laser-heat recovery is omitted; values are hypothetical, not NIF measurements. Target gain is not plant net electricity.

summary: 以高能雷射、增益定義與設施能量解析NIF 慣性融合能量邊界：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore NIF inertial-fusion energy boundaries through high-energy lasers, gain definitions and facility energy: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想單次脈衝：到target的雷射能量2 MJ、融合輸出3 MJ，Qtarget=1.5。若wall-plug雷射效率2%，電網驅動需100 MJ；僅回收融合熱且熱電效率35%，輸出1.05 MJ；另有5 MJ輔助輸入，淨能量=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ。未回收雷射熱，皆為假想而非NIF實測；target gain不等於電廠淨電。
workedExample.textEn: Assume one pulse with laser energy 2 MJ at the target and fusion output 3 MJ: Qtarget=1.5. At assumed wall-plug laser efficiency 2%, driver input is 100 MJ. Recovering only fusion heat at 35% gives 1.05 MJ; auxiliaries consume 5 MJ, so net=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ. Laser-heat recovery is omitted; values are hypothetical, not NIF measurements. Target gain is not plant net electricity.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

title: MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate spherical tokamak confinement and heating/gain definitions within the MAST Upgrade spherical tokamak case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對球形tokamak約束提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for spherical tokamak confinement.
steps.instruction: 在「MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識球形tokamak約束。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify spherical tokamak confinement in the mentor diagram and primary sources for MAST Upgrade spherical tokamak. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。
steps.observationEn: Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：達到研究目標就表示可直接售電。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A research milestone means electricity can immediately be sold.
steps.check: 提交球形tokamak約束的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for spherical tokamak confinement.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設融合輸出100 MW、指定等離子體加熱20 MW，Qplasma=5；若驅動電效率40%、熱電效率35%、其他輔機10 MW，假想淨電=100×0.35−20/0.40−10=−25 MW。忽略其他回收熱，說明Q>1不自動等於淨發電。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fusion output 100 MW and specified plasma heating 20 MW: Qplasma=5. With driver efficiency 40%, conversion 35% and auxiliaries 10 MW, assumed net=35−50−10=−25 MW. Other recovered heat is omitted; Q>1 does not ensure net electricity.

steps.title: 磁體或光學精度：架構分析

title: NSTX-U 球形電漿研究

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在NSTX-U 球形電漿研究案例中比較低aspect ratio約束與輸入與儲能budget，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate low-aspect-ratio confinement and input/stored-energy budget within the NSTX-U spherical-plasma research case.

steps.title: 約束方式與系統邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Confinement and system boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對低aspect ratio約束提出可反駁的約束方式與系統邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable confinement and system boundaries model and evidence record for low-aspect-ratio confinement.
steps.instruction: 在「NSTX-U 球形電漿研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識低aspect ratio約束。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify low-aspect-ratio confinement in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. steps.title: 傳動與發電轉換：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對參考傳動與generator提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 傳動與發電轉換：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Drivetrain and electrical conversion: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對參考傳動與generator提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable drivetrain and electrical conversion model and evidence record for reference drivetrain/generator.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「傳動與發電轉換」模型，檢查參考傳動與generator的兩個假想案例。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous drivetrain and electrical conversion model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving reference drivetrain/generator. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

knowledge.textEn: Assume a teaching rotor with rho=1.225 kg/m³, A=100 m², v=10 m/s and Cp=0.40: P=24.5000 kW. Drivetrain/electrical loss, wakes, ratings and wind distributions are excluded; these are not project specifications.

quiz.question: 就V236風速包絡的「風資源與功率包絡」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for wind resources and power envelopes in v236 wind envelope?
options: 額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
quiz.explanationEn: Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對大型blade載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for large-blade loads.
steps.instruction: 在「Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識大型blade載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify large-blade loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Vestas V236-15 MW rotor engineering. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on large blades, medium-speed drivetrain and full converters. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交大型blade載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for large-blade loads.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對大型blade載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for large-blade loads.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「葉片氣動與載荷」模型，檢查大型blade載荷的兩個假想案例。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous blade aerodynamics and loads model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving large-blade loads. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交大型blade載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for large-blade loads.

steps.title: 傳動與發電轉換：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Drivetrain and electrical conversion: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對中速gear與converter提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable drivetrain and electrical conversion model and evidence record for medium-speed gear/converter.
steps.instruction: 在「Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識中速gear與converter。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify medium-speed gear/converter in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Vestas V236-15 MW rotor engineering. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on large blades, medium-speed drivetrain and full converters. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。
steps.observationEn: Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：直驅代表無需發電機或功率電子。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Direct drive removes generators and power electronics.
steps.check: 提交中速gear與converter的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for medium-speed gear/converter.

steps.title: 支撐繫泊與動態：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Supports, mooring and dynamics: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對測試塔與support動態提出可反駁的支撐繫泊與動態模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable supports, mooring and dynamics model and evidence record for test-tower/support dynamics.
steps.instruction: 在「Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識測試塔與support動態。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify test-tower/support dynamics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Vestas V236-15 MW rotor engineering. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on large blades, medium-speed drivetrain and full converters. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識原型與壽命證據。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on large blades, medium-speed drivetrain and full converters. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

summary: 以大型葉片、中速傳動與全功率轉換解析Vestas V236-15 MW 風輪工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Vestas V236-15 MW rotor engineering through large blades, medium-speed drivetrain and full converters: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

workedExample.textEn: Assume a teaching rotor with rho=1.225 kg/m³, A=100 m², v=10 m/s and Cp=0.40: P=24.5000 kW. Drivetrain/electrical loss, wakes, ratings and wind distributions are excluded; these are not project specifications.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.

title: 霍恩西離岸風電場
summary: 以大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護解析霍恩西離岸風電場：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm through large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在霍恩西離岸風電場案例中比較Hornsea2風資源與陣列blade載荷，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate hornsea-2 wind resources and array blade loads within the Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm case.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Hornsea2風資源提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for hornsea-2 wind resources.
steps.instruction: 在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hornsea2風資源。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify hornsea-2 wind resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交Hornsea2風資源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hornsea-2 wind resources.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for wind resources and power envelopes in hornsea-2 wind resources?
options: 可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Hornsea2風資源提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for hornsea-2 wind resources.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「風資源與功率包絡」模型，檢查Hornsea2風資源的兩個假想案例。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous wind resources and power envelopes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving hornsea-2 wind resources. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交Hornsea2風資源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hornsea-2 wind resources.

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對陣列blade載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for array blade loads.
steps.instruction: 在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識陣列blade載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify array blade loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交陣列blade載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for array blade loads.

steps.objective: 針對風機與海上集電提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable drivetrain and electrical conversion model and evidence record for turbines/offshore collection.
steps.instruction: 在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識風機與海上集電。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對風機與海上集電提出可反駁的傳動與發電轉換模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「傳動與發電轉換」模型，檢查風機與海上集電的兩個假想案例。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous drivetrain and electrical conversion model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving turbines/offshore collection. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「霍恩西離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海上可達窗口。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是大陣列尾流、出口海纜與海上維護。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify offshore access windows in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on large-array wakes, export cables and offshore service. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。

optionsEn: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.
Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime.

steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對浮式葉片載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for floating-rotor loads.
steps.instruction: 在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識浮式葉片載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify floating-rotor loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.titleEn: Array wakes and cables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對動態海纜與陣列提出可反駁的陣列尾流與海纜模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Identify dynamic cables/array in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

optionsEn: Farm efficiency is single-turbine efficiency times turbine count.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instruction: 在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海況與供電可用率。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify sea states/power availability in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。
steps.observationEn: Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

summaryEn: Explore Hywind Tampen floating wind through floating concrete supports and platform electricity: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

title: 海風蘇格蘭浮式風場
summary: 以spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移解析海風蘇格蘭浮式風場：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm through spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在海風蘇格蘭浮式風場案例中比較Scotland風分佈與海上rotor載荷，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate scotland wind distribution and offshore rotor loads within the Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm case.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Scotland風分佈提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for scotland wind distribution.
steps.instruction: 在「海風蘇格蘭浮式風場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Scotland風分佈。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify scotland wind distribution in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.

steps.objective: 針對不同機型blade提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「葉片氣動與載荷」模型，檢查不同機型blade的兩個假想案例。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。

Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on phased demonstration, nearshore foundations and collection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「海上福爾摩沙離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識示範至商業證據。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分期示範、近岸基礎與集電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。

title: 胡佛水壩水力發電系統
summary: 以厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫解析胡佛水壩水力發電系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System through thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在胡佛水壩水力發電系統案例中比較Hoover有效水頭與水輪工況map，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate hoover effective head and turbine operating maps within the Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System case.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Hoover有效水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for hoover effective head.
steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hoover有效水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify hoover effective head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交Hoover有效水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hoover effective head.

knowledge.title: 水頭流量與能量
knowledge.text: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 本課架構對應：Hoover有效水頭

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設淨水頭30 m、流量7 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×7×30×0.88=1.812888 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 30 m, flow 7 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=1.812888 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

quiz.question: 就Hoover有效水頭的「水頭流量與能量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for head, flow and energy in hoover effective head?
options: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。
壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections.
Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Hoover有效水頭提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for hoover effective head.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「水頭流量與能量」模型，檢查Hoover有效水頭的兩個假想案例。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous head, flow and energy model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving hoover effective head. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
steps.observationEn: Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
steps.check: 提交Hoover有效水頭的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for hoover effective head.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for turbine operating maps.
steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水輪工況map。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify turbine operating maps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓力水路暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. steps.instructionEn: Use the previous water transients and water hammer model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving penstock transients. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識供水與發電調度。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify water/power scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous generation, storage and scheduling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving irrigation pump/generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 50 m, flow 6 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=2.589840 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

quiz.question: 就德基有效水頭的「水頭流量與能量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for head, flow and energy in techi effective head?
options: 壩高等於每個工況的淨水頭。
覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Dam height equals net head in every operating condition.
Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units.

steps.title: 水輪機與工況：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Turbines and operating envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對山區水輪工況提出可反駁的水輪機與工況模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for mountain turbine envelopes.
steps.instruction: 在「德基水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識山區水輪工況。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mountain turbine envelopes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Techi Hydropower System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.
steps.check: 提交山區水輪工況的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mountain turbine envelopes.

steps.title: 水輪機與工況：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Turbines and operating envelopes: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對山區水輪工況提出可反駁的水輪機與工況模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable turbines and operating envelopes model and evidence record for mountain turbine envelopes.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「水輪機與工況」模型，檢查山區水輪工況的兩個假想案例。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous turbines and operating envelopes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving mountain turbine envelopes. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有水輪機可在相同水頭流量下等效互換。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All turbines are interchangeable at equal head and flow.
steps.check: 提交山區水輪工況的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mountain turbine envelopes.

steps.title: 水路暫態與水錘：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Water transients and water hammer: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對引水隧道暫態提出可反駁的水路暫態與水錘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable water transients and water hammer model and evidence record for headrace transients.
steps.instruction: 在「德基水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識引水隧道暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify headrace transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Techi Hydropower System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。
steps.observationEn: Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：穩態水頭足以排除全部暫態壓力。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Steady head excludes all transient pressure.
steps.check: 提交引水隧道暫態的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for headrace transients.

steps.objective: 針對薄拱壩與基礎提出可反駁的土建機械與滲流模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable civil works, mechanics and seepage model and evidence record for thin-arch dam/foundation.
steps.instruction: 在「德基水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識薄拱壩與基礎。壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。 建立土建機械與滲流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify thin-arch dam/foundation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Techi Hydropower System. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。
steps.observationEn: Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：沒有可見漏水就證明基礎與壩體完全健康。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: No visible leakage proves a sound dam/foundation.
steps.check: 提交薄拱壩與基礎的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instruction: 在「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識上下池淨水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是上下池、可逆機組與往返效率。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設淨水頭60 m、流量7 m³/s、效率0.88，P=1000×9.81×7×60×0.88=3.625776 MW。另若抽蓄上下流程效率均0.88，往返效率0.7744；高程、流量皆是假想，非場站規格。
knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 60 m, flow 7 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=3.625776 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

steps.titleEn: Water transients and water hammer: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對切換水路暫態提出可反駁的水路暫態與水錘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable water transients and water hammer model and evidence record for transition transients.
steps.instruction: 在「明潭抽蓄水力發電廠」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識切換水路暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是上下池、可逆機組與往返效率。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify transition transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on upper/lower pools, reversible units and round-trip efficiency. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：穩態水頭足以排除全部暫態壓力。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Steady head excludes all transient pressure.

title: 南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站
titleEn: Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant
summary: 以地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性解析南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant through underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

steps.title: 水頭流量與能量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Head, flow and energy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對上下庫能量提出可反駁的水頭流量與能量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable head, flow and energy model and evidence record for reservoir energy.
steps.instruction: 在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識上下庫能量。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify reservoir energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on underground caverns, reversible units and grid flexibility. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識往返效率與電網。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是地下洞室、可逆機組及電網彈性。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.objective: 針對多目標水庫調度提出可反駁的發電儲能與調度模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable generation, storage and scheduling model and evidence record for multipurpose scheduling.
steps.instruction: 在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多目標水庫調度。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify multipurpose scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。
steps.observationEn: Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：抽回同一水就可無輸入重複製造淨能量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Recirculating water creates unlimited net energy without input.
steps.check: 提交多目標水庫調度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for multipurpose scheduling.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for generation, storage and scheduling in multipurpose scheduling?
options: 抽回同一水就可無輸入重複製造淨能量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。
optionsEn: Recirculating water creates unlimited net energy without input.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints.

steps.titleEn: Generation, storage and scheduling: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對多目標水庫調度提出可反駁的發電儲能與調度模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「發電儲能與調度」模型，檢查多目標水庫調度的兩個假想案例。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous generation, storage and scheduling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving multipurpose scheduling. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.objective: 針對水沙與生態證據提出可反駁的泥砂環境與壽命模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable sediment, environment and life model and evidence record for water/sediment/ecology.
steps.instruction: 在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水沙與生態證據。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify water/sediment/ecology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sediment, environment and life, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習

knowledge.textEn: Assume net head 40 m, flow 6 m³/s and efficiency 0.88: P=2.071872 MW. Two pumped-cycle legs at 0.88 yield round-trip efficiency 0.7744. Inputs are assumed, not plant specifications.

scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

title: Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究案例中比較EGS熱與連通與研究井完整性，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate egs heat/connectivity and research-well integrity within the Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research case.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對EGS熱與連通提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for egs heat/connectivity.
steps.instruction: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EGS熱與連通。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify egs heat/connectivity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交EGS熱與連通的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for egs heat/connectivity.

knowledge.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量
knowledge.text: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 本課架構對應：EGS熱與連通
knowledge.textEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Course architecture correspondence: EGS heat/connectivity

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設流體18 kg/s、比焓降290 kJ/kg，熱量率=5220 kW；轉換效率0.12、輔機100 kW，淨電=526.4 kW。未含儲層可持續性、相變細節與回注冷卻，非鑽井或現場設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume flow 18 kg/s and enthalpy drop 290 kJ/kg: heat rate 5220 kW. At conversion 0.12 and auxiliaries 100 kW, net=526.4 kW. Reservoir sustainability, phase details and reinjection cooling are omitted; no field settings are given.

quiz.question: 就EGS熱與連通的「儲層概念與可觀測量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir concepts and observables in egs heat/connectivity?
options: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。
測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation.
A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
quiz.explanationEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對EGS熱與連通提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for egs heat/connectivity.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查EGS熱與連通的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving egs heat/connectivity. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交EGS熱與連通的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for egs heat/connectivity.

steps.title: 井筒完整性與熱損：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Well integrity and heat loss: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對研究井完整性提出可反駁的井筒完整性與熱損模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well integrity and heat loss model and evidence record for research-well integrity.
steps.instruction: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識研究井完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify research-well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.
steps.check: 提交研究井完整性的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for research-well integrity.
