steps.title: 閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Flash, dry-steam and binary cycles: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對假想發電循環選擇提出可反駁的閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model and evidence record for assumed-cycle choice.
steps.instruction: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識假想發電循環選擇。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify assumed-cycle choice in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。
steps.observationEn: Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.
steps.check: 提交假想發電循環選擇的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instruction: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開microseismic目錄。地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。 建立微震監測與生態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microseismic monitoring and environment, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Flash, dry-steam and binary cycles: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對高低壓steam循環提出可反駁的閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model and evidence record for high/low-pressure steam.
steps.instruction: 在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識高低壓steam循環。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify high/low-pressure steam in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。
steps.observationEn: Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.
steps.check: 提交高低壓steam循環的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for high/low-pressure steam.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。 是本單元要排除的誤解。

quiz.question: 就高低壓steam循環的「閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for flash, dry-steam and binary cycles in high/low-pressure steam?
options: 所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。
資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.
Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。
quiz.explanationEn: Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram.

steps.title: 閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Flash, dry-steam and binary cycles: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對高低壓steam循環提出可反駁的閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model and evidence record for high/low-pressure steam.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環」模型，檢查高低壓steam循環的兩個假想案例。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving high/low-pressure steam. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.
steps.check: 提交高低壓steam循環的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. steps.instruction: 在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識回注與溫度變化。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

summaryEn: Explore Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations through two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在奧卡里亞地熱電站案例中比較Olkaria兩相資源與井羣與完整性，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate olkaria two-phase resources and wellfield integrity within the Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations case.

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reservoir concepts and observables: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Olkaria兩相資源提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for olkaria two-phase resources.
steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Olkaria兩相資源。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify olkaria two-phase resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交Olkaria兩相資源的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for olkaria two-phase resources.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir concepts and observables in olkaria two-phase resources?

測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation.
A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。

steps.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量：證據驗證

steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查Olkaria兩相資源的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving olkaria two-phase resources. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.objective: 針對井羣與完整性提出可反駁的井筒完整性與熱損模型與驗證紀錄。

steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識井羣與完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify wellfield integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Use the previous flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving flash/wellhead units. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.instruction: 在「奧卡里亞地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識回注與補給。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是兩相資源、閃蒸及分期井口電力。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well integrity and heat loss model and evidence record for steam wells/pipelines.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「井筒完整性與熱損」模型，檢查產汽井與管線的兩個假想案例。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous well integrity and heat loss model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving steam wells/pipelines. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.
steps.check: 提交產汽井與管線的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for steam wells/pipelines.

knowledge.title: 井筒完整性與熱損
knowledge.text: 井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 本課架構對應：產汽井與管線
knowledge.textEn: Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Course architecture correspondence: Steam wells/pipelines

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.

quiz.question: 就產汽井與管線的「井筒完整性與熱損」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for well integrity and heat loss in steam wells/pipelines?
options: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
quiz.explanationEn: Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.

stages.title: 功能架構與量化模型
stages.description: 在蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統案例中比較dry steam turbine與冷凝與熱傳，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate dry-steam turbines and condensation/heat transfer within the The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex case.

steps.title: 閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Flash, dry-steam and binary cycles: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對dry steam turbine提出可反駁的閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model and evidence record for dry-steam turbines.
steps.instruction: 在「蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識dry steam turbine。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify dry-steam turbines in the mentor diagram and primary sources for The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。
steps.observationEn: Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.
steps.check: 提交dry steam turbine的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for dry-steam turbines.

steps.title: 換熱結垢與腐蝕：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Heat transfer, scaling and corrosion: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對冷凝與熱傳提出可反駁的換熱結垢與腐蝕模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heat transfer, scaling and corrosion model and evidence record for condensation/heat transfer.
steps.instruction: 在「蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識冷凝與熱傳。結垢降低熱傳且影響流阻；化學腐蝕與機械磨耗不是同一機制。 建立換熱結垢與腐蝕的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify condensation/heat transfer in the mentor diagram and primary sources for The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：輸出下降只能來自地下溫度下降。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Output decline can only mean falling subsurface temperature.
steps.check: 提交冷凝與熱傳的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

stages.description: 在蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統案例中比較再生水與質量平衡與環境及微震monitor，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate reclaimed-water mass balance and environmental/seismic monitoring within the The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex case.

steps.title: 回注質量與熱突破：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對再生水與質量平衡提出可反駁的回注質量與熱突破模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough model and evidence record for reclaimed-water mass balance.
steps.instruction: 在「蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識再生水與質量平衡。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify reclaimed-water mass balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex. Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：回注量相同就證明熱突破時間相同。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal reinjection rates imply equal breakthrough time.
steps.check: 提交再生水與質量平衡的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reclaimed-water mass balance.

knowledge.title: 回注質量與熱突破

steps.objective: 針對Wairakei資源與歷史提出可反駁的儲層概念與可觀測量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir concepts and observables model and evidence record for wairakei resources/history.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲層概念與可觀測量」模型，檢查Wairakei資源與歷史的兩個假想案例。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous reservoir concepts and observables model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving wairakei resources/history. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
steps.check: 提交Wairakei資源與歷史的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for wairakei resources/history.

knowledge.title: 儲層概念與可觀測量
knowledge.text: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 本課架構對應：Wairakei資源與歷史
knowledge.textEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Course architecture correspondence: Wairakei resources/history

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設流體15 kg/s、比焓降310 kJ/kg，熱量率=4650 kW；轉換效率0.12、輔機100 kW，淨電=458.0 kW。未含儲層可持續性、相變細節與回注冷卻，非鑽井或現場設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume flow 15 kg/s and enthalpy drop 310 kJ/kg: heat rate 4650 kW. At conversion 0.12 and auxiliaries 100 kW, net=458.0 kW. Reservoir sustainability, phase details and reinjection cooling are omitted; no field settings are given.

quiz.question: 就Wairakei資源與歷史的「儲層概念與可觀測量」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for reservoir concepts and observables in wairakei resources/history?
options: 測到高溫就保證商業發電規模。
分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: A high-temperature measurement guarantees commercial generation.
Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。
quiz.explanationEn: Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties.

steps.title: 井筒完整性與熱損：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Well integrity and heat loss: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對舊井與完整性提出可反駁的井筒完整性與熱損模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable well integrity and heat loss model and evidence record for existing-well integrity.
steps.instruction: 在「懷拉基地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識舊井與完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify existing-well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Wairakei Geothermal Power Station. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：井口穩定就證明所有地下密封完整。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A stable wellhead proves every subsurface seal intact.
steps.check: 提交舊井與完整性的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for existing-well integrity.

steps.title: 閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Flash, dry-steam and binary cycles: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對steam至binary邊界提出可反駁的閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable flash, dry-steam and binary cycles model and evidence record for steam/binary boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「懷拉基地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識steam至binary邊界。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify steam/binary boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Wairakei Geothermal Power Station. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。
steps.observationEn: Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有地熱流體都直接進入同一種汽輪機。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.
steps.check: 提交steam至binary邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for steam/binary boundaries.

資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Every geothermal fluid enters the same turbine directly.
Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。

steps.title: 換熱結垢與腐蝕：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Heat transfer, scaling and corrosion: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對換熱效率與結垢提出可反駁的換熱結垢與腐蝕模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable heat transfer, scaling and corrosion model and evidence record for transfer efficiency/scaling.
steps.instruction: 在「懷拉基地熱電站」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識換熱效率與結垢。結垢降低熱傳且影響流阻；化學腐蝕與機械磨耗不是同一機制。 建立換熱結垢與腐蝕的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify transfer efficiency/scaling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Wairakei Geothermal Power Station. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Output decline can only mean falling subsurface temperature.

steps.title: 回注質量與熱突破：架構分析

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

title: Johan Sverdrup 海上油田

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate reservoir material/pressure and public well-barrier concepts within the Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield case.

steps.objective: 針對油藏物料與壓力提出可反駁的儲層模型與物料平衡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir models and material balance model and evidence record for reservoir material/pressure.
steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識油藏物料與壓力。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on shore power, platform integration and subsea tiebacks. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reservoir material/pressure.

steps.title: 多相輸送與壓降：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對油氣水多相界面提出可反駁的多相輸送與壓降模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable multiphase transport and pressure drop model and evidence record for oil/gas/water interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識油氣水多相界面。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.instruction: 在「Johan Sverdrup 海上油田」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識岸電與排放邊界。分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。 建立處理能量與排放的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是岸電、平臺整合與海底接回。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.title: 多相輸送與壓降：架構分析

steps.objective: 針對海底多相pump提出可反駁的多相輸送與壓降模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable multiphase transport and pressure drop model and evidence record for subsea multiphase pumps.
steps.instruction: 在「Shell Perdido 深水監測」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海底多相pump。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海底泵、多相流與遠端狀態辨識。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on subsea pumps, multiphase flow and remote diagnosis. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。
steps.observationEn: Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：油氣水混合流可不加說明地當作純水。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Oil/gas/water mixtures are indistinguishable from pure water without qualification.
steps.check: 提交海底多相pump的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.instructionEn: Identify floating-platform/riser interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Shell Perdido deepwater monitoring. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對天然氣資源與庫存提出可反駁的儲層模型與物料平衡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reservoir models and material balance model and evidence record for gas resources/inventory.
steps.instruction: 在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識天然氣資源與庫存。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gas resources/inventory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of processing energy and emissions, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable monitoring, shutdown and recovery model and evidence record for availability/event evidence.
steps.instruction: 在「Prelude FLNG 海上處理工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識可用率與事件證據。可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。 建立監測停機與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是海上氣體處理、液化及儲運邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify availability/event evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Prelude FLNG offshore processing engineering. Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, shutdown and recovery, focusing on offshore gas treatment, liquefaction and storage/transfer boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable processing energy and emissions model and evidence record for shore-power/compression energy.
steps.instruction: 在「Troll 海上油氣平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識岸電與壓縮能耗。分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。 建立處理能量與排放的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of processing energy and emissions, focusing on gravity bases, shore power and compression support. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 多相輸送與壓降：架構分析

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

title: Boddington 自動化金銅礦

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate gold/copper grades and surface autonomous haulage within the Boddington automated gold/copper mine case.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對金銅grade分佈提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for gold/copper grades.
steps.instruction: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識金銅grade分佈。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gold/copper grades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交金銅grade分佈的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gold/copper grades.

steps.instructionEn: Identify surface autonomous haulage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Course architecture correspondence: Mine water/tailings/rehabilitation

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設乾給料900 t、品位1.6 g/t、金屬回收率0.85，可回收金屬=1224.0 g=1.2240 kg。回收率不同於精礦品位；未含礦物解離、處理成本或任何浸出配方，非礦場實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume dry feed 900 t, grade 1.6 g/t and metal recovery 0.85: recovered metal 1224.0 g=1.2240 kg. Recovery differs from concentrate grade; liberation/costs and all leaching recipes are excluded; this is not a mine measurement.

quiz.question: 就礦水尾礦與覆育的「尾礦水與復育」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for tailings, water and rehabilitation in mine water/tailings/rehabilitation?
options: 回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。
optionsEn: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence.
quiz.explanation: 尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence.

summary: 以露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收解析Boddington 自動化金銅礦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Boddington automated gold/copper mine through surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 公開資源工程的離線質量、能量及環境證據判讀；不提供鑽井、井控、採掘、爆破或危險化學浸出SOP。採礦權、許可、地質完整性與現場規範需由合格團隊另行確認，課程完成不是操作資格。
scopeEn: Offline public resource-engineering material/energy/environmental analysis; no drilling, well-control, excavation, blasting or hazardous-leaching SOP. Qualified teams separately establish rights, permits, integrity and field requirements; completion is not operating qualification.

title: Cadia 地下金銅礦

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Cadia 地下金銅礦案例中比較地下grade與取樣與panel caving物料路徑，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate underground grades/sampling and panel-caving material paths within the Cadia underground gold/copper mine case.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對地下grade與取樣提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for underground grades/sampling.
steps.instruction: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識地下grade與取樣。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify underground grades/sampling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交地下grade與取樣的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for underground grades/sampling.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對地下grade與取樣提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for underground grades/sampling.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「資源品位與代表採樣」模型，檢查地下grade與取樣的兩個假想案例。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous resources, grade and representative sampling model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving underground grades/sampling. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交地下grade與取樣的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for underground grades/sampling.

steps.title: 開坑地下與搬運：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Open-pit, underground and haulage: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對panel caving物料路徑提出可反駁的開坑地下與搬運模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable open-pit, underground and haulage model and evidence record for panel-caving material paths.
steps.instruction: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識panel caving物料路徑。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify panel-caving material paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：露天與地下可沿用所有支護和搬運參數。

steps.check: 提交panel caving物料路徑的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for panel-caving material paths.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable ventilation, power and automation model and evidence record for underground ventilation/power.
steps.instruction: 在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識地下ventilation供電。地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。 建立通風電力與自動化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ventilation, power and automation, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

summaryEn: Explore Kibali large gold-mining engineering through multiple mining routes, support power and recovery evidence: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.

title: Nome Creek 砂金與重力選別
titleEn: Nome Creek placer gold and gravity separation

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate placer grades/sampling and permitted regions/handling within the Nome Creek placer gold and gravity separation case.

steps.title: 資源品位與代表採樣：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Resources, grade and representative sampling: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對砂金grade與取樣提出可反駁的資源品位與代表採樣模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable resources, grade and representative sampling model and evidence record for placer grades/sampling.
steps.instruction: 在「Nome Creek 砂金與重力選別」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識砂金grade與取樣。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是密度分離、代表取樣與河川環境。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify placer grades/sampling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Nome Creek placer gold and gravity separation. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on density separation, representative samples and river environments. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。
steps.observationEn: Compare weighted and unweighted grade means.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最好樣本的品位可代表所有礦石。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The best sample represents every ore parcel.
steps.check: 提交砂金grade與取樣的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for placer grades/sampling.

title: 深度 MLP 與自動編碼器

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在深度 MLP 與自動編碼器案例中比較MLP weight與bias與非線性與latent瓶頸，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate mlp weights/biases and nonlinearity/latent bottleneck within the Deep MLP and autoencoder case.

steps.title: 全連接層與參數：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Dense layers and parameters: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對MLP weight與bias提出可反駁的全連接層與參數模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable dense layers and parameters model and evidence record for mlp weights/biases.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MLP weight與bias。單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。 建立全連接層與參數的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mlp weights/biases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dense layers and parameters, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。
steps.observationEn: Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一層參數數永遠只等於神經元數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Layer parameters always equal neuron count.
steps.check: 提交MLP weight與bias的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mlp weights/biases.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設MLP架構32→8→32，每層含bias：encoder有32×8+8=264參數，decoder有8×32+32=288，總552。線性瓶頸最多秩8；非線性增加表達能力但不保證泛化，重建loss不能代替任務驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Assume MLP 32→8→32 with bias: encoder 264 parameters, decoder 288, total 552. A linear bottleneck has rank at most 8; nonlinear expression does not guarantee generalization, and reconstruction loss does not replace task validation.

兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。

steps.title: 全連接層與參數：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Dense layers and parameters: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對MLP weight與bias提出可反駁的全連接層與參數模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable dense layers and parameters model and evidence record for mlp weights/biases.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「全連接層與參數」模型，檢查MLP weight與bias的兩個假想案例。對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous dense layers and parameters model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving mlp weights/biases. Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.titleEn: Linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對非線性與latent瓶頸提出可反駁的線性瓶頸與非線性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities model and evidence record for nonlinearity/latent bottleneck.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識非線性與latent瓶頸。線性encoder-decoder組合的秩受瓶頸限制；非線性改變表達但不保證保留任務資訊。 建立線性瓶頸與非線性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

A linear encoder-decoder has bottleneck-limited rank; nonlinearity changes expression without ensuring task information survives. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare recoverable information in low-rank and nonlinear examples. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.objective: 針對input與hidden state提出可反駁的記憶與三個閘模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable memory and three gates model and evidence record for input/hidden states.
steps.instruction: 在「LSTM 循環時序網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識input與hidden state。常見LSTM分開input、forget、output閘與候選更新；cell state和hidden state不是同一變數。 建立記憶與三個閘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在一個假想時間步重算門值、cell與hidden，核對shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify input/hidden states in the mentor diagram and primary sources for LSTM recurrent sequence network. Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of memory and three gates, focusing on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate gates, cell and hidden on one assumed step and check shapes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

title: DDPM 擴散生成網路

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在DDPM 擴散生成網路案例中比較clean sample與noise與time-conditioned U-Net，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate clean samples/noise and time-conditioned u-net within the DDPM diffusion-generation network case.

steps.title: 前向加噪與邊際：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Forward noising and marginals: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對clean sample與noise提出可反駁的前向加噪與邊際模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable forward noising and marginals model and evidence record for clean samples/noise.
steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識clean sample與noise。DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。 建立前向加噪與邊際的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify clean samples/noise in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of forward noising and marginals, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。
steps.observationEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.
steps.check: 提交clean sample與noise的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for clean samples/noise.

knowledge.title: 前向加噪與邊際
knowledge.text: DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。 本課架構對應：clean sample與noise
knowledge.textEn: DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale. Course architecture correspondence: Clean samples/noise

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設q(x_t|x_0)中ᾱ_t=0.81，x_0=2、ε=−1，x_t=√0.81×2+√0.19×(−1)=1.364110。這是單一前向加噪例；noise prediction loss與反向生成品質不同，非特定模型權重結果。
knowledge.textEn: Assume alpha_bar=0.81, x0=2 and epsilon=−1: xt=sqrt(0.81)*2−sqrt(0.19)=1.364110. This is one forward-noising example; noise loss differs from reverse-generation quality and is not an output from model weights.

steps.title: 前向加噪與邊際：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Forward noising and marginals: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對clean sample與noise提出可反駁的前向加噪與邊際模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable forward noising and marginals model and evidence record for clean samples/noise.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「前向加噪與邊際」模型，檢查clean sample與noise的兩個假想案例。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous forward noising and marginals model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving clean samples/noise. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.objective: 針對time-conditioned U-Net提出可反駁的時間條件噪聲預測模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable time-conditioned noise prediction model and evidence record for time-conditioned u-net.
steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識time-conditioned U-Net。去噪網路需知道噪聲等級；噪聲預測loss与生成分布品質不是同一指標。 建立時間條件噪聲預測的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify time-conditioned u-net in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Denoisers need noise-level conditions; noise-prediction loss differs from generated-distribution quality. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of time-conditioned noise prediction, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。
steps.observationEn: Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：去掉時間條件不會影響任何去噪任務。

steps.check: 提交time-conditioned U-Net的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for time-conditioned u-net.

steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識noise prediction gradient。反向生成是多步模型依赖過程；seed、排程與模型版本共同决定可重現邊界。 建立反向取樣與可重現性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。保存假想seed、時間序列與版本，分開比較單步誤差及最終品質。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識sampling步數與記憶。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 製程窗口練習：ArF 浸潤式 λ = 193 nm、NA = 1.35、水折射率 n = 1.437。邊緣光角度 sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939，θ = 70°。高 NA 景深用 DOF = λ/[2n(1 − cosθ)] 估算：cos70° = 0.342，DOF = 193/(2×1.437×0.658) = 193/1.891 ≈ 102 nm，與近軸 λ/NA² ≈ 106 nm 相近。對焦預算以均方根合成：晶圓形貌 25 nm、晶圓台對焦 15 nm、鏡頭場曲 10 nm、調平感測 10 nm，RSS = √(625+225+100+100) = √1050 ≈ 32 nm；取正負兩側共 2×32 = 64 nm，留給光阻製程的可用景深約 102 − 64 = 38 nm。若 CD 以 k₁ = 0.28 計為 40 nm，CD 容差 ±10% 即 ±4 nm，Bossung 曲線必須在這 38 nm 內維持此容差。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Process-window exercise: ArF immersion with λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and water index n = 1.437. The marginal-ray angle is sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939, θ = 70°. Estimate the high-NA depth of focus with DOF = λ/[2n(1 − cosθ)]: cos70° = 0.342, so DOF = 193/(2×1.437×0.658) = 193/1.891 ≈ 102 nm, close to the paraxial λ/NA² ≈ 106 nm. Build the focus budget in quadrature: wafer topography 25 nm, stage focus 15 nm, lens field curvature 10 nm and levelling sensor 10 nm give RSS = √(625+225+100+100) = √1050 ≈ 32 nm; counting both sides, 2×32 = 64 nm, leaving about 102 − 64 = 38 nm of usable depth of focus for the resist process. With CD = 40 nm at k₁ = 0.28, the ±10% CD tolerance is ±4 nm, and the Bossung curves must hold that tolerance across those 38 nm. All values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」與「照明設定、部分同調與遠心」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries" and "Illumination settings, partial coherence and telecentricity": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Projection-lens NA and image space” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 投影光學把光罩圖形縮小 4 倍成像到晶圓，能印出的最小特徵由 Rayleigh 關係 CD = k₁·λ/NA 決定：λ 是曝光波長，NA 是像方數值孔徑，k₁ 是由照明、光罩與光阻製程共同決定的製程因子，物理下限為 0.25。景深則隨 NA 平方縮小，DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA²，所以提高 NA 換來解析度的同時，晶圓平坦度、對焦控制與鏡頭場曲的預算都被壓縮。ArF 浸潤式以水的折射率 1.437 把 NA 推到 1.35，EUV 則以 13.5 nm 波長在 NA 0.33 與 0.55 上取得更小的 CD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The projection optics image the reticle pattern onto the wafer at 4× reduction, and the smallest printable feature follows the Rayleigh relation CD = k₁·λ/NA, where λ is the exposure wavelength, NA the image-side numerical aperture and k₁ a process factor set jointly by illumination, mask and resist with a physical floor of 0.25. Depth of focus shrinks with the square of NA, DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA², so every gain in resolution from NA compresses the budget left for wafer flatness, focus control and lens field curvature. ArF immersion uses water with index 1.437 to reach NA 1.35, while EUV reaches smaller CD at 13.5 nm with NA 0.33 and 0.55. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Projection-lens NA and image space”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要 k₁ 設得夠小，單次曝光就能印出任何間距。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Projection-lens NA and image space”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界
knowledge.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries
knowledge.text: 投影光學把光罩圖形縮小 4 倍成像到晶圓，能印出的最小特徵由 Rayleigh 關係 CD = k₁·λ/NA 決定：λ 是曝光波長，NA 是像方數值孔徑，k₁ 是由照明、光罩與光阻製程共同決定的製程因子，物理下限為 0.25。景深則隨 NA 平方縮小，DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA²，所以提高 NA 換來解析度的同時，晶圓平坦度、對焦控制與鏡頭場曲的預算都被壓縮。
knowledge.textEn: The projection optics image the reticle pattern onto the wafer at 4× reduction, and the smallest printable feature follows the Rayleigh relation CD = k₁·λ/NA, where λ is the exposure wavelength, NA the image-side numerical aperture and k₁ a process factor set jointly by illumination, mask and resist with a physical floor of 0.25. Depth of focus shrinks with the square of NA, DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA², so every gain in resolution from NA compresses the budget left for wafer flatness, focus control and lens field curvature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要 k₁ 設得夠小，單次曝光就能印出任何間距。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries" is correct?
options: 只要 k₁ 設得夠小，單次曝光就能印出任何間距。
投影光學把光罩圖形縮小 4 倍成像到晶圓，能印出的最小特徵由 Rayleigh 關係 CD = k₁·λ/NA 決定：λ 是曝光波長，NA 是像方數值孔徑，k₁ 是由照明、光罩與光阻製程共同決定的製程因子，物理下限為 0.25。
σ 越大照明越亮，所以解析度一定越好。
optionsEn: With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch.

The projection optics image the reticle pattern onto the wafer at 4× reduction, and the smallest printable feature follows the Rayleigh relation CD = k₁·λ/NA, where λ is the exposure wavelength, NA the image-side numerical aperture and k₁ a process factor set jointly by illumination, mask and resist with a physical floor of 0.25.
A larger σ means brighter illumination and therefore always better resolution.
quiz.explanation: 投影光學把光罩圖形縮小 4 倍成像到晶圓，能印出的最小特徵由 Rayleigh 關係 CD = k₁·λ/NA 決定：λ 是曝光波長，NA 是像方數值孔徑，k₁ 是由照明、光罩與光阻製程共同決定的製程因子，物理下限為 0.25。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The projection optics image the reticle pattern onto the wafer at 4× reduction, and the smallest printable feature follows the Rayleigh relation CD = k₁·λ/NA, where λ is the exposure wavelength, NA the image-side numerical aperture and k₁ a process factor set jointly by illumination, mask and resist with a physical floor of 0.25. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Projection-lens NA and image space” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 λ = 193 nm、NA = 1.35、k₁ = 0.28：CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm；最小可解析半週期為 λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm（k₁ = 0.25）。EUV 取 λ = 13.5 nm、NA = 0.33、k₁ = 0.4：CD ≈ 16 nm；NA = 0.55 時約 10 nm。近軸景深 λ/NA² 在浸潤式為 193/1.8225 ≈ 106 nm，在 EUV NA 0.33 為 124 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25). For EUV with λ = 13.5 nm, NA = 0.33 and k₁ = 0.4, CD ≈ 16 nm, and about 10 nm at NA 0.55. The paraxial depth of focus λ/NA² is 193/1.8225 ≈ 106 nm for immersion and 124 nm for EUV at NA 0.33. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25). For EUV with λ = 13.5 nm, NA = 0.33 and k₁ = 0.4, CD ≈ 16 nm, and about 10 nm at NA 0.55. The paraxial depth of focus λ/NA² is 193/1.8225 ≈ 106 nm for immersion and 124 nm for EUV at NA 0.33.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 浸潤只是讓鏡頭更靠近晶圓，與 NA 無關。
鏡片吸收不到 1%，熱效應可以忽略。
optionsEn: Immersion merely brings the lens closer to the wafer and does not affect NA.
Elements absorb under 1%, so thermal effects are negligible.
With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25).
quiz.explanationEn: With λ = 193 nm, NA = 1.35 and k₁ = 0.28, CD = 0.28×193/1.35 ≈ 40 nm; the smallest resolvable half-pitch is λ/(4NA) = 193/5.4 ≈ 36 nm (k₁ = 0.25). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Projection-lens NA and image space” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只按 CD 公式選 NA 而忽略景深縮小，晶圓高低差與對焦雜訊會吃掉整個製程窗口，結果是場邊緣線條隨機斷線或橋接，而鏡頭本身的像差數據卻完全合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Choosing NA from the CD formula alone while ignoring the shrinking depth of focus lets wafer topography and focus noise consume the whole process window, so lines at the field edge randomly break or bridge even though the lens aberration data pass every specification.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。
knowledge.textEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries"?
options: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。
optionsEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely.
quiz.explanation: 用測試光罩印出一組不同間距的線條，以 CD-SEM 量測最小仍能解析的半週期，反推實際 k₁ 並與 0.25 下限比較；再做對焦曝光矩陣（FEM）畫出 Bossung 曲線，讀出 CD 維持在 ±10% 內的可用景深，與 λ/NA² 估計值核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Print a set of line pitches from a test reticle, measure the smallest half-pitch still resolved with a CD-SEM, back out the actual k₁ and compare it with the 0.25 floor; then run a focus-exposure matrix, plot Bossung curves and read the usable depth of focus over which CD stays within ±10%, checking it against the λ/NA² estimate. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Projection-lens NA and image space” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若只按 CD 公式選 NA 而忽略景深縮小，晶圓高低差與對焦雜訊會吃掉整個製程窗口，結果是場邊緣線條隨機斷線或橋接，而鏡頭本身的像差數據卻完全合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing NA from the CD formula alone while ignoring the shrinking depth of focus lets wafer topography and focus noise consume the whole process window, so lines at the field edge randomly break or bridge even though the lens aberration data pass every specification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ArF 浸潤式以水的折射率 1.437 把 NA 推到 1.35，EUV 則以 13.5 nm 波長在 NA 0.33 與 0.55 上取得更小的 CD。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ArF immersion uses water with index 1.437 to reach NA 1.35, while EUV reaches smaller CD at 13.5 nm with NA 0.33 and 0.55.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要 k₁ 設得夠小，單次曝光就能印出任何間距。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只按 CD 公式選 NA 而忽略景深縮小，晶圓高低差與對焦雜訊會吃掉整個製程窗口，結果是場邊緣線條隨機斷線或橋接，而鏡頭本身的像差數據卻完全合格。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing NA from the CD formula alone while ignoring the shrinking depth of focus lets wafer topography and focus noise consume the whole process window, so lines at the field edge randomly break or bridge even though the lens aberration data pass every specification.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

σ 越大照明越亮，所以解析度一定越好。
