steps.title: 照明設定、部分同調與遠心：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Illumination settings, partial coherence and telecentricity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「照明光瞳與部分同調」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Illumination pupil and partial coherence” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 照明系統把雷射光整形成光瞳上的特定分佈，用 σ 表示照明 NA 與投影 NA 的比值；離軸照明（環形、雙極）讓零階與一階繞射光對稱落入光瞳，能把可解析間距推到 λ/(2NA)。投影鏡頭在像方必須遠心：主光線垂直於晶圓，否則離焦會轉成放大率變化與套刻位移。光罩側也接近遠心，以降低光罩高度變化造成的位移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「照明光瞳與部分同調」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The illuminator shapes the laser beam into a chosen pupil distribution, with σ denoting the ratio of illumination NA to projection NA; off-axis schemes such as annular or dipole illumination place the zeroth and first diffraction orders symmetrically in the pupil, pushing the resolvable pitch toward λ/(2NA). The projection lens must be telecentric on the image side, with chief rays normal to the wafer, otherwise defocus turns into magnification change and overlay shift. The reticle side is also nearly telecentric to suppress placement errors from reticle height variation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Illumination pupil and partial coherence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：部分同調照明下可解析的最小間距為 p_min = λ/(NA·(1+σ))：σ = 0.5 時 p_min = 193/(1.35×1.5) ≈ 95 nm；σ = 1 時 ≈ 72 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under partially coherent illumination the minimum resolvable pitch is p_min = λ/(NA·(1+σ)): with σ = 0.5, p_min = 193/(1.35×1.5) ≈ 95 nm, and about 72 nm at σ = 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「σ 越大照明越亮，所以解析度一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger σ means brighter illumination and therefore always better resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「照明光瞳與部分同調」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Illumination pupil and partial coherence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 照明設定、部分同調與遠心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Illumination settings, partial coherence and telecentricity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「照明光瞳與部分同調」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Illumination pupil and partial coherence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：部分同調照明下可解析的最小間距為 p_min = λ/(NA·(1+σ))：σ = 0.5 時 p_min = 193/(1.35×1.5) ≈ 95 nm；σ = 1 時 ≈ 72 nm。像方遠心誤差 θ_t = 5 mrad 配上 100 nm 離焦，會造成 Δx = θ_t·Δz = 0.5 nm 的套刻位移，已占奈米級套刻預算的三分之一。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Under partially coherent illumination the minimum resolvable pitch is p_min = λ/(NA·(1+σ)): with σ = 0.5, p_min = 193/(1.35×1.5) ≈ 95 nm, and about 72 nm at σ = 1. An image-side telecentricity error of θ_t = 5 mrad combined with 100 nm of defocus produces an overlay shift Δx = θ_t·Δz = 0.5 nm, already a third of a nanometre-class overlay budget. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光瞳量測感測器在晶圓台上記錄照明光瞳影像，比較實際 σ、環形內外徑與設定值；再以不同離焦量曝光同一套刻標記，量測位移對離焦的斜率，直接得到各場點的遠心誤差並畫成場圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record the illumination pupil with a pupil-measurement sensor on the wafer stage and compare the actual σ and annulus radii with the settings; then expose the same overlay marks at several defocus values and measure the slope of shift versus defocus, which gives the telecentricity error at every field point as a map.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 部分同調照明下可解析的最小間距為 p_min = λ/(NA·(1+σ))：σ = 0.5 時 p_min = 193/(1.35×1.5) ≈ 95 nm；σ = 1 時 ≈ 72 nm。像方遠心誤差 θ_t = 5 mrad 配上 100 nm 離焦，會造成 Δx = θ_t·Δz = 0.5 nm 的套刻位移，已占奈米級套刻預算的三分之一。
knowledge.textEn: Under partially coherent illumination the minimum resolvable pitch is p_min = λ/(NA·(1+σ)): with σ = 0.5, p_min = 193/(1.35×1.5) ≈ 95 nm, and about 72 nm at σ = 1. An image-side telecentricity error of θ_t = 5 mrad combined with 100 nm of defocus produces an overlay shift Δx = θ_t·Δz = 0.5 nm, already a third of a nanometre-class overlay budget.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 照明設定、部分同調與遠心：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Illumination settings, partial coherence and telecentricity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「照明光瞳與部分同調」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Illumination pupil and partial coherence” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光瞳量測感測器在晶圓台上記錄照明光瞳影像，比較實際 σ、環形內外徑與設定值；再以不同離焦量曝光同一套刻標記，量測位移對離焦的斜率，直接得到各場點的遠心誤差並畫成場圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record the illumination pupil with a pupil-measurement sensor on the wafer stage and compare the actual σ and annulus radii with the settings; then expose the same overlay marks at several defocus values and measure the slope of shift versus defocus, which gives the telecentricity error at every field point as a map. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：照明光瞳若因鏡片污染而不對稱，雙極兩瓣能量不等，水平與垂直線條的 CD 出現系統性差異（H-V bias），並隨劑量漂移，常被誤判為光阻問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If lens contamination makes the illumination pupil asymmetric so that the two dipole lobes carry unequal energy, horizontal and vertical lines show a systematic CD difference (H-V bias) that drifts with dose and is often misdiagnosed as a resist problem.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以光瞳量測感測器在晶圓台上記錄照明光瞳影像，比較實際 σ、環形內外徑與設定值；再以不同離焦量曝光同一套刻標記，量測位移對離焦的斜率，直接得到各場點的遠心誤差並畫成場圖。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「照明設定、部分同調與遠心」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Illumination settings, partial coherence and telecentricity"?

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「照明光瞳與部分同調」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Illumination pupil and partial coherence” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 照明光瞳若因鏡片污染而不對稱，雙極兩瓣能量不等，水平與垂直線條的 CD 出現系統性差異（H-V bias），並隨劑量漂移，常被誤判為光阻問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If lens contamination makes the illumination pupil asymmetric so that the two dipole lobes carry unequal energy, horizontal and vertical lines show a systematic CD difference (H-V bias) that drifts with dose and is often misdiagnosed as a resist problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：光罩側也接近遠心，以降低光罩高度變化造成的位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The reticle side is also nearly telecentric to suppress placement errors from reticle height variation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「σ 越大照明越亮，所以解析度一定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger σ means brighter illumination and therefore always better resolution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「照明設定、部分同調與遠心」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Illumination settings, partial coherence and telecentricity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Refractive surfaces need figure as tight as mirrors.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算」與「折反射架構、浸潤與偏振控制」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets" and "Catadioptric architecture, immersion and polarization control": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 193 nm 可用的透鏡材料只有高純度熔融石英（n ≈ 1.560）與氟化鈣（n ≈ 1.501），兩者在深紫外的色散都很大，所以鏡頭幾乎無法消色差，必須靠雷射線寬窄化到 0.3 pm 等級來避免色像差。折射面的面形誤差 h 轉成波前誤差時乘上 (n − 1)，約為 0.56h，比反射鏡的 2h 寬鬆近四倍，但鏡頭有數十片元件，總波前預算仍須分配到次奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Only high-purity fused silica (n ≈ 1.560) and calcium fluoride (n ≈ 1.501) transmit well enough at 193 nm, and both disperse strongly in the deep UV, so the lens can barely be achromatised and instead relies on a laser linewidth narrowed to the 0.3 pm level to avoid chromatic aberration. A refracting surface converts a figure error h into wavefront error (n − 1)h, about 0.56h, nearly four times more forgiving than the 2h of a mirror, but with tens of elements the total wavefront budget still has to be split into sub-nanometre shares. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若系統波前 RMS 預算為 2.0 nm、由 30 片元件等額分擔，每片允許 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm 波前，對應熔融石英表面面形 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS；同樣預算若給 6 片反射鏡，每片為 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm 波前，即 0.41 nm 面形。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the system wavefront RMS budget is 2.0 nm shared equally by 30 elements, each element may contribute 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm of wavefront, corresponding to a fused-silica surface figure of 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS; the same budget spread over 6 mirrors allows 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm of wavefront per mirror, i.e. 0.41 nm of figure.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「折射鏡頭的面形要求和反射鏡一樣嚴格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Refractive surfaces need figure as tight as mirrors." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算
knowledge.titleEn: DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets
knowledge.text: 193 nm 可用的透鏡材料只有高純度熔融石英（n ≈ 1.560）與氟化鈣（n ≈ 1.501），兩者在深紫外的色散都很大，所以鏡頭幾乎無法消色差，必須靠雷射線寬窄化到 0.3 pm 等級來避免色像差。折射面的面形誤差 h 轉成波前誤差時乘上 (n − 1)，約為 0.56h，比反射鏡的 2h 寬鬆近四倍，但鏡頭有數十片元件，總波前預算仍須分配到次奈米。

A refracting surface converts a figure error h into wavefront error (n − 1)h, about 0.56h, nearly four times more forgiving than the 2h of a mirror, but with tens of elements the total wavefront budget still has to be split into sub-nanometre shares.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：折射鏡頭的面形要求和反射鏡一樣嚴格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Refractive surfaces need figure as tight as mirrors. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets" is correct?

浸潤只是讓鏡頭更靠近晶圓，與 NA 無關。

Refractive surfaces need figure as tight as mirrors.
Immersion merely brings the lens closer to the wafer and does not affect NA.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若系統波前 RMS 預算為 2.0 nm、由 30 片元件等額分擔，每片允許 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm 波前，對應熔融石英表面面形 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS；同樣預算若給 6 片反射鏡，每片為 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm 波前，即 0.41 nm 面形。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the system wavefront RMS budget is 2.0 nm shared equally by 30 elements, each element may contribute 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm of wavefront, corresponding to a fused-silica surface figure of 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS; the same budget spread over 6 mirrors allows 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm of wavefront per mirror, i.e. 0.41 nm of figure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每片鏡片以干涉儀量測面形後換算成 193 nm 的波前貢獻，核對是否在分配值內；材料則用 193 nm 透過率與雷射誘發吸收量測，並以干涉儀量測整塊毛胚的折射率均勻性，確認體內折射率變化不會另外吃掉波前預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each element's figure interferometrically, convert it to wavefront contribution at 193 nm and check it against the allocation; qualify the material with 193 nm transmission and laser-induced absorption tests, and map the refractive-index homogeneity of each blank with an interferometer so that bulk index variation does not silently consume the wavefront budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若系統波前 RMS 預算為 2.0 nm、由 30 片元件等額分擔，每片允許 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm 波前，對應熔融石英表面面形 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS；同樣預算若給 6 片反射鏡，每片為 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm 波前，即 0.41 nm 面形。
knowledge.textEn: If the system wavefront RMS budget is 2.0 nm shared equally by 30 elements, each element may contribute 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm of wavefront, corresponding to a fused-silica surface figure of 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS; the same budget spread over 6 mirrors allows 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm of wavefront per mirror, i.e. 0.41 nm of figure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets", which statement holds?
options: 鏡片吸收不到 1%，熱效應可以忽略。
若系統波前 RMS 預算為 2.0 nm、由 30 片元件等額分擔，每片允許 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm 波前，對應熔融石英表面面形 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS。
鏡頭通過干涉儀驗收，就不需要再做曝光驗證。
optionsEn: Elements absorb under 1%, so thermal effects are negligible.

If the system wavefront RMS budget is 2.0 nm shared equally by 30 elements, each element may contribute 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm of wavefront, corresponding to a fused-silica surface figure of 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS.
A lens that passes interferometric acceptance needs no exposure validation.
quiz.explanation: 若系統波前 RMS 預算為 2.0 nm、由 30 片元件等額分擔，每片允許 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm 波前，對應熔融石英表面面形 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS；同樣預算若給 6 片反射鏡，每片為 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm 波前，即 0.41 nm 面形。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the system wavefront RMS budget is 2.0 nm shared equally by 30 elements, each element may contribute 2.0/√30 ≈ 0.37 nm of wavefront, corresponding to a fused-silica surface figure of 0.37/0.56 ≈ 0.65 nm RMS; the same budget spread over 6 mirrors allows 2.0/√6 ≈ 0.82 nm of wavefront per mirror, i.e. 0.41 nm of figure. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每片鏡片以干涉儀量測面形後換算成 193 nm 的波前貢獻，核對是否在分配值內；材料則用 193 nm 透過率與雷射誘發吸收量測，並以干涉儀量測整塊毛胚的折射率均勻性，確認體內折射率變化不會另外吃掉波前預算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each element's figure interferometrically, convert it to wavefront contribution at 193 nm and check it against the allocation; qualify the material with 193 nm transmission and laser-induced absorption tests, and map the refractive-index homogeneity of each blank with an interferometer so that bulk index variation does not silently consume the wavefront budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：熔融石英在高能量密度下會形成色心與緻密化，折射率局部上升，鏡頭隨累積劑量逐漸出現球差與透過率下降；若未在材料驗證中做壽命外推，鏡頭在現場數年後才失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Under high fluence fused silica develops colour centres and compaction that raise the local refractive index, so the lens slowly gains spherical aberration and loses transmission with accumulated dose; without lifetime extrapolation during material qualification the lens fails in the field only after years.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每片鏡片以干涉儀量測面形後換算成 193 nm 的波前貢獻，核對是否在分配值內；材料則用 193 nm 透過率與雷射誘發吸收量測，並以干涉儀量測整塊毛胚的折射率均勻性，確認體內折射率變化不會另外吃掉波前預算。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each element's figure interferometrically, convert it to wavefront contribution at 193 nm and check it against the allocation; qualify the material with 193 nm transmission and laser-induced absorption tests, and map the refractive-index homogeneity of each blank with an interferometer so that bulk index variation does not silently consume the wavefront budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
只要 k₁ 設得夠小，單次曝光就能印出任何間距。
每片鏡片以干涉儀量測面形後換算成 193 nm 的波前貢獻，核對是否在分配值內。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch.
Measure each element's figure interferometrically, convert it to wavefront contribution at 193 nm and check it against the allocation.
quiz.explanation: 每片鏡片以干涉儀量測面形後換算成 193 nm 的波前貢獻，核對是否在分配值內；材料則用 193 nm 透過率與雷射誘發吸收量測，並以干涉儀量測整塊毛胚的折射率均勻性，確認體內折射率變化不會另外吃掉波前預算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each element's figure interferometrically, convert it to wavefront contribution at 193 nm and check it against the allocation; qualify the material with 193 nm transmission and laser-induced absorption tests, and map the refractive-index homogeneity of each blank with an interferometer so that bulk index variation does not silently consume the wavefront budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 深紫外鏡片材料、色散與面形預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: DUV lens materials, dispersion and figure budgets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 熔融石英在高能量密度下會形成色心與緻密化，折射率局部上升，鏡頭隨累積劑量逐漸出現球差與透過率下降；若未在材料驗證中做壽命外推，鏡頭在現場數年後才失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Under high fluence fused silica develops colour centres and compaction that raise the local refractive index, so the lens slowly gains spherical aberration and loses transmission with accumulated dose; without lifetime extrapolation during material qualification the lens fails in the field only after years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：折射面的面形誤差 h 轉成波前誤差時乘上 (n − 1)，約為 0.56h，比反射鏡的 2h 寬鬆近四倍，但鏡頭有數十片元件，總波前預算仍須分配到次奈米。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A refracting surface converts a figure error h into wavefront error (n − 1)h, about 0.56h, nearly four times more forgiving than the 2h of a mirror, but with tens of elements the total wavefront budget still has to be split into sub-nanometre shares.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「折射鏡頭的面形要求和反射鏡一樣嚴格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Refractive surfaces need figure as tight as mirrors." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 折反射架構、浸潤與偏振控制：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Catadioptric architecture, immersion and polarization control: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「折反射浸潤式末端鏡組」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catadioptric immersion final group” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: NA 超過 1 時，光在像方介質中的角度極大，純折射設計需要巨大的鏡片直徑與難以修正的場曲，因此高 NA 鏡頭採用折反射架構：以凹面鏡提供負 Petzval 貢獻並壓縮鏡片尺寸。末端鏡片以平面接觸水膜，水的折射率 1.437 把像方 NA 提高。在這麼大的角度下，TM 偏振的兩束干涉對比隨 cos(2θ) 下降甚至反相，因此照明必須以 TE 偏振為主並由鏡頭保持偏振純度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折反射浸潤式末端鏡組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Above NA 1 the ray angles in the image medium become extreme, and an all-refractive design would need huge element diameters and uncorrectable field curvature, so high-NA lenses use a catadioptric layout in which a concave mirror supplies negative Petzval contribution and shrinks the elements. The final element touches the water film with a flat face, and the water index of 1.437 raises the image-side NA. At such angles the two-beam interference contrast for TM polarization falls as cos(2θ) and can even invert, so illumination must be predominantly TE polarized and the lens must preserve that polarization purity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Catadioptric immersion final group”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：NA = 1.35 時水中邊緣光角度 sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939，θ ≈ 70°；進入光阻（n = 1.7）後 sinθ = 0.794，θ ≈ 52.6°，TM 干涉對比因子 cos(2θ) = cos(105.1°) ≈ −0.26，表示未偏振照明的對比會被嚴重稀釋；TE 偏振的對比因子維持 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At NA = 1.35 the marginal ray in water has sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939, θ ≈ 70°; inside resist with n = 1.7, sinθ = 0.794 and θ ≈ 52.6°, so the TM interference-contrast factor cos(2θ) = cos(105.1°) ≈ −0.26, meaning unpolarized illumination would badly dilute the contrast, whereas TE polarization keeps the factor at 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浸潤只是讓鏡頭更靠近晶圓，與 NA 無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Immersion merely brings the lens closer to the wafer and does not affect NA." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「折反射浸潤式末端鏡組」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Catadioptric immersion final group”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 折反射架構、浸潤與偏振控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catadioptric architecture, immersion and polarization control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折反射浸潤式末端鏡組」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catadioptric immersion final group” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：NA = 1.35 時水中邊緣光角度 sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939，θ ≈ 70°；進入光阻（n = 1.7）後 sinθ = 0.794，θ ≈ 52.6°，TM 干涉對比因子 cos(2θ) = cos(105.1°) ≈ −0.26，表示未偏振照明的對比會被嚴重稀釋；TE 偏振的對比因子維持 1。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At NA = 1.35 the marginal ray in water has sinθ = 1.35/1.437 = 0.939, θ ≈ 70°; inside resist with n = 1.7, sinθ = 0.794 and θ ≈ 52.6°, so the TM interference-contrast factor cos(2θ) = cos(105.1°) ≈ −0.26, meaning unpolarized illumination would badly dilute the contrast, whereas TE polarization keeps the factor at 1. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用晶圓台上的偏振量測感測器量鏡頭出瞳的 Stokes 參數，計算照明偏振純度（IPS）與鏡頭的偏振相位延遲；再以水平與垂直雙極照明分別曝光同一間距，比較對比與 CD 差異，與 cos(2θ) 模型預測核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the Stokes parameters at the lens exit pupil with a polarization sensor on the wafer stage to compute illumination polarization purity and the lens retardance; then expose the same pitch with horizontal and vertical dipoles and compare contrast and CD differences against the cos(2θ) model prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 折反射架構、浸潤與偏振控制：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catadioptric architecture, immersion and polarization control: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「折反射浸潤式末端鏡組」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Catadioptric immersion final group” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用晶圓台上的偏振量測感測器量鏡頭出瞳的 Stokes 參數，計算照明偏振純度（IPS）與鏡頭的偏振相位延遲；再以水平與垂直雙極照明分別曝光同一間距，比較對比與 CD 差異，與 cos(2θ) 模型預測核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the Stokes parameters at the lens exit pupil with a polarization sensor on the wafer stage to compute illumination polarization purity and the lens retardance; then expose the same pitch with horizontal and vertical dipoles and compare contrast and CD differences against the cos(2θ) model prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：CaF₂ 的本質雙折射與鏡片應力雙折射會把 TE 光部分轉成 TM，偏振純度下降幾個百分點就讓最小間距的對比明顯變差；水膜中若出現氣泡或局部溫度變化，則直接造成局部離焦與缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Intrinsic birefringence of CaF₂ and stress birefringence in elements convert part of the TE light into TM, and a few percent loss of polarization purity visibly degrades contrast at the smallest pitch; bubbles or local temperature changes in the water film cause local defocus and printed defects directly.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。

steps.instruction: CaF₂ 的本質雙折射與鏡片應力雙折射會把 TE 光部分轉成 TM，偏振純度下降幾個百分點就讓最小間距的對比明顯變差；水膜中若出現氣泡或局部溫度變化，則直接造成局部離焦與缺陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Intrinsic birefringence of CaF₂ and stress birefringence in elements convert part of the TE light into TM, and a few percent loss of polarization purity visibly degrades contrast at the smallest pitch; bubbles or local temperature changes in the water film cause local defocus and printed defects directly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在這麼大的角度下，TM 偏振的兩束干涉對比隨 cos(2θ) 下降甚至反相，因此照明必須以 TE 偏振為主並由鏡頭保持偏振純度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At such angles the two-beam interference contrast for TM polarization falls as cos(2θ) and can even invert, so illumination must be predominantly TE polarized and the lens must preserve that polarization purity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浸潤只是讓鏡頭更靠近晶圓，與 NA 無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Immersion merely brings the lens closer to the wafer and does not affect NA." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "In-situ wavefront metrology and Zernike decomposition" and "Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: In-situ wavefront metrology and Zernike decomposition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微影機在晶圓台上裝有干涉式波前感測器，以鏡頭本身的曝光光經過光罩側的針孔或光柵，在像方量測整個出瞳的波前，並分解成 Zernike 多項式係數 Z₂ 到 Z₃₇ 以上。低階的傾斜與離焦對應套刻位移與最佳焦面，彗差與球差造成圖形位移隨間距改變與 CD 隨焦距不對稱，像散造成水平與垂直線最佳焦面分離。每個場點都要量，因為像差隨場變化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The scanner carries an interferometric wavefront sensor on the wafer stage that uses the exposure light itself, passing through a pinhole or grating on the reticle side, to measure the full exit-pupil wavefront at the image and decompose it into Zernike coefficients from Z₂ up to Z₃₇ and beyond. Low-order tilt and defocus map to overlay shift and best-focus position, coma and spherical aberration produce pitch-dependent pattern shift and asymmetric CD through focus, and astigmatism separates the best focus of horizontal and vertical lines. Every field point must be measured because aberrations vary across the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：傾斜項 Z₂ 係數 a₂ 造成像位移 Δx = a₂/NA：a₂ = 1 nm、NA = 1.35 時 Δx ≈ 0.74 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A tilt coefficient a₂ of Z₂ shifts the image by Δx = a₂/NA: with a₂ = 1 nm and NA = 1.35, Δx ≈ 0.74 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡頭出廠時的波前數據可以一直沿用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The factory wavefront data of a lens remain valid indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: In-situ wavefront metrology and Zernike decomposition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：傾斜項 Z₂ 係數 a₂ 造成像位移 Δx = a₂/NA：a₂ = 1 nm、NA = 1.35 時 Δx ≈ 0.74 nm。離焦項的近軸關係為 a₄ ≈ Δz·NA²/(4n)，故 a₄ = 1 nm 對應 Δz = 4n·a₄/NA² = 4×1.437/1.8225 ≈ 3.2 nm 的焦面偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A tilt coefficient a₂ of Z₂ shifts the image by Δx = a₂/NA: with a₂ = 1 nm and NA = 1.35, Δx ≈ 0.74 nm. The paraxial defocus relation is a₄ ≈ Δz·NA²/(4n), so a₄ = 1 nm corresponds to a focus offset Δz = 4n·a₄/NA² = 4×1.437/1.8225 ≈ 3.2 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個場點重複量測波前，計算各 Zernike 項的重現性（通常要優於 0.1 nm），再用已知的靈敏度把 Z₇ 彗差預測的圖形位移與實際曝光的套刻量測比較，確認感測器座標、符號與縮放都與曝光結果一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat the wavefront measurement at several field points, compute the repeatability of each Zernike term (typically required to be better than 0.1 nm), then compare the pattern shift predicted from the measured Z₇ coma through known sensitivities with the overlay actually printed, confirming that sensor coordinates, sign conventions and scaling agree with exposure results.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 傾斜項 Z₂ 係數 a₂ 造成像位移 Δx = a₂/NA：a₂ = 1 nm、NA = 1.35 時 Δx ≈ 0.74 nm。離焦項的近軸關係為 a₄ ≈ Δz·NA²/(4n)，故 a₄ = 1 nm 對應 Δz = 4n·a₄/NA² = 4×1.437/1.8225 ≈ 3.2 nm 的焦面偏移。
knowledge.textEn: A tilt coefficient a₂ of Z₂ shifts the image by Δx = a₂/NA: with a₂ = 1 nm and NA = 1.35, Δx ≈ 0.74 nm. The paraxial defocus relation is a₄ ≈ Δz·NA²/(4n), so a₄ = 1 nm corresponds to a focus offset Δz = 4n·a₄/NA² = 4×1.437/1.8225 ≈ 3.2 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "In-situ wavefront metrology and Zernike decomposition", which statement holds?
options: 傾斜項 Z₂ 係數 a₂ 造成像位移 Δx = a₂/NA：a₂ = 1 nm、NA = 1.35 時 Δx ≈ 0.74 nm。
鏡頭通過干涉儀驗收，就不需要再做曝光驗證。
σ 越大照明越亮，所以解析度一定越好。
optionsEn: A tilt coefficient a₂ of Z₂ shifts the image by Δx = a₂/NA: with a₂ = 1 nm and NA = 1.35, Δx ≈ 0.74 nm.
A lens that passes interferometric acceptance needs no exposure validation.
A larger σ means brighter illumination and therefore always better resolution.
quiz.explanation: 傾斜項 Z₂ 係數 a₂ 造成像位移 Δx = a₂/NA：a₂ = 1 nm、NA = 1.35 時 Δx ≈ 0.74 nm。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: In-situ wavefront metrology and Zernike decomposition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在多個場點重複量測波前，計算各 Zernike 項的重現性（通常要優於 0.1 nm），再用已知的靈敏度把 Z₇ 彗差預測的圖形位移與實際曝光的套刻量測比較，確認感測器座標、符號與縮放都與曝光結果一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat the wavefront measurement at several field points, compute the repeatability of each Zernike term (typically required to be better than 0.1 nm), then compare the pattern shift predicted from the measured Z₇ coma through known sensitivities with the overlay actually printed, confirming that sensor coordinates, sign conventions and scaling agree with exposure results. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若感測器與曝光座標的符號約定不一致，校正動作會把像差加倍而不是消除；若只在場中心量測，場邊緣的像散與彗差未被看到，CD 場內均勻性就會超差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the sensor and exposure coordinate sign conventions disagree, the correction doubles the aberration instead of cancelling it; measuring only at field centre leaves edge astigmatism and coma unseen, so CD uniformity across the field fails.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在多個場點重複量測波前，計算各 Zernike 項的重現性（通常要優於 0.1 nm），再用已知的靈敏度把 Z₇ 彗差預測的圖形位移與實際曝光的套刻量測比較，確認感測器座標、符號與縮放都與曝光結果一致。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat the wavefront measurement at several field points, compute the repeatability of each Zernike term (typically required to be better than 0.1 nm), then compare the pattern shift predicted from the measured Z₇ coma through known sensitivities with the overlay actually printed, confirming that sensor coordinates, sign conventions and scaling agree with exposure results.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "In-situ wavefront metrology and Zernike decomposition"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在多個場點重複量測波前，計算各 Zernike 項的重現性（通常要優於 0.1 nm），再用已知的靈敏度把 Z₇ 彗差預測的圖形位移與實際曝光的套刻量測比較，確認感測器座標、符號與縮放都與曝光結果一致。
折射鏡頭的面形要求和反射鏡一樣嚴格。

quiz.explanationEn: Repeat the wavefront measurement at several field points, compute the repeatability of each Zernike term (typically required to be better than 0.1 nm), then compare the pattern shift predicted from the measured Z₇ coma through known sensitivities with the overlay actually printed, confirming that sensor coordinates, sign conventions and scaling agree with exposure results. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若感測器與曝光座標的符號約定不一致，校正動作會把像差加倍而不是消除；若只在場中心量測，場邊緣的像散與彗差未被看到，CD 場內均勻性就會超差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the sensor and exposure coordinate sign conventions disagree, the correction doubles the aberration instead of cancelling it; measuring only at field centre leaves edge astigmatism and coma unseen, so CD uniformity across the field fails. steps.title: 鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曝光光在鏡片材料與鍍膜中的微量吸收會讓鏡片升溫，熔融石英在 193 nm 的 dn/dT 約 2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹，溫度分佈又跟照明光瞳形狀相關：雙極照明只加熱光瞳上的兩個區域，於是產生與時間相關的像散與高階像差。這種漂移在每批晶圓曝光期間以分鐘尺度變化，必須以熱模型預測並由鏡頭操縱器即時補償，誤差預算要同時包含量測不確定度與模型殘差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Weak absorption of the exposure light in element materials and coatings heats the elements, and fused silica has dn/dT of about 2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ at 193 nm; because the heating pattern follows the illumination pupil, a dipole heats only two zones of a pupil-plane element and generates time-dependent astigmatism and higher-order aberrations. The drift evolves on a minute scale during each lot, so it must be predicted by a thermal model and compensated in real time by lens manipulators, with the error budget covering both measurement uncertainty and model residuals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光程變化 ΔOPD = L·(dn/dT)·ΔT：光瞳面附近元件厚度 L = 20 mm、兩瓣之間溫差 ΔT = 5 mK，ΔOPD = 0.02×2×10⁻⁵×0.005 = 2×10⁻⁹ m = 2 nm 的像散型波前誤差，已等於整支鏡頭的波前預算；熱膨脹項 (n − 1)·α·ΔT·L 以 α = 0.55 ppm/K 計僅約 0.03 nm，可忽略。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The optical-path change is ΔOPD = L·(dn/dT)·ΔT: for an element of thickness L = 20 mm near the pupil with ΔT = 5 mK between the two heated lobes, ΔOPD = 0.02×2×10⁻⁵×0.005 = 2×10⁻⁹ m = 2 nm of astigmatism-like wavefront error, equal to the entire lens wavefront budget; the expansion term (n − 1)·α·ΔT·L with α = 0.55 ppm/K is only about 0.03 nm and can be neglected.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡片吸收不到 1%，熱效應可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Elements absorb under 1%, so thermal effects are negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算

The drift evolves on a minute scale during each lot, so it must be predicted by a thermal model and compensated in real time by lens manipulators, with the error budget covering both measurement uncertainty and model residuals.

steps.title: 鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光程變化 ΔOPD = L·(dn/dT)·ΔT：光瞳面附近元件厚度 L = 20 mm、兩瓣之間溫差 ΔT = 5 mK，ΔOPD = 0.02×2×10⁻⁵×0.005 = 2×10⁻⁹ m = 2 nm 的像散型波前誤差，已等於整支鏡頭的波前預算；熱膨脹項 (n − 1)·α·ΔT·L 以 α = 0.55 ppm/K 計僅約 0.03 nm，可忽略。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The optical-path change is ΔOPD = L·(dn/dT)·ΔT: for an element of thickness L = 20 mm near the pupil with ΔT = 5 mK between the two heated lobes, ΔOPD = 0.02×2×10⁻⁵×0.005 = 2×10⁻⁹ m = 2 nm of astigmatism-like wavefront error, equal to the entire lens wavefront budget; the expansion term (n − 1)·α·ΔT·L with α = 0.55 ppm/K is only about 0.03 nm and can be neglected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以固定照明設定連續曝光並每隔數分鐘量一次波前，繪出各 Zernike 項對累積劑量的曲線，擬合熱時間常數與飽和值，與熱模型比較；再切換照明設定觀察冷卻恢復曲線，確認模型能預測正反兩個方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Expose continuously with a fixed illumination setting and measure the wavefront every few minutes, plot each Zernike term against accumulated dose, fit the thermal time constant and saturation level and compare with the thermal model; then switch illumination settings and record the cooling recovery curve to confirm the model predicts both directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The optical-path change is ΔOPD = L·(dn/dT)·ΔT: for an element of thickness L = 20 mm near the pupil with ΔT = 5 mK between the two heated lobes, ΔOPD = 0.02×2×10⁻⁵×0.005 = 2×10⁻⁹ m = 2 nm of astigmatism-like wavefront error, equal to the entire lens wavefront budget; the expansion term (n − 1)·α·ΔT·L with α = 0.55 ppm/K is only about 0.03 nm and can be neglected.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

折射鏡頭的面形要求和反射鏡一樣嚴格。
optionsEn: With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch.

steps.title: 鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以固定照明設定連續曝光並每隔數分鐘量一次波前，繪出各 Zernike 項對累積劑量的曲線，擬合熱時間常數與飽和值，與熱模型比較；再切換照明設定觀察冷卻恢復曲線，確認模型能預測正反兩個方向。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Expose continuously with a fixed illumination setting and measure the wavefront every few minutes, plot each Zernike term against accumulated dose, fit the thermal time constant and saturation level and compare with the thermal model; then switch illumination settings and record the cooling recovery curve to confirm the model predicts both directions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若熱模型用錯了照明光瞳或吸收係數，前饋補償會在批次開始時過度修正、批次結束時修正不足，CD 與套刻在每批內呈現系統性的首片到末片趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the thermal model uses the wrong illumination pupil or absorption coefficient, feedforward compensation over-corrects at lot start and under-corrects at lot end, so CD and overlay show a systematic first-to-last-wafer trend within every lot.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以固定照明設定連續曝光並每隔數分鐘量一次波前，繪出各 Zernike 項對累積劑量的曲線，擬合熱時間常數與飽和值，與熱模型比較；再切換照明設定觀察冷卻恢復曲線，確認模型能預測正反兩個方向。
knowledge.textEn: Expose continuously with a fixed illumination setting and measure the wavefront every few minutes, plot each Zernike term against accumulated dose, fit the thermal time constant and saturation level and compare with the thermal model; then switch illumination settings and record the cooling recovery curve to confirm the model predicts both directions.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget"?

optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.

quiz.explanationEn: Expose continuously with a fixed illumination setting and measure the wavefront every few minutes, plot each Zernike term against accumulated dose, fit the thermal time constant and saturation level and compare with the thermal model; then switch illumination settings and record the cooling recovery curve to confirm the model predicts both directions. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若熱模型用錯了照明光瞳或吸收係數，前饋補償會在批次開始時過度修正、批次結束時修正不足，CD 與套刻在每批內呈現系統性的首片到末片趨勢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the thermal model uses the wrong illumination pupil or absorption coefficient, feedforward compensation over-corrects at lot start and under-corrects at lot end, so CD and overlay show a systematic first-to-last-wafer trend within every lot. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種漂移在每批晶圓曝光期間以分鐘尺度變化，必須以熱模型預測並由鏡頭操縱器即時補償，誤差預算要同時包含量測不確定度與模型殘差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The drift evolves on a minute scale during each lot, so it must be predicted by a thermal model and compensated in real time by lens manipulators, with the error budget covering both measurement uncertainty and model residuals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡片吸收不到 1%，熱效應可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Elements absorb under 1%, so thermal effects are negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若熱模型用錯了照明光瞳或吸收係數，前饋補償會在批次開始時過度修正、批次結束時修正不足，CD 與套刻在每批內呈現系統性的首片到末片趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: If the thermal model uses the wrong illumination pupil or absorption coefficient, feedforward compensation over-corrects at lot start and under-corrects at lot end, so CD and overlay show a systematic first-to-last-wafer trend within every lot.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鏡頭加熱、像差漂移與誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lens heating, aberration drift and the error budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若熱模型用錯了照明光瞳或吸收係數，前饋補償會在批次開始時過度修正、批次結束時修正不足，CD 與套刻在每批內呈現系統性的首片到末片趨勢。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。
optionsEn: If the thermal model uses the wrong illumination pupil or absorption coefficient, feedforward compensation over-corrects at lot start and under-corrects at lot end, so CD and overlay show a systematic first-to-last-wafer trend within every lot.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely.
quiz.explanation: 若熱模型用錯了照明光瞳或吸收係數，前饋補償會在批次開始時過度修正、批次結束時修正不足，CD 與套刻在每批內呈現系統性的首片到末片趨勢。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the thermal model uses the wrong illumination pupil or absorption coefficient, feedforward compensation over-corrects at lot start and under-corrects at lot end, so CD and overlay show a systematic first-to-last-wafer trend within every lot. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂」與「系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence" and "System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鏡頭內有若干片可由致動器沿軸向移動、傾斜或橫向平移的元件，另有可變形或可加熱的波前操縱元件；每個自由度對各 Zernike 項的靈敏度在出廠時以干涉量測建立成矩陣。校正時把量測到的像差向量以最小平方法反解成操縱器動作，同時要控制交叉耦合：修正球差的軸向移動也會改變離焦與放大率，必須由其他自由度同時抵消。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Several elements inside the lens can be moved axially, tilted or translated by actuators, and deformable or heated wavefront manipulators add further degrees of freedom; the sensitivity of each degree of freedom to every Zernike term is established interferometrically at the factory as a matrix. During correction the measured aberration vector is inverted by least squares into manipulator moves while cross-coupling is managed, because an axial move that corrects spherical aberration also changes focus and magnification and must be cancelled simultaneously by other degrees of freedom. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設某元件軸向移動對 Z₉ 球差的靈敏度為 0.10 nm/µm，對 Z₄ 離焦的交叉靈敏度為 0.30 nm/µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Suppose an element's axial move has a sensitivity of 0.10 nm/µm to Z₉ spherical aberration and a cross-sensitivity of 0.30 nm/µm to Z₄ defocus.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂
knowledge.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence
knowledge.text: 鏡頭內有若干片可由致動器沿軸向移動、傾斜或橫向平移的元件，另有可變形或可加熱的波前操縱元件；每個自由度對各 Zernike 項的靈敏度在出廠時以干涉量測建立成矩陣。校正時把量測到的像差向量以最小平方法反解成操縱器動作，同時要控制交叉耦合：修正球差的軸向移動也會改變離焦與放大率，必須由其他自由度同時抵消。
knowledge.textEn: Several elements inside the lens can be moved axially, tilted or translated by actuators, and deformable or heated wavefront manipulators add further degrees of freedom; the sensitivity of each degree of freedom to every Zernike term is established interferometrically at the factory as a matrix. During correction the measured aberration vector is inverted by least squares into manipulator moves while cross-coupling is managed, because an axial move that corrects spherical aberration also changes focus and magnification and must be cancelled simultaneously by other degrees of freedom.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence" is correct?
options: 操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。
鏡頭內有若干片可由致動器沿軸向移動、傾斜或橫向平移的元件，另有可變形或可加熱的波前操縱元件。
鏡頭通過干涉儀驗收，就不需要再做曝光驗證。
optionsEn: With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely.
Several elements inside the lens can be moved axially, tilted or translated by actuators, and deformable or heated wavefront manipulators add further degrees of freedom.
A lens that passes interferometric acceptance needs no exposure validation.
quiz.explanation: 鏡頭內有若干片可由致動器沿軸向移動、傾斜或橫向平移的元件，另有可變形或可加熱的波前操縱元件；每個自由度對各 Zernike 項的靈敏度在出廠時以干涉量測建立成矩陣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Several elements inside the lens can be moved axially, tilted or translated by actuators, and deformable or heated wavefront manipulators add further degrees of freedom; the sensitivity of each degree of freedom to every Zernike term is established interferometrically at the factory as a matrix. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設某元件軸向移動對 Z₉ 球差的靈敏度為 0.10 nm/µm，對 Z₄ 離焦的交叉靈敏度為 0.30 nm/µm。要修正 1.5 nm 的 Z₉ 需移動 15 µm，同時引入 4.5 nm 的 Z₄，必須由對焦系統抵消；致動器 20 nm 的解析度留下 0.002 nm 的 Z₉ 殘差，表示收斂極限由靈敏度矩陣的誤差而非致動器解析度決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Suppose an element's axial move has a sensitivity of 0.10 nm/µm to Z₉ spherical aberration and a cross-sensitivity of 0.30 nm/µm to Z₄ defocus. Correcting 1.5 nm of Z₉ requires a 15 µm move that also introduces 4.5 nm of Z₄, which the focus system must cancel; the actuator's 20 nm resolution leaves a Z₉ residual of only 0.002 nm, showing that the convergence limit is set by errors in the sensitivity matrix rather than by actuator resolution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新；然後做閉環校正試驗，記錄每次疊代後的殘差 RMS，確認在兩到三次內收斂到預算以下且不出現振盪。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent; then run a closed-loop correction trial, log the residual RMS after each iteration and confirm convergence below budget within two or three iterations without oscillation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設某元件軸向移動對 Z₉ 球差的靈敏度為 0.10 nm/µm，對 Z₄ 離焦的交叉靈敏度為 0.30 nm/µm。要修正 1.5 nm 的 Z₉ 需移動 15 µm，同時引入 4.5 nm 的 Z₄，必須由對焦系統抵消；致動器 20 nm 的解析度留下 0.002 nm 的 Z₉ 殘差，表示收斂極限由靈敏度矩陣的誤差而非致動器解析度決定。
knowledge.textEn: Suppose an element's axial move has a sensitivity of 0.10 nm/µm to Z₉ spherical aberration and a cross-sensitivity of 0.30 nm/µm to Z₄ defocus. Correcting 1.5 nm of Z₉ requires a 15 µm move that also introduces 4.5 nm of Z₄, which the focus system must cancel; the actuator's 20 nm resolution leaves a Z₉ residual of only 0.002 nm, showing that the convergence limit is set by errors in the sensitivity matrix rather than by actuator resolution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence", which statement holds?
options: σ 越大照明越亮，所以解析度一定越好。
浸潤只是讓鏡頭更靠近晶圓，與 NA 無關。
設某元件軸向移動對 Z₉ 球差的靈敏度為 0.10 nm/µm，對 Z₄ 離焦的交叉靈敏度為 0.30 nm/µm。
optionsEn: A larger σ means brighter illumination and therefore always better resolution.
Immersion merely brings the lens closer to the wafer and does not affect NA.
Suppose an element's axial move has a sensitivity of 0.10 nm/µm to Z₉ spherical aberration and a cross-sensitivity of 0.30 nm/µm to Z₄ defocus.
quiz.explanation: 設某元件軸向移動對 Z₉ 球差的靈敏度為 0.10 nm/µm，對 Z₄ 離焦的交叉靈敏度為 0.30 nm/µm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Suppose an element's axial move has a sensitivity of 0.10 nm/µm to Z₉ spherical aberration and a cross-sensitivity of 0.30 nm/µm to Z₄ defocus. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新；然後做閉環校正試驗，記錄每次疊代後的殘差 RMS，確認在兩到三次內收斂到預算以下且不出現振盪。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent; then run a closed-loop correction trial, log the residual RMS after each iteration and confirm convergence below budget within two or three iterations without oscillation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：靈敏度矩陣若因鏡片老化而漂移，最小平方解會把能量推到條件數差的方向，操縱器大幅移動卻只換來微小改善，最後觸及行程極限而無法再校正。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the sensitivity matrix drifts with lens ageing, the least-squares solution pushes effort into poorly conditioned directions, so manipulators move a long way for little improvement and finally hit their travel limits, leaving the lens uncorrectable.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新；然後做閉環校正試驗，記錄每次疊代後的殘差 RMS，確認在兩到三次內收斂到預算以下且不出現振盪。
knowledge.textEn: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent; then run a closed-loop correction trial, log the residual RMS after each iteration and confirm convergence below budget within two or three iterations without oscillation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence"?
options: 對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
鏡頭出廠時的波前數據可以一直沿用。
optionsEn: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The factory wavefront data of a lens remain valid indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 對每個操縱器施加已知步進並量測波前，重新擬合靈敏度矩陣並與出廠值比較，差異超過幾個百分比就更新；然後做閉環校正試驗，記錄每次疊代後的殘差 RMS，確認在兩到三次內收斂到預算以下且不出現振盪。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply known steps to each manipulator while measuring the wavefront, refit the sensitivity matrix and compare it with the factory values, updating it when differences exceed a few percent; then run a closed-loop correction trial, log the residual RMS after each iteration and confirm convergence below budget within two or three iterations without oscillation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡頭操縱器、前饋補償與校正收斂：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lens manipulators, feedforward and correction convergence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 靈敏度矩陣若因鏡片老化而漂移，最小平方解會把能量推到條件數差的方向，操縱器大幅移動卻只換來微小改善，最後觸及行程極限而無法再校正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the sensitivity matrix drifts with lens ageing, the least-squares solution pushes effort into poorly conditioned directions, so manipulators move a long way for little improvement and finally hit their travel limits, leaving the lens uncorrectable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：校正時把量測到的像差向量以最小平方法反解成操縱器動作，同時要控制交叉耦合：修正球差的軸向移動也會改變離焦與放大率，必須由其他自由度同時抵消。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During correction the measured aberration vector is inverted by least squares into manipulator moves while cross-coupling is managed, because an axial move that corrects spherical aberration also changes focus and magnification and must be cancelled simultaneously by other degrees of freedom.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「操縱器越多，任何像差都能被完全修正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With enough manipulators every aberration can be corrected completely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

鏡頭通過干涉儀驗收，就不需要再做曝光驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

steps.title: 系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」如何決定ASML 微影投影光學工程的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Imaging acceptance and process-window record” determines the key performance of “ASML lithography projection-optics engineering”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 投影光學的最終驗收不是看鏡頭報告，而是看印出的結果：以測試光罩在整個場內量 CD 均勻性、H-V bias、通焦 CD 曲線與套刻畸變，並把鏡頭畸變、晶圓台、對準與光罩的貢獻合成一張套刻預算表。交接文件必須包含各場點的 Zernike 基準值、操縱器狀態、熱模型參數與允許的漂移範圍，讓後續維護能判斷鏡頭是否仍在預算內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Final acceptance of projection optics is judged on printed results rather than the lens report: a test reticle is used to measure CD uniformity across the field, H-V bias, CD through focus and overlay distortion, and the contributions of lens distortion, wafer stage, alignment and reticle are combined into a single overlay budget table. The handoff record must contain the baseline Zernike values at every field point, manipulator states, thermal-model parameters and permitted drift ranges, so that later maintenance can judge whether the lens is still within budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Imaging acceptance and process-window record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：機台對自身的套刻預算以均方根相加：鏡頭畸變 0.5 nm、晶圓台 0.8 nm、對準 0.6 nm、光罩 0.5 nm，RSS = √(0.25+0.64+0.36+0.25) = √1.50 ≈ 1.22 nm；再加入 0.5 nm 的鏡頭熱漂移殘差後為 √1.75 ≈ 1.32 nm，仍低於 1.5 nm 的允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The machine-to-itself overlay budget adds in quadrature: lens distortion 0.5 nm, wafer stage 0.8 nm, alignment 0.6 nm and reticle 0.5 nm give RSS = √(0.25+0.64+0.36+0.25) = √1.50 ≈ 1.22 nm; adding a 0.5 nm residual from lens-heating drift raises it to √1.75 ≈ 1.32 nm, still below an acceptance value of 1.5 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡頭通過干涉儀驗收，就不需要再做曝光驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lens that passes interferometric acceptance needs no exposure validation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Imaging acceptance and process-window record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff

knowledge.textEn: Final acceptance of projection optics is judged on printed results rather than the lens report: a test reticle is used to measure CD uniformity across the field, H-V bias, CD through focus and overlay distortion, and the contributions of lens distortion, wafer stage, alignment and reticle are combined into a single overlay budget table. The handoff record must contain the baseline Zernike values at every field point, manipulator states, thermal-model parameters and permitted drift ranges, so that later maintenance can judge whether the lens is still within budget.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡頭通過干涉儀驗收，就不需要再做曝光驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lens that passes interferometric acceptance needs no exposure validation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: A lens that passes interferometric acceptance needs no exposure validation.
With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Imaging acceptance and process-window record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：機台對自身的套刻預算以均方根相加：鏡頭畸變 0.5 nm、晶圓台 0.8 nm、對準 0.6 nm、光罩 0.5 nm，RSS = √(0.25+0.64+0.36+0.25) = √1.50 ≈ 1.22 nm；再加入 0.5 nm 的鏡頭熱漂移殘差後為 √1.75 ≈ 1.32 nm，仍低於 1.5 nm 的允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The machine-to-itself overlay budget adds in quadrature: lens distortion 0.5 nm, wafer stage 0.8 nm, alignment 0.6 nm and reticle 0.5 nm give RSS = √(0.25+0.64+0.36+0.25) = √1.50 ≈ 1.22 nm; adding a 0.5 nm residual from lens-heating drift raises it to √1.75 ≈ 1.32 nm, still below an acceptance value of 1.5 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一片晶圓做兩次曝光並量測套刻，分離出機台重複性與系統性畸變；對照 CD-SEM 的場內 CD 圖與波前推算的 CD 圖，核對殘差是否在量測不確定度內；最後確認交接文件的每個參數都有對應的量測日期與方法。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Expose the same wafer twice and measure overlay to separate machine repeatability from systematic distortion; compare the CD-SEM field map with the CD map predicted from the measured wavefront and confirm the residual lies within metrology uncertainty; finally check that every parameter in the handoff record carries a measurement date and method.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 機台對自身的套刻預算以均方根相加：鏡頭畸變 0.5 nm、晶圓台 0.8 nm、對準 0.6 nm、光罩 0.5 nm，RSS = √(0.25+0.64+0.36+0.25) = √1.50 ≈ 1.22 nm；再加入 0.5 nm 的鏡頭熱漂移殘差後為 √1.75 ≈ 1.32 nm，仍低於 1.5 nm 的允收值。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff", which statement holds?
