steps.title: 系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Imaging acceptance and process-window record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一片晶圓做兩次曝光並量測套刻，分離出機台重複性與系統性畸變；對照 CD-SEM 的場內 CD 圖與波前推算的 CD 圖，核對殘差是否在量測不確定度內；最後確認交接文件的每個參數都有對應的量測日期與方法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Expose the same wafer twice and measure overlay to separate machine repeatability from systematic distortion; compare the CD-SEM field map with the CD map predicted from the measured wavefront and confirm the residual lies within metrology uncertainty; finally check that every parameter in the handoff record carries a measurement date and method. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：驗收若只核對元件與鏡頭報告而不做整機成像，裝機時的鏡頭座應力或照明對準誤差會被忽略，直到量產晶圓出現場邊緣 CD 偏差才發現，重新校正要停機數日。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Acceptance that only checks element and lens reports without full-system imaging misses mount stress or illuminator misalignment introduced at installation, which surfaces as field-edge CD deviation on production wafers and costs days of downtime to recalibrate.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一片晶圓做兩次曝光並量測套刻，分離出機台重複性與系統性畸變；對照 CD-SEM 的場內 CD 圖與波前推算的 CD 圖，核對殘差是否在量測不確定度內；最後確認交接文件的每個參數都有對應的量測日期與方法。
knowledge.textEn: Expose the same wafer twice and measure overlay to separate machine repeatability from systematic distortion; compare the CD-SEM field map with the CD map predicted from the measured wavefront and confirm the residual lies within metrology uncertainty; finally check that every parameter in the handoff record carries a measurement date and method.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以同一片晶圓做兩次曝光並量測套刻，分離出機台重複性與系統性畸變。
鏡片吸收不到 1%，熱效應可以忽略。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Expose the same wafer twice and measure overlay to separate machine repeatability from systematic distortion.
Elements absorb under 1%, so thermal effects are negligible.
quiz.explanation: 以同一片晶圓做兩次曝光並量測套刻，分離出機台重複性與系統性畸變；對照 CD-SEM 的場內 CD 圖與波前推算的 CD 圖，核對殘差是否在量測不確定度內；最後確認交接文件的每個參數都有對應的量測日期與方法。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Expose the same wafer twice and measure overlay to separate machine repeatability from systematic distortion; compare the CD-SEM field map with the CD map predicted from the measured wavefront and confirm the residual lies within metrology uncertainty; finally check that every parameter in the handoff record carries a measurement date and method. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Imaging acceptance and process-window record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 驗收若只核對元件與鏡頭報告而不做整機成像，裝機時的鏡頭座應力或照明對準誤差會被忽略，直到量產晶圓出現場邊緣 CD 偏差才發現，重新校正要停機數日。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance that only checks element and lens reports without full-system imaging misses mount stress or illuminator misalignment introduced at installation, which surfaces as field-edge CD deviation on production wafers and costs days of downtime to recalibrate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須包含各場點的 Zernike 基準值、操縱器狀態、熱模型參數與允許的漂移範圍，讓後續維護能判斷鏡頭是否仍在預算內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must contain the baseline Zernike values at every field point, manipulator states, thermal-model parameters and permitted drift ranges, so that later maintenance can judge whether the lens is still within budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡頭通過干涉儀驗收，就不需要再做曝光驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lens that passes interferometric acceptance needs no exposure validation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 驗收若只核對元件與鏡頭報告而不做整機成像，裝機時的鏡頭座應力或照明對準誤差會被忽略，直到量產晶圓出現場邊緣 CD 偏差才發現，重新校正要停機數日。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance that only checks element and lens reports without full-system imaging misses mount stress or illuminator misalignment introduced at installation, which surfaces as field-edge CD deviation on production wafers and costs days of downtime to recalibrate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要 k₁ 設得夠小，單次曝光就能印出任何間距。
驗收若只核對元件與鏡頭報告而不做整機成像，裝機時的鏡頭座應力或照明對準誤差會被忽略，直到量產晶圓出現場邊緣 CD 偏差才發現，重新校正要停機數日。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
With a small enough k₁, a single exposure can print any pitch.

Acceptance that only checks element and lens reports without full-system imaging misses mount stress or illuminator misalignment introduced at installation, which surfaces as field-edge CD deviation on production wafers and costs days of downtime to recalibrate.

quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance that only checks element and lens reports without full-system imaging misses mount stress or illuminator misalignment introduced at installation, which surfaces as field-edge CD deviation on production wafers and costs days of downtime to recalibrate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡
summary: 從 EUV 強吸收出發，理解 Mo/Si 多層膜為何能反射、週期與粗糙度如何決定反射率，再把面形、鍍膜應力、污染、熱負載與波前誤差預算整合成可驗收的反射鏡工程。
summaryEn: Start from strong EUV absorption to see why Mo/Si multilayers reflect, how period and roughness set reflectance, then integrate figure, coating stress, contamination, thermal load and wavefront budgets into an acceptable mirror engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 波前預算練習：假設投影光學六片鏡子各分配 RMS 面形 0.15 nm、鍍膜 0.08 nm、對準 0.1 nm、熱漂移 0.1 nm。每片的面形貢獻為 2×0.15 = 0.30 nm；單鏡 RSS = √(0.30² + 0.08² + 0.10² + 0.10²) = 0.342 nm；六片 RSS = 0.342×√6 = 0.837 nm；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×0.837/13.5)²] = exp(−0.152) ≈ 0.86。若面形放寬到 0.25 nm，六片 RSS ≈ 1.29 nm，Strehl 降到約 0.70，低於 0.8 的常用判準。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Wavefront-budget exercise: assume six projection mirrors, each allocated 0.15 nm RMS figure, 0.08 nm coating, 0.10 nm alignment and 0.10 nm thermal drift. Each mirror's figure contribution is 2×0.15 = 0.30 nm; the per-mirror RSS is √(0.30² + 0.08² + 0.10² + 0.10²) = 0.342 nm; six mirrors give 0.342×√6 = 0.837 nm; Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×0.837/13.5)²] = exp(−0.152) ≈ 0.86. Relaxing figure to 0.25 nm raises the six-mirror RSS to about 1.29 nm and drops Strehl to about 0.70, below the common 0.8 criterion. Values are teaching assumptions, not any tool's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」與「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture" and "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「反射式光路與真空腔」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射式光路與真空腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「反射式光路與真空腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構
knowledge.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture
knowledge.text: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。
knowledge.textEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture" is correct?
options: 只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。
在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小。
雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
optionsEn: With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.
At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption.
More bilayers always give higher reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反射式光路與真空腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。
knowledge.textEn: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture", which statement holds?
options: 基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。
λ/4 的面形品質對任何波長都是「繞射極限」。
單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²。
optionsEn: For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.
λ/4 figure quality is diffraction limited at any wavelength.
A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence.
quiz.explanation: 單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「反射式光路與真空腔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。
knowledge.textEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture"?
options: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。
optionsEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation.
quiz.explanation: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反射式光路與真空腔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。
雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist.
More bilayers always give higher reflectance.

steps.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Multilayer period and the Bragg condition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mo/Si multilayer stack” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。各界面的微弱反射在正向入射時因為光程差等於一個波長而同相疊加，形成類似布拉格繞射的反射峰；由於材料吸收，週期數超過約 50 組後反射率不再提升。理論峰值約 74%，實際鍍膜約 70%。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The weak reflections from each interface add in phase at normal incidence because the round-trip path equals one wavelength, giving a Bragg-like reflectance peak; absorption makes additional bilayers beyond about 50 useless. The theoretical peak is about 74% and production coatings reach about 70%. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mo/Si multilayer stack”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More bilayers always give higher reflectance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Mo/Si multilayer stack”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The weak reflections from each interface add in phase at normal incidence because the round-trip path equals one wavelength, giving a Bragg-like reflectance peak; absorption makes additional bilayers beyond about 50 useless.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More bilayers always give higher reflectance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition" is correct?
options: 雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。
Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。
optionsEn: More bilayers always give higher reflectance.
A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.
A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4.

quiz.explanationEn: A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multilayer period and the Bragg condition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mo/Si multilayer stack” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。週期誤差會按 Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d 推移峰值波長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm. A period error shifts the peak by Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。週期誤差會按 Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d 推移峰值波長。
knowledge.textEn: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm. A period error shifts the peak by Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition", which statement holds?
options: 修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ。
在真空中工作的鏡面不會受到污染。
超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。
optionsEn: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ.
A mirror working in vacuum cannot get contaminated.

quiz.explanationEn: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multilayer period and the Bragg condition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Mo/Si multilayer stack” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance; if the lateral period gradient does not match the designed angle-of-incidence map, different mirror zones peak at different wavelengths and both reflectance and uniformity degrade.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。
knowledge.textEn: After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較。
每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The theoretical peak is about 74% and production coatings reach about 70%.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More bilayers always give higher reflectance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。
knowledge.textEn: Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance; if the lateral period gradient does not match the designed angle-of-incidence map, different mirror zones peak at different wavelengths and both reflectance and uniformity degrade.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.
Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance; if the lateral period gradient does not match the designed angle-of-incidence map, different mirror zones peak at different wavelengths and both reflectance and uniformity degrade. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射」與「鍍膜製程與多層膜應力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter" and "Deposition process and multilayer stress": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「基板面形與粗糙度頻譜」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Substrate figure and roughness spectrum” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鏡面誤差依空間頻率分成三段：低頻的面形誤差直接變成波前像差；中頻粗糙度（MSFR）把光散射到像點附近形成眩光（flare），降低影像對比；高頻粗糙度（HSFR）把光散射到視場之外，等效降低反射率。因為波長只有 13.5 nm，可接受的粗糙度是 0.1 nm 等級，比可見光光學嚴格兩個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基板面形與粗糙度頻譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mirror errors are split by spatial frequency: low-frequency figure error becomes wavefront aberration; mid-spatial-frequency roughness (MSFR) scatters light near the image point as flare that reduces contrast; high-spatial-frequency roughness (HSFR) scatters light out of the field and acts like a reflectance loss. Because the wavelength is only 13.5 nm, acceptable roughness is of order 0.1 nm, two orders of magnitude tighter than visible optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Substrate figure and roughness spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總積分散射近似為 TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²；取 σ = 0.1 nm、正向入射、λ = 13.5 nm，TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087，即約 0.9% 的光被散射；σ = 0.2 nm 時約 3.5%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total integrated scatter is approximately TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²; with σ = 0.1 nm at normal incidence and λ = 13.5 nm, TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087, about 0.9% of the light, and about 3.5% for σ = 0.2 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「基板面形與粗糙度頻譜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Substrate figure and roughness spectrum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射
knowledge.titleEn: Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter
knowledge.text: 鏡面誤差依空間頻率分成三段：低頻的面形誤差直接變成波前像差；中頻粗糙度（MSFR）把光散射到像點附近形成眩光（flare），降低影像對比；高頻粗糙度（HSFR）把光散射到視場之外，等效降低反射率。因為波長只有 13.5 nm，可接受的粗糙度是 0.1 nm 等級，比可見光光學嚴格兩個數量級。
knowledge.textEn: Mirror errors are split by spatial frequency: low-frequency figure error becomes wavefront aberration; mid-spatial-frequency roughness (MSFR) scatters light near the image point as flare that reduces contrast; high-spatial-frequency roughness (HSFR) scatters light out of the field and acts like a reflectance loss. Because the wavelength is only 13.5 nm, acceptable roughness is of order 0.1 nm, two orders of magnitude tighter than visible optics.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter" is correct?
options: 鏡面誤差依空間頻率分成三段：低頻的面形誤差直接變成波前像差。
達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。

optionsEn: Mirror errors are split by spatial frequency: low-frequency figure error becomes wavefront aberration.
A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.
For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基板面形與粗糙度頻譜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Substrate figure and roughness spectrum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總積分散射近似為 TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²；取 σ = 0.1 nm、正向入射、λ = 13.5 nm，TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087，即約 0.9% 的光被散射；σ = 0.2 nm 時約 3.5%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total integrated scatter is approximately TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²; with σ = 0.1 nm at normal incidence and λ = 13.5 nm, TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087, about 0.9% of the light, and about 3.5% for σ = 0.2 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以干涉儀量面形、以白光干涉或 AFM 量不同取樣長度的粗糙度，將功率譜密度（PSD）依頻段積分成三個 σ 值，再用 TIS 公式估散射損失並與反射率量測差額比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure figure with an interferometer and roughness at several sampling lengths with white-light interferometry or AFM, integrate the power spectral density into three band-limited σ values, then estimate scatter loss with the TIS relation and compare with the reflectance shortfall.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 總積分散射近似為 TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²；取 σ = 0.1 nm、正向入射、λ = 13.5 nm，TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087，即約 0.9% 的光被散射；σ = 0.2 nm 時約 3.5%。
knowledge.textEn: Total integrated scatter is approximately TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²; with σ = 0.1 nm at normal incidence and λ = 13.5 nm, TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087, about 0.9% of the light, and about 3.5% for σ = 0.2 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter", which statement holds?
options: λ/4 的面形品質對任何波長都是「繞射極限」。
總積分散射近似為 TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²。
每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。
optionsEn: λ/4 figure quality is diffraction limited at any wavelength.
Total integrated scatter is approximately TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)².
If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass.
quiz.explanation: 總積分散射近似為 TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²；取 σ = 0.1 nm、正向入射、λ = 13.5 nm，TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087，即約 0.9% 的光被散射；σ = 0.2 nm 時約 3.5%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Total integrated scatter is approximately TIS ≈ (4π·σ·cosθ/λ)²; with σ = 0.1 nm at normal incidence and λ = 13.5 nm, TIS ≈ (4π×0.1/13.5)² ≈ 0.0087, about 0.9% of the light, and about 3.5% for σ = 0.2 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「基板面形與粗糙度頻譜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Substrate figure and roughness spectrum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以干涉儀量面形、以白光干涉或 AFM 量不同取樣長度的粗糙度，將功率譜密度（PSD）依頻段積分成三個 σ 值，再用 TIS 公式估散射損失並與反射率量測差額比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure figure with an interferometer and roughness at several sampling lengths with white-light interferometry or AFM, integrate the power spectral density into three band-limited σ values, then estimate scatter loss with the TIS relation and compare with the reflectance shortfall. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：拋光若只追求低頻面形而留下週期數十微米的中頻波紋，成像會出現對比下降的眩光，即使面形與反射率各自合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Polishing that chases low-frequency figure while leaving tens-of-micrometre mid-frequency ripple produces contrast-robbing flare even when figure and reflectance each pass.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以干涉儀量面形、以白光干涉或 AFM 量不同取樣長度的粗糙度，將功率譜密度（PSD）依頻段積分成三個 σ 值，再用 TIS 公式估散射損失並與反射率量測差額比對。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「面形誤差、中高頻粗糙度與散射」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Figure error, mid/high-spatial-frequency roughness and scatter"?

With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.

Measure figure with an interferometer and roughness at several sampling lengths with white-light interferometry or AFM, integrate the power spectral density into three band-limited σ values, then estimate scatter loss with the TIS relation and compare with the reflectance shortfall.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure figure with an interferometer and roughness at several sampling lengths with white-light interferometry or AFM, integrate the power spectral density into three band-limited σ values, then estimate scatter loss with the TIS relation and compare with the reflectance shortfall. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。
optionsEn: Polishing that chases low-frequency figure while leaving tens-of-micrometre mid-frequency ripple produces contrast-robbing flare even when figure and reflectance each pass.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.
quiz.explanation: 拋光若只追求低頻面形而留下週期數十微米的中頻波紋，成像會出現對比下降的眩光，即使面形與反射率各自合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Polishing that chases low-frequency figure while leaving tens-of-micrometre mid-frequency ripple produces contrast-robbing flare even when figure and reflectance each pass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鍍膜製程與多層膜應力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Deposition process and multilayer stress: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「濺鍍腔與膜應力」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sputter chamber and coating stress” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多層膜通常以磁控濺鍍或離子束濺鍍逐層沉積，並以石英晶體或原位反射率監控厚度；每層厚度誤差必須控制在 0.01 nm 等級。Mo/Si 多層膜通常帶有數百 MPa 的壓應力，會把基板彎曲並改變已拋光好的面形，因此需要應力補償層、退火或在設計階段預留變形量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「濺鍍腔與膜應力」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multilayers are deposited layer by layer by magnetron or ion-beam sputtering with quartz-crystal or in-situ reflectance thickness control; per-layer errors must stay near 0.01 nm. Mo/Si stacks typically carry several hundred MPa of compressive stress that bends the substrate and alters the polished figure, so compensation layers, annealing or pre-compensated figure are required. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sputter chamber and coating stress”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Stoney 關係給出鍍膜後的曲率 κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stoney's relation gives the post-coating curvature κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「濺鍍腔與膜應力」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sputter chamber and coating stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鍍膜製程與多層膜應力
knowledge.text: 多層膜通常以磁控濺鍍或離子束濺鍍逐層沉積，並以石英晶體或原位反射率監控厚度；每層厚度誤差必須控制在 0.01 nm 等級。Mo/Si 多層膜通常帶有數百 MPa 的壓應力，會把基板彎曲並改變已拋光好的面形，因此需要應力補償層、退火或在設計階段預留變形量。
knowledge.textEn: Multilayers are deposited layer by layer by magnetron or ion-beam sputtering with quartz-crystal or in-situ reflectance thickness control; per-layer errors must stay near 0.01 nm. Mo/Si stacks typically carry several hundred MPa of compressive stress that bends the substrate and alters the polished figure, so compensation layers, annealing or pre-compensated figure are required.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鍍膜製程與多層膜應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deposition process and multilayer stress" is correct?
options: 基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。
多層膜通常以磁控濺鍍或離子束濺鍍逐層沉積，並以石英晶體或原位反射率監控厚度；每層厚度誤差必須控制在 0.01 nm 等級。
在真空中工作的鏡面不會受到污染。
optionsEn: For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.
Multilayers are deposited layer by layer by magnetron or ion-beam sputtering with quartz-crystal or in-situ reflectance thickness control.
A mirror working in vacuum cannot get contaminated.
quiz.explanation: 多層膜通常以磁控濺鍍或離子束濺鍍逐層沉積，並以石英晶體或原位反射率監控厚度；每層厚度誤差必須控制在 0.01 nm 等級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Multilayers are deposited layer by layer by magnetron or ion-beam sputtering with quartz-crystal or in-situ reflectance thickness control; per-layer errors must stay near 0.01 nm. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鍍膜製程與多層膜應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deposition process and multilayer stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濺鍍腔與膜應力」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sputter chamber and coating stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Stoney 關係給出鍍膜後的曲率 κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²)。取膜應力 σ_f = −400 MPa、總膜厚 t_f = 350 nm、ULE 基板 E_s = 67.6 GPa、ν_s = 0.17、厚度 t_s = 50 mm，κ ≈ 6×400e6×350e−9×0.83/(67.6e9×0.0025) ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁶ m⁻¹；對半徑 100 mm 的鏡面，矢高變化 ≈ κr²/2 ≈ 21 nm，遠超過次奈米面形預算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stoney's relation gives the post-coating curvature κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²). With σ_f = −400 MPa, total film thickness t_f = 350 nm, a ULE substrate with E_s = 67.6 GPa, ν_s = 0.17 and t_s = 50 mm, κ ≈ 6×400e6×350e−9×0.83/(67.6e9×0.0025) ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁶ m⁻¹; over a 100 mm radius the sag change is ≈ κr²/2 ≈ 21 nm, far beyond a sub-nanometre figure budget. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍膜前後各量一次面形並相減，與 Stoney 預測的球面項比較；若殘差含非球面項，表示應力沿鏡面不均勻或夾持造成變形，需另外分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure figure before and after coating and subtract; compare the difference with the Stoney spherical term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Stoney 關係給出鍍膜後的曲率 κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²)。取膜應力 σ_f = −400 MPa、總膜厚 t_f = 350 nm、ULE 基板 E_s = 67.6 GPa、ν_s = 0.17、厚度 t_s = 50 mm，κ ≈ 6×400e6×350e−9×0.83/(67.6e9×0.0025) ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁶ m⁻¹；對半徑 100 mm 的鏡面，矢高變化 ≈ κr²/2 ≈ 21 nm，遠超過次奈米面形預算。
knowledge.textEn: Stoney's relation gives the post-coating curvature κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²). With σ_f = −400 MPa, total film thickness t_f = 350 nm, a ULE substrate with E_s = 67.6 GPa, ν_s = 0.17 and t_s = 50 mm, κ ≈ 6×400e6×350e−9×0.83/(67.6e9×0.0025) ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁶ m⁻¹; over a 100 mm radius the sag change is ≈ κr²/2 ≈ 21 nm, far beyond a sub-nanometre figure budget.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鍍膜製程與多層膜應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deposition process and multilayer stress", which statement holds?
options: 超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。
只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。
Stoney 關係給出鍍膜後的曲率 κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²)。
optionsEn: Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation.
With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.
Stoney's relation gives the post-coating curvature κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²).
quiz.explanation: Stoney 關係給出鍍膜後的曲率 κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stoney's relation gives the post-coating curvature κ = 6σ_f·t_f·(1 − ν_s)/(E_s·t_s²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鍍膜製程與多層膜應力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deposition process and multilayer stress: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「濺鍍腔與膜應力」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sputter chamber and coating stress” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜前後各量一次面形並相減，與 Stoney 預測的球面項比較；若殘差含非球面項，表示應力沿鏡面不均勻或夾持造成變形，需另外分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure figure before and after coating and subtract; compare the difference with the Stoney spherical term. Residual non-spherical terms indicate stress non-uniformity or mounting-induced deformation that needs separate analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：忽略應力的鏡面在鍍膜後面形超差，只能重新修形並重鍍；若重鍍時週期控制又偏移，反射率與面形兩項同時不合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A mirror coated without stress accounting fails figure after coating and must be refigured and recoated; if period control drifts on the recoat, both reflectance and figure fail together.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鍍膜前後各量一次面形並相減，與 Stoney 預測的球面項比較；若殘差含非球面項，表示應力沿鏡面不均勻或夾持造成變形，需另外分析。
knowledge.textEn: Measure figure before and after coating and subtract; compare the difference with the Stoney spherical term. Residual non-spherical terms indicate stress non-uniformity or mounting-induced deformation that needs separate analysis.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鍍膜製程與多層膜應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deposition process and multilayer stress"?
options: 鍍膜前後各量一次面形並相減，與 Stoney 預測的球面項比較；若殘差含非球面項，表示應力沿鏡面不均勻或夾持造成變形，需另外分析。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
optionsEn: Measure figure before and after coating and subtract; compare the difference with the Stoney spherical term.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
More bilayers always give higher reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 鍍膜前後各量一次面形並相減，與 Stoney 預測的球面項比較；若殘差含非球面項，表示應力沿鏡面不均勻或夾持造成變形，需另外分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure figure before and after coating and subtract; compare the difference with the Stoney spherical term. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鍍膜製程與多層膜應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deposition process and multilayer stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濺鍍腔與膜應力」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sputter chamber and coating stress” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 忽略應力的鏡面在鍍膜後面形超差，只能重新修形並重鍍；若重鍍時週期控制又偏移，反射率與面形兩項同時不合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A mirror coated without stress accounting fails figure after coating and must be refigured and recoated; if period control drifts on the recoat, both reflectance and figure fail together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Mo/Si 多層膜通常帶有數百 MPa 的壓應力，會把基板彎曲並改變已拋光好的面形，因此需要應力補償層、退火或在設計階段預留變形量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mo/Si stacks typically carry several hundred MPa of compressive stress that bends the substrate and alters the polished figure, so compensation layers, annealing or pre-compensated figure are required.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略應力的鏡面在鍍膜後面形超差，只能重新修形並重鍍；若重鍍時週期控制又偏移，反射率與面形兩項同時不合格。
knowledge.textEn: A mirror coated without stress accounting fails figure after coating and must be refigured and recoated; if period control drifts on the recoat, both reflectance and figure fail together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鍍膜製程與多層膜應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deposition process and multilayer stress" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
忽略應力的鏡面在鍍膜後面形超差，只能重新修形並重鍍；若重鍍時週期控制又偏移，反射率與面形兩項同時不合格。
在真空中工作的鏡面不會受到污染。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A mirror coated without stress accounting fails figure after coating and must be refigured and recoated.
A mirror working in vacuum cannot get contaminated.
quiz.explanation: 忽略應力的鏡面在鍍膜後面形超差，只能重新修形並重鍍；若重鍍時週期控制又偏移，反射率與面形兩項同時不合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mirror coated without stress accounting fails figure after coating and must be refigured and recoated; if period control drifts on the recoat, both reflectance and figure fail together. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「表面污染、氧化與覆蓋層」與「波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surface contamination, oxidation and capping layers" and "Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 表面污染、氧化與覆蓋層：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Surface contamination, oxidation and capping layers: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Ru 覆蓋層與氫清潔」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ruthenium capping layer and hydrogen cleaning” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: EUV 光子與殘留碳氫化合物作用會在鏡面沉積碳；殘留水氣則使最上層 Si 氧化，氧化通常不可逆。因此多層膜頂部加上數奈米的 Ru 覆蓋層抗氧化，並以氫自由基清潔週期性移除碳膜。真空腔的殘氣分壓、材料除氣與光罩附近的清潔策略都屬於鏡面壽命工程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ru 覆蓋層與氫清潔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: EUV photons react with residual hydrocarbons to deposit carbon on the mirror, while residual water oxidises the top silicon layer, usually irreversibly. A few nanometres of ruthenium capping resists oxidation, and hydrogen-radical cleaning periodically removes carbon films. Residual-gas partial pressures, material outgassing and cleaning strategy near the reticle are all part of mirror-lifetime engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ruthenium capping layer and hydrogen cleaning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
