steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波前誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wavefront-error budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]。σ = 1.0 nm 時，(2π×1/13.5)² = 0.217，Strehl ≈ 0.805；σ = 1.5 nm 時約 0.614。六片鏡子若各分配 σᵢ，總和為 σ_total = √(Σσᵢ²)，且每片的面形貢獻 ≈ 2·figure_RMS·cosθ。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]. For σ = 1.0 nm, (2π×1/13.5)² = 0.217 and Strehl ≈ 0.805; for σ = 1.5 nm it is about 0.614. With six mirrors allocated σᵢ each, σ_total = √(Σσᵢ²), and each mirror's figure contribution is ≈ 2·figure_RMS·cosθ. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立預算表：列出每片鏡子的面形、鍍膜、對準、熱與量測不確定度，計算 RSS 並與允收值比較；再用波長相同的干涉量測或系統波前量測反推 Zernike 項，核對哪一項吃掉最多預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the budget table listing figure, coating, alignment, thermal and metrology uncertainty per mirror, compute the RSS and compare with the allowance; then use at-wavelength or system wavefront measurement to back out Zernike terms and see which item consumes the most budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]。σ = 1.0 nm 時，(2π×1/13.5)² = 0.217，Strehl ≈ 0.805；σ = 1.5 nm 時約 0.614。六片鏡子若各分配 σᵢ，總和為 σ_total = √(Σσᵢ²)，且每片的面形貢獻 ≈ 2·figure_RMS·cosθ。
knowledge.textEn: Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]. For σ = 1.0 nm, (2π×1/13.5)² = 0.217 and Strehl ≈ 0.805; for σ = 1.5 nm it is about 0.614. With six mirrors allocated σᵢ each, σ_total = √(Σσᵢ²), and each mirror's figure contribution is ≈ 2·figure_RMS·cosθ.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion", which statement holds?
options: 只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。
Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]。
達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。
optionsEn: With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.
Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²].
A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.
quiz.explanation: Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波前誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Wavefront-error budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 建立預算表：列出每片鏡子的面形、鍍膜、對準、熱與量測不確定度，計算 RSS 並與允收值比較；再用波長相同的干涉量測或系統波前量測反推 Zernike 項，核對哪一項吃掉最多預算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the budget table listing figure, coating, alignment, thermal and metrology uncertainty per mirror, compute the RSS and compare with the allowance; then use at-wavelength or system wavefront measurement to back out Zernike terms and see which item consumes the most budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 PV（峰谷）與 RMS 混用、或把同一來源重複計入兩個項目，會讓預算表看似合格但實際影像對比不足。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Mixing peak-to-valley with RMS values, or double-counting one source under two items, makes the budget look compliant while the real image contrast falls short.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立預算表：列出每片鏡子的面形、鍍膜、對準、熱與量測不確定度，計算 RSS 並與允收值比較；再用波長相同的干涉量測或系統波前量測反推 Zernike 項，核對哪一項吃掉最多預算。
knowledge.textEn: Build the budget table listing figure, coating, alignment, thermal and metrology uncertainty per mirror, compute the RSS and compare with the allowance; then use at-wavelength or system wavefront measurement to back out Zernike terms and see which item consumes the most budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。
建立預算表：列出每片鏡子的面形、鍍膜、對準、熱與量測不確定度，計算 RSS 並與允收值比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.
Build the budget table listing figure, coating, alignment, thermal and metrology uncertainty per mirror, compute the RSS and compare with the allowance.
quiz.explanation: 建立預算表：列出每片鏡子的面形、鍍膜、對準、熱與量測不確定度，計算 RSS 並與允收值比較；再用波長相同的干涉量測或系統波前量測反推 Zernike 項，核對哪一項吃掉最多預算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the budget table listing figure, coating, alignment, thermal and metrology uncertainty per mirror, compute the RSS and compare with the allowance; then use at-wavelength or system wavefront measurement to back out Zernike terms and see which item consumes the most budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波前誤差預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Wavefront-error budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 PV（峰谷）與 RMS 混用、或把同一來源重複計入兩個項目，會讓預算表看似合格但實際影像對比不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing peak-to-valley with RMS values, or double-counting one source under two items, makes the budget look compliant while the real image contrast falls short. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：各鏡的面形、鍍膜、對準與熱變形必須以均方根相加分配到次奈米等級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Figure, coating, alignment and thermal terms of every mirror must be allocated root-sum-square to sub-nanometre values.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「λ/4 的面形品質對任何波長都是「繞射極限」。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "λ/4 figure quality is diffraction limited at any wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 PV（峰谷）與 RMS 混用、或把同一來源重複計入兩個項目，會讓預算表看似合格但實際影像對比不足。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing peak-to-valley with RMS values, or double-counting one source under two items, makes the budget look compliant while the real image contrast falls short.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波前誤差預算與 Strehl 判準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wavefront-error budget and the Strehl criterion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把 PV（峰谷）與 RMS 混用、或把同一來源重複計入兩個項目，會讓預算表看似合格但實際影像對比不足。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。
optionsEn: Mixing peak-to-valley with RMS values, or double-counting one source under two items, makes the budget look compliant while the real image contrast falls short.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation.
quiz.explanation: 把 PV（峰谷）與 RMS 混用、或把同一來源重複計入兩個項目，會讓預算表看似合格但實際影像對比不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing peak-to-valley with RMS values, or double-counting one source under two items, makes the budget look compliant while the real image contrast falls short. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移」與「鏡組整合、對準與驗收」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift" and "Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱控與低膨脹基板」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每片鏡子吸收約 30% 的 EUV 以及光源帶來的紅外與帶外輻射，鏡面溫度會上升並隨曝光負載變化。基板採用 ULE 或 Zerodur 等超低膨脹玻璃陶瓷，熱膨脹係數在 ±20 ppb/K 以內，再配合主動溫控、熱感測與模型補償，才能把熱致面形漂移壓在次奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱控與低膨脹基板」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each mirror absorbs about 30% of the EUV plus infrared and out-of-band radiation from the source, so its temperature rises and varies with exposure load. Substrates use ultralow-expansion glass ceramics such as ULE or Zerodur with thermal expansion within ±20 ppb/K, combined with active temperature control, thermal sensing and model-based compensation, to keep thermal figure drift sub-nanometre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一維熱變形 Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A one-dimensional thermal deformation is Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熱控與低膨脹基板」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移
knowledge.titleEn: Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift
knowledge.text: 每片鏡子吸收約 30% 的 EUV 以及光源帶來的紅外與帶外輻射，鏡面溫度會上升並隨曝光負載變化。基板採用 ULE 或 Zerodur 等超低膨脹玻璃陶瓷，熱膨脹係數在 ±20 ppb/K 以內，再配合主動溫控、熱感測與模型補償，才能把熱致面形漂移壓在次奈米。
knowledge.textEn: Each mirror absorbs about 30% of the EUV plus infrared and out-of-band radiation from the source, so its temperature rises and varies with exposure load. Substrates use ultralow-expansion glass ceramics such as ULE or Zerodur with thermal expansion within ±20 ppb/K, combined with active temperature control, thermal sensing and model-based compensation, to keep thermal figure drift sub-nanometre.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift" is correct?
options: 超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。
每片鏡子吸收約 30% 的 EUV 以及光源帶來的紅外與帶外輻射，鏡面溫度會上升並隨曝光負載變化。
每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。
optionsEn: Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation.
Each mirror absorbs about 30% of the EUV plus infrared and out-of-band radiation from the source, so its temperature rises and varies with exposure load.
If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass.
quiz.explanation: 每片鏡子吸收約 30% 的 EUV 以及光源帶來的紅外與帶外輻射，鏡面溫度會上升並隨曝光負載變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each mirror absorbs about 30% of the EUV plus infrared and out-of-band radiation from the source, so its temperature rises and varies with exposure load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱控與低膨脹基板」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一維熱變形 Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h。取 α = 10 ppb/K、鏡體厚度 h = 50 mm、局部溫升 ΔT = 0.2 K，Δh ≈ 1×10⁻⁸×0.2×0.05 m = 0.1 nm；若改用 CTE 為 0.5 ppm/K 的普通玻璃，同樣條件下變形達 5 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A one-dimensional thermal deformation is Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h. With α = 10 ppb/K, a 50 mm mirror body and a local rise ΔT = 0.2 K, Δh ≈ 1×10⁻⁸×0.2×0.05 m = 0.1 nm; an ordinary glass with CTE 0.5 ppm/K would deform 5 nm under the same conditions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知熱負載照射或加熱鏡面並同時量面形，比較量測漂移與有限元素或一維估計值；檢查 CTE 在鏡體內的均勻性是否足以解釋殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Irradiate or heat the mirror with a known load while measuring figure, compare the measured drift with finite-element or one-dimensional estimates, and check whether CTE homogeneity across the blank explains any residual.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一維熱變形 Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h。取 α = 10 ppb/K、鏡體厚度 h = 50 mm、局部溫升 ΔT = 0.2 K，Δh ≈ 1×10⁻⁸×0.2×0.05 m = 0.1 nm；若改用 CTE 為 0.5 ppm/K 的普通玻璃，同樣條件下變形達 5 nm。
knowledge.textEn: A one-dimensional thermal deformation is Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h. With α = 10 ppb/K, a 50 mm mirror body and a local rise ΔT = 0.2 K, Δh ≈ 1×10⁻⁸×0.2×0.05 m = 0.1 nm; an ordinary glass with CTE 0.5 ppm/K would deform 5 nm under the same conditions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift", which statement holds?
options: 雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。
一維熱變形 Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h。
optionsEn: More bilayers always give higher reflectance.
For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.
A one-dimensional thermal deformation is Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h.
quiz.explanation: 一維熱變形 Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A one-dimensional thermal deformation is Δh ≈ α·ΔT·h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熱控與低膨脹基板」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知熱負載照射或加熱鏡面並同時量面形，比較量測漂移與有限元素或一維估計值；檢查 CTE 在鏡體內的均勻性是否足以解釋殘差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Irradiate or heat the mirror with a known load while measuring figure, compare the measured drift with finite-element or one-dimensional estimates, and check whether CTE homogeneity across the blank explains any residual. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：基板 CTE 不均勻時，即使平均 CTE 為零，溫度場仍會造成非均勻變形，出現無法用整體溫控消除的像散。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With inhomogeneous CTE, a zero average CTE still leaves non-uniform deformation under a temperature field, producing astigmatism that global temperature control cannot remove.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知熱負載照射或加熱鏡面並同時量面形，比較量測漂移與有限元素或一維估計值；檢查 CTE 在鏡體內的均勻性是否足以解釋殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Irradiate or heat the mirror with a known load while measuring figure, compare the measured drift with finite-element or one-dimensional estimates, and check whether CTE homogeneity across the blank explains any residual.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift"?
options: 以已知熱負載照射或加熱鏡面並同時量面形，比較量測漂移與有限元素或一維估計值；檢查 CTE 在鏡體內的均勻性是否足以解釋殘差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
在真空中工作的鏡面不會受到污染。
optionsEn: Irradiate or heat the mirror with a known load while measuring figure, compare the measured drift with finite-element or one-dimensional estimates, and check whether CTE homogeneity across the blank explains any residual.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A mirror working in vacuum cannot get contaminated.
quiz.explanation: 以已知熱負載照射或加熱鏡面並同時量面形，比較量測漂移與有限元素或一維估計值；檢查 CTE 在鏡體內的均勻性是否足以解釋殘差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Irradiate or heat the mirror with a known load while measuring figure, compare the measured drift with finite-element or one-dimensional estimates, and check whether CTE homogeneity across the blank explains any residual. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱控與低膨脹基板」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Thermal control and ultralow-expansion substrate” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 基板 CTE 不均勻時，即使平均 CTE 為零，溫度場仍會造成非均勻變形，出現無法用整體溫控消除的像散。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With inhomogeneous CTE, a zero average CTE still leaves non-uniform deformation under a temperature field, producing astigmatism that global temperature control cannot remove. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：基板採用 ULE 或 Zerodur 等超低膨脹玻璃陶瓷，熱膨脹係數在 ±20 ppb/K 以內，再配合主動溫控、熱感測與模型補償，才能把熱致面形漂移壓在次奈米。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Substrates use ultralow-expansion glass ceramics such as ULE or Zerodur with thermal expansion within ±20 ppb/K, combined with active temperature control, thermal sensing and model-based compensation, to keep thermal figure drift sub-nanometre.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基板 CTE 不均勻時，即使平均 CTE 為零，溫度場仍會造成非均勻變形，出現無法用整體溫控消除的像散。
knowledge.textEn: With inhomogeneous CTE, a zero average CTE still leaves non-uniform deformation under a temperature field, producing astigmatism that global temperature control cannot remove.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱負載、低膨脹材料與面形漂移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal load, ultralow-expansion materials and figure drift" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
基板 CTE 不均勻時，即使平均 CTE 為零，溫度場仍會造成非均勻變形，出現無法用整體溫控消除的像散。
每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
With inhomogeneous CTE, a zero average CTE still leaves non-uniform deformation under a temperature field, producing astigmatism that global temperature control cannot remove.
If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass.
quiz.explanation: 基板 CTE 不均勻時，即使平均 CTE 為零，溫度場仍會造成非均勻變形，出現無法用整體溫控消除的像散。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With inhomogeneous CTE, a zero average CTE still leaves non-uniform deformation under a temperature field, producing astigmatism that global temperature control cannot remove. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鏡組整合、對準與驗收：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「系統對準與驗收報告」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System alignment and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反射鏡以撓性或運動學支撐安裝，避免夾持應力並允許微米到奈米級的位置調整；每片鏡子的位移與傾斜對波前的靈敏度由光學設計的靈敏度矩陣給出。最後以成像或波前系統量測、眩光量測與壽命外推共同構成驗收，而不是只看元件各自合格。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「系統對準與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mirrors are held on flexure or kinematic mounts that avoid clamping stress and allow micrometre-to-nanometre adjustment; the wavefront sensitivity to each mirror's displacement and tilt comes from the optical design's sensitivity matrix. Acceptance combines system wavefront or imaging measurement, flare measurement and lifetime extrapolation rather than separate component passes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “System alignment and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某鏡傾斜靈敏度為 0.5 nm 波前／µrad，允許該項佔用 0.2 nm 預算，則傾斜公差為 0.4 µrad；對 200 mm 跨距，相當於邊緣位移 80 nm，顯示對準機構需要奈米級解析度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a mirror's tilt sensitivity is 0.5 nm wavefront per µrad and the item is allowed 0.2 nm of budget, the tilt tolerance is 0.4 µrad; over a 200 mm span that equals 80 nm of edge displacement, showing that the alignment mechanism needs nanometre resolution.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「系統對準與驗收報告」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “System alignment and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鏡組整合、對準與驗收
knowledge.text: 反射鏡以撓性或運動學支撐安裝，避免夾持應力並允許微米到奈米級的位置調整；每片鏡子的位移與傾斜對波前的靈敏度由光學設計的靈敏度矩陣給出。最後以成像或波前系統量測、眩光量測與壽命外推共同構成驗收，而不是只看元件各自合格。
knowledge.textEn: Mirrors are held on flexure or kinematic mounts that avoid clamping stress and allow micrometre-to-nanometre adjustment; the wavefront sensitivity to each mirror's displacement and tilt comes from the optical design's sensitivity matrix. Acceptance combines system wavefront or imaging measurement, flare measurement and lifetime extrapolation rather than separate component passes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡組整合、對準與驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance" is correct?
options: 每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。
只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。
反射鏡以撓性或運動學支撐安裝，避免夾持應力並允許微米到奈米級的位置調整；每片鏡子的位移與傾斜對波前的靈敏度由光學設計的靈敏度矩陣給出。
optionsEn: If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass.
With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.
Mirrors are held on flexure or kinematic mounts that avoid clamping stress and allow micrometre-to-nanometre adjustment.
quiz.explanation: 反射鏡以撓性或運動學支撐安裝，避免夾持應力並允許微米到奈米級的位置調整；每片鏡子的位移與傾斜對波前的靈敏度由光學設計的靈敏度矩陣給出。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mirrors are held on flexure or kinematic mounts that avoid clamping stress and allow micrometre-to-nanometre adjustment; the wavefront sensitivity to each mirror's displacement and tilt comes from the optical design's sensitivity matrix. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鏡組整合、對準與驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統對準與驗收報告」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System alignment and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某鏡傾斜靈敏度為 0.5 nm 波前／µrad，允許該項佔用 0.2 nm 預算，則傾斜公差為 0.4 µrad；對 200 mm 跨距，相當於邊緣位移 80 nm，顯示對準機構需要奈米級解析度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a mirror's tilt sensitivity is 0.5 nm wavefront per µrad and the item is allowed 0.2 nm of budget, the tilt tolerance is 0.4 µrad; over a 200 mm span that equals 80 nm of edge displacement, showing that the alignment mechanism needs nanometre resolution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用靈敏度矩陣把量到的 Zernike 項反解成各鏡的位移與傾斜修正量，施加修正後再量一次，確認殘差收斂並在預算內；驗收報告需同時列出反射率、波前、眩光、污染衰減速率與熱漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Invert the measured Zernike terms through the sensitivity matrix into per-mirror displacement and tilt corrections, apply them, re-measure, and confirm the residual converges within budget; the acceptance record must list reflectance, wavefront, flare, contamination decay rate and thermal drift together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某鏡傾斜靈敏度為 0.5 nm 波前／µrad，允許該項佔用 0.2 nm 預算，則傾斜公差為 0.4 µrad；對 200 mm 跨距，相當於邊緣位移 80 nm，顯示對準機構需要奈米級解析度。
knowledge.textEn: If a mirror's tilt sensitivity is 0.5 nm wavefront per µrad and the item is allowed 0.2 nm of budget, the tilt tolerance is 0.4 µrad; over a 200 mm span that equals 80 nm of edge displacement, showing that the alignment mechanism needs nanometre resolution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡組整合、對準與驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 若某鏡傾斜靈敏度為 0.5 nm 波前／µrad，允許該項佔用 0.2 nm 預算，則傾斜公差為 0.4 µrad。
達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。
在真空中工作的鏡面不會受到污染。
optionsEn: If a mirror's tilt sensitivity is 0.5 nm wavefront per µrad and the item is allowed 0.2 nm of budget, the tilt tolerance is 0.4 µrad.
A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.
A mirror working in vacuum cannot get contaminated.

quiz.explanationEn: If a mirror's tilt sensitivity is 0.5 nm wavefront per µrad and the item is allowed 0.2 nm of budget, the tilt tolerance is 0.4 µrad; over a 200 mm span that equals 80 nm of edge displacement, showing that the alignment mechanism needs nanometre resolution. Keep units when recalculating.

knowledge.textEn: Invert the measured Zernike terms through the sensitivity matrix into per-mirror displacement and tilt corrections, apply them, re-measure, and confirm the residual converges within budget; the acceptance record must list reflectance, wavefront, flare, contamination decay rate and thermal drift together.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡組整合、對準與驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用靈敏度矩陣把量到的 Zernike 項反解成各鏡的位移與傾斜修正量，施加修正後再量一次，確認殘差收斂並在預算內。
λ/4 的面形品質對任何波長都是「繞射極限」。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Invert the measured Zernike terms through the sensitivity matrix into per-mirror displacement and tilt corrections, apply them, re-measure, and confirm the residual converges within budget.
λ/4 figure quality is diffraction limited at any wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 用靈敏度矩陣把量到的 Zernike 項反解成各鏡的位移與傾斜修正量，施加修正後再量一次，確認殘差收斂並在預算內；驗收報告需同時列出反射率、波前、眩光、污染衰減速率與熱漂移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Invert the measured Zernike terms through the sensitivity matrix into per-mirror displacement and tilt corrections, apply them, re-measure, and confirm the residual converges within budget; the acceptance record must list reflectance, wavefront, flare, contamination decay rate and thermal drift together. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡組整合、對準與驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統對準與驗收報告」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “System alignment and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 安裝時的夾持力或黏著劑收縮會把合格的鏡面壓出像散；若驗收只核對元件報告而不做系統量測，這類錯誤會留到曝光結果才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Clamping force or adhesive shrinkage during mounting can press astigmatism into a passing mirror; acceptance that only checks component reports without a system measurement leaves such errors to be found in exposure results. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最後以成像或波前系統量測、眩光量測與壽命外推共同構成驗收，而不是只看元件各自合格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance combines system wavefront or imaging measurement, flare measurement and lifetime extrapolation rather than separate component passes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 安裝時的夾持力或黏著劑收縮會把合格的鏡面壓出像散；若驗收只核對元件報告而不做系統量測，這類錯誤會留到曝光結果才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Clamping force or adhesive shrinkage during mounting can press astigmatism into a passing mirror; acceptance that only checks component reports without a system measurement leaves such errors to be found in exposure results.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鏡組整合、對準與驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mirror-set integration, alignment and acceptance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。
安裝時的夾持力或黏著劑收縮會把合格的鏡面壓出像散；若驗收只核對元件報告而不做系統量測，這類錯誤會留到曝光結果才被發現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.
Clamping force or adhesive shrinkage during mounting can press astigmatism into a passing mirror.
quiz.explanation: 安裝時的夾持力或黏著劑收縮會把合格的鏡面壓出像散；若驗收只核對元件報告而不做系統量測，這類錯誤會留到曝光結果才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clamping force or adhesive shrinkage during mounting can press astigmatism into a passing mirror; acceptance that only checks component reports without a system measurement leaves such errors to be found in exposure results. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: EUV 光源錫滴控制概念
summary: 以 13.5 nm 雷射電漿（LPP）錫滴光源為對象，從錫離子的 4d–4f 發射帶與 CO₂ 雷射的臨界密度出發，建立從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈，再拆解錫滴產生器、前脈衝與主脈衝、錫滴偵測與雷射導向、劑量統計、氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔，最後以可用度與反射率衰減記錄完成驗收。本課為教學模型，不含任何操作程序。
summaryEn: Taking the 13.5 nm laser-produced-plasma tin-droplet source as the object, the course starts from the 4d–4f emission band of tin ions and the critical density of CO₂ laser light, builds the power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus, then works through the droplet generator, pre-pulse and main pulse, droplet detection and laser steering, dose statistics, hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning, and closes with an availability and reflectance-decay acceptance record. It is a teaching model and contains no operating procedure.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 功率鏈練習：驅動雷射 20 kW、50 kHz，每脈衝 0.4 J；CE = 5% 得 20 mJ 帶內 EUV 進入 2π 立體角，即 1000 W。集光鏡收集 5 sr（0.80）、反射率 0.60、氫氣透過率 0.90，η = 0.43，IF 功率 ≈ 430 W，每脈衝 8.6 mJ。進入掃描機後經照明系統 4 片、光罩 1 次與投影光學 6 片共 11 次反射，每次 0.65，0.65¹¹ ≈ 0.0088，晶圓處約 3.8 W。對 30 mJ/cm² 的光阻與 300 mm 晶圓（面積 π×15² ≈ 707 cm²），每片需 21.2 J，純曝光時間 21.2/3.8 ≈ 5.6 s；實際產能再受晶圓台步進、縫隙掃描開銷與劑量餘裕限制。若集光鏡反射率降到 0.50，IF 功率變為 358 W（下降 17%），曝光時間拉長 20%。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何光源規格。
workedExample.textEn: Power-chain exercise: a 20 kW drive laser at 50 kHz gives 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% yields 20 mJ of in-band EUV into 2π steradians, i.e. 1000 W. The collector captures 5 sr (0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so η = 0.43 and IF power ≈ 430 W, 8.6 mJ per pulse. Inside the scanner the light sees 11 reflections, 4 in the illuminator, 1 at the reticle and 6 in the projection optics, each at 0.65, so 0.65¹¹ ≈ 0.0088 and about 3.8 W reaches the wafer. For a 30 mJ/cm² resist on a 300 mm wafer (area π×15² ≈ 707 cm²) each wafer needs 21.2 J, a pure exposure time of 21.2/3.8 ≈ 5.6 s; real throughput is further limited by stage stepping, slit-scan overhead and dose margin. If collector reflectance drops to 0.50, IF power becomes 358 W (a 17% loss) and exposure time grows by 20%. All values are teaching assumptions, not any source specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」與「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" and "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。雷射在電漿中只能傳到臨界密度面，10.6 µm 的 CO₂ 雷射臨界密度比 1.06 µm 固態雷射低一百倍，電漿較稀薄、自吸收較少，CE 能達到 5% 以上，而固態雷射通常只有 2% 到 3%。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy. Laser light penetrates a plasma only up to the critical-density surface, and the critical density for 10.6 µm CO₂ light is a hundred times lower than for 1.06 µm solid-state light, so the emitting plasma is more dilute with less self-absorption, giving CE above 5% versus typically 2% to 3% with solid-state drivers. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³；Nd:YAG λ = 1.064 µm 時 n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³，相差約 100 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射
knowledge.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser
knowledge.text: 錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。雷射在電漿中只能傳到臨界密度面，10.6 µm 的 CO₂ 雷射臨界密度比 1.06 µm 固態雷射低一百倍，電漿較稀薄、自吸收較少，CE 能達到 5% 以上，而固態雷射通常只有 2% 到 3%。
knowledge.textEn: When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy. Laser light penetrates a plasma only up to the critical-density surface, and the critical density for 10.6 µm CO₂ light is a hundred times lower than for 1.06 µm solid-state light, so the emitting plasma is more dilute with less self-absorption, giving CE above 5% versus typically 2% to 3% with solid-state drivers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" is correct?
options: 雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。
錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。
光源功率只取決於雷射功率。
optionsEn: More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output.

When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy.
Source power depends only on the laser power.
quiz.explanation: 錫被加熱到約 30 到 40 eV 的電漿溫度時，Sn⁸⁺ 到 Sn¹³⁺ 離子的 4d–4f 躍遷形成密集的未解析躍遷陣列，發射峰正好落在 13.5 nm，而 Mo/Si 多層膜只反射 13.5 nm ± 1% 的 2% 頻寬，所以光源的品質指標是帶內轉換效率 CE：2π 立體角內帶內 EUV 能量除以雷射脈衝能量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When tin is heated to a plasma temperature of roughly 30 to 40 eV, the 4d–4f transitions of Sn⁸⁺ to Sn¹³⁺ ions form a dense unresolved transition array whose emission peaks right at 13.5 nm, and because Mo/Si multilayers reflect only the 2% band of 13.5 nm ± 1%, the figure of merit is the in-band conversion efficiency CE: in-band EUV energy into 2π steradians divided by laser pulse energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³；Nd:YAG λ = 1.064 µm 時 n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³，相差約 100 倍。13.5 nm 光子能量 hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100. The 13.5 nm photon energy is hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線；以光譜儀確認發射峰位置與 2% 頻寬內的能量比例，與 Mo/Si 反射帶重疊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³；Nd:YAG λ = 1.064 µm 時 n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³，相差約 100 倍。13.5 nm 光子能量 hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV。
knowledge.textEn: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100. The 13.5 nm photon energy is hc/λ = 1240/13.5 ≈ 91.8 eV.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。
臨界電子密度 n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³（λ 以 µm 計）：CO₂ 雷射 λ = 10.6 µm 時 n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³。
optionsEn: The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted.
If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter.
The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³.

quiz.explanationEn: The critical electron density is n_c ≈ 1.1×10²¹/λ² cm⁻³ with λ in µm: for CO₂ light at λ = 10.6 µm, n_c = 1.1×10²¹/112.4 ≈ 9.8×10¹⁸ cm⁻³; for Nd:YAG at λ = 1.064 µm, n_c ≈ 9.7×10²⁰ cm⁻³, a factor of about 100. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線；以光譜儀確認發射峰位置與 2% 頻寬內的能量比例，與 Mo/Si 反射帶重疊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線；以光譜儀確認發射峰位置與 2% 頻寬內的能量比例，與 Mo/Si 反射帶重疊。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 用帶有 Zr 濾片與 Mo/Si 多層膜的能量監測器量帶內 EUV 脈衝能量，同時記錄雷射脈衝能量，計算 CE 並畫出 CE 對雷射強度與錫靶尺寸的曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。
optionsEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure the in-band EUV pulse energy with an energy monitor behind a Zr filter and a Mo/Si multilayer while logging the laser pulse energy, compute CE and plot it against laser intensity and target size; confirm with a spectrometer that the emission peak and the fraction of energy inside the 2% band overlap the Mo/Si reflectance band. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錫電漿與 13.5 nm 頻帶」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Tin plasma and the 13.5 nm band” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雷射在電漿中只能傳到臨界密度面，10.6 µm 的 CO₂ 雷射臨界密度比 1.06 µm 固態雷射低一百倍，電漿較稀薄、自吸收較少，CE 能達到 5% 以上，而固態雷射通常只有 2% 到 3%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Laser light penetrates a plasma only up to the critical-density surface, and the critical density for 10.6 µm CO₂ light is a hundred times lower than for 1.06 µm solid-state light, so the emitting plasma is more dilute with less self-absorption, giving CE above 5% versus typically 2% to 3% with solid-state drivers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。
knowledge.textEn: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「為何是錫、為何是 CO₂ 雷射」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Why tin and why a CO₂ drive laser" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。
光源功率只取決於雷射功率。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics.
Source power depends only on the laser power.
quiz.explanation: 雷射強度過高時電漿溫度超過最佳值，離子化程度過高使發射峰移出 13.5 nm 頻帶，帶內 CE 反而下降，同時帶外輻射增加而加熱集光鏡與光學系統。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If laser intensity is too high the plasma overshoots the optimum temperature, over-ionisation shifts the emission away from the 13.5 nm band, in-band CE drops, and the extra out-of-band radiation heats the collector and downstream optics. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「中間焦點與功率鏈」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Intermediate focus and power chain” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光源輸出以中間焦點（IF）的帶內功率定義，IF 是光源與掃描機照明系統的交接面。功率鏈是乘法：雷射平均功率乘以 CE 得到 2π 立體角內的帶內 EUV，再乘以橢球集光鏡收集的立體角比例、多層膜反射率與氫氣透過率，才得到 IF 功率。每一項都小於 1，所以錫滴尺寸、雷射重複率與集光鏡狀態任何一項退化都會直接反映在晶圓產能上。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「中間焦點與功率鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator. The power chain is multiplicative: laser average power times CE gives in-band EUV into 2π steradians, and that is multiplied by the solid-angle fraction captured by the ellipsoidal collector, the multilayer reflectance and the hydrogen transmission before it becomes IF power. Every factor is below 1, so degradation in droplet size, laser repetition rate or collector condition shows up directly in wafer throughput. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Intermediate focus and power chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% gives 20 mJ per pulse, 1000 W of in-band EUV into 2π; the collector captures 5 sr (5/6.28 = 0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so the product 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43 yields about 430 W at IF, 8.6 mJ per pulse, equivalent to 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ photons.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光源功率只取決於雷射功率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Source power depends only on the laser power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「中間焦點與功率鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Intermediate focus and power chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈
knowledge.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus
knowledge.text: 光源輸出以中間焦點（IF）的帶內功率定義，IF 是光源與掃描機照明系統的交接面。功率鏈是乘法：雷射平均功率乘以 CE 得到 2π 立體角內的帶內 EUV，再乘以橢球集光鏡收集的立體角比例、多層膜反射率與氫氣透過率，才得到 IF 功率。
knowledge.textEn: Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator. The power chain is multiplicative: laser average power times CE gives in-band EUV into 2π steradians, and that is multiplied by the solid-angle fraction captured by the ellipsoidal collector, the multilayer reflectance and the hydrogen transmission before it becomes IF power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光源功率只取決於雷射功率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Source power depends only on the laser power. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus" is correct?
options: 光源功率只取決於雷射功率。
錫滴做得越大，EUV 輸出一定越多。
光源輸出以中間焦點（IF）的帶內功率定義，IF 是光源與掃描機照明系統的交接面。
optionsEn: Source power depends only on the laser power.
Bigger droplets always produce more EUV.
Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator.
quiz.explanation: 光源輸出以中間焦點（IF）的帶內功率定義，IF 是光源與掃描機照明系統的交接面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Source output is defined as in-band power at the intermediate focus (IF), the interface between the source and the scanner illuminator. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中間焦點與功率鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Intermediate focus and power chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設雷射 20 kW、50 kHz，每脈衝 0.4 J；CE = 5% 得每脈衝 20 mJ、1000 W 帶內 EUV 進入 2π；集光鏡收集 5 sr（5/6.28 = 0.80）、反射率 0.60、氫氣透過率 0.90，合成 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43，IF 功率 ≈ 430 W，每脈衝 8.6 mJ，相當於 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ 個光子。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% gives 20 mJ per pulse, 1000 W of in-band EUV into 2π; the collector captures 5 sr (5/6.28 = 0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so the product 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43 yields about 430 W at IF, 8.6 mJ per pulse, equivalent to 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ photons. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 IF 處以校正過的 EUV 功率計量帶內功率，同時由雷射功率計、CE 量測與集光鏡反射率記錄逐項計算鏈上每個因子，兩者相差超過 10% 時逐項追查是集光鏡污染、氫氣壓力還是錫滴尺寸偏離。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure in-band power at IF with a calibrated EUV power meter while computing every factor of the chain from the laser power meter, the CE measurement and the collector reflectance record; when the two disagree by more than 10%, trace the discrepancy factor by factor to collector contamination, hydrogen pressure or droplet-size deviation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus", which statement holds?
options: 設雷射 20 kW、50 kHz，每脈衝 0.4 J。
錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。
真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。

A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock.
The vessel is under vacuum, so the collector cannot get contaminated.
quiz.explanation: 設雷射 20 kW、50 kHz，每脈衝 0.4 J；CE = 5% 得每脈衝 20 mJ、1000 W 帶內 EUV 進入 2π；集光鏡收集 5 sr（5/6.28 = 0.80）、反射率 0.60、氫氣透過率 0.90，合成 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43，IF 功率 ≈ 430 W，每脈衝 8.6 mJ，相當於 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ 個光子。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a 20 kW laser at 50 kHz, 0.4 J per pulse; CE = 5% gives 20 mJ per pulse, 1000 W of in-band EUV into 2π; the collector captures 5 sr (5/6.28 = 0.80) with reflectance 0.60 and hydrogen transmission 0.90, so the product 0.80×0.60×0.90 ≈ 0.43 yields about 430 W at IF, 8.6 mJ per pulse, equivalent to 8.6×10⁻³/(91.8×1.602×10⁻¹⁹) ≈ 5.9×10¹⁴ photons. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The power chain from drive laser to intermediate focus: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「中間焦點與功率鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Intermediate focus and power chain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 IF 處以校正過的 EUV 功率計量帶內功率，同時由雷射功率計、CE 量測與集光鏡反射率記錄逐項計算鏈上每個因子，兩者相差超過 10% 時逐項追查是集光鏡污染、氫氣壓力還是錫滴尺寸偏離。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure in-band power at IF with a calibrated EUV power meter while computing every factor of the chain from the laser power meter, the CE measurement and the collector reflectance record; when the two disagree by more than 10%, trace the discrepancy factor by factor to collector contamination, hydrogen pressure or droplet-size deviation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：集光鏡反射率從 0.60 掉到 0.50 看似只少 10 個百分點，但 IF 功率同比例下降 17%，掃描機必須放慢掃描速度補劑量，整條產線的晶圓產能隨之下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A collector reflectance drop from 0.60 to 0.50 looks like only 10 points, but IF power falls by the same 17% ratio, the scanner must slow its scan to keep dose, and wafer throughput of the whole line falls with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 從驅動雷射到中間焦點的功率鏈：失效診斷

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂」與「主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup" and "MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「錫滴產生器噴嘴」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Droplet-generator nozzle” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錫在 232 °C 熔化，產生器把熔融錫加壓後從微米級噴嘴射出高速液柱，液柱因表面張力的 Rayleigh–Plateau 不穩定而分裂成細小液滴；用壓電元件調制噴嘴可以鎖定分裂頻率與相位，使細滴在飛行中合併成直徑約 25 到 30 µm、頻率等於雷射重複率的目標錫滴。錫滴直徑決定可用的錫質量與電漿尺寸，頻率與速度決定錫滴間距，而噴嘴磨損或阻塞會直接改變這三個量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「錫滴產生器噴嘴」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tin melts at 232 °C, and the generator pressurises molten tin through a micrometre-scale nozzle into a high-speed jet that breaks into fine droplets through the surface-tension-driven Rayleigh–Plateau instability; a piezoelectric modulation of the nozzle locks the breakup frequency and phase so the fine droplets coalesce in flight into target droplets of about 25 to 30 µm diameter at a frequency equal to the laser repetition rate. Droplet diameter sets the available tin mass and plasma size, frequency and velocity set the droplet spacing, and nozzle wear or clogging changes all three at once. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Droplet-generator nozzle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取錫滴直徑 27 µm、速度 80 m/s、頻率 50 kHz：間距 = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm；單滴體積 π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³，以密度 7000 kg/m³ 計質量 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg，錫流量 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h；若液柱速度亦為 80 m/s，所需壓力至少為 ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa（約 220 bar），尚未計入噴嘴黏滯損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take 27 µm droplets at 80 m/s and 50 kHz: spacing = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm; each droplet has volume π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³ and, at 7000 kg/m³, mass 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg, so the tin flow is 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h; if the jet also travels at 80 m/s the required pressure is at least ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa (about 220 bar) before viscous nozzle losses.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錫滴做得越大，EUV 輸出一定越多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bigger droplets always produce more EUV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「錫滴產生器噴嘴」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Droplet-generator nozzle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂
knowledge.text: 錫在 232 °C 熔化，產生器把熔融錫加壓後從微米級噴嘴射出高速液柱，液柱因表面張力的 Rayleigh–Plateau 不穩定而分裂成細小液滴；用壓電元件調制噴嘴可以鎖定分裂頻率與相位，使細滴在飛行中合併成直徑約 25 到 30 µm、頻率等於雷射重複率的目標錫滴。錫滴直徑決定可用的錫質量與電漿尺寸，頻率與速度決定錫滴間距，而噴嘴磨損或阻塞會直接改變這三個量。

Droplet diameter sets the available tin mass and plasma size, frequency and velocity set the droplet spacing, and nozzle wear or clogging changes all three at once.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錫滴做得越大，EUV 輸出一定越多。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup" is correct?
options: 錫在 232 °C 熔化，產生器把熔融錫加壓後從微米級噴嘴射出高速液柱，液柱因表面張力的 Rayleigh–Plateau 不穩定而分裂成細小液滴。

optionsEn: Tin melts at 232 °C, and the generator pressurises molten tin through a micrometre-scale nozzle into a high-speed jet that breaks into fine droplets through the surface-tension-driven Rayleigh–Plateau instability.
Bigger droplets always produce more EUV.

quiz.explanation: 錫在 232 °C 熔化，產生器把熔融錫加壓後從微米級噴嘴射出高速液柱，液柱因表面張力的 Rayleigh–Plateau 不穩定而分裂成細小液滴；用壓電元件調制噴嘴可以鎖定分裂頻率與相位，使細滴在飛行中合併成直徑約 25 到 30 µm、頻率等於雷射重複率的目標錫滴。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
