The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錫滴產生器噴嘴」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Droplet-generator nozzle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取錫滴直徑 27 µm、速度 80 m/s、頻率 50 kHz：間距 = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm；單滴體積 π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³，以密度 7000 kg/m³ 計質量 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg，錫流量 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h；若液柱速度亦為 80 m/s，所需壓力至少為 ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa（約 220 bar），尚未計入噴嘴黏滯損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take 27 µm droplets at 80 m/s and 50 kHz: spacing = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm; each droplet has volume π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³ and, at 7000 kg/m³, mass 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg, so the tin flow is 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h; if the jet also travels at 80 m/s the required pressure is at least ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa (about 220 bar) before viscous nozzle losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用頻閃背光相機拍攝錫滴列，量測直徑、間距與合併是否完成，並與壓電驅動頻率和相位比對；同時以稱重或液位記錄長時間的平均錫流量，核對與直徑、頻率計算值是否一致，偏差表示衛星滴或噴嘴狀態改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image the droplet train with a strobed backlit camera to measure diameter, spacing and completeness of coalescence and compare with the piezo drive frequency and phase; also log the long-term mean tin flow by weight or level and check it against the value computed from diameter and frequency, since a discrepancy indicates satellite droplets or a changed nozzle state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 取錫滴直徑 27 µm、速度 80 m/s、頻率 50 kHz：間距 = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm；單滴體積 π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³，以密度 7000 kg/m³ 計質量 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg，錫流量 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h；若液柱速度亦為 80 m/s，所需壓力至少為 ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa（約 220 bar），尚未計入噴嘴黏滯損失。
knowledge.textEn: Take 27 µm droplets at 80 m/s and 50 kHz: spacing = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm; each droplet has volume π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³ and, at 7000 kg/m³, mass 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg, so the tin flow is 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h; if the jet also travels at 80 m/s the required pressure is at least ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa (about 220 bar) before viscous nozzle losses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup", which statement holds?
options: 只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。
取錫滴直徑 27 µm、速度 80 m/s、頻率 50 kHz：間距 = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm。
驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。
optionsEn: If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter.
Take 27 µm droplets at 80 m/s and 50 kHz: spacing = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm.
Reaching rated power at acceptance means the source is qualified.
quiz.explanation: 取錫滴直徑 27 µm、速度 80 m/s、頻率 50 kHz：間距 = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm；單滴體積 π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³，以密度 7000 kg/m³ 計質量 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg，錫流量 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h；若液柱速度亦為 80 m/s，所需壓力至少為 ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa（約 220 bar），尚未計入噴嘴黏滯損失。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take 27 µm droplets at 80 m/s and 50 kHz: spacing = 80/50000 = 1.6 mm; each droplet has volume π·D³/6 ≈ 1.03×10⁻¹⁴ m³ and, at 7000 kg/m³, mass 7.2×10⁻¹¹ kg, so the tin flow is 3.6 mg/s ≈ 13 g/h; if the jet also travels at 80 m/s the required pressure is at least ½ρv² = 0.5×7000×80² ≈ 22 MPa (about 220 bar) before viscous nozzle losses. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「錫滴產生器噴嘴」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Droplet-generator nozzle” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用頻閃背光相機拍攝錫滴列，量測直徑、間距與合併是否完成，並與壓電驅動頻率和相位比對；同時以稱重或液位記錄長時間的平均錫流量，核對與直徑、頻率計算值是否一致，偏差表示衛星滴或噴嘴狀態改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image the droplet train with a strobed backlit camera to measure diameter, spacing and completeness of coalescence and compare with the piezo drive frequency and phase; also log the long-term mean tin flow by weight or level and check it against the value computed from diameter and frequency, since a discrepancy indicates satellite droplets or a changed nozzle state. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：噴嘴局部阻塞或氧化錫顆粒會讓液柱偏斜與分裂相位漂移，錫滴出現衛星滴與位置抖動，雷射命中率下降、CE 波動，並把更多未蒸發的錫噴向集光鏡。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Partial nozzle clogging or tin-oxide particles deflect the jet and drift the breakup phase, producing satellite droplets and position jitter, so laser hit rate falls, CE fluctuates and more unvaporised tin is sprayed toward the collector.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用頻閃背光相機拍攝錫滴列，量測直徑、間距與合併是否完成，並與壓電驅動頻率和相位比對；同時以稱重或液位記錄長時間的平均錫流量，核對與直徑、頻率計算值是否一致，偏差表示衛星滴或噴嘴狀態改變。
knowledge.textEn: Image the droplet train with a strobed backlit camera to measure diameter, spacing and completeness of coalescence and compare with the piezo drive frequency and phase; also log the long-term mean tin flow by weight or level and check it against the value computed from diameter and frequency, since a discrepancy indicates satellite droplets or a changed nozzle state.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。
用頻閃背光相機拍攝錫滴列，量測直徑、間距與合併是否完成，並與壓電驅動頻率和相位比對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output.
Image the droplet train with a strobed backlit camera to measure diameter, spacing and completeness of coalescence and compare with the piezo drive frequency and phase.
quiz.explanation: 用頻閃背光相機拍攝錫滴列，量測直徑、間距與合併是否完成，並與壓電驅動頻率和相位比對；同時以稱重或液位記錄長時間的平均錫流量，核對與直徑、頻率計算值是否一致，偏差表示衛星滴或噴嘴狀態改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Image the droplet train with a strobed backlit camera to measure diameter, spacing and completeness of coalescence and compare with the piezo drive frequency and phase; also log the long-term mean tin flow by weight or level and check it against the value computed from diameter and frequency, since a discrepancy indicates satellite droplets or a changed nozzle state. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錫滴產生器噴嘴」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Droplet-generator nozzle” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 噴嘴局部阻塞或氧化錫顆粒會讓液柱偏斜與分裂相位漂移，錫滴出現衛星滴與位置抖動，雷射命中率下降、CE 波動，並把更多未蒸發的錫噴向集光鏡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Partial nozzle clogging or tin-oxide particles deflect the jet and drift the breakup phase, producing satellite droplets and position jitter, so laser hit rate falls, CE fluctuates and more unvaporised tin is sprayed toward the collector. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：錫滴直徑決定可用的錫質量與電漿尺寸，頻率與速度決定錫滴間距，而噴嘴磨損或阻塞會直接改變這三個量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Droplet diameter sets the available tin mass and plasma size, frequency and velocity set the droplet spacing, and nozzle wear or clogging changes all three at once.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錫滴做得越大，EUV 輸出一定越多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bigger droplets always produce more EUV." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 噴嘴局部阻塞或氧化錫顆粒會讓液柱偏斜與分裂相位漂移，錫滴出現衛星滴與位置抖動，雷射命中率下降、CE 波動，並把更多未蒸發的錫噴向集光鏡。
knowledge.textEn: Partial nozzle clogging or tin-oxide particles deflect the jet and drift the breakup phase, producing satellite droplets and position jitter, so laser hit rate falls, CE fluctuates and more unvaporised tin is sprayed toward the collector.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錫滴產生器與 Rayleigh–Plateau 分裂」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Droplet generator and Rayleigh–Plateau breakup" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 噴嘴局部阻塞或氧化錫顆粒會讓液柱偏斜與分裂相位漂移，錫滴出現衛星滴與位置抖動，雷射命中率下降、CE 波動，並把更多未蒸發的錫噴向集光鏡。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
前脈衝只是把錫滴預熱，省略也無妨。
optionsEn: Partial nozzle clogging or tin-oxide particles deflect the jet and drift the breakup phase, producing satellite droplets and position jitter, so laser hit rate falls, CE fluctuates and more unvaporised tin is sprayed toward the collector.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted.
quiz.explanation: 噴嘴局部阻塞或氧化錫顆粒會讓液柱偏斜與分裂相位漂移，錫滴出現衛星滴與位置抖動，雷射命中率下降、CE 波動，並把更多未蒸發的錫噴向集光鏡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Partial nozzle clogging or tin-oxide particles deflect the jet and drift the breakup phase, producing satellite droplets and position jitter, so laser hit rate falls, CE fluctuates and more unvaporised tin is sprayed toward the collector. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CO₂ 驅動雷射與前脈衝」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CO₂ drive laser and pre-pulse” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驅動雷射採主振盪功率放大（MOPA）架構：種子雷射產生低能量脈衝，經多級 CO₂ 放大器放大到每脈衝數百毫焦，再以反射式光學聚焦到錫滴。先打一個能量較低的前脈衝，把球形錫滴推展成直徑數百微米的薄盤或霧團，使主脈衝能被更大的面積吸收且電漿密度接近最佳，CE 由約 2% 提升到 5% 以上。放大器還需要光隔離，因為錫滴像回射鏡會把光送回放大鏈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CO₂ 驅動雷射與前脈衝」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The drive laser is a master-oscillator power-amplifier (MOPA): a seed laser produces low-energy pulses that multi-stage CO₂ amplifiers raise to hundreds of millijoules per pulse, and reflective optics focus them onto the droplet. A weaker pre-pulse first flattens the spherical droplet into a disc or mist several hundred micrometres across, so the main pulse is absorbed over a larger area at a near-optimal plasma density, lifting CE from about 2% to above 5%. The amplifier chain also needs optical isolation because the droplet acts as a retro-reflector that sends light back into the amplifiers. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CO₂ drive laser and pre-pulse”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若前脈衝使錫滴以徑向速度 60 m/s 展開、主脈衝延遲 2 µs，半徑增加 60×2×10⁻⁶ = 120 µm，形成直徑約 270 µm 的薄盤；主脈衝 0.4 J、脈寬 100 ns 的峰值功率為 4 MW，均分在 π×(135 µm)² ≈ 5.7×10⁻⁸ m² 上的強度約 7×10¹³ W/m² = 7×10⁹ W/cm²，落在 LPP 的典型 10⁹ 到 10¹⁰ W/cm² 區間。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the pre-pulse expands the droplet radially at 60 m/s and the main pulse arrives 2 µs later, the radius grows by 60×2×10⁻⁶ = 120 µm, forming a disc about 270 µm across; a 0.4 J main pulse of 100 ns has a peak power of 4 MW, which spread over π×(135 µm)² ≈ 5.7×10⁻⁸ m² gives an intensity of about 7×10¹³ W/m² = 7×10⁹ W/cm², within the typical LPP window of 10⁹ to 10¹⁰ W/cm².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前脈衝只是把錫滴預熱，省略也無妨。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CO₂ 驅動雷射與前脈衝」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CO₂ drive laser and pre-pulse”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形
knowledge.titleEn: MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping
knowledge.text: 驅動雷射採主振盪功率放大（MOPA）架構：種子雷射產生低能量脈衝，經多級 CO₂ 放大器放大到每脈衝數百毫焦，再以反射式光學聚焦到錫滴。先打一個能量較低的前脈衝，把球形錫滴推展成直徑數百微米的薄盤或霧團，使主脈衝能被更大的面積吸收且電漿密度接近最佳，CE 由約 2% 提升到 5% 以上。

A weaker pre-pulse first flattens the spherical droplet into a disc or mist several hundred micrometres across, so the main pulse is absorbed over a larger area at a near-optimal plasma density, lifting CE from about 2% to above 5%.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前脈衝只是把錫滴預熱，省略也無妨。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

驅動雷射採主振盪功率放大（MOPA）架構：種子雷射產生低能量脈衝，經多級 CO₂ 放大器放大到每脈衝數百毫焦，再以反射式光學聚焦到錫滴。

steps.title: 主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CO₂ 驅動雷射與前脈衝」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CO₂ drive laser and pre-pulse” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若前脈衝使錫滴以徑向速度 60 m/s 展開、主脈衝延遲 2 µs，半徑增加 60×2×10⁻⁶ = 120 µm，形成直徑約 270 µm 的薄盤；主脈衝 0.4 J、脈寬 100 ns 的峰值功率為 4 MW，均分在 π×(135 µm)² ≈ 5.7×10⁻⁸ m² 上的強度約 7×10¹³ W/m² = 7×10⁹ W/cm²，落在 LPP 的典型 10⁹ 到 10¹⁰ W/cm² 區間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the pre-pulse expands the droplet radially at 60 m/s and the main pulse arrives 2 µs later, the radius grows by 60×2×10⁻⁶ = 120 µm, forming a disc about 270 µm across; a 0.4 J main pulse of 100 ns has a peak power of 4 MW, which spread over π×(135 µm)² ≈ 5.7×10⁻⁸ m² gives an intensity of about 7×10¹³ W/m² = 7×10⁹ W/cm², within the typical LPP window of 10⁹ to 10¹⁰ W/cm². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以陰影攝影在不同前脈衝延遲下記錄靶形，量測盤直徑對延遲的關係並擬合展開速度；掃描主脈衝延遲與能量，對每個條件量 CE，找出 CE 最大的延遲窗口並記錄其寬度，作為後續時序控制的容差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record target shapes by shadowgraphy at several pre-pulse delays, measure disc diameter versus delay and fit the expansion velocity; scan the main-pulse delay and energy while measuring CE at each setting, locate the delay window of maximum CE and record its width as the tolerance for later timing control.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若前脈衝使錫滴以徑向速度 60 m/s 展開、主脈衝延遲 2 µs，半徑增加 60×2×10⁻⁶ = 120 µm，形成直徑約 270 µm 的薄盤；主脈衝 0.4 J、脈寬 100 ns 的峰值功率為 4 MW，均分在 π×(135 µm)² ≈ 5.7×10⁻⁸ m² 上的強度約 7×10¹³ W/m² = 7×10⁹ W/cm²，落在 LPP 的典型 10⁹ 到 10¹⁰ W/cm² 區間。
knowledge.textEn: If the pre-pulse expands the droplet radially at 60 m/s and the main pulse arrives 2 µs later, the radius grows by 60×2×10⁻⁶ = 120 µm, forming a disc about 270 µm across; a 0.4 J main pulse of 100 ns has a peak power of 4 MW, which spread over π×(135 µm)² ≈ 5.7×10⁻⁸ m² gives an intensity of about 7×10¹³ W/m² = 7×10⁹ W/cm², within the typical LPP window of 10⁹ to 10¹⁰ W/cm².

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output.
If the pre-pulse expands the droplet radially at 60 m/s and the main pulse arrives 2 µs later, the radius grows by 60×2×10⁻⁶ = 120 µm, forming a disc about 270 µm across.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CO₂ 驅動雷射與前脈衝」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CO₂ drive laser and pre-pulse” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以陰影攝影在不同前脈衝延遲下記錄靶形，量測盤直徑對延遲的關係並擬合展開速度；掃描主脈衝延遲與能量，對每個條件量 CE，找出 CE 最大的延遲窗口並記錄其寬度，作為後續時序控制的容差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record target shapes by shadowgraphy at several pre-pulse delays, measure disc diameter versus delay and fit the expansion velocity; scan the main-pulse delay and energy while measuring CE at each setting, locate the delay window of maximum CE and record its width as the tolerance for later timing control. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：主脈衝延遲偏離最佳窗口，靶形不是過小就是已散成稀薄霧團，CE 可能下降一半；若回射光未被隔離，放大器會自激振盪並損壞光學元件。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A main-pulse delay outside the optimum window leaves the target either too small or dispersed into a thin mist, and CE can halve; if the retro-reflected light is not isolated, the amplifiers self-oscillate and damage optics.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以陰影攝影在不同前脈衝延遲下記錄靶形，量測盤直徑對延遲的關係並擬合展開速度；掃描主脈衝延遲與能量，對每個條件量 CE，找出 CE 最大的延遲窗口並記錄其寬度，作為後續時序控制的容差。
knowledge.textEn: Record target shapes by shadowgraphy at several pre-pulse delays, measure disc diameter versus delay and fit the expansion velocity; scan the main-pulse delay and energy while measuring CE at each setting, locate the delay window of maximum CE and record its width as the tolerance for later timing control.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping"?
options: 以陰影攝影在不同前脈衝延遲下記錄靶形，量測盤直徑對延遲的關係並擬合展開速度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
光源功率只取決於雷射功率。
optionsEn: Record target shapes by shadowgraphy at several pre-pulse delays, measure disc diameter versus delay and fit the expansion velocity.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Source power depends only on the laser power.
quiz.explanation: 以陰影攝影在不同前脈衝延遲下記錄靶形，量測盤直徑對延遲的關係並擬合展開速度；掃描主脈衝延遲與能量，對每個條件量 CE，找出 CE 最大的延遲窗口並記錄其寬度，作為後續時序控制的容差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record target shapes by shadowgraphy at several pre-pulse delays, measure disc diameter versus delay and fit the expansion velocity; scan the main-pulse delay and energy while measuring CE at each setting, locate the delay window of maximum CE and record its width as the tolerance for later timing control. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「CO₂ 驅動雷射與前脈衝」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “CO₂ drive laser and pre-pulse” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 主脈衝延遲偏離最佳窗口，靶形不是過小就是已散成稀薄霧團，CE 可能下降一半；若回射光未被隔離，放大器會自激振盪並損壞光學元件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A main-pulse delay outside the optimum window leaves the target either too small or dispersed into a thin mist, and CE can halve; if the retro-reflected light is not isolated, the amplifiers self-oscillate and damage optics. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：放大器還需要光隔離，因為錫滴像回射鏡會把光送回放大鏈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The amplifier chain also needs optical isolation because the droplet acts as a retro-reflector that sends light back into the amplifiers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「前脈衝只是把錫滴預熱，省略也無妨。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 主脈衝延遲偏離最佳窗口，靶形不是過小就是已散成稀薄霧團，CE 可能下降一半；若回射光未被隔離，放大器會自激振盪並損壞光學元件。
knowledge.textEn: A main-pulse delay outside the optimum window leaves the target either too small or dispersed into a thin mist, and CE can halve; if the retro-reflected light is not isolated, the amplifiers self-oscillate and damage optics.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主振盪功率放大器與前脈衝靶形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "MOPA drive laser and pre-pulse target shaping" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
主脈衝延遲偏離最佳窗口，靶形不是過小就是已散成稀薄霧團，CE 可能下降一半；若回射光未被隔離，放大器會自激振盪並損壞光學元件。
錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A main-pulse delay outside the optimum window leaves the target either too small or dispersed into a thin mist, and CE can halve.
A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock.
quiz.explanation: 主脈衝延遲偏離最佳窗口，靶形不是過小就是已散成稀薄霧團，CE 可能下降一半；若回射光未被隔離，放大器會自激振盪並損壞光學元件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A main-pulse delay outside the optimum window leaves the target either too small or dispersed into a thin mist, and CE can halve; if the retro-reflected light is not isolated, the amplifiers self-oscillate and damage optics. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向」與「脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering" and "Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「錫滴位置偵測與雷射導向」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Droplet detection and laser steering” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每一發雷射都必須在正確時刻命中一顆直徑 27 µm、以 80 m/s 飛行的錫滴，所以光源用雷射光簾與高速光偵測器在錫滴抵達主焦點前量測其通過時刻，用相機或位置敏感偵測器量測橫向位置，再由控制器調整雷射觸發時刻與快速導向鏡的角度。回授迴路的頻寬要能跟上錫滴列的慢速漂移與噴嘴振動，同時以統計方式過濾單顆錫滴的隨機抖動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「錫滴位置偵測與雷射導向」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every laser shot must hit a 27 µm droplet flying at 80 m/s at the right instant, so the source measures each droplet's passage time with laser curtains and fast photodetectors before it reaches the primary focus, measures lateral position with cameras or position-sensitive detectors, and lets the controller adjust the laser trigger time and the angle of fast steering mirrors. The feedback loop must track slow drift of the droplet train and nozzle vibration while statistically filtering the random jitter of individual droplets. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Droplet detection and laser steering”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：速度 80 m/s 時，10 ns 的觸發時序誤差等於 0.8 µm 的縱向位置誤差；偵測光簾在主焦點上游 20 mm，提供 20×10⁻³/80 = 250 µs 的前置時間，相當於 50 kHz 下 12.5 個錫滴週期。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 80 m/s a 10 ns trigger-timing error equals 0.8 µm of longitudinal position error; a detection curtain 20 mm upstream of the primary focus gives 20×10⁻³/80 = 250 µs of lead time, i.e. 12.5 droplet periods at 50 kHz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「錫滴位置偵測與雷射導向」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Droplet detection and laser steering”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向
knowledge.titleEn: Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering
knowledge.text: 每一發雷射都必須在正確時刻命中一顆直徑 27 µm、以 80 m/s 飛行的錫滴，所以光源用雷射光簾與高速光偵測器在錫滴抵達主焦點前量測其通過時刻，用相機或位置敏感偵測器量測橫向位置，再由控制器調整雷射觸發時刻與快速導向鏡的角度。回授迴路的頻寬要能跟上錫滴列的慢速漂移與噴嘴振動，同時以統計方式過濾單顆錫滴的隨機抖動。
knowledge.textEn: Every laser shot must hit a 27 µm droplet flying at 80 m/s at the right instant, so the source measures each droplet's passage time with laser curtains and fast photodetectors before it reaches the primary focus, measures lateral position with cameras or position-sensitive detectors, and lets the controller adjust the laser trigger time and the angle of fast steering mirrors. The feedback loop must track slow drift of the droplet train and nozzle vibration while statistically filtering the random jitter of individual droplets.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering" is correct?
options: 錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。
只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。
每一發雷射都必須在正確時刻命中一顆直徑 27 µm、以 80 m/s 飛行的錫滴，所以光源用雷射光簾與高速光偵測器在錫滴抵達主焦點前量測其通過時刻，用相機或位置敏感偵測器量測橫向位置，再由控制器調整雷射觸發時刻與快速導向鏡的角度。
optionsEn: A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock.
If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter.

Every laser shot must hit a 27 µm droplet flying at 80 m/s at the right instant, so the source measures each droplet's passage time with laser curtains and fast photodetectors before it reaches the primary focus, measures lateral position with cameras or position-sensitive detectors, and lets the controller adjust the laser trigger time and the angle of fast steering mirrors.
quiz.explanation: 每一發雷射都必須在正確時刻命中一顆直徑 27 µm、以 80 m/s 飛行的錫滴，所以光源用雷射光簾與高速光偵測器在錫滴抵達主焦點前量測其通過時刻，用相機或位置敏感偵測器量測橫向位置，再由控制器調整雷射觸發時刻與快速導向鏡的角度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every laser shot must hit a 27 µm droplet flying at 80 m/s at the right instant, so the source measures each droplet's passage time with laser curtains and fast photodetectors before it reaches the primary focus, measures lateral position with cameras or position-sensitive detectors, and lets the controller adjust the laser trigger time and the angle of fast steering mirrors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錫滴位置偵測與雷射導向」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Droplet detection and laser steering” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：速度 80 m/s 時，10 ns 的觸發時序誤差等於 0.8 µm 的縱向位置誤差；偵測光簾在主焦點上游 20 mm，提供 20×10⁻³/80 = 250 µs 的前置時間，相當於 50 kHz 下 12.5 個錫滴週期。若主脈衝焦斑直徑 270 µm，橫向命中容差取 ±10 µm，則導向鏡在 1 m 光程上的角度解析度需優於 10 µrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 80 m/s a 10 ns trigger-timing error equals 0.8 µm of longitudinal position error; a detection curtain 20 mm upstream of the primary focus gives 20×10⁻³/80 = 250 µs of lead time, i.e. 12.5 droplet periods at 50 kHz. With a 270 µm main-pulse spot and a lateral hit tolerance of ±10 µm, the steering mirror needs angular resolution better than 10 µrad over a 1 m path. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄數萬發的錫滴通過時刻與橫向位置，計算標準差與功率譜，區分隨機抖動與週期性的噴嘴振動；再把 CE 逐發與量測到的命中偏差作相關分析，確認偏差在容差內時 CE 平穩，超出時 CE 明顯下降。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the passage time and lateral position of tens of thousands of droplets, compute standard deviation and power spectrum to separate random jitter from periodic nozzle vibration; then correlate shot-by-shot CE with the measured hit offset to confirm that CE stays flat within tolerance and falls clearly beyond it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 速度 80 m/s 時，10 ns 的觸發時序誤差等於 0.8 µm 的縱向位置誤差；偵測光簾在主焦點上游 20 mm，提供 20×10⁻³/80 = 250 µs 的前置時間，相當於 50 kHz 下 12.5 個錫滴週期。若主脈衝焦斑直徑 270 µm，橫向命中容差取 ±10 µm，則導向鏡在 1 m 光程上的角度解析度需優於 10 µrad。
knowledge.textEn: At 80 m/s a 10 ns trigger-timing error equals 0.8 µm of longitudinal position error; a detection curtain 20 mm upstream of the primary focus gives 20×10⁻³/80 = 250 µs of lead time, i.e. 12.5 droplet periods at 50 kHz. With a 270 µm main-pulse spot and a lateral hit tolerance of ±10 µm, the steering mirror needs angular resolution better than 10 µrad over a 1 m path.

steps.title: 錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「錫滴位置偵測與雷射導向」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Droplet detection and laser steering” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄數萬發的錫滴通過時刻與橫向位置，計算標準差與功率譜，區分隨機抖動與週期性的噴嘴振動；再把 CE 逐發與量測到的命中偏差作相關分析，確認偏差在容差內時 CE 平穩，超出時 CE 明顯下降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the passage time and lateral position of tens of thousands of droplets, compute standard deviation and power spectrum to separate random jitter from periodic nozzle vibration; then correlate shot-by-shot CE with the measured hit offset to confirm that CE stays flat within tolerance and falls clearly beyond it. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：偵測器視窗被錫污染後訊號變弱，時序量測開始漏發或誤觸發，雷射打在錫滴之間的空隙，表現為帶內能量間歇歸零與劑量誤差警報。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When tin contaminates the detector windows the signal weakens, timing measurement starts missing or false-triggering, the laser fires into the gap between droplets, and the symptom is intermittent zero in-band energy with dose-error alarms.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 錫滴時序、位置量測與閉環導向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Droplet timing, position metrology and closed-loop steering: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錫滴位置偵測與雷射導向」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Droplet detection and laser steering” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 偵測器視窗被錫污染後訊號變弱，時序量測開始漏發或誤觸發，雷射打在錫滴之間的空隙，表現為帶內能量間歇歸零與劑量誤差警報。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When tin contaminates the detector windows the signal weakens, timing measurement starts missing or false-triggering, the laser fires into the gap between droplets, and the symptom is intermittent zero in-band energy with dose-error alarms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：回授迴路的頻寬要能跟上錫滴列的慢速漂移與噴嘴振動，同時以統計方式過濾單顆錫滴的隨機抖動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The feedback loop must track slow drift of the droplet train and nozzle vibration while statistically filtering the random jitter of individual droplets.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

When tin contaminates the detector windows the signal weakens, timing measurement starts missing or false-triggering, the laser fires into the gap between droplets, and the symptom is intermittent zero in-band energy with dose-error alarms.

steps.title: 脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「EUV 能量監測與劑量控制」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “EUV energy monitor and dose control” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每發 EUV 脈衝能量會因錫滴尺寸、命中偏差與雷射能量而隨機波動，掃描機曝光時晶圓上每一點接收縫隙通過期間的 N 發脈衝，劑量誤差因平均而縮小為單發變異除以 √N。光源以帶內能量監測器逐發量測，並用前饋調整下一發雷射能量，同時掃描機可按即時能量調整掃描速度。劑量誤差直接轉成 CD 誤差，所以光源規格除了功率還包含劑量穩定度與脈衝能量的分佈。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「EUV 能量監測與劑量控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each EUV pulse's energy fluctuates randomly with droplet size, hit offset and laser energy, and during a scan every wafer point receives the N pulses delivered while the slit passes, so the dose error averages down to the single-pulse variation divided by √N. The source measures in-band energy shot by shot and feeds forward a correction to the next laser pulse, while the scanner can also adjust scan speed to the real-time energy. Dose error converts directly into CD error, so the source specification includes dose stability and the pulse-energy distribution alongside power. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “EUV energy monitor and dose control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若單發能量標準差為 5%，縫隙在掃描方向高 2 mm、晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s，每點曝光時間 4 ms，在 50 kHz 下 N = 200 發，劑量標準差 ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%；若劑量對 CD 的靈敏度為 1 nm 每 1%，對應約 0.35 nm 的 CD 隨機誤差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 5% single-pulse standard deviation, a slit 2 mm high in the scan direction and a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s, each point is exposed for 4 ms, which at 50 kHz is N = 200 pulses, so the dose standard deviation ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%; with a dose-to-CD sensitivity of 1 nm per 1%, that is about 0.35 nm of random CD error.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「EUV 能量監測與劑量控制」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “EUV energy monitor and dose control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度
knowledge.text: 每發 EUV 脈衝能量會因錫滴尺寸、命中偏差與雷射能量而隨機波動，掃描機曝光時晶圓上每一點接收縫隙通過期間的 N 發脈衝，劑量誤差因平均而縮小為單發變異除以 √N。光源以帶內能量監測器逐發量測，並用前饋調整下一發雷射能量，同時掃描機可按即時能量調整掃描速度。
knowledge.textEn: Each EUV pulse's energy fluctuates randomly with droplet size, hit offset and laser energy, and during a scan every wafer point receives the N pulses delivered while the slit passes, so the dose error averages down to the single-pulse variation divided by √N. The source measures in-band energy shot by shot and feeds forward a correction to the next laser pulse, while the scanner can also adjust scan speed to the real-time energy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability" is correct?
options: 每發 EUV 脈衝能量會因錫滴尺寸、命中偏差與雷射能量而隨機波動，掃描機曝光時晶圓上每一點接收縫隙通過期間的 N 發脈衝，劑量誤差因平均而縮小為單發變異除以 √N。
只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。
真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。
optionsEn: Each EUV pulse's energy fluctuates randomly with droplet size, hit offset and laser energy, and during a scan every wafer point receives the N pulses delivered while the slit passes, so the dose error averages down to the single-pulse variation divided by √N.
If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter.

steps.title: 脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「EUV 能量監測與劑量控制」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “EUV energy monitor and dose control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若單發能量標準差為 5%，縫隙在掃描方向高 2 mm、晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s，每點曝光時間 4 ms，在 50 kHz 下 N = 200 發，劑量標準差 ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%；若劑量對 CD 的靈敏度為 1 nm 每 1%，對應約 0.35 nm 的 CD 隨機誤差。單發能量若有 1% 的脈衝完全漏打，平均劑量偏移 1%，必須由前饋補償。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 5% single-pulse standard deviation, a slit 2 mm high in the scan direction and a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s, each point is exposed for 4 ms, which at 50 kHz is N = 200 pulses, so the dose standard deviation ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%; with a dose-to-CD sensitivity of 1 nm per 1%, that is about 0.35 nm of random CD error. If 1% of pulses miss entirely, the mean dose shifts by 1% and must be compensated by feedforward. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：連續記錄逐發帶內能量的直方圖與自相關，計算任意連續 200 發的移動平均變異並與 σ/√N 比較；若實測大於預測，表示能量波動有低頻相關性（例如錫滴尺寸緩慢漂移），需要前饋補償而非只靠平均。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record a histogram and autocorrelation of shot-by-shot in-band energy, compute the variance of moving averages over any 200 consecutive pulses and compare with σ/√N; if the measured value exceeds the prediction, the fluctuations are correlated at low frequency, for example slow droplet-size drift, and need feedforward rather than averaging alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 若單發能量標準差為 5%，縫隙在掃描方向高 2 mm、晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s，每點曝光時間 4 ms，在 50 kHz 下 N = 200 發，劑量標準差 ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%；若劑量對 CD 的靈敏度為 1 nm 每 1%，對應約 0.35 nm 的 CD 隨機誤差。單發能量若有 1% 的脈衝完全漏打，平均劑量偏移 1%，必須由前饋補償。
knowledge.textEn: With a 5% single-pulse standard deviation, a slit 2 mm high in the scan direction and a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s, each point is exposed for 4 ms, which at 50 kHz is N = 200 pulses, so the dose standard deviation ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%; with a dose-to-CD sensitivity of 1 nm per 1%, that is about 0.35 nm of random CD error. If 1% of pulses miss entirely, the mean dose shifts by 1% and must be compensated by feedforward.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability", which statement holds?
options: 雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。
若單發能量標準差為 5%，縫隙在掃描方向高 2 mm、晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s，每點曝光時間 4 ms，在 50 kHz 下 N = 200 發，劑量標準差 ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%。
錫滴做得越大，EUV 輸出一定越多。
optionsEn: More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output.

With a 5% single-pulse standard deviation, a slit 2 mm high in the scan direction and a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s, each point is exposed for 4 ms, which at 50 kHz is N = 200 pulses, so the dose standard deviation ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%.
Bigger droplets always produce more EUV.
quiz.explanation: 若單發能量標準差為 5%，縫隙在掃描方向高 2 mm、晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s，每點曝光時間 4 ms，在 50 kHz 下 N = 200 發，劑量標準差 ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%；若劑量對 CD 的靈敏度為 1 nm 每 1%，對應約 0.35 nm 的 CD 隨機誤差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 5% single-pulse standard deviation, a slit 2 mm high in the scan direction and a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s, each point is exposed for 4 ms, which at 50 kHz is N = 200 pulses, so the dose standard deviation ≈ 5%/√200 ≈ 0.35%; with a dose-to-CD sensitivity of 1 nm per 1%, that is about 0.35 nm of random CD error. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「EUV 能量監測與劑量控制」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “EUV energy monitor and dose control” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 連續記錄逐發帶內能量的直方圖與自相關，計算任意連續 200 發的移動平均變異並與 σ/√N 比較；若實測大於預測，表示能量波動有低頻相關性（例如錫滴尺寸緩慢漂移），需要前饋補償而非只靠平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record a histogram and autocorrelation of shot-by-shot in-band energy, compute the variance of moving averages over any 200 consecutive pulses and compare with σ/√N; if the measured value exceeds the prediction, the fluctuations are correlated at low frequency, for example slow droplet-size drift, and need feedforward rather than averaging alone. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：能量監測器前的濾片被錫或碳污染後讀值偏低，前饋迴路誤以為能量不足而持續加大雷射能量，實際晶圓劑量過量、CD 系統性偏小，並加速集光鏡損耗。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When tin or carbon contaminates the filter in front of the energy monitor the reading falls low, the feedforward loop keeps raising laser energy to compensate, the wafer is overdosed with systematically small CD, and collector wear accelerates.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 連續記錄逐發帶內能量的直方圖與自相關，計算任意連續 200 發的移動平均變異並與 σ/√N 比較；若實測大於預測，表示能量波動有低頻相關性（例如錫滴尺寸緩慢漂移），需要前饋補償而非只靠平均。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
前脈衝只是把錫滴預熱，省略也無妨。
連續記錄逐發帶內能量的直方圖與自相關，計算任意連續 200 發的移動平均變異並與 σ/√N 比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted.
Record a histogram and autocorrelation of shot-by-shot in-band energy, compute the variance of moving averages over any 200 consecutive pulses and compare with σ/√N.
quiz.explanation: 連續記錄逐發帶內能量的直方圖與自相關，計算任意連續 200 發的移動平均變異並與 σ/√N 比較；若實測大於預測，表示能量波動有低頻相關性（例如錫滴尺寸緩慢漂移），需要前饋補償而非只靠平均。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record a histogram and autocorrelation of shot-by-shot in-band energy, compute the variance of moving averages over any 200 consecutive pulses and compare with σ/√N; if the measured value exceeds the prediction, the fluctuations are correlated at low frequency, for example slow droplet-size drift, and need feedforward rather than averaging alone. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「EUV 能量監測與劑量控制」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “EUV energy monitor and dose control” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 能量監測器前的濾片被錫或碳污染後讀值偏低，前饋迴路誤以為能量不足而持續加大雷射能量，實際晶圓劑量過量、CD 系統性偏小，並加速集光鏡損耗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When tin or carbon contaminates the filter in front of the energy monitor the reading falls low, the feedforward loop keeps raising laser energy to compensate, the wafer is overdosed with systematically small CD, and collector wear accelerates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：劑量誤差直接轉成 CD 誤差，所以光源規格除了功率還包含劑量穩定度與脈衝能量的分佈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dose error converts directly into CD error, so the source specification includes dose stability and the pulse-energy distribution alongside power.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 能量監測器前的濾片被錫或碳污染後讀值偏低，前饋迴路誤以為能量不足而持續加大雷射能量，實際晶圓劑量過量、CD 系統性偏小，並加速集光鏡損耗。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「脈衝能量統計與劑量穩定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pulse-energy statistics and dose stability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 能量監測器前的濾片被錫或碳污染後讀值偏低，前饋迴路誤以為能量不足而持續加大雷射能量，實際晶圓劑量過量、CD 系統性偏小，並加速集光鏡損耗。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。

Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
The vessel is under vacuum, so the collector cannot get contaminated.

quiz.explanationEn: When tin or carbon contaminates the filter in front of the energy monitor the reading falls low, the feedforward loop keeps raising laser energy to compensate, the wafer is overdosed with systematically small CD, and collector wear accelerates. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命」與「光源驗收、可用度與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life" and "Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電漿產生高速錫離子、中性原子與微滴，直接撞擊會濺蝕或覆蓋集光鏡多層膜，所以腔內充入低壓氫氣作為緩衝：氫分子碰撞使錫離子減速，EUV 光解離產生的氫自由基又能與沉積的錫反應生成氣態 SnH₄ 被抽走。氫氣壓力是權衡：壓力高抑制碎屑較好，但 EUV 被氫吸收的損失也增加。集光鏡反射率的衰減速率是光源壽命的核心指標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The plasma emits fast tin ions, neutrals and micro-droplets that would sputter or coat the collector multilayer, so the vessel is filled with low-pressure hydrogen as a buffer: collisions with hydrogen molecules slow the tin ions, and hydrogen radicals produced by EUV photolysis react with deposited tin to form gaseous SnH₄ that is pumped away. Hydrogen pressure is a trade-off, since higher pressure suppresses debris better but increases EUV absorption. The decay rate of collector reflectance is the central lifetime metric of the source. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 Pa、300 K 的氫氣數密度 n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³；取 H₂ 在 13.5 nm 的吸收截面約 4×10⁻²⁰ cm²（氫原子光游離截面的量級估計），1 m 路徑的 n·σ·L ≈ 0.097，透過率 ≈ 91%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hydrogen at 100 Pa and 300 K has number density n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³; taking an H₂ absorption cross-section of about 4×10⁻²⁰ cm² at 13.5 nm (an order-of-magnitude estimate from the hydrogen photoionisation cross-section), a 1 m path gives n·σ·L ≈ 0.097 and about 91% transmission.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The vessel is under vacuum, so the collector cannot get contaminated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命
knowledge.titleEn: Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life
knowledge.text: 電漿產生高速錫離子、中性原子與微滴，直接撞擊會濺蝕或覆蓋集光鏡多層膜，所以腔內充入低壓氫氣作為緩衝：氫分子碰撞使錫離子減速，EUV 光解離產生的氫自由基又能與沉積的錫反應生成氣態 SnH₄ 被抽走。氫氣壓力是權衡：壓力高抑制碎屑較好，但 EUV 被氫吸收的損失也增加。
knowledge.textEn: The plasma emits fast tin ions, neutrals and micro-droplets that would sputter or coat the collector multilayer, so the vessel is filled with low-pressure hydrogen as a buffer: collisions with hydrogen molecules slow the tin ions, and hydrogen radicals produced by EUV photolysis react with deposited tin to form gaseous SnH₄ that is pumped away. Hydrogen pressure is a trade-off, since higher pressure suppresses debris better but increases EUV absorption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The vessel is under vacuum, so the collector cannot get contaminated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life" is correct?
options: 真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。
電漿產生高速錫離子、中性原子與微滴，直接撞擊會濺蝕或覆蓋集光鏡多層膜，所以腔內充入低壓氫氣作為緩衝：氫分子碰撞使錫離子減速，EUV 光解離產生的氫自由基又能與沉積的錫反應生成氣態 SnH₄ 被抽走。
驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。
optionsEn: The vessel is under vacuum, so the collector cannot get contaminated.

The plasma emits fast tin ions, neutrals and micro-droplets that would sputter or coat the collector multilayer, so the vessel is filled with low-pressure hydrogen as a buffer: collisions with hydrogen molecules slow the tin ions, and hydrogen radicals produced by EUV photolysis react with deposited tin to form gaseous SnH₄ that is pumped away.
Reaching rated power at acceptance means the source is qualified.
quiz.explanation: 電漿產生高速錫離子、中性原子與微滴，直接撞擊會濺蝕或覆蓋集光鏡多層膜，所以腔內充入低壓氫氣作為緩衝：氫分子碰撞使錫離子減速，EUV 光解離產生的氫自由基又能與沉積的錫反應生成氣態 SnH₄ 被抽走。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The plasma emits fast tin ions, neutrals and micro-droplets that would sputter or coat the collector multilayer, so the vessel is filled with low-pressure hydrogen as a buffer: collisions with hydrogen molecules slow the tin ions, and hydrogen radicals produced by EUV photolysis react with deposited tin to form gaseous SnH₄ that is pumped away. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 Pa、300 K 的氫氣數密度 n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³；取 H₂ 在 13.5 nm 的吸收截面約 4×10⁻²⁰ cm²（氫原子光游離截面的量級估計），1 m 路徑的 n·σ·L ≈ 0.097，透過率 ≈ 91%。錫在 13.5 nm 的 β ≈ 0.07，α = 4πβ/λ ≈ 0.065 nm⁻¹，集光鏡上 1 nm 錫膜雙程損失 1 − exp(−0.13) ≈ 12%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Hydrogen at 100 Pa and 300 K has number density n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³; taking an H₂ absorption cross-section of about 4×10⁻²⁰ cm² at 13.5 nm (an order-of-magnitude estimate from the hydrogen photoionisation cross-section), a 1 m path gives n·σ·L ≈ 0.097 and about 91% transmission. Tin has β ≈ 0.07 at 13.5 nm, so α = 4πβ/λ ≈ 0.065 nm⁻¹ and a 1 nm tin film on the collector costs 1 − exp(−0.13) ≈ 12% in double pass. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以原位反射率量測或 IF 功率對雷射功率的比值追蹤集光鏡衰減速率，與腔內錫沉積的見證片以 XPS 或橢偏儀量得的厚度對照；改變氫氣壓力時同時記錄 IF 功率與衰減速率，確認透過率損失與碎屑抑制的權衡落在預期曲線上。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track the collector decay rate periodically through in-situ reflectance measurement or the ratio of IF power to laser power, and cross-check with tin thickness measured by XPS or ellipsometry on witness samples inside the vessel; when hydrogen pressure is changed, log IF power and decay rate together to confirm the transmission-versus-debris trade-off follows the expected curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 100 Pa、300 K 的氫氣數密度 n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³；取 H₂ 在 13.5 nm 的吸收截面約 4×10⁻²⁰ cm²（氫原子光游離截面的量級估計），1 m 路徑的 n·σ·L ≈ 0.097，透過率 ≈ 91%。錫在 13.5 nm 的 β ≈ 0.07，α = 4πβ/λ ≈ 0.065 nm⁻¹，集光鏡上 1 nm 錫膜雙程損失 1 − exp(−0.13) ≈ 12%。
knowledge.textEn: Hydrogen at 100 Pa and 300 K has number density n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³; taking an H₂ absorption cross-section of about 4×10⁻²⁰ cm² at 13.5 nm (an order-of-magnitude estimate from the hydrogen photoionisation cross-section), a 1 m path gives n·σ·L ≈ 0.097 and about 91% transmission. Tin has β ≈ 0.07 at 13.5 nm, so α = 4πβ/λ ≈ 0.065 nm⁻¹ and a 1 nm tin film on the collector costs 1 − exp(−0.13) ≈ 12% in double pass.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life", which statement holds?
options: 光源功率只取決於雷射功率。
前脈衝只是把錫滴預熱，省略也無妨。
optionsEn: Source power depends only on the laser power.
The pre-pulse merely pre-heats the droplet and can be omitted.
Hydrogen at 100 Pa and 300 K has number density n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³.
quiz.explanation: 100 Pa、300 K 的氫氣數密度 n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³；取 H₂ 在 13.5 nm 的吸收截面約 4×10⁻²⁰ cm²（氫原子光游離截面的量級估計），1 m 路徑的 n·σ·L ≈ 0.097，透過率 ≈ 91%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrogen at 100 Pa and 300 K has number density n = P/(kT) = 100/(1.38×10⁻²³×300) ≈ 2.4×10²² m⁻³ = 2.4×10¹⁶ cm⁻³; taking an H₂ absorption cross-section of about 4×10⁻²⁰ cm² at 13.5 nm (an order-of-magnitude estimate from the hydrogen photoionisation cross-section), a 1 m path gives n·σ·L ≈ 0.097 and about 91% transmission. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 定期以原位反射率量測或 IF 功率對雷射功率的比值追蹤集光鏡衰減速率，與腔內錫沉積的見證片以 XPS 或橢偏儀量得的厚度對照；改變氫氣壓力時同時記錄 IF 功率與衰減速率，確認透過率損失與碎屑抑制的權衡落在預期曲線上。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track the collector decay rate periodically through in-situ reflectance measurement or the ratio of IF power to laser power, and cross-check with tin thickness measured by XPS or ellipsometry on witness samples inside the vessel; when hydrogen pressure is changed, log IF power and decay rate together to confirm the transmission-versus-debris trade-off follows the expected curve. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：氫自由基清潔若因氣流分佈不均而在集光鏡邊緣不足，錫在該區域累積成數奈米厚，反射率呈現環狀衰減；若氫氣流量過低，微滴直接撞擊造成不可逆的多層膜損傷，整片集光鏡必須更換。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If uneven gas flow starves the collector edge of hydrogen radicals, tin accumulates there to several nanometres and reflectance decays in a ring pattern; if hydrogen flow is too low, micro-droplets strike the multilayer directly and cause irreversible damage that forces a full collector replacement.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期以原位反射率量測或 IF 功率對雷射功率的比值追蹤集光鏡衰減速率，與腔內錫沉積的見證片以 XPS 或橢偏儀量得的厚度對照；改變氫氣壓力時同時記錄 IF 功率與衰減速率，確認透過率損失與碎屑抑制的權衡落在預期曲線上。
knowledge.textEn: Track the collector decay rate periodically through in-situ reflectance measurement or the ratio of IF power to laser power, and cross-check with tin thickness measured by XPS or ellipsometry on witness samples inside the vessel; when hydrogen pressure is changed, log IF power and decay rate together to confirm the transmission-versus-debris trade-off follows the expected curve.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life"?
options: 定期以原位反射率量測或 IF 功率對雷射功率的比值追蹤集光鏡衰減速率，與腔內錫沉積的見證片以 XPS 或橢偏儀量得的厚度對照。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
錫滴列夠穩定，雷射用固定時脈觸發即可。
optionsEn: Track the collector decay rate periodically through in-situ reflectance measurement or the ratio of IF power to laser power, and cross-check with tin thickness measured by XPS or ellipsometry on witness samples inside the vessel.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock.
quiz.explanation: 定期以原位反射率量測或 IF 功率對雷射功率的比值追蹤集光鏡衰減速率，與腔內錫沉積的見證片以 XPS 或橢偏儀量得的厚度對照；改變氫氣壓力時同時記錄 IF 功率與衰減速率，確認透過率損失與碎屑抑制的權衡落在預期曲線上。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track the collector decay rate periodically through in-situ reflectance measurement or the ratio of IF power to laser power, and cross-check with tin thickness measured by XPS or ellipsometry on witness samples inside the vessel; when hydrogen pressure is changed, log IF power and decay rate together to confirm the transmission-versus-debris trade-off follows the expected curve. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氫氣緩衝與集光鏡清潔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Hydrogen buffer gas and collector cleaning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 氫自由基清潔若因氣流分佈不均而在集光鏡邊緣不足，錫在該區域累積成數奈米厚，反射率呈現環狀衰減；若氫氣流量過低，微滴直接撞擊造成不可逆的多層膜損傷，整片集光鏡必須更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If uneven gas flow starves the collector edge of hydrogen radicals, tin accumulates there to several nanometres and reflectance decays in a ring pattern; if hydrogen flow is too low, micro-droplets strike the multilayer directly and cause irreversible damage that forces a full collector replacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：集光鏡反射率的衰減速率是光源壽命的核心指標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The decay rate of collector reflectance is the central lifetime metric of the source.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空腔裡沒有空氣，所以集光鏡不會被污染。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The vessel is under vacuum, so the collector cannot get contaminated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 氫自由基清潔若因氣流分佈不均而在集光鏡邊緣不足，錫在該區域累積成數奈米厚，反射率呈現環狀衰減；若氫氣流量過低，微滴直接撞擊造成不可逆的多層膜損傷，整片集光鏡必須更換。
knowledge.textEn: If uneven gas flow starves the collector edge of hydrogen radicals, tin accumulates there to several nanometres and reflectance decays in a ring pattern; if hydrogen flow is too low, micro-droplets strike the multilayer directly and cause irreversible damage that forces a full collector replacement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「碎屑抑制、氫氣透過率與集光鏡壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Debris mitigation, hydrogen transmission and collector life" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
氫自由基清潔若因氣流分佈不均而在集光鏡邊緣不足，錫在該區域累積成數奈米厚，反射率呈現環狀衰減。
驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If uneven gas flow starves the collector edge of hydrogen radicals, tin accumulates there to several nanometres and reflectance decays in a ring pattern.
Reaching rated power at acceptance means the source is qualified.
quiz.explanation: 氫自由基清潔若因氣流分佈不均而在集光鏡邊緣不足，錫在該區域累積成數奈米厚，反射率呈現環狀衰減；若氫氣流量過低，微滴直接撞擊造成不可逆的多層膜損傷，整片集光鏡必須更換。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If uneven gas flow starves the collector edge of hydrogen radicals, tin accumulates there to several nanometres and reflectance decays in a ring pattern; if hydrogen flow is too low, micro-droplets strike the multilayer directly and cause irreversible damage that forces a full collector replacement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 光源驗收、可用度與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光源驗收與可用度記錄」如何決定EUV 光源錫滴控制概念的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source acceptance and availability record” determines the key performance of “EUV-source tin-droplet control concepts”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光源驗收不是一次量到額定功率就結束，而是以長時間運轉記錄證明：IF 帶內功率、劑量穩定度、錫滴產生器連續運轉時數、集光鏡反射率衰減速率與可用度都必須在規格內。可用度由平均故障間隔與平均修復時間決定，錫滴產生器更換與集光鏡更換是主要的計畫性停機。交接文件要包含每個子系統的基準曲線與允許漂移，讓現場工程師能從趨勢判斷何時該維護而非等待故障。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光源驗收與可用度記錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Source acceptance is not a single reading of rated power but a long-run record showing that in-band IF power, dose stability, droplet-generator continuous running hours, collector reflectance decay rate and availability all stay within specification. Availability follows from mean time between failures and mean time to repair, with droplet-generator and collector replacement as the main planned downtimes. The handoff record must carry baseline curves and allowed drift for every subsystem so field engineers can schedule maintenance from trends instead of waiting for failures. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Source acceptance and availability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：可用度 A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR)：若錫滴產生器平均每 400 h 需更換且更換需 10 h，A = 400/410 ≈ 97.6%；若集光鏡反射率以每週 0.5% 的速率衰減，從 0.60 降到允許下限 0.50 需 (0.10/0.60)/0.005 ≈ 33 週，據此排定更換週期。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Availability A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR): if the droplet generator must be replaced every 400 h on average and replacement takes 10 h, A = 400/410 ≈ 97.6%; if collector reflectance decays at 0.5% per week, falling from 0.60 to the allowed floor of 0.50 takes (0.10/0.60)/0.005 ≈ 33 weeks, which sets the replacement interval.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching rated power at acceptance means the source is qualified." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光源驗收與可用度記錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Source acceptance and availability record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光源驗收、可用度與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 光源驗收不是一次量到額定功率就結束，而是以長時間運轉記錄證明：IF 帶內功率、劑量穩定度、錫滴產生器連續運轉時數、集光鏡反射率衰減速率與可用度都必須在規格內。可用度由平均故障間隔與平均修復時間決定，錫滴產生器更換與集光鏡更換是主要的計畫性停機。
knowledge.textEn: Source acceptance is not a single reading of rated power but a long-run record showing that in-band IF power, dose stability, droplet-generator continuous running hours, collector reflectance decay rate and availability all stay within specification. Availability follows from mean time between failures and mean time to repair, with droplet-generator and collector replacement as the main planned downtimes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reaching rated power at acceptance means the source is qualified. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光源驗收、可用度與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。
雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。
光源驗收不是一次量到額定功率就結束，而是以長時間運轉記錄證明：IF 帶內功率、劑量穩定度、錫滴產生器連續運轉時數、集光鏡反射率衰減速率與可用度都必須在規格內。
optionsEn: Reaching rated power at acceptance means the source is qualified.
More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output.

Source acceptance is not a single reading of rated power but a long-run record showing that in-band IF power, dose stability, droplet-generator continuous running hours, collector reflectance decay rate and availability all stay within specification.
quiz.explanation: 光源驗收不是一次量到額定功率就結束，而是以長時間運轉記錄證明：IF 帶內功率、劑量穩定度、錫滴產生器連續運轉時數、集光鏡反射率衰減速率與可用度都必須在規格內。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Source acceptance is not a single reading of rated power but a long-run record showing that in-band IF power, dose stability, droplet-generator continuous running hours, collector reflectance decay rate and availability all stay within specification. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光源驗收、可用度與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光源驗收與可用度記錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Source acceptance and availability record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：可用度 A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR)：若錫滴產生器平均每 400 h 需更換且更換需 10 h，A = 400/410 ≈ 97.6%；若集光鏡反射率以每週 0.5% 的速率衰減，從 0.60 降到允許下限 0.50 需 (0.10/0.60)/0.005 ≈ 33 週，據此排定更換週期。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Availability A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR): if the droplet generator must be replaced every 400 h on average and replacement takes 10 h, A = 400/410 ≈ 97.6%; if collector reflectance decays at 0.5% per week, falling from 0.60 to the allowed floor of 0.50 takes (0.10/0.60)/0.005 ≈ 33 weeks, which sets the replacement interval. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以數週的連續運轉資料計算實際可用度、IF 功率趨勢與劑量誤差分佈，與驗收規格逐項比較；核對交接文件中每條基準曲線都附有量測方法、日期與不確定度，並由第二位工程師獨立重算功率鏈與可用度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the actual availability, IF power trend and dose-error distribution from several weeks of continuous running data and compare each with the acceptance specification; check that every baseline curve in the handoff record carries its measurement method, date and uncertainty, and have a second engineer independently recompute the power chain and availability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 可用度 A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR)：若錫滴產生器平均每 400 h 需更換且更換需 10 h，A = 400/410 ≈ 97.6%；若集光鏡反射率以每週 0.5% 的速率衰減，從 0.60 降到允許下限 0.50 需 (0.10/0.60)/0.005 ≈ 33 週，據此排定更換週期。
knowledge.textEn: Availability A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR): if the droplet generator must be replaced every 400 h on average and replacement takes 10 h, A = 400/410 ≈ 97.6%; if collector reflectance decays at 0.5% per week, falling from 0.60 to the allowed floor of 0.50 takes (0.10/0.60)/0.005 ≈ 33 weeks, which sets the replacement interval.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

錫滴做得越大，EUV 輸出一定越多。

A stable droplet train lets the laser fire on a fixed clock.
