steps.title: 光源驗收、可用度與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光源驗收與可用度記錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Source acceptance and availability record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以數週的連續運轉資料計算實際可用度、IF 功率趨勢與劑量誤差分佈，與驗收規格逐項比較；核對交接文件中每條基準曲線都附有量測方法、日期與不確定度，並由第二位工程師獨立重算功率鏈與可用度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the actual availability, IF power trend and dose-error distribution from several weeks of continuous running data and compare each with the acceptance specification; check that every baseline curve in the handoff record carries its measurement method, date and uncertainty, and have a second engineer independently recompute the power chain and availability. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若驗收只憑短時間的峰值功率，長期運轉時錫滴產生器壽命與集光鏡衰減未被記錄，產線在數月後才發現產能逐步下滑，而且沒有基準曲線可以判斷是哪個子系統造成。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If acceptance relies on short-term peak power, droplet-generator life and collector decay go unrecorded, the fab discovers a gradual throughput decline only months later, and without baseline curves there is no way to tell which subsystem is responsible.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以數週的連續運轉資料計算實際可用度、IF 功率趨勢與劑量誤差分佈，與驗收規格逐項比較；核對交接文件中每條基準曲線都附有量測方法、日期與不確定度，並由第二位工程師獨立重算功率鏈與可用度。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the actual availability, IF power trend and dose-error distribution from several weeks of continuous running data and compare each with the acceptance specification; check that every baseline curve in the handoff record carries its measurement method, date and uncertainty, and have a second engineer independently recompute the power chain and availability.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光源驗收、可用度與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以數週的連續運轉資料計算實際可用度、IF 功率趨勢與劑量誤差分佈，與驗收規格逐項比較。
只要平均功率達標，單發能量波動不重要。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Compute the actual availability, IF power trend and dose-error distribution from several weeks of continuous running data and compare each with the acceptance specification.
If average power meets specification, single-pulse fluctuations do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以數週的連續運轉資料計算實際可用度、IF 功率趨勢與劑量誤差分佈，與驗收規格逐項比較；核對交接文件中每條基準曲線都附有量測方法、日期與不確定度，並由第二位工程師獨立重算功率鏈與可用度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute the actual availability, IF power trend and dose-error distribution from several weeks of continuous running data and compare each with the acceptance specification; check that every baseline curve in the handoff record carries its measurement method, date and uncertainty, and have a second engineer independently recompute the power chain and availability. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光源驗收、可用度與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光源驗收與可用度記錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Source acceptance and availability record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若驗收只憑短時間的峰值功率，長期運轉時錫滴產生器壽命與集光鏡衰減未被記錄，產線在數月後才發現產能逐步下滑，而且沒有基準曲線可以判斷是哪個子系統造成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If acceptance relies on short-term peak power, droplet-generator life and collector decay go unrecorded, the fab discovers a gradual throughput decline only months later, and without baseline curves there is no way to tell which subsystem is responsible. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件要包含每個子系統的基準曲線與允許漂移，讓現場工程師能從趨勢判斷何時該維護而非等待故障。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must carry baseline curves and allowed drift for every subsystem so field engineers can schedule maintenance from trends instead of waiting for failures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「驗收時達到額定功率就代表光源合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching rated power at acceptance means the source is qualified." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光源驗收、可用度與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Source acceptance, availability and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
雷射功率越高，EUV 輸出就一定按比例增加。
若驗收只憑短時間的峰值功率，長期運轉時錫滴產生器壽命與集光鏡衰減未被記錄，產線在數月後才發現產能逐步下滑，而且沒有基準曲線可以判斷是哪個子系統造成。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
More laser power always gives proportionally more EUV output.

title: 微影晶圓台精密定位
titleEn: Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
summary: 以步進掃描微影機的雙台晶圓台為對象：先建立光罩台與晶圓台 4:1 同步掃描的 MA/MSD 誤差定義與 Abbe 原理，再拆解長短行程 Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量、雷射干涉儀與二維光柵編碼器的解析度與空氣折射率限制，接著以伺服頻寬、前饋精度、校正圖與隔振傳遞率建立奈米級誤差預算，最後整合成產能與套刻驗收記錄。
summaryEn: Taking the dual wafer stage of a step-and-scan lithography system as the object, the course first defines the MA/MSD errors of 4:1 synchronised reticle and wafer scanning and the Abbe principle, then dissects long- and short-stroke Lorentz actuators with balance masses, the resolution and air-index limits of laser interferometers and two-dimensional grating encoders, builds a nanometre error budget from servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy, calibration maps and isolation transmissibility, and closes with a throughput and overlay acceptance record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 掃描與誤差預算練習：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s、光罩台 2.0 m/s、加速度 20 m/s²。加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 6.25 mm；掃描 33 mm 場加 8 mm 縫隙共 41 mm 需 82 ms；每點在縫隙下 16 ms。伺服交越 300 Hz 時 ω_c = 1885 rad/s，無前饋的加速度追蹤誤差 a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm，前饋精度 99.9% 後剩 5.6 nm，這是 MA 的一個主要項。量測側：干涉儀死程 300 mm、10 mK 溫度變化給 2.8 nm，改用 3 mm 氣隙的光柵編碼器後為 0.028 nm。MA 預算取編碼器殘差 0.4、Abbe 0.3、伺服 0.5、熱 0.4、光柵 0.3 nm，RSS ≈ 0.87 nm；若保留干涉儀的 2.8 nm 空氣項，RSS 變成 √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm，超過 1.5 nm 的套刻分配，這就是光柵編碼器取代長光程干涉儀的工程理由。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Scan and error-budget exercise: wafer scan speed 0.5 m/s, reticle stage 2.0 m/s, acceleration 20 m/s². Reaching 0.5 m/s takes 25 ms and 6.25 mm; the 33 mm field plus 8 mm slit, 41 mm in all, takes 82 ms; each point sits under the slit for 16 ms. With a 300 Hz servo crossover, ω_c = 1885 rad/s, the acceleration tracking error without feedforward is a/ω_c² = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm, and 99.9% feedforward accuracy leaves 5.6 nm, a major MA item. On the measurement side, a 300 mm interferometer dead path with a 10 mK change gives 2.8 nm, whereas a grating encoder with a 3 mm air gap gives 0.028 nm. The MA budget with encoder residual 0.4, Abbe 0.3, servo 0.5, thermal 0.4 and grating 0.3 nm gives RSS ≈ 0.87 nm; keeping the interferometer's 2.8 nm air term instead raises the RSS to √(0.75 + 7.84) ≈ 2.9 nm, beyond a 1.5 nm overlay allocation, which is the engineering reason grating encoders replaced long-path interferometers. All numbers are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」與「Abbe 原理與計量框架」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan" and "The Abbe principle and the metrology frame": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。晶圓上任一點在縫隙通過期間累積曝光，所以位置誤差的影響分成兩類：這段時間的平均誤差（MA）直接變成套刻誤差，而誤差的移動標準差（MSD）讓影像模糊、降低對比與 CD 均勻性。因此規格不是單一的定位精度，而是對掃描時間窗平均後的 MA 與 MSD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. Any wafer point accumulates exposure while the slit passes, so position error acts in two ways: its average over that window (MA) becomes overlay error, while its moving standard deviation (MSD) blurs the image and degrades contrast and CD uniformity. The specification is therefore not a single positioning accuracy but MA and MSD averaged over the scan time window. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義
knowledge.text: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。晶圓上任一點在縫隙通過期間累積曝光，所以位置誤差的影響分成兩類：這段時間的平均誤差（MA）直接變成套刻誤差，而誤差的移動標準差（MSD）讓影像模糊、降低對比與 CD 均勻性。
knowledge.textEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. Any wafer point accumulates exposure while the slit passes, so position error acts in two ways: its average over that window (MA) becomes overlay error, while its moving standard deviation (MSD) blurs the image and degrades contrast and CD uniformity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan" is correct?
options: 晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。
步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。
只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。
optionsEn: The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy.

A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one.
With straight enough guideways, rotation errors can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 步進掃描機以一條約 26 mm 寬、數毫米高的照明縫隙掃過光罩，光罩台與晶圓台必須以 4:1 的速度比反向同步運動，掃完一個 26×33 mm 的場後晶圓台步進到下一場。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A step-and-scan system sweeps an illumination slit roughly 26 mm wide and a few millimetres high across the reticle while the reticle stage and wafer stage move in opposite directions at a 4:1 speed ratio, and after each 26×33 mm field the wafer stage steps to the next one. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s；掃描長度 33 mm 加縫隙高 8 mm 共 41 mm，需時 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms；以 20 m/s² 加速到 0.5 m/s 需 25 ms 與 v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm 的助跑距離；晶圓上每一點在 8 mm 縫隙下停留 16 ms，MA 與 MSD 就是在這 16 ms 窗口內計算。
knowledge.textEn: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan", which statement holds?
options: 干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。
一次出廠校正就能讓校正圖永久有效。
晶圓掃描速度 0.5 m/s 時光罩台為 2.0 m/s。
optionsEn: An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy.
A single factory calibration keeps the calibration map valid forever.
At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s.

quiz.explanationEn: At a wafer scan speed of 0.5 m/s the reticle stage runs at 2.0 m/s; the 33 mm scan plus an 8 mm slit height is 41 mm and takes 41×10⁻³/0.5 = 82 ms; accelerating to 0.5 m/s at 20 m/s² takes 25 ms and a run-up distance of v²/(2a) = 0.25/40 = 6.25 mm; every wafer point sits under the 8 mm slit for 16 ms, and MA and MSD are computed over that 16 ms window. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：掃描方向的加速段若未完全穩定就進入曝光，場的起始端會留下系統性的 MA 偏移與較高的 MSD，表現為每個場上緣的套刻偏差與線寬粗糙，而靜態定位測試完全看不出來。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。
knowledge.textEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan"?
options: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。
optionsEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency.
quiz.explanation: 從伺服系統以取樣率數十 kHz 記錄光罩台與晶圓台的位置誤差，先換算成晶圓座標（光罩誤差除以 4），對 16 ms 的滑動窗口計算 MA 與 MSD，沿掃描方向畫成曲線，再與曝光後的套刻與 CD 量測對應，確認兩者的空間分佈一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log reticle- and wafer-stage position errors from the servo at tens of kHz, convert them to wafer coordinates (reticle error divided by 4), compute MA and MSD over a sliding 16 ms window, plot them along the scan direction and correlate with post-exposure overlay and CD measurements to confirm matching spatial patterns. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 步進掃描的同步誤差定義：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曝光縫隙與同步掃描」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Exposure slit and synchronised scanning” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 掃描方向的加速段若未完全穩定就進入曝光，場的起始端會留下系統性的 MA 偏移與較高的 MSD，表現為每個場上緣的套刻偏差與線寬粗糙，而靜態定位測試完全看不出來。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此規格不是單一的定位精度，而是對掃描時間窗平均後的 MA 與 MSD。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The specification is therefore not a single positioning accuracy but MA and MSD averaged over the scan time window.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 掃描方向的加速段若未完全穩定就進入曝光，場的起始端會留下系統性的 MA 偏移與較高的 MSD，表現為每個場上緣的套刻偏差與線寬粗糙，而靜態定位測試完全看不出來。
knowledge.textEn: If exposure starts before the acceleration phase has fully settled, the leading edge of every field carries a systematic MA offset and elevated MSD, seen as overlay deviation and rougher linewidth along one field edge, something a static positioning test never reveals.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「步進掃描的同步誤差定義」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Defining synchronisation error in step-and-scan" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The Abbe principle and the metrology frame: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Abbe 原理要求量測軸與被量測點共線，否則載台的微小旋轉會乘上偏置距離變成位置誤差。晶圓表面與干涉儀光束或編碼器讀頭之間總有數毫米的垂直偏置，所以晶圓台必須同時量測六個自由度，用俯仰與偏擺角把 Abbe 誤差算回去。所有量測都參照一個由 Zerodur 或碳化矽製成、與機架隔振的計量框架，投影鏡頭與感測器固定其上，使位置量測的參考零點與影像位置共用同一剛體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. There is always a vertical offset of several millimetres between the wafer surface and the interferometer beams or encoder heads, so the wafer stage must be measured in all six degrees of freedom and the pitch and yaw angles used to compute the Abbe error back out. Every measurement refers to a metrology frame made of Zerodur or silicon carbide and isolated from the base frame; the projection lens and sensors are mounted on it so the position reference and the image share one rigid body. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Metrology frame and Abbe offset”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Abbe 誤差 = 偏置 × 旋轉角：偏置 5 mm、載台俯仰 0.2 µrad 時誤差 = 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm；若角度量測解析度為 0.05 µrad，殘餘 Abbe 誤差可壓到 0.25 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Abbe error = offset × rotation: with a 5 mm offset and 0.2 µrad of stage pitch the error is 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm; with an angular measurement resolution of 0.05 µrad the residual Abbe error falls to 0.25 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With straight enough guideways, rotation errors can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Metrology frame and Abbe offset”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. There is always a vertical offset of several millimetres between the wafer surface and the interferometer beams or encoder heads, so the wafer stage must be measured in all six degrees of freedom and the pitch and yaw angles used to compute the Abbe error back out.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With straight enough guideways, rotation errors can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Abbe 原理與計量框架」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error.
quiz.explanation: Abbe 原理要求量測軸與被量測點共線，否則載台的微小旋轉會乘上偏置距離變成位置誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Abbe principle demands that the measurement axis pass through the point of interest, otherwise a tiny stage rotation multiplied by the offset distance becomes a position error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The Abbe principle and the metrology frame: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Abbe 誤差 = 偏置 × 旋轉角：偏置 5 mm、載台俯仰 0.2 µrad 時誤差 = 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm；若角度量測解析度為 0.05 µrad，殘餘 Abbe 誤差可壓到 0.25 nm。計量框架若在 1 m 跨距上有 10 nm 的熱變形，對應 0.01 µrad 的參考傾斜，在 300 mm 晶圓邊緣造成 1.5 nm 的位置偏差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Abbe error = offset × rotation: with a 5 mm offset and 0.2 µrad of stage pitch the error is 5×10⁻³×0.2×10⁻⁶ = 1 nm; with an angular measurement resolution of 0.05 µrad the residual Abbe error falls to 0.25 nm. A thermal deformation of 10 nm over a 1 m span of the metrology frame equals a 0.01 µrad reference tilt, which displaces positions by 1.5 nm at the edge of a 300 mm wafer. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：刻意讓載台在固定 XY 位置上做已知的俯仰與偏擺微動，記錄 XY 讀值的變化，擬合出實際的 Abbe 偏置距離並與機械設計值比較；再以放在晶圓位置的參考標記對準量測，確認補償後的殘差小於預算值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Command known small pitch and yaw motions at a fixed XY position, record the resulting XY readings, fit the actual Abbe offset distance and compare it with the mechanical design value; then measure alignment on a reference mark at wafer height to confirm that the compensated residual stays below budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A thermal deformation of 10 nm over a 1 m span of the metrology frame equals a 0.01 µrad reference tilt, which displaces positions by 1.5 nm at the edge of a 300 mm wafer.

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The Abbe principle and the metrology frame: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 刻意讓載台在固定 XY 位置上做已知的俯仰與偏擺微動，記錄 XY 讀值的變化，擬合出實際的 Abbe 偏置距離並與機械設計值比較；再以放在晶圓位置的參考標記對準量測，確認補償後的殘差小於預算值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Command known small pitch and yaw motions at a fixed XY position, record the resulting XY readings, fit the actual Abbe offset distance and compare it with the mechanical design value; then measure alignment on a reference mark at wafer height to confirm that the compensated residual stays below budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：晶圓夾盤更換後晶圓表面高度改變 0.5 mm，若軟體仍用舊的 Abbe 偏置，每 1 µrad 的載台旋轉就多出 0.5 nm 的未補償誤差，套刻在場與場之間出現與旋轉相關的系統性圖案。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After a chuck exchange raises the wafer surface by 0.5 mm, software still using the old Abbe offset leaves 0.5 nm of uncompensated error per microradian of stage rotation, and overlay shows a rotation-correlated systematic pattern from field to field.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: Abbe 原理與計量框架：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The Abbe principle and the metrology frame: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「計量框架與 Abbe 偏置」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Metrology frame and Abbe offset” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 晶圓夾盤更換後晶圓表面高度改變 0.5 mm，若軟體仍用舊的 Abbe 偏置，每 1 µrad 的載台旋轉就多出 0.5 nm 的未補償誤差，套刻在場與場之間出現與旋轉相關的系統性圖案。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After a chuck exchange raises the wafer surface by 0.5 mm, software still using the old Abbe offset leaves 0.5 nm of uncompensated error per microradian of stage rotation, and overlay shows a rotation-correlated systematic pattern from field to field. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：所有量測都參照一個由 Zerodur 或碳化矽製成、與機架隔振的計量框架，投影鏡頭與感測器固定其上，使位置量測的參考零點與影像位置共用同一剛體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every measurement refers to a metrology frame made of Zerodur or silicon carbide and isolated from the base frame; the projection lens and sensors are mounted on it so the position reference and the image share one rigid body.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長短行程致動與反作用力管理」與「干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long- and short-stroke actuation and reaction-force management" and "Interferometer resolution, air index and grating metrology": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長短行程致動與反作用力管理：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Long- and short-stroke actuation and reaction-force management: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lorentz actuators and balance mass” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 晶圓台採雙層結構：長行程台以線性或平面馬達在整片晶圓範圍移動，精度在微米級；短行程台以六組 Lorentz 致動器相對長行程台做毫米級行程的六自由度微動，達到奈米級。Lorentz 致動器力與電流成正比且無接觸、無磁滯，重力由永磁補償器承擔以減少發熱。加速時的反作用力若傳到機架會激發振動，所以馬達定子裝在可自由滑動的平衡質量上，動量守恆讓反作用力留在平衡質量而不進入計量框架。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The wafer stage is a two-layer system: a long-stroke stage driven by linear or planar motors covers the whole wafer at micrometre accuracy, while a short-stroke stage rides on it with six Lorentz actuators providing millimetre-range six-degree-of-freedom fine motion at nanometre level. Lorentz actuators give force proportional to current without contact or hysteresis, and a permanent-magnet gravity compensator carries the weight to limit heating. Reaction forces during acceleration would excite the frame, so the motor stators sit on a freely sliding balance mass, and momentum conservation keeps the reaction in the balance mass instead of the metrology frame. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lorentz actuators and balance mass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：短行程台 20 kg 以 20 m/s² 加速需 F = 400 N；馬達力常數 40 N/A 時電流 10 A，線圈電阻 2 Ω 的瞬時銅損 I²R = 200 W，必須水冷。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 20 kg short-stroke stage accelerating at 20 m/s² needs F = 400 N; with a motor force constant of 40 N/A the current is 10 A, and a 2 Ω coil dissipates I²R = 200 W during the pulse, which requires water cooling.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器力量越大，定位就越精準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stronger actuators give more precise positioning." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Lorentz 致動器與平衡質量」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lorentz actuators and balance mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：短行程台 20 kg 以 20 m/s² 加速需 F = 400 N；馬達力常數 40 N/A 時電流 10 A，線圈電阻 2 Ω 的瞬時銅損 I²R = 200 W，必須水冷。平衡質量 400 kg 時，載台掃描 33 mm 使平衡質量反向移動 (20/400)×33 = 1.65 mm，傳到機架的只剩導軌摩擦與纜線拖曳的殘餘力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 20 kg short-stroke stage accelerating at 20 m/s² needs F = 400 N; with a motor force constant of 40 N/A the current is 10 A, and a 2 Ω coil dissipates I²R = 200 W during the pulse, which requires water cooling. With a 400 kg balance mass a 33 mm stage scan moves the balance mass (20/400)×33 = 1.65 mm the other way, and only residual guide friction and cable drag reach the frame. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在馬達線圈上裝溫度感測器並以熱像儀記錄加速循環中的溫升，與 I²R 估計值比較；用加速度計量測機架在掃描循環中的振動頻譜，比較有無平衡質量的差異，確認反作用力隔離達到預期的數量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit temperature sensors on the motor coils and record the temperature rise with a thermal camera during acceleration cycles, comparing with the I²R estimate; measure the frame vibration spectrum with accelerometers during scan cycles with and without the balance mass to confirm the expected order of reaction-force isolation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 在馬達線圈上裝溫度感測器並以熱像儀記錄加速循環中的溫升，與 I²R 估計值比較；用加速度計量測機架在掃描循環中的振動頻譜，比較有無平衡質量的差異，確認反作用力隔離達到預期的數量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit temperature sensors on the motor coils and record the temperature rise with a thermal camera during acceleration cycles, comparing with the I²R estimate; measure the frame vibration spectrum with accelerometers during scan cycles with and without the balance mass to confirm the expected order of reaction-force isolation. steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If coil heat is not fully removed, local warming of the short-stroke stage expands the metal structure and shifts the sensor-to-wafer distance, seen as overlay drifting slowly within a lot and recovering after idle cooling.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instruction: 線圈發熱若未被完全帶走，短行程台的局部溫升使金屬結構膨脹並改變感測器到晶圓的距離，表現為曝光批次中套刻隨時間緩慢漂移，待機冷卻後又恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.observation: 連結機制：加速時的反作用力若傳到機架會激發振動，所以馬達定子裝在可自由滑動的平衡質量上，動量守恆讓反作用力留在平衡質量而不進入計量框架。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reaction forces during acceleration would excite the frame, so the motor stators sit on a freely sliding balance mass, and momentum conservation keeps the reaction in the balance mass instead of the metrology frame.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器力量越大，定位就越精準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Interferometer resolution, air index and grating metrology: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser interferometer and grating encoder” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統晶圓台以 HeNe 雷射外差干涉儀量測位置：平面鏡雙程架構使每條干涉條紋對應四分之一波長，再由相位內插得到次奈米解析度。它的弱點是光束在空氣中走過數百毫米，空氣折射率隨溫度、壓力與濕度變化，死程誤差與擾流成為主要誤差源。近代機台改用固定在計量框架下方的二維光柵板與載台上的編碼器讀頭，空氣光程縮短到毫米級，對環境的靈敏度下降兩個數量級，代價是光柵板本身的圖樣誤差必須被校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conventional wafer stages are measured with HeNe heterodyne laser interferometers: a double-pass plane-mirror configuration makes each fringe correspond to a quarter wavelength, and phase interpolation yields sub-nanometre resolution. Their weakness is the beam path of several hundred millimetres through air, whose refractive index varies with temperature, pressure and humidity, so dead-path error and turbulence dominate. Modern systems instead use two-dimensional grating plates fixed under the metrology frame with encoder heads on the stage, shrinking the air path to millimetres and cutting environmental sensitivity by two orders of magnitude, at the cost of having to calibrate the grating pattern itself. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser interferometer and grating encoder”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：HeNe λ = 632.8 nm 雙程干涉儀每條紋 λ/4 = 158.2 nm，4096 倍相位內插得 0.039 nm 解析度；但空氣 dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，死程 300 mm 遇到 10 mK 溫度變化就產生 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm 誤差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A HeNe λ = 632.8 nm double-pass interferometer has λ/4 = 158.2 nm per fringe and 4096-fold phase interpolation gives 0.039 nm resolution; but air has dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, so a 300 mm dead path with a 10 mK temperature change produces 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm of error.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laser interferometer and grating encoder”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: HeNe λ = 632.8 nm 雙程干涉儀每條紋 λ/4 = 158.2 nm，4096 倍相位內插得 0.039 nm 解析度；但空氣 dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，死程 300 mm 遇到 10 mK 溫度變化就產生 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm 誤差。光柵編碼器的空氣間隙約 3 mm，同樣 10 mK 只造成 0.028 nm。
knowledge.textEn: A HeNe λ = 632.8 nm double-pass interferometer has λ/4 = 158.2 nm per fringe and 4096-fold phase interpolation gives 0.039 nm resolution; but air has dn/dT ≈ −0.93×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, so a 300 mm dead path with a 10 mK temperature change produces 0.3×0.93×10⁻⁶×0.01 ≈ 2.8 nm of error. A grating encoder with a 3 mm air gap suffers only 0.028 nm for the same 10 mK.

steps.title: 干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測：量測與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laser interferometer and grating encoder” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 讓載台靜止並連續記錄干涉儀或編碼器讀值數分鐘，計算 Allan 偏差隨平均時間的曲線，區分白雜訊、空氣擾流與熱漂移；再以溫度、壓力感測器同步記錄，用 Edlén 公式修正後比較殘差是否下降到預期量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Hold the stage still and log the interferometer or encoder reading for several minutes, compute the Allan deviation versus averaging time to separate white noise, air turbulence and thermal drift; log temperature and pressure simultaneously, apply the Edlén correction and check that the residual falls to the expected level. steps.observation: 注意干擾：干涉儀光路若有局部熱源造成空氣擾流，位置雜訊在 1 到 10 Hz 出現數奈米的隨機漂移，伺服系統會忠實跟隨這個假訊號而讓載台真的抖動，MSD 超標。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interferometer resolution, air index and grating metrology: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射干涉儀與光柵編碼器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laser interferometer and grating encoder” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀光路若有局部熱源造成空氣擾流，位置雜訊在 1 到 10 Hz 出現數奈米的隨機漂移，伺服系統會忠實跟隨這個假訊號而讓載台真的抖動，MSD 超標。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A local heat source in an interferometer beam path produces air turbulence with several nanometres of random drift between 1 and 10 Hz, the servo faithfully follows this false signal so the stage really shakes, and MSD exceeds specification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：近代機台改用固定在計量框架下方的二維光柵板與載台上的編碼器讀頭，空氣光程縮短到毫米級，對環境的靈敏度下降兩個數量級，代價是光柵板本身的圖樣誤差必須被校正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern systems instead use two-dimensional grating plates fixed under the metrology frame with encoder heads on the stage, shrinking the air path to millimetres and cutting environmental sensitivity by two orders of magnitude, at the cost of having to calibrate the grating pattern itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 干涉儀光路若有局部熱源造成空氣擾流，位置雜訊在 1 到 10 Hz 出現數奈米的隨機漂移，伺服系統會忠實跟隨這個假訊號而讓載台真的抖動，MSD 超標。

quiz.question: 在「干涉儀解析度、空氣折射率與光柵量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「伺服頻寬、前饋精度與結構共振」與「載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy and structural resonance" and "Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 伺服頻寬、前饋精度與結構共振：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy and structural resonance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「伺服迴路與前饋控制」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Servo loop and feedforward control” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 載台位置迴路通常用 PID 加上陷波濾波器，交越頻率在數百赫茲；更高的頻寬會被載台本體的第一個結構共振限制，經驗上共振頻率要高於頻寬的三到五倍，因此載台用碳化矽或陶瓷等高比剛度材料。掃描時的追蹤誤差主要不是靠回授壓低，而是用加速度前饋：把參考軌跡的加速度乘上質量直接送到致動器，回授只處理前饋的殘差與擾動。前饋的質量與延遲若估錯，殘差就直接以加速度為比例出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「伺服迴路與前饋控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The stage position loop is typically PID with notch filters and a crossover of a few hundred hertz; higher bandwidth is limited by the first structural resonance of the stage body, which by experience must lie three to five times above the bandwidth, hence stage bodies of silicon carbide or ceramics with high specific stiffness. Tracking error during scanning is suppressed mainly by acceleration feedforward rather than feedback: the reference trajectory's acceleration times the mass is sent straight to the actuators and the loop handles only feedforward residuals and disturbances. A wrong mass or delay in the feedforward produces an error proportional to acceleration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Servo loop and feedforward control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙積分受控體在恆定加速度下的穩態誤差 e ≈ a/ω_c²：a = 20 m/s²、交越頻率 300 Hz（ω_c = 1885 rad/s）時 e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm；若前饋把 99.9% 的加速力提供出來，剩餘誤差為 5.6 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A double-integrator plant under constant acceleration has steady-state error e ≈ a/ω_c²: with a = 20 m/s² and a 300 Hz crossover (ω_c = 1885 rad/s), e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm; if feedforward supplies 99.9% of the acceleration force, the remaining error is 5.6 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提高伺服增益就能消除掃描時的追蹤誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Raising the servo gain removes scan tracking error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「伺服迴路與前饋控制」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Servo loop and feedforward control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Tracking error during scanning is suppressed mainly by acceleration feedforward rather than feedback: the reference trajectory's acceleration times the mass is sent straight to the actuators and the loop handles only feedforward residuals and disturbances.

steps.title: 伺服頻寬、前饋精度與結構共振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy and structural resonance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伺服迴路與前饋控制」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Servo loop and feedforward control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙積分受控體在恆定加速度下的穩態誤差 e ≈ a/ω_c²：a = 20 m/s²、交越頻率 300 Hz（ω_c = 1885 rad/s）時 e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm；若前饋把 99.9% 的加速力提供出來，剩餘誤差為 5.6 nm。頻寬 300 Hz 要求第一共振高於約 1.5 kHz；整定時間常數 1/ω_c ≈ 0.53 ms，從 1 µm 收斂到 1 nm 需 ln(1000)×0.53 ≈ 3.7 ms。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A double-integrator plant under constant acceleration has steady-state error e ≈ a/ω_c²: with a = 20 m/s² and a 300 Hz crossover (ω_c = 1885 rad/s), e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm; if feedforward supplies 99.9% of the acceleration force, the remaining error is 5.6 nm. A 300 Hz bandwidth requires the first resonance above about 1.5 kHz; the settling time constant 1/ω_c ≈ 0.53 ms means converging from 1 µm to 1 nm takes ln(1000)×0.53 ≈ 3.7 ms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

knowledge.text: 雙積分受控體在恆定加速度下的穩態誤差 e ≈ a/ω_c²：a = 20 m/s²、交越頻率 300 Hz（ω_c = 1885 rad/s）時 e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm；若前饋把 99.9% 的加速力提供出來，剩餘誤差為 5.6 nm。頻寬 300 Hz 要求第一共振高於約 1.5 kHz；整定時間常數 1/ω_c ≈ 0.53 ms，從 1 µm 收斂到 1 nm 需 ln(1000)×0.53 ≈ 3.7 ms。
knowledge.textEn: A double-integrator plant under constant acceleration has steady-state error e ≈ a/ω_c²: with a = 20 m/s² and a 300 Hz crossover (ω_c = 1885 rad/s), e = 20/3.55×10⁶ ≈ 5.6 µm; if feedforward supplies 99.9% of the acceleration force, the remaining error is 5.6 nm. A 300 Hz bandwidth requires the first resonance above about 1.5 kHz; the settling time constant 1/ω_c ≈ 0.53 ms means converging from 1 µm to 1 nm takes ln(1000)×0.53 ≈ 3.7 ms.

steps.title: 伺服頻寬、前饋精度與結構共振：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy and structural resonance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「伺服迴路與前饋控制」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Servo loop and feedforward control” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量測開迴路頻率響應（Bode 圖）確認增益交越、相位餘裕與共振位置；執行標準掃描軌跡並記錄誤差，分別關閉與開啟前饋比較誤差量級，再微調前饋質量與延遲參數直到加速段的殘差不再與加速度成比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the open-loop frequency response (Bode plot) to confirm gain crossover, phase margin and resonance locations; run the standard scan trajectory and log the error with feedforward off and on to compare magnitudes, then tune the feedforward mass and delay until the residual during acceleration no longer scales with acceleration. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：纜線拖鏈或冷卻水管的剛度隨位置改變，使受控體在某些位置多出一個低頻共振，固定的陷波濾波器失效，載台在特定場位置出現數十赫茲的極限環振盪與 MSD 尖峰。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Cable carriers or coolant hoses whose stiffness varies with position add a low-frequency resonance at certain locations, the fixed notch filters no longer match, and the stage shows limit-cycle oscillation of tens of hertz with MSD spikes at specific field positions.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 伺服頻寬、前饋精度與結構共振：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Servo bandwidth, feedforward accuracy and structural resonance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伺服迴路與前饋控制」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 纜線拖鏈或冷卻水管的剛度隨位置改變，使受控體在某些位置多出一個低頻共振，固定的陷波濾波器失效，載台在特定場位置出現數十赫茲的極限環振盪與 MSD 尖峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Cable carriers or coolant hoses whose stiffness varies with position add a low-frequency resonance at certain locations, the fixed notch filters no longer match, and the stage shows limit-cycle oscillation of tens of hertz with MSD spikes at specific field positions. steps.observation: 連結機制：前饋的質量與延遲若估錯，殘差就直接以加速度為比例出現。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提高伺服增益就能消除掃描時的追蹤誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「校正圖與誤差預算表」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Calibration maps and error-budget table” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量測系統本身有系統性誤差：干涉儀反射鏡的平面度、光柵板的圖樣誤差、讀頭之間的非正交性與比例誤差，都要用自校正或交叉比對建成校正圖並在控制器中即時扣除。MA 誤差直接進入套刻預算，而 MSD 則像高斯模糊降低影像對比，對小間距的影響最大。誤差預算表把量測、致動、熱與振動的各項以均方根合成，並區分可校正的系統項與不可校正的隨機項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正圖與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The measurement system has systematic errors of its own: flatness of interferometer mirrors, pattern errors of the grating plate, non-orthogonality and scale errors between heads, all of which must be captured by self-calibration or cross-comparison into calibration maps subtracted in real time by the controller. MA error enters the overlay budget directly, while MSD acts like a Gaussian blur that reduces image contrast, most severely at small pitch. The error-budget table combines measurement, actuation, thermal and vibration terms in quadrature and separates correctable systematic terms from uncorrectable random ones. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibration maps and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：MSD = 3 nm 對週期 80 nm 線條的對比因子為 exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973，即損失 2.7%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An MSD of 3 nm gives a contrast factor for 80 nm pitch lines of exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973, a 2.7% loss.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次出廠校正就能讓校正圖永久有效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single factory calibration keeps the calibration map valid forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「校正圖與誤差預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Calibration maps and error-budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
