steps.title: 載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「校正圖與誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Calibration maps and error-budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：MSD = 3 nm 對週期 80 nm 線條的對比因子為 exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973，即損失 2.7%。MA 預算：編碼器校正殘差 0.4 nm、Abbe 補償殘差 0.3 nm、伺服 MA 0.5 nm、熱漂移 0.4 nm、光柵圖樣殘差 0.3 nm，RSS = √(0.16+0.09+0.25+0.16+0.09) = √0.75 ≈ 0.87 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An MSD of 3 nm gives a contrast factor for 80 nm pitch lines of exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973, a 2.7% loss. MA budget: encoder calibration residual 0.4 nm, Abbe compensation residual 0.3 nm, servo MA 0.5 nm, thermal drift 0.4 nm and grating pattern residual 0.3 nm give RSS = √(0.16+0.09+0.25+0.16+0.09) = √0.75 ≈ 0.87 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用晶圓上的參考標記陣列在不同載台位置與旋轉下重複對準，以自校正演算法分離載台誤差與標記誤差並更新校正圖；之後曝光測試晶圓，比較套刻量測的系統性殘差與預算表中各項的合計，確認未被建模的項目不超過預算的 20%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align repeatedly on a reference mark array at different stage positions and rotations, separate stage error from mark error with a self-calibration algorithm and update the calibration maps; then expose test wafers and compare the systematic overlay residual with the sum of the budget items, confirming that unmodelled contributions stay below 20% of the budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: MSD = 3 nm 對週期 80 nm 線條的對比因子為 exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973，即損失 2.7%。MA 預算：編碼器校正殘差 0.4 nm、Abbe 補償殘差 0.3 nm、伺服 MA 0.5 nm、熱漂移 0.4 nm、光柵圖樣殘差 0.3 nm，RSS = √(0.16+0.09+0.25+0.16+0.09) = √0.75 ≈ 0.87 nm。
knowledge.textEn: An MSD of 3 nm gives a contrast factor for 80 nm pitch lines of exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973, a 2.7% loss. MA budget: encoder calibration residual 0.4 nm, Abbe compensation residual 0.3 nm, servo MA 0.5 nm, thermal drift 0.4 nm and grating pattern residual 0.3 nm give RSS = √(0.16+0.09+0.25+0.16+0.09) = √0.75 ≈ 0.87 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget", which statement holds?
options: 晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。
MSD = 3 nm 對週期 80 nm 線條的對比因子為 exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973，即損失 2.7%。
致動器力量越大，定位就越精準。
optionsEn: The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy.
An MSD of 3 nm gives a contrast factor for 80 nm pitch lines of exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973, a 2.7% loss.
Stronger actuators give more precise positioning.
quiz.explanation: MSD = 3 nm 對週期 80 nm 線條的對比因子為 exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973，即損失 2.7%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An MSD of 3 nm gives a contrast factor for 80 nm pitch lines of exp(−2π²σ²/p²) = exp(−2π²×9/6400) ≈ 0.973, a 2.7% loss. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「校正圖與誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Calibration maps and error-budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用晶圓上的參考標記陣列在不同載台位置與旋轉下重複對準，以自校正演算法分離載台誤差與標記誤差並更新校正圖；之後曝光測試晶圓，比較套刻量測的系統性殘差與預算表中各項的合計，確認未被建模的項目不超過預算的 20%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align repeatedly on a reference mark array at different stage positions and rotations, separate stage error from mark error with a self-calibration algorithm and update the calibration maps; then expose test wafers and compare the systematic overlay residual with the sum of the budget items, confirming that unmodelled contributions stay below 20% of the budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光柵板若因固定座應力而緩慢變形，校正圖會在幾週內過期，套刻出現平滑的低階場內圖案（放大率與旋轉項）逐漸增大，直到重新校正才消失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If mount stress slowly deforms the grating plate, the calibration map expires within weeks and overlay develops smooth low-order intra-field patterns (magnification and rotation terms) that grow until recalibration.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用晶圓上的參考標記陣列在不同載台位置與旋轉下重複對準，以自校正演算法分離載台誤差與標記誤差並更新校正圖；之後曝光測試晶圓，比較套刻量測的系統性殘差與預算表中各項的合計，確認未被建模的項目不超過預算的 20%。
knowledge.textEn: Align repeatedly on a reference mark array at different stage positions and rotations, separate stage error from mark error with a self-calibration algorithm and update the calibration maps; then expose test wafers and compare the systematic overlay residual with the sum of the budget items, confirming that unmodelled contributions stay below 20% of the budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。
用晶圓上的參考標記陣列在不同載台位置與旋轉下重複對準，以自校正演算法分離載台誤差與標記誤差並更新校正圖。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy.
Align repeatedly on a reference mark array at different stage positions and rotations, separate stage error from mark error with a self-calibration algorithm and update the calibration maps.
quiz.explanation: 用晶圓上的參考標記陣列在不同載台位置與旋轉下重複對準，以自校正演算法分離載台誤差與標記誤差並更新校正圖；之後曝光測試晶圓，比較套刻量測的系統性殘差與預算表中各項的合計，確認未被建模的項目不超過預算的 20%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align repeatedly on a reference mark array at different stage positions and rotations, separate stage error from mark error with a self-calibration algorithm and update the calibration maps; then expose test wafers and compare the systematic overlay residual with the sum of the budget items, confirming that unmodelled contributions stay below 20% of the budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「校正圖與誤差預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Calibration maps and error-budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 光柵板若因固定座應力而緩慢變形，校正圖會在幾週內過期，套刻出現平滑的低階場內圖案（放大率與旋轉項）逐漸增大，直到重新校正才消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If mount stress slowly deforms the grating plate, the calibration map expires within weeks and overlay develops smooth low-order intra-field patterns (magnification and rotation terms) that grow until recalibration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：誤差預算表把量測、致動、熱與振動的各項以均方根合成，並區分可校正的系統項與不可校正的隨機項。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The error-budget table combines measurement, actuation, thermal and vibration terms in quadrature and separates correctable systematic terms from uncorrectable random ones.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次出廠校正就能讓校正圖永久有效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single factory calibration keeps the calibration map valid forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 光柵板若因固定座應力而緩慢變形，校正圖會在幾週內過期，套刻出現平滑的低階場內圖案（放大率與旋轉項）逐漸增大，直到重新校正才消失。
knowledge.textEn: If mount stress slowly deforms the grating plate, the calibration map expires within weeks and overlay develops smooth low-order intra-field patterns (magnification and rotation terms) that grow until recalibration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「載台校正、MSD 對比損失與誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stage calibration, MSD contrast loss and the error budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 光柵板若因固定座應力而緩慢變形，校正圖會在幾週內過期，套刻出現平滑的低階場內圖案（放大率與旋轉項）逐漸增大，直到重新校正才消失。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。
optionsEn: If mount stress slowly deforms the grating plate, the calibration map expires within weeks and overlay develops smooth low-order intra-field patterns (magnification and rotation terms) that grow until recalibration.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency.
quiz.explanation: 光柵板若因固定座應力而緩慢變形，校正圖會在幾週內過期，套刻出現平滑的低階場內圖案（放大率與旋轉項）逐漸增大，直到重新校正才消失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If mount stress slowly deforms the grating plate, the calibration map expires within weeks and overlay develops smooth low-order intra-field patterns (magnification and rotation terms) that grow until recalibration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計」與「載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration" and "Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「主動隔振與地面振動」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active isolation and floor vibration” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 計量框架與投影鏡頭由三到四組氣浮或電磁隔振器支撐，形成約 1 Hz 的低頻彈簧質量系統，地面振動在遠高於共振的頻率被衰減；主動隔振再以加速度計回授增加阻尼並壓低共振峰，同時以載台反作用力與重心移動的前饋抵消可預測的擾動。晶圓廠地板的振動等級、幫浦與空調的窄頻擾動、以及載台本身的動量轉移，都必須納入整機振動預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動隔振與地面振動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The metrology frame and projection lens rest on three or four pneumatic or electromagnetic isolators forming a spring-mass system near 1 Hz, so floor vibration well above that resonance is attenuated; active isolation adds accelerometer feedback for damping and resonance suppression, plus feedforward to cancel predictable disturbances from stage reaction forces and centre-of-gravity shifts. The fab floor vibration class, narrowband disturbances from pumps and air handling, and momentum transfer from the stages themselves all enter the whole-tool vibration budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active isolation and floor vibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「主動隔振與地面振動」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Active isolation and floor vibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計
knowledge.text: 計量框架與投影鏡頭由三到四組氣浮或電磁隔振器支撐，形成約 1 Hz 的低頻彈簧質量系統，地面振動在遠高於共振的頻率被衰減；主動隔振再以加速度計回授增加阻尼並壓低共振峰，同時以載台反作用力與重心移動的前饋抵消可預測的擾動。晶圓廠地板的振動等級、幫浦與空調的窄頻擾動、以及載台本身的動量轉移，都必須納入整機振動預算。
knowledge.textEn: The metrology frame and projection lens rest on three or four pneumatic or electromagnetic isolators forming a spring-mass system near 1 Hz, so floor vibration well above that resonance is attenuated; active isolation adds accelerometer feedback for damping and resonance suppression, plus feedforward to cancel predictable disturbances from stage reaction forces and centre-of-gravity shifts. The fab floor vibration class, narrowband disturbances from pumps and air handling, and momentum transfer from the stages themselves all enter the whole-tool vibration budget.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration" is correct?
options: 隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。
計量框架與投影鏡頭由三到四組氣浮或電磁隔振器支撐，形成約 1 Hz 的低頻彈簧質量系統，地面振動在遠高於共振的頻率被衰減。
套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。
optionsEn: Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency.

The metrology frame and projection lens rest on three or four pneumatic or electromagnetic isolators forming a spring-mass system near 1 Hz, so floor vibration well above that resonance is attenuated.
A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely.
quiz.explanation: 計量框架與投影鏡頭由三到四組氣浮或電磁隔振器支撐，形成約 1 Hz 的低頻彈簧質量系統，地面振動在遠高於共振的頻率被衰減；主動隔振再以加速度計回授增加阻尼並壓低共振峰，同時以載台反作用力與重心移動的前饋抵消可預測的擾動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The metrology frame and projection lens rest on three or four pneumatic or electromagnetic isolators forming a spring-mass system near 1 Hz, so floor vibration well above that resonance is attenuated; active isolation adds accelerometer feedback for damping and resonance suppression, plus feedforward to cancel predictable disturbances from stage reaction forces and centre-of-gravity shifts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主動隔振與地面振動」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active isolation and floor vibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。若地板在 10 Hz 的振動速度為 3 µm/s，位移振幅 = v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm，經隔振後計量框架只動 0.48 nm；但在 1.5 Hz 附近傳遞率反而放大到 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8，必須靠主動阻尼壓低。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010. If the floor vibrates at 3 µm/s at 10 Hz, the displacement amplitude is v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm, and the metrology frame moves only 0.48 nm after isolation; near 1.5 Hz, however, transmissibility rises to 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8 and must be suppressed by active damping. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。若地板在 10 Hz 的振動速度為 3 µm/s，位移振幅 = v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm，經隔振後計量框架只動 0.48 nm；但在 1.5 Hz 附近傳遞率反而放大到 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8，必須靠主動阻尼壓低。
knowledge.textEn: An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010. If the floor vibrates at 3 µm/s at 10 Hz, the displacement amplitude is v/(2πf) = 3×10⁻⁶/62.8 ≈ 48 nm, and the metrology frame moves only 0.48 nm after isolation; near 1.5 Hz, however, transmissibility rises to 1/(2.25 − 1) = 0.8 and must be suppressed by active damping.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration", which statement holds?
options: 只要載台導軌夠直，旋轉誤差就可以忽略。
干涉儀的解析度 0.04 nm 就是它的量測精度。
無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。
optionsEn: With straight enough guideways, rotation errors can be ignored.
An interferometer with 0.04 nm resolution measures with 0.04 nm accuracy.
An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010.
quiz.explanation: 無阻尼隔振器的傳遞率 T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1)：f_n = 1 Hz 時，10 Hz 的傳遞率約 1/99 ≈ 0.010。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An undamped isolator has transmissibility T ≈ 1/((f/f_n)² − 1): with f_n = 1 Hz the transmissibility at 10 Hz is about 1/99 ≈ 0.010. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「主動隔振與地面振動」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Active isolation and floor vibration” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：廠務新增的真空幫浦在 25 Hz 產生窄頻振動，雖然傳遞率只有 0.0016，但若剛好接近載台某個模態，MSD 會在該頻率出現尖峰，整批晶圓的 CD 均勻性下降而找不到機台內部原因。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A newly installed facility vacuum pump produces narrowband vibration at 25 Hz; although transmissibility is only 0.0016, if it lands near a stage mode the MSD spikes at that frequency and CD uniformity drops across whole lots with no internal cause to be found.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。
knowledge.textEn: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration"?
options: 在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
提高伺服增益就能消除掃描時的追蹤誤差。
optionsEn: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Raising the servo gain removes scan tracking error.
quiz.explanation: 在地板與計量框架同時裝加速度計，量測傳遞率頻譜並與模型比較；再執行完整的掃描與步進循環，記錄框架振動與載台 MSD 的相關性，確認載台反作用力前饋能把共振附近的放大壓到預算內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount accelerometers on both floor and metrology frame, measure the transmissibility spectrum and compare with the model; then run full scan-and-step cycles, record the correlation between frame vibration and stage MSD, and confirm that reaction-force feedforward keeps amplification near resonance within budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主動隔振與地面振動」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Active isolation and floor vibration” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 廠務新增的真空幫浦在 25 Hz 產生窄頻振動，雖然傳遞率只有 0.0016，但若剛好接近載台某個模態，MSD 會在該頻率出現尖峰，整批晶圓的 CD 均勻性下降而找不到機台內部原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A newly installed facility vacuum pump produces narrowband vibration at 25 Hz; although transmissibility is only 0.0016, if it lands near a stage mode the MSD spikes at that frequency and CD uniformity drops across whole lots with no internal cause to be found. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：晶圓廠地板的振動等級、幫浦與空調的窄頻擾動、以及載台本身的動量轉移，都必須納入整機振動預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fab floor vibration class, narrowband disturbances from pumps and air handling, and momentum transfer from the stages themselves all enter the whole-tool vibration budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔振器把所有頻率的振動都衰減。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Isolators attenuate vibration at every frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 廠務新增的真空幫浦在 25 Hz 產生窄頻振動，雖然傳遞率只有 0.0016，但若剛好接近載台某個模態，MSD 會在該頻率出現尖峰，整批晶圓的 CD 均勻性下降而找不到機台內部原因。
knowledge.textEn: A newly installed facility vacuum pump produces narrowband vibration at 25 Hz; although transmissibility is only 0.0016, if it lands near a stage mode the MSD spikes at that frequency and CD uniformity drops across whole lots with no internal cause to be found.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隔振傳遞率與振動整合設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Isolation transmissibility and vibration integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
廠務新增的真空幫浦在 25 Hz 產生窄頻振動，雖然傳遞率只有 0.0016，但若剛好接近載台某個模態，MSD 會在該頻率出現尖峰，整批晶圓的 CD 均勻性下降而找不到機台內部原因。
套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A newly installed facility vacuum pump produces narrowband vibration at 25 Hz.
A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely.
quiz.explanation: 廠務新增的真空幫浦在 25 Hz 產生窄頻振動，雖然傳遞率只有 0.0016，但若剛好接近載台某個模態，MSD 會在該頻率出現尖峰，整批晶圓的 CD 均勻性下降而找不到機台內部原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A newly installed facility vacuum pump produces narrowband vibration at 25 Hz; although transmissibility is only 0.0016, if it lands near a stage mode the MSD spikes at that frequency and CD uniformity drops across whole lots with no internal cause to be found. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」如何決定微影晶圓台精密定位的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。產能由每場的掃描時間、步進時間、整定時間與晶圓交換時間決定，雙台架構讓對準與高度量測在另一台上同時進行，把量測時間隱藏在曝光之後。驗收用同一片晶圓重複曝光量機台對自身套刻，用不同機台曝光量機台間套刻；交接文件包括校正圖版本、MA/MSD 基準曲線、熱穩定時間與所有感測器的校正日期。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The stage's engineering value is finally expressed in two numbers: wafers per hour and overlay. Throughput follows from scan time, step time, settling time and wafer exchange per field, and the dual-stage architecture lets alignment and height mapping run on the other stage so that measurement time hides behind exposure. Acceptance measures machine-to-itself overlay by re-exposing the same wafer and machine-to-machine overlay across tools; the handoff record includes calibration-map versions, MA/MSD baseline curves, thermal stabilisation time and the calibration dates of every sensor. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每場掃描 82 ms 加步進與整定 50 ms 共 132 ms，96 個場需 12.7 s；晶圓交換與未被隱藏的開銷取 8 s，每片 20.7 s，產能 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 片/小時。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each field takes 82 ms of scan plus 50 ms of step and settle, 132 ms in all, so 96 fields need 12.7 s; with 8 s of wafer exchange and unhidden overhead the wafer takes 20.7 s, giving 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 wafers per hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。產能由每場的掃描時間、步進時間、整定時間與晶圓交換時間決定，雙台架構讓對準與高度量測在另一台上同時進行，把量測時間隱藏在曝光之後。
knowledge.textEn: The stage's engineering value is finally expressed in two numbers: wafers per hour and overlay. Throughput follows from scan time, step time, settling time and wafer exchange per field, and the dual-stage architecture lets alignment and height mapping run on the other stage so that measurement time hides behind exposure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。
晶圓台的靜態定位精度就等於套刻精度。
載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。
optionsEn: A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely.
The static positioning accuracy of the stage equals the overlay accuracy.
The stage's engineering value is finally expressed in two numbers: wafers per hour and overlay.
quiz.explanation: 載台的工程價值最後以兩個數字體現：每小時晶圓數與套刻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The stage's engineering value is finally expressed in two numbers: wafers per hour and overlay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每場掃描 82 ms 加步進與整定 50 ms 共 132 ms，96 個場需 12.7 s；晶圓交換與未被隱藏的開銷取 8 s，每片 20.7 s，產能 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 片/小時。若整定時間因共振問題多出 20 ms，每片多 1.9 s，產能降到 159 片/小時，下降 8.6%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each field takes 82 ms of scan plus 50 ms of step and settle, 132 ms in all, so 96 fields need 12.7 s; with 8 s of wafer exchange and unhidden overhead the wafer takes 20.7 s, giving 3600/20.7 ≈ 174 wafers per hour. If a resonance problem adds 20 ms of settling per field, each wafer takes 1.9 s longer and throughput falls to 159 wafers per hour, a drop of 8.6%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源；對同一片晶圓做兩次曝光量測套刻，取 |mean| + 3σ 與規格比較；核對交接文件中的校正圖版本與感測器校正日期是否與機台實際狀態一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss; expose the same wafer twice, measure overlay as |mean| + 3σ and compare with specification; check that the calibration-map versions and sensor calibration dates in the handoff record match the tool's actual state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

If a resonance problem adds 20 ms of settling per field, each wafer takes 1.9 s longer and throughput falls to 159 wafers per hour, a drop of 8.6%.

steps.instruction: 用機台時間戳記錄每一場的掃描、步進、整定與交換時間，與模型逐項比較找出產能損失來源；對同一片晶圓做兩次曝光量測套刻，取 |mean| + 3σ 與規格比較；核對交接文件中的校正圖版本與感測器校正日期是否與機台實際狀態一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the scan, step, settle and exchange time of every field from machine timestamps and compare with the model item by item to locate throughput loss; expose the same wafer twice, measure overlay as |mean| + 3σ and compare with specification; check that the calibration-map versions and sensor calibration dates in the handoff record match the tool's actual state. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了衝產能縮短整定時間，MA 看似仍在規格內，但 MSD 在每場起始端悄悄升高，CD 均勻性與良率在數週後才在電性測試中暴露，追查時已無當時的載台誤差紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field; CD uniformity and yield only surface weeks later in electrical test, by which time the stage error logs of that period are gone.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 載台產能、整機驗收與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stage throughput, system acceptance and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「產能模型與套刻驗收記錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Throughput model and overlay acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了衝產能縮短整定時間，MA 看似仍在規格內，但 MSD 在每場起始端悄悄升高，CD 均勻性與良率在數週後才在電性測試中暴露，追查時已無當時的載台誤差紀錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting settling time to chase throughput leaves MA apparently within specification while MSD creeps up at the start of every field; CD uniformity and yield only surface weeks later in electrical test, by which time the stage error logs of that period are gone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收用同一片晶圓重複曝光量機台對自身套刻，用不同機台曝光量機台間套刻；交接文件包括校正圖版本、MA/MSD 基準曲線、熱穩定時間與所有感測器的校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance measures machine-to-itself overlay by re-exposing the same wafer and machine-to-machine overlay across tools; the handoff record includes calibration-map versions, MA/MSD baseline curves, thermal stabilisation time and the calibration dates of every sensor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「套刻合格的機台，產能設定可以任意提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tool that passes overlay can have its throughput settings raised freely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: 複消色差顯微物鏡
summary: 以 100×/1.4 油浸複消色差物鏡為對象：從 Abbe 解析度與軸向景深建立規格邊界，推導二級光譜如何由玻璃的部分色散差決定、為何需要螢石類異常色散材料，說明齊明半球前鏡組如何把 NA 1.4 的光線角逐級降低，再談鏡片偏心與增透膜、蓋玻片厚度球差與校正環，最後以多波長 PSF 量測與 Strehl 預算完成驗收。
summaryEn: Taking a 100×/1.4 oil-immersion apochromat as the object, the course sets the specification boundary from Abbe resolution and axial depth of field, derives how secondary spectrum is fixed by the partial-dispersion difference of the glasses and why fluorite-type anomalous-dispersion materials are needed, explains how the aplanatic hemispherical front group steps the NA 1.4 ray angles down, covers element decentration, antireflection coatings, cover-glass spherical aberration and the correction collar, and closes acceptance with multi-wavelength PSF measurement and a Strehl budget.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 二級光譜練習：100× 物鏡配 200 mm 筒鏡，f_obj = 2 mm；NA 1.4 油浸在 550 nm 的單側景深 n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm。若用 N-BK7（ν = 64.2，P_gF = 0.535）與 F2（ν = 36.4，P_gF = 0.583）做消色差，g 線焦點偏離 Δf = f·ΔP/Δν = 2 mm×(−0.048/27.8) ≈ −3.4 µm，是景深的 8 倍，藍色影像必然模糊。改用異常色散對（ΔP ≈ 0.004、Δν ≈ 50），Δf ≈ 2 mm×8×10⁻⁵ = 0.16 µm，落在景深內。再算整機 Strehl：物鏡 25 nm、筒鏡 15 nm、對準 15 nm、蓋玻片殘差 20 nm，RSS ≈ 38 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] ≈ 0.83。若橫向色差為 0.1%，視場邊緣 125 µm 處紅藍錯位 125 nm，超過 196 nm 解析極限的一半，所以橫向色差規格也要訂在 0.05% 以下。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Secondary-spectrum exercise: a 100× objective with a 200 mm tube lens has f_obj = 2 mm; NA 1.4 oil immersion at 550 nm gives a one-sided depth of field n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm. An achromat built from N-BK7 (ν = 64.2, P_gF = 0.535) and F2 (ν = 36.4, P_gF = 0.583) places the g-line focus at Δf = f·ΔP/Δν = 2 mm×(−0.048/27.8) ≈ −3.4 µm, 8 times the depth of field, so the blue image must blur. An anomalous-dispersion pair (ΔP ≈ 0.004, Δν ≈ 50) gives Δf ≈ 2 mm×8×10⁻⁵ = 0.16 µm, inside the depth of field. Now the system Strehl: objective 25 nm, tube lens 15 nm, alignment 15 nm and cover-glass residual 20 nm give RSS ≈ 38 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] ≈ 0.83. With 0.1% lateral colour, red and blue are displaced by 125 nm at the 125 µm field edge, more than half the 196 nm resolution limit, so the lateral-colour specification must also be set below 0.05%. All numbers are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界」與「二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries" and "Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 顯微物鏡能分辨的最小週期由 Abbe 條件決定：d = λ/(2NA)，NA = n·sinα 是物方介質折射率與半孔徑角正弦的乘積，油浸以 n = 1.515 把 NA 推到 1.4。軸向解析度隨 NA 的平方改善，但景深也跟著縮到 1 µm 以下，於是任何波長之間的焦點差都必須小於景深，否則不同顏色的影像無法同時清晰；這正是複消色差物鏡存在的理由，色差規格要用景深為尺度來訂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The finest period a microscope objective can resolve follows the Abbe condition d = λ/(2NA), where NA = n·sinα is the product of the object-space index and the sine of the half-aperture angle, and oil immersion with n = 1.515 pushes NA to 1.4. Axial resolution improves with the square of NA, but depth of field shrinks below 1 µm with it, so any focus difference between wavelengths must be smaller than that depth or the colours cannot be sharp simultaneously; this is exactly why apochromats exist, and chromatic specifications must be written in units of depth of field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100×/1.4 油浸物鏡在 λ = 550 nm：Abbe 極限 d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm，Rayleigh 判據 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm；軸向單側景深 n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm，全寬約 0.85 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 100×/1.4 oil objective at λ = 550 nm the Abbe limit is d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm and the Rayleigh criterion 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm; the one-sided axial depth n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm, about 0.85 µm full width.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「放大倍率越高，解析度就一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher magnification always means better resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries" is correct?
options: 放大倍率越高，解析度就一定越好。

steps.title: Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100×/1.4 油浸物鏡在 λ = 550 nm：Abbe 極限 d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm，Rayleigh 判據 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm；軸向單側景深 n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm，全寬約 0.85 µm。乾式 40×/0.95 的橫向極限為 290 nm，軸向景深 0.61 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 100×/1.4 oil objective at λ = 550 nm the Abbe limit is d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm and the Rayleigh criterion 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm; the one-sided axial depth n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm, about 0.85 µm full width. A dry 40×/0.95 objective has a lateral limit of 290 nm and an axial depth of 0.61 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 100 nm 螢光珠或 Siemens 星形靶量測橫向 PSF 半高寬與最小可分辨週期，與 λ/(2NA) 比較；再沿 z 軸以 50 nm 步進掃描同一顆珠，量軸向強度分佈的半高寬，核對是否接近 n·λ/NA² 的預測，偏大表示實際 NA 不足或存在球差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the lateral PSF full width at half maximum and the smallest resolvable period with 100 nm fluorescent beads or a Siemens star target and compare with λ/(2NA); then scan the same bead along z in 50 nm steps, measure the axial intensity full width at half maximum and check it against the n·λ/NA² prediction, since a larger value indicates reduced effective NA or spherical aberration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 100×/1.4 油浸物鏡在 λ = 550 nm：Abbe 極限 d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm，Rayleigh 判據 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm；軸向單側景深 n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm，全寬約 0.85 µm。乾式 40×/0.95 的橫向極限為 290 nm，軸向景深 0.61 µm。
knowledge.textEn: For a 100×/1.4 oil objective at λ = 550 nm the Abbe limit is d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm and the Rayleigh criterion 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm; the one-sided axial depth n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm, about 0.85 µm full width. A dry 40×/0.95 objective has a lateral limit of 290 nm and an axial depth of 0.61 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 鏡片多幾片沒關係，鍍膜損失可以忽略。
油浸物鏡對任何試樣深度都沒有球差。
100×/1.4 油浸物鏡在 λ = 550 nm：Abbe 極限 d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm，Rayleigh 判據 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm。
optionsEn: A few extra elements do not matter because coating losses are negligible.
Oil-immersion objectives are free of spherical aberration at any specimen depth.
For a 100×/1.4 oil objective at λ = 550 nm the Abbe limit is d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm and the Rayleigh criterion 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm.
quiz.explanation: 100×/1.4 油浸物鏡在 λ = 550 nm：Abbe 極限 d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm，Rayleigh 判據 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm；軸向單側景深 n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm，全寬約 0.85 µm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 100×/1.4 oil objective at λ = 550 nm the Abbe limit is d = 550/(2×1.4) ≈ 196 nm and the Rayleigh criterion 0.61λ/NA ≈ 240 nm; the one-sided axial depth n·λ/NA² = 1.515×0.55/1.96 ≈ 0.43 µm, about 0.85 µm full width. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 100 nm 螢光珠或 Siemens 星形靶量測橫向 PSF 半高寬與最小可分辨週期，與 λ/(2NA) 比較；再沿 z 軸以 50 nm 步進掃描同一顆珠，量軸向強度分佈的半高寬，核對是否接近 n·λ/NA² 的預測，偏大表示實際 NA 不足或存在球差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the lateral PSF full width at half maximum and the smallest resolvable period with 100 nm fluorescent beads or a Siemens star target and compare with λ/(2NA); then scan the same bead along z in 50 nm steps, measure the axial intensity full width at half maximum and check it against the n·λ/NA² prediction, since a larger value indicates reduced effective NA or spherical aberration. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若浸油折射率與設計值不符或油膜中有氣泡，有效 NA 下降，橫向解析度從 196 nm 退化到 250 nm 以上，而物鏡本身並無缺陷，使用者卻以為物鏡不良。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the immersion oil index deviates from design or the oil film contains bubbles, the effective NA drops, lateral resolution degrades from 196 nm to above 250 nm, and the user blames an objective that is actually faultless.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 100 nm 螢光珠或 Siemens 星形靶量測橫向 PSF 半高寬與最小可分辨週期，與 λ/(2NA) 比較；再沿 z 軸以 50 nm 步進掃描同一顆珠，量軸向強度分佈的半高寬，核對是否接近 n·λ/NA² 的預測，偏大表示實際 NA 不足或存在球差。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the lateral PSF full width at half maximum and the smallest resolvable period with 100 nm fluorescent beads or a Siemens star target and compare with λ/(2NA); then scan the same bead along z in 50 nm steps, measure the axial intensity full width at half maximum and check it against the n·λ/NA² prediction, since a larger value indicates reduced effective NA or spherical aberration.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries"?
options: 以 100 nm 螢光珠或 Siemens 星形靶量測橫向 PSF 半高寬與最小可分辨週期，與 λ/(2NA) 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
物鏡上標的倍率在任何顯微鏡上都成立。
optionsEn: Measure the lateral PSF full width at half maximum and the smallest resolvable period with 100 nm fluorescent beads or a Siemens star target and compare with λ/(2NA).
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The magnification engraved on an objective holds on any microscope.
quiz.explanation: 以 100 nm 螢光珠或 Siemens 星形靶量測橫向 PSF 半高寬與最小可分辨週期，與 λ/(2NA) 比較；再沿 z 軸以 50 nm 步進掃描同一顆珠，量軸向強度分佈的半高寬，核對是否接近 n·λ/NA² 的預測，偏大表示實際 NA 不足或存在球差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the lateral PSF full width at half maximum and the smallest resolvable period with 100 nm fluorescent beads or a Siemens star target and compare with λ/(2NA); then scan the same bead along z in 50 nm steps, measure the axial intensity full width at half maximum and check it against the n·λ/NA² prediction, since a larger value indicates reduced effective NA or spherical aberration. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「物鏡出瞳與數值孔徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Objective exit pupil and numerical aperture” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若浸油折射率與設計值不符或油膜中有氣泡，有效 NA 下降，橫向解析度從 196 nm 退化到 250 nm 以上，而物鏡本身並無缺陷，使用者卻以為物鏡不良。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the immersion oil index deviates from design or the oil film contains bubbles, the effective NA drops, lateral resolution degrades from 196 nm to above 250 nm, and the user blames an objective that is actually faultless. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：軸向解析度隨 NA 的平方改善，但景深也跟著縮到 1 µm 以下，於是任何波長之間的焦點差都必須小於景深，否則不同顏色的影像無法同時清晰；這正是複消色差物鏡存在的理由，色差規格要用景深為尺度來訂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Axial resolution improves with the square of NA, but depth of field shrinks below 1 µm with it, so any focus difference between wavelengths must be smaller than that depth or the colours cannot be sharp simultaneously; this is exactly why apochromats exist, and chromatic specifications must be written in units of depth of field.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「放大倍率越高，解析度就一定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher magnification always means better resolution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若浸油折射率與設計值不符或油膜中有氣泡，有效 NA 下降，橫向解析度從 196 nm 退化到 250 nm 以上，而物鏡本身並無缺陷，使用者卻以為物鏡不良。
knowledge.textEn: If the immersion oil index deviates from design or the oil film contains bubbles, the effective NA drops, lateral resolution degrades from 196 nm to above 250 nm, and the user blames an objective that is actually faultless.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Abbe 解析度與軸向景深的規格邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abbe resolution and axial depth as specification boundaries" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若浸油折射率與設計值不符或油膜中有氣泡，有效 NA 下降，橫向解析度從 196 nm 退化到 250 nm 以上，而物鏡本身並無缺陷，使用者卻以為物鏡不良。
只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

If the immersion oil index deviates from design or the oil film contains bubbles, the effective NA drops, lateral resolution degrades from 196 nm to above 250 nm, and the user blames an objective that is actually faultless.
With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum.
quiz.explanation: 若浸油折射率與設計值不符或油膜中有氣泡，有效 NA 下降，橫向解析度從 196 nm 退化到 250 nm 以上，而物鏡本身並無缺陷，使用者卻以為物鏡不良。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the immersion oil index deviates from design or the oil film contains bubbles, the effective NA drops, lateral resolution degrades from 196 nm to above 250 nm, and the user blames an objective that is actually faultless. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「部分色散圖與二級光譜」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Partial-dispersion diagram and secondary spectrum” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 消色差雙合鏡只能讓兩個波長（F 與 C 線）共焦，其餘波長的焦點偏離稱為二級光譜，大小由兩種玻璃的部分色散差 ΔP 與 Abbe 數差 Δν 的比值決定。普通玻璃的部分色散幾乎落在一條直線上，所以 ΔP/Δν 幾乎是常數，無法用普通玻璃消除；只有螢石、氟磷酸鹽冕玻璃或特殊短火石這類偏離正常線的材料，才能讓三個波長共焦並同時校正球差，這就是複消色差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「部分色散圖與二級光譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An achromatic doublet brings only two wavelengths (the F and C lines) to a common focus; the residual focus error of other wavelengths is the secondary spectrum, whose size is set by the ratio of the partial-dispersion difference ΔP to the Abbe-number difference Δν of the two glasses. Ordinary glasses have partial dispersions lying almost on a straight line, so ΔP/Δν is nearly constant and cannot be cancelled with ordinary glasses; only materials off the normal line such as fluorite, fluorophosphate crowns or special short flints allow three wavelengths to share a focus while spherical aberration is also corrected, which is the apochromatic condition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Partial-dispersion diagram and secondary spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：二級光譜 Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Secondary spectrum Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「部分色散圖與二級光譜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Partial-dispersion diagram and secondary spectrum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件
knowledge.titleEn: Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition
knowledge.text: 消色差雙合鏡只能讓兩個波長（F 與 C 線）共焦，其餘波長的焦點偏離稱為二級光譜，大小由兩種玻璃的部分色散差 ΔP 與 Abbe 數差 Δν 的比值決定。普通玻璃的部分色散幾乎落在一條直線上，所以 ΔP/Δν 幾乎是常數，無法用普通玻璃消除；只有螢石、氟磷酸鹽冕玻璃或特殊短火石這類偏離正常線的材料，才能讓三個波長共焦並同時校正球差，這就是複消色差。
knowledge.textEn: An achromatic doublet brings only two wavelengths (the F and C lines) to a common focus; the residual focus error of other wavelengths is the secondary spectrum, whose size is set by the ratio of the partial-dispersion difference ΔP to the Abbe-number difference Δν of the two glasses. Ordinary glasses have partial dispersions lying almost on a straight line, so ΔP/Δν is nearly constant and cannot be cancelled with ordinary glasses; only materials off the normal line such as fluorite, fluorophosphate crowns or special short flints allow three wavelengths to share a focus while spherical aberration is also corrected, which is the apochromatic condition.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition" is correct?
options: 只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。
螢石鏡片只是為了讓透過率更高。
消色差雙合鏡只能讓兩個波長（F 與 C 線）共焦，其餘波長的焦點偏離稱為二級光譜，大小由兩種玻璃的部分色散差 ΔP 與 Abbe 數差 Δν 的比值決定。
optionsEn: With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum.
Fluorite elements are used only to raise transmission.
An achromatic doublet brings only two wavelengths (the F and C lines) to a common focus.
quiz.explanation: 消色差雙合鏡只能讓兩個波長（F 與 C 線）共焦，其餘波長的焦點偏離稱為二級光譜，大小由兩種玻璃的部分色散差 ΔP 與 Abbe 數差 Δν 的比值決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An achromatic doublet brings only two wavelengths (the F and C lines) to a common focus; the residual focus error of other wavelengths is the secondary spectrum, whose size is set by the ratio of the partial-dispersion difference ΔP to the Abbe-number difference Δν of the two glasses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「部分色散圖與二級光譜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Partial-dispersion diagram and secondary spectrum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：二級光譜 Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂)。N-BK7（ν = 64.2，P_gF = 0.535）與 F2（ν = 36.4，P_gF = 0.583）：ΔP/Δν = −0.048/27.8 ≈ −1.7×10⁻³，即 f/580；物鏡焦距 f = 2 mm 時 g 線焦點偏離 3.4 µm，是 0.43 µm 景深的 8 倍。改用匹配的異常色散對（ΔP ≈ 0.004、Δν ≈ 50）得 8×10⁻⁵，即 f/12500，殘差 0.16 µm，小於景深。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Secondary spectrum Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂). For N-BK7 (ν = 64.2, P_gF = 0.535) with F2 (ν = 36.4, P_gF = 0.583), ΔP/Δν = −0.048/27.8 ≈ −1.7×10⁻³, i.e. f/580; for an objective focal length f = 2 mm the g-line focus is off by 3.4 µm, 8 times the 0.43 µm depth of field. A matched anomalous-dispersion pair (ΔP ≈ 0.004, Δν ≈ 50) gives 8×10⁻⁵, i.e. f/12500, a residual of 0.16 µm, below the depth of field. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用 405、488、561 與 640 nm 的雷射線或窄帶濾光片依序對同一顆次解析螢光珠找最佳焦面，記錄各波長的 z 位置差；把焦點差畫成波長的函數，與設計軟體輸出的軸向色差曲線比較，並確認最大偏差落在景深之內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Find the best focus of the same sub-resolution fluorescent bead at 405, 488, 561 and 640 nm using laser lines or narrowband filters and record the z position for each wavelength; plot the focus difference against wavelength, compare with the axial chromatic curve from the design software and confirm the largest deviation lies within the depth of field.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 二級光譜 Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂)。N-BK7（ν = 64.2，P_gF = 0.535）與 F2（ν = 36.4，P_gF = 0.583）：ΔP/Δν = −0.048/27.8 ≈ −1.7×10⁻³，即 f/580；物鏡焦距 f = 2 mm 時 g 線焦點偏離 3.4 µm，是 0.43 µm 景深的 8 倍。改用匹配的異常色散對（ΔP ≈ 0.004、Δν ≈ 50）得 8×10⁻⁵，即 f/12500，殘差 0.16 µm，小於景深。
knowledge.textEn: Secondary spectrum Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂). For N-BK7 (ν = 64.2, P_gF = 0.535) with F2 (ν = 36.4, P_gF = 0.583), ΔP/Δν = −0.048/27.8 ≈ −1.7×10⁻³, i.e. f/580; for an objective focal length f = 2 mm the g-line focus is off by 3.4 µm, 8 times the 0.43 µm depth of field. A matched anomalous-dispersion pair (ΔP ≈ 0.004, Δν ≈ 50) gives 8×10⁻⁵, i.e. f/12500, a residual of 0.16 µm, below the depth of field.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition", which statement holds?

量一個波長的 PSF 就足以驗證複消色差物鏡。
物鏡上標的倍率在任何顯微鏡上都成立。
optionsEn: Secondary spectrum Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂).
A single-wavelength PSF measurement suffices to qualify an apochromat.
The magnification engraved on an objective holds on any microscope.

quiz.explanationEn: Secondary spectrum Δf_g ≈ f·(P₁ − P₂)/(ν₁ − ν₂). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「部分色散圖與二級光譜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Partial-dispersion diagram and secondary spectrum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用 405、488、561 與 640 nm 的雷射線或窄帶濾光片依序對同一顆次解析螢光珠找最佳焦面，記錄各波長的 z 位置差；把焦點差畫成波長的函數，與設計軟體輸出的軸向色差曲線比較，並確認最大偏差落在景深之內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Find the best focus of the same sub-resolution fluorescent bead at 405, 488, 561 and 640 nm using laser lines or narrowband filters and record the z position for each wavelength; plot the focus difference against wavelength, compare with the axial chromatic curve from the design software and confirm the largest deviation lies within the depth of field. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若量產時把一片氟磷酸鹽冕玻璃替換成部分色散不同的替代牌號，三個波長的共焦條件被破壞，紅與藍通道的影像平面相差超過 1 µm，多色共定位實驗出現假性的空間分離。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If production substitutes a fluorophosphate crown with an alternative grade of different partial dispersion, the three-wavelength common focus is lost, red and blue image planes separate by more than 1 µm, and multicolour colocalisation experiments show false spatial separation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 用 405、488、561 與 640 nm 的雷射線或窄帶濾光片依序對同一顆次解析螢光珠找最佳焦面，記錄各波長的 z 位置差；把焦點差畫成波長的函數，與設計軟體輸出的軸向色差曲線比較，並確認最大偏差落在景深之內。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 二級光譜、部分色散與複消色差條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Secondary spectrum, partial dispersion and the apochromatic condition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「部分色散圖與二級光譜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Partial-dispersion diagram and secondary spectrum” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若量產時把一片氟磷酸鹽冕玻璃替換成部分色散不同的替代牌號，三個波長的共焦條件被破壞，紅與藍通道的影像平面相差超過 1 µm，多色共定位實驗出現假性的空間分離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If production substitutes a fluorophosphate crown with an alternative grade of different partial dispersion, the three-wavelength common focus is lost, red and blue image planes separate by more than 1 µm, and multicolour colocalisation experiments show false spatial separation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：普通玻璃的部分色散幾乎落在一條直線上，所以 ΔP/Δν 幾乎是常數，無法用普通玻璃消除；只有螢石、氟磷酸鹽冕玻璃或特殊短火石這類偏離正常線的材料，才能讓三個波長共焦並同時校正球差，這就是複消色差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ordinary glasses have partial dispersions lying almost on a straight line, so ΔP/Δν is nearly constant and cannot be cancelled with ordinary glasses; only materials off the normal line such as fluorite, fluorophosphate crowns or special short flints allow three wavelengths to share a focus while spherical aberration is also corrected, which is the apochromatic condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「齊明面、螢石材料與光線角的逐級降低」與「鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Aplanatic surfaces, fluorite materials and stepwise angle reduction" and "Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 齊明面、螢石材料與光線角的逐級降低：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Aplanatic surfaces, fluorite materials and stepwise angle reduction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「齊明半球前鏡組」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aplanatic hemispherical front group” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高 NA 物鏡的前端是一片半球或超半球透鏡，試樣與浸油的折射率相近，試樣位於球面的齊明點（距球心 R/n）時，球面既不產生球差也不產生彗差，但把光線的正弦角度除以 n，再接一片齊明彎月鏡可以再除一次。這樣把 NA 1.4 的陡峭光束降成後方鏡組容易處理的角度，之後的螢石與異常色散玻璃雙合、三合鏡才負責色差與剩餘球差的校正。螢石（CaF₂）的 Abbe 數約 95，但質地軟且易受熱衝擊，加工與鍍膜都需特別處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「齊明半球前鏡組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The front of a high-NA objective is a hemispherical or hyper-hemispherical lens; with specimen and immersion oil of nearly equal index, a specimen at the aplanatic point of the sphere (R/n from the centre) sees neither spherical aberration nor coma, while the sine of the ray angle is divided by n, and a following aplanatic meniscus divides it once more. This reduces the steep NA 1.4 beam to angles the rear groups can handle, after which fluorite and anomalous-dispersion doublets and triplets correct colour and residual spherical aberration. Fluorite (CaF₂) has an Abbe number near 95 but is soft and sensitive to thermal shock, so it needs special handling in polishing and coating. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aplanatic hemispherical front group”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The marginal ray in oil has sinu = 1.4/1.515 = 0.924 (u ≈ 67.5°); after the first aplanatic surface sinu' = 0.924/1.515 = 0.610 (37.6°), and after the second aplanatic meniscus 0.610/1.515 = 0.403 (23.7°), so the rear groups handle only an NA 0.4 beam.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螢石鏡片只是為了讓透過率更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fluorite elements are used only to raise transmission." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「齊明半球前鏡組」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Aplanatic hemispherical front group”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

This reduces the steep NA 1.4 beam to angles the rear groups can handle, after which fluorite and anomalous-dispersion doublets and triplets correct colour and residual spherical aberration.

steps.title: 齊明面、螢石材料與光線角的逐級降低：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aplanatic surfaces, fluorite materials and stepwise angle reduction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「齊明半球前鏡組」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aplanatic hemispherical front group” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：油中邊緣光 sinu = 1.4/1.515 = 0.924（u ≈ 67.5°）；經第一齊明面後 sinu' = 0.924/1.515 = 0.610（37.6°），第二齊明彎月鏡後 0.610/1.515 = 0.403（23.7°），相當於後鏡組只需處理 NA 0.4 的光束。每個齊明面的橫向放大率為 n² ≈ 2.3，兩面合計約 5.3 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The marginal ray in oil has sinu = 1.4/1.515 = 0.924 (u ≈ 67.5°); after the first aplanatic surface sinu' = 0.924/1.515 = 0.610 (37.6°), and after the second aplanatic meniscus 0.610/1.515 = 0.403 (23.7°), so the rear groups handle only an NA 0.4 beam. steps.observation: 如何核對：用設計軟體追跡邊緣光線，核對每個齊明面前後的 sinu 比值是否等於折射率，並確認前鏡組單獨的球差與彗差係數接近零；實物上以干涉儀對前鏡組做局部波前測試，比較量測的球差項與設計殘差，差異反映曲率半徑或中心厚度的加工偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace the marginal ray in design software and check that the ratio of sinu before and after each aplanatic surface equals the refractive index, confirming that the front group alone has near-zero spherical and coma coefficients; on hardware, test the front group's wavefront interferometrically and compare the measured spherical term with the design residual, since any difference reflects fabrication errors in radius or centre thickness.

steps.title: 齊明面、螢石材料與光線角的逐級降低：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「齊明半球前鏡組」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。

steps.instruction: 用設計軟體追跡邊緣光線，核對每個齊明面前後的 sinu 比值是否等於折射率，並確認前鏡組單獨的球差與彗差係數接近零；實物上以干涉儀對前鏡組做局部波前測試，比較量測的球差項與設計殘差，差異反映曲率半徑或中心厚度的加工偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace the marginal ray in design software and check that the ratio of sinu before and after each aplanatic surface equals the refractive index, confirming that the front group alone has near-zero spherical and coma coefficients; on hardware, test the front group's wavefront interferometrically and compare the measured spherical term with the design residual, since any difference reflects fabrication errors in radius or centre thickness. steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the hemispherical front lens is 20 µm thicker than design, the aplanatic point shifts, spherical aberration and coma appear together, the correction collar cannot fully compensate, and the whole objective's Strehl falls below 0.8 even at best focus.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 齊明面、螢石材料與光線角的逐級降低：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aplanatic surfaces, fluorite materials and stepwise angle reduction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「齊明半球前鏡組」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Aplanatic hemispherical front group” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 半球前鏡的中心厚度若比設計厚 20 µm，齊明點位置偏移，球差與彗差同時出現，無法靠校正環完全補償，整支物鏡的 Strehl 在最佳焦面也降到 0.8 以下。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the hemispherical front lens is 20 µm thicker than design, the aplanatic point shifts, spherical aberration and coma appear together, the correction collar cannot fully compensate, and the whole objective's Strehl falls below 0.8 even at best focus. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：螢石（CaF₂）的 Abbe 數約 95，但質地軟且易受熱衝擊，加工與鍍膜都需特別處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fluorite (CaF₂) has an Abbe number near 95 but is soft and sensitive to thermal shock, so it needs special handling in polishing and coating.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螢石鏡片只是為了讓透過率更高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鏡片偏心公差與增透膜」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Element centring tolerance and antireflection coatings” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一支複消色差物鏡通常有 10 到 15 片鏡片，其中多組膠合；每片的曲率、厚度與折射率誤差都會改變色差與球差的平衡，所以組裝時以空氣間隙或選配鏡片作為補償項。鏡片對心是最敏感的公差：偏心產生與視場無關的彗差，用對心儀以反射像判定光軸後再修邊與膠合。每個玻璃空氣界面都要鍍寬頻增透膜，否則 30 個界面的反射損失會讓透過率與對比同時崩潰。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片偏心公差與增透膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An apochromat typically has 10 to 15 elements, several cemented; errors in radius, thickness and refractive index of every element shift the balance of chromatic and spherical correction, so an air gap or selected elements serve as compensators during assembly. Centring is the most sensitive tolerance: decentration produces field-independent coma, so each element's optical axis is located with a centring instrument from reflected images before edging and cementing. Every glass-air interface needs a broadband antireflection coating, otherwise the reflection losses of 30 interfaces collapse both transmission and contrast. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Element centring tolerance and antireflection coatings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某片鏡片的彗差靈敏度為 0.05 波/µm 偏心，2 µm 偏心產生 0.1 波（550 nm 下 55 nm）的彗差，超過 Maréchal 判據 λ/14 ≈ 39 nm，因此偏心必須控制在約 1 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If an element's coma sensitivity is 0.05 waves per µm of decentration, 2 µm produces 0.1 waves (55 nm at 550 nm) of coma, beyond the Maréchal criterion λ/14 ≈ 39 nm, so decentration must be held to about 1 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡片多幾片沒關係，鍍膜損失可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A few extra elements do not matter because coating losses are negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鏡片偏心公差與增透膜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Element centring tolerance and antireflection coatings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜
knowledge.titleEn: Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings
knowledge.text: 一支複消色差物鏡通常有 10 到 15 片鏡片，其中多組膠合；每片的曲率、厚度與折射率誤差都會改變色差與球差的平衡，所以組裝時以空氣間隙或選配鏡片作為補償項。鏡片對心是最敏感的公差：偏心產生與視場無關的彗差，用對心儀以反射像判定光軸後再修邊與膠合。
knowledge.textEn: An apochromat typically has 10 to 15 elements, several cemented; errors in radius, thickness and refractive index of every element shift the balance of chromatic and spherical correction, so an air gap or selected elements serve as compensators during assembly. Centring is the most sensitive tolerance: decentration produces field-independent coma, so each element's optical axis is located with a centring instrument from reflected images before edging and cementing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡片多幾片沒關係，鍍膜損失可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A few extra elements do not matter because coating losses are negligible. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

一支複消色差物鏡通常有 10 到 15 片鏡片，其中多組膠合；每片的曲率、厚度與折射率誤差都會改變色差與球差的平衡，所以組裝時以空氣間隙或選配鏡片作為補償項。
