steps.title: 鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡片偏心公差與增透膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Element centring tolerance and antireflection coatings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某片鏡片的彗差靈敏度為 0.05 波/µm 偏心，2 µm 偏心產生 0.1 波（550 nm 下 55 nm）的彗差，超過 Maréchal 判據 λ/14 ≈ 39 nm，因此偏心必須控制在約 1 µm。透過率：30 個界面各反射 0.3% 時 T = 0.997³⁰ ≈ 0.91；若未鍍膜各反射 4%，T = 0.96³⁰ ≈ 0.29。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If an element's coma sensitivity is 0.05 waves per µm of decentration, 2 µm produces 0.1 waves (55 nm at 550 nm) of coma, beyond the Maréchal criterion λ/14 ≈ 39 nm, so decentration must be held to about 1 µm. Transmission: 30 interfaces at 0.3% reflection each give T = 0.997³⁰ ≈ 0.91; uncoated at 4% each, T = 0.96³⁰ ≈ 0.29. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：組裝後以星點測試或干涉儀量軸上波前，彗差項若大於預算就依靈敏度表反推是哪一組偏心並重新對心；用分光光度計量整支物鏡 400 到 700 nm 的透過率曲線，與各界面鍍膜反射率的乘積模型比較，差異大於 3% 表示某層膜或膠合層有問題。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After assembly measure the on-axis wavefront with a star test or interferometer; if the coma term exceeds budget, use the sensitivity table to identify which group is decentred and re-centre it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Transmission: 30 interfaces at 0.3% reflection each give T = 0.997³⁰ ≈ 0.91; uncoated at 4% each, T = 0.96³⁰ ≈ 0.29.

steps.title: 鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鏡片偏心公差與增透膜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Element centring tolerance and antireflection coatings” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 組裝後以星點測試或干涉儀量軸上波前，彗差項若大於預算就依靈敏度表反推是哪一組偏心並重新對心；用分光光度計量整支物鏡 400 到 700 nm 的透過率曲線，與各界面鍍膜反射率的乘積模型比較，差異大於 3% 表示某層膜或膠合層有問題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After assembly measure the on-axis wavefront with a star test or interferometer; if the coma term exceeds budget, use the sensitivity table to identify which group is decentred and re-centre it. Measure the full objective's transmission from 400 to 700 nm with a spectrophotometer and compare with the product model of the interface reflectances, where a discrepancy above 3% points to a faulty coating or cement layer. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：膠合層固化時收縮不均會把一組鏡片拉偏數微米，物鏡在出廠測試合格，但經過幾個月的熱循環後彗差逐漸浮現，影像在整個視場出現同方向的彗星尾。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Uneven shrinkage of a cement layer during curing can pull a cemented group several micrometres off centre; the objective passes the factory test, but after months of thermal cycling coma gradually emerges and every point in the field shows a comet tail in the same direction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 組裝後以星點測試或干涉儀量軸上波前，彗差項若大於預算就依靈敏度表反推是哪一組偏心並重新對心；用分光光度計量整支物鏡 400 到 700 nm 的透過率曲線，與各界面鍍膜反射率的乘積模型比較，差異大於 3% 表示某層膜或膠合層有問題。

Measure the full objective's transmission from 400 to 700 nm with a spectrophotometer and compare with the product model of the interface reflectances, where a discrepancy above 3% points to a faulty coating or cement layer.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings"?
options: 組裝後以星點測試或干涉儀量軸上波前，彗差項若大於預算就依靈敏度表反推是哪一組偏心並重新對心。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。
optionsEn: After assembly measure the on-axis wavefront with a star test or interferometer.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum.

quiz.explanationEn: After assembly measure the on-axis wavefront with a star test or interferometer; if the coma term exceeds budget, use the sensitivity table to identify which group is decentred and re-centre it. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡片偏心公差與增透膜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Element centring tolerance and antireflection coatings” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 膠合層固化時收縮不均會把一組鏡片拉偏數微米，物鏡在出廠測試合格，但經過幾個月的熱循環後彗差逐漸浮現，影像在整個視場出現同方向的彗星尾。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven shrinkage of a cement layer during curing can pull a cemented group several micrometres off centre; the objective passes the factory test, but after months of thermal cycling coma gradually emerges and every point in the field shows a comet tail in the same direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每個玻璃空氣界面都要鍍寬頻增透膜，否則 30 個界面的反射損失會讓透過率與對比同時崩潰。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every glass-air interface needs a broadband antireflection coating, otherwise the reflection losses of 30 interfaces collapse both transmission and contrast.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡片多幾片沒關係，鍍膜損失可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A few extra elements do not matter because coating losses are negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 膠合層固化時收縮不均會把一組鏡片拉偏數微米，物鏡在出廠測試合格，但經過幾個月的熱循環後彗差逐漸浮現，影像在整個視場出現同方向的彗星尾。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鏡片製造、對心組裝與寬頻增透膜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Element fabrication, centred assembly and broadband antireflection coatings" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測」與「蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring PSF, Strehl and axial colour" and "Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring PSF, Strehl and axial colour: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「多波長 PSF 量測台」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multi-wavelength PSF measurement bench” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 物鏡的最終品質以點擴散函數（PSF）衡量：用直徑遠小於解析度的螢光珠或針孔作為點光源，記錄三維影像堆疊，從中取橫向半高寬、軸向半高寬、對稱性與 Strehl 比。多波長量測則揭露軸向色差與橫向色差；干涉儀測試能給出 Zernike 係數，但需要與物鏡匹配的參考球面與浸液。量測時蓋玻片厚度、浸油折射率與溫度都必須和設計條件一致，否則量到的是測試條件的像差而非物鏡的像差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多波長 PSF 量測台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An objective's final quality is judged by its point-spread function (PSF): a fluorescent bead or pinhole far smaller than the resolution serves as a point source, a three-dimensional image stack is recorded, and lateral and axial full widths at half maximum, symmetry and Strehl ratio are extracted. Multi-wavelength measurement exposes axial and lateral colour; interferometric testing gives Zernike coefficients but needs a matched reference sphere and immersion. Cover-glass thickness, oil index and temperature during the test must match the design conditions, otherwise the measured aberration belongs to the test setup rather than to the objective. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-wavelength PSF measurement bench”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：NA 1.4 在 520 nm 的理想橫向 PSF 半高寬 ≈ 0.51λ/NA = 0.51×520/1.4 ≈ 189 nm；若量到 215 nm，相當於有效 NA 降到 1.23 或存在像差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The ideal lateral PSF full width at half maximum at NA 1.4 and 520 nm is ≈ 0.51λ/NA = 0.51×520/1.4 ≈ 189 nm; a measured 215 nm corresponds to an effective NA of 1.23 or to aberration.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量一個波長的 PSF 就足以驗證複消色差物鏡。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single-wavelength PSF measurement suffices to qualify an apochromat." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「多波長 PSF 量測台」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Multi-wavelength PSF measurement bench”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多波長 PSF 量測台」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multi-wavelength PSF measurement bench” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：NA 1.4 在 520 nm 的理想橫向 PSF 半高寬 ≈ 0.51λ/NA = 0.51×520/1.4 ≈ 189 nm；若量到 215 nm，相當於有效 NA 降到 1.23 或存在像差。Strehl 由 RMS 波前估計：σ = 30 nm 時 Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×30/550)²] = exp(−0.117) ≈ 0.89；σ = 45 nm 時約 0.77，已低於 0.8。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The ideal lateral PSF full width at half maximum at NA 1.4 and 520 nm is ≈ 0.51λ/NA = 0.51×520/1.4 ≈ 189 nm; a measured 215 nm corresponds to an effective NA of 1.23 or to aberration. Strehl is estimated from RMS wavefront: for σ = 30 nm, Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×30/550)²] = exp(−0.117) ≈ 0.89; for σ = 45 nm about 0.77, already below 0.8. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一批 100 nm 珠在至少三個波長各取 10 顆珠的 PSF，計算半高寬平均與標準差，排除珠子大小的貢獻（以 √(FWHM² − d²) 近似去卷積）；把量測的 PSF 與由設計 Zernike 係數模擬的 PSF 比較，兩者半高寬差異應在 5% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acquire PSFs of at least 10 beads from the same 100 nm batch at three or more wavelengths, compute the mean and standard deviation of the widths and remove the bead-size contribution with the approximation √(FWHM² − d²); compare the measured PSF with the PSF simulated from the design Zernike coefficients, where the widths should agree within 5%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Strehl is estimated from RMS wavefront: for σ = 30 nm, Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×30/550)²] = exp(−0.117) ≈ 0.89; for σ = 45 nm about 0.77, already below 0.8.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring PSF, Strehl and axial colour", which statement holds?
options: NA 1.4 在 520 nm 的理想橫向 PSF 半高寬 ≈ 0.51λ/NA = 0.51×520/1.4 ≈ 189 nm。
物鏡的 Strehl 是固定常數，與使用條件無關。
只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。
optionsEn: The ideal lateral PSF full width at half maximum at NA 1.4 and 520 nm is ≈ 0.51λ/NA = 0.51×520/1.4 ≈ 189 nm.
An objective's Strehl is a fixed constant independent of usage conditions.
With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum.

quiz.explanationEn: The ideal lateral PSF full width at half maximum at NA 1.4 and 520 nm is ≈ 0.51λ/NA = 0.51×520/1.4 ≈ 189 nm; a measured 215 nm corresponds to an effective NA of 1.23 or to aberration. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring PSF, Strehl and axial colour: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「多波長 PSF 量測台」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Multi-wavelength PSF measurement bench” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一批 100 nm 珠在至少三個波長各取 10 顆珠的 PSF，計算半高寬平均與標準差，排除珠子大小的貢獻（以 √(FWHM² − d²) 近似去卷積）；把量測的 PSF 與由設計 Zernike 係數模擬的 PSF 比較，兩者半高寬差異應在 5% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acquire PSFs of at least 10 beads from the same 100 nm batch at three or more wavelengths, compute the mean and standard deviation of the widths and remove the bead-size contribution with the approximation √(FWHM² − d²); compare the measured PSF with the PSF simulated from the design Zernike coefficients, where the widths should agree within 5%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若用厚度 150 µm 的蓋玻片測試設計給 170 µm 的物鏡，球差讓軸向 PSF 不對稱並拉長 50% 以上，測試報告判定物鏡不良，實際上是測試條件錯誤。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Testing an objective designed for a 170 µm cover glass with a 150 µm one introduces spherical aberration that makes the axial PSF asymmetric and over 50% longer, so the report condemns a good objective when the test condition was wrong.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一批 100 nm 珠在至少三個波長各取 10 顆珠的 PSF，計算半高寬平均與標準差，排除珠子大小的貢獻（以 √(FWHM² − d²) 近似去卷積）；把量測的 PSF 與由設計 Zernike 係數模擬的 PSF 比較，兩者半高寬差異應在 5% 內。
knowledge.textEn: Acquire PSFs of at least 10 beads from the same 100 nm batch at three or more wavelengths, compute the mean and standard deviation of the widths and remove the bead-size contribution with the approximation √(FWHM² − d²); compare the measured PSF with the PSF simulated from the design Zernike coefficients, where the widths should agree within 5%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring PSF, Strehl and axial colour"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以同一批 100 nm 珠在至少三個波長各取 10 顆珠的 PSF，計算半高寬平均與標準差，排除珠子大小的貢獻（以 √(FWHM² − d²) 近似去卷積）。
螢石鏡片只是為了讓透過率更高。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Acquire PSFs of at least 10 beads from the same 100 nm batch at three or more wavelengths, compute the mean and standard deviation of the widths and remove the bead-size contribution with the approximation √(FWHM² − d²).
Fluorite elements are used only to raise transmission.
quiz.explanation: 以同一批 100 nm 珠在至少三個波長各取 10 顆珠的 PSF，計算半高寬平均與標準差，排除珠子大小的貢獻（以 √(FWHM² − d²) 近似去卷積）；把量測的 PSF 與由設計 Zernike 係數模擬的 PSF 比較，兩者半高寬差異應在 5% 內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Acquire PSFs of at least 10 beads from the same 100 nm batch at three or more wavelengths, compute the mean and standard deviation of the widths and remove the bead-size contribution with the approximation √(FWHM² − d²); compare the measured PSF with the PSF simulated from the design Zernike coefficients, where the widths should agree within 5%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring PSF, Strehl and axial colour: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多波長 PSF 量測台」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Multi-wavelength PSF measurement bench” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若用厚度 150 µm 的蓋玻片測試設計給 170 µm 的物鏡，球差讓軸向 PSF 不對稱並拉長 50% 以上，測試報告判定物鏡不良，實際上是測試條件錯誤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Testing an objective designed for a 170 µm cover glass with a 150 µm one introduces spherical aberration that makes the axial PSF asymmetric and over 50% longer, so the report condemns a good objective when the test condition was wrong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測時蓋玻片厚度、浸油折射率與溫度都必須和設計條件一致，否則量到的是測試條件的像差而非物鏡的像差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover-glass thickness, oil index and temperature during the test must match the design conditions, otherwise the measured aberration belongs to the test setup rather than to the objective.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量一個波長的 PSF 就足以驗證複消色差物鏡。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single-wavelength PSF measurement suffices to qualify an apochromat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若用厚度 150 µm 的蓋玻片測試設計給 170 µm 的物鏡，球差讓軸向 PSF 不對稱並拉長 50% 以上，測試報告判定物鏡不良，實際上是測試條件錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Testing an objective designed for a 170 µm cover glass with a 150 µm one introduces spherical aberration that makes the axial PSF asymmetric and over 50% longer, so the report condemns a good objective when the test condition was wrong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「PSF、Strehl 與軸向色差的量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measuring PSF, Strehl and axial colour" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
油浸物鏡對任何試樣深度都沒有球差。
若用厚度 150 µm 的蓋玻片測試設計給 170 µm 的物鏡，球差讓軸向 PSF 不對稱並拉長 50% 以上，測試報告判定物鏡不良，實際上是測試條件錯誤。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Oil-immersion objectives are free of spherical aberration at any specimen depth.

Testing an objective designed for a 170 µm cover glass with a 150 µm one introduces spherical aberration that makes the axial PSF asymmetric and over 50% longer, so the report condemns a good objective when the test condition was wrong.
quiz.explanation: 若用厚度 150 µm 的蓋玻片測試設計給 170 µm 的物鏡，球差讓軸向 PSF 不對稱並拉長 50% 以上，測試報告判定物鏡不良，實際上是測試條件錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing an objective designed for a 170 µm cover glass with a 150 µm one introduces spherical aberration that makes the axial PSF asymmetric and over 50% longer, so the report condemns a good objective when the test condition was wrong. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「蓋玻片厚度與校正環」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover-glass thickness and correction collar” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 物鏡以特定蓋玻片厚度（通常 0.17 mm）與浸液折射率設計，任何厚度偏差或折射率失配都會引入與 NA 四次方成正比的球差，高 NA 乾式物鏡對此最敏感，因此配有校正環改變一組鏡片的間距來抵消。油浸物鏡在蓋玻片與油折射率匹配時對厚度不敏感，但觀察水性試樣深處時，水與油的折射率差會隨深度累積球差。誤差預算要把這些使用條件項與物鏡本身的殘差一起列入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「蓋玻片厚度與校正環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An objective is designed for a specific cover-glass thickness (usually 0.17 mm) and immersion index, and any thickness deviation or index mismatch introduces spherical aberration proportional to the fourth power of NA, to which high-NA dry objectives are most sensitive, hence a correction collar that shifts one lens group to cancel it. Oil objectives are insensitive to cover-glass thickness when oil and glass indices match, but imaging deep into aqueous specimens accumulates spherical aberration with depth from the water-oil index difference. The error budget must list these usage-condition terms alongside the objective's own residuals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cover-glass thickness and correction collar”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平行平板引入的三階球差 W₀₄₀ ≈ Δt·(n² − 1)/(8n³)·NA⁴：n = 1.515 時 (n² − 1)/(8n³) ≈ 0.0466；乾式 NA 0.95 的 NA⁴ = 0.81，厚度誤差 Δt = 10 µm 給 0.0466×0.81×10 µm ≈ 0.38 µm 的峰值波前，重新對焦後 RMS ≈ W₀₄₀/13.4 ≈ 28 nm；Δt = 20 µm 時約 56 nm，超過 λ/14 = 39 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A plane-parallel plate adds third-order spherical aberration W₀₄₀ ≈ Δt·(n² − 1)/(8n³)·NA⁴: for n = 1.515, (n² − 1)/(8n³) ≈ 0.0466; a dry NA 0.95 objective has NA⁴ = 0.81, so a thickness error Δt = 10 µm gives 0.0466×0.81×10 µm ≈ 0.38 µm of peak wavefront, about 28 nm RMS after refocus (W₀₄₀/13.4); Δt = 20 µm gives about 56 nm, beyond λ/14 = 39 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油浸物鏡對任何試樣深度都沒有球差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Oil-immersion objectives are free of spherical aberration at any specimen depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「蓋玻片厚度與校正環」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cover-glass thickness and correction collar”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蓋玻片厚度與校正環」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cover-glass thickness and correction collar” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平行平板引入的三階球差 W₀₄₀ ≈ Δt·(n² − 1)/(8n³)·NA⁴：n = 1.515 時 (n² − 1)/(8n³) ≈ 0.0466；乾式 NA 0.95 的 NA⁴ = 0.81，厚度誤差 Δt = 10 µm 給 0.0466×0.81×10 µm ≈ 0.38 µm 的峰值波前，重新對焦後 RMS ≈ W₀₄₀/13.4 ≈ 28 nm；Δt = 20 µm 時約 56 nm，超過 λ/14 = 39 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A plane-parallel plate adds third-order spherical aberration W₀₄₀ ≈ Δt·(n² − 1)/(8n³)·NA⁴: for n = 1.515, (n² − 1)/(8n³) ≈ 0.0466; a dry NA 0.95 objective has NA⁴ = 0.81, so a thickness error Δt = 10 µm gives 0.0466×0.81×10 µm ≈ 0.38 µm of peak wavefront, about 28 nm RMS after refocus (W₀₄₀/13.4); Δt = 20 µm gives about 56 nm, beyond λ/14 = 39 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用一組已知厚度（150、170、190 µm）的蓋玻片放置同樣的螢光珠，對每一片記錄軸向 PSF 並量不對稱度，驗證球差隨厚度偏差線性變化；再轉動校正環找出每個厚度的最佳設定，建立校正環刻度對實際厚度的對照表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the same fluorescent beads under cover glasses of known thickness (150, 170 and 190 µm), record the axial PSF for each and quantify its asymmetry to verify that spherical aberration varies linearly with thickness deviation; then rotate the correction collar to find the best setting for each thickness and build a table relating collar scale to actual thickness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget", which statement holds?
options: 放大倍率越高，解析度就一定越好。
平行平板引入的三階球差 W₀₄₀ ≈ Δt·(n² − 1)/(8n³)·NA⁴：n = 1.515 時 (n² − 1)/(8n³) ≈ 0.0466。
螢石鏡片只是為了讓透過率更高。
optionsEn: Higher magnification always means better resolution.
A plane-parallel plate adds third-order spherical aberration W₀₄₀ ≈ Δt·(n² − 1)/(8n³)·NA⁴: for n = 1.515, (n² − 1)/(8n³) ≈ 0.0466.
Fluorite elements are used only to raise transmission.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「蓋玻片厚度與校正環」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cover-glass thickness and correction collar” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用一組已知厚度（150、170、190 µm）的蓋玻片放置同樣的螢光珠，對每一片記錄軸向 PSF 並量不對稱度，驗證球差隨厚度偏差線性變化；再轉動校正環找出每個厚度的最佳設定，建立校正環刻度對實際厚度的對照表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place the same fluorescent beads under cover glasses of known thickness (150, 170 and 190 µm), record the axial PSF for each and quantify its asymmetry to verify that spherical aberration varies linearly with thickness deviation; then rotate the correction collar to find the best setting for each thickness and build a table relating collar scale to actual thickness. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在 37 °C 的活細胞實驗中，浸油折射率比 23 °C 時低約 0.005，與蓋玻片失配後產生的球差隨成像深度累積，30 µm 深處的訊號強度與解析度明顯下降，常被誤判為試樣散射。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In live-cell work at 37 °C the immersion-oil index is about 0.005 lower than at 23 °C, the resulting mismatch with the cover glass accumulates spherical aberration with imaging depth, and signal and resolution at 30 µm depth drop visibly, often misattributed to specimen scattering.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用一組已知厚度（150、170、190 µm）的蓋玻片放置同樣的螢光珠，對每一片記錄軸向 PSF 並量不對稱度，驗證球差隨厚度偏差線性變化；再轉動校正環找出每個厚度的最佳設定，建立校正環刻度對實際厚度的對照表。
knowledge.textEn: Place the same fluorescent beads under cover glasses of known thickness (150, 170 and 190 µm), record the axial PSF for each and quantify its asymmetry to verify that spherical aberration varies linearly with thickness deviation; then rotate the correction collar to find the best setting for each thickness and build a table relating collar scale to actual thickness.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
鏡片多幾片沒關係，鍍膜損失可以忽略。
用一組已知厚度（150、170、190 µm）的蓋玻片放置同樣的螢光珠，對每一片記錄軸向 PSF 並量不對稱度，驗證球差隨厚度偏差線性變化。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A few extra elements do not matter because coating losses are negligible.

Place the same fluorescent beads under cover glasses of known thickness (150, 170 and 190 µm), record the axial PSF for each and quantify its asymmetry to verify that spherical aberration varies linearly with thickness deviation.

quiz.explanationEn: Place the same fluorescent beads under cover glasses of known thickness (150, 170 and 190 µm), record the axial PSF for each and quantify its asymmetry to verify that spherical aberration varies linearly with thickness deviation; then rotate the correction collar to find the best setting for each thickness and build a table relating collar scale to actual thickness. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蓋玻片厚度與校正環」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cover-glass thickness and correction collar” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在 37 °C 的活細胞實驗中，浸油折射率比 23 °C 時低約 0.005，與蓋玻片失配後產生的球差隨成像深度累積，30 µm 深處的訊號強度與解析度明顯下降，常被誤判為試樣散射。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: In live-cell work at 37 °C the immersion-oil index is about 0.005 lower than at 23 °C, the resulting mismatch with the cover glass accumulates spherical aberration with imaging depth, and signal and resolution at 30 µm depth drop visibly, often misattributed to specimen scattering. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：誤差預算要把這些使用條件項與物鏡本身的殘差一起列入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The error budget must list these usage-condition terms alongside the objective's own residuals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油浸物鏡對任何試樣深度都沒有球差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Oil-immersion objectives are free of spherical aberration at any specimen depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在 37 °C 的活細胞實驗中，浸油折射率比 23 °C 時低約 0.005，與蓋玻片失配後產生的球差隨成像深度累積，30 µm 深處的訊號強度與解析度明顯下降，常被誤判為試樣散射。
knowledge.textEn: In live-cell work at 37 °C the immersion-oil index is about 0.005 lower than at 23 °C, the resulting mismatch with the cover glass accumulates spherical aberration with imaging depth, and signal and resolution at 30 µm depth drop visibly, often misattributed to specimen scattering.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蓋玻片球差、折射率失配與誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover-glass spherical aberration, index mismatch and the error budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在 37 °C 的活細胞實驗中，浸油折射率比 23 °C 時低約 0.005，與蓋玻片失配後產生的球差隨成像深度累積，30 µm 深處的訊號強度與解析度明顯下降，常被誤判為試樣散射。

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差」與「Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour" and "Strehl budget, acceptance report and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「筒鏡、齊焦距離與視場數」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tube lens, parfocal distance and field number” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 現代物鏡為無限遠校正：物鏡把試樣成像到無窮遠，由筒鏡（焦距依廠牌為 164.5、180 或 200 mm）成像到中間像面，標稱倍率等於筒鏡焦距除以物鏡焦距。物鏡與筒鏡是一組被整體設計的系統，橫向色差（放大率隨波長變化）可能在物鏡內校正，也可能留給筒鏡補償，因此混用不同廠牌會引入橫向色差。齊焦距離、螺紋規格、視場數與後焦面位置都是整合時必須一致的介面參數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「筒鏡、齊焦距離與視場數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modern objectives are infinity-corrected: the objective images the specimen to infinity and a tube lens (164.5, 180 or 200 mm focal length depending on the maker) forms the intermediate image, with nominal magnification equal to tube-lens focal length divided by objective focal length. Objective and tube lens are designed as one system, and lateral colour (magnification varying with wavelength) may be corrected inside the objective or left for the tube lens to compensate, so mixing makers introduces lateral colour. Parfocal distance, thread standard, field number and back-focal-plane position are the interface parameters that must agree during integration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tube lens, parfocal distance and field number”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：筒鏡 200 mm 配 100× 物鏡時 f_obj = 2 mm；視場數 25 mm 對應試樣面視場直徑 25/100 = 0.25 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 200 mm tube lens with a 100× objective implies f_obj = 2 mm; a field number of 25 mm corresponds to a specimen-plane field diameter of 25/100 = 0.25 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「物鏡上標的倍率在任何顯微鏡上都成立。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The magnification engraved on an objective holds on any microscope." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「筒鏡、齊焦距離與視場數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Tube lens, parfocal distance and field number”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差
knowledge.titleEn: Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour
knowledge.text: 現代物鏡為無限遠校正：物鏡把試樣成像到無窮遠，由筒鏡（焦距依廠牌為 164.5、180 或 200 mm）成像到中間像面，標稱倍率等於筒鏡焦距除以物鏡焦距。物鏡與筒鏡是一組被整體設計的系統，橫向色差（放大率隨波長變化）可能在物鏡內校正，也可能留給筒鏡補償，因此混用不同廠牌會引入橫向色差。
knowledge.textEn: Modern objectives are infinity-corrected: the objective images the specimen to infinity and a tube lens (164.5, 180 or 200 mm focal length depending on the maker) forms the intermediate image, with nominal magnification equal to tube-lens focal length divided by objective focal length. Objective and tube lens are designed as one system, and lateral colour (magnification varying with wavelength) may be corrected inside the objective or left for the tube lens to compensate, so mixing makers introduces lateral colour.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：物鏡上標的倍率在任何顯微鏡上都成立。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The magnification engraved on an objective holds on any microscope. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour" is correct?
options: 物鏡上標的倍率在任何顯微鏡上都成立。
現代物鏡為無限遠校正：物鏡把試樣成像到無窮遠，由筒鏡（焦距依廠牌為 164.5、180 或 200 mm）成像到中間像面，標稱倍率等於筒鏡焦距除以物鏡焦距。
物鏡的 Strehl 是固定常數，與使用條件無關。
optionsEn: The magnification engraved on an objective holds on any microscope.

Modern objectives are infinity-corrected: the objective images the specimen to infinity and a tube lens (164.5, 180 or 200 mm focal length depending on the maker) forms the intermediate image, with nominal magnification equal to tube-lens focal length divided by objective focal length.
An objective's Strehl is a fixed constant independent of usage conditions.
quiz.explanation: 現代物鏡為無限遠校正：物鏡把試樣成像到無窮遠，由筒鏡（焦距依廠牌為 164.5、180 或 200 mm）成像到中間像面，標稱倍率等於筒鏡焦距除以物鏡焦距。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「筒鏡、齊焦距離與視場數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tube lens, parfocal distance and field number” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：筒鏡 200 mm 配 100× 物鏡時 f_obj = 2 mm；視場數 25 mm 對應試樣面視場直徑 25/100 = 0.25 mm。若混用廠牌造成 486 與 656 nm 之間 0.1% 的放大率差，視場邊緣（離軸 125 µm）的紅藍影像橫向錯位 125 µm×0.001 = 125 nm，已超過半個解析極限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 200 mm tube lens with a 100× objective implies f_obj = 2 mm; a field number of 25 mm corresponds to a specimen-plane field diameter of 25/100 = 0.25 mm. If mixing makers produces a 0.1% magnification difference between 486 and 656 nm, the red and blue images at the field edge (125 µm off axis) are displaced laterally by 125 µm×0.001 = 125 nm, more than half the resolution limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在視場邊緣以多色螢光珠記錄紅、綠、藍通道影像，量測各通道質心的徑向位置差並對離軸距離作圖，斜率即橫向色差的放大率差；同時用刻度尺標定實際倍率，確認筒鏡焦距與物鏡匹配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record red, green and blue channel images of multicolour beads at the field edge, measure the radial centroid difference between channels and plot it against off-axis distance, where the slope gives the magnification difference of lateral colour; calibrate the actual magnification with a stage micrometer to confirm that tube-lens focal length and objective are matched.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 筒鏡 200 mm 配 100× 物鏡時 f_obj = 2 mm；視場數 25 mm 對應試樣面視場直徑 25/100 = 0.25 mm。若混用廠牌造成 486 與 656 nm 之間 0.1% 的放大率差，視場邊緣（離軸 125 µm）的紅藍影像橫向錯位 125 µm×0.001 = 125 nm，已超過半個解析極限。
knowledge.textEn: A 200 mm tube lens with a 100× objective implies f_obj = 2 mm; a field number of 25 mm corresponds to a specimen-plane field diameter of 25/100 = 0.25 mm. If mixing makers produces a 0.1% magnification difference between 486 and 656 nm, the red and blue images at the field edge (125 µm off axis) are displaced laterally by 125 µm×0.001 = 125 nm, more than half the resolution limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour", which statement holds?
options: 只要鏡片數量夠多，用普通玻璃也能消除二級光譜。
鏡片多幾片沒關係，鍍膜損失可以忽略。
筒鏡 200 mm 配 100× 物鏡時 f_obj = 2 mm；視場數 25 mm 對應試樣面視場直徑 25/100 = 0.25 mm。
optionsEn: With enough elements, ordinary glasses can remove the secondary spectrum.
A few extra elements do not matter because coating losses are negligible.
A 200 mm tube lens with a 100× objective implies f_obj = 2 mm; a field number of 25 mm corresponds to a specimen-plane field diameter of 25/100 = 0.25 mm.
quiz.explanation: 筒鏡 200 mm 配 100× 物鏡時 f_obj = 2 mm；視場數 25 mm 對應試樣面視場直徑 25/100 = 0.25 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 200 mm tube lens with a 100× objective implies f_obj = 2 mm; a field number of 25 mm corresponds to a specimen-plane field diameter of 25/100 = 0.25 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「筒鏡、齊焦距離與視場數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Tube lens, parfocal distance and field number” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在視場邊緣以多色螢光珠記錄紅、綠、藍通道影像，量測各通道質心的徑向位置差並對離軸距離作圖，斜率即橫向色差的放大率差；同時用刻度尺標定實際倍率，確認筒鏡焦距與物鏡匹配。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record red, green and blue channel images of multicolour beads at the field edge, measure the radial centroid difference between channels and plot it against off-axis distance, where the slope gives the magnification difference of lateral colour; calibrate the actual magnification with a stage micrometer to confirm that tube-lens focal length and objective are matched. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把為 180 mm 筒鏡設計的物鏡裝在 200 mm 筒鏡的顯微鏡上，倍率變成 111× 而非 100×，若軟體仍以 100× 計算像素尺寸，所有長度量測都有 11% 的系統誤差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Mounting an objective designed for a 180 mm tube lens on a microscope with a 200 mm tube lens yields 111× instead of 100×, and if software still assumes 100× for pixel size, every length measurement carries an 11% systematic error.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在視場邊緣以多色螢光珠記錄紅、綠、藍通道影像，量測各通道質心的徑向位置差並對離軸距離作圖，斜率即橫向色差的放大率差；同時用刻度尺標定實際倍率，確認筒鏡焦距與物鏡匹配。
knowledge.textEn: Record red, green and blue channel images of multicolour beads at the field edge, measure the radial centroid difference between channels and plot it against off-axis distance, where the slope gives the magnification difference of lateral colour; calibrate the actual magnification with a stage micrometer to confirm that tube-lens focal length and objective are matched.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour"?
options: 在視場邊緣以多色螢光珠記錄紅、綠、藍通道影像，量測各通道質心的徑向位置差並對離軸距離作圖，斜率即橫向色差的放大率差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
量一個波長的 PSF 就足以驗證複消色差物鏡。
optionsEn: Record red, green and blue channel images of multicolour beads at the field edge, measure the radial centroid difference between channels and plot it against off-axis distance, where the slope gives the magnification difference of lateral colour.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A single-wavelength PSF measurement suffices to qualify an apochromat.
quiz.explanation: 在視場邊緣以多色螢光珠記錄紅、綠、藍通道影像，量測各通道質心的徑向位置差並對離軸距離作圖，斜率即橫向色差的放大率差；同時用刻度尺標定實際倍率，確認筒鏡焦距與物鏡匹配。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record red, green and blue channel images of multicolour beads at the field edge, measure the radial centroid difference between channels and plot it against off-axis distance, where the slope gives the magnification difference of lateral colour; calibrate the actual magnification with a stage micrometer to confirm that tube-lens focal length and objective are matched. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「筒鏡、齊焦距離與視場數」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Tube lens, parfocal distance and field number” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把為 180 mm 筒鏡設計的物鏡裝在 200 mm 筒鏡的顯微鏡上，倍率變成 111× 而非 100×，若軟體仍以 100× 計算像素尺寸，所有長度量測都有 11% 的系統誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Mounting an objective designed for a 180 mm tube lens on a microscope with a 200 mm tube lens yields 111× instead of 100×, and if software still assumes 100× for pixel size, every length measurement carries an 11% systematic error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：齊焦距離、螺紋規格、視場數與後焦面位置都是整合時必須一致的介面參數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Parfocal distance, thread standard, field number and back-focal-plane position are the interface parameters that must agree during integration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「物鏡上標的倍率在任何顯微鏡上都成立。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The magnification engraved on an objective holds on any microscope." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把為 180 mm 筒鏡設計的物鏡裝在 200 mm 筒鏡的顯微鏡上，倍率變成 111× 而非 100×，若軟體仍以 100× 計算像素尺寸，所有長度量測都有 11% 的系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Mounting an objective designed for a 180 mm tube lens on a microscope with a 200 mm tube lens yields 111× instead of 100×, and if software still assumes 100× for pixel size, every length measurement carries an 11% systematic error.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無限遠共軛系統整合與橫向色差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Infinity-conjugate system integration and lateral colour" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把為 180 mm 筒鏡設計的物鏡裝在 200 mm 筒鏡的顯微鏡上，倍率變成 111× 而非 100×，若軟體仍以 100× 計算像素尺寸，所有長度量測都有 11% 的系統誤差。
物鏡的 Strehl 是固定常數，與使用條件無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Mounting an objective designed for a 180 mm tube lens on a microscope with a 200 mm tube lens yields 111× instead of 100×, and if software still assumes 100× for pixel size, every length measurement carries an 11% systematic error.
An objective's Strehl is a fixed constant independent of usage conditions.
quiz.explanation: 把為 180 mm 筒鏡設計的物鏡裝在 200 mm 筒鏡的顯微鏡上，倍率變成 111× 而非 100×，若軟體仍以 100× 計算像素尺寸，所有長度量測都有 11% 的系統誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mounting an objective designed for a 180 mm tube lens on a microscope with a 200 mm tube lens yields 111× instead of 100×, and if software still assumes 100× for pixel size, every length measurement carries an 11% systematic error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Strehl budget, acceptance report and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「物鏡驗收資料表」如何決定複消色差顯微物鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Objective acceptance data sheet” determines the key performance of “Apochromatic microscope objectives”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 物鏡出貨前的驗收把所有量測整合成一份資料表：各波長的軸上 Strehl 與 Zernike 係數、軸向與橫向色差、視場平坦度、透過率曲線、工作距離與齊焦距離實測值，以及測試時的蓋玻片厚度、浸液與溫度。系統整合者再把物鏡殘差、筒鏡、對準與使用條件以均方根合成，判斷整機能否維持 Strehl 0.8。交接時必須連同測試條件一起移交，否則後續的現場量測無法與出廠值比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡驗收資料表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pre-shipment acceptance consolidates every measurement into one data sheet: on-axis Strehl and Zernike coefficients per wavelength, axial and lateral colour, field flatness, transmission curve, measured working and parfocal distances, and the cover-glass thickness, immersion and temperature used in testing. The system integrator then combines objective residual, tube lens, alignment and usage conditions in quadrature to judge whether the whole instrument keeps Strehl at 0.8. The test conditions must be handed over with the data, otherwise later field measurements cannot be compared with factory values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective acceptance data sheet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：RMS 波前預算：物鏡殘差 25 nm、筒鏡 15 nm、對準 15 nm、蓋玻片與浸液殘差 20 nm，RSS = √(625+225+225+400) = √1475 ≈ 38 nm，恰在 λ/14 ≈ 39 nm 之內；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] = exp(−0.189) ≈ 0.83。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: RMS wavefront budget: objective residual 25 nm, tube lens 15 nm, alignment 15 nm and cover-glass plus immersion residual 20 nm give RSS = √(625+225+225+400) = √1475 ≈ 38 nm, just inside λ/14 ≈ 39 nm; Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] = exp(−0.189) ≈ 0.83.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「物鏡的 Strehl 是固定常數，與使用條件無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An objective's Strehl is a fixed constant independent of usage conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「物鏡驗收資料表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Objective acceptance data sheet”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Strehl budget, acceptance report and handoff
knowledge.text: 物鏡出貨前的驗收把所有量測整合成一份資料表：各波長的軸上 Strehl 與 Zernike 係數、軸向與橫向色差、視場平坦度、透過率曲線、工作距離與齊焦距離實測值，以及測試時的蓋玻片厚度、浸液與溫度。系統整合者再把物鏡殘差、筒鏡、對準與使用條件以均方根合成，判斷整機能否維持 Strehl 0.8。
knowledge.textEn: Pre-shipment acceptance consolidates every measurement into one data sheet: on-axis Strehl and Zernike coefficients per wavelength, axial and lateral colour, field flatness, transmission curve, measured working and parfocal distances, and the cover-glass thickness, immersion and temperature used in testing. The system integrator then combines objective residual, tube lens, alignment and usage conditions in quadrature to judge whether the whole instrument keeps Strehl at 0.8.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：物鏡的 Strehl 是固定常數，與使用條件無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An objective's Strehl is a fixed constant independent of usage conditions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strehl budget, acceptance report and handoff" is correct?
options: 物鏡的 Strehl 是固定常數，與使用條件無關。
放大倍率越高，解析度就一定越好。
物鏡出貨前的驗收把所有量測整合成一份資料表：各波長的軸上 Strehl 與 Zernike 係數、軸向與橫向色差、視場平坦度、透過率曲線、工作距離與齊焦距離實測值，以及測試時的蓋玻片厚度、浸液與溫度。
optionsEn: An objective's Strehl is a fixed constant independent of usage conditions.
Higher magnification always means better resolution.

Pre-shipment acceptance consolidates every measurement into one data sheet: on-axis Strehl and Zernike coefficients per wavelength, axial and lateral colour, field flatness, transmission curve, measured working and parfocal distances, and the cover-glass thickness, immersion and temperature used in testing.
quiz.explanation: 物鏡出貨前的驗收把所有量測整合成一份資料表：各波長的軸上 Strehl 與 Zernike 係數、軸向與橫向色差、視場平坦度、透過率曲線、工作距離與齊焦距離實測值，以及測試時的蓋玻片厚度、浸液與溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pre-shipment acceptance consolidates every measurement into one data sheet: on-axis Strehl and Zernike coefficients per wavelength, axial and lateral colour, field flatness, transmission curve, measured working and parfocal distances, and the cover-glass thickness, immersion and temperature used in testing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strehl budget, acceptance report and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「物鏡驗收資料表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Objective acceptance data sheet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：RMS 波前預算：物鏡殘差 25 nm、筒鏡 15 nm、對準 15 nm、蓋玻片與浸液殘差 20 nm，RSS = √(625+225+225+400) = √1475 ≈ 38 nm，恰在 λ/14 ≈ 39 nm 之內；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] = exp(−0.189) ≈ 0.83。若蓋玻片項放寬到 30 nm，RSS ≈ 44 nm，Strehl 降到約 0.78。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: RMS wavefront budget: objective residual 25 nm, tube lens 15 nm, alignment 15 nm and cover-glass plus immersion residual 20 nm give RSS = √(625+225+225+400) = √1475 ≈ 38 nm, just inside λ/14 ≈ 39 nm; Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] = exp(−0.189) ≈ 0.83. Relaxing the cover-glass term to 30 nm raises the RSS to about 44 nm and drops Strehl to about 0.78. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在整合後的顯微鏡上重複出廠的 PSF 與色差量測，使用相同的珠子、蓋玻片與浸液，比較 Strehl 與軸向色差是否在出廠值的不確定度內；逐項核對資料表的測試條件、日期與儀器，並把現場量測結果附在交接文件中作為新的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat the factory PSF and chromatic measurements on the integrated microscope with the same beads, cover glass and immersion, and compare Strehl and axial colour with the factory values within their uncertainty; check the test conditions, dates and instruments on the data sheet item by item and attach the field results to the handoff record as the new baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: RMS 波前預算：物鏡殘差 25 nm、筒鏡 15 nm、對準 15 nm、蓋玻片與浸液殘差 20 nm，RSS = √(625+225+225+400) = √1475 ≈ 38 nm，恰在 λ/14 ≈ 39 nm 之內；Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] = exp(−0.189) ≈ 0.83。若蓋玻片項放寬到 30 nm，RSS ≈ 44 nm，Strehl 降到約 0.78。
knowledge.textEn: RMS wavefront budget: objective residual 25 nm, tube lens 15 nm, alignment 15 nm and cover-glass plus immersion residual 20 nm give RSS = √(625+225+225+400) = √1475 ≈ 38 nm, just inside λ/14 ≈ 39 nm; Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×38/550)²] = exp(−0.189) ≈ 0.83. Relaxing the cover-glass term to 30 nm raises the RSS to about 44 nm and drops Strehl to about 0.78.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Fluorite elements are used only to raise transmission.
A single-wavelength PSF measurement suffices to qualify an apochromat.

steps.title: Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strehl budget, acceptance report and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「物鏡驗收資料表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Objective acceptance data sheet” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在整合後的顯微鏡上重複出廠的 PSF 與色差量測，使用相同的珠子、蓋玻片與浸液，比較 Strehl 與軸向色差是否在出廠值的不確定度內；逐項核對資料表的測試條件、日期與儀器，並把現場量測結果附在交接文件中作為新的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat the factory PSF and chromatic measurements on the integrated microscope with the same beads, cover glass and immersion, and compare Strehl and axial colour with the factory values within their uncertainty; check the test conditions, dates and instruments on the data sheet item by item and attach the field results to the handoff record as the new baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：資料表若只給一個總 Strehl 值而未註明波長與蓋玻片條件，現場用不同波長量到 0.7 時無法判斷是物鏡退化、筒鏡不匹配還是測試條件不同，爭議只能靠返廠重測解決。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the data sheet gives a single Strehl value without wavelength and cover-glass conditions, a field measurement of 0.7 at another wavelength cannot be attributed to objective degradation, tube-lens mismatch or test conditions, and the dispute can only be settled by returning the objective for retest.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Repeat the factory PSF and chromatic measurements on the integrated microscope with the same beads, cover glass and immersion, and compare Strehl and axial colour with the factory values within their uncertainty; check the test conditions, dates and instruments on the data sheet item by item and attach the field results to the handoff record as the new baseline.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

油浸物鏡對任何試樣深度都沒有球差。

Repeat the factory PSF and chromatic measurements on the integrated microscope with the same beads, cover glass and immersion, and compare Strehl and axial colour with the factory values within their uncertainty.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Strehl 預算、驗收報告與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strehl budget, acceptance report and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「物鏡驗收資料表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Objective acceptance data sheet” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 資料表若只給一個總 Strehl 值而未註明波長與蓋玻片條件，現場用不同波長量到 0.7 時無法判斷是物鏡退化、筒鏡不匹配還是測試條件不同，爭議只能靠返廠重測解決。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the data sheet gives a single Strehl value without wavelength and cover-glass conditions, a field measurement of 0.7 at another wavelength cannot be attributed to objective degradation, tube-lens mismatch or test conditions, and the dispute can only be settled by returning the objective for retest. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時必須連同測試條件一起移交，否則後續的現場量測無法與出廠值比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The test conditions must be handed over with the data, otherwise later field measurements cannot be compared with factory values.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「物鏡的 Strehl 是固定常數，與使用條件無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An objective's Strehl is a fixed constant independent of usage conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

Higher magnification always means better resolution.

title: 非球面光學加工
summary: 以一片半徑 50 mm、口徑 50 mm 的拋物面為貫穿案例：先用矢高方程算出它與球面的偏離量與斜率，說明為何無法用標準球面工法與干涉儀直接處理，再拆解 CNC 研磨、磁流變等確定性次口徑拋光的去除率與收斂、單點鑽石車削的理論粗糙度與精密玻璃模造的收縮補償，接著以輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接量測建立誤差預算，最後以對心公差、熱穩定性與 ISO 10110 圖面完成驗收交接。
summaryEn: Using a paraboloid of 50 mm radius and 50 mm aperture as the running case, the course first computes its departure from a sphere and its slope with the sag equation to show why standard spherical methods and interferometers cannot handle it directly, then dissects CNC grinding, the removal rate and convergence of deterministic subaperture polishing such as MRF, the theoretical roughness of single-point diamond turning and the shrinkage compensation of precision glass molding, builds an error budget from profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching, and finishes with centring tolerances, thermal stability and ISO 10110 drawing-based acceptance.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 非球面加工練習：拋物面 R = 50 mm、k = −1、口徑 50 mm。邊緣矢高：拋物面 r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點球面 50 − √(50² − 25²) = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面約 110 µm，邊緣斜率約 31 mrad。干涉儀：1000 像素相機每像素 50 µm，可量斜率上限約 3.2 mrad，條紋間距在邊緣只有 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm，因此採用 CGH 零位測試。加工：研磨後 3 µm PV，去除體積 1963 mm²×1.5 µm ≈ 2.9 mm³，MRF 以 0.1 mm³/min 需 29 min；收斂比 7，兩次循環後 0.06 µm PV。對心：10 µm 偏心乘 31 mrad 得 0.31 µm 表面誤差，乘 (n − 1) = 0.52 為 0.16 µm 波前 ≈ 0.25 波，因此對心公差訂為 1 µm。驗收：面形 25 nm RMS、CGH 量測不確定度 13.6 nm，量測比 1.8:1 不足，改用面形 5 nm 的 CGH 基板後 RSS ≈ √(25+36+25+25) ≈ 10.5 nm，接近 2.4:1，並以輪廓儀交叉驗證。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Asphere manufacturing exercise: paraboloid R = 50 mm, k = −1, 50 mm aperture. Edge sag: paraboloid r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, same-vertex sphere 50 − √(50² − 25²) = 6.70 mm, departure 0.45 mm; about 110 µm from the best-fit sphere with an edge slope of about 31 mrad. Interferometry: a 1000-pixel camera at 50 µm per pixel can resolve slopes up to about 3.2 mrad, while fringes at the edge are only 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm apart, so a CGH null test is chosen. Fabrication: 3 µm PV after grinding, removal volume 1963 mm²×1.5 µm ≈ 2.9 mm³, 29 min of MRF at 0.1 mm³/min; with a convergence ratio of 7, two cycles reach 0.06 µm PV. Centring: 10 µm of decentration times 31 mrad gives 0.31 µm of surface error, times (n − 1) = 0.52 gives 0.16 µm of wavefront ≈ 0.25 waves, so the centring tolerance is set at 1 µm. Acceptance: figure 25 nm RMS with a CGH uncertainty of 13.6 nm is a 1.8:1 ratio, insufficient; a CGH substrate of 5 nm figure gives RSS ≈ √(25+36+25+25) ≈ 10.5 nm, close to 2.4:1, and a profilometer cross-check is added. All values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」與「面形、中頻漣波與粗糙度的頻段劃分」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope" and "Figure, mid-spatial-frequency ripple and roughness bands": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」如何決定非球面光學加工的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant” determines the key performance of “Aspheric-optics manufacturing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 球面只有一個自由度（曲率），無法同時滿足聚焦與消球差，所以 f 數小的鏡片必須多片組合；非球面以矢高方程 z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ 加入圓錐常數 k 與高次項，一面就能消除球差。代價是表面不再有旋轉對稱球面那種「任何方向都一樣」的性質：曲率隨半徑變化，傳統靠工具與工件互磨自然成形的球面工法失效，量測也不能直接用球面參考波前。偏離量與斜率的大小決定了加工與量測方法。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sphere has a single degree of freedom, its curvature, and cannot focus and cancel spherical aberration at once, so fast lenses need many elements; an asphere adds a conic constant k and higher-order terms through the sag equation z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ and removes spherical aberration with one surface. The price is losing the property of a sphere that every direction is alike: curvature varies with radius, so traditional spherical lapping in which tool and part grind each other into shape no longer works, and testing cannot simply use a spherical reference wavefront. The magnitude of departure and slope decides which fabrication and metrology methods apply. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：R = 50 mm、k = −1（拋物面）、口徑 50 mm：邊緣 r = 25 mm 的拋物面矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點曲率球面的矢高 z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面的偏離約為四分之一，即 110 µm，邊緣的偏離斜率約 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With R = 50 mm, k = −1 (a paraboloid) and a 50 mm aperture, the paraboloid sag at the edge r = 25 mm is z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, the sphere of the same vertex curvature has z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm, a departure of 0.45 mm; the departure from the best-fit sphere is about a quarter of that, 110 µm, and the departure slope at the edge is about 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非球面只是比較精密的球面，用同樣工法就能做。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率
knowledge.titleEn: Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope
knowledge.text: 球面只有一個自由度（曲率），無法同時滿足聚焦與消球差，所以 f 數小的鏡片必須多片組合；非球面以矢高方程 z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ 加入圓錐常數 k 與高次項，一面就能消除球差。代價是表面不再有旋轉對稱球面那種「任何方向都一樣」的性質：曲率隨半徑變化，傳統靠工具與工件互磨自然成形的球面工法失效，量測也不能直接用球面參考波前。
knowledge.textEn: A sphere has a single degree of freedom, its curvature, and cannot focus and cancel spherical aberration at once, so fast lenses need many elements; an asphere adds a conic constant k and higher-order terms through the sag equation z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ and removes spherical aberration with one surface. The price is losing the property of a sphere that every direction is alike: curvature varies with radius, so traditional spherical lapping in which tool and part grind each other into shape no longer works, and testing cannot simply use a spherical reference wavefront.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：非球面只是比較精密的球面，用同樣工法就能做。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope" is correct?
options: 非球面只是比較精密的球面，用同樣工法就能做。
球面只有一個自由度（曲率），無法同時滿足聚焦與消球差，所以 f 數小的鏡片必須多片組合。
PV 與 RMS 合格就代表表面品質合格。
optionsEn: An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way.
A sphere has a single degree of freedom, its curvature, and cannot focus and cancel spherical aberration at once, so fast lenses need many elements.
Passing PV and RMS means the surface quality is acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 球面只有一個自由度（曲率），無法同時滿足聚焦與消球差，所以 f 數小的鏡片必須多片組合；非球面以矢高方程 z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ 加入圓錐常數 k 與高次項，一面就能消除球差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A sphere has a single degree of freedom, its curvature, and cannot focus and cancel spherical aberration at once, so fast lenses need many elements; an asphere adds a conic constant k and higher-order terms through the sag equation z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ and removes spherical aberration with one surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：R = 50 mm、k = −1（拋物面）、口徑 50 mm：邊緣 r = 25 mm 的拋物面矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點曲率球面的矢高 z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面的偏離約為四分之一，即 110 µm，邊緣的偏離斜率約 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With R = 50 mm, k = −1 (a paraboloid) and a 50 mm aperture, the paraboloid sag at the edge r = 25 mm is z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, the sphere of the same vertex curvature has z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm, a departure of 0.45 mm; the departure from the best-fit sphere is about a quarter of that, 110 µm, and the departure slope at the edge is about 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用設計軟體或試算表對同一方程算出每 1 mm 半徑的矢高、對最佳擬合球面的偏離與斜率，畫成曲線並標出最大斜率位置；再以此表決定干涉儀是否需要補償器、輪廓儀探針是否會因斜率而失準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate the sag, best-fit-sphere departure and slope every 1 mm of radius from the same equation in design software or a spreadsheet, plot them and mark the position of maximum slope; use that table to decide whether the interferometer needs a null compensator and whether a profilometer stylus would misread because of the slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: R = 50 mm、k = −1（拋物面）、口徑 50 mm：邊緣 r = 25 mm 的拋物面矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點曲率球面的矢高 z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面的偏離約為四分之一，即 110 µm，邊緣的偏離斜率約 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad。
knowledge.textEn: With R = 50 mm, k = −1 (a paraboloid) and a 50 mm aperture, the paraboloid sag at the edge r = 25 mm is z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, the sphere of the same vertex curvature has z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm, a departure of 0.45 mm; the departure from the best-fit sphere is about a quarter of that, 110 µm, and the departure slope at the edge is about 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope", which statement holds?
options: 模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。
非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。
R = 50 mm、k = −1（拋物面）、口徑 50 mm：邊緣 r = 25 mm 的拋物面矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點曲率球面的矢高 z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm。
optionsEn: Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones.
An asphere with good figure is as easy to centre as a spherical lens.

With R = 50 mm, k = −1 (a paraboloid) and a 50 mm aperture, the paraboloid sag at the edge r = 25 mm is z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm, the sphere of the same vertex curvature has z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm, a departure of 0.45 mm.
quiz.explanation: R = 50 mm、k = −1（拋物面）、口徑 50 mm：邊緣 r = 25 mm 的拋物面矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 6.25 mm，同頂點曲率球面的矢高 z = R − √(R² − r²) = 50 − 43.30 = 6.70 mm，偏離量 0.45 mm；對最佳擬合球面的偏離約為四分之一，即 110 µm，邊緣的偏離斜率約 2×(r⁴/8R³)/r = 2×0.39/25 ≈ 31 mrad。 重算時請保留單位。
