Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用設計軟體或試算表對同一方程算出每 1 mm 半徑的矢高、對最佳擬合球面的偏離與斜率，畫成曲線並標出最大斜率位置；再以此表決定干涉儀是否需要補償器、輪廓儀探針是否會因斜率而失準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate the sag, best-fit-sphere departure and slope every 1 mm of radius from the same equation in design software or a spreadsheet, plot them and mark the position of maximum slope; use that table to decide whether the interferometer needs a null compensator and whether a profilometer stylus would misread because of the slope. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把非球面係數的符號約定或單位搞錯（例如把 A₄ 以 mm⁻³ 當成 mm⁻⁴），加工出的表面在邊緣偏離設計數十微米，量測時整片表面看似合格的球面卻完全不是設計的非球面。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用設計軟體或試算表對同一方程算出每 1 mm 半徑的矢高、對最佳擬合球面的偏離與斜率，畫成曲線並標出最大斜率位置；再以此表決定干涉儀是否需要補償器、輪廓儀探針是否會因斜率而失準。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate the sag, best-fit-sphere departure and slope every 1 mm of radius from the same equation in design software or a spreadsheet, plot them and mark the position of maximum slope; use that table to decide whether the interferometer needs a null compensator and whether a profilometer stylus would misread because of the slope.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope"?
options: 用設計軟體或試算表對同一方程算出每 1 mm 半徑的矢高、對最佳擬合球面的偏離與斜率，畫成曲線並標出最大斜率位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。
optionsEn: Tabulate the sag, best-fit-sphere departure and slope every 1 mm of radius from the same equation in design software or a spreadsheet, plot them and mark the position of maximum slope.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting.
quiz.explanation: 用設計軟體或試算表對同一方程算出每 1 mm 半徑的矢高、對最佳擬合球面的偏離與斜率，畫成曲線並標出最大斜率位置；再以此表決定干涉儀是否需要補償器、輪廓儀探針是否會因斜率而失準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate the sag, best-fit-sphere departure and slope every 1 mm of radius from the same equation in design software or a spreadsheet, plot them and mark the position of maximum slope; use that table to decide whether the interferometer needs a null compensator and whether a profilometer stylus would misread because of the slope. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把非球面係數的符號約定或單位搞錯（例如把 A₄ 以 mm⁻³ 當成 mm⁻⁴），加工出的表面在邊緣偏離設計數十微米，量測時整片表面看似合格的球面卻完全不是設計的非球面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：偏離量與斜率的大小決定了加工與量測方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The magnitude of departure and slope decides which fabrication and metrology methods apply.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「非球面只是比較精密的球面，用同樣工法就能做。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把非球面係數的符號約定或單位搞錯（例如把 A₄ 以 mm⁻³ 當成 mm⁻⁴），加工出的表面在邊緣偏離設計數十微米，量測時整片表面看似合格的球面卻完全不是設計的非球面。
knowledge.textEn: A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把非球面係數的符號約定或單位搞錯（例如把 A₄ 以 mm⁻³ 當成 mm⁻⁴），加工出的表面在邊緣偏離設計數十微米，量測時整片表面看似合格的球面卻完全不是設計的非球面。
PV 與 RMS 合格就代表表面品質合格。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed.
Passing PV and RMS means the surface quality is acceptable.

quiz.explanationEn: A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed. steps.title: 面形、中頻漣波與粗糙度的頻段劃分：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Figure, mid-spatial-frequency ripple and roughness bands: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「表面誤差功率譜密度」如何決定非球面光學加工的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surface-error power spectral density” determines the key performance of “Aspheric-optics manufacturing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非球面加工的誤差按空間頻率分成三段：低頻面形誤差對應像差，可由後續修形去除；中頻漣波（週期約 0.1 到 10 mm）是次口徑工具沿軌跡留下的週期結構，會把光散射到像點附近形成小角度的眩光與對比損失；高頻粗糙度造成大角度散射。球面全口徑拋光天然不產生中頻，而非球面依賴小工具，所以中頻誤差成為非球面特有的品質問題，必須用功率譜密度（PSD）而不是單一的 PV 或 RMS 數字來規範。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「表面誤差功率譜密度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Errors in aspheric fabrication fall into three spatial-frequency bands: low-frequency figure error maps to aberration and can be corrected by subsequent figuring; mid-spatial-frequency ripple (periods of roughly 0.1 to 10 mm) is the periodic structure left along the tool path by subaperture tools and scatters light close to the image point as small-angle flare with contrast loss; high-frequency roughness scatters at large angles. Full-aperture spherical polishing produces no mid-frequency content naturally, whereas aspheres depend on small tools, so mid-spatial-frequency error is a quality problem specific to aspheres that must be specified with a power spectral density rather than a single PV or RMS number. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Surface-error power spectral density”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：週期 Λ = 2 mm 的漣波把 633 nm 的光散射到 θ ≈ λ/Λ = 0.32 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ripple with period Λ = 2 mm scatters 633 nm light to θ ≈ λ/Λ = 0.32 mrad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「PV 與 RMS 合格就代表表面品質合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing PV and RMS means the surface quality is acceptable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「表面誤差功率譜密度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Surface-error power spectral density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 面形、中頻漣波與粗糙度的頻段劃分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Figure, mid-spatial-frequency ripple and roughness bands: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「表面誤差功率譜密度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Surface-error power spectral density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：週期 Λ = 2 mm 的漣波把 633 nm 的光散射到 θ ≈ λ/Λ = 0.32 mrad。反射面 RMS 漣波 σ = 5 nm 的散射比例 TIS ≈ (4πσ/λ)² = (4π×5/633)² ≈ 0.0099，約 1%；同樣漣波在 n = 1.52 的透射面只有 (2π(n − 1)σ/λ)² = (2π×0.52×5/633)² ≈ 0.00067，約 0.07%，相差 15 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ripple with period Λ = 2 mm scatters 633 nm light to θ ≈ λ/Λ = 0.32 mrad. For a reflective surface with RMS ripple σ = 5 nm the scattered fraction is TIS ≈ (4πσ/λ)² = (4π×5/633)² ≈ 0.0099, about 1%; the same ripple on a transmitting surface with n = 1.52 gives only (2π(n − 1)σ/λ)² = (2π×0.52×5/633)² ≈ 0.00067, about 0.07%, a factor of 15 less. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以干涉儀量面形、以白光干涉顯微鏡在數個視場尺寸量中高頻，把各段資料合成 PSD 曲線並與規格的 PSD 上限比較；對關鍵的中頻段用帶通濾波後的 RMS 值核對，並用 TIS 公式估算散射損失與實測的散射量比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure figure with an interferometer and mid-to-high frequencies with a white-light interference microscope at several field sizes, merge the data into a PSD curve and compare with the specified PSD ceiling; check the critical mid-frequency band with band-pass-filtered RMS values and compare the TIS-estimated scatter loss with measured scatter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Ripple with period Λ = 2 mm scatters 633 nm light to θ ≈ λ/Λ = 0.32 mrad. For a reflective surface with RMS ripple σ = 5 nm the scattered fraction is TIS ≈ (4πσ/λ)² = (4π×5/633)² ≈ 0.0099, about 1%; the same ripple on a transmitting surface with n = 1.52 gives only (2π(n − 1)σ/λ)² = (2π×0.52×5/633)² ≈ 0.00067, about 0.07%, a factor of 15 less.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 面形、中頻漣波與粗糙度的頻段劃分：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Figure, mid-spatial-frequency ripple and roughness bands: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「表面誤差功率譜密度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Surface-error power spectral density” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以干涉儀量面形、以白光干涉顯微鏡在數個視場尺寸量中高頻，把各段資料合成 PSD 曲線並與規格的 PSD 上限比較；對關鍵的中頻段用帶通濾波後的 RMS 值核對，並用 TIS 公式估算散射損失與實測的散射量比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure figure with an interferometer and mid-to-high frequencies with a white-light interference microscope at several field sizes, merge the data into a PSD curve and compare with the specified PSD ceiling; check the critical mid-frequency band with band-pass-filtered RMS values and compare the TIS-estimated scatter loss with measured scatter. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格只寫 PV 0.1 µm 而不限制 PSD 時，供應商用小工具把面形修到合格，卻留下 10 nm 的中頻漣波，裝進雷射系統後出現環狀眩光與光束品質下降，追溯時每張報告都顯示合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the drawing specifies only PV 0.1 µm without a PSD limit, a supplier figures the surface into tolerance with a small tool yet leaves 10 nm of mid-frequency ripple, the laser system then shows ring-shaped flare and beam-quality loss, and every report in the trail still reads as compliant.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。

steps.instruction: 非球面先以 CNC 金剛石砂輪依矢高方程研磨成形，留下數微米的面形誤差與次表面損傷層，再進入確定性拋光：磁流變拋光（MRF）、氣囊拋光或小工具電腦控制拋光都以一個已校正的工具去除函數（TIF）在表面上移動，停留時間圖由誤差圖與 TIF 的反卷積求得，去除量與停留時間成正比。每次疊代把誤差降低一個收斂比，通常需要兩到三次量測與拋光循環；MRF 的剪切去除機制幾乎不施壓，因此不會引入新的次表面損傷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CNC 研磨與磁流變拋光頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An asphere is first ground to the sag equation with a CNC diamond wheel, leaving several micrometres of figure error and a subsurface damage layer, then enters deterministic polishing: magnetorheological finishing (MRF), bonnet polishing or computer-controlled small-tool polishing all move a calibrated tool influence function (TIF) over the surface, the dwell-time map is obtained by deconvolving the error map with the TIF, and removal is proportional to dwell time. Each iteration reduces the error by a convergence ratio, so two or three measure-and-polish cycles are usual; the shear-based removal of MRF applies almost no pressure and introduces no new subsurface damage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CNC grinding and MRF polishing head”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：研磨後殘留 3 µm PV 面形誤差，平均需去除 1.5 µm；口徑 50 mm 的面積 π×25² ≈ 1963 mm²，去除體積 ≈ 1963×1.5×10⁻³ ≈ 2.9 mm³；以 MRF 體積去除率 0.1 mm³/min 計約 29 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: After grinding the residual figure error is 3 µm PV, requiring an average removal of 1.5 µm; the 50 mm aperture has area π×25² ≈ 1963 mm², so the removal volume is ≈ 1963×1.5×10⁻³ ≈ 2.9 mm³, about 29 min at an MRF volumetric removal rate of 0.1 mm³/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拋光越久表面一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer polishing always yields a better surface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CNC 研磨與磁流變拋光頭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CNC grinding and MRF polishing head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 確定性次口徑拋光：去除函數、停留時間與收斂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deterministic subaperture polishing: removal function, dwell time and convergence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CNC 研磨與磁流變拋光頭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CNC grinding and MRF polishing head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：研磨後殘留 3 µm PV 面形誤差，平均需去除 1.5 µm；口徑 50 mm 的面積 π×25² ≈ 1963 mm²，去除體積 ≈ 1963×1.5×10⁻³ ≈ 2.9 mm³；以 MRF 體積去除率 0.1 mm³/min 計約 29 min。若每次收斂比為 7，兩次循環後殘差約 3/49 ≈ 0.06 µm PV，達到 λ/10 等級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: After grinding the residual figure error is 3 µm PV, requiring an average removal of 1.5 µm; the 50 mm aperture has area π×25² ≈ 1963 mm², so the removal volume is ≈ 1963×1.5×10⁻³ ≈ 2.9 mm³, about 29 min at an MRF volumetric removal rate of 0.1 mm³/min. With a convergence ratio of 7 per run, two cycles leave about 3/49 ≈ 0.06 µm PV, i.e. λ/10 class. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先在同材質試片上以固定停留時間做一個去除斑並量測其深度與形狀，得到實際 TIF 與去除率；拋光後再量面形，計算實際收斂比並與預測比較，若低於 3 表示 TIF 漂移、定位誤差或量測與機台座標不一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: First polish a single spot on a coupon of the same material for a fixed dwell time and measure its depth and shape to obtain the actual TIF and removal rate; after polishing, re-measure figure, compute the achieved convergence ratio and compare with prediction, since a ratio below 3 indicates TIF drift, positioning error or a mismatch between metrology and machine coordinates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: After grinding the residual figure error is 3 µm PV, requiring an average removal of 1.5 µm; the 50 mm aperture has area π×25² ≈ 1963 mm², so the removal volume is ≈ 1963×1.5×10⁻³ ≈ 2.9 mm³, about 29 min at an MRF volumetric removal rate of 0.1 mm³/min. steps.title: 確定性次口徑拋光：去除函數、停留時間與收斂：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CNC 研磨與磁流變拋光頭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CNC grinding and MRF polishing head” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先在同材質試片上以固定停留時間做一個去除斑並量測其深度與形狀，得到實際 TIF 與去除率；拋光後再量面形，計算實際收斂比並與預測比較，若低於 3 表示 TIF 漂移、定位誤差或量測與機台座標不一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First polish a single spot on a coupon of the same material for a fixed dwell time and measure its depth and shape to obtain the actual TIF and removal rate; after polishing, re-measure figure, compute the achieved convergence ratio and compare with prediction, since a ratio below 3 indicates TIF drift, positioning error or a mismatch between metrology and machine coordinates. steps.observation: 注意干擾：研磨留下的次表面裂紋若未被足夠的拋光去除量清除，表面在鍍膜或熱循環後出現微裂與散射，甚至在高功率雷射下損傷，而面形量測在交貨時完全正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If subsurface cracks from grinding are not removed by sufficient polishing depth, the surface develops micro-cracks and scatter after coating or thermal cycling and may even damage under high laser power, while figure metrology at delivery looked perfectly normal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」如何決定非球面光學加工的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diamond tool and glass mold” determines the key performance of “Aspheric-optics manufacturing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 金屬、紅外晶體與塑膠的非球面常以單點鑽石車削直接成形：工件在空氣主軸上旋轉，鑽石刀尖沿非球面軌跡以奈米級解析度進給，表面粗糙度由進給量與刀尖半徑決定，形狀精度由機台的定位精度與熱穩定性決定。大量生產的玻璃非球面則用精密玻璃模造：玻璃預形體加熱到轉變溫度以上，在碳化鎢或碳化矽模具之間壓製成形後緩慢冷卻；模具本身是以研磨拋光做出的非球面，並且必須預先補償玻璃冷卻收縮與折射率因冷卻速率下降的效應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aspheres in metals, infrared crystals and plastics are often shaped directly by single-point diamond turning: the part rotates on an air-bearing spindle while a diamond tool follows the aspheric path with nanometre feed resolution; roughness is set by feed and tool-nose radius, and form accuracy by the machine's positioning accuracy and thermal stability. High-volume glass aspheres use precision glass molding instead: a glass preform is heated above its transition temperature, pressed between tungsten-carbide or silicon-carbide molds and cooled slowly; the molds are themselves ground and polished aspheres and must pre-compensate the shrinkage of the glass on cooling and the refractive-index drop caused by the cooling rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Diamond tool and glass mold”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鑽石車削的理論粗糙度 h = f²/(8R_t)：進給 f = 5 µm/rev、刀尖半徑 R_t = 0.5 mm 時 h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV，對應約 2 nm Ra。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The theoretical roughness of diamond turning is h = f²/(8R_t): with feed f = 5 µm/rev and tool-nose radius R_t = 0.5 mm, h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV, roughly 2 nm Ra.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Diamond tool and glass mold”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding" is correct?
options: 模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。
金屬、紅外晶體與塑膠的非球面常以單點鑽石車削直接成形：工件在空氣主軸上旋轉，鑽石刀尖沿非球面軌跡以奈米級解析度進給，表面粗糙度由進給量與刀尖半徑決定，形狀精度由機台的定位精度與熱穩定性決定。
干涉儀的條紋越密，量測資訊越豐富。
optionsEn: Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones.

Aspheres in metals, infrared crystals and plastics are often shaped directly by single-point diamond turning: the part rotates on an air-bearing spindle while a diamond tool follows the aspheric path with nanometre feed resolution.
Denser interferometer fringes carry more measurement information.

quiz.explanationEn: Aspheres in metals, infrared crystals and plastics are often shaped directly by single-point diamond turning: the part rotates on an air-bearing spindle while a diamond tool follows the aspheric path with nanometre feed resolution; roughness is set by feed and tool-nose radius, and form accuracy by the machine's positioning accuracy and thermal stability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diamond tool and glass mold” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鑽石車削的理論粗糙度 h = f²/(8R_t)：進給 f = 5 µm/rev、刀尖半徑 R_t = 0.5 mm 時 h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV，對應約 2 nm Ra。玻璃模造：玻璃 α = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，從 470 °C 冷卻到 20 °C 的線性收縮 8×10⁻⁶×450 = 0.36%，口徑 10 mm 的鏡片縮小 36 µm，模具必須按此放大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The theoretical roughness of diamond turning is h = f²/(8R_t): with feed f = 5 µm/rev and tool-nose radius R_t = 0.5 mm, h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV, roughly 2 nm Ra. For glass molding, a glass with α = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ cooled from 470 °C to 20 °C shrinks linearly by 8×10⁻⁶×450 = 0.36%, so a 10 mm lens contracts by 36 µm and the mold must be scaled up accordingly. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：車削件以白光干涉顯微鏡量粗糙度並與 f²/(8R_t) 比較，差異大表示刀尖磨損或主軸振動；模造件則量第一批成品的面形與設計差，把誤差反向補償到模具再做第二批，確認收縮與折射率變化的補償收斂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the roughness of turned parts with a white-light interference microscope and compare with f²/(8R_t), where a large discrepancy indicates tool wear or spindle vibration; for molded parts, measure the figure error of the first batch against design, feed the inverse error back into the mold and run a second batch to confirm that the shrinkage and index-change compensation converges.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The theoretical roughness of diamond turning is h = f²/(8R_t): with feed f = 5 µm/rev and tool-nose radius R_t = 0.5 mm, h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV, roughly 2 nm Ra. For glass molding, a glass with α = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ cooled from 470 °C to 20 °C shrinks linearly by 8×10⁻⁶×450 = 0.36%, so a 10 mm lens contracts by 36 µm and the mold must be scaled up accordingly.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding", which statement holds?
options: 鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。
非球面只是比較精密的球面，用同樣工法就能做。
鑽石車削的理論粗糙度 h = f²/(8R_t)：進給 f = 5 µm/rev、刀尖半徑 R_t = 0.5 mm 時 h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV，對應約 2 nm Ra。
optionsEn: A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting.
An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way.

quiz.explanation: 鑽石車削的理論粗糙度 h = f²/(8R_t)：進給 f = 5 µm/rev、刀尖半徑 R_t = 0.5 mm 時 h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV，對應約 2 nm Ra。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The theoretical roughness of diamond turning is h = f²/(8R_t): with feed f = 5 µm/rev and tool-nose radius R_t = 0.5 mm, h = 25/(8×500) µm ≈ 6 nm PV, roughly 2 nm Ra. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Diamond tool and glass mold” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 車削件以白光干涉顯微鏡量粗糙度並與 f²/(8R_t) 比較，差異大表示刀尖磨損或主軸振動；模造件則量第一批成品的面形與設計差，把誤差反向補償到模具再做第二批，確認收縮與折射率變化的補償收斂。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the roughness of turned parts with a white-light interference microscope and compare with f²/(8R_t), where a large discrepancy indicates tool wear or spindle vibration; for molded parts, measure the figure error of the first batch against design, feed the inverse error back into the mold and run a second batch to confirm that the shrinkage and index-change compensation converges. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鑽石刀尖在車削矽或鍺時磨損，粗糙度從 2 nm 升到 10 nm 以上，紅外鏡片透過率因散射下降；模造時若脫模溫度過高或模具鍍層劣化，玻璃黏模造成表面缺陷與面形偏差，整批報廢。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Diamond tool wear while turning silicon or germanium raises roughness from 2 nm to over 10 nm and the infrared lens loses transmission to scatter; in molding, releasing at too high a temperature or a degraded mold coating makes the glass stick, producing surface defects and figure deviation that scrap the batch.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 車削件以白光干涉顯微鏡量粗糙度並與 f²/(8R_t) 比較，差異大表示刀尖磨損或主軸振動；模造件則量第一批成品的面形與設計差，把誤差反向補償到模具再做第二批，確認收縮與折射率變化的補償收斂。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the roughness of turned parts with a white-light interference microscope and compare with f²/(8R_t), where a large discrepancy indicates tool wear or spindle vibration; for molded parts, measure the figure error of the first batch against design, feed the inverse error back into the mold and run a second batch to confirm that the shrinkage and index-change compensation converges.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding"?
options: 車削件以白光干涉顯微鏡量粗糙度並與 f²/(8R_t) 比較，差異大表示刀尖磨損或主軸振動。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
PV 與 RMS 合格就代表表面品質合格。
optionsEn: Measure the roughness of turned parts with a white-light interference microscope and compare with f²/(8R_t), where a large discrepancy indicates tool wear or spindle vibration.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing PV and RMS means the surface quality is acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 車削件以白光干涉顯微鏡量粗糙度並與 f²/(8R_t) 比較，差異大表示刀尖磨損或主軸振動；模造件則量第一批成品的面形與設計差，把誤差反向補償到模具再做第二批，確認收縮與折射率變化的補償收斂。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the roughness of turned parts with a white-light interference microscope and compare with f²/(8R_t), where a large discrepancy indicates tool wear or spindle vibration; for molded parts, measure the figure error of the first batch against design, feed the inverse error back into the mold and run a second batch to confirm that the shrinkage and index-change compensation converges. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Diamond tool and glass mold” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鑽石刀尖在車削矽或鍺時磨損，粗糙度從 2 nm 升到 10 nm 以上，紅外鏡片透過率因散射下降；模造時若脫模溫度過高或模具鍍層劣化，玻璃黏模造成表面缺陷與面形偏差，整批報廢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大量生產的玻璃非球面則用精密玻璃模造：玻璃預形體加熱到轉變溫度以上，在碳化鎢或碳化矽模具之間壓製成形後緩慢冷卻；模具本身是以研磨拋光做出的非球面，並且必須預先補償玻璃冷卻收縮與折射率因冷卻速率下降的效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High-volume glass aspheres use precision glass molding instead: a glass preform is heated above its transition temperature, pressed between tungsten-carbide or silicon-carbide molds and cooled slowly; the molds are themselves ground and polished aspheres and must pre-compensate the shrinkage of the glass on cooling and the refractive-index drop caused by the cooling rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鑽石刀尖在車削矽或鍺時磨損，粗糙度從 2 nm 升到 10 nm 以上，紅外鏡片透過率因散射下降；模造時若脫模溫度過高或模具鍍層劣化，玻璃黏模造成表面缺陷與面形偏差，整批報廢。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單點鑽石車削與精密玻璃模造」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Single-point diamond turning and precision glass molding" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鑽石刀尖在車削矽或鍺時磨損，粗糙度從 2 nm 升到 10 nm 以上，紅外鏡片透過率因散射下降。
干涉儀的條紋越密，量測資訊越豐富。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Diamond tool wear while turning silicon or germanium raises roughness from 2 nm to over 10 nm and the infrared lens loses transmission to scatter.

quiz.explanation: 鑽石刀尖在車削矽或鍺時磨損，粗糙度從 2 nm 升到 10 nm 以上，紅外鏡片透過率因散射下降；模造時若脫模溫度過高或模具鍍層劣化，玻璃黏模造成表面缺陷與面形偏差，整批報廢。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Diamond tool wear while turning silicon or germanium raises roughness from 2 nm to over 10 nm and the infrared lens loses transmission to scatter; in molding, releasing at too high a temperature or a degraded mold coating makes the glass stick, producing surface defects and figure deviation that scrap the batch. stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接」與「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching" and "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」如何決定非球面光學加工的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Profilometer stylus and CGH null” determines the key performance of “Aspheric-optics manufacturing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非球面與球面參考波前干涉時，條紋密度由偏離斜率決定，超過相機解析度就無法量測，因此需要讓參考波前變成非球面的零位元件：電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生設計波前，或用折射式零位鏡；另一條路是不做零位而用次口徑拼接或傾斜波干涉儀。接觸式與光學輪廓儀逐點掃描剖面，不受斜率的條紋限制但速度慢、取樣稀，且探針半徑與斜率會產生系統性的量測誤差。工程上通常以輪廓儀做前段加工的量測，以 CGH 干涉做最終驗收。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When an asphere interferes with a spherical reference wavefront the fringe density is set by the departure slope, and beyond the camera's resolution nothing can be measured, so a null element must turn the reference into the aspheric wavefront: a computer-generated hologram (CGH) produces the design wavefront by diffraction, or a refractive null lens does; the alternative is to avoid a null and use subaperture stitching or a tilted-wave interferometer. Contact and optical profilometers scan profiles point by point, free of the fringe limit but slow and sparse, with systematic errors from stylus radius and slope. In practice profilometry serves the early fabrication stages and CGH interferometry the final acceptance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Profilometer stylus and CGH null”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1000 像素相機涵蓋 50 mm 口徑時每像素 50 µm，Nyquist 要求條紋間距至少 100 µm，對應表面斜率上限 λ/(2×100 µm) = 0.633/200 ≈ 3.2 mrad（雙程）；拋物面邊緣 31 mrad 的偏離斜率超出 10 倍，條紋間距只有 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm，必須用 CGH 零位或拼接。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 1000-pixel camera over a 50 mm aperture gives 50 µm per pixel, Nyquist requires fringe spacing of at least 100 µm, corresponding to a surface-slope limit of λ/(2×100 µm) = 0.633/200 ≈ 3.2 mrad in double pass; the paraboloid's 31 mrad edge slope exceeds this tenfold, with fringes only 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm apart, so a CGH null or stitching is mandatory.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「干涉儀的條紋越密，量測資訊越豐富。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Denser interferometer fringes carry more measurement information." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Profilometer stylus and CGH null”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Profilometer stylus and CGH null” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1000 像素相機涵蓋 50 mm 口徑時每像素 50 µm，Nyquist 要求條紋間距至少 100 µm，對應表面斜率上限 λ/(2×100 µm) = 0.633/200 ≈ 3.2 mrad（雙程）；拋物面邊緣 31 mrad 的偏離斜率超出 10 倍，條紋間距只有 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm，必須用 CGH 零位或拼接。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 1000-pixel camera over a 50 mm aperture gives 50 µm per pixel, Nyquist requires fringe spacing of at least 100 µm, corresponding to a surface-slope limit of λ/(2×100 µm) = 0.633/200 ≈ 3.2 mrad in double pass; the paraboloid's 31 mrad edge slope exceeds this tenfold, with fringes only 0.633/(2×0.031) ≈ 10 µm apart, so a CGH null or stitching is mandatory. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 CGH 干涉量得的面形圖與輪廓儀的兩條正交剖面比較，扣除傾斜與離焦後殘差應在兩種方法的不確定度合成值內；另外用 CGH 的對準區確認 CGH 與干涉儀的相對位置，並量測一片已知球面以確認干涉儀本身的參考誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the figure map from CGH interferometry with two orthogonal profilometer traces; after removing tilt and defocus the residual should lie within the combined uncertainty of the two methods; also use the CGH alignment zone to confirm its position relative to the interferometer, and measure a known sphere to establish the interferometer's own reference error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Profilometer stylus and CGH null” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 CGH 干涉量得的面形圖與輪廓儀的兩條正交剖面比較，扣除傾斜與離焦後殘差應在兩種方法的不確定度合成值內；另外用 CGH 的對準區確認 CGH 與干涉儀的相對位置，並量測一片已知球面以確認干涉儀本身的參考誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the figure map from CGH interferometry with two orthogonal profilometer traces; after removing tilt and defocus the residual should lie within the combined uncertainty of the two methods; also use the CGH alignment zone to confirm its position relative to the interferometer, and measure a known sphere to establish the interferometer's own reference error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure; the figuring machine removes it faithfully and spoils a surface that was actually within tolerance, and the next measurement shows coma of the opposite sign.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 CGH 干涉量得的面形圖與輪廓儀的兩條正交剖面比較，扣除傾斜與離焦後殘差應在兩種方法的不確定度合成值內；另外用 CGH 的對準區確認 CGH 與干涉儀的相對位置，並量測一片已知球面以確認干涉儀本身的參考誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the figure map from CGH interferometry with two orthogonal profilometer traces; after removing tilt and defocus the residual should lie within the combined uncertainty of the two methods; also use the CGH alignment zone to confirm its position relative to the interferometer, and measure a known sphere to establish the interferometer's own reference error.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Profilometer stylus and CGH null” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure; the figuring machine removes it faithfully and spoils a surface that was actually within tolerance, and the next measurement shows coma of the opposite sign. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工程上通常以輪廓儀做前段加工的量測，以 CGH 干涉做最終驗收。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In practice profilometry serves the early fabrication stages and CGH interferometry the final acceptance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「干涉儀的條紋越密，量測資訊越豐富。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。
knowledge.textEn: A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure; the figuring machine removes it faithfully and spoils a surface that was actually within tolerance, and the next measurement shows coma of the opposite sign.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。
CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
An asphere with good figure is as easy to centre as a spherical lens.
A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure.
quiz.explanation: CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure; the figuring machine removes it faithfully and spoils a surface that was actually within tolerance, and the next measurement shows coma of the opposite sign. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」如何決定非球面光學加工的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis” determines the key performance of “Aspheric-optics manufacturing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 球面沒有軸，任何通過球心的直線都是對稱軸；非球面卻有唯一的對稱軸，它與鏡片的機械軸（外圓）或另一面的光軸若不重合，整個偏離量分佈就相對光瞳平移，產生與偏心量乘以局部斜率成正比的彗差型表面誤差。因此非球面的誤差預算除了面形、中頻與粗糙度，還要包含非球面軸的偏心與傾斜、中心厚度與頂點位置，這些量在球面鏡片上幾乎不需要關心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sphere has no axis, since any line through its centre is an axis of symmetry; an asphere has a unique symmetry axis, and if it does not coincide with the mechanical axis of the lens edge or the optical axis of the other surface, the whole departure map shifts relative to the pupil, producing a coma-like surface error proportional to decentration times local slope. The error budget of an asphere therefore includes, beyond figure, mid-frequency and roughness, the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis, the centre thickness and the vertex position, quantities that hardly matter for spherical elements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偏離斜率 31 mrad 的邊緣處，非球面軸偏心 δ = 10 µm 造成表面誤差 ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm；折射面乘上 (n − 1) = 0.52 後為 0.16 µm 波前，相當於 633 nm 的 0.25 波，遠超 λ/14。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At the edge where the departure slope is 31 mrad, a decentration of the aspheric axis δ = 10 µm produces a surface error ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm; multiplied by (n − 1) = 0.52 for a refracting surface this is 0.16 µm of wavefront, 0.25 waves at 633 nm, far beyond λ/14.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An asphere with good figure is as easy to centre as a spherical lens." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The error budget of an asphere therefore includes, beyond figure, mid-frequency and roughness, the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis, the centre thickness and the vertex position, quantities that hardly matter for spherical elements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget" is correct?
options: 球面沒有軸，任何通過球心的直線都是對稱軸。
非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。
鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。
optionsEn: A sphere has no axis, since any line through its centre is an axis of symmetry.
An asphere with good figure is as easy to centre as a spherical lens.
A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting.
quiz.explanation: 球面沒有軸，任何通過球心的直線都是對稱軸；非球面卻有唯一的對稱軸，它與鏡片的機械軸（外圓）或另一面的光軸若不重合，整個偏離量分佈就相對光瞳平移，產生與偏心量乘以局部斜率成正比的彗差型表面誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偏離斜率 31 mrad 的邊緣處，非球面軸偏心 δ = 10 µm 造成表面誤差 ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm；折射面乘上 (n − 1) = 0.52 後為 0.16 µm 波前，相當於 633 nm 的 0.25 波，遠超 λ/14。要把此項壓到 0.02 波，偏心必須小於 0.8 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At the edge where the departure slope is 31 mrad, a decentration of the aspheric axis δ = 10 µm produces a surface error ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm; multiplied by (n − 1) = 0.52 for a refracting surface this is 0.16 µm of wavefront, 0.25 waves at 633 nm, far beyond λ/14. To keep this term at 0.02 waves the decentration must be below 0.8 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用對心儀分別量兩面的頂點反射像與非球面的軸（以多環帶反射或干涉法找對稱軸），計算非球面軸對機械軸的偏心與傾斜；再把量到的面形圖以 6 個剛體自由度擬合，確認面形殘差中的彗差項與偏心量乘斜率的預測一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a centring instrument to locate the vertex reflections of both surfaces and the axis of the asphere (finding the symmetry axis from multiple annular reflections or interferometry), compute the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis relative to the mechanical axis; then fit the measured figure map with 6 rigid-body degrees of freedom and confirm that the coma term in the residual matches decentration times slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 偏離斜率 31 mrad 的邊緣處，非球面軸偏心 δ = 10 µm 造成表面誤差 ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm；折射面乘上 (n − 1) = 0.52 後為 0.16 µm 波前，相當於 633 nm 的 0.25 波，遠超 λ/14。要把此項壓到 0.02 波，偏心必須小於 0.8 µm。
knowledge.textEn: At the edge where the departure slope is 31 mrad, a decentration of the aspheric axis δ = 10 µm produces a surface error ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm; multiplied by (n − 1) = 0.52 for a refracting surface this is 0.16 µm of wavefront, 0.25 waves at 633 nm, far beyond λ/14. To keep this term at 0.02 waves the decentration must be below 0.8 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget", which statement holds?
options: 非球面只是比較精密的球面，用同樣工法就能做。
偏離斜率 31 mrad 的邊緣處，非球面軸偏心 δ = 10 µm 造成表面誤差 ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm。
拋光越久表面一定越好。
optionsEn: An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way.
At the edge where the departure slope is 31 mrad, a decentration of the aspheric axis δ = 10 µm produces a surface error ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm.
Longer polishing always yields a better surface.
quiz.explanation: 偏離斜率 31 mrad 的邊緣處，非球面軸偏心 δ = 10 µm 造成表面誤差 ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm；折射面乘上 (n − 1) = 0.52 後為 0.16 µm 波前，相當於 633 nm 的 0.25 波，遠超 λ/14。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At the edge where the departure slope is 31 mrad, a decentration of the aspheric axis δ = 10 µm produces a surface error ≈ 0.031×10 µm = 0.31 µm; multiplied by (n − 1) = 0.52 for a refracting surface this is 0.16 µm of wavefront, 0.25 waves at 633 nm, far beyond λ/14. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用對心儀分別量兩面的頂點反射像與非球面的軸（以多環帶反射或干涉法找對稱軸），計算非球面軸對機械軸的偏心與傾斜；再把量到的面形圖以 6 個剛體自由度擬合，確認面形殘差中的彗差項與偏心量乘斜率的預測一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a centring instrument to locate the vertex reflections of both surfaces and the axis of the asphere (finding the symmetry axis from multiple annular reflections or interferometry), compute the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis relative to the mechanical axis; then fit the measured figure map with 6 rigid-body degrees of freedom and confirm that the coma term in the residual matches decentration times slope. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：修邊時若以球面那一側的光軸為基準，非球面軸對外圓偏心 15 µm，鏡片裝入鏡筒後彗差固定存在且無法用旋轉消除，整個鏡頭的 MTF 在全視場都下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If edging is referenced to the optical axis of the spherical side, the aspheric axis ends up 15 µm off the edge; once mounted, the coma is permanent and cannot be removed by rotation, and the whole lens loses MTF across the field.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用對心儀分別量兩面的頂點反射像與非球面的軸（以多環帶反射或干涉法找對稱軸），計算非球面軸對機械軸的偏心與傾斜；再把量到的面形圖以 6 個剛體自由度擬合，確認面形殘差中的彗差項與偏心量乘斜率的預測一致。
knowledge.textEn: Use a centring instrument to locate the vertex reflections of both surfaces and the axis of the asphere (finding the symmetry axis from multiple annular reflections or interferometry), compute the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis relative to the mechanical axis; then fit the measured figure map with 6 rigid-body degrees of freedom and confirm that the coma term in the residual matches decentration times slope.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。
用對心儀分別量兩面的頂點反射像與非球面的軸（以多環帶反射或干涉法找對稱軸），計算非球面軸對機械軸的偏心與傾斜。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones.

Use a centring instrument to locate the vertex reflections of both surfaces and the axis of the asphere (finding the symmetry axis from multiple annular reflections or interferometry), compute the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis relative to the mechanical axis.

quiz.explanationEn: Use a centring instrument to locate the vertex reflections of both surfaces and the axis of the asphere (finding the symmetry axis from multiple annular reflections or interferometry), compute the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis relative to the mechanical axis; then fit the measured figure map with 6 rigid-body degrees of freedom and confirm that the coma term in the residual matches decentration times slope. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 修邊時若以球面那一側的光軸為基準，非球面軸對外圓偏心 15 µm，鏡片裝入鏡筒後彗差固定存在且無法用旋轉消除，整個鏡頭的 MTF 在全視場都下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If edging is referenced to the optical axis of the spherical side, the aspheric axis ends up 15 µm off the edge; once mounted, the coma is permanent and cannot be removed by rotation, and the whole lens loses MTF across the field. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此非球面的誤差預算除了面形、中頻與粗糙度，還要包含非球面軸的偏心與傾斜、中心厚度與頂點位置，這些量在球面鏡片上幾乎不需要關心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The error budget of an asphere therefore includes, beyond figure, mid-frequency and roughness, the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis, the centre thickness and the vertex position, quantities that hardly matter for spherical elements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An asphere with good figure is as easy to centre as a spherical lens." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 修邊時若以球面那一側的光軸為基準，非球面軸對外圓偏心 15 µm，鏡片裝入鏡筒後彗差固定存在且無法用旋轉消除，整個鏡頭的 MTF 在全視場都下降。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。
optionsEn: If edging is referenced to the optical axis of the spherical side, the aspheric axis ends up 15 µm off the edge.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting.

quiz.explanationEn: If edging is referenced to the optical axis of the spherical side, the aspheric axis ends up 15 µm off the edge; once mounted, the coma is permanent and cannot be removed by rotation, and the whole lens loses MTF across the field. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性」與「非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability" and "Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」如何決定非球面光學加工的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Barrel interface and thermal expansion” determines the key performance of “Aspheric-optics manufacturing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非球面鏡片裝入鏡筒時以邊緣與斜面定位，夾持力與黏著劑收縮都可能把面形壓變形；材料的選擇決定熱穩定性：玻璃的 dn/dT 與熱膨脹都很小，塑膠的 dn/dT 為負且數量級大一百倍，模造玻璃居中。整合時要用熱光系數估算焦距隨溫度的漂移，並決定是否需要被動無熱化（混合不同材料）或主動對焦。鏡筒材料的膨脹也會改變鏡片間距，與鏡片本身的效應同時計入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An asphere is located in its barrel by its edge and a bevel, and clamping force or adhesive shrinkage can distort the figure; the material choice sets thermal stability, since glass has small dn/dT and expansion, plastic has a negative dn/dT a hundred times larger, and molded glass lies between. Integration uses the thermo-optic coefficients to estimate focal-length drift with temperature and to decide whether passive athermalisation by mixing materials or active focusing is needed. Barrel-material expansion also changes element spacing and must be counted together with the elements themselves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Barrel interface and thermal expansion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：焦距溫度漂移 Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Focal drift with temperature is Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Barrel interface and thermal expansion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性
knowledge.titleEn: Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability
knowledge.text: 非球面鏡片裝入鏡筒時以邊緣與斜面定位，夾持力與黏著劑收縮都可能把面形壓變形；材料的選擇決定熱穩定性：玻璃的 dn/dT 與熱膨脹都很小，塑膠的 dn/dT 為負且數量級大一百倍，模造玻璃居中。整合時要用熱光系數估算焦距隨溫度的漂移，並決定是否需要被動無熱化（混合不同材料）或主動對焦。
knowledge.textEn: An asphere is located in its barrel by its edge and a bevel, and clamping force or adhesive shrinkage can distort the figure; the material choice sets thermal stability, since glass has small dn/dT and expansion, plastic has a negative dn/dT a hundred times larger, and molded glass lies between. Integration uses the thermo-optic coefficients to estimate focal-length drift with temperature and to decide whether passive athermalisation by mixing materials or active focusing is needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability" is correct?
options: 鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。
非球面鏡片裝入鏡筒時以邊緣與斜面定位，夾持力與黏著劑收縮都可能把面形壓變形。
量測儀器的解析度就是量測不確定度。
optionsEn: A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting.
An asphere is located in its barrel by its edge and a bevel, and clamping force or adhesive shrinkage can distort the figure.
An instrument's resolution equals its measurement uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 非球面鏡片裝入鏡筒時以邊緣與斜面定位，夾持力與黏著劑收縮都可能把面形壓變形；材料的選擇決定熱穩定性：玻璃的 dn/dT 與熱膨脹都很小，塑膠的 dn/dT 為負且數量級大一百倍，模造玻璃居中。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An asphere is located in its barrel by its edge and a bevel, and clamping force or adhesive shrinkage can distort the figure; the material choice sets thermal stability, since glass has small dn/dT and expansion, plastic has a negative dn/dT a hundred times larger, and molded glass lies between. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Barrel interface and thermal expansion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：焦距溫度漂移 Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1)。塑膠非球面 dn/dT = −1×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、α = 7×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹、n = 1.49：Δf/f = 7×10⁻⁵ + 1×10⁻⁴/0.49 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹，f = 10 mm 升溫 20 K 漂移 54 µm；玻璃 dn/dT = 2×10⁻⁶、α = 7×10⁻⁶、n = 1.52：Δf/f ≈ 3.2×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，同條件僅 0.6 µm，相差約 90 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Focal drift with temperature is Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1). A plastic asphere with dn/dT = −1×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, α = 7×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ and n = 1.49 gives Δf/f = 7×10⁻⁵ + 1×10⁻⁴/0.49 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, so f = 10 mm drifts 54 µm for a 20 K rise; a glass with dn/dT = 2×10⁻⁶, α = 7×10⁻⁶ and n = 1.52 gives Δf/f ≈ 3.2×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, only 0.6 µm under the same conditions, about 90 times less. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把組裝好的鏡組放入溫控箱，在 0 到 40 °C 之間每 10 K 量一次最佳焦面位置與波前，擬合焦距對溫度的斜率並與熱光模型比較；同時在鏡片裝入前後各量一次面形，確認夾持與黏著引起的面形變化小於預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the assembled lens in a thermal chamber and measure best-focus position and wavefront every 10 K from 0 to 40 °C, fit the slope of focal length against temperature and compare with the thermo-optic model; also measure figure before and after mounting to confirm that clamping and adhesive distortion stay within budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 焦距溫度漂移 Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1)。塑膠非球面 dn/dT = −1×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、α = 7×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹、n = 1.49：Δf/f = 7×10⁻⁵ + 1×10⁻⁴/0.49 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹，f = 10 mm 升溫 20 K 漂移 54 µm；玻璃 dn/dT = 2×10⁻⁶、α = 7×10⁻⁶、n = 1.52：Δf/f ≈ 3.2×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹，同條件僅 0.6 µm，相差約 90 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Focal drift with temperature is Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1). A plastic asphere with dn/dT = −1×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, α = 7×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ and n = 1.49 gives Δf/f = 7×10⁻⁵ + 1×10⁻⁴/0.49 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, so f = 10 mm drifts 54 µm for a 20 K rise; a glass with dn/dT = 2×10⁻⁶, α = 7×10⁻⁶ and n = 1.52 gives Δf/f ≈ 3.2×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, only 0.6 µm under the same conditions, about 90 times less.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability", which statement holds?
options: PV 與 RMS 合格就代表表面品質合格。
模造鏡片與拋光鏡片的折射率完全相同。
焦距溫度漂移 Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1)。
optionsEn: Passing PV and RMS means the surface quality is acceptable.
Molded lenses have exactly the same refractive index as polished ones.
Focal drift with temperature is Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1).
quiz.explanation: 焦距溫度漂移 Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Focal drift with temperature is Δf/f ≈ α − (dn/dT)/(n − 1). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Barrel interface and thermal expansion” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把組裝好的鏡組放入溫控箱，在 0 到 40 °C 之間每 10 K 量一次最佳焦面位置與波前，擬合焦距對溫度的斜率並與熱光模型比較；同時在鏡片裝入前後各量一次面形，確認夾持與黏著引起的面形變化小於預算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place the assembled lens in a thermal chamber and measure best-focus position and wavefront every 10 K from 0 to 40 °C, fit the slope of focal length against temperature and compare with the thermo-optic model; also measure figure before and after mounting to confirm that clamping and adhesive distortion stay within budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：塑膠非球面在車用鏡頭中經歷 −40 到 85 °C 的溫差，焦點漂移數百微米，若鏡組未無熱化，影像在冬夏兩季都失焦，而室溫下的驗收測試完全合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A plastic asphere in an automotive lens sees −40 to 85 °C, drifting focus by hundreds of micrometres; without athermalisation the image is out of focus in both winter and summer, although the room-temperature acceptance test passed completely.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把組裝好的鏡組放入溫控箱，在 0 到 40 °C 之間每 10 K 量一次最佳焦面位置與波前，擬合焦距對溫度的斜率並與熱光模型比較；同時在鏡片裝入前後各量一次面形，確認夾持與黏著引起的面形變化小於預算。
knowledge.textEn: Place the assembled lens in a thermal chamber and measure best-focus position and wavefront every 10 K from 0 to 40 °C, fit the slope of focal length against temperature and compare with the thermo-optic model; also measure figure before and after mounting to confirm that clamping and adhesive distortion stay within budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability"?
options: 把組裝好的鏡組放入溫控箱，在 0 到 40 °C 之間每 10 K 量一次最佳焦面位置與波前，擬合焦距對溫度的斜率並與熱光模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
干涉儀的條紋越密，量測資訊越豐富。
optionsEn: Place the assembled lens in a thermal chamber and measure best-focus position and wavefront every 10 K from 0 to 40 °C, fit the slope of focal length against temperature and compare with the thermo-optic model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Denser interferometer fringes carry more measurement information.
quiz.explanation: 把組裝好的鏡組放入溫控箱，在 0 到 40 °C 之間每 10 K 量一次最佳焦面位置與波前，擬合焦距對溫度的斜率並與熱光模型比較；同時在鏡片裝入前後各量一次面形，確認夾持與黏著引起的面形變化小於預算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place the assembled lens in a thermal chamber and measure best-focus position and wavefront every 10 K from 0 to 40 °C, fit the slope of focal length against temperature and compare with the thermo-optic model; also measure figure before and after mounting to confirm that clamping and adhesive distortion stay within budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Barrel interface and thermal expansion” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 塑膠非球面在車用鏡頭中經歷 −40 到 85 °C 的溫差，焦點漂移數百微米，若鏡組未無熱化，影像在冬夏兩季都失焦，而室溫下的驗收測試完全合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A plastic asphere in an automotive lens sees −40 to 85 °C, drifting focus by hundreds of micrometres; without athermalisation the image is out of focus in both winter and summer, although the room-temperature acceptance test passed completely. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鏡筒材料的膨脹也會改變鏡片間距，與鏡片本身的效應同時計入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Barrel-material expansion also changes element spacing and must be counted together with the elements themselves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡片面形合格，安裝後面形不會改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lens with good figure keeps that figure after mounting." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 塑膠非球面在車用鏡頭中經歷 −40 到 85 °C 的溫差，焦點漂移數百微米，若鏡組未無熱化，影像在冬夏兩季都失焦，而室溫下的驗收測試完全合格。
knowledge.textEn: A plastic asphere in an automotive lens sees −40 to 85 °C, drifting focus by hundreds of micrometres; without athermalisation the image is out of focus in both winter and summer, although the room-temperature acceptance test passed completely.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝、材料熱特性與環境穩定性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mounting, material thermal behaviour and environmental stability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
塑膠非球面在車用鏡頭中經歷 −40 到 85 °C 的溫差，焦點漂移數百微米，若鏡組未無熱化，影像在冬夏兩季都失焦，而室溫下的驗收測試完全合格。
量測儀器的解析度就是量測不確定度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A plastic asphere in an automotive lens sees −40 to 85 °C, drifting focus by hundreds of micrometres.
An instrument's resolution equals its measurement uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 塑膠非球面在車用鏡頭中經歷 −40 到 85 °C 的溫差，焦點漂移數百微米，若鏡組未無熱化，影像在冬夏兩季都失焦，而室溫下的驗收測試完全合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A plastic asphere in an automotive lens sees −40 to 85 °C, drifting focus by hundreds of micrometres; without athermalisation the image is out of focus in both winter and summer, although the room-temperature acceptance test passed completely. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度」如何決定非球面光學加工的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty” determines the key performance of “Aspheric-optics manufacturing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非球面的圖面依 ISO 10110 系列標示：非球面方程與係數、面形公差（PV、RMS 與斜率）、中頻 PSD 或帶限 RMS、粗糙度、對心公差與中心厚度，每一項都要指明量測方法與去除的擬合項（例如扣除傾斜與離焦）。驗收報告要附上量測不確定度，依慣例量測不確定度應小於公差的四分之一（量測比 4:1）；達不到時需要改進量測或用兩種獨立方法交叉驗證。交接文件還要包含實測的矢高表或面形圖檔，供光學設計做「實測重最佳化」。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asphere drawings follow the ISO 10110 series: the aspheric equation and coefficients, figure tolerance (PV, RMS and slope), mid-frequency PSD or band-limited RMS, roughness, centring tolerance and centre thickness, each with its measurement method and the fitted terms removed (for example tilt and defocus). The acceptance report must state measurement uncertainty, which by convention should be below a quarter of the tolerance (a 4:1 test-uncertainty ratio); when that cannot be reached, the metrology must improve or two independent methods must cross-validate. The handoff package also includes the measured sag table or figure map so the optical designer can re-optimise with as-built data. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面形公差 25 nm RMS 時，4:1 量測比要求不確定度 ≤ 6 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 25 nm RMS figure tolerance, a 4:1 ratio requires uncertainty ≤ 6 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量測儀器的解析度就是量測不確定度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An instrument's resolution equals its measurement uncertainty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
