steps.title: 非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面形公差 25 nm RMS 時，4:1 量測比要求不確定度 ≤ 6 nm。CGH 測試的不確定度預算：CGH 基板面形 10 nm、圖樣定位誤差 0.1 µm 對 10 µm 線距產生 λ/100 ≈ 6 nm、對準 5 nm、干涉儀參考 5 nm，RSS = √(100+36+25+25) ≈ 13.6 nm，量測比僅 1.8:1，必須改用更好的基板或扣除已校正的基板誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 25 nm RMS figure tolerance, a 4:1 ratio requires uncertainty ≤ 6 nm. A CGH test uncertainty budget: CGH substrate figure 10 nm, pattern placement error of 0.1 µm on 10 µm line spacing giving λ/100 ≈ 6 nm, alignment 5 nm and interferometer reference 5 nm give RSS = √(100+36+25+25) ≈ 13.6 nm, a ratio of only 1.8:1, so a better substrate or subtraction of the calibrated substrate error is needed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項建立量測不確定度預算並以已校正的參考件（球面或已知非球面）驗證；把 CGH 干涉與輪廓儀的結果相減，差異的 RMS 應接近兩者不確定度的合成值；核對圖面每一項規格在報告中都有對應的量測值、方法與擬合項說明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the uncertainty budget term by term and validate it with calibrated reference parts (a sphere or a known asphere); subtract the CGH-interferometric and profilometer results, where the RMS of the difference should approach the combined uncertainty; check that every specification on the drawing has a corresponding measured value, method and fitted-term statement in the report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A CGH test uncertainty budget: CGH substrate figure 10 nm, pattern placement error of 0.1 µm on 10 µm line spacing giving λ/100 ≈ 6 nm, alignment 5 nm and interferometer reference 5 nm give RSS = √(100+36+25+25) ≈ 13.6 nm, a ratio of only 1.8:1, so a better substrate or subtraction of the calibrated substrate error is needed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐項建立量測不確定度預算並以已校正的參考件（球面或已知非球面）驗證；把 CGH 干涉與輪廓儀的結果相減，差異的 RMS 應接近兩者不確定度的合成值；核對圖面每一項規格在報告中都有對應的量測值、方法與擬合項說明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the uncertainty budget term by term and validate it with calibrated reference parts (a sphere or a known asphere); subtract the CGH-interferometric and profilometer results, where the RMS of the difference should approach the combined uncertainty; check that every specification on the drawing has a corresponding measured value, method and fitted-term statement in the report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：報告只寫「面形 20 nm RMS 合格」而未註明扣除了哪些項與量測不確定度，客戶用不同的擬合方式重算得到 40 nm，雙方對同一片鏡片各執一詞，交期因重測與爭議延後數週。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A report stating only that figure is 20 nm RMS and compliant, without naming the removed terms or the uncertainty, lets the customer recompute 40 nm with a different fit, both sides defend their number for the same lens, and delivery slips by weeks of retesting and dispute.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項建立量測不確定度預算並以已校正的參考件（球面或已知非球面）驗證；把 CGH 干涉與輪廓儀的結果相減，差異的 RMS 應接近兩者不確定度的合成值；核對圖面每一項規格在報告中都有對應的量測值、方法與擬合項說明。
knowledge.textEn: Build the uncertainty budget term by term and validate it with calibrated reference parts (a sphere or a known asphere); subtract the CGH-interferometric and profilometer results, where the RMS of the difference should approach the combined uncertainty; check that every specification on the drawing has a corresponding measured value, method and fitted-term statement in the report.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
逐項建立量測不確定度預算並以已校正的參考件（球面或已知非球面）驗證。
非球面鏡片只要面形合格，對心和球面鏡一樣容易。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Build the uncertainty budget term by term and validate it with calibrated reference parts (a sphere or a known asphere).
An asphere with good figure is as easy to centre as a spherical lens.
quiz.explanation: 逐項建立量測不確定度預算並以已校正的參考件（球面或已知非球面）驗證；把 CGH 干涉與輪廓儀的結果相減，差異的 RMS 應接近兩者不確定度的合成值；核對圖面每一項規格在報告中都有對應的量測值、方法與擬合項說明。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the uncertainty budget term by term and validate it with calibrated reference parts (a sphere or a known asphere); subtract the CGH-interferometric and profilometer results, where the RMS of the difference should approach the combined uncertainty; check that every specification on the drawing has a corresponding measured value, method and fitted-term statement in the report. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 報告只寫「面形 20 nm RMS 合格」而未註明扣除了哪些項與量測不確定度，客戶用不同的擬合方式重算得到 40 nm，雙方對同一片鏡片各執一詞，交期因重測與爭議延後數週。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A report stating only that figure is 20 nm RMS and compliant, without naming the removed terms or the uncertainty, lets the customer recompute 40 nm with a different fit, both sides defend their number for the same lens, and delivery slips by weeks of retesting and dispute. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件還要包含實測的矢高表或面形圖檔，供光學設計做「實測重最佳化」。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package also includes the measured sag table or figure map so the optical designer can re-optimise with as-built data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量測儀器的解析度就是量測不確定度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An instrument's resolution equals its measurement uncertainty." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 報告只寫「面形 20 nm RMS 合格」而未註明扣除了哪些項與量測不確定度，客戶用不同的擬合方式重算得到 40 nm，雙方對同一片鏡片各執一詞，交期因重測與爭議延後數週。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

An asphere is just a more precise sphere and can be made the same way.

title: 自由曲面光學量測
summary: 以一片口徑 50 mm、對最佳擬合球面偏離 200 µm、最大斜率 20 mrad 的自由曲面反射鏡為案例：先說明無對稱軸的表面為何讓六個剛體自由度與面形誤差糾纏，必須靠基準與定位標記配準；再比較 CGH 零位干涉、傾斜波非零位干涉、接觸與光學探針輪廓儀及次口徑拼接的物理限制，建立含 CGH 寫入誤差、基板、回溯誤差與熱漂移的不確定度預算，最後以兩種獨立方法交叉驗證並把量測圖回饋到確定性修形與實測重最佳化。
summaryEn: Using a 50 mm freeform mirror with 200 µm departure from its best-fit sphere and 20 mrad maximum slope as the case, the course first shows why a surface without a symmetry axis entangles the six rigid-body degrees of freedom with form error and must be registered through datums and fiducials; it then compares the physical limits of CGH null interferometry, tilted-wave non-null interferometry, contact and optical probe profilometry and subaperture stitching, builds an uncertainty budget covering CGH writing error, substrate, retrace error and thermal drift, and closes by cross-validating two independent methods and feeding the map back into deterministic figuring and as-built re-optimisation.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 自由曲面 CGH 量測練習：鏡面口徑 50 mm、最大斜率 20 mrad、公差 20 nm RMS。雙程波前斜率 40 mrad，CGH 局部線距 0.633/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm；寫入機定位誤差 50 nm 產生 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 波 ≈ 2 nm 波前，即 1 nm 表面，取保守值 2 nm。基板面形已量測並扣除，殘留 3 nm；對準與回溯 3 nm；參考面 2 nm；熱漂移 2 nm（鋁鏡矢高 5 mm、0.02 K 對應 2.3 nm）；雜訊 1 nm。RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，量測比 20/5.6 ≈ 3.6:1。配準：三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各 1 µm 不確定度 → 10 µrad 轉動 → 半口徑 25 mm 處 0.25 µm → 乘 20 mrad 得 5 nm，仍在預算內。交叉驗證：輪廓儀不確定度 8 nm，差異圖期望 RMS √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異 25 nm，先檢查探針半徑補償（20 mrad 處 100 nm 的高度修正）與 Y 軸方向約定。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Freeform CGH metrology exercise: mirror aperture 50 mm, maximum slope 20 mrad, tolerance 20 nm RMS. The double-pass wavefront slope is 40 mrad, so the CGH local line spacing is 0.633/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm; a writer placement error of 50 nm gives 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 waves ≈ 2 nm of wavefront, i.e. 1 nm of surface, taken conservatively as 2 nm. The substrate figure is measured and subtracted, leaving 3 nm; alignment and retrace 3 nm; reference surface 2 nm; thermal drift 2 nm (an aluminium mirror with 5 mm sag at 0.02 K gives 2.3 nm); noise 1 nm. RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of 20/5.6 ≈ 3.6:1. Registration: three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline at 1 µm each give 10 µrad of clocking, 0.25 µm at the 25 mm half-aperture, which times 20 mrad is 5 nm, still within budget. Cross-validation: the profilometer uncertainty is 8 nm, so the expected RMS of the difference map is √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; if the measured difference is 25 nm, first check the probe-radius compensation (a 100 nm height correction at 20 mrad) and the Y-axis sign convention. All values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」與「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom" and "Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「自由曲面定義與基準座標」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Freeform definition and datum frame” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由曲面是沒有旋轉對稱軸的光學面，通常以圓錐基面加上 XY 多項式或 Zernike 項描述，用於離軸反射系統、頭戴顯示與光束整形。量測的對象不是「面」本身，而是面相對於設計座標系的誤差：球面或旋轉對稱非球面可以靠對稱性消去部分剛體自由度，自由曲面卻讓平移、傾斜與繞軸轉動（clocking）六個自由度都和面形誤差混在一起。沒有基準面與定位標記，量到的誤差圖只是某個最佳擬合下的殘差，與設計師在系統中需要的誤差並不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A freeform is an optical surface without a rotational symmetry axis, usually described by a conic base plus XY polynomial or Zernike terms, and used in off-axis reflective systems, head-mounted displays and beam shaping. The measurand is not the surface itself but its error relative to the design coordinate frame: spheres and rotationally symmetric aspheres let symmetry eliminate some rigid-body degrees of freedom, whereas a freeform entangles all six, translation, tilt and clocking, with form error. Without datum surfaces and fiducials the measured map is only a residual under some best fit, not the error the designer needs in the system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Freeform definition and datum frame”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Freeform definition and datum frame”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The measurand is not the surface itself but its error relative to the design coordinate frame: spheres and rotationally symmetric aspheres let symmetry eliminate some rigid-body degrees of freedom, whereas a freeform entangles all six, translation, tilt and clocking, with form error.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom" is correct?
options: 自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。
自由曲面是沒有旋轉對稱軸的光學面，通常以圓錐基面加上 XY 多項式或 Zernike 項描述，用於離軸反射系統、頭戴顯示與光束整形。
非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。

A freeform is an optical surface without a rotational symmetry axis, usually described by a conic base plus XY polynomial or Zernike terms, and used in off-axis reflective systems, head-mounted displays and beam shaping.

quiz.explanation: 自由曲面是沒有旋轉對稱軸的光學面，通常以圓錐基面加上 XY 多項式或 Zernike 項描述，用於離軸反射系統、頭戴顯示與光束整形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A freeform is an optical surface without a rotational symmetry axis, usually described by a conic base plus XY polynomial or Zernike terms, and used in off-axis reflective systems, head-mounted displays and beam shaping. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Freeform definition and datum frame” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。若目標量測不確定度為 5 nm RMS，橫向配準必須優於約 0.2 µm、角度配準優於約 2 µrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm. For a target uncertainty of 5 nm RMS, lateral registration must be better than about 0.2 µm and angular registration better than about 2 µrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。若目標量測不確定度為 5 nm RMS，橫向配準必須優於約 0.2 µm、角度配準優於約 2 µrad。
knowledge.textEn: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm. For a target uncertainty of 5 nm RMS, lateral registration must be better than about 0.2 µm and angular registration better than about 2 µrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom", which statement holds?
options: 接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。
量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。
面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差。
optionsEn: A contact probe reads the surface height directly.
Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty.
Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error.
quiz.explanation: 面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「自由曲面定義與基準座標」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Freeform definition and datum frame” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。
knowledge.textEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom"?
options: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。
optionsEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials.
quiz.explanation: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Freeform definition and datum frame” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沒有基準面與定位標記，量到的誤差圖只是某個最佳擬合下的殘差，與設計師在系統中需要的誤差並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without datum surfaces and fiducials the measured map is only a residual under some best fit, not the error the designer needs in the system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CGH line spacing and retrace error” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀只能解析條紋間距大於兩個像素的區域，自由曲面對參考波前的斜率差讓條紋在大部分區域過密，因此有兩條路：零位測試用電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生與設計表面完全匹配的波前，條紋只反映誤差；非零位測試如傾斜波干涉儀用一組傾斜的點光源，使每個局部區域至少有一個光源的條紋可解析，再用已校正的光線追跡模型扣除非共路的回溯誤差。零位測試精度高但 CGH 專用於一個設計；非零位測試通用但依賴儀器模型的完整校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An interferometer resolves only regions where fringe spacing exceeds two pixels, and a freeform's slope difference from the reference wavefront makes fringes too dense almost everywhere, leaving two routes: a null test uses a computer-generated hologram (CGH) that diffracts a wavefront exactly matching the design surface so that fringes show only error, while a non-null test such as the tilted-wave interferometer uses an array of tilted point sources so that every local region has at least one source with resolvable fringes, then removes the non-common-path retrace error with a calibrated ray-trace model of the instrument. Null tests are the most accurate but each CGH serves one design; non-null tests are general but depend on a fully calibrated instrument model. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CGH line spacing and retrace error”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CGH line spacing and retrace error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CGH line spacing and retrace error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。寫入機的圖樣定位誤差 50 nm 造成相位誤差 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 波，即約 2 nm 波前、1 nm 表面；定位誤差 0.5 µm 則變成 10 nm 表面誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test. A writer placement error of 50 nm gives a phase error of 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 waves, about 2 nm of wavefront or 1 nm of surface; a 0.5 µm placement error would become 10 nm of surface error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget; for a non-null instrument, measure a set of known spheres and flats, compare the retrace error predicted by the model with measurement, and recalibrate the model parameters when the residual exceeds budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

More subapertures always make the stitched result more accurate.

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CGH line spacing and retrace error” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget; for a non-null instrument, measure a set of known spheres and flats, compare the retrace error predicted by the model with measurement, and recalibrate the model parameters when the residual exceeds budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.instruction: 傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.observation: 連結機制：零位測試精度高但 CGH 專用於一個設計；非零位測試通用但依賴儀器模型的完整校正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Null tests are the most accurate but each CGH serves one design; non-null tests are general but depend on a fully calibrated instrument model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 傾斜波干涉儀的模型若未納入準直鏡的實際像差，回溯誤差扣除不完整，所有量測結果都帶有同樣的低階系統誤差，不同鏡子看起來有相同的像散圖樣而被誤認為加工問題。
knowledge.textEn: If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected.

If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication.

quiz.explanationEn: If the tilted-wave model omits the real aberration of its collimator, retrace error is incompletely removed, every measurement carries the same low-order systematic error, and different mirrors appear to share one astigmatism pattern that is wrongly blamed on fabrication. stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差」與「接觸與光學探針輪廓量測的物理限制」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error" and "Physical limits of contact and optical probe profiling": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: CGH 是在熔融石英基板上以電子束或雷射直寫的繞射圖樣，振幅型以鉻膜遮光，相位型以蝕刻深度產生 π 相位差，效率差四倍；設計時加入載波傾斜使主測量級次與其他級次在像面上分離，避免鬼像干涉。基板本身的面形與厚度不均勻會直接疊加在測量波前上，必須事先量測並扣除；CGH 上另外寫入對準區，用回射或貓眼圖樣讓 CGH 相對干涉儀的位置與傾斜能被獨立確認。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A CGH is a diffractive pattern written by electron beam or laser on a fused-silica substrate; amplitude types block light with chrome, phase types etch a depth giving a π phase difference and are four times more efficient. A carrier tilt is added in the design so the measurement order separates from the other orders at the image plane and ghost interference is avoided. The substrate's own figure and thickness variation add directly to the measured wavefront and must be measured beforehand and subtracted; an alignment zone written on the CGH returns a retro or cat's-eye pattern so the CGH position and tilt relative to the interferometer can be confirmed independently. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：二元振幅 CGH 的一階效率為 1/π² ≈ 10.1%，蝕刻至 π 相位的二元相位 CGH 為 4/π² ≈ 40.5%；雙程通過後回傳功率比例為效率的平方，分別約 1.0% 與 16.4%，相位型的訊號強度高 16 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A binary amplitude CGH has a first-order efficiency of 1/π² ≈ 10.1%, a binary phase CGH etched to π has 4/π² ≈ 40.5%; after double pass the returned power scales with the square of efficiency, about 1.0% versus 16.4%, so the phase type delivers 16 times the signal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差
knowledge.titleEn: CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error
knowledge.text: CGH 是在熔融石英基板上以電子束或雷射直寫的繞射圖樣，振幅型以鉻膜遮光，相位型以蝕刻深度產生 π 相位差，效率差四倍；設計時加入載波傾斜使主測量級次與其他級次在像面上分離，避免鬼像干涉。基板本身的面形與厚度不均勻會直接疊加在測量波前上，必須事先量測並扣除；CGH 上另外寫入對準區，用回射或貓眼圖樣讓 CGH 相對干涉儀的位置與傾斜能被獨立確認。
knowledge.textEn: A CGH is a diffractive pattern written by electron beam or laser on a fused-silica substrate; amplitude types block light with chrome, phase types etch a depth giving a π phase difference and are four times more efficient. A carrier tilt is added in the design so the measurement order separates from the other orders at the image plane and ghost interference is avoided.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error" is correct?
options: CGH 是在熔融石英基板上以電子束或雷射直寫的繞射圖樣，振幅型以鉻膜遮光，相位型以蝕刻深度產生 π 相位差，效率差四倍。
CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。
接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。
optionsEn: A CGH is a diffractive pattern written by electron beam or laser on a fused-silica substrate.
A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected.
A contact probe reads the surface height directly.
quiz.explanation: CGH 是在熔融石英基板上以電子束或雷射直寫的繞射圖樣，振幅型以鉻膜遮光，相位型以蝕刻深度產生 π 相位差，效率差四倍；設計時加入載波傾斜使主測量級次與其他級次在像面上分離，避免鬼像干涉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：二元振幅 CGH 的一階效率為 1/π² ≈ 10.1%，蝕刻至 π 相位的二元相位 CGH 為 4/π² ≈ 40.5%；雙程通過後回傳功率比例為效率的平方，分別約 1.0% 與 16.4%，相位型的訊號強度高 16 倍。基板面形若已量得 5 nm RMS 且不確定度 2 nm，扣除後只剩 2 nm 進入預算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A binary amplitude CGH has a first-order efficiency of 1/π² ≈ 10.1%, a binary phase CGH etched to π has 4/π² ≈ 40.5%; after double pass the returned power scales with the square of efficiency, about 1.0% versus 16.4%, so the phase type delivers 16 times the signal. If the substrate figure is measured as 5 nm RMS with 2 nm uncertainty, only 2 nm enters the budget after subtraction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以功率計量測零級與一級的回傳光強，確認效率與鬼像抑制符合設計；在干涉儀上先只裝 CGH 的對準區，調整到回射條紋為零後記錄位置，再以同一 CGH 量測一片已知的參考球面，核對殘差是否等於基板誤差扣除後的預期值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the returned power in the zeroth and first orders with a power meter to confirm efficiency and ghost suppression match the design; mount only the CGH alignment zone on the interferometer first, adjust until the retro fringes null and record the position, then measure a known reference sphere with the same CGH to check that the residual equals the expectation after substrate subtraction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 二元振幅 CGH 的一階效率為 1/π² ≈ 10.1%，蝕刻至 π 相位的二元相位 CGH 為 4/π² ≈ 40.5%；雙程通過後回傳功率比例為效率的平方，分別約 1.0% 與 16.4%，相位型的訊號強度高 16 倍。基板面形若已量得 5 nm RMS 且不確定度 2 nm，扣除後只剩 2 nm 進入預算。
knowledge.textEn: A binary amplitude CGH has a first-order efficiency of 1/π² ≈ 10.1%, a binary phase CGH etched to π has 4/π² ≈ 40.5%; after double pass the returned power scales with the square of efficiency, about 1.0% versus 16.4%, so the phase type delivers 16 times the signal. If the substrate figure is measured as 5 nm RMS with 2 nm uncertainty, only 2 nm enters the budget after subtraction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error", which statement holds?
options: 量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。
二元振幅 CGH 的一階效率為 1/π² ≈ 10.1%，蝕刻至 π 相位的二元相位 CGH 為 4/π² ≈ 40.5%。
兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。
optionsEn: Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty.
A binary amplitude CGH has a first-order efficiency of 1/π² ≈ 10.1%, a binary phase CGH etched to π has 4/π² ≈ 40.5%.
When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate.
quiz.explanation: 二元振幅 CGH 的一階效率為 1/π² ≈ 10.1%，蝕刻至 π 相位的二元相位 CGH 為 4/π² ≈ 40.5%；雙程通過後回傳功率比例為效率的平方，分別約 1.0% 與 16.4%，相位型的訊號強度高 16 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A binary amplitude CGH has a first-order efficiency of 1/π² ≈ 10.1%, a binary phase CGH etched to π has 4/π² ≈ 40.5%; after double pass the returned power scales with the square of efficiency, about 1.0% versus 16.4%, so the phase type delivers 16 times the signal. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以功率計量測零級與一級的回傳光強，確認效率與鬼像抑制符合設計；在干涉儀上先只裝 CGH 的對準區，調整到回射條紋為零後記錄位置，再以同一 CGH 量測一片已知的參考球面，核對殘差是否等於基板誤差扣除後的預期值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the returned power in the zeroth and first orders with a power meter to confirm efficiency and ghost suppression match the design; mount only the CGH alignment zone on the interferometer first, adjust until the retro fringes null and record the position, then measure a known reference sphere with the same CGH to check that the residual equals the expectation after substrate subtraction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：蝕刻深度若偏離 π 相位 10%，零級殘留光增強並與一級形成鬼像條紋，面形圖出現與線距相關的週期性假紋，量測重複性從 1 nm 惡化到 5 nm 以上。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the etch depth departs from π by 10%, residual zeroth-order light grows and forms ghost fringes with the first order, the figure map shows periodic artefacts tied to the line spacing, and repeatability degrades from 1 nm to over 5 nm.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以功率計量測零級與一級的回傳光強，確認效率與鬼像抑制符合設計；在干涉儀上先只裝 CGH 的對準區，調整到回射條紋為零後記錄位置，再以同一 CGH 量測一片已知的參考球面，核對殘差是否等於基板誤差扣除後的預期值。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the returned power in the zeroth and first orders with a power meter to confirm efficiency and ghost suppression match the design; mount only the CGH alignment zone on the interferometer first, adjust until the retro fringes null and record the position, then measure a known reference sphere with the same CGH to check that the residual equals the expectation after substrate subtraction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。
以功率計量測零級與一級的回傳光強，確認效率與鬼像抑制符合設計。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error.
Measure the returned power in the zeroth and first orders with a power meter to confirm efficiency and ghost suppression match the design.
quiz.explanation: 以功率計量測零級與一級的回傳光強，確認效率與鬼像抑制符合設計；在干涉儀上先只裝 CGH 的對準區，調整到回射條紋為零後記錄位置，再以同一 CGH 量測一片已知的參考球面，核對殘差是否等於基板誤差扣除後的預期值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the returned power in the zeroth and first orders with a power meter to confirm efficiency and ghost suppression match the design; mount only the CGH alignment zone on the interferometer first, adjust until the retro fringes null and record the position, then measure a known reference sphere with the same CGH to check that the residual equals the expectation after substrate subtraction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 蝕刻深度若偏離 π 相位 10%，零級殘留光增強並與一級形成鬼像條紋，面形圖出現與線距相關的週期性假紋，量測重複性從 1 nm 惡化到 5 nm 以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the etch depth departs from π by 10%, residual zeroth-order light grows and forms ghost fringes with the first order, the figure map shows periodic artefacts tied to the line spacing, and repeatability degrades from 1 nm to over 5 nm. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：基板本身的面形與厚度不均勻會直接疊加在測量波前上，必須事先量測並扣除；CGH 上另外寫入對準區，用回射或貓眼圖樣讓 CGH 相對干涉儀的位置與傾斜能被獨立確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The substrate's own figure and thickness variation add directly to the measured wavefront and must be measured beforehand and subtracted; an alignment zone written on the CGH returns a retro or cat's-eye pattern so the CGH position and tilt relative to the interferometer can be confirmed independently.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 蝕刻深度若偏離 π 相位 10%，零級殘留光增強並與一級形成鬼像條紋，面形圖出現與線距相關的週期性假紋，量測重複性從 1 nm 惡化到 5 nm 以上。
knowledge.textEn: If the etch depth departs from π by 10%, residual zeroth-order light grows and forms ghost fringes with the first order, the figure map shows periodic artefacts tied to the line spacing, and repeatability degrades from 1 nm to over 5 nm.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 接觸與光學探針輪廓量測的物理限制：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of contact and optical probe profiling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「探針球與多波長光學探頭」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輪廓儀以接觸探針或非接觸光學探頭沿表面掃描，不受條紋密度限制，是自由曲面量測的通用方法。接觸探針以紅寶石球接觸表面，量到的是球心軌跡，必須依局部斜率做探針半徑補償，探針力則造成赫茲接觸壓入；光學探頭（多波長干涉或共軛焦）無接觸，但對斜率與表面反射率敏感。兩者都要用高精度的運動平台或旋轉台與線性尺，量測時間長達數小時，熱漂移成為主要誤差源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「探針球與多波長光學探頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A profilometer scans the surface with a contact stylus or a non-contact optical probe, is unconstrained by fringe density and is the general-purpose freeform method. A contact probe touches the surface with a ruby ball, measures the trajectory of the ball centre and therefore needs a radius compensation based on local slope, while the probe force causes Hertzian indentation; optical probes (multi-wavelength interferometric or confocal) are contact-free but sensitive to slope and surface reflectivity. Both rely on high-precision motion stages or rotary tables with linear scales, and because scans take hours, thermal drift becomes the dominant error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：赫茲接觸：探針力 F = 1 mN、紅寶石球半徑 R = 0.5 mm、紅寶石對熔融石英的等效模數 E* ≈ 63 GPa，接觸半徑 a = (3FR/4E*)^(1/3) ≈ 1.8 µm，壓入深度 δ = a²/R ≈ 6.6 nm，最大接觸壓力約 0.15 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hertzian contact: a probe force F = 1 mN, a ruby ball of radius R = 0.5 mm and an effective modulus E* ≈ 63 GPa for ruby on fused silica give a contact radius a = (3FR/4E*)^(1/3) ≈ 1.8 µm, an indentation δ = a²/R ≈ 6.6 nm and a peak contact pressure of about 0.15 GPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A contact probe reads the surface height directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「探針球與多波長光學探頭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 接觸與光學探針輪廓量測的物理限制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of contact and optical probe profiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「探針球與多波長光學探頭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：赫茲接觸：探針力 F = 1 mN、紅寶石球半徑 R = 0.5 mm、紅寶石對熔融石英的等效模數 E* ≈ 63 GPa，接觸半徑 a = (3FR/4E*)^(1/3) ≈ 1.8 µm，壓入深度 δ = a²/R ≈ 6.6 nm，最大接觸壓力約 0.15 GPa。探針半徑補償：在 20 mrad 斜率處接觸點橫移 R·sinθ = 10 µm，高度修正 R(1 − cosθ) ≈ 100 nm，不補償就是百奈米級錯誤。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Hertzian contact: a probe force F = 1 mN, a ruby ball of radius R = 0.5 mm and an effective modulus E* ≈ 63 GPa for ruby on fused silica give a contact radius a = (3FR/4E*)^(1/3) ≈ 1.8 µm, an indentation δ = a²/R ≈ 6.6 nm and a peak contact pressure of about 0.15 GPa. Radius compensation: at 20 mrad slope the contact point shifts laterally by R·sinθ = 10 µm and the height correction is R(1 − cosθ) ≈ 100 nm, a hundred-nanometre error if omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已校正的參考球量測探針球的有效半徑與形狀誤差，並在不同探針力下重複量測一片光學平面，確認壓入深度隨力的 2/3 次方變化且與赫茲預測一致；長時間掃描前後各量一次固定點，評估熱漂移並以線性或參考點法修正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the probe ball's effective radius and form error against a certified reference sphere, and repeat a measurement of an optical flat at several probe forces to confirm that indentation scales with the 2/3 power of force as Hertz predicts; measure a fixed point before and after a long scan to assess thermal drift and correct it linearly or with reference points.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Radius compensation: at 20 mrad slope the contact point shifts laterally by R·sinθ = 10 µm and the height correction is R(1 − cosθ) ≈ 100 nm, a hundred-nanometre error if omitted.

steps.title: 接觸與光學探針輪廓量測的物理限制：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of contact and optical probe profiling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「探針球與多波長光學探頭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用已校正的參考球量測探針球的有效半徑與形狀誤差，並在不同探針力下重複量測一片光學平面，確認壓入深度隨力的 2/3 次方變化且與赫茲預測一致；長時間掃描前後各量一次固定點，評估熱漂移並以線性或參考點法修正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the probe ball's effective radius and form error against a certified reference sphere, and repeat a measurement of an optical flat at several probe forces to confirm that indentation scales with the 2/3 power of force as Hertz predicts; measure a fixed point before and after a long scan to assess thermal drift and correct it linearly or with reference points. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：探針球若沾上拋光粉或在高斜率處側向滑動，有效半徑與接觸點都改變，單一掃描線上出現數十奈米的台階，拼成的三維面形圖帶有條紋狀假誤差而被誤認為中頻漣波。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the probe ball picks up polishing compound or slides sideways at high slope, both effective radius and contact point change, single scan lines show steps of tens of nanometres, and the assembled map carries stripe-like artefacts mistaken for mid-frequency ripple.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instructionEn: If the probe ball picks up polishing compound or slides sideways at high slope, both effective radius and contact point change, single scan lines show steps of tens of nanometres, and the assembled map carries stripe-like artefacts mistaken for mid-frequency ripple. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩者都要用高精度的運動平台或旋轉台與線性尺，量測時間長達數小時，熱漂移成為主要誤差源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both rely on high-precision motion stages or rotary tables with linear scales, and because scans take hours, thermal drift becomes the dominant error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A contact probe reads the surface height directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積」與「量測不確定度預算與追溯」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement" and "Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「次口徑拼接與重疊區」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 次口徑拼接把自由曲面分成多個小區域，每個區域傾斜到局部斜率在干涉儀可解析範圍內分別量測，再用重疊區解出各子孔徑的六個剛體參數與參考波前誤差後合成全口徑。拼接的強項是用一般球面干涉儀量任意面形，弱點是子孔徑之間的對準誤差會隨拼接鏈長度以隨機漫步方式累積，低階的整體形狀誤差最難被約束；通常搭配一次低解析度的全口徑量測或外部基準作為全域約束。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subaperture stitching divides a freeform into small regions, each tilted so the local slope falls within the interferometer's resolvable range and measured separately, then solves the six rigid-body parameters and reference-wavefront error of every subaperture from the overlaps to assemble the full aperture. Its strength is measuring arbitrary shapes with an ordinary spherical interferometer; its weakness is that alignment errors between subapertures accumulate along the stitching chain like a random walk, with the low-order global shape hardest to constrain, so a low-resolution full-aperture measurement or an external datum is usually added as a global constraint. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每個重疊區的拼接誤差 σ_s = 2 nm、鏈長 m = 10 個重疊時，累積誤差 ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm；加上全域低階約束後若能把鏈長有效縮到 2，累積降為 2.8 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a stitching error σ_s = 2 nm per overlap and a chain of m = 10 overlaps, the accumulated error ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm; with a global low-order constraint that effectively shortens the chain to 2, it falls to 2.8 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「子孔徑越多，拼接結果一定越準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More subapertures always make the stitched result more accurate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：子孔徑越多，拼接結果一定越準。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty.
