steps.title: 拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每個重疊區的拼接誤差 σ_s = 2 nm、鏈長 m = 10 個重疊時，累積誤差 ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm；加上全域低階約束後若能把鏈長有效縮到 2，累積降為 2.8 nm。子孔徑直徑 10 mm 在 20 mrad 全域斜率的表面上，局部斜率變化約 20 mrad×(10/50) = 4 mrad，接近未傾斜時 3.2 mrad 的解析上限，因此每個子孔徑都必須單獨調傾斜。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a stitching error σ_s = 2 nm per overlap and a chain of m = 10 overlaps, the accumulated error ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm; with a global low-order constraint that effectively shortens the chain to 2, it falls to 2.8 nm. A 10 mm subaperture on a surface with 20 mrad global slope sees a local slope change of about 20 mrad×(10/50) = 4 mrad, close to the 3.2 mrad resolvable limit without tilting, so every subaperture must be individually tilted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同一片表面做兩次不同子孔徑佈局的拼接，比較兩張全口徑圖的差異 RMS 並與 σ_s√m 預測比較；再與 CGH 零位或輪廓儀的結果相減，確認低階項（像散、彗差）的差異在全域約束的不確定度內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Stitch the same surface twice with different subaperture layouts, compare the RMS difference of the two full-aperture maps with the σ_s√m prediction; then subtract the CGH null or profilometer result and confirm that the low-order differences (astigmatism, coma) lie within the uncertainty of the global constraint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每個重疊區的拼接誤差 σ_s = 2 nm、鏈長 m = 10 個重疊時，累積誤差 ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm；加上全域低階約束後若能把鏈長有效縮到 2，累積降為 2.8 nm。子孔徑直徑 10 mm 在 20 mrad 全域斜率的表面上，局部斜率變化約 20 mrad×(10/50) = 4 mrad，接近未傾斜時 3.2 mrad 的解析上限，因此每個子孔徑都必須單獨調傾斜。
knowledge.textEn: With a stitching error σ_s = 2 nm per overlap and a chain of m = 10 overlaps, the accumulated error ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm; with a global low-order constraint that effectively shortens the chain to 2, it falls to 2.8 nm. A 10 mm subaperture on a surface with 20 mrad global slope sees a local slope change of about 20 mrad×(10/50) = 4 mrad, close to the 3.2 mrad resolvable limit without tilting, so every subaperture must be individually tilted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement", which statement holds?
options: 每個重疊區的拼接誤差 σ_s = 2 nm、鏈長 m = 10 個重疊時，累積誤差 ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm。
兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。
非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。
optionsEn: With a stitching error σ_s = 2 nm per overlap and a chain of m = 10 overlaps, the accumulated error ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm.
When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate.
A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element.
quiz.explanation: 每個重疊區的拼接誤差 σ_s = 2 nm、鏈長 m = 10 個重疊時，累積誤差 ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm；加上全域低階約束後若能把鏈長有效縮到 2，累積降為 2.8 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a stitching error σ_s = 2 nm per overlap and a chain of m = 10 overlaps, the accumulated error ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm; with a global low-order constraint that effectively shortens the chain to 2, it falls to 2.8 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「次口徑拼接與重疊區」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用同一片表面做兩次不同子孔徑佈局的拼接，比較兩張全口徑圖的差異 RMS 並與 σ_s√m 預測比較；再與 CGH 零位或輪廓儀的結果相減，確認低階項（像散、彗差）的差異在全域約束的不確定度內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Stitch the same surface twice with different subaperture layouts, compare the RMS difference of the two full-aperture maps with the σ_s√m prediction; then subtract the CGH null or profilometer result and confirm that the low-order differences (astigmatism, coma) lie within the uncertainty of the global constraint. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：重疊區若只有 10% 而非建議的 30% 以上，子孔徑之間的相對傾斜解算病態，合成圖出現沿拼接邊界的「屋頂」狀折痕，被誤認為真正的面形不連續。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With overlaps of only 10% instead of the recommended 30% or more, the solution for relative tilt between subapertures becomes ill-conditioned, the assembled map shows roof-like creases along the stitching boundaries, and these are mistaken for real form discontinuities.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用同一片表面做兩次不同子孔徑佈局的拼接，比較兩張全口徑圖的差異 RMS 並與 σ_s√m 預測比較；再與 CGH 零位或輪廓儀的結果相減，確認低階項（像散、彗差）的差異在全域約束的不確定度內。
knowledge.textEn: Stitch the same surface twice with different subaperture layouts, compare the RMS difference of the two full-aperture maps with the σ_s√m prediction; then subtract the CGH null or profilometer result and confirm that the low-order differences (astigmatism, coma) lie within the uncertainty of the global constraint.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用同一片表面做兩次不同子孔徑佈局的拼接，比較兩張全口徑圖的差異 RMS 並與 σ_s√m 預測比較。
CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Stitch the same surface twice with different subaperture layouts, compare the RMS difference of the two full-aperture maps with the σ_s√m prediction.
A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected.
quiz.explanation: 用同一片表面做兩次不同子孔徑佈局的拼接，比較兩張全口徑圖的差異 RMS 並與 σ_s√m 預測比較；再與 CGH 零位或輪廓儀的結果相減，確認低階項（像散、彗差）的差異在全域約束的不確定度內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Stitch the same surface twice with different subaperture layouts, compare the RMS difference of the two full-aperture maps with the σ_s√m prediction; then subtract the CGH null or profilometer result and confirm that the low-order differences (astigmatism, coma) lie within the uncertainty of the global constraint. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 重疊區若只有 10% 而非建議的 30% 以上，子孔徑之間的相對傾斜解算病態，合成圖出現沿拼接邊界的「屋頂」狀折痕，被誤認為真正的面形不連續。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With overlaps of only 10% instead of the recommended 30% or more, the solution for relative tilt between subapertures becomes ill-conditioned, the assembled map shows roof-like creases along the stitching boundaries, and these are mistaken for real form discontinuities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：拼接的強項是用一般球面干涉儀量任意面形，弱點是子孔徑之間的對準誤差會隨拼接鏈長度以隨機漫步方式累積，低階的整體形狀誤差最難被約束；通常搭配一次低解析度的全口徑量測或外部基準作為全域約束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its strength is measuring arbitrary shapes with an ordinary spherical interferometer; its weakness is that alignment errors between subapertures accumulate along the stitching chain like a random walk, with the low-order global shape hardest to constrain, so a low-resolution full-aperture measurement or an external datum is usually added as a global constraint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「子孔徑越多，拼接結果一定越準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More subapertures always make the stitched result more accurate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重疊區若只有 10% 而非建議的 30% 以上，子孔徑之間的相對傾斜解算病態，合成圖出現沿拼接邊界的「屋頂」狀折痕，被誤認為真正的面形不連續。
knowledge.textEn: With overlaps of only 10% instead of the recommended 30% or more, the solution for relative tilt between subapertures becomes ill-conditioned, the assembled map shows roof-like creases along the stitching boundaries, and these are mistaken for real form discontinuities.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。
重疊區若只有 10% 而非建議的 30% 以上，子孔徑之間的相對傾斜解算病態，合成圖出現沿拼接邊界的「屋頂」狀折痕，被誤認為真正的面形不連續。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty.

With overlaps of only 10% instead of the recommended 30% or more, the solution for relative tilt between subapertures becomes ill-conditioned, the assembled map shows roof-like creases along the stitching boundaries, and these are mistaken for real form discontinuities.
quiz.explanation: 重疊區若只有 10% 而非建議的 30% 以上，子孔徑之間的相對傾斜解算病態，合成圖出現沿拼接邊界的「屋頂」狀折痕，被誤認為真正的面形不連續。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With overlaps of only 10% instead of the recommended 30% or more, the solution for relative tilt between subapertures becomes ill-conditioned, the assembled map shows roof-like creases along the stitching boundaries, and these are mistaken for real form discontinuities. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 量測不確定度預算與追溯：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「不確定度預算表與參考件」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每種方法都要有一張不確定度預算表：干涉儀參考面、CGH 或儀器模型、對準與回溯、拼接、熱漂移與雜訊逐項列出，以均方根合成後與公差比較。追溯靠參考件：三平面法或隨機球法給出絕對參考面誤差，經國家計量機構（如 PTB）校正的球面與非球面標準件提供與長度單位的連結。熱是長時間量測的主因：工件、夾具與儀器的膨脹與折射率變化都在預算內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「不確定度預算表與參考件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every method needs an uncertainty-budget table: interferometer reference, CGH or instrument model, alignment and retrace, stitching, thermal drift and noise are listed term by term, combined in quadrature and compared with the tolerance. Traceability rests on reference artefacts: the three-flat or random-ball test gives the absolute reference-surface error, and spherical and aspheric standards calibrated by a national metrology institute such as PTB link the measurement to the unit of length. Temperature dominates long measurements, so expansion and index change of the part, fixture and instrument all belong in the budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：CGH 測試預算：CGH 圖樣 2 nm、基板 3 nm、對準與回溯 3 nm、參考面 2 nm、熱漂移 2 nm、雜訊 1 nm，RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，對 20 nm RMS 公差的量測比約 3.6:1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: CGH test budget: CGH pattern 2 nm, substrate 3 nm, alignment and retrace 3 nm, reference surface 2 nm, thermal drift 2 nm, noise 1 nm, RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of about 3.6:1 against a 20 nm RMS tolerance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「不確定度預算表與參考件」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 量測不確定度預算與追溯
knowledge.text: 每種方法都要有一張不確定度預算表：干涉儀參考面、CGH 或儀器模型、對準與回溯、拼接、熱漂移與雜訊逐項列出，以均方根合成後與公差比較。追溯靠參考件：三平面法或隨機球法給出絕對參考面誤差，經國家計量機構（如 PTB）校正的球面與非球面標準件提供與長度單位的連結。
knowledge.textEn: Every method needs an uncertainty-budget table: interferometer reference, CGH or instrument model, alignment and retrace, stitching, thermal drift and noise are listed term by term, combined in quadrature and compared with the tolerance. Traceability rests on reference artefacts: the three-flat or random-ball test gives the absolute reference-surface error, and spherical and aspheric standards calibrated by a national metrology institute such as PTB link the measurement to the unit of length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「量測不確定度預算與追溯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability" is correct?
options: 每種方法都要有一張不確定度預算表：干涉儀參考面、CGH 或儀器模型、對準與回溯、拼接、熱漂移與雜訊逐項列出，以均方根合成後與公差比較。
量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。
自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。
optionsEn: Every method needs an uncertainty-budget table: interferometer reference, CGH or instrument model, alignment and retrace, stitching, thermal drift and noise are listed term by term, combined in quadrature and compared with the tolerance.
Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty.
A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials.
quiz.explanation: 每種方法都要有一張不確定度預算表：干涉儀參考面、CGH 或儀器模型、對準與回溯、拼接、熱漂移與雜訊逐項列出，以均方根合成後與公差比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every method needs an uncertainty-budget table: interferometer reference, CGH or instrument model, alignment and retrace, stitching, thermal drift and noise are listed term by term, combined in quadrature and compared with the tolerance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 量測不確定度預算與追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不確定度預算表與參考件」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：CGH 測試預算：CGH 圖樣 2 nm、基板 3 nm、對準與回溯 3 nm、參考面 2 nm、熱漂移 2 nm、雜訊 1 nm，RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，對 20 nm RMS 公差的量測比約 3.6:1。熱項來源：鋁製自由曲面矢高 5 mm、α = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹、溫差 0.1 K，矢高變化 5 mm×23×10⁻⁶×0.1 ≈ 11.5 nm，因此量測時溫度須穩定在約 0.02 K 以內。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: CGH test budget: CGH pattern 2 nm, substrate 3 nm, alignment and retrace 3 nm, reference surface 2 nm, thermal drift 2 nm, noise 1 nm, RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of about 3.6:1 against a 20 nm RMS tolerance. The thermal term comes from an aluminium freeform with 5 mm sag, α = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ and a 0.1 K change, whose sag shifts by 5 mm×23×10⁻⁶×0.1 ≈ 11.5 nm, so temperature must hold within about 0.02 K during measurement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每一項以實驗求值：重複量測得雜訊，拆裝重裝得對準項，參考件得參考面項，連續記錄溫度與面形得熱項；把各項的實驗值填回預算表，合成值應與整體重複性加系統誤差估計一致，並以校正標準件的量測差異驗證追溯鏈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Evaluate each term experimentally: repeated measurements give noise, remove-and-replace cycles give alignment, reference artefacts give the reference term, and simultaneous logging of temperature and figure gives the thermal term; enter the experimental values back into the table, check that the combined value agrees with overall repeatability plus the systematic estimate, and verify the traceability chain by the measured deviation of a calibrated standard.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: CGH 測試預算：CGH 圖樣 2 nm、基板 3 nm、對準與回溯 3 nm、參考面 2 nm、熱漂移 2 nm、雜訊 1 nm，RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，對 20 nm RMS 公差的量測比約 3.6:1。熱項來源：鋁製自由曲面矢高 5 mm、α = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹、溫差 0.1 K，矢高變化 5 mm×23×10⁻⁶×0.1 ≈ 11.5 nm，因此量測時溫度須穩定在約 0.02 K 以內。
knowledge.textEn: CGH test budget: CGH pattern 2 nm, substrate 3 nm, alignment and retrace 3 nm, reference surface 2 nm, thermal drift 2 nm, noise 1 nm, RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of about 3.6:1 against a 20 nm RMS tolerance. The thermal term comes from an aluminium freeform with 5 mm sag, α = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ and a 0.1 K change, whose sag shifts by 5 mm×23×10⁻⁶×0.1 ≈ 11.5 nm, so temperature must hold within about 0.02 K during measurement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「量測不確定度預算與追溯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability", which statement holds?
options: 自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。
CGH 測試預算：CGH 圖樣 2 nm、基板 3 nm、對準與回溯 3 nm、參考面 2 nm、熱漂移 2 nm、雜訊 1 nm，RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，對 20 nm RMS 公差的量測比約 3.6:1。
CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。
optionsEn: Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error.

CGH test budget: CGH pattern 2 nm, substrate 3 nm, alignment and retrace 3 nm, reference surface 2 nm, thermal drift 2 nm, noise 1 nm, RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of about 3.6:1 against a 20 nm RMS tolerance.
A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected.
quiz.explanation: CGH 測試預算：CGH 圖樣 2 nm、基板 3 nm、對準與回溯 3 nm、參考面 2 nm、熱漂移 2 nm、雜訊 1 nm，RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，對 20 nm RMS 公差的量測比約 3.6:1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: CGH test budget: CGH pattern 2 nm, substrate 3 nm, alignment and retrace 3 nm, reference surface 2 nm, thermal drift 2 nm, noise 1 nm, RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of about 3.6:1 against a 20 nm RMS tolerance. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 量測不確定度預算與追溯：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「不確定度預算表與參考件」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對每一項以實驗求值：重複量測得雜訊，拆裝重裝得對準項，參考件得參考面項，連續記錄溫度與面形得熱項；把各項的實驗值填回預算表，合成值應與整體重複性加系統誤差估計一致，並以校正標準件的量測差異驗證追溯鏈。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Evaluate each term experimentally: repeated measurements give noise, remove-and-replace cycles give alignment, reference artefacts give the reference term, and simultaneous logging of temperature and figure gives the thermal term; enter the experimental values back into the table, check that the combined value agrees with overall repeatability plus the systematic estimate, and verify the traceability chain by the measured deviation of a calibrated standard. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：預算表若只用儀器型錄的重複性 0.5 nm 當作不確定度，忽略 3 nm 的基板與 3 nm 的回溯誤差，報告出的 2 nm 不確定度被客戶的獨立量測推翻，差異達 8 nm 時雙方都無法判定誰對。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the table takes the catalogue repeatability of 0.5 nm as the uncertainty and ignores 3 nm of substrate and 3 nm of retrace error, the reported 2 nm uncertainty is contradicted by the customer's independent measurement, and when the two disagree by 8 nm neither side can tell who is right.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每一項以實驗求值：重複量測得雜訊，拆裝重裝得對準項，參考件得參考面項，連續記錄溫度與面形得熱項；把各項的實驗值填回預算表，合成值應與整體重複性加系統誤差估計一致，並以校正標準件的量測差異驗證追溯鏈。
knowledge.textEn: Evaluate each term experimentally: repeated measurements give noise, remove-and-replace cycles give alignment, reference artefacts give the reference term, and simultaneous logging of temperature and figure gives the thermal term; enter the experimental values back into the table, check that the combined value agrees with overall repeatability plus the systematic estimate, and verify the traceability chain by the measured deviation of a calibrated standard.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「量測不確定度預算與追溯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。
對每一項以實驗求值：重複量測得雜訊，拆裝重裝得對準項，參考件得參考面項，連續記錄溫度與面形得熱項。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A contact probe reads the surface height directly.

Evaluate each term experimentally: repeated measurements give noise, remove-and-replace cycles give alignment, reference artefacts give the reference term, and simultaneous logging of temperature and figure gives the thermal term.
quiz.explanation: 對每一項以實驗求值：重複量測得雜訊，拆裝重裝得對準項，參考件得參考面項，連續記錄溫度與面形得熱項；把各項的實驗值填回預算表，合成值應與整體重複性加系統誤差估計一致，並以校正標準件的量測差異驗證追溯鏈。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Evaluate each term experimentally: repeated measurements give noise, remove-and-replace cycles give alignment, reference artefacts give the reference term, and simultaneous logging of temperature and figure gives the thermal term; enter the experimental values back into the table, check that the combined value agrees with overall repeatability plus the systematic estimate, and verify the traceability chain by the measured deviation of a calibrated standard. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 量測不確定度預算與追溯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不確定度預算表與參考件」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 預算表若只用儀器型錄的重複性 0.5 nm 當作不確定度，忽略 3 nm 的基板與 3 nm 的回溯誤差，報告出的 2 nm 不確定度被客戶的獨立量測推翻，差異達 8 nm 時雙方都無法判定誰對。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the table takes the catalogue repeatability of 0.5 nm as the uncertainty and ignores 3 nm of substrate and 3 nm of retrace error, the reported 2 nm uncertainty is contradicted by the customer's independent measurement, and when the two disagree by 8 nm neither side can tell who is right. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱是長時間量測的主因：工件、夾具與儀器的膨脹與折射率變化都在預算內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature dominates long measurements, so expansion and index change of the part, fixture and instrument all belong in the budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預算表若只用儀器型錄的重複性 0.5 nm 當作不確定度，忽略 3 nm 的基板與 3 nm 的回溯誤差，報告出的 2 nm 不確定度被客戶的獨立量測推翻，差異達 8 nm 時雙方都無法判定誰對。
knowledge.textEn: If the table takes the catalogue repeatability of 0.5 nm as the uncertainty and ignores 3 nm of substrate and 3 nm of retrace error, the reported 2 nm uncertainty is contradicted by the customer's independent measurement, and when the two disagree by 8 nm neither side can tell who is right.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「量測不確定度預算與追溯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 預算表若只用儀器型錄的重複性 0.5 nm 當作不確定度，忽略 3 nm 的基板與 3 nm 的回溯誤差，報告出的 2 nm 不確定度被客戶的獨立量測推翻，差異達 8 nm 時雙方都無法判定誰對。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。
optionsEn: If the table takes the catalogue repeatability of 0.5 nm as the uncertainty and ignores 3 nm of substrate and 3 nm of retrace error, the reported 2 nm uncertainty is contradicted by the customer's independent measurement, and when the two disagree by 8 nm neither side can tell who is right.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials.
quiz.explanation: 預算表若只用儀器型錄的重複性 0.5 nm 當作不確定度，忽略 3 nm 的基板與 3 nm 的回溯誤差，報告出的 2 nm 不確定度被客戶的獨立量測推翻，差異達 8 nm 時雙方都無法判定誰對。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the table takes the catalogue repeatability of 0.5 nm as the uncertainty and ignores 3 nm of substrate and 3 nm of retrace error, the reported 2 nm uncertainty is contradicted by the customer's independent measurement, and when the two disagree by 8 nm neither side can tell who is right. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環」與「獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring" and "Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「定位標記與數位製造迴路」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由曲面的工程價值在於量測圖能被正確放回設計座標並驅動下一步：加工端用它計算修形的停留時間圖，設計端用它做實測重最佳化，裝配端用它決定補償調整。這需要在工件上設計可量測的基準：三個定位球或基準平面與邊緣，在加工機、量測機與鏡座之間共用同一套參考。定位標記本身的量測不確定度透過斜率轉成面形不確定度，因此基準的佈局要盡量拉長基線、靠近有效口徑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The engineering value of freeform metrology lies in placing the measured map correctly into the design frame and letting it drive the next step: the fabricator computes the figuring dwell-time map from it, the designer re-optimises with as-built data, and the integrator decides compensating adjustments. This needs measurable datums designed into the part, three fiducial spheres or a datum plane plus edge, shared as one reference by the machine tool, the metrology instrument and the mount. The fiducials' own measurement uncertainty converts through slope into form uncertainty, so their layout should maximise the baseline and sit close to the clear aperture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad；在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，乘以 20 mrad 斜率得 5 nm 的假性面形。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad; at the 25 mm half-aperture this displaces points laterally by 0.25 µm, which times the 20 mrad slope gives 5 nm of false form.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環
knowledge.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring
knowledge.text: 自由曲面的工程價值在於量測圖能被正確放回設計座標並驅動下一步：加工端用它計算修形的停留時間圖，設計端用它做實測重最佳化，裝配端用它決定補償調整。這需要在工件上設計可量測的基準：三個定位球或基準平面與邊緣，在加工機、量測機與鏡座之間共用同一套參考。
knowledge.textEn: The engineering value of freeform metrology lies in placing the measured map correctly into the design frame and letting it drive the next step: the fabricator computes the figuring dwell-time map from it, the designer re-optimises with as-built data, and the integrator decides compensating adjustments. This needs measurable datums designed into the part, three fiducial spheres or a datum plane plus edge, shared as one reference by the machine tool, the metrology instrument and the mount.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring" is correct?
options: 自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。
自由曲面的工程價值在於量測圖能被正確放回設計座標並驅動下一步：加工端用它計算修形的停留時間圖，設計端用它做實測重最佳化，裝配端用它決定補償調整。
兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。
optionsEn: A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials.

The engineering value of freeform metrology lies in placing the measured map correctly into the design frame and letting it drive the next step: the fabricator computes the figuring dwell-time map from it, the designer re-optimises with as-built data, and the integrator decides compensating adjustments.
When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate.
quiz.explanation: 自由曲面的工程價值在於量測圖能被正確放回設計座標並驅動下一步：加工端用它計算修形的停留時間圖，設計端用它做實測重最佳化，裝配端用它決定補償調整。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The engineering value of freeform metrology lies in placing the measured map correctly into the design frame and letting it drive the next step: the fabricator computes the figuring dwell-time map from it, the designer re-optimises with as-built data, and the integrator decides compensating adjustments. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad；在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，乘以 20 mrad 斜率得 5 nm 的假性面形。若基線縮到 30 mm，轉動不確定度升到 33 µrad，假性面形變成 17 nm，接近整個公差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad; at the 25 mm half-aperture this displaces points laterally by 0.25 µm, which times the 20 mrad slope gives 5 nm of false form. With the baseline shortened to 30 mm the clocking uncertainty rises to 33 µrad and the false form grows to 17 nm, close to the whole tolerance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差；把量測圖經座標轉換後生成修形停留時間圖，做一次修形再量測，收斂比若低於 3 表示配準或座標方向有錯。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines; generate the figuring dwell-time map from the transformed measurement, run one figuring pass and re-measure, where a convergence ratio below 3 indicates a registration or axis-direction error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad；在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，乘以 20 mrad 斜率得 5 nm 的假性面形。若基線縮到 30 mm，轉動不確定度升到 33 µrad，假性面形變成 17 nm，接近整個公差。
knowledge.textEn: Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad; at the 25 mm half-aperture this displaces points laterally by 0.25 µm, which times the 20 mrad slope gives 5 nm of false form. With the baseline shortened to 30 mm the clocking uncertainty rises to 33 µrad and the false form grows to 17 nm, close to the whole tolerance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring", which statement holds?
options: 非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。
接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。
三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad。
optionsEn: A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element.
A contact probe reads the surface height directly.
Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad.
quiz.explanation: 三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad；在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，乘以 20 mrad 斜率得 5 nm 的假性面形。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad; at the 25 mm half-aperture this displaces points laterally by 0.25 µm, which times the 20 mrad slope gives 5 nm of false form. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「定位標記與數位製造迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差；把量測圖經座標轉換後生成修形停留時間圖，做一次修形再量測，收斂比若低於 3 表示配準或座標方向有錯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines; generate the figuring dwell-time map from the transformed measurement, run one figuring pass and re-measure, where a convergence ratio below 3 indicates a registration or axis-direction error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：量測機與加工機對 Y 軸正方向的定義相反，誤差圖被鏡像後送去修形，第一次修形把誤差加倍而不是消除，連續兩次疊代後才發現是座標約定問題，浪費數天與數十微米的材料。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the metrology instrument and the machine tool define the positive Y axis oppositely, the mirrored error map is sent to figuring, the first pass doubles the error instead of removing it, and only after two iterations is the coordinate convention found at fault, wasting days and tens of micrometres of material.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差；把量測圖經座標轉換後生成修形停留時間圖，做一次修形再量測，收斂比若低於 3 表示配準或座標方向有錯。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines; generate the figuring dwell-time map from the transformed measurement, run one figuring pass and re-measure, where a convergence ratio below 3 indicates a registration or axis-direction error.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring"?
options: 在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
子孔徑越多，拼接結果一定越準。
optionsEn: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
More subapertures always make the stitched result more accurate.
quiz.explanation: 在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差；把量測圖經座標轉換後生成修形停留時間圖，做一次修形再量測，收斂比若低於 3 表示配準或座標方向有錯。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines; generate the figuring dwell-time map from the transformed measurement, run one figuring pass and re-measure, where a convergence ratio below 3 indicates a registration or axis-direction error. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 量測機與加工機對 Y 軸正方向的定義相反，誤差圖被鏡像後送去修形，第一次修形把誤差加倍而不是消除，連續兩次疊代後才發現是座標約定問題，浪費數天與數十微米的材料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the metrology instrument and the machine tool define the positive Y axis oppositely, the mirrored error map is sent to figuring, the first pass doubles the error instead of removing it, and only after two iterations is the coordinate convention found at fault, wasting days and tens of micrometres of material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定位標記本身的量測不確定度透過斜率轉成面形不確定度，因此基準的佈局要盡量拉長基線、靠近有效口徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fiducials' own measurement uncertainty converts through slope into form uncertainty, so their layout should maximise the baseline and sit close to the clear aperture.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。

兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由曲面沒有簡單的通用標準件，所以驗收依賴兩種物理原理不同的方法互相比對：例如 CGH 干涉與探針輪廓儀，兩者的差異圖應在合成不確定度內且不含結構性圖樣。驗收報告依 ISO 10110-19 的自由曲面規格標示面形、斜率誤差、中頻與粗糙度，並註明所用的座標系、扣除的擬合項、取樣密度與不確定度；交接文件附上以設計座標表示的實測面形檔，供後續的實測重最佳化與系統對準使用。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Freeforms have no simple universal standard artefact, so acceptance relies on comparing two methods of different physical principle, for example CGH interferometry and probe profilometry, whose difference map should lie within the combined uncertainty and contain no structured pattern. The acceptance report specifies figure, slope error, mid-frequency and roughness according to the freeform conventions of ISO 10110-19 and states the coordinate frame, the removed fitted terms, the sampling density and the uncertainty; the handoff package includes the as-measured surface file in design coordinates for later as-built re-optimisation and system alignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：方法 A（CGH）不確定度 5.6 nm、方法 B（輪廓儀）8 nm，兩者差異圖的期望 RMS ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異為 25 nm RMS，超出期望 2.5 倍，表示存在系統誤差（通常是配準或探針補償），不能把兩者平均當作結果。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Method A (CGH) with 5.6 nm uncertainty and method B (profilometer) with 8 nm give an expected RMS of the difference map ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; a measured difference of 25 nm RMS, 2.5 times the expectation, signals a systematic error, usually registration or probe compensation, and the two results must not simply be averaged.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接
knowledge.text: 自由曲面沒有簡單的通用標準件，所以驗收依賴兩種物理原理不同的方法互相比對：例如 CGH 干涉與探針輪廓儀，兩者的差異圖應在合成不確定度內且不含結構性圖樣。驗收報告依 ISO 10110-19 的自由曲面規格標示面形、斜率誤差、中頻與粗糙度，並註明所用的座標系、扣除的擬合項、取樣密度與不確定度；交接文件附上以設計座標表示的實測面形檔，供後續的實測重最佳化與系統對準使用。
knowledge.textEn: Freeforms have no simple universal standard artefact, so acceptance relies on comparing two methods of different physical principle, for example CGH interferometry and probe profilometry, whose difference map should lie within the combined uncertainty and contain no structured pattern. The acceptance report specifies figure, slope error, mid-frequency and roughness according to the freeform conventions of ISO 10110-19 and states the coordinate frame, the removed fitted terms, the sampling density and the uncertainty; the handoff package includes the as-measured surface file in design coordinates for later as-built re-optimisation and system alignment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff" is correct?
options: 兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。
自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。
自由曲面沒有簡單的通用標準件，所以驗收依賴兩種物理原理不同的方法互相比對：例如 CGH 干涉與探針輪廓儀，兩者的差異圖應在合成不確定度內且不含結構性圖樣。
optionsEn: When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate.
Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error.

Freeforms have no simple universal standard artefact, so acceptance relies on comparing two methods of different physical principle, for example CGH interferometry and probe profilometry, whose difference map should lie within the combined uncertainty and contain no structured pattern.
quiz.explanation: 自由曲面沒有簡單的通用標準件，所以驗收依賴兩種物理原理不同的方法互相比對：例如 CGH 干涉與探針輪廓儀，兩者的差異圖應在合成不確定度內且不含結構性圖樣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Freeforms have no simple universal standard artefact, so acceptance relies on comparing two methods of different physical principle, for example CGH interferometry and probe profilometry, whose difference map should lie within the combined uncertainty and contain no structured pattern. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：方法 A（CGH）不確定度 5.6 nm、方法 B（輪廓儀）8 nm，兩者差異圖的期望 RMS ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異為 25 nm RMS，超出期望 2.5 倍，表示存在系統誤差（通常是配準或探針補償），不能把兩者平均當作結果。差異圖若含 0.3 週期/mm 的條紋成分，可直接指向拼接或掃描線間距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Method A (CGH) with 5.6 nm uncertainty and method B (profilometer) with 8 nm give an expected RMS of the difference map ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; a measured difference of 25 nm RMS, 2.5 times the expectation, signals a systematic error, usually registration or probe compensation, and the two results must not simply be averaged. A fringe component at 0.3 cycles/mm in the difference map points directly to stitching or scan-line spacing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把兩種方法的面形圖在同一設計座標系下相減，計算差異的 RMS、PSD 與低階 Zernike 分量，分別與合成不確定度、各方法的頻率響應及配準不確定度比較；確認報告列出的每項規格都附量測方法、擬合項與不確定度，並由另一位工程師複核座標約定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Subtract the two methods' maps in the same design frame, compute the RMS, PSD and low-order Zernike content of the difference and compare them respectively with the combined uncertainty, each method's frequency response and the registration uncertainty; confirm that every specification in the report carries its method, fitted terms and uncertainty, and have a second engineer check the coordinate conventions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 方法 A（CGH）不確定度 5.6 nm、方法 B（輪廓儀）8 nm，兩者差異圖的期望 RMS ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異為 25 nm RMS，超出期望 2.5 倍，表示存在系統誤差（通常是配準或探針補償），不能把兩者平均當作結果。差異圖若含 0.3 週期/mm 的條紋成分，可直接指向拼接或掃描線間距。
knowledge.textEn: Method A (CGH) with 5.6 nm uncertainty and method B (profilometer) with 8 nm give an expected RMS of the difference map ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; a measured difference of 25 nm RMS, 2.5 times the expectation, signals a systematic error, usually registration or probe compensation, and the two results must not simply be averaged. A fringe component at 0.3 cycles/mm in the difference map points directly to stitching or scan-line spacing.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff", which statement holds?
options: 方法 A（CGH）不確定度 5.6 nm、方法 B（輪廓儀）8 nm，兩者差異圖的期望 RMS ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm。
CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。
子孔徑越多，拼接結果一定越準。
optionsEn: Method A (CGH) with 5.6 nm uncertainty and method B (profilometer) with 8 nm give an expected RMS of the difference map ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm.
A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected.
More subapertures always make the stitched result more accurate.
quiz.explanation: 方法 A（CGH）不確定度 5.6 nm、方法 B（輪廓儀）8 nm，兩者差異圖的期望 RMS ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異為 25 nm RMS，超出期望 2.5 倍，表示存在系統誤差（通常是配準或探針補償），不能把兩者平均當作結果。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Method A (CGH) with 5.6 nm uncertainty and method B (profilometer) with 8 nm give an expected RMS of the difference map ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; a measured difference of 25 nm RMS, 2.5 times the expectation, signals a systematic error, usually registration or probe compensation, and the two results must not simply be averaged. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把兩種方法的面形圖在同一設計座標系下相減，計算差異的 RMS、PSD 與低階 Zernike 分量，分別與合成不確定度、各方法的頻率響應及配準不確定度比較；確認報告列出的每項規格都附量測方法、擬合項與不確定度，並由另一位工程師複核座標約定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract the two methods' maps in the same design frame, compute the RMS, PSD and low-order Zernike content of the difference and compare them respectively with the combined uncertainty, each method's frequency response and the registration uncertainty; confirm that every specification in the report carries its method, fitted terms and uncertainty, and have a second engineer check the coordinate conventions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若驗收只用一種方法且報告未註明扣除的擬合項，系統整合時發現離軸鏡的像散比報告高 30 nm，追查時無法分辨是量測遺漏、配準錯誤還是安裝變形，整個光學系統的對準時程被打亂。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Acceptance by a single method with no statement of the removed terms leaves the integrator finding 30 nm more astigmatism in the off-axis mirror than reported, with no way to separate metrology omission, registration error or mount distortion, and the alignment schedule of the whole optical system is disrupted.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把兩種方法的面形圖在同一設計座標系下相減，計算差異的 RMS、PSD 與低階 Zernike 分量，分別與合成不確定度、各方法的頻率響應及配準不確定度比較；確認報告列出的每項規格都附量測方法、擬合項與不確定度，並由另一位工程師複核座標約定。
knowledge.textEn: Subtract the two methods' maps in the same design frame, compute the RMS, PSD and low-order Zernike content of the difference and compare them respectively with the combined uncertainty, each method's frequency response and the registration uncertainty; confirm that every specification in the report carries its method, fitted terms and uncertainty, and have a second engineer check the coordinate conventions.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
把兩種方法的面形圖在同一設計座標系下相減，計算差異的 RMS、PSD 與低階 Zernike 分量，分別與合成不確定度、各方法的頻率響應及配準不確定度比較。
量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Subtract the two methods' maps in the same design frame, compute the RMS, PSD and low-order Zernike content of the difference and compare them respectively with the combined uncertainty, each method's frequency response and the registration uncertainty.
Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 把兩種方法的面形圖在同一設計座標系下相減，計算差異的 RMS、PSD 與低階 Zernike 分量，分別與合成不確定度、各方法的頻率響應及配準不確定度比較；確認報告列出的每項規格都附量測方法、擬合項與不確定度，並由另一位工程師複核座標約定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtract the two methods' maps in the same design frame, compute the RMS, PSD and low-order Zernike content of the difference and compare them respectively with the combined uncertainty, each method's frequency response and the registration uncertainty; confirm that every specification in the report carries its method, fitted terms and uncertainty, and have a second engineer check the coordinate conventions. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若驗收只用一種方法且報告未註明扣除的擬合項，系統整合時發現離軸鏡的像散比報告高 30 nm，追查時無法分辨是量測遺漏、配準錯誤還是安裝變形，整個光學系統的對準時程被打亂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance by a single method with no statement of the removed terms leaves the integrator finding 30 nm more astigmatism in the off-axis mirror than reported, with no way to separate metrology omission, registration error or mount distortion, and the alignment schedule of the whole optical system is disrupted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收報告依 ISO 10110-19 的自由曲面規格標示面形、斜率誤差、中頻與粗糙度，並註明所用的座標系、扣除的擬合項、取樣密度與不確定度；交接文件附上以設計座標表示的實測面形檔，供後續的實測重最佳化與系統對準使用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The acceptance report specifies figure, slope error, mid-frequency and roughness according to the freeform conventions of ISO 10110-19 and states the coordinate frame, the removed fitted terms, the sampling density and the uncertainty; the handoff package includes the as-measured surface file in design coordinates for later as-built re-optimisation and system alignment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: 光學玻璃精密退火
summary: 以一塊厚 100 mm 的 N-BK7 光學玻璃毛胚為案例：從黏度與 Maxwell 鬆弛時間說明退火點與應變點的意義，推導冷卻速率如何透過假想溫度改變折射率、毛胚內溫差如何依 Adams–Williamson 關係凍結成殘餘應力，再談精密退火爐的均勻性要求、應力雙折射與折射率均勻性的量測，最後設計一份完整的退火程式並以熔次資料表完成與光學設計的交接。
summaryEn: Using a 100 mm thick N-BK7 blank as the case, the course explains the annealing and strain points through viscosity and the Maxwell relaxation time, derives how cooling rate changes refractive index via the fictive temperature and how the temperature difference inside the blank freezes into residual stress by the Adams–Williamson relation, then covers the uniformity demands on a precision annealing furnace, the measurement of stress birefringence and index homogeneity, and finally designs a complete annealing schedule and hands the melt data sheet over to optical design.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 退火程式練習：N-BK7 毛胚厚 100 mm，熱擴散率 a ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s，Eα/(1−ν) ≈ 0.73 MPa/K，光彈常數 27.7 nm/cm 每 MPa，目標雙折射 ≤ 4 nm/cm、折射率公差 ±0.0002。第一步：1 K/h 時 ΔT = q·d²/(8a) = 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(4.16×10⁻⁶) ≈ 0.67 K，永久應力 σ ≈ (2/3)×0.73×0.67 ≈ 0.33 MPa，雙折射 ≈ 9.1 nm/cm，不合格。第二步：改 0.3 K/h，ΔT ≈ 0.20 K，σ ≈ 0.10 MPa，雙折射 ≈ 2.7 nm/cm，合格。第三步：若玻璃廠的參考速率為 h₀ 且退火係數 m ≈ −0.001，0.3 K/h 相對 h₀ 的折射率偏移為 −0.001×log₁₀(0.3/h₀)；要落在 ±0.0002 內，0.3 K/h 必須在 0.63h₀ 到 1.6h₀ 之間，否則把偏移量寫進熔次資料表供設計重算。第四步：時間預算為保溫 2 h、慢冷 80 K/0.3 = 267 h、快冷 460 K/5 = 92 h，共約 15 天；快冷段暫時應力 ≈ 1.7 MPa，安全。最後以偏光儀與均勻性干涉驗收，並做熔次重算。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Annealing-schedule exercise: an N-BK7 blank 100 mm thick, diffusivity a ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s, Eα/(1−ν) ≈ 0.73 MPa/K, photoelastic constant 27.7 nm/cm per MPa, target birefringence ≤ 4 nm/cm and index tolerance ±0.0002. Step one: at 1 K/h, ΔT = q·d²/(8a) = 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(4.16×10⁻⁶) ≈ 0.67 K, permanent stress σ ≈ (2/3)×0.73×0.67 ≈ 0.33 MPa, birefringence ≈ 9.1 nm/cm, a failure. Step two: at 0.3 K/h, ΔT ≈ 0.20 K, σ ≈ 0.10 MPa, birefringence ≈ 2.7 nm/cm, a pass. Step three: if the maker's reference rate is h₀ and the annealing coefficient m ≈ −0.001, the index shift of 0.3 K/h relative to h₀ is −0.001×log₁₀(0.3/h₀); to stay within ±0.0002, 0.3 K/h must lie between 0.63h₀ and 1.6h₀, otherwise the shift is written into the melt data sheet for the design recompute. Step four: the time budget is 2 h hold, slow cool 80 K/0.3 = 267 h, fast cool 460 K/5 = 92 h, about 15 days in all; the transient stress in the fast segment is ≈ 1.7 MPa, which is safe. Finally accept with the polarimeter and homogeneity interferometry and perform the melt recompute. All numbers are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」與「冷卻速率如何決定折射率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" and "How cooling rate sets the refractive index": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。應力以 Maxwell 模型鬆弛，時間常數 τ = η/G，所以在退火點附近幾十秒就能釋放應力，在應變點以下則需要數小時到數天，實際上被凍結。N-BK7 的轉變溫度約 557 °C，精密退火就是在這段溫度範圍內用受控的速率冷卻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. Stress relaxes by the Maxwell model with a time constant τ = η/G, so near the annealing point stress releases within tens of seconds, while below the strain point it would take hours to days and is effectively frozen. N-BK7 has a transformation temperature near 557 °C, and precision annealing means cooling through this range at a controlled rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time
knowledge.text: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。應力以 Maxwell 模型鬆弛，時間常數 τ = η/G，所以在退火點附近幾十秒就能釋放應力，在應變點以下則需要數小時到數天，實際上被凍結。
knowledge.textEn: Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. Stress relaxes by the Maxwell model with a time constant τ = η/G, so near the annealing point stress releases within tens of seconds, while below the strain point it would take hours to days and is effectively frozen.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" is correct?
options: 玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。
玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。
折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。
optionsEn: Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature.

Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower.
Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃沒有熔點，只有黏度隨溫度連續變化的轉變區：退火點定義為黏度 10¹² Pa·s（10¹³ dPa·s）的溫度，應變點為 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s，兩者之間約 30 到 40 K。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Glass has no melting point, only a transition range in which viscosity changes continuously with temperature: the annealing point is defined at a viscosity of 10¹² Pa·s (10¹³ dPa·s), the strain point at 10¹³·⁵ Pa·s, roughly 30 to 40 K lower. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。退火點 η = 10¹² Pa·s 時 τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s；應變點 η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s 時 τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min；再低約 100 K 處 η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s，τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 天，應力已無法在製程時間內鬆弛。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa. At the annealing point, η = 10¹² Pa·s, τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s; at the strain point, η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s, τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min; about 100 K lower, η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s and τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 days, so stress can no longer relax within process time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較；由此校正該玻璃的退火點與應變點，而不是只依型錄值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction; use this to calibrate the annealing and strain points of that glass instead of relying only on catalogue values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

At the annealing point, η = 10¹² Pa·s, τ = 10¹²/3.4×10¹⁰ ≈ 29 s; at the strain point, η = 3.2×10¹³ Pa·s, τ ≈ 930 s ≈ 15 min; about 100 K lower, η ≈ 10¹⁶ Pa·s and τ ≈ 2.9×10⁵ s ≈ 3.4 days, so stress can no longer relax within process time.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time", which statement holds?
options: 退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。
型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。
optionsEn: Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness.
The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank.

quiz.explanation: N-BK7 的剪切模數 G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The shear modulus of N-BK7 is G = E/[2(1+ν)] = 82 GPa/(2×1.206) ≈ 34 GPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 取同一熔次的小試片，在幾個溫度下施加固定彎曲應變並以偏光儀即時觀察應力雙折射的衰減，擬合指數時間常數並與 η/G 預測比較；由此校正該玻璃的退火點與應變點，而不是只依型錄值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take small coupons from the same melt, apply a fixed bending strain at several temperatures and watch the stress birefringence decay in real time with a polarimeter, fit the exponential time constant and compare with the η/G prediction; use this to calibrate the annealing and strain points of that glass instead of relying only on catalogue values. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏度溫度曲線與退火點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Viscosity-temperature curve and annealing point” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把應變點以下的溫度當成仍可鬆弛的區間，程式在那裡放慢冷卻完全無效，而真正需要慢冷的退火點附近卻冷得太快，毛胚帶著殘餘應力出爐，拋光後面形隨材料去除而變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast; the blank leaves the furnace with residual stress and its figure changes as material is removed in polishing. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: N-BK7 has a transformation temperature near 557 °C, and precision annealing means cooling through this range at a controlled rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「玻璃轉變、黏度與應力鬆弛時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Glass transition, viscosity and stress-relaxation time" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Treating temperatures below the strain point as still relaxing wastes slow cooling there while the region near the annealing point that really needs it is cooled too fast.
Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.
