steps.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「假想溫度與折射率」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fictive temperature and refractive index” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。每把冷卻速率提高十倍，T_f 大約上升二十幾度，因此折射率與冷卻速率的對數成線性關係，玻璃廠以退火係數描述：n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀)。型錄折射率對應參考冷卻速率，任何後續的熱成形或模造若用不同速率冷卻，折射率就會偏離，必須重新退火或在設計中用實測值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「假想溫度與折射率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. Each tenfold increase in cooling rate raises T_f by roughly twenty-odd kelvin, so refractive index is linear in the logarithm of cooling rate, which glass makers express with an annealing coefficient: n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀). Catalogue indices correspond to a reference cooling rate, and any later hot forming or molding cooled at a different rate shifts the index, requiring re-annealing or the use of measured values in design. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fictive temperature and refractive index”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 T_g ≈ 830 K、活化能 E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol 估計，每十倍速率的 T_f 變化 ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimating with T_g ≈ 830 K and activation energy E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol, the change of T_f per decade of rate is ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「假想溫度與折射率」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fictive temperature and refractive index”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率
knowledge.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index
knowledge.text: 穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。每把冷卻速率提高十倍，T_f 大約上升二十幾度，因此折射率與冷卻速率的對數成線性關係，玻璃廠以退火係數描述：n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀)。
knowledge.textEn: On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. Each tenfold increase in cooling rate raises T_f by roughly twenty-odd kelvin, so refractive index is linear in the logarithm of cooling rate, which glass makers express with an annealing coefficient: n(h) = n(h₀) + m·log₁₀(h/h₀).

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷卻速率如何決定折射率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How cooling rate sets the refractive index" is correct?
options: 折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。
退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。
穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。
optionsEn: Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.
An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one.
On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f.
quiz.explanation: 穿過轉變區時，結構在某個溫度「凍結」，這個溫度稱為假想溫度 T_f；冷得越快，結構在越高的溫度凍結，密度越低，折射率也越低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: On passing through the transition range the structure freezes at some temperature called the fictive temperature T_f; faster cooling freezes the structure at a higher temperature with lower density and hence lower refractive index. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「假想溫度與折射率」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fictive temperature and refractive index” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 T_g ≈ 830 K、活化能 E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol 估計，每十倍速率的 T_f 變化 ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K。取教學值 m ≈ −1×10⁻³（每十倍）：冷卻速率比參考值快 10 倍時 n_d 低 0.001，慢 10 倍則高 0.001；dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹。要把折射率控制在 ±0.0002，速率必須落在參考值的 10^±0.2 即 0.63 到 1.6 倍之間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimating with T_g ≈ 830 K and activation energy E_a ≈ 500 kJ/mol, the change of T_f per decade of rate is ≈ ln10·R·T_g²/E_a = 2.303×8.314×830²/5×10⁵ ≈ 26 K. With a teaching value m ≈ −1×10⁻³ per decade, cooling 10 times faster than the reference rate lowers n_d by 0.001 and 10 times slower raises it by 0.001; dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹. Holding the index to ±0.0002 requires the rate to stay within 10^±0.2, i.e. 0.63 to 1.6 times the reference rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把同一熔次的試片分別以 0.5、5 與 50 K/h 冷卻，用 V 形塊折射儀或最小偏向角法量 n_d 到 10⁻⁵，將 n_d 對 log₁₀(h) 作圖，斜率就是該玻璃的實際退火係數，與玻璃廠公布值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cool coupons from the same melt at 0.5, 5 and 50 K/h, measure n_d to 10⁻⁵ with a V-block refractometer or the minimum-deviation method, plot n_d against log₁₀(h), and take the slope as the actual annealing coefficient of that glass for comparison with the maker's published value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

With a teaching value m ≈ −1×10⁻³ per decade, cooling 10 times faster than the reference rate lowers n_d by 0.001 and 10 times slower raises it by 0.001; dn/dT_f ≈ −0.001/26 ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹. steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「假想溫度與折射率」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fictive temperature and refractive index” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把同一熔次的試片分別以 0.5、5 與 50 K/h 冷卻，用 V 形塊折射儀或最小偏向角法量 n_d 到 10⁻⁵，將 n_d 對 log₁₀(h) 作圖，斜率就是該玻璃的實際退火係數，與玻璃廠公布值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cool coupons from the same melt at 0.5, 5 and 50 K/h, measure n_d to 10⁻⁵ with a V-block refractometer or the minimum-deviation method, plot n_d against log₁₀(h), and take the slope as the actual annealing coefficient of that glass for comparison with the maker's published value. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A molded lens cooled at tens of kelvin per minute has an index about 0.002 below catalogue; a design that keeps the catalogue value shifts focus beyond the depth of focus and the whole molded batch misses MTF, although its figure measurements pass completely.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 冷卻速率如何決定折射率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How cooling rate sets the refractive index: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「假想溫度與折射率」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fictive temperature and refractive index” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 模造鏡片以每分鐘數十度冷卻，折射率比型錄低約 0.002，若設計時沿用型錄值，焦距偏移超過景深，整批模造鏡片的 MTF 不達標，而面形量測卻完全合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A molded lens cooled at tens of kelvin per minute has an index about 0.002 below catalogue; a design that keeps the catalogue value shifts focus beyond the depth of focus and the whole molded batch misses MTF, although its figure measurements pass completely. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：型錄折射率對應參考冷卻速率，任何後續的熱成形或模造若用不同速率冷卻，折射率就會偏離，必須重新退火或在設計中用實測值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Catalogue indices correspond to a reference cooling rate, and any later hot forming or molding cooled at a different rate shifts the index, requiring re-annealing or the use of measured values in design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載」與「毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading" and "Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 精密退火爐是一個以多區加熱、厚重爐膛與輻射屏蔽把毛胚包起來的慢速溫控系統，目標不是加熱而是讓整個裝載區在冷卻過程中保持極小的空間溫差：橫向溫差會在凍結瞬間變成假想溫度差，直接轉成折射率的不均勻。熱電偶要靠近毛胚、定期以固定點或參考熱電偶校正，控制器以程式化的速率曲線運行數天到數週；毛胚放在耐火板與分離粉上，避免黏結與因接觸造成的局部熱流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A precision annealing furnace is a slow temperature-control system with multi-zone heating, a massive muffle and radiation shields enclosing the blanks; its purpose is not heating but keeping the spatial temperature difference across the load extremely small during cooling, because a lateral difference at the moment of freezing becomes a fictive-temperature difference and hence index inhomogeneity. Thermocouples sit close to the blanks and are calibrated regularly against fixed points or reference thermocouples, the controller runs a programmed rate curve over days to weeks, and blanks rest on refractory plates with parting powder to avoid sticking and local heat flow through contact. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ 計，裝載區在凍結時若有 1 K 的橫向溫差，毛胚內折射率差達 3.8×10⁻⁵，遠超 H2 級的 ±5×10⁻⁶；要達 H3 級的 ±2×10⁻⁶，溫差須小於約 0.05 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹, a lateral difference of 1 K across the load at freezing produces an index difference of 3.8×10⁻⁵ inside the blank, far beyond the ±5×10⁻⁶ of grade H2; reaching grade H3 at ±2×10⁻⁶ needs a difference below about 0.05 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載
knowledge.titleEn: Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading
knowledge.text: 精密退火爐是一個以多區加熱、厚重爐膛與輻射屏蔽把毛胚包起來的慢速溫控系統，目標不是加熱而是讓整個裝載區在冷卻過程中保持極小的空間溫差：橫向溫差會在凍結瞬間變成假想溫度差，直接轉成折射率的不均勻。熱電偶要靠近毛胚、定期以固定點或參考熱電偶校正，控制器以程式化的速率曲線運行數天到數週；毛胚放在耐火板與分離粉上，避免黏結與因接觸造成的局部熱流。
knowledge.textEn: A precision annealing furnace is a slow temperature-control system with multi-zone heating, a massive muffle and radiation shields enclosing the blanks; its purpose is not heating but keeping the spatial temperature difference across the load extremely small during cooling, because a lateral difference at the moment of freezing becomes a fictive-temperature difference and hence index inhomogeneity. Thermocouples sit close to the blanks and are calibrated regularly against fixed points or reference thermocouples, the controller runs a programmed rate curve over days to weeks, and blanks rest on refractory plates with parting powder to avoid sticking and local heat flow through contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading" is correct?

退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。
退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。
optionsEn: A precision annealing furnace is a slow temperature-control system with multi-zone heating, a massive muffle and radiation shields enclosing the blanks.
An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one.
Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness.
quiz.explanation: 精密退火爐是一個以多區加熱、厚重爐膛與輻射屏蔽把毛胚包起來的慢速溫控系統，目標不是加熱而是讓整個裝載區在冷卻過程中保持極小的空間溫差：橫向溫差會在凍結瞬間變成假想溫度差，直接轉成折射率的不均勻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ 計，裝載區在凍結時若有 1 K 的橫向溫差，毛胚內折射率差達 3.8×10⁻⁵，遠超 H2 級的 ±5×10⁻⁶；要達 H3 級的 ±2×10⁻⁶，溫差須小於約 0.05 K。黏度在退火點附近每 25 K 變化約一個數量級，所以熱電偶 5 K 的絕對誤差會讓鬆弛時間差 10^(5/25) ≈ 1.6 倍，保溫時間必須留此餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹, a lateral difference of 1 K across the load at freezing produces an index difference of 3.8×10⁻⁵ inside the blank, far beyond the ±5×10⁻⁶ of grade H2; reaching grade H3 at ±2×10⁻⁶ needs a difference below about 0.05 K. Viscosity changes by about one order of magnitude per 25 K near the annealing point, so a 5 K absolute thermocouple error changes relaxation time by 10^(5/25) ≈ 1.6 times, and the hold time must carry that margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在空爐與滿載時於裝載區放置多支校正過的熱電偶，記錄整個冷卻程式中各點溫度，計算最大橫向與縱向溫差隨時間的曲線；再把退火後毛胚的折射率均勻性圖與溫差分佈比對，確認兩者的空間圖樣相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place several calibrated thermocouples across the load zone with the furnace empty and fully loaded, log every point through the whole cooling programme and compute the maximum lateral and vertical differences versus time; then compare the index-homogeneity map of the annealed blank with the temperature-difference distribution to confirm that the spatial patterns correlate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ 計，裝載區在凍結時若有 1 K 的橫向溫差，毛胚內折射率差達 3.8×10⁻⁵，遠超 H2 級的 ±5×10⁻⁶；要達 H3 級的 ±2×10⁻⁶，溫差須小於約 0.05 K。黏度在退火點附近每 25 K 變化約一個數量級，所以熱電偶 5 K 的絕對誤差會讓鬆弛時間差 10^(5/25) ≈ 1.6 倍，保溫時間必須留此餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: With dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹, a lateral difference of 1 K across the load at freezing produces an index difference of 3.8×10⁻⁵ inside the blank, far beyond the ±5×10⁻⁶ of grade H2; reaching grade H3 at ±2×10⁻⁶ needs a difference below about 0.05 K. Viscosity changes by about one order of magnitude per 25 K near the annealing point, so a 5 K absolute thermocouple error changes relaxation time by 10^(5/25) ≈ 1.6 times, and the hold time must carry that margin.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading", which statement holds?
options: 型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。
以 dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ 計，裝載區在凍結時若有 1 K 的橫向溫差，毛胚內折射率差達 3.8×10⁻⁵，遠超 H2 級的 ±5×10⁻⁶。
同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。
optionsEn: The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank.
With dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹, a lateral difference of 1 K across the load at freezing produces an index difference of 3.8×10⁻⁵ inside the blank, far beyond the ±5×10⁻⁶ of grade H2.
Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt.
quiz.explanation: 以 dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ 計，裝載區在凍結時若有 1 K 的橫向溫差，毛胚內折射率差達 3.8×10⁻⁵，遠超 H2 級的 ±5×10⁻⁶；要達 H3 級的 ±2×10⁻⁶，溫差須小於約 0.05 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With dn/dT_f ≈ −3.8×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹, a lateral difference of 1 K across the load at freezing produces an index difference of 3.8×10⁻⁵ inside the blank, far beyond the ±5×10⁻⁶ of grade H2; reaching grade H3 at ±2×10⁻⁶ needs a difference below about 0.05 K. steps.title: 退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Precision annealing furnace and temperature uniformity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在空爐與滿載時於裝載區放置多支校正過的熱電偶，記錄整個冷卻程式中各點溫度，計算最大橫向與縱向溫差隨時間的曲線；再把退火後毛胚的折射率均勻性圖與溫差分佈比對，確認兩者的空間圖樣相關。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place several calibrated thermocouples across the load zone with the furnace empty and fully loaded, log every point through the whole cooling programme and compute the maximum lateral and vertical differences versus time; then compare the index-homogeneity map of the annealed blank with the temperature-difference distribution to confirm that the spatial patterns correlate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：爐門一側的隔熱老化後形成 0.5 K 的穩定梯度，整批毛胚的折射率沿同一方向出現 2×10⁻⁵ 的線性變化，對大口徑透鏡等效於一個無法用修形去除的楔形相位。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Degraded insulation on one side of the furnace door creates a stable 0.5 K gradient, every blank in the batch shows a 2×10⁻⁵ linear index variation in the same direction, and for a large lens this is a wedge-like phase error that figuring cannot remove.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Place several calibrated thermocouples across the load zone with the furnace empty and fully loaded, log every point through the whole cooling programme and compute the maximum lateral and vertical differences versus time; then compare the index-homogeneity map of the annealed blank with the temperature-difference distribution to confirm that the spatial patterns correlate.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annealing-furnace design: uniformity, thermocouples and loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「精密退火爐與溫度均勻性」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 爐門一側的隔熱老化後形成 0.5 K 的穩定梯度，整批毛胚的折射率沿同一方向出現 2×10⁻⁵ 的線性變化，對大口徑透鏡等效於一個無法用修形去除的楔形相位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Degraded insulation on one side of the furnace door creates a stable 0.5 K gradient, every blank in the batch shows a 2×10⁻⁵ linear index variation in the same direction, and for a large lens this is a wedge-like phase error that figuring cannot remove. steps.observation: 連結機制：熱電偶要靠近毛胚、定期以固定點或參考熱電偶校正，控制器以程式化的速率曲線運行數天到數週；毛胚放在耐火板與分離粉上，避免黏結與因接觸造成的局部熱流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thermocouples sit close to the blanks and are calibrated regularly against fixed points or reference thermocouples, the controller runs a programmed rate curve over days to weeks, and blanks rest on refractory plates with parting powder to avoid sticking and local heat flow through contact.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「退火爐設計：均勻性、熱電偶與裝載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以固定速率冷卻的玻璃板，中心比表面熱，溫差與速率成正比、與厚度平方成正比、與熱擴散率成反比。穿過轉變區時這個溫差被凍結：之後中心比表面多收縮，於是表面受壓、中心受拉，形成永久的殘餘應力；Adams 與 Williamson 在 1920 年給出永久應力與冷卻速率的正比關係，是退火程式設計的核心。厚毛胚因此需要極慢的冷卻，退火時間以週計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A glass plate cooled at a constant rate is hotter at its centre than at its surface, with a difference proportional to rate and to thickness squared and inversely proportional to thermal diffusivity. On passing through the transition range this difference is frozen: the centre then contracts more than the surface, leaving the surface in compression and the centre in tension as permanent residual stress; Adams and Williamson in 1920 gave the proportionality between permanent stress and cooling rate that underlies every annealing schedule. Thick blanks therefore need very slow cooling, with annealing times measured in weeks. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The centre-to-surface difference is ΔT = q·d²/(8a): N-BK7 has diffusivity a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s; with thickness d = 100 mm and rate q = 1 K/h = 2.78×10⁻⁴ K/s, ΔT ≈ 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(8×5.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 0.67 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係
knowledge.titleEn: Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation
knowledge.text: 以固定速率冷卻的玻璃板，中心比表面熱，溫差與速率成正比、與厚度平方成正比、與熱擴散率成反比。穿過轉變區時這個溫差被凍結：之後中心比表面多收縮，於是表面受壓、中心受拉，形成永久的殘餘應力；Adams 與 Williamson 在 1920 年給出永久應力與冷卻速率的正比關係，是退火程式設計的核心。
knowledge.textEn: A glass plate cooled at a constant rate is hotter at its centre than at its surface, with a difference proportional to rate and to thickness squared and inversely proportional to thermal diffusivity. On passing through the transition range this difference is frozen: the centre then contracts more than the surface, leaving the surface in compression and the centre in tension as permanent residual stress; Adams and Williamson in 1920 gave the proportionality between permanent stress and cooling rate that underlies every annealing schedule.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation" is correct?
options: 退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。
以固定速率冷卻的玻璃板，中心比表面熱，溫差與速率成正比、與厚度平方成正比、與熱擴散率成反比。
只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。
optionsEn: Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness.
A glass plate cooled at a constant rate is hotter at its centre than at its surface, with a difference proportional to rate and to thickness squared and inversely proportional to thermal diffusivity.
A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress.
quiz.explanation: 以固定速率冷卻的玻璃板，中心比表面熱，溫差與速率成正比、與厚度平方成正比、與熱擴散率成反比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A glass plate cooled at a constant rate is hotter at its centre than at its surface, with a difference proportional to rate and to thickness squared and inversely proportional to thermal diffusivity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：中心與表面溫差 ΔT = q·d²/(8a)：N-BK7 熱擴散率 a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s；厚度 d = 100 mm、速率 q = 1 K/h = 2.78×10⁻⁴ K/s 時 ΔT ≈ 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(8×5.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 0.67 K。表面永久應力 σ ≈ (2/3)·Eα/(1−ν)·ΔT，Eα/(1−ν) = 82×10⁹×7.1×10⁻⁶/0.794 ≈ 0.73 MPa/K，得 σ ≈ 0.33 MPa；速率降為 0.3 K/h 時 ΔT ≈ 0.20 K、σ ≈ 0.10 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The centre-to-surface difference is ΔT = q·d²/(8a): N-BK7 has diffusivity a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s; with thickness d = 100 mm and rate q = 1 K/h = 2.78×10⁻⁴ K/s, ΔT ≈ 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(8×5.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 0.67 K. The permanent surface stress is σ ≈ (2/3)·Eα/(1−ν)·ΔT with Eα/(1−ν) = 82×10⁹×7.1×10⁻⁶/0.794 ≈ 0.73 MPa/K, giving σ ≈ 0.33 MPa; at 0.3 K/h, ΔT ≈ 0.20 K and σ ≈ 0.10 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在一塊犧牲毛胚中心鑽孔埋入熱電偶，與表面熱電偶同步記錄冷卻過程，實測 ΔT 並與 q·d²/(8a) 比較以校正熱擴散率；退火後以偏光儀量中心與邊緣的應力雙折射，核對應力分佈是否呈拋物線且大小接近 Adams–Williamson 估計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Embed a thermocouple in a hole drilled to the centre of a sacrificial blank, log it together with a surface thermocouple during cooling, and compare the measured ΔT with q·d²/(8a) to calibrate the diffusivity; after annealing, measure the stress birefringence at centre and edge with a polarimeter and check that the distribution is parabolic with a magnitude close to the Adams–Williamson estimate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: The centre-to-surface difference is ΔT = q·d²/(8a): N-BK7 has diffusivity a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s; with thickness d = 100 mm and rate q = 1 K/h = 2.78×10⁻⁴ K/s, ΔT ≈ 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(8×5.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 0.67 K. The permanent surface stress is σ ≈ (2/3)·Eα/(1−ν)·ΔT with Eα/(1−ν) = 82×10⁹×7.1×10⁻⁶/0.794 ≈ 0.73 MPa/K, giving σ ≈ 0.33 MPa; at 0.3 K/h, ΔT ≈ 0.20 K and σ ≈ 0.10 MPa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation", which statement holds?
options: 退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。
玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。
中心與表面溫差 ΔT = q·d²/(8a)：N-BK7 熱擴散率 a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s。
optionsEn: A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate.
Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature.
The centre-to-surface difference is ΔT = q·d²/(8a): N-BK7 has diffusivity a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s.
quiz.explanationEn: The centre-to-surface difference is ΔT = q·d²/(8a): N-BK7 has diffusivity a = k/(ρc_p) = 1.114/(2510×858) ≈ 5.2×10⁻⁷ m²/s; with thickness d = 100 mm and rate q = 1 K/h = 2.78×10⁻⁴ K/s, ΔT ≈ 2.78×10⁻⁴×0.01/(8×5.2×10⁻⁷) ≈ 0.67 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在一塊犧牲毛胚中心鑽孔埋入熱電偶，與表面熱電偶同步記錄冷卻過程，實測 ΔT 並與 q·d²/(8a) 比較以校正熱擴散率；退火後以偏光儀量中心與邊緣的應力雙折射，核對應力分佈是否呈拋物線且大小接近 Adams–Williamson 估計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Embed a thermocouple in a hole drilled to the centre of a sacrificial blank, log it together with a surface thermocouple during cooling, and compare the measured ΔT with q·d²/(8a) to calibrate the diffusivity; after annealing, measure the stress birefringence at centre and edge with a polarimeter and check that the distribution is parabolic with a magnitude close to the Adams–Williamson estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 50 mm 毛胚的程式直接用在 100 mm 毛胚，溫差變成四倍，殘餘應力與雙折射也變成四倍，大塊毛胚切割時因應力釋放而翹曲甚至開裂。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying a 50 mm blank's schedule to a 100 mm blank quadruples the internal temperature difference and therefore the residual stress and birefringence, and the large blank warps or even cracks when cutting releases the stress.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 毛胚內溫差、凍結應力與 Adams–Williamson 關係：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal temperature difference, frozen stress and the Adams–Williamson relation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「毛胚厚度與熱擴散率」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Blank thickness and thermal diffusivity” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 50 mm 毛胚的程式直接用在 100 mm 毛胚，溫差變成四倍，殘餘應力與雙折射也變成四倍，大塊毛胚切割時因應力釋放而翹曲甚至開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.observation: 連結機制：厚毛胚因此需要極慢的冷卻，退火時間以週計。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級」與「折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence" and "Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏光儀與光彈常數」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 殘餘應力使玻璃成為弱雙折射材料，光程差與應力和光程長度成正比，比例係數是光彈常數 K。量測用偏光儀：Sénarmont 補償法把光程差轉成檢偏鏡的旋轉角，光彈調制器法則以交流訊號達到 0.1 nm 等級；結果以每公分光程的奈米數（nm/cm）表示，是玻璃型錄的分級量。因為毛胚內應力分佈為中心拉、表面壓，量測要在穿透厚度方向與多個位置進行，並以平均與最大值分別記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏光儀與光彈常數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Residual stress makes glass weakly birefringent, with an optical path difference proportional to stress and path length through the photoelastic constant K. It is measured with a polarimeter: the Sénarmont compensation method converts the path difference into an analyser rotation angle, and photoelastic-modulator methods reach the 0.1 nm level with an AC signal; the result is quoted in nanometres per centimetre of path (nm/cm), the grading quantity in glass catalogues. Because the stress is tensile at the centre and compressive at the surface, measurement is made through the thickness at several positions and reported as both mean and maximum. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：N-BK7 的光彈常數 K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹，即每 MPa 應力產生 2.77×10⁻⁶ 的 Δn，換算為 27.7 nm/cm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The photoelastic constant of N-BK7 is K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹, so each MPa of stress produces a Δn of 2.77×10⁻⁶, equivalent to 27.7 nm/cm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「偏光儀與光彈常數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級
knowledge.titleEn: Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence
knowledge.text: 殘餘應力使玻璃成為弱雙折射材料，光程差與應力和光程長度成正比，比例係數是光彈常數 K。量測用偏光儀：Sénarmont 補償法把光程差轉成檢偏鏡的旋轉角，光彈調制器法則以交流訊號達到 0.1 nm 等級；結果以每公分光程的奈米數（nm/cm）表示，是玻璃型錄的分級量。
knowledge.textEn: Residual stress makes glass weakly birefringent, with an optical path difference proportional to stress and path length through the photoelastic constant K. It is measured with a polarimeter: the Sénarmont compensation method converts the path difference into an analyser rotation angle, and photoelastic-modulator methods reach the 0.1 nm level with an AC signal; the result is quoted in nanometres per centimetre of path (nm/cm), the grading quantity in glass catalogues.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence" is correct?
options: 只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。
型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。
殘餘應力使玻璃成為弱雙折射材料，光程差與應力和光程長度成正比，比例係數是光彈常數 K。
optionsEn: A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress.
The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank.
Residual stress makes glass weakly birefringent, with an optical path difference proportional to stress and path length through the photoelastic constant K.
quiz.explanation: 殘餘應力使玻璃成為弱雙折射材料，光程差與應力和光程長度成正比，比例係數是光彈常數 K。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Residual stress makes glass weakly birefringent, with an optical path difference proportional to stress and path length through the photoelastic constant K. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏光儀與光彈常數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N-BK7 的光彈常數 K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹，即每 MPa 應力產生 2.77×10⁻⁶ 的 Δn，換算為 27.7 nm/cm。前一單元 1 K/h 冷卻的 0.33 MPa 對應約 9.1 nm/cm，超過 4 nm/cm 的精密退火等級；0.3 K/h 的 0.10 MPa 對應 2.7 nm/cm，合格。反過來，量到 6 nm/cm 就表示約 0.22 MPa 的應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The photoelastic constant of N-BK7 is K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹, so each MPa of stress produces a Δn of 2.77×10⁻⁶, equivalent to 27.7 nm/cm. The 0.33 MPa from 1 K/h cooling in the previous unit corresponds to about 9.1 nm/cm, beyond a 4 nm/cm precision-annealed grade; the 0.10 MPa from 0.3 K/h gives 2.7 nm/cm and passes. Conversely, a reading of 6 nm/cm implies about 0.22 MPa of stress. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用已知光程差的石英波片校正偏光儀的零點與線性，再對毛胚沿厚度方向在中心、半徑一半與邊緣各量數點，除以實際路徑長度得到 nm/cm；用熔融石英參考片確認背景讀值低於 0.5 nm/cm，並比較兩個正交方向的讀值以區分應力與材料本質雙折射。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the polarimeter's zero and linearity with quartz waveplates of known retardation, then measure the blank through its thickness at the centre, half radius and edge and divide by the actual path length to obtain nm/cm; confirm with a fused-silica reference that the background reading is below 0.5 nm/cm, and compare two orthogonal orientations to separate stress from intrinsic material birefringence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: N-BK7 的光彈常數 K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹，即每 MPa 應力產生 2.77×10⁻⁶ 的 Δn，換算為 27.7 nm/cm。前一單元 1 K/h 冷卻的 0.33 MPa 對應約 9.1 nm/cm，超過 4 nm/cm 的精密退火等級；0.3 K/h 的 0.10 MPa 對應 2.7 nm/cm，合格。反過來，量到 6 nm/cm 就表示約 0.22 MPa 的應力。

The 0.33 MPa from 1 K/h cooling in the previous unit corresponds to about 9.1 nm/cm, beyond a 4 nm/cm precision-annealed grade; the 0.10 MPa from 0.3 K/h gives 2.7 nm/cm and passes. Conversely, a reading of 6 nm/cm implies about 0.22 MPa of stress.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence", which statement holds?

optionsEn: The photoelastic constant of N-BK7 is K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹, so each MPa of stress produces a Δn of 2.77×10⁻⁶, equivalent to 27.7 nm/cm.
Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt.
Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.
quiz.explanation: N-BK7 的光彈常數 K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹，即每 MPa 應力產生 2.77×10⁻⁶ 的 Δn，換算為 27.7 nm/cm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The photoelastic constant of N-BK7 is K ≈ 2.77×10⁻⁶ mm²/N = 2.77×10⁻¹² Pa⁻¹, so each MPa of stress produces a Δn of 2.77×10⁻⁶, equivalent to 27.7 nm/cm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偏光儀與光彈常數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先用已知光程差的石英波片校正偏光儀的零點與線性，再對毛胚沿厚度方向在中心、半徑一半與邊緣各量數點，除以實際路徑長度得到 nm/cm；用熔融石英參考片確認背景讀值低於 0.5 nm/cm，並比較兩個正交方向的讀值以區分應力與材料本質雙折射。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the polarimeter's zero and linearity with quartz waveplates of known retardation, then measure the blank through its thickness at the centre, half radius and edge and divide by the actual path length to obtain nm/cm; confirm with a fused-silica reference that the background reading is below 0.5 nm/cm, and compare two orthogonal orientations to separate stress from intrinsic material birefringence. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：量測時以毛胚標稱厚度而非實際厚度換算 nm/cm，或量測點集中在應力為零的中性面附近，報告低估最大應力，鏡片在精磨減薄後因應力重新分佈而彎曲，面形失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Converting to nm/cm with the nominal instead of the actual thickness, or measuring only near the stress-free neutral plane, understates the maximum stress; the lens then bends when fine grinding thins it and redistributes the stress, and its figure fails.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。

steps.title: 殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring and grading residual stress birefringence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏光儀與光彈常數」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Polarimeter and photoelastic constant” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 量測時以毛胚標稱厚度而非實際厚度換算 nm/cm，或量測點集中在應力為零的中性面附近，報告低估最大應力，鏡片在精磨減薄後因應力重新分佈而彎曲，面形失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Converting to nm/cm with the nominal instead of the actual thickness, or measuring only near the stress-free neutral plane, understates the maximum stress; the lens then bends when fine grinding thins it and redistributes the stress, and its figure fails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為毛胚內應力分佈為中心拉、表面壓，量測要在穿透厚度方向與多個位置進行，並以平均與最大值分別記錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the stress is tensile at the centre and compressive at the surface, measurement is made through the thickness at several positions and reported as both mean and maximum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 量測時以毛胚標稱厚度而非實際厚度換算 nm/cm，或量測點集中在應力為零的中性面附近，報告低估最大應力，鏡片在精磨減薄後因應力重新分佈而彎曲，面形失效。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「殘餘應力雙折射的量測與分級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank.
Converting to nm/cm with the nominal instead of the actual thickness, or measuring only near the stress-free neutral plane, understates the maximum stress.

steps.title: 折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 折射率以 V 形塊折射儀（精度約 1×10⁻⁵）或光譜測角儀的最小偏向角法（可達數個 10⁻⁶）在多條譜線量測，Abbe 數由 n_d、n_F、n_C 算出；均勻性則用干涉儀量穿透波前：把毛胚磨成平行板後量透射波前，扣除兩個表面的面形貢獻（以油浸或分別量測表面的方法）後，剩餘波前除以厚度就是折射率的空間變化。這些量的不確定度要與公差等級一起寫進熔次資料表，因為設計端會依此決定是否需要重算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Refractive index is measured on several spectral lines with a V-block refractometer (about 1×10⁻⁵) or by the minimum-deviation method on a spectral goniometer (a few 10⁻⁶), and the Abbe number follows from n_d, n_F and n_C; homogeneity is measured interferometrically on the transmitted wavefront: the blank is worked into a parallel plate, the transmitted wavefront is measured, the contributions of the two surfaces are removed by oil immersion or by separate surface measurements, and the remaining wavefront divided by thickness gives the spatial index variation. The uncertainties of these quantities must appear in the melt data sheet together with the tolerance grades, because the design side decides from them whether a recompute is needed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：透射波前 W = Δn·L：厚度 L = 100 mm 的毛胚若扣除表面後波前 PV 為 50 nm，Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷，優於 H4 的 ±1×10⁻⁶；干涉儀 10 nm 的不確定度對應 1×10⁻⁷ 的折射率不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The transmitted wavefront is W = Δn·L: for a 100 mm thick blank with a surface-corrected wavefront PV of 50 nm, Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷, better than the ±1×10⁻⁶ of grade H4; an interferometer uncertainty of 10 nm corresponds to an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁷.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度
knowledge.titleEn: Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty
knowledge.text: 折射率以 V 形塊折射儀（精度約 1×10⁻⁵）或光譜測角儀的最小偏向角法（可達數個 10⁻⁶）在多條譜線量測，Abbe 數由 n_d、n_F、n_C 算出；均勻性則用干涉儀量穿透波前：把毛胚磨成平行板後量透射波前，扣除兩個表面的面形貢獻（以油浸或分別量測表面的方法）後，剩餘波前除以厚度就是折射率的空間變化。這些量的不確定度要與公差等級一起寫進熔次資料表，因為設計端會依此決定是否需要重算。

The uncertainties of these quantities must appear in the melt data sheet together with the tolerance grades, because the design side decides from them whether a recompute is needed.

steps.title: 折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：透射波前 W = Δn·L：厚度 L = 100 mm 的毛胚若扣除表面後波前 PV 為 50 nm，Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷，優於 H4 的 ±1×10⁻⁶；干涉儀 10 nm 的不確定度對應 1×10⁻⁷ 的折射率不確定度。折射率量測不確定度 1×10⁻⁵ 時，Abbe 數 ν_d = (n_d − 1)/(n_F − n_C) 的不確定度約 (n_F − n_C) 誤差 1.4×10⁻⁵ 除以 0.00806 乘以 64，約 ±0.11。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The transmitted wavefront is W = Δn·L: for a 100 mm thick blank with a surface-corrected wavefront PV of 50 nm, Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷, better than the ±1×10⁻⁶ of grade H4; an interferometer uncertainty of 10 nm corresponds to an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁷. With an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁵, the Abbe number ν_d = (n_d − 1)/(n_F − n_C) carries an uncertainty of roughly the (n_F − n_C) error 1.4×10⁻⁵ divided by 0.00806 times 64, about ±0.11. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以經校正的參考玻璃（已知 n_d 到 10⁻⁶）檢查折射儀的偏差，每天記錄；均勻性量測前後各量一次空腔，確認干涉儀參考面與環境漂移小於 5 nm；把兩次獨立安裝的均勻性圖相減，殘差 RMS 應小於宣稱不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the refractometer's bias daily with a calibrated reference glass of known n_d to 10⁻⁶; measure the empty cavity before and after each homogeneity measurement to confirm that reference-surface and environmental drift stay below 5 nm; subtract two homogeneity maps from independent mountings and confirm that the residual RMS is below the claimed uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 透射波前 W = Δn·L：厚度 L = 100 mm 的毛胚若扣除表面後波前 PV 為 50 nm，Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷，優於 H4 的 ±1×10⁻⁶；干涉儀 10 nm 的不確定度對應 1×10⁻⁷ 的折射率不確定度。折射率量測不確定度 1×10⁻⁵ 時，Abbe 數 ν_d = (n_d − 1)/(n_F − n_C) 的不確定度約 (n_F − n_C) 誤差 1.4×10⁻⁵ 除以 0.00806 乘以 64，約 ±0.11。
knowledge.textEn: The transmitted wavefront is W = Δn·L: for a 100 mm thick blank with a surface-corrected wavefront PV of 50 nm, Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷, better than the ±1×10⁻⁶ of grade H4; an interferometer uncertainty of 10 nm corresponds to an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁷. With an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁵, the Abbe number ν_d = (n_d − 1)/(n_F − n_C) carries an uncertainty of roughly the (n_F − n_C) error 1.4×10⁻⁵ divided by 0.00806 times 64, about ±0.11.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。
透射波前 W = Δn·L：厚度 L = 100 mm 的毛胚若扣除表面後波前 PV 為 50 nm，Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷，優於 H4 的 ±1×10⁻⁶。
退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。
optionsEn: Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature.
The transmitted wavefront is W = Δn·L: for a 100 mm thick blank with a surface-corrected wavefront PV of 50 nm, Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷, better than the ±1×10⁻⁶ of grade H4.
An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one.
quiz.explanation: 透射波前 W = Δn·L：厚度 L = 100 mm 的毛胚若扣除表面後波前 PV 為 50 nm，Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷，優於 H4 的 ±1×10⁻⁶；干涉儀 10 nm 的不確定度對應 1×10⁻⁷ 的折射率不確定度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The transmitted wavefront is W = Δn·L: for a 100 mm thick blank with a surface-corrected wavefront PV of 50 nm, Δn = 50×10⁻⁹/0.1 = 5×10⁻⁷, better than the ±1×10⁻⁶ of grade H4; an interferometer uncertainty of 10 nm corresponds to an index uncertainty of 1×10⁻⁷. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以經校正的參考玻璃（已知 n_d 到 10⁻⁶）檢查折射儀的偏差，每天記錄；均勻性量測前後各量一次空腔，確認干涉儀參考面與環境漂移小於 5 nm；把兩次獨立安裝的均勻性圖相減，殘差 RMS 應小於宣稱不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the refractometer's bias daily with a calibrated reference glass of known n_d to 10⁻⁶; measure the empty cavity before and after each homogeneity measurement to confirm that reference-surface and environmental drift stay below 5 nm; subtract two homogeneity maps from independent mountings and confirm that the residual RMS is below the claimed uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：均勻性量測若未扣除毛胚表面的面形，表面 100 nm 的彎曲被當成體內折射率變化，報告錯判為 H2 級而被降價出售，或反過來把真正不均勻的毛胚判為合格而流入大口徑鏡頭。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the blank's surface figure is not removed from the homogeneity measurement, 100 nm of surface curvature is read as bulk index variation and the blank is wrongly graded H2 and sold down, or conversely a truly inhomogeneous blank passes and ends up in a large-aperture lens.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以經校正的參考玻璃（已知 n_d 到 10⁻⁶）檢查折射儀的偏差，每天記錄；均勻性量測前後各量一次空腔，確認干涉儀參考面與環境漂移小於 5 nm；把兩次獨立安裝的均勻性圖相減，殘差 RMS 應小於宣稱不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Check the refractometer's bias daily with a calibrated reference glass of known n_d to 10⁻⁶; measure the empty cavity before and after each homogeneity measurement to confirm that reference-surface and environmental drift stay below 5 nm; subtract two homogeneity maps from independent mountings and confirm that the residual RMS is below the claimed uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。
以經校正的參考玻璃（已知 n_d 到 10⁻⁶）檢查折射儀的偏差，每天記錄。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness.
Check the refractometer's bias daily with a calibrated reference glass of known n_d to 10⁻⁶.
quiz.explanation: 以經校正的參考玻璃（已知 n_d 到 10⁻⁶）檢查折射儀的偏差，每天記錄；均勻性量測前後各量一次空腔，確認干涉儀參考面與環境漂移小於 5 nm；把兩次獨立安裝的均勻性圖相減，殘差 RMS 應小於宣稱不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the refractometer's bias daily with a calibrated reference glass of known n_d to 10⁻⁶; measure the empty cavity before and after each homogeneity measurement to confirm that reference-surface and environmental drift stay below 5 nm; subtract two homogeneity maps from independent mountings and confirm that the residual RMS is below the claimed uncertainty. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「折射儀與均勻性干涉量測」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Refractometer and homogeneity interferometry” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 均勻性量測若未扣除毛胚表面的面形，表面 100 nm 的彎曲被當成體內折射率變化，報告錯判為 H2 級而被降價出售，或反過來把真正不均勻的毛胚判為合格而流入大口徑鏡頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the blank's surface figure is not removed from the homogeneity measurement, 100 nm of surface curvature is read as bulk index variation and the blank is wrongly graded H2 and sold down, or conversely a truly inhomogeneous blank passes and ends up in a large-aperture lens. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些量的不確定度要與公差等級一起寫進熔次資料表，因為設計端會依此決定是否需要重算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The uncertainties of these quantities must appear in the melt data sheet together with the tolerance grades, because the design side decides from them whether a recompute is needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 均勻性量測若未扣除毛胚表面的面形，表面 100 nm 的彎曲被當成體內折射率變化，報告錯判為 H2 級而被降價出售，或反過來把真正不均勻的毛胚判為合格而流入大口徑鏡頭。
knowledge.textEn: If the blank's surface figure is not removed from the homogeneity measurement, 100 nm of surface curvature is read as bulk index variation and the blank is wrongly graded H2 and sold down, or conversely a truly inhomogeneous blank passes and ends up in a large-aperture lens.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「折射率、Abbe 數與均勻性的量測與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measuring index, Abbe number and homogeneity with uncertainty" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 均勻性量測若未扣除毛胚表面的面形，表面 100 nm 的彎曲被當成體內折射率變化，報告錯判為 H2 級而被降價出售，或反過來把真正不均勻的毛胚判為合格而流入大口徑鏡頭。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。
optionsEn: If the blank's surface figure is not removed from the homogeneity measurement, 100 nm of surface curvature is read as bulk index variation and the blank is wrongly graded H2 and sold down, or conversely a truly inhomogeneous blank passes and ends up in a large-aperture lens.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate.
quiz.explanation: 均勻性量測若未扣除毛胚表面的面形，表面 100 nm 的彎曲被當成體內折射率變化，報告錯判為 H2 級而被降價出售，或反過來把真正不均勻的毛胚判為合格而流入大口徑鏡頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the blank's surface figure is not removed from the homogeneity measurement, 100 nm of surface curvature is read as bulk index variation and the blank is wrongly graded H2 and sold down, or conversely a truly inhomogeneous blank passes and ends up in a large-aperture lens. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合」與「熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated" and "Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整的退火程式由四段組成：升溫到退火點附近並保溫足夠時間讓既有應力鬆弛與溫度均勻；以慢速率穿過退火點到應變點的轉變區，這一段決定折射率與永久應力；過了應變點後以較快速率冷卻，此時溫差只造成暫時的彈性應力，不再凍結，但仍須低於玻璃的破裂強度；最後接近室溫時再減速避免熱衝擊。速率切換點與各段速率都由前面的鬆弛時間、Adams–Williamson 應力與折射率公差共同決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A complete schedule has four segments: heating to near the annealing point and holding long enough for existing stress to relax and the temperature to equalise; cooling slowly through the transition range from annealing to strain point, the segment that fixes index and permanent stress; cooling faster below the strain point, where the temperature difference causes only transient elastic stress that no longer freezes but must stay below the fracture strength of the glass; and slowing again near room temperature to avoid thermal shock. The switch points and each segment's rate follow jointly from the relaxation times, the Adams–Williamson stress and the index tolerance derived earlier. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 mm N-BK7：保溫 2 h（約 250 個 29 s 的鬆弛時間常數）；以 0.3 K/h 從 560 °C 冷到 480 °C，80 K 需 267 h ≈ 11 天；再以 5 K/h 冷到 20 °C，460 K 需 92 h ≈ 3.8 天，此段暫時溫差 ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K，暫時應力 ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa，遠低於約 50 MPa 的設計強度；若改用 50 K/h，暫時應力達 17 MPa，對含表面缺陷的大毛胚已有破裂風險。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For 100 mm N-BK7: hold 2 h (about 250 relaxation constants of 29 s); cool at 0.3 K/h from 560 °C to 480 °C, 80 K in 267 h ≈ 11 days; then cool at 5 K/h to 20 °C, 460 K in 92 h ≈ 3.8 days, during which the transient difference ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K gives a transient stress ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa, far below a design strength of about 50 MPa; at 50 K/h the transient stress would reach 17 MPa, already a fracture risk for a large blank with surface flaws.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合
knowledge.titleEn: Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated
knowledge.text: 完整的退火程式由四段組成：升溫到退火點附近並保溫足夠時間讓既有應力鬆弛與溫度均勻；以慢速率穿過退火點到應變點的轉變區，這一段決定折射率與永久應力；過了應變點後以較快速率冷卻，此時溫差只造成暫時的彈性應力，不再凍結，但仍須低於玻璃的破裂強度；最後接近室溫時再減速避免熱衝擊。速率切換點與各段速率都由前面的鬆弛時間、Adams–Williamson 應力與折射率公差共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: A complete schedule has four segments: heating to near the annealing point and holding long enough for existing stress to relax and the temperature to equalise; cooling slowly through the transition range from annealing to strain point, the segment that fixes index and permanent stress; cooling faster below the strain point, where the temperature difference causes only transient elastic stress that no longer freezes but must stay below the fracture strength of the glass; and slowing again near room temperature to avoid thermal shock. The switch points and each segment's rate follow jointly from the relaxation times, the Adams–Williamson stress and the index tolerance derived earlier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated" is correct?
options: 退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。
完整的退火程式由四段組成：升溫到退火點附近並保溫足夠時間讓既有應力鬆弛與溫度均勻。
同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。
optionsEn: A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate.
A complete schedule has four segments: heating to near the annealing point and holding long enough for existing stress to relax and the temperature to equalise.
