quiz.explanationEn: A complete schedule has four segments: heating to near the annealing point and holding long enough for existing stress to relax and the temperature to equalise; cooling slowly through the transition range from annealing to strain point, the segment that fixes index and permanent stress; cooling faster below the strain point, where the temperature difference causes only transient elastic stress that no longer freezes but must stay below the fracture strength of the glass; and slowing again near room temperature to avoid thermal shock. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 mm N-BK7：保溫 2 h（約 250 個 29 s 的鬆弛時間常數）；以 0.3 K/h 從 560 °C 冷到 480 °C，80 K 需 267 h ≈ 11 天；再以 5 K/h 冷到 20 °C，460 K 需 92 h ≈ 3.8 天，此段暫時溫差 ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K，暫時應力 ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa，遠低於約 50 MPa 的設計強度；若改用 50 K/h，暫時應力達 17 MPa，對含表面缺陷的大毛胚已有破裂風險。全程約 15 天。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For 100 mm N-BK7: hold 2 h (about 250 relaxation constants of 29 s); cool at 0.3 K/h from 560 °C to 480 °C, 80 K in 267 h ≈ 11 days; then cool at 5 K/h to 20 °C, 460 K in 92 h ≈ 3.8 days, during which the transient difference ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K gives a transient stress ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa, far below a design strength of about 50 MPa; at 50 K/h the transient stress would reach 17 MPa, already a fracture risk for a large blank with surface flaws. The whole schedule takes about 15 days. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把程式輸入控制器後以空爐試跑並記錄實際溫度曲線，確認每段速率誤差小於 10%、切換點無過衝；正式批次完成後量折射率、雙折射與均勻性，與程式設計時的預測值（n_d 偏移、nm/cm）逐項比較，差異超過預算就回頭修正速率或保溫時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load the schedule into the controller, run it with an empty furnace and record the actual curve to confirm that each segment's rate error is below 10% and the switch points show no overshoot; after the production batch, measure index, birefringence and homogeneity and compare each with the predictions made when the schedule was designed (n_d shift, nm/cm), revising rates or hold time when a difference exceeds budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 100 mm N-BK7：保溫 2 h（約 250 個 29 s 的鬆弛時間常數）；以 0.3 K/h 從 560 °C 冷到 480 °C，80 K 需 267 h ≈ 11 天；再以 5 K/h 冷到 20 °C，460 K 需 92 h ≈ 3.8 天，此段暫時溫差 ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K，暫時應力 ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa，遠低於約 50 MPa 的設計強度；若改用 50 K/h，暫時應力達 17 MPa，對含表面缺陷的大毛胚已有破裂風險。全程約 15 天。
knowledge.textEn: For 100 mm N-BK7: hold 2 h (about 250 relaxation constants of 29 s); cool at 0.3 K/h from 560 °C to 480 °C, 80 K in 267 h ≈ 11 days; then cool at 5 K/h to 20 °C, 460 K in 92 h ≈ 3.8 days, during which the transient difference ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K gives a transient stress ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa, far below a design strength of about 50 MPa; at 50 K/h the transient stress would reach 17 MPa, already a fracture risk for a large blank with surface flaws. The whole schedule takes about 15 days.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated", which statement holds?
options: 折射率是玻璃成分決定的常數，與熱歷史無關。
退火時間只和玻璃種類有關，與毛胚厚度無關。
100 mm N-BK7：保溫 2 h（約 250 個 29 s 的鬆弛時間常數）。
optionsEn: Refractive index is a constant fixed by composition, independent of thermal history.
Annealing time depends only on the glass type, not on blank thickness.
For 100 mm N-BK7: hold 2 h (about 250 relaxation constants of 29 s).
quiz.explanation: 100 mm N-BK7：保溫 2 h（約 250 個 29 s 的鬆弛時間常數）；以 0.3 K/h 從 560 °C 冷到 480 °C，80 K 需 267 h ≈ 11 天；再以 5 K/h 冷到 20 °C，460 K 需 92 h ≈ 3.8 天，此段暫時溫差 ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K，暫時應力 ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa，遠低於約 50 MPa 的設計強度；若改用 50 K/h，暫時應力達 17 MPa，對含表面缺陷的大毛胚已有破裂風險。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For 100 mm N-BK7: hold 2 h (about 250 relaxation constants of 29 s); cool at 0.3 K/h from 560 °C to 480 °C, 80 K in 267 h ≈ 11 days; then cool at 5 K/h to 20 °C, 460 K in 92 h ≈ 3.8 days, during which the transient difference ΔT = 0.67×5 ≈ 3.4 K gives a transient stress ≈ 0.73×3.4×2/3 ≈ 1.7 MPa, far below a design strength of about 50 MPa; at 50 K/h the transient stress would reach 17 MPa, already a fracture risk for a large blank with surface flaws. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把程式輸入控制器後以空爐試跑並記錄實際溫度曲線，確認每段速率誤差小於 10%、切換點無過衝；正式批次完成後量折射率、雙折射與均勻性，與程式設計時的預測值（n_d 偏移、nm/cm）逐項比較，差異超過預算就回頭修正速率或保溫時間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Load the schedule into the controller, run it with an empty furnace and record the actual curve to confirm that each segment's rate error is below 10% and the switch points show no overshoot; after the production batch, measure index, birefringence and homogeneity and compare each with the predictions made when the schedule was designed (n_d shift, nm/cm), revising rates or hold time when a difference exceeds budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為縮短週期把慢冷段從 0.3 提高到 1 K/h，殘餘應力升到 9 nm/cm、折射率比參考值低約 0.0005，整批毛胚從精密級降為標準級，省下的 8 天抵不過降級的損失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the slow-cool segment from 0.3 to 1 K/h to shorten the cycle lifts residual stress to 9 nm/cm and lowers the index by about 0.0005 relative to the reference, downgrading the whole batch from precision to standard grade, and the 8 days saved never repay the loss.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把程式輸入控制器後以空爐試跑並記錄實際溫度曲線，確認每段速率誤差小於 10%、切換點無過衝；正式批次完成後量折射率、雙折射與均勻性，與程式設計時的預測值（n_d 偏移、nm/cm）逐項比較，差異超過預算就回頭修正速率或保溫時間。
knowledge.textEn: Load the schedule into the controller, run it with an empty furnace and record the actual curve to confirm that each segment's rate error is below 10% and the switch points show no overshoot; after the production batch, measure index, birefringence and homogeneity and compare each with the predictions made when the schedule was designed (n_d shift, nm/cm), revising rates or hold time when a difference exceeds budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated"?
options: 把程式輸入控制器後以空爐試跑並記錄實際溫度曲線，確認每段速率誤差小於 10%、切換點無過衝。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。
optionsEn: Load the schedule into the controller, run it with an empty furnace and record the actual curve to confirm that each segment's rate error is below 10% and the switch points show no overshoot.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress.
quiz.explanation: 把程式輸入控制器後以空爐試跑並記錄實際溫度曲線，確認每段速率誤差小於 10%、切換點無過衝；正式批次完成後量折射率、雙折射與均勻性，與程式設計時的預測值（n_d 偏移、nm/cm）逐項比較，差異超過預算就回頭修正速率或保溫時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Load the schedule into the controller, run it with an empty furnace and record the actual curve to confirm that each segment's rate error is below 10% and the switch points show no overshoot; after the production batch, measure index, birefringence and homogeneity and compare each with the predictions made when the schedule was designed (n_d shift, nm/cm), revising rates or hold time when a difference exceeds budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「退火程式曲線與速率切換點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Annealing schedule curve and rate switch points” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為縮短週期把慢冷段從 0.3 提高到 1 K/h，殘餘應力升到 9 nm/cm、折射率比參考值低約 0.0005，整批毛胚從精密級降為標準級，省下的 8 天抵不過降級的損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the slow-cool segment from 0.3 to 1 K/h to shorten the cycle lifts residual stress to 9 nm/cm and lowers the index by about 0.0005 relative to the reference, downgrading the whole batch from precision to standard grade, and the 8 days saved never repay the loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速率切換點與各段速率都由前面的鬆弛時間、Adams–Williamson 應力與折射率公差共同決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The switch points and each segment's rate follow jointly from the relaxation times, the Adams–Williamson stress and the index tolerance derived earlier.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「退火程式越慢越好，速率沒有下限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A slower annealing schedule is always better, with no lower limit on rate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為縮短週期把慢冷段從 0.3 提高到 1 K/h，殘餘應力升到 9 nm/cm、折射率比參考值低約 0.0005，整批毛胚從精密級降為標準級，省下的 8 天抵不過降級的損失。
knowledge.textEn: Raising the slow-cool segment from 0.3 to 1 K/h to shorten the cycle lifts residual stress to 9 nm/cm and lowers the index by about 0.0005 relative to the reference, downgrading the whole batch from precision to standard grade, and the 8 days saved never repay the loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「退火程式設計：保溫、慢冷與快冷的整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Schedule design: hold, slow cool and fast cool integrated" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
為縮短週期把慢冷段從 0.3 提高到 1 K/h，殘餘應力升到 9 nm/cm、折射率比參考值低約 0.0005，整批毛胚從精密級降為標準級，省下的 8 天抵不過降級的損失。
同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Raising the slow-cool segment from 0.3 to 1 K/h to shorten the cycle lifts residual stress to 9 nm/cm and lowers the index by about 0.0005 relative to the reference, downgrading the whole batch from precision to standard grade, and the 8 days saved never repay the loss.
Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt.
quiz.explanation: 為縮短週期把慢冷段從 0.3 提高到 1 K/h，殘餘應力升到 9 nm/cm、折射率比參考值低約 0.0005，整批毛胚從精密級降為標準級，省下的 8 天抵不過降級的損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising the slow-cool segment from 0.3 to 1 K/h to shorten the cycle lifts residual stress to 9 nm/cm and lowers the index by about 0.0005 relative to the reference, downgrading the whole batch from precision to standard grade, and the 8 days saved never repay the loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熔次資料表與設計重算」如何決定光學玻璃精密退火的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Melt data sheet and design recompute” determines the key performance of “Precision annealing of optical glass”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 退火完成的毛胚以熔次資料表交付：實測的 n_d、ν_d 與各譜線折射率、折射率與 Abbe 數的公差等級、應力雙折射（nm/cm）、均勻性等級、條紋與氣泡等級，以及退火速率與量測不確定度。光學設計端拿到實測值後進行「熔次重算」：把設計中的型錄折射率換成實測值，重新最佳化曲率、厚度或空氣間隔，再把修正後的加工圖交給光學工廠。沒有這一步，精密退火得到的折射率精度就白費了。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熔次資料表與設計重算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An annealed blank is delivered with a melt data sheet: measured n_d, ν_d and indices at each spectral line, the tolerance grades for index and Abbe number, stress birefringence in nm/cm, homogeneity grade, striae and bubble classes, plus the annealing rate and measurement uncertainties. The optical designer then performs a melt recompute, replacing catalogue indices in the design with measured values and re-optimising radii, thicknesses or air spaces before releasing corrected fabrication drawings to the optics shop. Without this step the index accuracy won by precision annealing is simply wasted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Melt data sheet and design recompute”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：薄透鏡焦距對折射率的靈敏度 Δf/f = −Δn/(n − 1)：熔次實測 n_d = 1.5171 而設計用 1.5168，Δn = +0.0003，f = 100 mm 時 Δf = −100×0.0003/0.5168 ≈ −58 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thin-lens focal sensitivity to index is Δf/f = −Δn/(n − 1): with a melt value n_d = 1.5171 against a design value of 1.5168, Δn = +0.0003, and for f = 100 mm, Δf = −100×0.0003/0.5168 ≈ −58 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熔次資料表與設計重算」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Melt data sheet and design recompute”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 退火完成的毛胚以熔次資料表交付：實測的 n_d、ν_d 與各譜線折射率、折射率與 Abbe 數的公差等級、應力雙折射（nm/cm）、均勻性等級、條紋與氣泡等級，以及退火速率與量測不確定度。光學設計端拿到實測值後進行「熔次重算」：把設計中的型錄折射率換成實測值，重新最佳化曲率、厚度或空氣間隔，再把修正後的加工圖交給光學工廠。
knowledge.textEn: An annealed blank is delivered with a melt data sheet: measured n_d, ν_d and indices at each spectral line, the tolerance grades for index and Abbe number, stress birefringence in nm/cm, homogeneity grade, striae and bubble classes, plus the annealing rate and measurement uncertainties. The optical designer then performs a melt recompute, replacing catalogue indices in the design with measured values and re-optimising radii, thicknesses or air spaces before releasing corrected fabrication drawings to the optics shop.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。
玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。
退火完成的毛胚以熔次資料表交付：實測的 n_d、ν_d 與各譜線折射率、折射率與 Abbe 數的公差等級、應力雙折射（nm/cm）、均勻性等級、條紋與氣泡等級，以及退火速率與量測不確定度。
optionsEn: Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt.
Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature.

An annealed blank is delivered with a melt data sheet: measured n_d, ν_d and indices at each spectral line, the tolerance grades for index and Abbe number, stress birefringence in nm/cm, homogeneity grade, striae and bubble classes, plus the annealing rate and measurement uncertainties.
quiz.explanation: 退火完成的毛胚以熔次資料表交付：實測的 n_d、ν_d 與各譜線折射率、折射率與 Abbe 數的公差等級、應力雙折射（nm/cm）、均勻性等級、條紋與氣泡等級，以及退火速率與量測不確定度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An annealed blank is delivered with a melt data sheet: measured n_d, ν_d and indices at each spectral line, the tolerance grades for index and Abbe number, stress birefringence in nm/cm, homogeneity grade, striae and bubble classes, plus the annealing rate and measurement uncertainties. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熔次資料表與設計重算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Melt data sheet and design recompute” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：薄透鏡焦距對折射率的靈敏度 Δf/f = −Δn/(n − 1)：熔次實測 n_d = 1.5171 而設計用 1.5168，Δn = +0.0003，f = 100 mm 時 Δf = −100×0.0003/0.5168 ≈ −58 µm。f/4 系統在 550 nm 的焦深約 ±2λ(f/#)² = ±2×0.55×16 ≈ ±18 µm，焦距偏移是焦深的 3 倍，必須重算或調整空氣間隔。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thin-lens focal sensitivity to index is Δf/f = −Δn/(n − 1): with a melt value n_d = 1.5171 against a design value of 1.5168, Δn = +0.0003, and for f = 100 mm, Δf = −100×0.0003/0.5168 ≈ −58 µm. An f/4 system at 550 nm has a depth of focus of about ±2λ(f/#)² = ±2×0.55×16 ≈ ±18 µm, so the focal shift is 3 times the depth of focus and a recompute or air-space adjustment is mandatory. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對資料表上每個數值都附有量測方法與不確定度，且熔次編號與毛胚標記一致；設計端用實測折射率重新追跡，確認重算後的像質回到名義值，並把更新的曲率與厚度以版本號記錄在加工圖與交接文件中。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check that every value on the sheet carries its measurement method and uncertainty and that the melt number matches the blank marking; have the design side re-trace with the measured indices, confirm that the recomputed image quality returns to nominal, and record the updated radii and thicknesses with a version number on the fabrication drawings and in the handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Thin-lens focal sensitivity to index is Δf/f = −Δn/(n − 1): with a melt value n_d = 1.5171 against a design value of 1.5168, Δn = +0.0003, and for f = 100 mm, Δf = −100×0.0003/0.5168 ≈ −58 µm. An f/4 system at 550 nm has a depth of focus of about ±2λ(f/#)² = ±2×0.55×16 ≈ ±18 µm, so the focal shift is 3 times the depth of focus and a recompute or air-space adjustment is mandatory.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 退火爐只要溫度控制準確，均勻性自然就好。
只要雙折射讀值為零，毛胚裡就沒有應力。

An accurately controlled furnace is automatically a uniform one.
A zero birefringence reading means the blank contains no stress.

steps.title: 熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熔次資料表與設計重算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Melt data sheet and design recompute” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 核對資料表上每個數值都附有量測方法與不確定度，且熔次編號與毛胚標記一致；設計端用實測折射率重新追跡，確認重算後的像質回到名義值，並把更新的曲率與厚度以版本號記錄在加工圖與交接文件中。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check that every value on the sheet carries its measurement method and uncertainty and that the melt number matches the blank marking; have the design side re-trace with the measured indices, confirm that the recomputed image quality returns to nominal, and record the updated radii and thicknesses with a version number on the fabrication drawings and in the handoff record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩個熔次的同牌號玻璃折射率相差 0.0004，若工廠混用而設計未按熔次重算，同一批鏡頭的焦距分佈變成雙峰，組裝時無法用統一的墊片補償，良率驟降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Two melts of the same glass type differing by 0.0004 in index, mixed in the shop without a per-melt recompute, give the lens batch a bimodal focal-length distribution that no single shim can compensate at assembly, and yield collapses.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對資料表上每個數值都附有量測方法與不確定度，且熔次編號與毛胚標記一致；設計端用實測折射率重新追跡，確認重算後的像質回到名義值，並把更新的曲率與厚度以版本號記錄在加工圖與交接文件中。
knowledge.textEn: Check that every value on the sheet carries its measurement method and uncertainty and that the melt number matches the blank marking; have the design side re-trace with the measured indices, confirm that the recomputed image quality returns to nominal, and record the updated radii and thicknesses with a version number on the fabrication drawings and in the handoff record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
核對資料表上每個數值都附有量測方法與不確定度，且熔次編號與毛胚標記一致。
型錄上的折射率小數點後五位對每一塊毛胚都成立。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Check that every value on the sheet carries its measurement method and uncertainty and that the melt number matches the blank marking.
The five-decimal catalogue index holds for every individual blank.
quiz.explanation: 核對資料表上每個數值都附有量測方法與不確定度，且熔次編號與毛胚標記一致；設計端用實測折射率重新追跡，確認重算後的像質回到名義值，並把更新的曲率與厚度以版本號記錄在加工圖與交接文件中。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check that every value on the sheet carries its measurement method and uncertainty and that the melt number matches the blank marking; have the design side re-trace with the measured indices, confirm that the recomputed image quality returns to nominal, and record the updated radii and thicknesses with a version number on the fabrication drawings and in the handoff record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熔次資料表與設計重算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Melt data sheet and design recompute” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩個熔次的同牌號玻璃折射率相差 0.0004，若工廠混用而設計未按熔次重算，同一批鏡頭的焦距分佈變成雙峰，組裝時無法用統一的墊片補償，良率驟降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Two melts of the same glass type differing by 0.0004 in index, mixed in the shop without a per-melt recompute, give the lens batch a bimodal focal-length distribution that no single shim can compensate at assembly, and yield collapses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沒有這一步，精密退火得到的折射率精度就白費了。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without this step the index accuracy won by precision annealing is simply wasted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同牌號的光學玻璃不論熔次，折射率都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Optical glass of the same type has the same index regardless of melt." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「熔次資料、規格等級與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Melt data, specification grades and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

玻璃只要冷到室溫，應力自然會慢慢消失。
兩個熔次的同牌號玻璃折射率相差 0.0004，若工廠混用而設計未按熔次重算，同一批鏡頭的焦距分佈變成雙峰，組裝時無法用統一的墊片補償，良率驟降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Stress in glass fades by itself once it reaches room temperature.

Two melts of the same glass type differing by 0.0004 in index, mixed in the shop without a per-melt recompute, give the lens batch a bimodal focal-length distribution that no single shim can compensate at assembly, and yield collapses.

title: 離子束光學表面修形
summary: 從氬離子濺射的原子級去除出發，建立高斯去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與空間頻率上限的概念，再把離子源、柵極、真空與基板熱負載、干涉量測對位、誤差預算與驗收紀錄串成一條可重複的確定性修形流程。
summaryEn: Starting from atomic-scale removal by argon-ion sputtering, build the Gaussian removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and spatial-frequency limit, then chain ion source, grids, vacuum, substrate thermal load, interferometer registration, error budget and acceptance record into a repeatable deterministic figuring process.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 確定性修形練習：直徑 300 mm 熔融石英平面，初始面形 25 nm RMS、120 nm PV。去除函數為高斯，峰值 R₀ = 1.0 nm/s、FWHM = 10 mm，σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 = R₀·2πσ² = 1.0 × 113 = 113 nm·mm²/s。假設修正需要的平均去除深度為 70 nm（高於最低點的平均高度 60 nm 加 10 nm 底層），工件面積 π×150² = 70,686 mm²，總體積 70 × 70,686 = 4.95×10⁶ nm·mm²，修形時間 ≈ 4.95×10⁶/113 ≈ 43,800 s ≈ 12.2 h；加上 21% 邊緣溢出約 14.8 h。誤差預算：束流穩定 1% × 70 nm = 0.7 nm、量測 0.5 nm、對位 0.3 mm × 1 nm/mm = 0.3 nm、週期小於 20 mm 的不可修正中頻 2 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.7² + 0.5² + 0.3² + 2²) ≈ 2.2 nm RMS，收斂 91%。熱平衡：束流 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W，7.8 kg 石英（密度 2.2 g/cm³，熱容約 5.8 kJ/K）若不散熱每小時升溫 40×3600/5800 ≈ 25 K，所以必須靠夾具導熱與限制電流把穩態溫升壓在 30 K 以下。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Deterministic-figuring exercise: a 300 mm diameter fused-silica flat with initial figure 25 nm RMS and 120 nm PV. The removal function is Gaussian with peak R₀ = 1.0 nm/s and FWHM = 10 mm, so σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate = R₀·2πσ² = 1.0 × 113 = 113 nm·mm²/s. Assume the correction needs a mean removal of 70 nm (60 nm mean height above the lowest point plus a 10 nm floor); the part area is π×150² = 70,686 mm², the total volume 70 × 70,686 = 4.95×10⁶ nm·mm², and the figuring time ≈ 4.95×10⁶/113 ≈ 43,800 s ≈ 12.2 h, about 14.8 h with 21% edge overrun. Error budget: beam stability 1% × 70 nm = 0.7 nm, metrology 0.5 nm, registration 0.3 mm × 1 nm/mm = 0.3 nm, uncorrectable mid-frequency below a 20 mm period 2 nm, residual ≈ √(0.7² + 0.5² + 0.3² + 2²) ≈ 2.2 nm RMS, a 91% convergence. Thermal balance: beam power 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W; without cooling the 7.8 kg silica part (density 2.2 g/cm³, heat capacity about 5.8 kJ/K) would warm by 40×3600/5800 ≈ 25 K per hour, so fixture conduction and current limits must hold the steady-state rise below 30 K. All values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「濺射去除的物理與去除率」與「去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" and "Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氬離子束與工件表面」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束修形用能量約 0.5 到 1.5 keV 的氬離子轟擊光學表面，離子把動量傳給近表面原子，形成碰撞級聯，部分原子獲得足以脫離表面的能量而被濺射出去。每個入射離子平均濺射出的原子數稱為濺射產率 Y，對熔融石英在 1 keV 附近約為 1 個原子，去除深度只由離子通量、產率與材料原子密度決定。因為沒有機械接觸，不存在拋光壓力造成的邊緣效應與工具磨耗，整個過程在真空中進行，去除量以奈米為單位可預測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氬離子束與工件表面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ion-beam figuring bombards the optical surface with argon ions of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 keV; each ion transfers momentum to near-surface atoms, starting a collision cascade in which some atoms gain enough energy to leave the surface. The mean number of atoms ejected per incident ion is the sputter yield Y, about 1 atom per ion for fused silica near 1 keV, so removal depth is set only by ion flux, yield and atomic density. With no mechanical contact there is no pressure-driven edge effect and no tool wear; the process runs in vacuum and removal is predictable in nanometres. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氬離子束與工件表面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「濺射去除的物理與去除率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" is correct?
options: 離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。
離子束修形用能量約 0.5 到 1.5 keV 的氬離子轟擊光學表面，離子把動量傳給近表面原子，形成碰撞級聯，部分原子獲得足以脫離表面的能量而被濺射出去。

optionsEn: An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel.
Ion-beam figuring bombards the optical surface with argon ions of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 keV.
Given enough dwell time an ion beam can correct errors of any spatial frequency.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氬離子束與工件表面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。熔融石英 n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² 原子/cm³；取 Y = 1.0、j = 1 mA/cm²，離子通量 j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ 離子/(cm²·s)，ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s，約 56 nm/min；產率隨入射角在 60° 到 70° 附近達到最大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. For fused silica n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² atoms/cm³; with Y = 1.0 and j = 1 mA/cm² the ion flux j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ ions/(cm²·s) gives ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s, about 56 nm/min; the yield peaks near 60° to 70° incidence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. For fused silica n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² atoms/cm³; with Y = 1.0 and j = 1 mA/cm² the ion flux j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ ions/(cm²·s) gives ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s, about 56 nm/min; the yield peaks near 60° to 70° incidence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「濺射去除的物理與去除率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sputter removal physics and removal rate", which statement holds?
options: 離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。

optionsEn: Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored.
With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero.
Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density.
quiz.explanation: 去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氬離子束與工件表面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把從熔融石英量到的去除率直接套到碳化矽或微晶玻璃，產率差異會讓實際去除量與駐留時間圖不符，修形後面形不但沒有收斂反而出現與誤差圖同形的殘差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying a removal rate measured on fused silica to silicon carbide or glass ceramic lets the yield difference desynchronise actual removal from the dwell map; the figure fails to converge and leaves a residual shaped like the original error map.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濺射去除的物理與去除率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.instruction: 若把從熔融石英量到的去除率直接套到碳化矽或微晶玻璃，產率差異會讓實際去除量與駐留時間圖不符，修形後面形不但沒有收斂反而出現與誤差圖同形的殘差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Applying a removal rate measured on fused silica to silicon carbide or glass ceramic lets the yield difference desynchronise actual removal from the dwell map; the figure fails to converge and leaves a residual shaped like the original error map. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束在工件上的去除分佈稱為去除函數（beam removal function），通常近似高斯，半高全寬由柵極光學與工作距離決定，約 3 到 30 mm。修形時束流以固定功率在面上掃描，實際去除量等於去除函數與駐留時間圖的二維卷積，因此已知誤差圖後必須反卷積求出非負的駐留時間，常用 Richardson–Lucy 或帶非負約束的最小平方法。高斯函數在頻域也是高斯，空間週期短於束寬的誤差幾乎無法被修正，這決定了離子束修形只能處理低頻面形，中高頻必須由前段拋光控制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The removal distribution of the beam on the workpiece is the beam removal function, usually near Gaussian with a full width at half maximum set by grid optics and working distance, about 3 to 30 mm. During figuring the beam scans the surface at constant power, and actual removal equals the two-dimensional convolution of the removal function with the dwell-time map, so the error map must be deconvolved into a non-negative dwell map with Richardson–Lucy or non-negative least squares. A Gaussian is also Gaussian in the frequency domain, so errors with periods shorter than the beam width are barely correctable; ion-beam figuring therefore handles low-frequency figure only, and mid and high frequencies must be controlled by the preceding polish. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：去除函數 R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²)，σ = FWHM/2.355；FWHM = 10 mm 時 σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Removal function R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²) with σ = FWHM/2.355; for FWHM = 10 mm, σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要駐留時間夠長，任何空間頻率的誤差都能被離子束修掉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Given enough dwell time an ion beam can correct errors of any spatial frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：去除函數 R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²)，σ = FWHM/2.355；FWHM = 10 mm 時 σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s。其頻率響應 H(f) = exp(−2π²σ²f²)：週期等於 FWHM（f = 0.1 mm⁻¹）時 H ≈ 0.028，週期 20 mm 時 H ≈ 0.41，週期 40 mm 時 H ≈ 0.80，所以可修正週期約需大於 3 倍束寬。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Removal function R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²) with σ = FWHM/2.355; for FWHM = 10 mm, σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s. Its frequency response H(f) = exp(−2π²σ²f²) gives H ≈ 0.028 for a period equal to the FWHM (f = 0.1 mm⁻¹), H ≈ 0.41 at a 20 mm period and H ≈ 0.80 at 40 mm, so correctable periods need to exceed roughly 3 beam widths. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把量到的誤差圖做功率譜密度分析，用 H(f) 預測每個頻段修形後的殘餘量，再與實際修形後的 PSD 比較；同時用去除函數與駐留時間圖重新卷積，確認模擬去除量與干涉儀量到的前後差異在幾個奈米內一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the power spectral density of the measured error map, predict the post-figuring residual per band with H(f), and compare with the PSD measured after the run; also re-convolve the removal function with the dwell map and confirm that the simulated removal matches the interferometric before-and-after difference within a few nanometres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與頻率上限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and frequency limit: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把量到的誤差圖做功率譜密度分析，用 H(f) 預測每個頻段修形後的殘餘量，再與實際修形後的 PSD 比較；同時用去除函數與駐留時間圖重新卷積，確認模擬去除量與干涉儀量到的前後差異在幾個奈米內一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the power spectral density of the measured error map, predict the post-figuring residual per band with H(f), and compare with the PSD measured after the run; also re-convolve the removal function with the dwell map and confirm that the simulated removal matches the interferometric before-and-after difference within a few nanometres. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若反卷積未加非負約束，演算法會要求在某些位置「加材料」，實際執行時這些負駐留被截成零，結果在高點附近留下未修正的環狀殘差；若誤差圖含低於束寬的波紋，反卷積會放大雜訊造成駐留時間圖劇烈震盪。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without a non-negativity constraint the deconvolution asks for material to be added at some points; those negative dwells are clipped to zero and ring-shaped residuals remain around the peaks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 若反卷積未加非負約束，演算法會要求在某些位置「加材料」，實際執行時這些負駐留被截成零，結果在高點附近留下未修正的環狀殘差；若誤差圖含低於束寬的波紋，反卷積會放大雜訊造成駐留時間圖劇烈震盪。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「離子源、柵極光學與真空環境」與「基板材料反應、粗糙度與熱管理」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment" and "Substrate response, roughness and thermal management": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 離子源、柵極光學與真空環境：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「柵極離子源與中和器」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gridded ion source and neutralizer” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 修形機的核心是 Kaufman 型柵極離子源：放電室以燈絲或射頻把氬氣游離成電漿，屏蔽柵與加速柵之間的電位差把離子抽出並加速到設定能量，兩片柵極的孔徑對準與間距決定束流發散與去除函數寬度。束流離開後由熱燈絲或電漿橋中和器注入電子，避免絕緣的玻璃工件表面充電而使束流偏折。腔體工作壓力約 10⁻⁴ mbar，比離子平均自由徑對應的壓力低，使離子在抵達工件前幾乎不碰撞；真空品質、氣體流量與柵極溫度都影響束流穩定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「柵極離子源與中和器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The heart of the machine is a Kaufman-type gridded ion source: a discharge chamber ionises argon with a filament or RF antenna, the potential between screen and accelerator grids extracts and accelerates ions to the set energy, and the alignment and gap of the two grids set beam divergence and removal-function width. A hot-filament or plasma-bridge neutralizer injects electrons into the beam so the insulating glass workpiece does not charge and deflect it. The chamber operates near 10⁻⁴ mbar, low enough that ions rarely collide before reaching the part; vacuum quality, gas flow and grid temperature all affect beam stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gridded ion source and neutralizer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柵極抽取電流受 Child–Langmuir 空間電荷限制 j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The extractable grid current is bounded by the Child–Langmuir space-charge limit j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提高柵極電壓就能無限制地提高束流密度與去除率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Raising grid voltage increases beam current density and removal rate without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「柵極離子源與中和器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gridded ion source and neutralizer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Raising grid voltage increases beam current density and removal rate without limit.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 離子源、柵極光學與真空環境：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柵極離子源與中和器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gridded ion source and neutralizer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柵極抽取電流受 Child–Langmuir 空間電荷限制 j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d²。氬離子 √(2e/m) ≈ 2.2×10³ (C/kg)^{1/2}，V = 1000 V、柵距 d = 1 mm 時 j_max ≈ 3.9×10⁻¹² × 2.2×10³ × 3.16×10⁴ / 10⁻⁶ ≈ 270 A/m² ≈ 27 mA/cm²，實際抽取值只有此上限的一部分。另外 10⁻⁴ mbar 下氬的平均自由徑約 0.7 m，遠大於 0.2 m 的工作距離。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The extractable grid current is bounded by the Child–Langmuir space-charge limit j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d². For argon ions √(2e/m) ≈ 2.2×10³ (C/kg)^{1/2}; with V = 1000 V and grid gap d = 1 mm, j_max ≈ 3.9×10⁻¹² × 2.2×10³ × 3.16×10⁴ / 10⁻⁶ ≈ 270 A/m² ≈ 27 mA/cm², and real sources extract only a fraction of this bound. At 10⁻⁴ mbar the argon mean free path is about 0.7 m, far beyond a 0.2 m working distance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用法拉第杯陣列或單一法拉第杯掃描束流剖面，取得電流密度分佈與半高全寬，並與靜止凹坑的去除函數比對；連續記錄束流電流、放電電壓與腔壓一小時，確認電流漂移在 ±1% 內，中和器開關前後工件表面電位差小於數十伏。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the beam profile with a Faraday-cup array or a single Faraday cup to obtain the current-density distribution and full width at half maximum, and compare with the stationary-crater removal function; log beam current, discharge voltage and chamber pressure for an hour to confirm current drift within ±1% and a surface-potential change below tens of volts when the neutralizer is switched on.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 柵極抽取電流受 Child–Langmuir 空間電荷限制 j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d²。氬離子 √(2e/m) ≈ 2.2×10³ (C/kg)^{1/2}，V = 1000 V、柵距 d = 1 mm 時 j_max ≈ 3.9×10⁻¹² × 2.2×10³ × 3.16×10⁴ / 10⁻⁶ ≈ 270 A/m² ≈ 27 mA/cm²，實際抽取值只有此上限的一部分。另外 10⁻⁴ mbar 下氬的平均自由徑約 0.7 m，遠大於 0.2 m 的工作距離。
knowledge.textEn: The extractable grid current is bounded by the Child–Langmuir space-charge limit j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d². For argon ions √(2e/m) ≈ 2.2×10³ (C/kg)^{1/2}; with V = 1000 V and grid gap d = 1 mm, j_max ≈ 3.9×10⁻¹² × 2.2×10³ × 3.16×10⁴ / 10⁻⁶ ≈ 270 A/m² ≈ 27 mA/cm², and real sources extract only a fraction of this bound. At 10⁻⁴ mbar the argon mean free path is about 0.7 m, far beyond a 0.2 m working distance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「離子源、柵極光學與真空環境」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment", which statement holds?
options: 多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。
柵極抽取電流受 Child–Langmuir 空間電荷限制 j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d²。
PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。
optionsEn: With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero.
The extractable grid current is bounded by the Child–Langmuir space-charge limit j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d².
A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better.
quiz.explanation: 柵極抽取電流受 Child–Langmuir 空間電荷限制 j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The extractable grid current is bounded by the Child–Langmuir space-charge limit j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 離子源、柵極光學與真空環境：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「柵極離子源與中和器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gridded ion source and neutralizer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用法拉第杯陣列或單一法拉第杯掃描束流剖面，取得電流密度分佈與半高全寬，並與靜止凹坑的去除函數比對；連續記錄束流電流、放電電壓與腔壓一小時，確認電流漂移在 ±1% 內，中和器開關前後工件表面電位差小於數十伏。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the beam profile with a Faraday-cup array or a single Faraday cup to obtain the current-density distribution and full width at half maximum, and compare with the stationary-crater removal function; log beam current, discharge voltage and chamber pressure for an hour to confirm current drift within ±1% and a surface-potential change below tens of volts when the neutralizer is switched on. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：柵極受熱變形或孔徑錯位會讓束流偏斜與展寬，去除函數不再是校正時的高斯形，整張駐留時間圖隨之失效；中和器失效時玻璃表面累積正電荷，束流被排斥而去除率驟降且不均勻。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Thermally warped or misaligned grids skew and broaden the beam so the removal function no longer matches the calibrated Gaussian and the whole dwell map is invalid; a failed neutralizer lets positive charge build on the glass, repelling the beam so removal collapses and becomes non-uniform.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用法拉第杯陣列或單一法拉第杯掃描束流剖面，取得電流密度分佈與半高全寬，並與靜止凹坑的去除函數比對；連續記錄束流電流、放電電壓與腔壓一小時，確認電流漂移在 ±1% 內，中和器開關前後工件表面電位差小於數十伏。
knowledge.textEn: Scan the beam profile with a Faraday-cup array or a single Faraday cup to obtain the current-density distribution and full width at half maximum, and compare with the stationary-crater removal function; log beam current, discharge voltage and chamber pressure for an hour to confirm current drift within ±1% and a surface-potential change below tens of volts when the neutralizer is switched on.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「離子源、柵極光學與真空環境」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。
用法拉第杯陣列或單一法拉第杯掃描束流剖面，取得電流密度分佈與半高全寬，並與靜止凹坑的去除函數比對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel.

Scan the beam profile with a Faraday-cup array or a single Faraday cup to obtain the current-density distribution and full width at half maximum, and compare with the stationary-crater removal function.
quiz.explanation: 用法拉第杯陣列或單一法拉第杯掃描束流剖面，取得電流密度分佈與半高全寬，並與靜止凹坑的去除函數比對；連續記錄束流電流、放電電壓與腔壓一小時，確認電流漂移在 ±1% 內，中和器開關前後工件表面電位差小於數十伏。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan the beam profile with a Faraday-cup array or a single Faraday cup to obtain the current-density distribution and full width at half maximum, and compare with the stationary-crater removal function; log beam current, discharge voltage and chamber pressure for an hour to confirm current drift within ±1% and a surface-potential change below tens of volts when the neutralizer is switched on. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 離子源、柵極光學與真空環境：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柵極離子源與中和器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Gridded ion source and neutralizer” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 柵極受熱變形或孔徑錯位會讓束流偏斜與展寬，去除函數不再是校正時的高斯形，整張駐留時間圖隨之失效；中和器失效時玻璃表面累積正電荷，束流被排斥而去除率驟降且不均勻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Thermally warped or misaligned grids skew and broaden the beam so the removal function no longer matches the calibrated Gaussian and the whole dwell map is invalid; a failed neutralizer lets positive charge build on the glass, repelling the beam so removal collapses and becomes non-uniform. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：腔體工作壓力約 10⁻⁴ mbar，比離子平均自由徑對應的壓力低，使離子在抵達工件前幾乎不碰撞；真空品質、氣體流量與柵極溫度都影響束流穩定度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The chamber operates near 10⁻⁴ mbar, low enough that ions rarely collide before reaching the part; vacuum quality, gas flow and grid temperature all affect beam stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提高柵極電壓就能無限制地提高束流密度與去除率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Raising grid voltage increases beam current density and removal rate without limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 柵極受熱變形或孔徑錯位會讓束流偏斜與展寬，去除函數不再是校正時的高斯形，整張駐留時間圖隨之失效；中和器失效時玻璃表面累積正電荷，束流被排斥而去除率驟降且不均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Thermally warped or misaligned grids skew and broaden the beam so the removal function no longer matches the calibrated Gaussian and the whole dwell map is invalid; a failed neutralizer lets positive charge build on the glass, repelling the beam so removal collapses and becomes non-uniform.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「離子源、柵極光學與真空環境」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 柵極受熱變形或孔徑錯位會讓束流偏斜與展寬，去除函數不再是校正時的高斯形，整張駐留時間圖隨之失效；中和器失效時玻璃表面累積正電荷，束流被排斥而去除率驟降且不均勻。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。
optionsEn: Thermally warped or misaligned grids skew and broaden the beam so the removal function no longer matches the calibrated Gaussian and the whole dwell map is invalid.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 柵極受熱變形或孔徑錯位會讓束流偏斜與展寬，去除函數不再是校正時的高斯形，整張駐留時間圖隨之失效；中和器失效時玻璃表面累積正電荷，束流被排斥而去除率驟降且不均勻。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermally warped or misaligned grids skew and broaden the beam so the removal function no longer matches the calibrated Gaussian and the whole dwell map is invalid; a failed neutralizer lets positive charge build on the glass, repelling the beam so removal collapses and becomes non-uniform. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基板材料反應、粗糙度與熱管理：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Substrate response, roughness and thermal management: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「基板材料與熱負載」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Substrate material and thermal load” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束修形把束流功率的大部分變成工件的熱：1 keV 離子停在表面下僅 2 到 3 nm，能量以熱的形式沉積，而玻璃的熱導率只有約 1.3 W/(m·K)，真空中又只能靠輻射與夾具傳導散熱，所以大型工件在長時間修形中會升溫數十度。材料對濺射的反應也不同：熔融石英為均質玻璃，修形後粗糙度幾乎不變；微晶玻璃含有奈米級結晶相與玻璃相，兩相濺射速率不同，深度去除後粗糙度可能從 0.3 nm 上升到 1 nm 等級，因此前段拋光必須先把誤差壓到數百奈米以內以限制去除深度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基板材料與熱負載」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most beam power ends up as heat in the workpiece: 1 keV ions stop only 2 to 3 nm below the surface and deposit their energy thermally, while glass conducts only about 1.3 W/(m·K) and in vacuum can shed heat only by radiation and conduction into the fixture, so a large part warms by tens of kelvin during a long run. Materials also respond differently: fused silica is homogeneous and keeps its roughness, whereas glass ceramic contains nanometre crystallites and a glassy phase that sputter at different rates, so deep removal can raise roughness from 0.3 nm toward 1 nm; the preceding polish must therefore bring the error within a few hundred nanometres to limit removal depth. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Substrate material and thermal load”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：穩態溫升估計：束流功率 P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W 平均落在直徑 300 mm 的工件上，面功率密度 q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²；若只靠兩面輻射散熱，線性化輻射係數 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K)，兩面共 10.3 W/(m²·K)，ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K；夾具傳導可把它壓低，但顯示束流電流必須配合散熱設計。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Steady-state temperature-rise estimate: beam power P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W averaged over a 300 mm diameter part gives q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²; with radiation from both faces only, the linearised radiative coefficient 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K), 10.3 W/(m²·K) for two faces, so ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K; fixture conduction lowers this, but it shows that beam current must match the cooling design.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「基板材料與熱負載」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Substrate material and thermal load”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 基板材料反應、粗糙度與熱管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Substrate response, roughness and thermal management: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基板材料與熱負載」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Substrate material and thermal load” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：穩態溫升估計：束流功率 P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W 平均落在直徑 300 mm 的工件上，面功率密度 q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²；若只靠兩面輻射散熱，線性化輻射係數 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K)，兩面共 10.3 W/(m²·K)，ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K；夾具傳導可把它壓低，但顯示束流電流必須配合散熱設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Steady-state temperature-rise estimate: beam power P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W averaged over a 300 mm diameter part gives q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²; with radiation from both faces only, the linearised radiative coefficient 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K), 10.3 W/(m²·K) for two faces, so ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K; fixture conduction lowers this, but it shows that beam current must match the cooling design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在工件背面貼熱電偶或用紅外測溫，記錄整個修形過程的溫度曲線，與功率平衡估計比較；修形前後用白光干涉儀與 AFM 量同一區域的粗糙度與 PSD，確認高頻段沒有因差異濺射而上升，微晶玻璃工件另外檢查表面是否出現結晶相造成的顆粒狀紋理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Attach a thermocouple to the back of the part or use infrared thermometry to log the temperature trace through the run and compare it with the power-balance estimate; measure roughness and PSD of the same region with white-light interferometry and AFM before and after figuring to confirm the high-frequency band has not risen from differential sputtering, and for glass ceramic check for granular texture from the crystalline phase.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 穩態溫升估計：束流功率 P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W 平均落在直徑 300 mm 的工件上，面功率密度 q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²；若只靠兩面輻射散熱，線性化輻射係數 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K)，兩面共 10.3 W/(m²·K)，ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K；夾具傳導可把它壓低，但顯示束流電流必須配合散熱設計。
knowledge.textEn: Steady-state temperature-rise estimate: beam power P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W averaged over a 300 mm diameter part gives q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²; with radiation from both faces only, the linearised radiative coefficient 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K), 10.3 W/(m²·K) for two faces, so ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K; fixture conduction lowers this, but it shows that beam current must match the cooling design.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「基板材料反應、粗糙度與熱管理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter.
An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel.

steps.title: 基板材料反應、粗糙度與熱管理：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Substrate response, roughness and thermal management: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「基板材料與熱負載」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Substrate material and thermal load” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在工件背面貼熱電偶或用紅外測溫，記錄整個修形過程的溫度曲線，與功率平衡估計比較；修形前後用白光干涉儀與 AFM 量同一區域的粗糙度與 PSD，確認高頻段沒有因差異濺射而上升，微晶玻璃工件另外檢查表面是否出現結晶相造成的顆粒狀紋理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Attach a thermocouple to the back of the part or use infrared thermometry to log the temperature trace through the run and compare it with the power-balance estimate; measure roughness and PSD of the same region with white-light interferometry and AFM before and after figuring to confirm the high-frequency band has not risen from differential sputtering, and for glass ceramic check for granular texture from the crystalline phase. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：高束流長時間駐留在厚玻璃的局部區域會造成熱應力，輕則面形量測時殘留熱變形，重則工件開裂；在微晶玻璃上為了修掉數微米誤差而深度去除，會把粗糙度推高到散射超標。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A high current dwelling for long periods on one region of thick glass creates thermal stress, leaving thermal deformation in the figure measurement at best and cracking the part at worst; removing several micrometres from glass ceramic to fix a large error pushes roughness past the scatter specification.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在工件背面貼熱電偶或用紅外測溫，記錄整個修形過程的溫度曲線，與功率平衡估計比較；修形前後用白光干涉儀與 AFM 量同一區域的粗糙度與 PSD，確認高頻段沒有因差異濺射而上升，微晶玻璃工件另外檢查表面是否出現結晶相造成的顆粒狀紋理。
knowledge.textEn: Attach a thermocouple to the back of the part or use infrared thermometry to log the temperature trace through the run and compare it with the power-balance estimate; measure roughness and PSD of the same region with white-light interferometry and AFM before and after figuring to confirm the high-frequency band has not risen from differential sputtering, and for glass ceramic check for granular texture from the crystalline phase.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基板材料反應、粗糙度與熱管理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Attach a thermocouple to the back of the part or use infrared thermometry to log the temperature trace through the run and compare it with the power-balance estimate; measure roughness and PSD of the same region with white-light interferometry and AFM before and after figuring to confirm the high-frequency band has not risen from differential sputtering, and for glass ceramic check for granular texture from the crystalline phase. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 基板材料反應、粗糙度與熱管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Substrate response, roughness and thermal management: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基板材料與熱負載」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Substrate material and thermal load” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 高束流長時間駐留在厚玻璃的局部區域會造成熱應力，輕則面形量測時殘留熱變形，重則工件開裂；在微晶玻璃上為了修掉數微米誤差而深度去除，會把粗糙度推高到散射超標。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A high current dwelling for long periods on one region of thick glass creates thermal stress, leaving thermal deformation in the figure measurement at best and cracking the part at worst; removing several micrometres from glass ceramic to fix a large error pushes roughness past the scatter specification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：材料對濺射的反應也不同：熔融石英為均質玻璃，修形後粗糙度幾乎不變；微晶玻璃含有奈米級結晶相與玻璃相，兩相濺射速率不同，深度去除後粗糙度可能從 0.3 nm 上升到 1 nm 等級，因此前段拋光必須先把誤差壓到數百奈米以內以限制去除深度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Materials also respond differently: fused silica is homogeneous and keeps its roughness, whereas glass ceramic contains nanometre crystallites and a glassy phase that sputter at different rates, so deep removal can raise roughness from 0.3 nm toward 1 nm; the preceding polish must therefore bring the error within a few hundred nanometres to limit removal depth.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: A high current dwelling for long periods on one region of thick glass creates thermal stress, leaving thermal deformation in the figure measurement at best and cracking the part at worst; removing several micrometres from glass ceramic to fix a large error pushes roughness past the scatter specification.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正」與「誤差預算與收斂極限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration" and "Error budget and convergence limit": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interferometer error map and machine registration” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 修形的輸入是干涉儀量到的面形誤差圖，它必須以基準記號或邊緣偵測對位到機台的掃描座標，位置誤差會乘上局部斜率變成去除誤差。去除函數必須在每次修形前以靜止凹坑實測，而不是沿用舊值，因為柵極老化、氣流與工作距離變化都會改變峰值速率與寬度。干涉儀本身的重複性、參考面誤差與空氣擾動設定了可達到的面形下限，所以量測需平均多幀並扣除參考面。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The input to figuring is the interferometric error map, which must be registered to the machine scan coordinates with fiducials or edge detection; a position error multiplied by the local slope becomes a removal error. The removal function must be re-measured with a stationary crater before every run rather than reused, because grid ageing, gas flow and working-distance changes alter both peak rate and width. Interferometer repeatability, reference-surface error and air turbulence set the attainable figure floor, so measurements are averaged over many frames with the reference subtracted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interferometer error map and machine registration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：靜止駐留 180 s 得到凹坑深度 180 nm，峰值去除率 R₀ = 1.00 nm/s，凹坑剖面擬合 FWHM = 9.8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 180 s stationary dwell yields a crater depth of 180 nm, so the peak rate R₀ = 1.00 nm/s, and a fit to the crater profile gives FWHM = 9.8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「去除函數是機台常數，校正一次就能長期使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The removal function is a machine constant that needs calibrating only once." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Interferometer error map and machine registration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The removal function must be re-measured with a stationary crater before every run rather than reused, because grid ageing, gas flow and working-distance changes alter both peak rate and width.

quiz.question: 關於「面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration" is correct?
options: 去除函數是機台常數，校正一次就能長期使用。
多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。
