steps.title: 面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interferometer error map and machine registration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：靜止駐留 180 s 得到凹坑深度 180 nm，峰值去除率 R₀ = 1.00 nm/s，凹坑剖面擬合 FWHM = 9.8 mm。若束流在運行中漂移 2%，對 150 nm 的去除深度造成 3 nm 誤差；若對位誤差 0.5 mm 而局部斜率 10 nm/mm，則去除位置誤差帶來 5 nm；干涉儀 16 幀平均的重複性約 0.5 nm RMS。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 180 s stationary dwell yields a crater depth of 180 nm, so the peak rate R₀ = 1.00 nm/s, and a fit to the crater profile gives FWHM = 9.8 mm. A 2% beam drift during the run produces a 3 nm error on a 150 nm removal; a 0.5 mm registration error on a local slope of 10 nm/mm adds 5 nm; a 16-frame interferometer average repeats to about 0.5 nm RMS. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩次獨立安裝量測同一工件並相減，RMS 差值除以 √2 作為量測重複性；在工件邊緣刻意製作一個已知位置的小凹坑，修形後檢查凹坑與誤差圖的座標偏移量，確認對位誤差小於 0.3 mm。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the same part in two independent mountings and subtract; the RMS of the difference divided by √2 is the measurement repeatability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 靜止駐留 180 s 得到凹坑深度 180 nm，峰值去除率 R₀ = 1.00 nm/s，凹坑剖面擬合 FWHM = 9.8 mm。若束流在運行中漂移 2%，對 150 nm 的去除深度造成 3 nm 誤差；若對位誤差 0.5 mm 而局部斜率 10 nm/mm，則去除位置誤差帶來 5 nm；干涉儀 16 幀平均的重複性約 0.5 nm RMS。
knowledge.textEn: A 180 s stationary dwell yields a crater depth of 180 nm, so the peak rate R₀ = 1.00 nm/s, and a fit to the crater profile gives FWHM = 9.8 mm. A 2% beam drift during the run produces a 3 nm error on a 150 nm removal; a 0.5 mm registration error on a local slope of 10 nm/mm adds 5 nm; a 16-frame interferometer average repeats to about 0.5 nm RMS.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration", which statement holds?
options: 靜止駐留 180 s 得到凹坑深度 180 nm，峰值去除率 R₀ = 1.00 nm/s，凹坑剖面擬合 FWHM = 9.8 mm。
PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。
只要駐留時間夠長，任何空間頻率的誤差都能被離子束修掉。
optionsEn: A 180 s stationary dwell yields a crater depth of 180 nm, so the peak rate R₀ = 1.00 nm/s, and a fit to the crater profile gives FWHM = 9.8 mm.

steps.title: 面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Interferometer error map and machine registration” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以兩次獨立安裝量測同一工件並相減，RMS 差值除以 √2 作為量測重複性；在工件邊緣刻意製作一個已知位置的小凹坑，修形後檢查凹坑與誤差圖的座標偏移量，確認對位誤差小於 0.3 mm。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the same part in two independent mountings and subtract; the RMS of the difference divided by √2 is the measurement repeatability. Make a small crater at a known position near the edge, and after the run check the offset between the crater and the error map to confirm registration error below 0.3 mm. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：沿用上個月的去除函數而柵極已老化，峰值速率低了 15%，一次修形後殘差仍與原誤差圖同形只是縮小；誤差圖左右鏡像裝反，修形反而把誤差加倍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reusing last month's removal function after the grids have aged, with the peak rate 15% lower, leaves a residual shaped like the original map, only smaller; a mirrored error map doubles the error instead of removing it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以兩次獨立安裝量測同一工件並相減，RMS 差值除以 √2 作為量測重複性；在工件邊緣刻意製作一個已知位置的小凹坑，修形後檢查凹坑與誤差圖的座標偏移量，確認對位誤差小於 0.3 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the same part in two independent mountings and subtract; the RMS of the difference divided by √2 is the measurement repeatability. Make a small crater at a known position near the edge, and after the run check the offset between the crater and the error map to confirm registration error below 0.3 mm.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration"?

steps.title: 誤差預算與收斂極限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Error budget and convergence limit: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「修形誤差預算表」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Figuring error budget table” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一次修形後的殘差來自幾個互相獨立的來源：量測重複性、去除率漂移乘以去除深度、對位誤差乘以斜率、反卷積無法修正的中頻成分，以及工件邊緣束流溢出造成的邊緣效應。因為各項獨立，總殘差以均方根相加；去除率與對位項正比於本次去除深度，所以第二次迭代時它們自動縮小，最後收斂到由中頻與量測底限決定的平台。理解這個結構才能判斷再多做一次迭代是否值得。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「修形誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The residual after one run comes from several independent sources: measurement repeatability, rate drift times removal depth, registration error times slope, the mid-spatial-frequency content that deconvolution cannot correct, and the edge effect from beam overrun at the part boundary. Being independent, they add root-sum-square; the rate and registration terms scale with the removal depth of that run, so they shrink automatically in the second iteration, and the process converges to a floor set by mid-frequency content and the metrology limit. Understanding this structure tells you whether another iteration is worth running. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Figuring error budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第一次迭代：量測 0.5 nm、去除率 2%×150 nm = 3 nm、對位 1 nm、不可修正中頻 2 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.5² + 3² + 1² + 2²) = √14.25 ≈ 3.8 nm RMS，從 25 nm 起算收斂 85%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: First iteration: metrology 0.5 nm, rate 2%×150 nm = 3 nm, registration 1 nm, uncorrectable mid-frequency 2 nm, residual ≈ √(0.5² + 3² + 1² + 2²) = √14.25 ≈ 3.8 nm RMS, an 85% convergence from 25 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「修形誤差預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Figuring error budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 誤差預算與收斂極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Error budget and convergence limit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「修形誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Figuring error budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第一次迭代：量測 0.5 nm、去除率 2%×150 nm = 3 nm、對位 1 nm、不可修正中頻 2 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.5² + 3² + 1² + 2²) = √14.25 ≈ 3.8 nm RMS，從 25 nm 起算收斂 85%。第二次迭代去除深度降到約 15 nm，去除率項 0.3 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.25 + 0.09 + 0.01 + 4) ≈ 2.1 nm，已由中頻項主導。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: First iteration: metrology 0.5 nm, rate 2%×150 nm = 3 nm, registration 1 nm, uncorrectable mid-frequency 2 nm, residual ≈ √(0.5² + 3² + 1² + 2²) = √14.25 ≈ 3.8 nm RMS, an 85% convergence from 25 nm. In the second iteration removal depth falls to about 15 nm, the rate term to 0.3 nm, and the residual ≈ √(0.25 + 0.09 + 0.01 + 4) ≈ 2.1 nm, now dominated by the mid-frequency term. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次迭代後把殘差圖做頻段分解，比較低頻段與中頻段 RMS 的變化：低頻應按預算縮小，中頻應幾乎不變；若中頻段反而上升，表示束流穩定度或掃描步距有問題；把實測收斂率與預算預測值列在同一張表中追蹤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each iteration decompose the residual map by band and compare low- and mid-frequency RMS: the low band should shrink as budgeted while the mid band stays nearly constant; a rising mid band points to beam instability or raster-pitch problems.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

In the second iteration removal depth falls to about 15 nm, the rate term to 0.3 nm, and the residual ≈ √(0.25 + 0.09 + 0.01 + 4) ≈ 2.1 nm, now dominated by the mid-frequency term.

steps.title: 誤差預算與收斂極限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Error budget and convergence limit: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「修形誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Figuring error budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每次迭代後把殘差圖做頻段分解，比較低頻段與中頻段 RMS 的變化：低頻應按預算縮小，中頻應幾乎不變；若中頻段反而上升，表示束流穩定度或掃描步距有問題；把實測收斂率與預算預測值列在同一張表中追蹤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each iteration decompose the residual map by band and compare low- and mid-frequency RMS: the low band should shrink as budgeted while the mid band stays nearly constant; a rising mid band points to beam instability or raster-pitch problems. Track measured versus predicted convergence in one table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把所有殘差歸咎於機台而反覆迭代，實際上殘差已由不可修正的中頻主導，多做三次迭代只多花十幾小時並增加熱負載與粗糙度，面形沒有進一步改善。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Blaming the machine for all residual and iterating repeatedly when the residual is already mid-frequency dominated costs tens of hours, more thermal load and more roughness with no figure improvement.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 每次迭代後把殘差圖做頻段分解，比較低頻段與中頻段 RMS 的變化：低頻應按預算縮小，中頻應幾乎不變；若中頻段反而上升，表示束流穩定度或掃描步距有問題；把實測收斂率與預算預測值列在同一張表中追蹤。

optionsEn: Blaming the machine for all residual and iterating repeatedly when the residual is already mid-frequency dominated costs tens of hours, more thermal load and more roughness with no figure improvement.

An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 把所有殘差歸咎於機台而反覆迭代，實際上殘差已由不可修正的中頻主導，多做三次迭代只多花十幾小時並增加熱負載與粗糙度，面形沒有進一步改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blaming the machine for all residual and iterating repeatedly when the residual is already mid-frequency dominated costs tens of hours, more thermal load and more roughness with no figure improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略」與「驗收規格換算與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy" and "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Process chain and thermal settling” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束修形位於製程鏈的末端：研磨與傳統拋光先給出低粗糙度與受控的中頻，磁流變或小工具拋光把面形壓到數百奈米，最後才由離子束做奈米級收斂，之後清洗、鍍膜。掃描策略決定邊緣處理：為了讓邊緣也獲得正確去除，駐留時間圖必須延伸到工件外一到兩個束寬，這段溢出時間是純粹的成本。修形後工件溫度高於環境，低膨脹材料雖然變形小，但量測仍需等待熱平衡，否則面形圖內含熱梯度項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ion-beam figuring sits at the end of the chain: grinding and conventional polishing deliver low roughness and controlled mid-frequency, magnetorheological or small-tool polishing brings figure to a few hundred nanometres, and only then does the ion beam provide nanometre convergence, followed by cleaning and coating. The scan strategy governs edge handling: for correct removal at the rim the dwell map must extend one to two beam widths beyond the part, and that overrun time is pure cost. After the run the part is warmer than ambient; even a low-expansion material must settle thermally before measurement or the map contains a thermal-gradient term. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Process chain and thermal settling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：直徑 300 mm、厚 50 mm 的微晶玻璃質量 ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg，熱容 ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K；出腔後在空氣中以 h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K)、面積 0.19 m² 散熱，時間常數 τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h，從 27 K 溫差降到 0.1 K 需 ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 300 mm diameter, 50 mm thick glass-ceramic part has mass ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg and heat capacity ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K; cooling in air with h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K) over 0.19 m² gives a time constant τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h, so settling from a 27 K excess to 0.1 K takes ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子束可以直接修正任何粗拋後的表面，前段拋光品質不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Process chain and thermal settling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy" is correct?

A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Process chain and thermal settling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：直徑 300 mm、厚 50 mm 的微晶玻璃質量 ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg，熱容 ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K；出腔後在空氣中以 h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K)、面積 0.19 m² 散熱，時間常數 τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h，從 27 K 溫差降到 0.1 K 需 ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h。邊緣溢出：束寬 10 mm、延伸 15 mm，掃描面積由 π×150² 增為 π×165²，多出 21% 的時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 300 mm diameter, 50 mm thick glass-ceramic part has mass ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg and heat capacity ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K; cooling in air with h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K) over 0.19 m² gives a time constant τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h, so settling from a 27 K excess to 0.1 K takes ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h. Edge overrun: with a 10 mm beam extended 15 mm, the scanned area grows from π×150² to π×165², about 21% more time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄工件出腔後每 30 分鐘的干涉圖，追蹤像散與離焦項隨時間的衰減，直到連續兩次量測差異小於 1 nm RMS 才視為熱平衡；比較邊緣 10 mm 環帶與中心區的殘差 RMS，確認溢出策略有效且沒有邊緣塌陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record an interferogram every 30 minutes after the part leaves the chamber and track the decay of astigmatism and defocus until two consecutive maps differ by less than 1 nm RMS, which defines thermal settling; compare residual RMS in the outer 10 mm annulus with the central zone to confirm the overrun strategy works and there is no edge roll.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 直徑 300 mm、厚 50 mm 的微晶玻璃質量 ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg，熱容 ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K；出腔後在空氣中以 h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K)、面積 0.19 m² 散熱，時間常數 τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h，從 27 K 溫差降到 0.1 K 需 ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h。邊緣溢出：束寬 10 mm、延伸 15 mm，掃描面積由 π×150² 增為 π×165²，多出 21% 的時間。

Edge overrun: with a 10 mm beam extended 15 mm, the scanned area grows from π×150² to π×165², about 21% more time.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy", which statement holds?
options: 只要駐留時間夠長，任何空間頻率的誤差都能被離子束修掉。
離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。
直徑 300 mm、厚 50 mm 的微晶玻璃質量 ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg，熱容 ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K。

Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored.
A 300 mm diameter, 50 mm thick glass-ceramic part has mass ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg and heat capacity ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Process chain and thermal settling” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄工件出腔後每 30 分鐘的干涉圖，追蹤像散與離焦項隨時間的衰減，直到連續兩次量測差異小於 1 nm RMS 才視為熱平衡；比較邊緣 10 mm 環帶與中心區的殘差 RMS，確認溢出策略有效且沒有邊緣塌陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record an interferogram every 30 minutes after the part leaves the chamber and track the decay of astigmatism and defocus until two consecutive maps differ by less than 1 nm RMS, which defines thermal settling; compare residual RMS in the outer 10 mm annulus with the central zone to confirm the overrun strategy works and there is no edge roll. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了省時間不做邊緣溢出，邊緣一圈去除不足，面形在最外 10 mm 出現向上翹的環帶；工件未熱平衡就量測，把熱離焦誤當成面形誤差餵回下一次駐留時間圖，修形後反而出現相反符號的球差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Skipping the edge overrun to save time under-removes the rim and leaves an upturned annulus in the outer 10 mm; measuring before thermal settling feeds thermal defocus into the next dwell map as if it were figure, and the run then imprints spherical error of the opposite sign.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄工件出腔後每 30 分鐘的干涉圖，追蹤像散與離焦項隨時間的衰減，直到連續兩次量測差異小於 1 nm RMS 才視為熱平衡；比較邊緣 10 mm 環帶與中心區的殘差 RMS，確認溢出策略有效且沒有邊緣塌陷。
knowledge.textEn: Record an interferogram every 30 minutes after the part leaves the chamber and track the decay of astigmatism and defocus until two consecutive maps differ by less than 1 nm RMS, which defines thermal settling; compare residual RMS in the outer 10 mm annulus with the central zone to confirm the overrun strategy works and there is no edge roll.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy"?
options: 記錄工件出腔後每 30 分鐘的干涉圖，追蹤像散與離焦項隨時間的衰減，直到連續兩次量測差異小於 1 nm RMS 才視為熱平衡。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
去除函數是機台常數，校正一次就能長期使用。
optionsEn: Record an interferogram every 30 minutes after the part leaves the chamber and track the decay of astigmatism and defocus until two consecutive maps differ by less than 1 nm RMS, which defines thermal settling.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The removal function is a machine constant that needs calibrating only once.
quiz.explanation: 記錄工件出腔後每 30 分鐘的干涉圖，追蹤像散與離焦項隨時間的衰減，直到連續兩次量測差異小於 1 nm RMS 才視為熱平衡；比較邊緣 10 mm 環帶與中心區的殘差 RMS，確認溢出策略有效且沒有邊緣塌陷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record an interferogram every 30 minutes after the part leaves the chamber and track the decay of astigmatism and defocus until two consecutive maps differ by less than 1 nm RMS, which defines thermal settling; compare residual RMS in the outer 10 mm annulus with the central zone to confirm the overrun strategy works and there is no edge roll. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Process chain and thermal settling” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了省時間不做邊緣溢出，邊緣一圈去除不足，面形在最外 10 mm 出現向上翹的環帶；工件未熱平衡就量測，把熱離焦誤當成面形誤差餵回下一次駐留時間圖，修形後反而出現相反符號的球差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping the edge overrun to save time under-removes the rim and leaves an upturned annulus in the outer 10 mm; measuring before thermal settling feeds thermal defocus into the next dwell map as if it were figure, and the run then imprints spherical error of the opposite sign. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修形後工件溫度高於環境，低膨脹材料雖然變形小，但量測仍需等待熱平衡，否則面形圖內含熱梯度項。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After the run the part is warmer than ambient; even a low-expansion material must settle thermally before measurement or the map contains a thermal-gradient term.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子束可以直接修正任何粗拋後的表面，前段拋光品質不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了省時間不做邊緣溢出，邊緣一圈去除不足，面形在最外 10 mm 出現向上翹的環帶；工件未熱平衡就量測，把熱離焦誤當成面形誤差餵回下一次駐留時間圖，修形後反而出現相反符號的球差。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping the edge overrun to save time under-removes the rim and leaves an upturned annulus in the outer 10 mm; measuring before thermal settling feeds thermal defocus into the next dwell map as if it were figure, and the run then imprints spherical error of the opposite sign.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
為了省時間不做邊緣溢出，邊緣一圈去除不足，面形在最外 10 mm 出現向上翹的環帶。
PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Skipping the edge overrun to save time under-removes the rim and leaves an upturned annulus in the outer 10 mm.
A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better.
quiz.explanation: 為了省時間不做邊緣溢出，邊緣一圈去除不足，面形在最外 10 mm 出現向上翹的環帶；工件未熱平衡就量測，把熱離焦誤當成面形誤差餵回下一次駐留時間圖，修形後反而出現相反符號的球差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping the edge overrun to save time under-removes the rim and leaves an upturned annulus in the outer 10 mm; measuring before thermal settling feeds thermal defocus into the next dwell map as if it were figure, and the run then imprints spherical error of the opposite sign. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收報告與交接資料包」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance report and handoff package” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收不是只看一個 PV 數字：規格通常以波長分數給出，必須換算成表面 RMS 並說明是否已扣除傾斜與離焦、使用的濾波頻寬與取樣密度。反射鏡的表面誤差在波前上加倍，Maréchal 判準給出 Strehl 0.8 所需的波前 RMS 約 λ/14，可反推表面容許值。交接資料包應包含最終面形圖與 Zernike 係數、各頻段 PSD、修形前後粗糙度、去除函數校正紀錄、駐留時間圖與總去除深度，以及鍍膜前清洗建議，讓下游能追溯每一項數據的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收報告與交接資料包」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance is more than one PV number: specifications are usually given as a wavelength fraction and must be converted to surface RMS with a statement of whether tilt and focus were removed, the filter bandwidth and the sampling density. A mirror's surface error doubles in the wavefront, and the Maréchal criterion requires about λ/14 RMS wavefront for a Strehl ratio of 0.8, from which the surface allowance follows. The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the removal-function calibration record, the dwell map and total removal depth, plus a pre-coating cleaning recommendation, so downstream users can trace every figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance report and handoff package”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：規格 λ/20 PV（633 nm）= 31.7 nm PV；對隨機誤差 RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A λ/20 PV specification at 633 nm is 31.7 nm PV; for random error RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收報告與交接資料包」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance report and handoff package”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 驗收不是只看一個 PV 數字：規格通常以波長分數給出，必須換算成表面 RMS 並說明是否已扣除傾斜與離焦、使用的濾波頻寬與取樣密度。反射鏡的表面誤差在波前上加倍，Maréchal 判準給出 Strehl 0.8 所需的波前 RMS 約 λ/14，可反推表面容許值。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance is more than one PV number: specifications are usually given as a wavelength fraction and must be converted to surface RMS with a statement of whether tilt and focus were removed, the filter bandwidth and the sampling density. A mirror's surface error doubles in the wavefront, and the Maréchal criterion requires about λ/14 RMS wavefront for a Strehl ratio of 0.8, from which the surface allowance follows.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「驗收規格換算與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。
離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。
驗收不是只看一個 PV 數字：規格通常以波長分數給出，必須換算成表面 RMS 並說明是否已扣除傾斜與離焦、使用的濾波頻寬與取樣密度。
optionsEn: A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better.
An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel.

Acceptance is more than one PV number: specifications are usually given as a wavelength fraction and must be converted to surface RMS with a statement of whether tilt and focus were removed, the filter bandwidth and the sampling density.
quiz.explanation: 驗收不是只看一個 PV 數字：規格通常以波長分數給出，必須換算成表面 RMS 並說明是否已扣除傾斜與離焦、使用的濾波頻寬與取樣密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance is more than one PV number: specifications are usually given as a wavelength fraction and must be converted to surface RMS with a statement of whether tilt and focus were removed, the filter bandwidth and the sampling density. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收報告與交接資料包」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance report and handoff package” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：規格 λ/20 PV（633 nm）= 31.7 nm PV；對隨機誤差 RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm。反射使用時波前 RMS = 2×6.3 = 12.7 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×12.7/633)²] ≈ exp(−0.0159) ≈ 0.984。離子束修形常達到 2 nm RMS 表面，對應波前 4 nm，Strehl ≈ 0.998；總去除深度紀錄 70 nm，對 Ar 佈植深度 3 nm 的表層需在鍍膜前清洗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A λ/20 PV specification at 633 nm is 31.7 nm PV; for random error RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm. Used in reflection the wavefront RMS = 2×6.3 = 12.7 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×12.7/633)²] ≈ exp(−0.0159) ≈ 0.984. Ion-beam figuring commonly reaches 2 nm RMS surface, 4 nm wavefront, Strehl ≈ 0.998; a recorded total removal of 70 nm leaves a 3 nm argon-implanted skin that must be cleaned before coating. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；核對交接資料包中每個數值的量測條件（波長、濾波、對位）是否一致，並確認鍍膜廠接收的清洗方式不會改變面形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 規格 λ/20 PV（633 nm）= 31.7 nm PV；對隨機誤差 RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm。反射使用時波前 RMS = 2×6.3 = 12.7 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×12.7/633)²] ≈ exp(−0.0159) ≈ 0.984。離子束修形常達到 2 nm RMS 表面，對應波前 4 nm，Strehl ≈ 0.998；總去除深度紀錄 70 nm，對 Ar 佈植深度 3 nm 的表層需在鍍膜前清洗。
knowledge.textEn: A λ/20 PV specification at 633 nm is 31.7 nm PV; for random error RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm. Used in reflection the wavefront RMS = 2×6.3 = 12.7 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×12.7/633)²] ≈ exp(−0.0159) ≈ 0.984. Ion-beam figuring commonly reaches 2 nm RMS surface, 4 nm wavefront, Strehl ≈ 0.998; a recorded total removal of 70 nm leaves a 3 nm argon-implanted skin that must be cleaned before coating.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「驗收規格換算與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 規格 λ/20 PV（633 nm）= 31.7 nm PV；對隨機誤差 RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm。
提高柵極電壓就能無限制地提高束流密度與去除率。
去除函數是機台常數，校正一次就能長期使用。
optionsEn: A λ/20 PV specification at 633 nm is 31.7 nm PV; for random error RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm.
Raising grid voltage increases beam current density and removal rate without limit.
The removal function is a machine constant that needs calibrating only once.
quiz.explanation: 規格 λ/20 PV（633 nm）= 31.7 nm PV；對隨機誤差 RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A λ/20 PV specification at 633 nm is 31.7 nm PV; for random error RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收報告與交接資料包」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance report and handoff package” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；核對交接資料包中每個數值的量測條件（波長、濾波、對位）是否一致，並確認鍍膜廠接收的清洗方式不會改變面形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification. Check that every number in the package carries consistent measurement conditions (wavelength, filtering, registration) and that the cleaning process the coating shop will use does not alter the figure. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格；缺少去除函數與駐留時間紀錄，日後面形異常時無法追溯是量測、機台還是材料的問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reporting a tilt-and-focus-removed RMS as if it were full-aperture PV fails acceptance when the customer re-measures with different filtering; without the removal-function and dwell records a later figure anomaly cannot be traced to metrology, machine or material.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；核對交接資料包中每個數值的量測條件（波長、濾波、對位）是否一致，並確認鍍膜廠接收的清洗方式不會改變面形。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification. Check that every number in the package carries consistent measurement conditions (wavelength, filtering, registration) and that the cleaning process the coating shop will use does not alter the figure.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收規格換算與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一。
多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification.
With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；核對交接資料包中每個數值的量測條件（波長、濾波、對位）是否一致，並確認鍍膜廠接收的清洗方式不會改變面形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收報告與交接資料包」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance report and handoff package” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格；缺少去除函數與駐留時間紀錄，日後面形異常時無法追溯是量測、機台還是材料的問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting a tilt-and-focus-removed RMS as if it were full-aperture PV fails acceptance when the customer re-measures with different filtering; without the removal-function and dwell records a later figure anomaly cannot be traced to metrology, machine or material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料包應包含最終面形圖與 Zernike 係數、各頻段 PSD、修形前後粗糙度、去除函數校正紀錄、駐留時間圖與總去除深度，以及鍍膜前清洗建議，讓下游能追溯每一項數據的來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the removal-function calibration record, the dwell map and total removal depth, plus a pre-coating cleaning recommendation, so downstream users can trace every figure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格；缺少去除函數與駐留時間紀錄，日後面形異常時無法追溯是量測、機台還是材料的問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting a tilt-and-focus-removed RMS as if it were full-aperture PV fails acceptance when the customer re-measures with different filtering; without the removal-function and dwell records a later figure anomaly cannot be traced to metrology, machine or material.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「驗收規格換算與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。
把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel.
Reporting a tilt-and-focus-removed RMS as if it were full-aperture PV fails acceptance when the customer re-measures with different filtering.
quiz.explanation: 把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格；缺少去除函數與駐留時間紀錄，日後面形異常時無法追溯是量測、機台還是材料的問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting a tilt-and-focus-removed RMS as if it were full-aperture PV fails acceptance when the customer re-measures with different filtering; without the removal-function and dwell records a later figure anomaly cannot be traced to metrology, machine or material. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 磁流變光學拋光
summary: 從羰基鐵粒子在磁場中成鏈、形成具降伏應力的流體帶談起，用 Preston 關係與 D 形去除點建立磁流變拋光的去除模型，再把拋光輪、流體黏度閉迴路、工件材料與次表面損傷、干涉量測與去除點校正、誤差預算，直到清洗與驗收交接，整合成一條可重複的非球面修形流程。
summaryEn: Start with carbonyl-iron particles chaining in a magnetic field into a ribbon with a yield stress, model removal with the Preston relation and the D-shaped spot, then integrate the wheel, fluid-viscosity loop, workpiece materials and subsurface damage, interferometry and spot calibration, error budget, cleaning and acceptance into a repeatable aspheric figuring process.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 非球面修形練習：直徑 100 mm 的 BK7 非球面，初始面形 60 nm RMS、300 nm PV。去除點以 10 s 靜止得到 0.40 µm 深度，峰值去除率 40 nm/s = 2.4 µm/min，D 形點 10 mm × 4 mm，體積去除率 ≈ 0.4×10×4×2.4×10⁻³ ≈ 0.04 mm³/min。駐留圖需要的平均去除量取 0.25 µm（高點平均 0.20 µm 加 0.05 µm 底層），體積 0.25×10⁻³ mm × 7854 mm² ≈ 1.96 mm³，修形時間 ≈ 1.96/0.04 ≈ 49 min，含 21% 邊緣越程約 59 min。誤差預算：去除率漂移 3% × 250 nm = 7.5 nm、量測 1 nm、對位 20 µm × 0.5 µm/mm = 10 nm 以 RMS 計約 1 nm（斜率只在邊緣大）、中頻紋理 3 nm，殘差 ≈ √(7.5² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 8.2 nm RMS，縮小 7.3 倍。第二次迭代去除深度降到約 30 nm，漂移項 0.9 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.9² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 3.4 nm RMS。穿透波前貢獻 (1.517 − 1)×3.4 ≈ 1.8 nm ≈ λ/350。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Aspheric-figuring exercise: a 100 mm BK7 asphere with initial figure 60 nm RMS and 300 nm PV. A 10 s stationary spot is 0.40 µm deep, so the peak rate is 40 nm/s = 2.4 µm/min; the D-shaped spot is 10 mm × 4 mm with a volumetric rate ≈ 0.4×10×4×2.4×10⁻³ ≈ 0.04 mm³/min. The dwell map needs a mean removal of 0.25 µm (0.20 µm mean height of the hills plus a 0.05 µm floor), a volume of 0.25×10⁻³ mm × 7854 mm² ≈ 1.96 mm³, a run time ≈ 1.96/0.04 ≈ 49 min, about 59 min with 21% edge overrun. Error budget: rate drift 3% × 250 nm = 7.5 nm, metrology 1 nm, registration 20 µm × 0.5 µm/mm = 10 nm at the edge but about 1 nm as an area-weighted RMS because slope is large only near the rim, mid-frequency texture 3 nm, residual ≈ √(7.5² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 8.2 nm RMS, a 7.3-fold reduction. In the second iteration the removal depth falls to about 30 nm, the drift term to 0.9 nm, and the residual ≈ √(0.9² + 1² + 1² + 3²) ≈ 3.4 nm RMS. The transmitted-wavefront contribution is (1.517 − 1)×3.4 ≈ 1.8 nm ≈ λ/350. All values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」與「Preston 去除關係與去除點函數」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" and "Preston removal relation and the spot function": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」如何決定磁流變光學拋光的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “MR ribbon and electromagnet” determines the key performance of “Magnetorheological optical finishing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 磁流變液是水基懸浮液，含有直徑約 4 µm 的羰基鐵粒子、拋光用的氧化鈰或奈米鑽石磨料以及穩定劑。無磁場時它是黏度約 0.5 Pa·s 的流體，可被泵送到旋轉輪面；進入電磁鐵上方約 0.2 到 0.4 T 的區域後，鐵粒子沿磁力線成鏈，流體在毫秒內變成具有降伏應力的賓漢塑性體，形成一條硬化的「流體帶」。工件以約 0.5 mm 的深度浸入帶中，磨料被磁場梯度推向帶的表面，材料去除由這個受控的剪切流決定，而不是由硬質拋光工具的壓力決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An MR fluid is a water-based suspension of roughly 4 µm carbonyl-iron particles, cerium-oxide or nanodiamond polishing abrasive and stabilisers. Without a field it is a liquid of about 0.5 Pa·s that can be pumped onto a rotating wheel; above the electromagnet, in a field of about 0.2 to 0.4 T, the iron particles chain along field lines and within milliseconds the fluid becomes a Bingham plastic with a yield stress, forming a stiffened ribbon. The workpiece is immersed about 0.5 mm into the ribbon, the field gradient pushes abrasive toward the ribbon surface, and removal is governed by this controlled shear flow rather than by the pressure of a hard tool. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MR ribbon and electromagnet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：賓漢模型 τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bingham model τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「磁流變拋光就是用磁鐵把磨料壓在工件上，去除量取決於壓力大小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "MRF simply presses abrasive onto the part with a magnet, so removal depends on how hard it presses." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “MR ribbon and electromagnet”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶
knowledge.titleEn: Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon
knowledge.text: 磁流變液是水基懸浮液，含有直徑約 4 µm 的羰基鐵粒子、拋光用的氧化鈰或奈米鑽石磨料以及穩定劑。無磁場時它是黏度約 0.5 Pa·s 的流體，可被泵送到旋轉輪面；進入電磁鐵上方約 0.2 到 0.4 T 的區域後，鐵粒子沿磁力線成鏈，流體在毫秒內變成具有降伏應力的賓漢塑性體，形成一條硬化的「流體帶」。
knowledge.textEn: An MR fluid is a water-based suspension of roughly 4 µm carbonyl-iron particles, cerium-oxide or nanodiamond polishing abrasive and stabilisers. Without a field it is a liquid of about 0.5 Pa·s that can be pumped onto a rotating wheel; above the electromagnet, in a field of about 0.2 to 0.4 T, the iron particles chain along field lines and within milliseconds the fluid becomes a Bingham plastic with a yield stress, forming a stiffened ribbon.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：磁流變拋光就是用磁鐵把磨料壓在工件上，去除量取決於壓力大小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: MRF simply presses abrasive onto the part with a magnet, so removal depends on how hard it presses. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" is correct?
options: 磁流變拋光就是用磁鐵把磨料壓在工件上，去除量取決於壓力大小。
磁流變液是水基懸浮液，含有直徑約 4 µm 的羰基鐵粒子、拋光用的氧化鈰或奈米鑽石磨料以及穩定劑。
去除點只與流體有關，與工件曲率和浸入深度無關。
optionsEn: MRF simply presses abrasive onto the part with a magnet, so removal depends on how hard it presses.
An MR fluid is a water-based suspension of roughly 4 µm carbonyl-iron particles, cerium-oxide or nanodiamond polishing abrasive and stabilisers.
The spot depends only on the fluid, not on part curvature or immersion depth.
quiz.explanation: 磁流變液是水基懸浮液，含有直徑約 4 µm 的羰基鐵粒子、拋光用的氧化鈰或奈米鑽石磨料以及穩定劑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An MR fluid is a water-based suspension of roughly 4 µm carbonyl-iron particles, cerium-oxide or nanodiamond polishing abrasive and stabilisers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “MR ribbon and electromagnet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：賓漢模型 τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇。取 0.3 T 下 τ_y ≈ 20 kPa（教學假設）、η = 0.5 Pa·s；輪面速度 2 m/s、浸入深度 0.5 mm 的剪切率 γ̇ ≈ 2/(0.5×10⁻³) = 4000 s⁻¹，黏性項 η·γ̇ = 2 kPa，只有降伏項的十分之一，所以去除主要由磁場設定的降伏應力決定，而磁場電流 5% 的變化會直接反映為去除率變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bingham model τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇. Take τ_y ≈ 20 kPa at 0.3 T (teaching assumption) and η = 0.5 Pa·s; at a wheel speed of 2 m/s and 0.5 mm immersion the shear rate γ̇ ≈ 2/(0.5×10⁻³) = 4000 s⁻¹, so the viscous term η·γ̇ = 2 kPa is only a tenth of the yield term. Removal is therefore set mainly by the field-controlled yield stress, and a 5% change in magnet current shows up directly as a removal-rate change. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用旋轉流變儀在不同磁場下量流體的降伏應力與黏度曲線，確認 τ_y 隨磁場的上升與飽和；在機台上以高斯計量輪面上方磁通密度，並用特氟龍刮片量流體帶高度，確認帶形與磁場分佈一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the fluid's yield stress and viscosity curves at several fields with a rotational rheometer to confirm how τ_y rises and saturates with field; on the machine, measure flux density above the wheel with a gaussmeter and ribbon height with a PTFE gauge to confirm the ribbon shape matches the field distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 賓漢模型 τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇。取 0.3 T 下 τ_y ≈ 20 kPa（教學假設）、η = 0.5 Pa·s；輪面速度 2 m/s、浸入深度 0.5 mm 的剪切率 γ̇ ≈ 2/(0.5×10⁻³) = 4000 s⁻¹，黏性項 η·γ̇ = 2 kPa，只有降伏項的十分之一，所以去除主要由磁場設定的降伏應力決定，而磁場電流 5% 的變化會直接反映為去除率變化。
knowledge.textEn: Bingham model τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇. Take τ_y ≈ 20 kPa at 0.3 T (teaching assumption) and η = 0.5 Pa·s; at a wheel speed of 2 m/s and 0.5 mm immersion the shear rate γ̇ ≈ 2/(0.5×10⁻³) = 4000 s⁻¹, so the viscous term η·γ̇ = 2 kPa is only a tenth of the yield term. Removal is therefore set mainly by the field-controlled yield stress, and a 5% change in magnet current shows up directly as a removal-rate change.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon", which statement holds?
options: 只要是拋光，就一定會在表面下留下新的損傷層。
只要 RMS 達標，面形圖裡的週期性紋理就不會影響成像。
賓漢模型 τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇。
optionsEn: Any polishing process necessarily leaves a fresh damage layer beneath the surface.
If the RMS meets specification, periodic texture in the map cannot affect imaging.
Bingham model τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇.
quiz.explanation: 賓漢模型 τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Bingham model τ = τ_y(B) + η·γ̇. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “MR ribbon and electromagnet” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用旋轉流變儀在不同磁場下量流體的降伏應力與黏度曲線，確認 τ_y 隨磁場的上升與飽和；在機台上以高斯計量輪面上方磁通密度，並用特氟龍刮片量流體帶高度，確認帶形與磁場分佈一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the fluid's yield stress and viscosity curves at several fields with a rotational rheometer to confirm how τ_y rises and saturates with field; on the machine, measure flux density above the wheel with a gaussmeter and ribbon height with a PTFE gauge to confirm the ribbon shape matches the field distribution. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鐵粒子氧化或流體含水量變化會讓降伏應力與黏度漂移，去除點深度在一天內變化超過 10%，用舊校正值執行的駐留圖留下與誤差圖同形的殘差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Oxidised iron particles or a change in water content shift yield stress and viscosity, the spot depth drifts by more than 10% within a day, and a dwell map run with the old calibration leaves a residual shaped like the error map.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用旋轉流變儀在不同磁場下量流體的降伏應力與黏度曲線，確認 τ_y 隨磁場的上升與飽和；在機台上以高斯計量輪面上方磁通密度，並用特氟龍刮片量流體帶高度，確認帶形與磁場分佈一致。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the fluid's yield stress and viscosity curves at several fields with a rotational rheometer to confirm how τ_y rises and saturates with field; on the machine, measure flux density above the wheel with a gaussmeter and ribbon height with a PTFE gauge to confirm the ribbon shape matches the field distribution.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon"?
options: 用旋轉流變儀在不同磁場下量流體的降伏應力與黏度曲線，確認 τ_y 隨磁場的上升與飽和。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
磁流變拋光可以取代所有前段工序，直接從粗磨面修到最終面形。
optionsEn: Measure the fluid's yield stress and viscosity curves at several fields with a rotational rheometer to confirm how τ_y rises and saturates with field.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
MRF can replace all earlier steps and figure a rough-ground surface directly to final shape.
quiz.explanation: 用旋轉流變儀在不同磁場下量流體的降伏應力與黏度曲線，確認 τ_y 隨磁場的上升與飽和；在機台上以高斯計量輪面上方磁通密度，並用特氟龍刮片量流體帶高度，確認帶形與磁場分佈一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the fluid's yield stress and viscosity curves at several fields with a rotational rheometer to confirm how τ_y rises and saturates with field; on the machine, measure flux density above the wheel with a gaussmeter and ribbon height with a PTFE gauge to confirm the ribbon shape matches the field distribution. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “MR ribbon and electromagnet” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鐵粒子氧化或流體含水量變化會讓降伏應力與黏度漂移，去除點深度在一天內變化超過 10%，用舊校正值執行的駐留圖留下與誤差圖同形的殘差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Oxidised iron particles or a change in water content shift yield stress and viscosity, the spot depth drifts by more than 10% within a day, and a dwell map run with the old calibration leaves a residual shaped like the error map. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工件以約 0.5 mm 的深度浸入帶中，磨料被磁場梯度推向帶的表面，材料去除由這個受控的剪切流決定，而不是由硬質拋光工具的壓力決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The workpiece is immersed about 0.5 mm into the ribbon, the field gradient pushes abrasive toward the ribbon surface, and removal is governed by this controlled shear flow rather than by the pressure of a hard tool.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「磁流變拋光就是用磁鐵把磨料壓在工件上，去除量取決於壓力大小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "MRF simply presses abrasive onto the part with a magnet, so removal depends on how hard it presses." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: Preston 去除關係與去除點函數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Preston removal relation and the spot function: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「D 形去除點與 Preston 關係」如何決定磁流變光學拋光的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “D-shaped removal spot and the Preston relation” determines the key performance of “Magnetorheological optical finishing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 材料去除率遵循 Preston 關係：單位時間去除深度正比於介面應力與相對速度的乘積，比例常數 k_p 由材料、磨料與化學環境決定。工件靜止在流體帶中時，去除集中在一個 D 形的去除點，長軸沿輪面運動方向約 10 mm、寬約 4 mm，深度分佈由帶內剪切應力與磨料分佈決定。去除點是整個修形的單位脈衝：工件沿螺旋或光柵軌跡移動，實際去除等於去除點函數與駐留時間的卷積，去除點一旦量準，修形便是確定性的。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「D 形去除點與 Preston 關係」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Removal follows the Preston relation: depth removed per unit time is proportional to the product of interfacial stress and relative velocity, with a constant k_p set by material, abrasive and chemistry. With the part held still in the ribbon the removal concentrates in a D-shaped spot about 10 mm long along the wheel motion and 4 mm wide, its depth profile set by the shear stress and abrasive distribution in the ribbon. The spot is the unit impulse of the whole process: the part moves along a spiral or raster path, actual removal equals the convolution of the spot function with dwell time, and once the spot is measured the figuring is deterministic. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “D-shaped removal spot and the Preston relation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：dz/dt = k_p·P·v。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: dz/dt = k_p·P·v.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「去除點只與流體有關，與工件曲率和浸入深度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The spot depends only on the fluid, not on part curvature or immersion depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「D 形去除點與 Preston 關係」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “D-shaped removal spot and the Preston relation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: Preston 去除關係與去除點函數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Preston removal relation and the spot function: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「D 形去除點與 Preston 關係」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “D-shaped removal spot and the Preston relation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：dz/dt = k_p·P·v。取 BK7 配氧化鈰的 k_p = 2×10⁻¹³ Pa⁻¹、介面應力 P = 100 kPa、v = 2 m/s（教學假設），峰值去除率 = 2×10⁻¹³ × 10⁵ × 2 = 4×10⁻⁸ m/s = 40 nm/s ≈ 2.4 µm/min；靜止 10 s 得到 0.4 µm 深的去除點。D 形去除點體積去除率 ≈ 0.4 × 10 mm × 4 mm × 2.4 µm/min ≈ 0.04 mm³/min。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: dz/dt = k_p·P·v. With k_p = 2×10⁻¹³ Pa⁻¹ for BK7 with cerium oxide, interfacial stress P = 100 kPa and v = 2 m/s (teaching assumptions), the peak removal rate = 2×10⁻¹³ × 10⁵ × 2 = 4×10⁻⁸ m/s = 40 nm/s ≈ 2.4 µm/min, so a 10 s stationary dwell makes a 0.4 µm deep spot. The D-shaped spot's volumetric rate ≈ 0.4 × 10 mm × 4 mm × 2.4 µm/min ≈ 0.04 mm³/min. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同材料、同曲率的試片上打幾個固定時間的去除點，用干涉儀量深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，積分得到體積去除率；改變輪速 ±20% 重做，確認去除率近似線性隨速度變化，符合 Preston 關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Make several fixed-time spots on a witness piece of the same material and curvature, measure depth and shape with an interferometer, divide depth by time for the peak rate and integrate for the volumetric rate; repeat at wheel speeds ±20% to confirm the rate scales roughly linearly with speed as the Preston relation predicts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: dz/dt = k_p·P·v. With k_p = 2×10⁻¹³ Pa⁻¹ for BK7 with cerium oxide, interfacial stress P = 100 kPa and v = 2 m/s (teaching assumptions), the peak removal rate = 2×10⁻¹³ × 10⁵ × 2 = 4×10⁻⁸ m/s = 40 nm/s ≈ 2.4 µm/min, so a 10 s stationary dwell makes a 0.4 µm deep spot. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Preston 去除關係與去除點函數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Preston removal relation and the spot function", which statement holds?
options: dz/dt = k_p·P·v。

磁流變拋光可以取代所有前段工序，直接從粗磨面修到最終面形。
optionsEn: dz/dt = k_p·P·v.
A sharp measurement map can go straight into dwell-time calculation; registration and calibration are optional.
MRF can replace all earlier steps and figure a rough-ground surface directly to final shape.

quiz.explanationEn: dz/dt = k_p·P·v. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Preston 去除關係與去除點函數：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Preston removal relation and the spot function: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「D 形去除點與 Preston 關係」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “D-shaped removal spot and the Preston relation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同材料、同曲率的試片上打幾個固定時間的去除點，用干涉儀量深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，積分得到體積去除率；改變輪速 ±20% 重做，確認去除率近似線性隨速度變化，符合 Preston 關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Make several fixed-time spots on a witness piece of the same material and curvature, measure depth and shape with an interferometer, divide depth by time for the peak rate and integrate for the volumetric rate; repeat at wheel speeds ±20% to confirm the rate scales roughly linearly with speed as the Preston relation predicts. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在平面試片上校正去除點，卻拿來修曲率半徑 100 mm 的凸面，浸入幾何改變使去除點變形，實際去除比預測偏 10% 以上，面形收斂停在幾十奈米。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating the spot on a flat witness and using it on a convex surface of 100 mm radius changes the immersion geometry, distorts the spot, and shifts removal by more than 10% from prediction, stalling figure convergence at tens of nanometres.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同材料、同曲率的試片上打幾個固定時間的去除點，用干涉儀量深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，積分得到體積去除率；改變輪速 ±20% 重做，確認去除率近似線性隨速度變化，符合 Preston 關係。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Preston 去除關係與去除點函數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Preston removal relation and the spot function"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在同材料、同曲率的試片上打幾個固定時間的去除點，用干涉儀量深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，積分得到體積去除率。
表面誤差數值就是波前誤差，透鏡與反射鏡的規格可以直接互換。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Make several fixed-time spots on a witness piece of the same material and curvature, measure depth and shape with an interferometer, divide depth by time for the peak rate and integrate for the volumetric rate.

quiz.explanationEn: Make several fixed-time spots on a witness piece of the same material and curvature, measure depth and shape with an interferometer, divide depth by time for the peak rate and integrate for the volumetric rate; repeat at wheel speeds ±20% to confirm the rate scales roughly linearly with speed as the Preston relation predicts. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在平面試片上校正去除點，卻拿來修曲率半徑 100 mm 的凸面，浸入幾何改變使去除點變形，實際去除比預測偏 10% 以上，面形收斂停在幾十奈米。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating the spot on a flat witness and using it on a convex surface of 100 mm radius changes the immersion geometry, distorts the spot, and shifts removal by more than 10% from prediction, stalling figure convergence at tens of nanometres.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Preston 去除關係與去除點函數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
MR fluid is like polishing slurry: once mixed it can be used for a long time without monitoring.

Calibrating the spot on a flat witness and using it on a convex surface of 100 mm radius changes the immersion geometry, distorts the spot, and shifts removal by more than 10% from prediction, stalling figure convergence at tens of nanometres.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「機台結構、流體循環與黏度閉迴路」與「材料反應、磨料選擇與次表面損傷」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Machine structure, fluid circulation and the viscosity loop" and "Material response, abrasive choice and subsurface damage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 機台結構、流體循環與黏度閉迴路：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Machine structure, fluid circulation and the viscosity loop: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「拋光輪、噴嘴與流體調節迴路」如何決定磁流變光學拋光的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel, nozzle and fluid-conditioning loop” determines the key performance of “Magnetorheological optical finishing”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機台把流體從調節槽泵到噴嘴，鋪在直徑約 150 mm 的旋轉輪面上，流過電磁鐵極靴上方的工作區後被刮刀回收，回到調節槽重新混合與控溫。因為水會蒸發、鐵粒子會氧化，調節迴路用流量與壓降推算黏度，並自動補水把黏度維持在設定值，這是去除率穩定的關鍵。工件由多軸數控平台握持，三軸機可修平面與淺曲面，修非球面與自由曲面需五軸讓表面法線始終對準流體帶。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「拋光輪、噴嘴與流體調節迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The machine pumps fluid from a conditioning tank to a nozzle, lays it on a rotating wheel of about 150 mm diameter, carries it through the working zone above the electromagnet pole pieces, scrapes it off and returns it to the tank for remixing and temperature control. Because water evaporates and iron oxidises, the loop infers viscosity from flow and pressure drop and adds water automatically to hold the setpoint, which is the key to a stable removal rate. A multi-axis CNC stage holds the part; three axes suffice for flats and shallow curves, while aspheres and freeforms need five axes to keep the surface normal aligned to the ribbon. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wheel, nozzle and fluid-conditioning loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輪面速度 v = πDN/60：D = 150 mm、N = 250 rpm 時 v = π×0.15×250/60 ≈ 1.96 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wheel speed v = πDN/60: for D = 150 mm and N = 250 rpm, v = π×0.15×250/60 ≈ 1.96 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「磁流變液像拋光粉一樣，配好以後就可以長期使用不必監控。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "MR fluid is like polishing slurry: once mixed it can be used for a long time without monitoring." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「拋光輪、噴嘴與流體調節迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Wheel, nozzle and fluid-conditioning loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Because water evaporates and iron oxidises, the loop infers viscosity from flow and pressure drop and adds water automatically to hold the setpoint, which is the key to a stable removal rate.
