knowledge.textEn: A lens surface error enters the transmitted wavefront (n − 1) times, a mirror surface 2 times, so before acceptance the surface RMS must be converted to the wavefront quantity the system requires, stating whether tilt and focus were removed and which spatial filter was used. The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the spot-calibration record, fluid batch and viscosity log, total removal depth and cleaning record, so coating and assembly can judge residual risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表面誤差數值就是波前誤差，透鏡與反射鏡的規格可以直接互換。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Surface error equals wavefront error, so lens and mirror specifications are interchangeable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「規格換算、驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 表面誤差數值就是波前誤差，透鏡與反射鏡的規格可以直接互換。
磁流變拋光就是用磁鐵把磨料壓在工件上，去除量取決於壓力大小。
透鏡表面誤差對穿透波前的影響是 (n − 1) 倍，反射面則是 2 倍，驗收前必須把表面 RMS 換算成系統要求的波前量，並註明是否扣除傾斜、離焦與使用的空間濾波。
optionsEn: Surface error equals wavefront error, so lens and mirror specifications are interchangeable.
MRF simply presses abrasive onto the part with a magnet, so removal depends on how hard it presses.

A lens surface error enters the transmitted wavefront (n − 1) times, a mirror surface 2 times, so before acceptance the surface RMS must be converted to the wavefront quantity the system requires, stating whether tilt and focus were removed and which spatial filter was used.
quiz.explanation: 透鏡表面誤差對穿透波前的影響是 (n − 1) 倍，反射面則是 2 倍，驗收前必須把表面 RMS 換算成系統要求的波前量，並註明是否扣除傾斜、離焦與使用的空間濾波。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A lens surface error enters the transmitted wavefront (n − 1) times, a mirror surface 2 times, so before acceptance the surface RMS must be converted to the wavefront quantity the system requires, stating whether tilt and focus were removed and which spatial filter was used. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 規格換算、驗收與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收報告與穿透波前換算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance report and transmitted-wavefront conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：BK7 在 633 nm 的 n = 1.517，表面殘差 8.2 nm RMS 的穿透波前貢獻 = (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150；同樣的表面若作為反射鏡則為 16.4 nm ≈ λ/39。若系統分配給此面的波前預算為 λ/100 = 6.3 nm，則表面允許 6.3/0.517 ≈ 12.2 nm RMS，8.2 nm 的結果合格並留有 30% 餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For BK7 at 633 nm, n = 1.517, so a surface residual of 8.2 nm RMS contributes (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150 to the transmitted wavefront; the same surface used as a mirror would give 16.4 nm ≈ λ/39. If the system allocates λ/100 = 6.3 nm of wavefront to this surface, the surface may carry 6.3/0.517 ≈ 12.2 nm RMS, so the 8.2 nm result passes with 30% margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用第二台干涉儀或不同的 CGH 複測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；把透鏡裝入組件後量穿透波前，與 (n − 1) 換算值比較；檢查交接資料中所有數值的濾波、對位與波長條件一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-measure the final figure on a second interferometer or with a different CGH, requiring agreement within one fifth of specification; after mounting, measure the transmitted wavefront and compare with the (n − 1) conversion; check that filtering, registration and wavelength conditions are consistent across every number in the package.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: BK7 在 633 nm 的 n = 1.517，表面殘差 8.2 nm RMS 的穿透波前貢獻 = (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150；同樣的表面若作為反射鏡則為 16.4 nm ≈ λ/39。若系統分配給此面的波前預算為 λ/100 = 6.3 nm，則表面允許 6.3/0.517 ≈ 12.2 nm RMS，8.2 nm 的結果合格並留有 30% 餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: For BK7 at 633 nm, n = 1.517, so a surface residual of 8.2 nm RMS contributes (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150 to the transmitted wavefront; the same surface used as a mirror would give 16.4 nm ≈ λ/39. If the system allocates λ/100 = 6.3 nm of wavefront to this surface, the surface may carry 6.3/0.517 ≈ 12.2 nm RMS, so the 8.2 nm result passes with 30% margin.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「規格換算、驗收與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: BK7 在 633 nm 的 n = 1.517，表面殘差 8.2 nm RMS 的穿透波前貢獻 = (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150。
磁流變液像拋光粉一樣，配好以後就可以長期使用不必監控。
量測圖只要夠清晰就能直接送進駐留時間計算，對位和校正是可選步驟。
optionsEn: For BK7 at 633 nm, n = 1.517, so a surface residual of 8.2 nm RMS contributes (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150 to the transmitted wavefront.
MR fluid is like polishing slurry: once mixed it can be used for a long time without monitoring.
A sharp measurement map can go straight into dwell-time calculation; registration and calibration are optional.
quiz.explanation: BK7 在 633 nm 的 n = 1.517，表面殘差 8.2 nm RMS 的穿透波前貢獻 = (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150；同樣的表面若作為反射鏡則為 16.4 nm ≈ λ/39。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For BK7 at 633 nm, n = 1.517, so a surface residual of 8.2 nm RMS contributes (1.517 − 1)×8.2 ≈ 4.2 nm RMS ≈ λ/150 to the transmitted wavefront; the same surface used as a mirror would give 16.4 nm ≈ λ/39. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 規格換算、驗收與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收報告與穿透波前換算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance report and transmitted-wavefront conversion” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用第二台干涉儀或不同的 CGH 複測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；把透鏡裝入組件後量穿透波前，與 (n − 1) 換算值比較；檢查交接資料中所有數值的濾波、對位與波長條件一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-measure the final figure on a second interferometer or with a different CGH, requiring agreement within one fifth of specification; after mounting, measure the transmitted wavefront and compare with the (n − 1) conversion; check that filtering, registration and wavelength conditions are consistent across every number in the package. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把反射量測的表面誤差直接當成穿透波前報出，數值被高估兩倍而讓合格件被退回；或缺少流體批號與去除點紀錄，日後同型件失效時無法分辨是流體老化還是量測問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reporting a reflection-measured surface error directly as transmitted wavefront overstates it twofold and rejects a good part; missing fluid-batch and spot records later make it impossible to tell fluid ageing from a metrology problem when a similar part fails.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用第二台干涉儀或不同的 CGH 複測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；把透鏡裝入組件後量穿透波前，與 (n − 1) 換算值比較；檢查交接資料中所有數值的濾波、對位與波長條件一致。
knowledge.textEn: Re-measure the final figure on a second interferometer or with a different CGH, requiring agreement within one fifth of specification; after mounting, measure the transmitted wavefront and compare with the (n − 1) conversion; check that filtering, registration and wavelength conditions are consistent across every number in the package.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規格換算、驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用第二台干涉儀或不同的 CGH 複測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一。
只要 RMS 達標，面形圖裡的週期性紋理就不會影響成像。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Re-measure the final figure on a second interferometer or with a different CGH, requiring agreement within one fifth of specification.
If the RMS meets specification, periodic texture in the map cannot affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: 用第二台干涉儀或不同的 CGH 複測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；把透鏡裝入組件後量穿透波前，與 (n − 1) 換算值比較；檢查交接資料中所有數值的濾波、對位與波長條件一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Re-measure the final figure on a second interferometer or with a different CGH, requiring agreement within one fifth of specification; after mounting, measure the transmitted wavefront and compare with the (n − 1) conversion; check that filtering, registration and wavelength conditions are consistent across every number in the package. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 規格換算、驗收與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收報告與穿透波前換算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance report and transmitted-wavefront conversion” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把反射量測的表面誤差直接當成穿透波前報出，數值被高估兩倍而讓合格件被退回；或缺少流體批號與去除點紀錄，日後同型件失效時無法分辨是流體老化還是量測問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting a reflection-measured surface error directly as transmitted wavefront overstates it twofold and rejects a good part; missing fluid-batch and spot records later make it impossible to tell fluid ageing from a metrology problem when a similar part fails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：獨立儀器的複測是驗收的核心，而不是只核對機台自己的量測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Re-measurement on an independent instrument is the core of acceptance, not a check of the machine's own data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「表面誤差數值就是波前誤差，透鏡與反射鏡的規格可以直接互換。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surface error equals wavefront error, so lens and mirror specifications are interchangeable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把反射量測的表面誤差直接當成穿透波前報出，數值被高估兩倍而讓合格件被退回；或缺少流體批號與去除點紀錄，日後同型件失效時無法分辨是流體老化還是量測問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting a reflection-measured surface error directly as transmitted wavefront overstates it twofold and rejects a good part; missing fluid-batch and spot records later make it impossible to tell fluid ageing from a metrology problem when a similar part fails.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「規格換算、驗收與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
磁流變拋光就是用磁鐵把磨料壓在工件上，去除量取決於壓力大小。
把反射量測的表面誤差直接當成穿透波前報出，數值被高估兩倍而讓合格件被退回；或缺少流體批號與去除點紀錄，日後同型件失效時無法分辨是流體老化還是量測問題。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
MRF simply presses abrasive onto the part with a magnet, so removal depends on how hard it presses.
Reporting a reflection-measured surface error directly as transmitted wavefront overstates it twofold and rejects a good part.
quiz.explanation: 把反射量測的表面誤差直接當成穿透波前報出，數值被高估兩倍而讓合格件被退回；或缺少流體批號與去除點紀錄，日後同型件失效時無法分辨是流體老化還是量測問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting a reflection-measured surface error directly as transmitted wavefront overstates it twofold and rejects a good part; missing fluid-batch and spot records later make it impossible to tell fluid ageing from a metrology problem when a similar part fails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
summary: 從單層膜的 Fresnel 振幅相加出發，用特徵矩陣與導納轉換推導四分之一波堆的反射率與阻帶寬度，再討論氧化物與氟化物材料、蒸鍍與濺鍍的微結構差異、石英晶體與光學監控、分光光度驗證與逆向工程、入射角與環境造成的光譜位移，直到均勻性夾具、環境測試與驗收交接。
summaryEn: Beginning with Fresnel amplitudes adding in a single film, derive quarter-wave-stack reflectance and stop-band width with the characteristic matrix and admittance transformation, then cover oxide and fluoride materials, the microstructural difference between evaporated and sputtered films, quartz-crystal and optical monitoring, spectrophotometric verification and reverse engineering, spectral shifts with incidence angle and environment, and finally uniformity fixtures, environmental testing and acceptance handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 薄膜、繞射與微結構光學元件
subcategoryTitleEn: Coatings, diffractive and structured optical elements

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 四分之一波堆練習：設計 550 nm 的 TiO₂/SiO₂ 高反射膜 Glass | (HL)⁹H | air，n_H = 2.35、n_L = 1.46、n_s = 1.52。各層厚度 d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm、d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm，19 層總厚度 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm。導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴，R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998（無吸收時）。阻帶半寬 Δg ≈ 0.150，阻帶約 478 到 647 nm。若整批厚度一致偏厚 1%，整個光譜紅移 5.5 nm；以 10° 入射使用時藍移 0.44%（2.4 nm），兩者部分抵消。以 IBS 0.1 nm/s 沉積需 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h；石英晶體監控一層 94.2 nm 的 SiO₂ 對應 Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz。數值為教學假設，不代表任何鍍膜廠的設計或製程。
workedExample.textEn: Quarter-wave-stack exercise: design a 550 nm TiO₂/SiO₂ high reflector Glass | (HL)⁹H | air with n_H = 2.35, n_L = 1.46 and n_s = 1.52. Layer thicknesses are d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm and d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm, a 19-layer total of 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm. The admittance Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴, so R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998 without absorption. The stop-band half-width Δg ≈ 0.150 gives a band from about 478 to 647 nm. A uniform 1% thickness excess red-shifts the whole spectrum by 5.5 nm, while use at 10° incidence blue-shifts it by 0.44% (2.4 nm), partly cancelling. Depositing by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h; one 94.2 nm SiO₂ layer on the quartz-crystal monitor corresponds to Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions, not any coating shop's design or process.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」與「特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition" and "Characteristic matrix, admittance transformation and the quarter-wave stack": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單層膜的兩個界面」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The two interfaces of a single film” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一層厚度 d、折射率 n₁ 的透明薄膜有兩個界面，各自依 Fresnel 公式反射一部分振幅；兩束反射光的相位差由光程 2n₁d·cosθ 決定，彼此可以相消或相加。當光學厚度 n₁d 等於四分之一波長時，兩個界面的反射相位相反，若 n₁ 介於入射介質與基板之間反射率下降，若 n₁ 高於基板反射率反而上升；光學厚度為半波時薄膜「隱形」，反射率回到裸基板值。這個單層結果是所有干涉鍍膜的基本單元，也說明為何同一層膜在不同波長下行為完全不同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單層膜的兩個界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transparent film of thickness d and index n₁ has two interfaces, each reflecting part of the amplitude according to the Fresnel equations; the phase difference between the two reflected waves is set by the path 2n₁d·cosθ, so they can cancel or reinforce. When the optical thickness n₁d equals a quarter wavelength the two reflections are in antiphase: reflectance drops if n₁ lies between the incident medium and substrate, but rises if n₁ exceeds the substrate index; at half-wave thickness the film is absentee and reflectance returns to the bare-substrate value. This single-layer result is the basic unit of every interference coating and shows why one film behaves completely differently at different wavelengths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The two interfaces of a single film”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單層膜的兩個界面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “The two interfaces of a single film”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加
knowledge.titleEn: Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition

When the optical thickness n₁d equals a quarter wavelength the two reflections are in antiphase: reflectance drops if n₁ lies between the incident medium and substrate, but rises if n₁ exceeds the substrate index; at half-wave thickness the film is absentee and reflectance returns to the bare-substrate value.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition" is correct?
options: 任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。
一層厚度 d、折射率 n₁ 的透明薄膜有兩個界面，各自依 Fresnel 公式反射一部分振幅。
層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。
optionsEn: Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass.
A transparent film of thickness d and index n₁ has two interfaces, each reflecting part of the amplitude according to the Fresnel equations.
More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider.
quiz.explanation: 一層厚度 d、折射率 n₁ 的透明薄膜有兩個界面，各自依 Fresnel 公式反射一部分振幅；兩束反射光的相位差由光程 2n₁d·cosθ 決定，彼此可以相消或相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A transparent film of thickness d and index n₁ has two interfaces, each reflecting part of the amplitude according to the Fresnel equations; the phase difference between the two reflected waves is set by the path 2n₁d·cosθ, so they can cancel or reinforce. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單層膜的兩個界面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The two interfaces of a single film” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。TiO₂（n₁ = 2.35）鍍在 BK7（n_s = 1.52）上：R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323，由裸玻璃的 4.3% 升到 32%；同一層在半波波長（設計波長的一半）時 R 回到 4.3%。相位厚度 δ = 2πn₁d/λ，550 nm 的四分之一波 TiO₂ 厚度 d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]². For TiO₂ (n₁ = 2.35) on BK7 (n_s = 1.52): R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323, up from 4.3% for bare glass to 32%; at the half-wave wavelength (half the design wavelength) R returns to 4.3%. The phase thickness is δ = 2πn₁d/λ, so a quarter-wave TiO₂ layer for 550 nm has d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%；用橢偏儀量出 n₁ 與 d，把量到的極值波長與 4n₁d 比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm; measure n₁ and d by ellipsometry and compare the measured extremum wavelength with 4n₁d.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。TiO₂（n₁ = 2.35）鍍在 BK7（n_s = 1.52）上：R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323，由裸玻璃的 4.3% 升到 32%；同一層在半波波長（設計波長的一半）時 R 回到 4.3%。相位厚度 δ = 2πn₁d/λ，550 nm 的四分之一波 TiO₂ 厚度 d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm。
knowledge.textEn: A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]². For TiO₂ (n₁ = 2.35) on BK7 (n_s = 1.52): R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323, up from 4.3% for bare glass to 32%; at the half-wave wavelength (half the design wavelength) R returns to 4.3%. The phase thickness is δ = 2πn₁d/λ, so a quarter-wave TiO₂ layer for 550 nm has d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition", which statement holds?
options: 石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。
鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。
四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。
optionsEn: The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate.
Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.
A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]².
quiz.explanation: 四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單層膜的兩個界面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “The two interfaces of a single film” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%；用橢偏儀量出 n₁ 與 d，把量到的極值波長與 4n₁d 比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm; measure n₁ and d by ellipsometry and compare the measured extremum wavelength with 4n₁d. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把高折射率單層誤當成增透膜鍍在透鏡上，反射率反而由 4% 升到 30%，整組鏡頭的穿透率與鬼影同時惡化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Depositing a high-index single layer as if it were an antireflection film raises reflectance from 4% to 30%, degrading lens transmission and ghost images together.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%；用橢偏儀量出 n₁ 與 d，把量到的極值波長與 4n₁d 比較。
knowledge.textEn: Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm; measure n₁ and d by ellipsometry and compare the measured extremum wavelength with 4n₁d.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition"?
options: 鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。
optionsEn: Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film.
quiz.explanation: 鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%；用橢偏儀量出 n₁ 與 d，把量到的極值波長與 4n₁d 比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm; measure n₁ and d by ellipsometry and compare the measured extremum wavelength with 4n₁d. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 把高折射率單層誤當成增透膜鍍在透鏡上，反射率反而由 4% 升到 30%，整組鏡頭的穿透率與鬼影同時惡化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Characteristic matrix, admittance transformation and the quarter-wave stack: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四分之一波堆與導納」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quarter-wave stack and admittance” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多層膜用每層的 2×2 特徵矩陣連乘來計算，矩陣元素只含該層的折射率與相位厚度，整個膜系在入射側呈現一個等效導納 Y，反射率就是 [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]²。四分之一波層的矩陣特別簡單：它把後方的導納 Y 轉成 n²/Y，所以高低折射率交替的 (HL)ᴺ 堆每加一對就把導納乘上 (n_H/n_L)²，反射率隨對數迅速逼近 1。阻帶寬度只由折射率比決定，與層數無關；層數只決定阻帶內的反射率深度與帶邊陡度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四分之一波堆與導納」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A multilayer is computed by multiplying the 2×2 characteristic matrix of each layer, whose elements contain only that layer's index and phase thickness; the whole stack presents an equivalent admittance Y on the incident side, and reflectance is [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]². A quarter-wave layer has an especially simple matrix: it transforms the admittance behind it, Y, into n²/Y, so each added pair of an alternating (HL)ᴺ stack multiplies the admittance by (n_H/n_L)² and reflectance approaches 1 rapidly with pair count. The stop-band width depends only on the index ratio, not on the layer count; the count sets only the reflectance depth inside the band and the edge steepness. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quarter-wave stack and admittance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Glass | (HL)ᴺ | air 的導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For glass | (HL)ᴺ | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四分之一波堆與導納」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Quarter-wave stack and admittance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider.

steps.title: 特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Characteristic matrix, admittance transformation and the quarter-wave stack: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四分之一波堆與導納」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quarter-wave stack and admittance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Glass | (HL)ᴺ | air 的導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s。TiO₂/SiO₂（2.35/1.46）、N = 10 對、n_s = 1.52：(2.35/1.46)²⁰ = e^{20×0.476} ≈ 1.37×10⁴，Y ≈ 2.08×10⁴，R = [(Y − 1)/(Y + 1)]² ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998。阻帶半寬 Δg = (2/π)·arcsin[(n_H − n_L)/(n_H + n_L)] = (2/π)·arcsin(0.234) ≈ 0.150，設計波長 550 nm 的阻帶約從 478 nm 延伸到 647 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For glass | (HL)ᴺ | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s. With TiO₂/SiO₂ (2.35/1.46), N = 10 pairs and n_s = 1.52: (2.35/1.46)²⁰ = e^{20×0.476} ≈ 1.37×10⁴, Y ≈ 2.08×10⁴, R = [(Y − 1)/(Y + 1)]² ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998. The stop-band half-width Δg = (2/π)·arcsin[(n_H − n_L)/(n_H + n_L)] = (2/π)·arcsin(0.234) ≈ 0.150, so a 550 nm design has a stop band from about 478 nm to 647 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用薄膜設計軟體或自行寫的矩陣程式計算 (HL)¹⁰ 的光譜，核對阻帶中心反射率與帶邊位置是否與導納公式一致；再量測實鍍樣品的反射率，比較阻帶寬度（應只隨折射率比變化）與帶內漣波（反映厚度誤差）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the (HL)¹⁰ spectrum with thin-film software or your own matrix code and check that the central reflectance and band edges agree with the admittance formulas; then measure a deposited sample and compare the stop-band width, which should depend only on index ratio, and the in-band ripple, which reflects thickness errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For glass | (HL)ᴺ | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s. With TiO₂/SiO₂ (2.35/1.46), N = 10 pairs and n_s = 1.52: (2.35/1.46)²⁰ = e^{20×0.476} ≈ 1.37×10⁴, Y ≈ 2.08×10⁴, R = [(Y − 1)/(Y + 1)]² ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998. The stop-band half-width Δg = (2/π)·arcsin[(n_H − n_L)/(n_H + n_L)] = (2/π)·arcsin(0.234) ≈ 0.150, so a 550 nm design has a stop band from about 478 nm to 647 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Characteristic matrix, admittance transformation and the quarter-wave stack: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四分之一波堆與導納」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Quarter-wave stack and admittance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用薄膜設計軟體或自行寫的矩陣程式計算 (HL)¹⁰ 的光譜，核對阻帶中心反射率與帶邊位置是否與導納公式一致；再量測實鍍樣品的反射率，比較阻帶寬度（應只隨折射率比變化）與帶內漣波（反映厚度誤差）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the (HL)¹⁰ spectrum with thin-film software or your own matrix code and check that the central reflectance and band edges agree with the admittance formulas; then measure a deposited sample and compare the stop-band width, which should depend only on index ratio, and the in-band ripple, which reflects thickness errors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了拓寬阻帶一味增加層數，寬度毫無改善而膜厚與應力倍增，基板彎曲且膜層開裂；正確做法是提高折射率比或堆疊不同中心波長的子堆。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Adding layers to widen a stop band leaves the width unchanged while doubling thickness and stress, bending the substrate and cracking the film; the correct approach is a higher index ratio or stacked sub-stacks with different centre wavelengths.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用薄膜設計軟體或自行寫的矩陣程式計算 (HL)¹⁰ 的光譜，核對阻帶中心反射率與帶邊位置是否與導納公式一致；再量測實鍍樣品的反射率，比較阻帶寬度（應只隨折射率比變化）與帶內漣波（反映厚度誤差）。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：阻帶寬度只由折射率比決定，與層數無關；層數只決定阻帶內的反射率深度與帶邊陡度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The stop-band width depends only on the index ratio, not on the layer count; the count sets only the reflectance depth inside the band and the edge steepness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了拓寬阻帶一味增加層數，寬度毫無改善而膜厚與應力倍增，基板彎曲且膜層開裂；正確做法是提高折射率比或堆疊不同中心波長的子堆。
knowledge.textEn: Adding layers to widen a stop band leaves the width unchanged while doubling thickness and stress, bending the substrate and cracking the film; the correct approach is a higher index ratio or stacked sub-stacks with different centre wavelengths.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Characteristic matrix, admittance transformation and the quarter-wave stack" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。
為了拓寬阻帶一味增加層數，寬度毫無改善而膜厚與應力倍增，基板彎曲且膜層開裂；正確做法是提高折射率比或堆疊不同中心波長的子堆。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material.
Adding layers to widen a stop band leaves the width unchanged while doubling thickness and stress, bending the substrate and cracking the film.
quiz.explanation: 為了拓寬阻帶一味增加層數，寬度毫無改善而膜厚與應力倍增，基板彎曲且膜層開裂；正確做法是提高折射率比或堆疊不同中心波長的子堆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding layers to widen a stop band leaves the width unchanged while doubling thickness and stress, bending the substrate and cracking the film; the correct approach is a higher index ratio or stacked sub-stacks with different centre wavelengths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度」與「沉積製程與厚度監控」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Material choice, absorption edge and packing density" and "Deposition processes and thickness monitoring": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氧化物與氟化物膜材」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Oxide and fluoride film materials” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層；紫外區要避開 TiO₂ 與 Ta₂O₅ 的吸收邊，改用 HfO₂ 或氟化物如 MgF₂（1.38）與 LaF₃；紅外區則用 ZnS、Ge、YbF₃。材料選擇同時受吸收係數、應力、硬度與與基板的附著力限制。蒸鍍膜常呈柱狀多孔結構，堆積密度 0.8 到 0.9，孔隙吸水後折射率上升、光譜紅移；離子輔助或濺鍍能把密度推近 1，光譜才能穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers; in the ultraviolet the absorption edges of TiO₂ and Ta₂O₅ must be avoided in favour of HfO₂ or fluorides such as MgF₂ (1.38) and LaF₃, while the infrared uses ZnS, Ge and YbF₃. The choice is also bounded by absorption coefficient, stress, hardness and adhesion to the substrate. Evaporated films are often columnar and porous with packing density 0.8 to 0.9; water filling the pores raises the index and red-shifts the spectrum, and only ion assistance or sputtering pushes density toward 1 so the spectrum stays stable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Oxide and fluoride film materials”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm; at p = 0.98 the same calculation gives only 0.3%, about 1.6 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Oxide and fluoride film materials”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度
knowledge.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density
knowledge.text: 可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層；紫外區要避開 TiO₂ 與 Ta₂O₅ 的吸收邊，改用 HfO₂ 或氟化物如 MgF₂（1.38）與 LaF₃；紅外區則用 ZnS、Ge、YbF₃。材料選擇同時受吸收係數、應力、硬度與與基板的附著力限制。
knowledge.textEn: Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers; in the ultraviolet the absorption edges of TiO₂ and Ta₂O₅ must be avoided in favour of HfO₂ or fluorides such as MgF₂ (1.38) and LaF₃, while the infrared uses ZnS, Ge and YbF₃. The choice is also bounded by absorption coefficient, stress, hardness and adhesion to the substrate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material choice, absorption edge and packing density" is correct?
options: 可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層。
薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。
石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。
optionsEn: Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers.
A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material.
The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate.
quiz.explanation: 可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層；紫外區要避開 TiO₂ 與 Ta₂O₅ 的吸收邊，改用 HfO₂ 或氟化物如 MgF₂（1.38）與 LaF₃；紅外區則用 ZnS、Ge、YbF₃。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers; in the ultraviolet the absorption edges of TiO₂ and Ta₂O₅ must be avoided in favour of HfO₂ or fluorides such as MgF₂ (1.38) and LaF₃, while the infrared uses ZnS, Ge and YbF₃. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Oxide and fluoride film materials” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性混合估計（教學假設）：堆積密度 p = 0.85 的 TiO₂ 膜，乾燥時 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275，孔隙吸水後 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325，光學厚度變化 Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2%，550 nm 的設計波長紅移約 12 nm；若 p = 0.98，同樣計算只得 0.3%，約 1.6 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm; at p = 0.98 the same calculation gives only 0.3%, about 1.6 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度；用橢偏儀量各材料的 n、k 光譜，確認在工作波段 k 低於 10⁻⁴ 並記錄吸收邊位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density; measure n and k spectra of each material by ellipsometry to confirm k below 10⁻⁴ in the working band and record the absorption-edge position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm; at p = 0.98 the same calculation gives only 0.3%, about 1.6 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Material choice, absorption edge and packing density", which statement holds?
options: 鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。
鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。
optionsEn: Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.

Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm.
A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number.
quiz.explanation: 線性混合估計（教學假設）：堆積密度 p = 0.85 的 TiO₂ 膜，乾燥時 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275，孔隙吸水後 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325，光學厚度變化 Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2%，550 nm 的設計波長紅移約 12 nm；若 p = 0.98，同樣計算只得 0.3%，約 1.6 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm; at p = 0.98 the same calculation gives only 0.3%, about 1.6 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氧化物與氟化物膜材」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Oxide and fluoride film materials” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度；用橢偏儀量各材料的 n、k 光譜，確認在工作波段 k 低於 10⁻⁴ 並記錄吸收邊位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density; measure n and k spectra of each material by ellipsometry to confirm k below 10⁻⁴ in the working band and record the absorption-edge position. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用 TiO₂ 設計 350 nm 紫外濾光片，膜層在工作波段強烈吸收，穿透率只剩設計值的一半且雷射照射下升溫脫落；蒸鍍多孔膜出廠光譜合格，裝機後因吸濕紅移 10 nm 而失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Designing a 350 nm ultraviolet filter with TiO₂ puts the working band inside its absorption, halving transmission and causing heating and delamination under laser exposure; a porous evaporated filter that passed at shipment fails after installation when humidity red-shifts it by 10 nm.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度；用橢偏儀量各材料的 n、k 光譜，確認在工作波段 k 低於 10⁻⁴ 並記錄吸收邊位置。
knowledge.textEn: Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density; measure n and k spectra of each material by ellipsometry to confirm k below 10⁻⁴ in the working band and record the absorption-edge position.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Material choice, absorption edge and packing density"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。
把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass.
Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density.
quiz.explanation: 把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度；用橢偏儀量各材料的 n、k 光譜，確認在工作波段 k 低於 10⁻⁴ 並記錄吸收邊位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density; measure n and k spectra of each material by ellipsometry to confirm k below 10⁻⁴ in the working band and record the absorption-edge position. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Oxide and fluoride film materials” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用 TiO₂ 設計 350 nm 紫外濾光片，膜層在工作波段強烈吸收，穿透率只剩設計值的一半且雷射照射下升溫脫落；蒸鍍多孔膜出廠光譜合格，裝機後因吸濕紅移 10 nm 而失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a 350 nm ultraviolet filter with TiO₂ puts the working band inside its absorption, halving transmission and causing heating and delamination under laser exposure; a porous evaporated filter that passed at shipment fails after installation when humidity red-shifts it by 10 nm. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：蒸鍍膜常呈柱狀多孔結構，堆積密度 0.8 到 0.9，孔隙吸水後折射率上升、光譜紅移；離子輔助或濺鍍能把密度推近 1，光譜才能穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Evaporated films are often columnar and porous with packing density 0.8 to 0.9; water filling the pores raises the index and red-shifts the spectrum, and only ion assistance or sputtering pushes density toward 1 so the spectrum stays stable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 用 TiO₂ 設計 350 nm 紫外濾光片，膜層在工作波段強烈吸收，穿透率只剩設計值的一半且雷射照射下升溫脫落；蒸鍍多孔膜出廠光譜合格，裝機後因吸濕紅移 10 nm 而失效。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Material choice, absorption edge and packing density" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
