steps.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Deposition processes and thickness monitoring: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高；磁控濺鍍與離子束濺鍍（IBS）的到達能量為數 eV 到數十 eV，膜層緻密、非晶且損耗最低，但 IBS 速率僅約 0.1 nm/s；原子層沉積以自限反應逐層生長，共形性最好但更慢。厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Electron-beam evaporation delivers adatoms with only about 0.1 eV, producing columnar porous films, and ion-assisted deposition raises their density; magnetron and ion-beam sputtering arrive with several to tens of eV, giving dense amorphous films with the lowest loss, though IBS runs at only about 0.1 nm/s; atomic layer deposition grows self-limiting monolayers with the best conformality but is slower still. Thickness monitoring comes in two kinds: a quartz-crystal microbalance converts mass change into frequency change through the Sauerbrey relation and needs a calibrated tooling factor to map crystal position to substrate position, while optical monitoring watches the transmittance or reflectance of a witness at a control wavelength and stops at the quarter-wave turning point, which self-compensates thickness errors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Sauerbrey：Δf = −C_f·Δm/A，5 MHz AT 切晶體 C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sauerbrey: Δf = −C_f·Δm/A with C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg for a 5 MHz AT-cut crystal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控
knowledge.text: 電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高；磁控濺鍍與離子束濺鍍（IBS）的到達能量為數 eV 到數十 eV，膜層緻密、非晶且損耗最低，但 IBS 速率僅約 0.1 nm/s；原子層沉積以自限反應逐層生長，共形性最好但更慢。厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。
knowledge.textEn: Electron-beam evaporation delivers adatoms with only about 0.1 eV, producing columnar porous films, and ion-assisted deposition raises their density; magnetron and ion-beam sputtering arrive with several to tens of eV, giving dense amorphous films with the lowest loss, though IBS runs at only about 0.1 nm/s; atomic layer deposition grows self-limiting monolayers with the best conformality but is slower still. Thickness monitoring comes in two kinds: a quartz-crystal microbalance converts mass change into frequency change through the Sauerbrey relation and needs a calibrated tooling factor to map crystal position to substrate position, while optical monitoring watches the transmittance or reflectance of a witness at a control wavelength and stops at the quarter-wave turning point, which self-compensates thickness errors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉積製程與厚度監控」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deposition processes and thickness monitoring" is correct?
options: 石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。
電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高。
分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。
optionsEn: The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate.
Electron-beam evaporation delivers adatoms with only about 0.1 eV, producing columnar porous films, and ion-assisted deposition raises their density.
A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.
quiz.explanation: 電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高；磁控濺鍍與離子束濺鍍（IBS）的到達能量為數 eV 到數十 eV，膜層緻密、非晶且損耗最低，但 IBS 速率僅約 0.1 nm/s；原子層沉積以自限反應逐層生長，共形性最好但更慢。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Electron-beam evaporation delivers adatoms with only about 0.1 eV, producing columnar porous films, and ion-assisted deposition raises their density; magnetron and ion-beam sputtering arrive with several to tens of eV, giving dense amorphous films with the lowest loss, though IBS runs at only about 0.1 nm/s; atomic layer deposition grows self-limiting monolayers with the best conformality but is slower still. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deposition processes and thickness monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Sauerbrey：Δf = −C_f·Δm/A，5 MHz AT 切晶體 C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg。鍍 100 nm 的 SiO₂（ρ = 2.2 g/cm³）面密度 Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm²，Δf ≈ −1245 Hz；頻率解析度 0.1 Hz 對應約 0.008 nm，但工具因子若誤差 2%，100 nm 層就偏 2 nm。IBS 以 0.1 nm/s 沉積 1.5 µm 的 19 層堆需約 4.2 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sauerbrey: Δf = −C_f·Δm/A with C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg for a 5 MHz AT-cut crystal. Depositing 100 nm of SiO₂ (ρ = 2.2 g/cm³) adds Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm², so Δf ≈ −1245 Hz; a 0.1 Hz resolution corresponds to about 0.008 nm, but a 2% tooling-factor error puts a 100 nm layer off by 2 nm. Depositing a 1.5 µm, 19-layer stack by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes about 4.2 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做；用光學監控記錄穿透率隨時間的曲線，確認轉折點清晰且在預期時間出現，並比較兩種監控給出的厚度差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture; record the optical-monitor transmittance trace against time, confirm the turning point is sharp and arrives when expected, and compare the thicknesses implied by the two monitors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Sauerbrey：Δf = −C_f·Δm/A，5 MHz AT 切晶體 C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg。鍍 100 nm 的 SiO₂（ρ = 2.2 g/cm³）面密度 Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm²，Δf ≈ −1245 Hz；頻率解析度 0.1 Hz 對應約 0.008 nm，但工具因子若誤差 2%，100 nm 層就偏 2 nm。IBS 以 0.1 nm/s 沉積 1.5 µm 的 19 層堆需約 4.2 h。
knowledge.textEn: Sauerbrey: Δf = −C_f·Δm/A with C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg for a 5 MHz AT-cut crystal. Depositing 100 nm of SiO₂ (ρ = 2.2 g/cm³) adds Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm², so Δf ≈ −1245 Hz; a 0.1 Hz resolution corresponds to about 0.008 nm, but a 2% tooling-factor error puts a 100 nm layer off by 2 nm. Depositing a 1.5 µm, 19-layer stack by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes about 4.2 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「沉積製程與厚度監控」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deposition processes and thickness monitoring", which statement holds?
options: 同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。
任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。
Sauerbrey：Δf = −C_f·Δm/A，5 MHz AT 切晶體 C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg。
optionsEn: Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film.
Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass.
Sauerbrey: Δf = −C_f·Δm/A with C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg for a 5 MHz AT-cut crystal.
quiz.explanation: Sauerbrey：Δf = −C_f·Δm/A，5 MHz AT 切晶體 C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Sauerbrey: Δf = −C_f·Δm/A with C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg for a 5 MHz AT-cut crystal. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deposition processes and thickness monitoring: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做；用光學監控記錄穿透率隨時間的曲線，確認轉折點清晰且在預期時間出現，並比較兩種監控給出的厚度差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture; record the optical-monitor transmittance trace against time, confirm the turning point is sharp and arrives when expected, and compare the thicknesses implied by the two monitors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：石英晶體壽命將盡時頻率跳動，監控把假訊號當成沉積量提前關閉快門，該層薄了 5%，整個濾光片的通帶偏移到規格之外；蒸鍍腔未加離子輔助，出廠合格的濾光片在濕季全部紅移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A crystal near end of life jitters in frequency, the monitor reads the glitch as deposition and closes the shutter early, the layer is 5% thin and the filter passband shifts out of specification; an evaporation chamber without ion assistance ships filters that all red-shift in the humid season.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做；用光學監控記錄穿透率隨時間的曲線，確認轉折點清晰且在預期時間出現，並比較兩種監控給出的厚度差異。
knowledge.textEn: Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture; record the optical-monitor transmittance trace against time, confirm the turning point is sharp and arrives when expected, and compare the thicknesses implied by the two monitors.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉積製程與厚度監控」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deposition processes and thickness monitoring"?
options: 鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。
optionsEn: Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider.
quiz.explanation: 鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做；用光學監控記錄穿透率隨時間的曲線，確認轉折點清晰且在預期時間出現，並比較兩種監控給出的厚度差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture; record the optical-monitor transmittance trace against time, confirm the turning point is sharp and arrives when expected, and compare the thicknesses implied by the two monitors. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deposition processes and thickness monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 石英晶體壽命將盡時頻率跳動，監控把假訊號當成沉積量提前關閉快門，該層薄了 5%，整個濾光片的通帶偏移到規格之外；蒸鍍腔未加離子輔助，出廠合格的濾光片在濕季全部紅移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A crystal near end of life jitters in frequency, the monitor reads the glitch as deposition and closes the shutter early, the layer is 5% thin and the filter passband shifts out of specification; an evaporation chamber without ion assistance ships filters that all red-shift in the humid season. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thickness monitoring comes in two kinds: a quartz-crystal microbalance converts mass change into frequency change through the Sauerbrey relation and needs a calibrated tooling factor to map crystal position to substrate position, while optical monitoring watches the transmittance or reflectance of a witness at a control wavelength and stops at the quarter-wave turning point, which self-compensates thickness errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 石英晶體壽命將盡時頻率跳動，監控把假訊號當成沉積量提前關閉快門，該層薄了 5%，整個濾光片的通帶偏移到規格之外；蒸鍍腔未加離子輔助，出廠合格的濾光片在濕季全部紅移。
knowledge.textEn: A crystal near end of life jitters in frequency, the monitor reads the glitch as deposition and closes the shutter early, the layer is 5% thin and the filter passband shifts out of specification; an evaporation chamber without ion assistance ships filters that all red-shift in the humid season.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉積製程與厚度監控」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deposition processes and thickness monitoring" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
石英晶體壽命將盡時頻率跳動，監控把假訊號當成沉積量提前關閉快門，該層薄了 5%，整個濾光片的通帶偏移到規格之外。
分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A crystal near end of life jitters in frequency, the monitor reads the glitch as deposition and closes the shutter early, the layer is 5% thin and the filter passband shifts out of specification.
A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.
quiz.explanation: 石英晶體壽命將盡時頻率跳動，監控把假訊號當成沉積量提前關閉快門，該層薄了 5%，整個濾光片的通帶偏移到規格之外；蒸鍍腔未加離子輔助，出廠合格的濾光片在濕季全部紅移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A crystal near end of life jitters in frequency, the monitor reads the glitch as deposition and closes the shutter early, the layer is 5% thin and the filter passband shifts out of specification; an evaporation chamber without ion assistance ships filters that all red-shift in the humid season. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」與「入射角、偏振與公差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition" and "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「分光光度計與逆向工程」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對；差異可用逆向工程把各層厚度與折射率當成未知數擬合，找出是哪一層、哪一種誤差造成偏移。損耗以 1 − R − T 分解成吸收與散射，吸收由光熱或光腔衰盪法量到 ppm 等級，散射由總積分散射儀取得。對窄帶濾光片，中心波長對光學厚度極度敏感，所以驗證必須同時說明量測的波長準確度與光束發散角。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「分光光度計與逆向工程」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. Loss is decomposed as 1 − R − T into absorption and scatter, absorption measured to ppm by photothermal or cavity ring-down methods and scatter by total-integrated-scatter instruments. For narrowband filters the centre wavelength is extremely sensitive to optical thickness, so verification must state the wavelength accuracy and beam divergence of the measurement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「分光光度計與逆向工程」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解
knowledge.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition
knowledge.text: 鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對；差異可用逆向工程把各層厚度與折射率當成未知數擬合，找出是哪一層、哪一種誤差造成偏移。損耗以 1 − R − T 分解成吸收與散射，吸收由光熱或光腔衰盪法量到 ppm 等級，散射由總積分散射儀取得。
knowledge.textEn: After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. Loss is decomposed as 1 − R − T into absorption and scatter, absorption measured to ppm by photothermal or cavity ring-down methods and scatter by total-integrated-scatter instruments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition" is correct?
options: 分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。
鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。
鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對。
optionsEn: A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.
Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.
After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve.
quiz.explanation: 鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對；差異可用逆向工程把各層厚度與折射率當成未知數擬合，找出是哪一層、哪一種誤差造成偏移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分光光度計與逆向工程」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。全膜厚度一致偏 1%，550 nm 設計位移 5.5 nm；1550 nm 的 DWDM 濾光片 FWHM 1 nm，0.1% 的厚度誤差已造成 1.55 nm 位移，所以必須控制到 0.01%（0.15 nm）等級，這就是 IBS 配合光學監控的理由。損耗分解：R = 99.95%、T = 0.03% 時 A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd). A uniform 1% thickness error shifts a 550 nm design by 5.5 nm; for a 1550 nm DWDM filter with 1 nm FWHM, a 0.1% error already shifts it 1.55 nm, so control must reach the 0.01% (0.15 nm) level, which is why IBS with optical monitoring is used. Loss decomposition: with R = 99.95% and T = 0.03%, A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。全膜厚度一致偏 1%，550 nm 設計位移 5.5 nm；1550 nm 的 DWDM 濾光片 FWHM 1 nm，0.1% 的厚度誤差已造成 1.55 nm 位移，所以必須控制到 0.01%（0.15 nm）等級，這就是 IBS 配合光學監控的理由。損耗分解：R = 99.95%、T = 0.03% 時 A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm。
knowledge.textEn: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd). A uniform 1% thickness error shifts a 550 nm design by 5.5 nm; for a 1550 nm DWDM filter with 1 nm FWHM, a 0.1% error already shifts it 1.55 nm, so control must reach the 0.01% (0.15 nm) level, which is why IBS with optical monitoring is used. Loss decomposition: with R = 99.95% and T = 0.03%, A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition", which statement holds?
options: 光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。
鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。
層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。
optionsEn: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd).
A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number.
More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider.
quiz.explanation: 光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「分光光度計與逆向工程」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品。
薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring.
A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material.
quiz.explanation: 先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分光光度計與逆向工程」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對窄帶濾光片，中心波長對光學厚度極度敏感，所以驗證必須同時說明量測的波長準確度與光束發散角。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For narrowband filters the centre wavelength is extremely sensitive to optical thickness, so verification must state the wavelength accuracy and beam divergence of the measurement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。
用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.
Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts.
quiz.explanation: 用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。斜入射時 s 與 p 偏振的 Fresnel 係數不同，阻帶寬度與帶邊位置分裂，45° 的分光鏡必須分別對兩個偏振設計。公差預算把厚度、折射率、均勻性與入射角誤差各自換算成波長位移，以均方根相加，再與規格的帶邊容差比較，決定哪一項必須被製程或量測收緊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths; the shift is governed by an effective index, with high-index stacks shifting less. At oblique incidence the s and p Fresnel coefficients differ, so stop-band width and edge positions split, and a 45° beam splitter must be designed for each polarization separately. The tolerance budget converts thickness, index, uniformity and angle errors into wavelength shifts, adds them root-sum-square and compares the total with the specified edge tolerance to decide which term the process or metrology must tighten. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算
knowledge.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget
knowledge.text: 薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。斜入射時 s 與 p 偏振的 Fresnel 係數不同，阻帶寬度與帶邊位置分裂，45° 的分光鏡必須分別對兩個偏振設計。
knowledge.textEn: The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths; the shift is governed by an effective index, with high-index stacks shifting less. At oblique incidence the s and p Fresnel coefficients differ, so stop-band width and edge positions split, and a 45° beam splitter must be designed for each polarization separately.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入射角、偏振與公差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget" is correct?
options: 薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。
鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。
同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。
optionsEn: The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths.
Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.
Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film.
quiz.explanation: 薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths; the shift is governed by an effective index, with high-index stacks shifting less. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²)。取 n_eff = 1.85（TiO₂/SiO₂ 幾何平均）：θ = 10° 時位移 −0.44%，550 nm 設計移 −2.4 nm；θ = 45° 時 √(1 − 0.5/3.42) ≈ 0.924，位移 −7.6%，約 −42 nm。帶邊公差 ±1%（±5.5 nm）的預算：厚度 0.5%、折射率 0.3%、均勻性 0.3%、入射角 ±2°（在 45° 附近約 0.5%），RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%，尚有餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²). With n_eff = 1.85 (the TiO₂/SiO₂ geometric mean): at θ = 10° the shift is −0.44%, −2.4 nm for a 550 nm design; at 45°, √(1 − 0.5/3.42) ≈ 0.924, a −7.6% shift of about −42 nm. For an edge tolerance of ±1% (±5.5 nm) the budget of thickness 0.5%, index 0.3%, uniformity 0.3% and angle ±2° (about 0.5% near 45°) gives RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%, still within margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff；把量到的批內位移分佈與公差預算的 RSS 比較，若實測分佈更寬，逐項找出被低估的來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the same sample at 0°, 10°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on the spectrophotometer, record the edge wavelengths and fit λ(θ) to extract n_eff; compare the measured within-batch shift distribution with the budget's RSS and, if the real spread is wider, locate the underestimated term one by one.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²). With n_eff = 1.85 (the TiO₂/SiO₂ geometric mean): at θ = 10° the shift is −0.44%, −2.4 nm for a 550 nm design; at 45°, √(1 − 0.5/3.42) ≈ 0.924, a −7.6% shift of about −42 nm. For an edge tolerance of ±1% (±5.5 nm) the budget of thickness 0.5%, index 0.3%, uniformity 0.3% and angle ±2° (about 0.5% near 45°) gives RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%, still within margin.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「入射角、偏振與公差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget", which statement holds?
options: 任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。
λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²)。
薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。
optionsEn: Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass.
λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²).
A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material.
quiz.explanation: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff；把量到的批內位移分佈與公差預算的 RSS 比較，若實測分佈更寬，逐項找出被低估的來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the same sample at 0°, 10°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on the spectrophotometer, record the edge wavelengths and fit λ(θ) to extract n_eff; compare the measured within-batch shift distribution with the budget's RSS and, if the real spread is wider, locate the underestimated term one by one. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在 0° 設計並驗證的濾光片被裝在 20° 收斂光束中，中心藍移 1.7% 且通帶因角度範圍而變寬，系統訊噪比下降；45° 分光鏡只對平均偏振設計，s 與 p 的分光比差了 20%，偏振相關損耗超標。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A filter designed and verified at 0° installed in a 20° converging beam blue-shifts by 1.7% and broadens with the angle range, lowering system signal-to-noise; a 45° splitter designed for average polarization splits s and p 20% apart and fails polarization-dependent loss.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff；把量到的批內位移分佈與公差預算的 RSS 比較，若實測分佈更寬，逐項找出被低估的來源。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the same sample at 0°, 10°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on the spectrophotometer, record the edge wavelengths and fit λ(θ) to extract n_eff; compare the measured within-batch shift distribution with the budget's RSS and, if the real spread is wider, locate the underestimated term one by one.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入射角、偏振與公差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。
在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate.
Measure the same sample at 0°, 10°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on the spectrophotometer, record the edge wavelengths and fit λ(θ) to extract n_eff.
quiz.explanation: 在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff；把量到的批內位移分佈與公差預算的 RSS 比較，若實測分佈更寬，逐項找出被低估的來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the same sample at 0°, 10°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on the spectrophotometer, record the edge wavelengths and fit λ(θ) to extract n_eff; compare the measured within-batch shift distribution with the budget's RSS and, if the real spread is wider, locate the underestimated term one by one. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在 0° 設計並驗證的濾光片被裝在 20° 收斂光束中，中心藍移 1.7% 且通帶因角度範圍而變寬，系統訊噪比下降；45° 分光鏡只對平均偏振設計，s 與 p 的分光比差了 20%，偏振相關損耗超標。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A filter designed and verified at 0° installed in a 20° converging beam blue-shifts by 1.7% and broadens with the angle range, lowering system signal-to-noise; a 45° splitter designed for average polarization splits s and p 20% apart and fails polarization-dependent loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：公差預算把厚度、折射率、均勻性與入射角誤差各自換算成波長位移，以均方根相加，再與規格的帶邊容差比較，決定哪一項必須被製程或量測收緊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The tolerance budget converts thickness, index, uniformity and angle errors into wavelength shifts, adds them root-sum-square and compares the total with the specified edge tolerance to decide which term the process or metrology must tighten.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在 0° 設計並驗證的濾光片被裝在 20° 收斂光束中，中心藍移 1.7% 且通帶因角度範圍而變寬，系統訊噪比下降；45° 分光鏡只對平均偏振設計，s 與 p 的分光比差了 20%，偏振相關損耗超標。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入射角、偏振與公差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。

optionsEn: A filter designed and verified at 0° installed in a 20° converging beam blue-shifts by 1.7% and broadens with the angle range, lowering system signal-to-noise.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film.
quiz.explanation: 在 0° 設計並驗證的濾光片被裝在 20° 收斂光束中，中心藍移 1.7% 且通帶因角度範圍而變寬，系統訊噪比下降；45° 分光鏡只對平均偏振設計，s 與 p 的分光比差了 20%，偏振相關損耗超標。 需以量測區分可能原因。
