Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久」與「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability" and "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內；濺鍍系統則靠靶材與基板幾何及公轉達到相同目的。每一批放入與產品同材料的見證片，用於光譜、附著與環境測試。環境耐久依 ISO 9211 或軍規序列進行：濕熱、鹽霧、溫度循環、膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗，確認膜層不會起泡、龜裂或脫落。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion. Each batch carries witness samples of the same material as the product for spectral, adhesion and environmental tests. Durability follows ISO 9211 or military-specification sequences: humidity, salt fog, temperature cycling, tape adhesion and eraser abrasion, confirming that the film neither blisters, cracks nor delaminates. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久
knowledge.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability
knowledge.text: 鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內；濺鍍系統則靠靶材與基板幾何及公轉達到相同目的。每一批放入與產品同材料的見證片，用於光譜、附著與環境測試。
knowledge.textEn: Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion. Each batch carries witness samples of the same material as the product for spectral, adhesion and environmental tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability" is correct?
options: 同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。
鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內。
鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。
optionsEn: Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film.

Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion.
A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number.
quiz.explanation: 鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內；濺鍍系統則靠靶材與基板幾何及公轉達到相同目的。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。源到基板 h = 600 mm，離軸 r = 150 mm：(1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129，厚度只有中心的 88.6%，即 11.4% 的落差；加上行星公轉與遮罩後，批內殘差可壓到 ±0.3%。環境測試後允許的光譜位移若為 ±0.5%，依第三單元的線性混合估計就要求堆積密度高於約 0.97。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]². For a source-to-substrate height h = 600 mm and off-axis radius r = 150 mm, (1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129, so the thickness is only 88.6% of centre, an 11.4% fall-off; planetary rotation plus masking brings the within-batch residual to ±0.3%. If the allowed spectral shift after environmental testing is ±0.5%, the linear-mixing estimate of unit 3 requires a packing density above about 0.97. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。源到基板 h = 600 mm，離軸 r = 150 mm：(1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129，厚度只有中心的 88.6%，即 11.4% 的落差；加上行星公轉與遮罩後，批內殘差可壓到 ±0.3%。環境測試後允許的光譜位移若為 ±0.5%，依第三單元的線性混合估計就要求堆積密度高於約 0.97。
knowledge.textEn: A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]². For a source-to-substrate height h = 600 mm and off-axis radius r = 150 mm, (1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129, so the thickness is only 88.6% of centre, an 11.4% fall-off; planetary rotation plus masking brings the within-batch residual to ±0.3%. If the allowed spectral shift after environmental testing is ±0.5%, the linear-mixing estimate of unit 3 requires a packing density above about 0.97.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability", which statement holds?
options: 層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。
石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。
面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。
optionsEn: More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider.
The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate.
A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]².
quiz.explanation: 面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification; poor substrate cleaning gives weak adhesion and the film peels in sheets after salt-fog testing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。
knowledge.textEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability"?
options: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。
optionsEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.
quiz.explanation: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification; poor substrate cleaning gives weak adhesion and the film peels in sheets after salt-fog testing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環境耐久依 ISO 9211 或軍規序列進行：濕熱、鹽霧、溫度循環、膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗，確認膜層不會起泡、龜裂或脫落。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Durability follows ISO 9211 or military-specification sequences: humidity, salt fog, temperature cycling, tape adhesion and eraser abrasion, confirming that the film neither blisters, cracks nor delaminates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。
knowledge.textEn: A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification; poor substrate cleaning gives weak adhesion and the film peels in sheets after salt-fog testing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。
鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification.
A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number.
quiz.explanation: 修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification; poor substrate cleaning gives weak adhesion and the film peels in sheets after salt-fog testing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。因為量測有不確定度，驗收必須設保護帶：量測值必須比規格好於量測不確定度的範圍才能判定合格。交接資料包含設計層結構摘要（不含製程配方）、見證片光譜、逆向工程結果、均勻性分佈、環境測試報告與批次編號，讓系統整合端能追溯每片元件的鍍膜狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold; missing any item leaves acceptance without a basis. Because measurements carry uncertainty, acceptance needs a guard band: the measured value must beat the specification by the measurement uncertainty before a pass is declared. The handoff package holds a design summary of the layer structure (not the process recipe), witness spectra, reverse-engineering results, uniformity map, environmental test report and batch numbers so the system integrator can trace each element's coating state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。因為量測有不確定度，驗收必須設保護帶：量測值必須比規格好於量測不確定度的範圍才能判定合格。
knowledge.textEn: A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold; missing any item leaves acceptance without a basis. Because measurements carry uncertainty, acceptance needs a guard band: the measured value must beat the specification by the measurement uncertainty before a pass is declared.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。
任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。
鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。
optionsEn: A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number.
Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass.

A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold.
quiz.explanation: 鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold; missing any item leaves acceptance without a basis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。製程能力：帶邊規格 ±1.5%，製程位移標準差 σ = 0.33%（±1% 為 3σ），C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5，預期良率約 99.99%；若 σ 升到 0.5%，C_pk = 1.0，良率約 99.7%，每千片有 3 片超規。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%. Process capability: edge specification ±1.5% with a process shift standard deviation σ = 0.33% (±1% as 3σ) gives C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5 and an expected yield of about 99.99%; if σ rises to 0.5%, C_pk = 1.0 and yield about 99.7%, three parts per thousand out of specification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。製程能力：帶邊規格 ±1.5%，製程位移標準差 σ = 0.33%（±1% 為 3σ），C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5，預期良率約 99.99%；若 σ 升到 0.5%，C_pk = 1.0，良率約 99.7%，每千片有 3 片超規。
knowledge.textEn: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%. Process capability: edge specification ±1.5% with a process shift standard deviation σ = 0.33% (±1% as 3σ) gives C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5 and an expected yield of about 99.99%; if σ rises to 0.5%, C_pk = 1.0 and yield about 99.7%, three parts per thousand out of specification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。
薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。
分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。
optionsEn: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%.
A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material.
A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.
quiz.explanation: 規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格只寫「穿透率大於 95%」而未指定波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向合格，客戶在 480 nm、15° 下使用而穿透率只有 90%，雙方各執一詞；沒有批次編號，現場失效的濾光片無法回溯到同爐的見證片。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A specification reading only transmittance above 95% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while the customer uses it at 480 nm and 15° with 90% transmission, leaving both sides arguing; without batch numbers a field failure cannot be traced back to its witness samples.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。
knowledge.textEn: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半。
鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band.
Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.
quiz.explanation: 抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格只寫「穿透率大於 95%」而未指定波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向合格，客戶在 480 nm、15° 下使用而穿透率只有 90%，雙方各執一詞；沒有批次編號，現場失效的濾光片無法回溯到同爐的見證片。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A specification reading only transmittance above 95% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while the customer uses it at 480 nm and 15° with 90% transmission, leaving both sides arguing; without batch numbers a field failure cannot be traced back to its witness samples. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料包含設計層結構摘要（不含製程配方）、見證片光譜、逆向工程結果、均勻性分佈、環境測試報告與批次編號，讓系統整合端能追溯每片元件的鍍膜狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package holds a design summary of the layer structure (not the process recipe), witness spectra, reverse-engineering results, uniformity map, environmental test report and batch numbers so the system integrator can trace each element's coating state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。
規格只寫「穿透率大於 95%」而未指定波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向合格，客戶在 480 nm、15° 下使用而穿透率只有 90%，雙方各執一詞。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass.

A specification reading only transmittance above 95% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while the customer uses it at 480 nm and 15° with 90% transmission, leaving both sides arguing.
quiz.explanation: 規格只寫「穿透率大於 95%」而未指定波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向合格，客戶在 480 nm、15° 下使用而穿透率只有 90%，雙方各執一詞；沒有批次編號，現場失效的濾光片無法回溯到同爐的見證片。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A specification reading only transmittance above 95% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while the customer uses it at 480 nm and 15° with 90% transmission, leaving both sides arguing; without batch numbers a field failure cannot be traced back to its witness samples. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 增透膜設計與沉積
summary: 從 Fresnel 反射與多片鏡頭的穿透率損失出發，用導納匹配條件推導 MgF₂ 單層、四分之一波雙層 V 膜與四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜的殘餘反射率，再討論低折射率膜材與熱基板蒸鍍、透鏡上的厚度分佈、低反射率量測的背面陷阱、入射角與偏振的影響，最後把殘餘反射換算成鏡頭鬼影與穿透率預算並完成驗收交接。
summaryEn: Starting from Fresnel reflection and the transmission loss of multi-element lenses, derive the residual reflectance of a MgF₂ single layer, a quarter-quarter V-coat and a quarter-half-quarter broadband design from the admittance-matching condition, then cover low-index materials and hot-substrate evaporation, thickness distribution on lenses, the back-surface trap in low-reflectance metrology, incidence-angle and polarization effects, and finally convert residual reflectance into lens ghost and transmission budgets for acceptance handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 增透膜設計與整合練習：BK7（n_s = 1.52）透鏡，工作波段 450 到 650 nm，主光線入射角 0 到 30°。先評估單層 MgF₂：R(550) = [(1.52 − 1.38²)/(1.52 + 1.38²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/3.424]² ≈ 0.0126，400 到 700 nm 平均 1.48%，不符 0.5% 的要求。改用四分之一／半波／四分之一設計（520 nm）：MgF₂ 94.2 nm、ZrO₂ 126.8 nm、Al₂O₃ 79.8 nm，矩陣計算 400 到 700 nm 平均 0.20%，30° 時 0.31%，仍在 0.5% 內。二十面中十六面以此膜計 0.25%、四面陡峭面計 0.5%，鏡頭穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ × 0.98 ≈ 0.92，最亮雙面鬼影 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵。製程公差：蒙地卡羅各層 ±3% 厚度擾動一千次後平均反射率落在 0.19% 到 0.28%，良率 100%；邊緣傾角 30° 的面厚度薄 13%，需把夾具傾斜或把設計中心上移 5% 補償。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Antireflection design and integration exercise: a BK7 lens (n_s = 1.52) working from 450 to 650 nm with chief-ray incidence from 0 to 30°. First evaluate single-layer MgF₂: R(550) = [(1.52 − 1.38²)/(1.52 + 1.38²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/3.424]² ≈ 0.0126 and a 400 to 700 nm average of 1.48%, failing the 0.5% requirement. Switch to a quarter-half-quarter design at 520 nm: MgF₂ 94.2 nm, ZrO₂ 126.8 nm, Al₂O₃ 79.8 nm; the matrix calculation gives a 400 to 700 nm average of 0.20% and 0.31% at 30°, still within 0.5%. Counting sixteen of twenty surfaces at 0.25% and four steep surfaces at 0.5%, lens transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ × 0.98 ≈ 0.92 and the brightest two-surface ghost is 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵. Process tolerance: a thousand-trial Monte-Carlo run with ±3% thickness perturbation per layer keeps the average reflectance between 0.19% and 0.28%, full yield; a surface with a 30° rim tilt receives 13% less thickness and needs a tilted fixture or a 5% upward bias of the design centre to compensate. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影」與「導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images" and "Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每個空氣與玻璃的界面在正向入射時依 Fresnel 公式反射 [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² 的能量，BK7 約 4.3%。一支十片透鏡的鏡頭有二十個這樣的界面，未鍍膜時穿透率只剩四成，而且任意兩個界面反射的光會再度抵達像面形成鬼影，其強度正比於兩個反射率的乘積。增透膜的任務就是把每個界面的反射率壓到千分之幾，使穿透率回到九成以上，並把鬼影強度降低兩個數量級；因此增透膜的規格必須從系統的穿透率與雜散光預算倒推，而不是單獨追求某一波長的零反射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At normal incidence each air-glass interface reflects a fraction [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² of the energy by the Fresnel equations, about 4.3% for BK7. A ten-element lens has twenty such interfaces, so uncoated it transmits only about forty percent, and light reflected by any two interfaces reaches the image again as a ghost whose intensity scales with the product of the two reflectances. The job of an antireflection film is to push each interface to a few tenths of a percent, restoring transmission above ninety percent and cutting ghost intensity by two orders of magnitude; the coating specification therefore follows from the system's transmission and stray-light budget rather than from zero reflectance at one wavelength. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A single BK7 interface has R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影
knowledge.titleEn: Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images
knowledge.text: 每個空氣與玻璃的界面在正向入射時依 Fresnel 公式反射 [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² 的能量，BK7 約 4.3%。一支十片透鏡的鏡頭有二十個這樣的界面，未鍍膜時穿透率只剩四成，而且任意兩個界面反射的光會再度抵達像面形成鬼影，其強度正比於兩個反射率的乘積。
knowledge.textEn: At normal incidence each air-glass interface reflects a fraction [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² of the energy by the Fresnel equations, about 4.3% for BK7. A ten-element lens has twenty such interfaces, so uncoated it transmits only about forty percent, and light reflected by any two interfaces reaches the image again as a ghost whose intensity scales with the product of the two reflectances.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images" is correct?
options: 一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。
每個空氣與玻璃的界面在正向入射時依 Fresnel 公式反射 [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² 的能量，BK7 約 4.3%。
增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall.
At normal incidence each air-glass interface reflects a fraction [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² of the energy by the Fresnel equations, about 4.3% for BK7.
An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 每個空氣與玻璃的界面在正向入射時依 Fresnel 公式反射 [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² 的能量，BK7 約 4.3%。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At normal incidence each air-glass interface reflects a fraction [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² of the energy by the Fresnel equations, about 4.3% for BK7. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：BK7 單界面 R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426。二十個界面：未鍍膜穿透率 0.9574²⁰ ≈ 0.42；每面 0.5% 時 0.995²⁰ ≈ 0.905；每面 0.2% 時 0.998²⁰ ≈ 0.961。雙面鬼影相對強度 ≈ R₁·R₂：未鍍膜 0.0426² ≈ 1.8×10⁻³，鍍 0.5% 增透膜後 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，下降約 72 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A single BK7 interface has R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426. For twenty interfaces the uncoated transmission is 0.9574²⁰ ≈ 0.42; at 0.5% per surface 0.995²⁰ ≈ 0.905; at 0.2% per surface 0.998²⁰ ≈ 0.961. The relative intensity of a two-surface ghost ≈ R₁·R₂: uncoated 0.0426² ≈ 1.8×10⁻³, with 0.5% antireflection 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵, about 72 times lower. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用積分球或準直光束量整支鏡頭在工作波段的穿透率，與每面反射率的乘積模型比較；把鏡頭對準點光源拍攝，量測鬼影相對亮度並用光線追跡的鬼影分析辨認是哪一對面，核對其乘積是否與量到的亮度一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the whole lens's in-band transmission with an integrating sphere or a collimated beam and compare with the product-of-surfaces model; photograph a point source through the lens, measure relative ghost brightness and identify the responsible surface pair with ray-trace ghost analysis, checking that the product of their reflectances matches the measured brightness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A single BK7 interface has R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426. For twenty interfaces the uncoated transmission is 0.9574²⁰ ≈ 0.42; at 0.5% per surface 0.995²⁰ ≈ 0.905; at 0.2% per surface 0.998²⁰ ≈ 0.961. The relative intensity of a two-surface ghost ≈ R₁·R₂: uncoated 0.0426² ≈ 1.8×10⁻³, with 0.5% antireflection 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵, about 72 times lower.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images", which statement holds?
options: 同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。
增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。
optionsEn: A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited.
Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle.
A single BK7 interface has R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426.
quiz.explanationEn: A single BK7 interface has R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用積分球或準直光束量整支鏡頭在工作波段的穿透率，與每面反射率的乘積模型比較；把鏡頭對準點光源拍攝，量測鬼影相對亮度並用光線追跡的鬼影分析辨認是哪一對面，核對其乘積是否與量到的亮度一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the whole lens's in-band transmission with an integrating sphere or a collimated beam and compare with the product-of-surfaces model; photograph a point source through the lens, measure relative ghost brightness and identify the responsible surface pair with ray-trace ghost analysis, checking that the product of their reflectances matches the measured brightness. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只在 550 nm 要求零反射而忽略 450 nm 與 650 nm 的殘餘反射，鏡頭在白光下出現帶紫紅色的鬼影與偏色的穿透率，影像對比在藍與紅端下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Demanding zero reflectance at 550 nm while ignoring the residual at 450 and 650 nm produces purple-tinted ghosts and a colour-biased transmission under white light, lowering contrast at the blue and red ends.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用積分球或準直光束量整支鏡頭在工作波段的穿透率，與每面反射率的乘積模型比較；把鏡頭對準點光源拍攝，量測鬼影相對亮度並用光線追跡的鬼影分析辨認是哪一對面，核對其乘積是否與量到的亮度一致。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the whole lens's in-band transmission with an integrating sphere or a collimated beam and compare with the product-of-surfaces model; photograph a point source through the lens, measure relative ghost brightness and identify the responsible surface pair with ray-trace ghost analysis, checking that the product of their reflectances matches the measured brightness.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images"?
options: 用積分球或準直光束量整支鏡頭在工作波段的穿透率，與每面反射率的乘積模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。
optionsEn: Measure the whole lens's in-band transmission with an integrating sphere or a collimated beam and compare with the product-of-surfaces model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface.
quiz.explanation: 用積分球或準直光束量整支鏡頭在工作波段的穿透率，與每面反射率的乘積模型比較；把鏡頭對準點光源拍攝，量測鬼影相對亮度並用光線追跡的鬼影分析辨認是哪一對面，核對其乘積是否與量到的亮度一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the whole lens's in-band transmission with an integrating sphere or a collimated beam and compare with the product-of-surfaces model; photograph a point source through the lens, measure relative ghost brightness and identify the responsible surface pair with ray-trace ghost analysis, checking that the product of their reflectances matches the measured brightness. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 只在 550 nm 要求零反射而忽略 450 nm 與 650 nm 的殘餘反射，鏡頭在白光下出現帶紫紅色的鬼影與偏色的穿透率，影像對比在藍與紅端下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Demanding zero reflectance at 550 nm while ignoring the residual at 450 and 650 nm produces purple-tinted ghosts and a colour-biased transmission under white light, lowering contrast at the blue and red ends. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：增透膜的任務就是把每個界面的反射率壓到千分之幾，使穿透率回到九成以上，並把鬼影強度降低兩個數量級；因此增透膜的規格必須從系統的穿透率與雜散光預算倒推，而不是單獨追求某一波長的零反射。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The job of an antireflection film is to push each interface to a few tenths of a percent, restoring transmission above ninety percent and cutting ghost intensity by two orders of magnitude; the coating specification therefore follows from the system's transmission and stray-light budget rather than from zero reflectance at one wavelength.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Demanding zero reflectance at 550 nm while ignoring the residual at 450 and 650 nm produces purple-tinted ghosts and a colour-biased transmission under white light, lowering contrast at the blue and red ends.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
只在 550 nm 要求零反射而忽略 450 nm 與 650 nm 的殘餘反射，鏡頭在白光下出現帶紫紅色的鬼影與偏色的穿透率，影像對比在藍與紅端下降。
增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Demanding zero reflectance at 550 nm while ignoring the residual at 450 and 650 nm produces purple-tinted ghosts and a colour-biased transmission under white light, lowering contrast at the blue and red ends.
An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 只在 550 nm 要求零反射而忽略 450 nm 與 650 nm 的殘餘反射，鏡頭在白光下出現帶紫紅色的鬼影與偏色的穿透率，影像對比在藍與紅端下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Demanding zero reflectance at 550 nm while ignoring the residual at 450 and 650 nm produces purple-tinted ghosts and a colour-biased transmission under white light, lowering contrast at the blue and red ends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增透的條件是讓膜系在入射側的等效導納等於入射介質的折射率。四分之一波單層把基板導納 n_s 轉成 n₁²/n_s，要完全匹配空氣需要 n₁ = √n_s，對 BK7 是 1.23，沒有這麼低的緻密材料，最接近的 MgF₂（1.38）只能把反射率降到 1.3%。雙層四分之一波設計用內層的高折射率把基板導納先抬高、再由外層 MgF₂ 拉回 1，條件是 n₂/n₁ = √n_s；這種設計在單一波長達到近零反射而兩側迅速上升，光譜呈 V 形，因此稱為 V 膜，適合雷射線寬的應用。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The antireflection condition is that the stack's equivalent admittance on the incident side equals the index of the incident medium. A quarter-wave single layer transforms the substrate admittance n_s into n₁²/n_s, so matching air requires n₁ = √n_s, about 1.23 for BK7; no dense material is that low, and the closest, MgF₂ at 1.38, only brings reflectance down to 1.3%. A two-layer quarter-quarter design uses a higher-index inner layer to raise the substrate admittance first and the outer MgF₂ layer to bring it back to 1, with the condition n₂/n₁ = √n_s; it reaches near-zero reflectance at one wavelength and rises quickly on both sides, giving the V-shaped spectrum that names the V-coat and suits laser-line applications. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A quarter-wave MgF₂ single layer on BK7: R = [(n_s − n₁²)/(n_s + n₁²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/(1.52 + 1.904)]² ≈ 0.0126.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜
knowledge.titleEn: Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs
knowledge.text: 增透的條件是讓膜系在入射側的等效導納等於入射介質的折射率。四分之一波單層把基板導納 n_s 轉成 n₁²/n_s，要完全匹配空氣需要 n₁ = √n_s，對 BK7 是 1.23，沒有這麼低的緻密材料，最接近的 MgF₂（1.38）只能把反射率降到 1.3%。
knowledge.textEn: The antireflection condition is that the stack's equivalent admittance on the incident side equals the index of the incident medium. A quarter-wave single layer transforms the substrate admittance n_s into n₁²/n_s, so matching air requires n₁ = √n_s, about 1.23 for BK7; no dense material is that low, and the closest, MgF₂ at 1.38, only brings reflectance down to 1.3%.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs" is correct?
options: 增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。
半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。
增透的條件是讓膜系在入射側的等效導納等於入射介質的折射率。
optionsEn: An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant.
A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design.
The antireflection condition is that the stack's equivalent admittance on the incident side equals the index of the incident medium.
quiz.explanation: 增透的條件是讓膜系在入射側的等效導納等於入射介質的折射率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The antireflection condition is that the stack's equivalent admittance on the incident side equals the index of the incident medium. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單層四分之一波 MgF₂ 於 BK7：R = [(n_s − n₁²)/(n_s + n₁²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/(1.52 + 1.904)]² ≈ 0.0126。雙層 MgF₂/Al₂O₃（1.38/1.63）：Y = n₁²·n_s/n₂² = 1.904×1.52/2.657 ≈ 1.090，R = [(1 − 1.090)/(1 + 1.090)]² ≈ 0.0018；理想內層 n₂ = 1.38×√1.52 ≈ 1.70 時 R 趨近 0。V 膜在 550 nm 設計下，500 nm 為 0.51%、600 nm 為 0.41%、450 nm 已達 1.6%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A quarter-wave MgF₂ single layer on BK7: R = [(n_s − n₁²)/(n_s + n₁²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/(1.52 + 1.904)]² ≈ 0.0126. A two-layer MgF₂/Al₂O₃ (1.38/1.63) design: Y = n₁²·n_s/n₂² = 1.904×1.52/2.657 ≈ 1.090 and R = [(1 − 1.090)/(1 + 1.090)]² ≈ 0.0018; with the ideal inner index n₂ = 1.38×√1.52 ≈ 1.70, R approaches 0. Designed for 550 nm, the V-coat reads 0.51% at 500 nm, 0.41% at 600 nm and already 1.6% at 450 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在導納圖上手繪兩層的軌跡：從 n_s 出發，內層四分之一波沿圓弧走到 n₂²/n_s，外層再走到 n₁²n_s/n₂²，確認終點是否落在 1 附近；再把鍍好的 V 膜用分光光度計掃描，確認最低點波長與設計一致、兩側上升速率符合計算曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace the two-layer path on an admittance diagram: start at n_s, let the inner quarter wave move along its arc to n₂²/n_s and the outer layer to n₁²n_s/n₂², and check that the end point lands near 1; then scan the deposited V-coat on a spectrophotometer to confirm that the minimum wavelength matches the design and that the rise on both sides follows the calculated curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A quarter-wave MgF₂ single layer on BK7: R = [(n_s − n₁²)/(n_s + n₁²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/(1.52 + 1.904)]² ≈ 0.0126. A two-layer MgF₂/Al₂O₃ (1.38/1.63) design: Y = n₁²·n_s/n₂² = 1.904×1.52/2.657 ≈ 1.090 and R = [(1 − 1.090)/(1 + 1.090)]² ≈ 0.0018; with the ideal inner index n₂ = 1.38×√1.52 ≈ 1.70, R approaches 0. Designed for 550 nm, the V-coat reads 0.51% at 500 nm, 0.41% at 600 nm and already 1.6% at 450 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在導納圖上手繪兩層的軌跡：從 n_s 出發，內層四分之一波沿圓弧走到 n₂²/n_s，外層再走到 n₁²n_s/n₂²，確認終點是否落在 1 附近；再把鍍好的 V 膜用分光光度計掃描，確認最低點波長與設計一致、兩側上升速率符合計算曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace the two-layer path on an admittance diagram: start at n_s, let the inner quarter wave move along its arc to n₂²/n_s and the outer layer to n₁²n_s/n₂², and check that the end point lands near 1; then scan the deposited V-coat on a spectrophotometer to confirm that the minimum wavelength matches the design and that the rise on both sides follows the calculated curve. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把內外層順序顛倒，MgF₂ 貼在玻璃上而 Al₂O₃ 在最外側，導納終點落在 2 以上，反射率反而比裸玻璃高；或用 V 膜處理白光鏡頭，兩端殘餘反射超過 1.5% 而產生偏色。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reversing the layer order, with MgF₂ against the glass and Al₂O₃ outermost, lands the admittance above 2 and reflects more than bare glass; using a V-coat on a white-light lens leaves residuals above 1.5% at the band ends and causes colour cast.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在導納圖上手繪兩層的軌跡：從 n_s 出發，內層四分之一波沿圓弧走到 n₂²/n_s，外層再走到 n₁²n_s/n₂²，確認終點是否落在 1 附近；再把鍍好的 V 膜用分光光度計掃描，確認最低點波長與設計一致、兩側上升速率符合計算曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Trace the two-layer path on an admittance diagram: start at n_s, let the inner quarter wave move along its arc to n₂²/n_s and the outer layer to n₁²n_s/n₂², and check that the end point lands near 1; then scan the deposited V-coat on a spectrophotometer to confirm that the minimum wavelength matches the design and that the rise on both sides follows the calculated curve.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在導納圖上手繪兩層的軌跡：從 n_s 出發，內層四分之一波沿圓弧走到 n₂²/n_s，外層再走到 n₁²n_s/n₂²，確認終點是否落在 1 附近。
增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Trace the two-layer path on an admittance diagram: start at n_s, let the inner quarter wave move along its arc to n₂²/n_s and the outer layer to n₁²n_s/n₂², and check that the end point lands near 1.
An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough.
quiz.explanation: 在導納圖上手繪兩層的軌跡：從 n_s 出發，內層四分之一波沿圓弧走到 n₂²/n_s，外層再走到 n₁²n_s/n₂²，確認終點是否落在 1 附近；再把鍍好的 V 膜用分光光度計掃描，確認最低點波長與設計一致、兩側上升速率符合計算曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace the two-layer path on an admittance diagram: start at n_s, let the inner quarter wave move along its arc to n₂²/n_s and the outer layer to n₁²n_s/n₂², and check that the end point lands near 1; then scan the deposited V-coat on a spectrophotometer to confirm that the minimum wavelength matches the design and that the rise on both sides follows the calculated curve. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把內外層順序顛倒，MgF₂ 貼在玻璃上而 Al₂O₃ 在最外側，導納終點落在 2 以上，反射率反而比裸玻璃高；或用 V 膜處理白光鏡頭，兩端殘餘反射超過 1.5% 而產生偏色。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reversing the layer order, with MgF₂ against the glass and Al₂O₃ outermost, lands the admittance above 2 and reflects more than bare glass; using a V-coat on a white-light lens leaves residuals above 1.5% at the band ends and causes colour cast. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雙層四分之一波設計用內層的高折射率把基板導納先抬高、再由外層 MgF₂ 拉回 1，條件是 n₂/n₁ = √n_s；這種設計在單一波長達到近零反射而兩側迅速上升，光譜呈 V 形，因此稱為 V 膜，適合雷射線寬的應用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A two-layer quarter-quarter design uses a higher-index inner layer to raise the substrate admittance first and the outer MgF₂ layer to bring it back to 1, with the condition n₂/n₁ = √n_s; it reaches near-zero reflectance at one wavelength and rises quickly on both sides, giving the V-shaped spectrum that names the V-coat and suits laser-line applications.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把內外層順序顛倒，MgF₂ 貼在玻璃上而 Al₂O₃ 在最外側，導納終點落在 2 以上，反射率反而比裸玻璃高；或用 V 膜處理白光鏡頭，兩端殘餘反射超過 1.5% 而產生偏色。
knowledge.textEn: Reversing the layer order, with MgF₂ against the glass and Al₂O₃ outermost, lands the admittance above 2 and reflects more than bare glass; using a V-coat on a white-light lens leaves residuals above 1.5% at the band ends and causes colour cast.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。
把內外層順序顛倒，MgF₂ 貼在玻璃上而 Al₂O₃ 在最外側，導納終點落在 2 以上，反射率反而比裸玻璃高。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design.
Reversing the layer order, with MgF₂ against the glass and Al₂O₃ outermost, lands the admittance above 2 and reflects more than bare glass.

quiz.explanationEn: Reversing the layer order, with MgF₂ against the glass and Al₂O₃ outermost, lands the admittance above 2 and reflects more than bare glass; using a V-coat on a white-light lens leaves residuals above 1.5% at the band ends and causes colour cast. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「寬帶增透設計與層數取捨」與「低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs" and "Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 寬帶增透設計與層數取捨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quarter-half-quarter broadband design” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 寬帶增透的經典三層結構由基板側起為四分之一波 Al₂O₃、半波 ZrO₂ 與四分之一波 MgF₂：半波層在設計波長是「隱形」的，不改變中心反射率，但在偏離中心的波長上它改變導納軌跡的曲率，把兩側的反射率壓平，使可見光全波段平均降到 0.2% 等級。再往上走是四到八層的 TiO₂/SiO₂ 或 Nb₂O₅/SiO₂ 最佳化設計，可把 400 到 700 nm 的平均反射率壓到 0.2% 以下並延伸到近紅外，代價是總厚度、應力與對厚度誤差的敏感度上升。層數的選擇是光譜寬度、角度容忍度、製程能力與成本之間的平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The classic three-layer broadband structure, from the substrate side, is a quarter-wave Al₂O₃, a half-wave ZrO₂ and a quarter-wave MgF₂: the half-wave layer is absentee at the design wavelength and leaves the central reflectance unchanged, but away from centre it alters the curvature of the admittance path and flattens the reflectance on both sides, bringing the visible-band average to the 0.2% level. Beyond that, four- to eight-layer optimised TiO₂/SiO₂ or Nb₂O₅/SiO₂ designs push the 400 to 700 nm average below 0.2% and extend into the near infrared, at the cost of total thickness, stress and sensitivity to thickness error. Choosing the layer count balances spectral width, angular tolerance, process capability and cost. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quarter-half-quarter broadband design”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Design wavelength 520 nm: quarter-wave MgF₂ 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm, half-wave ZrO₂ (n = 2.05) 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm, quarter-wave Al₂O₃ 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm, total ≈ 301 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Quarter-half-quarter broadband design”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
