steps.title: 寬帶增透設計與層數取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quarter-half-quarter broadband design” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設計波長 520 nm：MgF₂ 四分之一波 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm、ZrO₂（n = 2.05）半波 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm、Al₂O₃ 四分之一波 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm，總厚 ≈ 301 nm。矩陣計算得 R(450) ≈ 0.03%、R(500) ≈ 0.17%、R(600) ≈ 0.04%、R(700) ≈ 0.54%，400 到 700 nm 平均 ≈ 0.20%；同樣基板的單層 MgF₂ 平均為 1.48%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Design wavelength 520 nm: quarter-wave MgF₂ 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm, half-wave ZrO₂ (n = 2.05) 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm, quarter-wave Al₂O₃ 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm, total ≈ 301 nm. The matrix calculation gives R(450) ≈ 0.03%, R(500) ≈ 0.17%, R(600) ≈ 0.04%, R(700) ≈ 0.54% and a 400 to 700 nm average ≈ 0.20%; a single MgF₂ layer on the same substrate averages 1.48%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用薄膜軟體把三層設計與一個六層最佳化設計放在同一張圖上比較平均反射率、最大反射率與總厚度；把三層設計的每層厚度各隨機擾動 ±3% 做一百次蒙地卡羅，統計平均反射率的分佈，判斷製程能力是否足以支撐該設計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay the three-layer design and a six-layer optimised design in thin-film software and compare average reflectance, maximum reflectance and total thickness; perturb each layer of the three-layer design randomly by ±3% in a hundred Monte-Carlo trials and examine the distribution of average reflectance to judge whether the process capability supports the design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Design wavelength 520 nm: quarter-wave MgF₂ 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm, half-wave ZrO₂ (n = 2.05) 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm, quarter-wave Al₂O₃ 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm, total ≈ 301 nm. The matrix calculation gives R(450) ≈ 0.03%, R(500) ≈ 0.17%, R(600) ≈ 0.04%, R(700) ≈ 0.54% and a 400 to 700 nm average ≈ 0.20%; a single MgF₂ layer on the same substrate averages 1.48%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「寬帶增透設計與層數取捨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs", which statement holds?
options: 增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。
增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。
optionsEn: Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle.
Design wavelength 520 nm: quarter-wave MgF₂ 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm, half-wave ZrO₂ (n = 2.05) 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm, quarter-wave Al₂O₃ 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm, total ≈ 301 nm.
An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough.
quiz.explanation: 設計波長 520 nm：MgF₂ 四分之一波 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm、ZrO₂（n = 2.05）半波 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm、Al₂O₃ 四分之一波 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm，總厚 ≈ 301 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Design wavelength 520 nm: quarter-wave MgF₂ 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm, half-wave ZrO₂ (n = 2.05) 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm, quarter-wave Al₂O₃ 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm, total ≈ 301 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 寬帶增透設計與層數取捨：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Quarter-half-quarter broadband design” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用薄膜軟體把三層設計與一個六層最佳化設計放在同一張圖上比較平均反射率、最大反射率與總厚度；把三層設計的每層厚度各隨機擾動 ±3% 做一百次蒙地卡羅，統計平均反射率的分佈，判斷製程能力是否足以支撐該設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay the three-layer design and a six-layer optimised design in thin-film software and compare average reflectance, maximum reflectance and total thickness; perturb each layer of the three-layer design randomly by ±3% in a hundred Monte-Carlo trials and examine the distribution of average reflectance to judge whether the process capability supports the design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了追求 0.1% 的平均反射率採用十二層設計，但蒸鍍腔的厚度控制只有 ±3%，量產批次的平均反射率散佈到 0.1% 至 0.6%，良率不到一半，反而不如製程穩定的三層設計。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Chasing a 0.1% average with a twelve-layer design in an evaporation chamber whose thickness control is only ±3% scatters production batches between 0.1% and 0.6% with under fifty percent yield, worse than a process-robust three-layer design.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用薄膜軟體把三層設計與一個六層最佳化設計放在同一張圖上比較平均反射率、最大反射率與總厚度；把三層設計的每層厚度各隨機擾動 ±3% 做一百次蒙地卡羅，統計平均反射率的分佈，判斷製程能力是否足以支撐該設計。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay the three-layer design and a six-layer optimised design in thin-film software and compare average reflectance, maximum reflectance and total thickness; perturb each layer of the three-layer design randomly by ±3% in a hundred Monte-Carlo trials and examine the distribution of average reflectance to judge whether the process capability supports the design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「寬帶增透設計與層數取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。
用薄膜軟體把三層設計與一個六層最佳化設計放在同一張圖上比較平均反射率、最大反射率與總厚度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall.
Overlay the three-layer design and a six-layer optimised design in thin-film software and compare average reflectance, maximum reflectance and total thickness.
quiz.explanation: 用薄膜軟體把三層設計與一個六層最佳化設計放在同一張圖上比較平均反射率、最大反射率與總厚度；把三層設計的每層厚度各隨機擾動 ±3% 做一百次蒙地卡羅，統計平均反射率的分佈，判斷製程能力是否足以支撐該設計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Overlay the three-layer design and a six-layer optimised design in thin-film software and compare average reflectance, maximum reflectance and total thickness; perturb each layer of the three-layer design randomly by ±3% in a hundred Monte-Carlo trials and examine the distribution of average reflectance to judge whether the process capability supports the design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 寬帶增透設計與層數取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Quarter-half-quarter broadband design” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了追求 0.1% 的平均反射率採用十二層設計，但蒸鍍腔的厚度控制只有 ±3%，量產批次的平均反射率散佈到 0.1% 至 0.6%，良率不到一半，反而不如製程穩定的三層設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Chasing a 0.1% average with a twelve-layer design in an evaporation chamber whose thickness control is only ±3% scatters production batches between 0.1% and 0.6% with under fifty percent yield, worse than a process-robust three-layer design. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：層數的選擇是光譜寬度、角度容忍度、製程能力與成本之間的平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Choosing the layer count balances spectral width, angular tolerance, process capability and cost.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了追求 0.1% 的平均反射率採用十二層設計，但蒸鍍腔的厚度控制只有 ±3%，量產批次的平均反射率散佈到 0.1% 至 0.6%，良率不到一半，反而不如製程穩定的三層設計。
knowledge.textEn: Chasing a 0.1% average with a twelve-layer design in an evaporation chamber whose thickness control is only ±3% scatters production batches between 0.1% and 0.6% with under fifty percent yield, worse than a process-robust three-layer design.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「寬帶增透設計與層數取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了追求 0.1% 的平均反射率採用十二層設計，但蒸鍍腔的厚度控制只有 ±3%，量產批次的平均反射率散佈到 0.1% 至 0.6%，良率不到一半，反而不如製程穩定的三層設計。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。
optionsEn: Chasing a 0.1% average with a twelve-layer design in an evaporation chamber whose thickness control is only ±3% scatters production batches between 0.1% and 0.6% with under fifty percent yield, worse than a process-robust three-layer design.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited.
quiz.explanation: 為了追求 0.1% 的平均反射率採用十二層設計，但蒸鍍腔的厚度控制只有 ±3%，量產批次的平均反射率散佈到 0.1% 至 0.6%，良率不到一半，反而不如製程穩定的三層設計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Chasing a 0.1% average with a twelve-layer design in an evaporation chamber whose thickness control is only ±3% scatters production batches between 0.1% and 0.6% with under fifty percent yield, worse than a process-robust three-layer design. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增透膜的最外層必須是低折射率材料，可見光區幾乎只有 MgF₂ 與 SiO₂ 可選。MgF₂ 以熱蒸鍍或電子束蒸鍍沉積，基板必須加熱到 250 °C 以上才能得到緻密、附著良好且耐擦拭的膜，冷基板上的 MgF₂ 疏鬆、吸濕且一擦就花。玻璃透鏡可以承受加熱，但塑膠透鏡只能在 80 °C 以下處理，必須改用離子輔助蒸鍍或濺鍍 SiO₂ 並加上附著層。加熱沉積後冷卻時，膜與基板的熱膨脹差異在膜內留下張應力，厚膜系會因此龜裂，這是寬帶多層增透膜總厚度受限的原因之一。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The outermost antireflection layer must be a low-index material, and in the visible there are essentially only MgF₂ and SiO₂. MgF₂ is deposited by thermal or electron-beam evaporation with the substrate heated above 250 °C to obtain a dense, well-adhered, wipe-resistant film; on a cold substrate MgF₂ is porous, hygroscopic and scratches at the first wipe. Glass lenses tolerate heating, but polymer lenses must stay below 80 °C, forcing ion-assisted evaporation or sputtered SiO₂ with an adhesion layer. On cooling after hot deposition the thermal-expansion mismatch between film and substrate leaves tensile stress in the film, which cracks thick stacks and is one reason the total thickness of broadband multilayers is limited. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱失配應力 σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal-mismatch stress σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力
knowledge.titleEn: Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress
knowledge.text: 增透膜的最外層必須是低折射率材料，可見光區幾乎只有 MgF₂ 與 SiO₂ 可選。MgF₂ 以熱蒸鍍或電子束蒸鍍沉積，基板必須加熱到 250 °C 以上才能得到緻密、附著良好且耐擦拭的膜，冷基板上的 MgF₂ 疏鬆、吸濕且一擦就花。
knowledge.textEn: The outermost antireflection layer must be a low-index material, and in the visible there are essentially only MgF₂ and SiO₂. MgF₂ is deposited by thermal or electron-beam evaporation with the substrate heated above 250 °C to obtain a dense, well-adhered, wipe-resistant film; on a cold substrate MgF₂ is porous, hygroscopic and scratches at the first wipe.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress" is correct?
options: 同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。
增透膜的最外層必須是低折射率材料，可見光區幾乎只有 MgF₂ 與 SiO₂ 可選。
分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。
optionsEn: A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited.
The outermost antireflection layer must be a low-index material, and in the visible there are essentially only MgF₂ and SiO₂.
The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 增透膜的最外層必須是低折射率材料，可見光區幾乎只有 MgF₂ 與 SiO₂ 可選。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The outermost antireflection layer must be a low-index material, and in the visible there are essentially only MgF₂ and SiO₂. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱失配應力 σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT。取 MgF₂ 膜 E_f = 100 GPa、ν_f = 0.3（教學假設）、平均 α_f = 11×10⁻⁶/K，BK7 α_s = 7.1×10⁻⁶/K，由 275 °C 冷卻到 25 °C 的 ΔT = 250 K：σ_f ≈ 1.43×10¹¹ × 3.9×10⁻⁶ × 250 ≈ 1.4×10⁸ Pa ≈ 140 MPa 張應力；對 94 nm 的單層可承受，對 1 µm 以上的多層堆則接近龜裂門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal-mismatch stress σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT. Taking a MgF₂ film with E_f = 100 GPa and ν_f = 0.3 (teaching assumptions), mean α_f = 11×10⁻⁶/K, BK7 α_s = 7.1×10⁻⁶/K and ΔT = 250 K for cooling from 275 °C to 25 °C: σ_f ≈ 1.43×10¹¹ × 3.9×10⁻⁶ × 250 ≈ 1.4×10⁸ Pa ≈ 140 MPa tensile, tolerable for a 94 nm single layer but close to the cracking threshold for stacks above 1 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同基板溫度（100、200、300 °C）各鍍一片 MgF₂ 試片，用橢偏儀量折射率並以濕度循環觀察光譜位移，確認高溫片的折射率接近 1.38 且位移最小；以薄片基板的曲率變化量膜應力，並做膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗測試比較三者。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deposit MgF₂ witness samples at substrate temperatures of 100, 200 and 300 °C, measure index by ellipsometry and spectral shift under humidity cycling to confirm the hot sample sits near 1.38 with minimal shift; measure film stress from the curvature change of thin substrates and compare the three with tape-adhesion and eraser-abrasion tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱失配應力 σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT。取 MgF₂ 膜 E_f = 100 GPa、ν_f = 0.3（教學假設）、平均 α_f = 11×10⁻⁶/K，BK7 α_s = 7.1×10⁻⁶/K，由 275 °C 冷卻到 25 °C 的 ΔT = 250 K：σ_f ≈ 1.43×10¹¹ × 3.9×10⁻⁶ × 250 ≈ 1.4×10⁸ Pa ≈ 140 MPa 張應力；對 94 nm 的單層可承受，對 1 µm 以上的多層堆則接近龜裂門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal-mismatch stress σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT. Taking a MgF₂ film with E_f = 100 GPa and ν_f = 0.3 (teaching assumptions), mean α_f = 11×10⁻⁶/K, BK7 α_s = 7.1×10⁻⁶/K and ΔT = 250 K for cooling from 275 °C to 25 °C: σ_f ≈ 1.43×10¹¹ × 3.9×10⁻⁶ × 250 ≈ 1.4×10⁸ Pa ≈ 140 MPa tensile, tolerable for a 94 nm single layer but close to the cracking threshold for stacks above 1 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress", which statement holds?
options: 透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。
一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。
熱失配應力 σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT。
optionsEn: Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface.
One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall.
Thermal-mismatch stress σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT.
quiz.explanation: 熱失配應力 σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以不同基板溫度（100、200、300 °C）各鍍一片 MgF₂ 試片，用橢偏儀量折射率並以濕度循環觀察光譜位移，確認高溫片的折射率接近 1.38 且位移最小；以薄片基板的曲率變化量膜應力，並做膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗測試比較三者。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deposit MgF₂ witness samples at substrate temperatures of 100, 200 and 300 °C, measure index by ellipsometry and spectral shift under humidity cycling to confirm the hot sample sits near 1.38 with minimal shift; measure film stress from the curvature change of thin substrates and compare the three with tape-adhesion and eraser-abrasion tests. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了趕工在未達溫的基板上鍍 MgF₂，膜層疏鬆，出廠光譜合格但客戶擦拭後出現霧狀刮痕並在潮濕環境下反射率回升；塑膠鏡片誤用熱製程而翹曲變形。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Depositing MgF₂ on substrates that have not reached temperature to save time gives porous films that pass at shipment but haze and scratch when the customer wipes them and lose antireflection in humid air; a polymer lens run through the hot process warps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同基板溫度（100、200、300 °C）各鍍一片 MgF₂ 試片，用橢偏儀量折射率並以濕度循環觀察光譜位移，確認高溫片的折射率接近 1.38 且位移最小；以薄片基板的曲率變化量膜應力，並做膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗測試比較三者。
knowledge.textEn: Deposit MgF₂ witness samples at substrate temperatures of 100, 200 and 300 °C, measure index by ellipsometry and spectral shift under humidity cycling to confirm the hot sample sits near 1.38 with minimal shift; measure film stress from the curvature change of thin substrates and compare the three with tape-adhesion and eraser-abrasion tests.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress"?
options: 以不同基板溫度（100、200、300 °C）各鍍一片 MgF₂ 試片，用橢偏儀量折射率並以濕度循環觀察光譜位移，確認高溫片的折射率接近 1.38 且位移最小。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: Deposit MgF₂ witness samples at substrate temperatures of 100, 200 and 300 °C, measure index by ellipsometry and spectral shift under humidity cycling to confirm the hot sample sits near 1.38 with minimal shift.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant.

quiz.explanationEn: Deposit MgF₂ witness samples at substrate temperatures of 100, 200 and 300 °C, measure index by ellipsometry and spectral shift under humidity cycling to confirm the hot sample sits near 1.38 with minimal shift; measure film stress from the curvature change of thin substrates and compare the three with tape-adhesion and eraser-abrasion tests. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了趕工在未達溫的基板上鍍 MgF₂，膜層疏鬆，出廠光譜合格但客戶擦拭後出現霧狀刮痕並在潮濕環境下反射率回升；塑膠鏡片誤用熱製程而翹曲變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Depositing MgF₂ on substrates that have not reached temperature to save time gives porous films that pass at shipment but haze and scratch when the customer wipes them and lose antireflection in humid air; a polymer lens run through the hot process warps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：加熱沉積後冷卻時，膜與基板的熱膨脹差異在膜內留下張應力，厚膜系會因此龜裂，這是寬帶多層增透膜總厚度受限的原因之一。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On cooling after hot deposition the thermal-expansion mismatch between film and substrate leaves tensile stress in the film, which cracks thick stacks and is one reason the total thickness of broadband multilayers is limited.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 為了趕工在未達溫的基板上鍍 MgF₂，膜層疏鬆，出廠光譜合格但客戶擦拭後出現霧狀刮痕並在潮濕環境下反射率回升；塑膠鏡片誤用熱製程而翹曲變形。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
為了趕工在未達溫的基板上鍍 MgF₂，膜層疏鬆，出廠光譜合格但客戶擦拭後出現霧狀刮痕並在潮濕環境下反射率回升；塑膠鏡片誤用熱製程而翹曲變形。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低反射率量測與背面陷阱」與「入射角、偏振與厚度公差」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap" and "Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低反射率量測與背面陷阱：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「V-W 反射率附件與背面處理」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量 0.2% 的反射率比量 99% 的反射率困難得多，因為任何雜散光與基板背面的反射都會淹沒訊號。平行平板試片若只有正面鍍膜，背面的 4.3% 反射會穿過正面進入偵測器，量到的總反射率幾乎全是背面貢獻；所以量測前必須把背面磨粗並塗黑，或使用楔形試片把背面反射偏離光路，或以穿透率反推。絕對反射率需要 V-W 型附件，用同一面鏡子在兩種幾何下的比值消去鏡面反射率；光度刻度則以 NIST 可追溯的反射率標準校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「V-W 反射率附件與背面處理」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring 0.2% reflectance is far harder than measuring 99%, because any stray light and the substrate's back-surface reflection swamp the signal. A plane-parallel witness coated only on the front lets the 4.3% back reflection pass through the front into the detector, so the measured total is almost entirely the back surface; the back must therefore be ground and blackened, a wedged witness used to steer the back reflection out of the path, or the front reflectance inferred from transmission. Absolute reflectance needs a V-W accessory, where the ratio of two geometries with the same mirror cancels the mirror's reflectance, and the photometric scale is calibrated with NIST-traceable reflectance standards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：正面 V 膜 R_f = 0.18%、背面裸玻璃 R_b = 4.26% 的平板：量到的反射率 ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%，正面訊號只佔 4%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A plate with a V-coat front R_f = 0.18% and a bare back R_b = 4.26% measures ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%, with the front contributing only 4% of the signal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「V-W 反射率附件與背面處理」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低反射率量測與背面陷阱
knowledge.titleEn: Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap
knowledge.text: 量 0.2% 的反射率比量 99% 的反射率困難得多，因為任何雜散光與基板背面的反射都會淹沒訊號。平行平板試片若只有正面鍍膜，背面的 4.3% 反射會穿過正面進入偵測器，量到的總反射率幾乎全是背面貢獻；所以量測前必須把背面磨粗並塗黑，或使用楔形試片把背面反射偏離光路，或以穿透率反推。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring 0.2% reflectance is far harder than measuring 99%, because any stray light and the substrate's back-surface reflection swamp the signal. A plane-parallel witness coated only on the front lets the 4.3% back reflection pass through the front into the detector, so the measured total is almost entirely the back surface; the back must therefore be ground and blackened, a wedged witness used to steer the back reflection out of the path, or the front reflectance inferred from transmission.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低反射率量測與背面陷阱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap" is correct?
options: 分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。
增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。
量 0.2% 的反射率比量 99% 的反射率困難得多，因為任何雜散光與基板背面的反射都會淹沒訊號。
optionsEn: The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance.
Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle.
Measuring 0.2% reflectance is far harder than measuring 99%, because any stray light and the substrate's back-surface reflection swamp the signal.
quiz.explanation: 量 0.2% 的反射率比量 99% 的反射率困難得多，因為任何雜散光與基板背面的反射都會淹沒訊號。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring 0.2% reflectance is far harder than measuring 99%, because any stray light and the substrate's back-surface reflection swamp the signal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低反射率量測與背面陷阱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「V-W 反射率附件與背面處理」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：正面 V 膜 R_f = 0.18%、背面裸玻璃 R_b = 4.26% 的平板：量到的反射率 ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%，正面訊號只佔 4%。改量穿透率 T ≈ (1 − R_f)(1 − R_b) ≈ 0.9557，由 T 反推 R_f = 1 − T/(1 − R_b)，當 T 的不確定度為 0.1% 時 R_f 的不確定度約 0.1%，仍不足以驗證 0.18%，所以必須塗黑背面直接量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A plate with a V-coat front R_f = 0.18% and a bare back R_b = 4.26% measures ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%, with the front contributing only 4% of the signal. Measuring transmission instead, T ≈ (1 − R_f)(1 − R_b) ≈ 0.9557 and R_f = 1 − T/(1 − R_b); a 0.1% uncertainty in T gives about 0.1% uncertainty in R_f, still too coarse to verify 0.18%, so the back must be blackened and the front measured directly. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同一片試片分別以未處理背面、塗黑背面與楔形試片三種方式量測，確認塗黑後的讀值降到與設計相符的 0.2% 等級且重複性優於 0.03%；以已知反射率的標準片確認光度刻度，並記錄量測光斑大小與入射角。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the same witness three ways, with untreated back, blackened back and as a wedged piece, confirming that the blackened reading drops to the design-level 0.2% with repeatability better than 0.03%; verify the photometric scale with a standard of known reflectance and record the spot size and incidence angle.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
