knowledge.text: 正面 V 膜 R_f = 0.18%、背面裸玻璃 R_b = 4.26% 的平板：量到的反射率 ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%，正面訊號只佔 4%。改量穿透率 T ≈ (1 − R_f)(1 − R_b) ≈ 0.9557，由 T 反推 R_f = 1 − T/(1 − R_b)，當 T 的不確定度為 0.1% 時 R_f 的不確定度約 0.1%，仍不足以驗證 0.18%，所以必須塗黑背面直接量。
knowledge.textEn: A plate with a V-coat front R_f = 0.18% and a bare back R_b = 4.26% measures ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%, with the front contributing only 4% of the signal. Measuring transmission instead, T ≈ (1 − R_f)(1 − R_b) ≈ 0.9557 and R_f = 1 − T/(1 − R_b); a 0.1% uncertainty in T gives about 0.1% uncertainty in R_f, still too coarse to verify 0.18%, so the back must be blackened and the front measured directly.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「低反射率量測與背面陷阱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap", which statement holds?
options: 增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。
增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。
optionsEn: A plate with a V-coat front R_f = 0.18% and a bare back R_b = 4.26% measures ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%, with the front contributing only 4% of the signal.
An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough.
An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 正面 V 膜 R_f = 0.18%、背面裸玻璃 R_b = 4.26% 的平板：量到的反射率 ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%，正面訊號只佔 4%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A plate with a V-coat front R_f = 0.18% and a bare back R_b = 4.26% measures ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%, with the front contributing only 4% of the signal. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低反射率量測與背面陷阱：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「V-W 反射率附件與背面處理」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 同一片試片分別以未處理背面、塗黑背面與楔形試片三種方式量測，確認塗黑後的讀值降到與設計相符的 0.2% 等級且重複性優於 0.03%；以已知反射率的標準片確認光度刻度，並記錄量測光斑大小與入射角。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the same witness three ways, with untreated back, blackened back and as a wedged piece, confirming that the blackened reading drops to the design-level 0.2% with repeatability better than 0.03%; verify the photometric scale with a standard of known reflectance and record the spot size and incidence angle. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：未處理背面就量反射率，4.4% 的讀數讓合格的增透膜被判為失敗而整批重鍍；或用穿透率推算，0.1% 的不確定度把 0.18% 與 0.28% 混為一談，無法分辨製程漂移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring without treating the back yields 4.4% and condemns a good antireflection batch to recoating; inferring from transmission with 0.1% uncertainty cannot tell 0.18% from 0.28% and hides process drift.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同一片試片分別以未處理背面、塗黑背面與楔形試片三種方式量測，確認塗黑後的讀值降到與設計相符的 0.2% 等級且重複性優於 0.03%；以已知反射率的標準片確認光度刻度，並記錄量測光斑大小與入射角。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the same witness three ways, with untreated back, blackened back and as a wedged piece, confirming that the blackened reading drops to the design-level 0.2% with repeatability better than 0.03%; verify the photometric scale with a standard of known reflectance and record the spot size and incidence angle.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低反射率量測與背面陷阱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
同一片試片分別以未處理背面、塗黑背面與楔形試片三種方式量測，確認塗黑後的讀值降到與設計相符的 0.2% 等級且重複性優於 0.03%。
半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Measure the same witness three ways, with untreated back, blackened back and as a wedged piece, confirming that the blackened reading drops to the design-level 0.2% with repeatability better than 0.03%.
A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design.
quiz.explanation: 同一片試片分別以未處理背面、塗黑背面與楔形試片三種方式量測，確認塗黑後的讀值降到與設計相符的 0.2% 等級且重複性優於 0.03%；以已知反射率的標準片確認光度刻度，並記錄量測光斑大小與入射角。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the same witness three ways, with untreated back, blackened back and as a wedged piece, confirming that the blackened reading drops to the design-level 0.2% with repeatability better than 0.03%; verify the photometric scale with a standard of known reflectance and record the spot size and incidence angle. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 低反射率量測與背面陷阱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「V-W 反射率附件與背面處理」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 未處理背面就量反射率，4.4% 的讀數讓合格的增透膜被判為失敗而整批重鍍；或用穿透率推算，0.1% 的不確定度把 0.18% 與 0.28% 混為一談，無法分辨製程漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring without treating the back yields 4.4% and condemns a good antireflection batch to recoating; inferring from transmission with 0.1% uncertainty cannot tell 0.18% from 0.28% and hides process drift. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：絕對反射率需要 V-W 型附件，用同一面鏡子在兩種幾何下的比值消去鏡面反射率；光度刻度則以 NIST 可追溯的反射率標準校正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Absolute reflectance needs a V-W accessory, where the ratio of two geometries with the same mirror cancels the mirror's reflectance, and the photometric scale is calibrated with NIST-traceable reflectance standards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未處理背面就量反射率，4.4% 的讀數讓合格的增透膜被判為失敗而整批重鍍；或用穿透率推算，0.1% 的不確定度把 0.18% 與 0.28% 混為一談，無法分辨製程漂移。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring without treating the back yields 4.4% and condemns a good antireflection batch to recoating; inferring from transmission with 0.1% uncertainty cannot tell 0.18% from 0.28% and hides process drift.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低反射率量測與背面陷阱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。
未處理背面就量反射率，4.4% 的讀數讓合格的增透膜被判為失敗而整批重鍍。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle.
Measuring without treating the back yields 4.4% and condemns a good antireflection batch to recoating.
quiz.explanation: 未處理背面就量反射率，4.4% 的讀數讓合格的增透膜被判為失敗而整批重鍍；或用穿透率推算，0.1% 的不確定度把 0.18% 與 0.28% 混為一談，無法分辨製程漂移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring without treating the back yields 4.4% and condemns a good antireflection batch to recoating; inferring from transmission with 0.1% uncertainty cannot tell 0.18% from 0.28% and hides process drift. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與厚度公差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增透膜在斜入射時有兩個效應：各層有效光學厚度隨 cosθ 縮短使最低點向短波移動，以及 s 與 p 偏振的導納分離使兩者的殘餘反射率不再相同，s 偏振通常惡化得更快。V 膜因為頻寬窄，對角度與厚度誤差都比寬帶膜敏感；寬帶膜在 30° 內仍能維持接近正向的平均反射率。公差分析要把製程厚度散佈、折射率散佈與使用角度範圍一起放進蒙地卡羅，算出平均反射率的分佈，而不是只看設計點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At oblique incidence an antireflection film shows two effects: each layer's effective optical thickness shrinks with cosθ, moving the minimum to shorter wavelengths, and the admittances for s and p polarization separate so their residual reflectances differ, with s usually degrading faster. A V-coat, being narrow, is more sensitive to both angle and thickness error than a broadband design, which keeps near-normal average reflectance out to about 30°. Tolerance analysis must put the process thickness spread, index spread and the range of use angles together into a Monte-Carlo run and report the distribution of average reflectance, not just the design point. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：矩陣計算（550 nm V 膜）：兩層同時薄 5% 時 R 由 0.18% 升到 0.27%，薄 13% 時升到 0.72%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Matrix results for the 550 nm V-coat: with both layers 5% thin, R rises from 0.18% to 0.27%, and 13% thin to 0.72%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入射角、偏振與厚度公差
knowledge.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance
knowledge.text: 增透膜在斜入射時有兩個效應：各層有效光學厚度隨 cosθ 縮短使最低點向短波移動，以及 s 與 p 偏振的導納分離使兩者的殘餘反射率不再相同，s 偏振通常惡化得更快。V 膜因為頻寬窄，對角度與厚度誤差都比寬帶膜敏感；寬帶膜在 30° 內仍能維持接近正向的平均反射率。
knowledge.textEn: At oblique incidence an antireflection film shows two effects: each layer's effective optical thickness shrinks with cosθ, moving the minimum to shorter wavelengths, and the admittances for s and p polarization separate so their residual reflectances differ, with s usually degrading faster. A V-coat, being narrow, is more sensitive to both angle and thickness error than a broadband design, which keeps near-normal average reflectance out to about 30°.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入射角、偏振與厚度公差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance" is correct?
options: 增透膜在斜入射時有兩個效應：各層有效光學厚度隨 cosθ 縮短使最低點向短波移動，以及 s 與 p 偏振的導納分離使兩者的殘餘反射率不再相同，s 偏振通常惡化得更快。
增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。
透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。
optionsEn: At oblique incidence an antireflection film shows two effects: each layer's effective optical thickness shrinks with cosθ, moving the minimum to shorter wavelengths, and the admittances for s and p polarization separate so their residual reflectances differ, with s usually degrading faster.
Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle.
Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface.
quiz.explanation: 增透膜在斜入射時有兩個效應：各層有效光學厚度隨 cosθ 縮短使最低點向短波移動，以及 s 與 p 偏振的導納分離使兩者的殘餘反射率不再相同，s 偏振通常惡化得更快。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At oblique incidence an antireflection film shows two effects: each layer's effective optical thickness shrinks with cosθ, moving the minimum to shorter wavelengths, and the admittances for s and p polarization separate so their residual reflectances differ, with s usually degrading faster. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與厚度公差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：矩陣計算（550 nm V 膜）：兩層同時薄 5% 時 R 由 0.18% 升到 0.27%，薄 13% 時升到 0.72%。角度：15° 時 R_s = 0.24%、R_p = 0.15%；30° 時 R_s = 0.61%、R_p = 0.13%，平均 0.37%；45° 時 R_s = 2.27%、R_p = 0.20%，平均 1.23%。三層寬帶膜 400 到 700 nm 平均：0° 為 0.20%、30° 為 0.31%、45° 為 0.99%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Matrix results for the 550 nm V-coat: with both layers 5% thin, R rises from 0.18% to 0.27%, and 13% thin to 0.72%. Angle: at 15°, R_s = 0.24% and R_p = 0.15%; at 30°, R_s = 0.61% and R_p = 0.13%, average 0.37%; at 45°, R_s = 2.27% and R_p = 0.20%, average 1.23%. The three-layer broadband design averages 0.20% at 0°, 0.31% at 30° and 0.99% at 45° over 400 to 700 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在分光光度計的可變角附件上以 s、p 偏振片量 0°、15°、30°、45° 的反射率光譜，與矩陣計算逐點比較，差異應在 0.05% 內；把鏡頭設計中每個面的主光線入射角範圍列表，對照角度敏感度表決定哪些面需要寬帶膜、哪些可用 V 膜。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure reflectance spectra at 0°, 15°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on a variable-angle accessory and compare point by point with the matrix calculation, expecting agreement within 0.05%; tabulate the chief-ray incidence-angle range on every surface of the lens design and use the angle-sensitivity table to decide which surfaces need broadband films and which can take a V-coat.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Matrix results for the 550 nm V-coat: with both layers 5% thin, R rises from 0.18% to 0.27%, and 13% thin to 0.72%. Angle: at 15°, R_s = 0.24% and R_p = 0.15%; at 30°, R_s = 0.61% and R_p = 0.13%, average 0.37%; at 45°, R_s = 2.27% and R_p = 0.20%, average 1.23%. The three-layer broadband design averages 0.20% at 0°, 0.31% at 30° and 0.99% at 45° over 400 to 700 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「入射角、偏振與厚度公差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance", which statement holds?
options: 一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。
矩陣計算（550 nm V 膜）：兩層同時薄 5% 時 R 由 0.18% 升到 0.27%，薄 13% 時升到 0.72%。
半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。
optionsEn: One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall.
Matrix results for the 550 nm V-coat: with both layers 5% thin, R rises from 0.18% to 0.27%, and 13% thin to 0.72%.
A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design.
quiz.explanation: 矩陣計算（550 nm V 膜）：兩層同時薄 5% 時 R 由 0.18% 升到 0.27%，薄 13% 時升到 0.72%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Matrix results for the 550 nm V-coat: with both layers 5% thin, R rises from 0.18% to 0.27%, and 13% thin to 0.72%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與厚度公差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在分光光度計的可變角附件上以 s、p 偏振片量 0°、15°、30°、45° 的反射率光譜，與矩陣計算逐點比較，差異應在 0.05% 內；把鏡頭設計中每個面的主光線入射角範圍列表，對照角度敏感度表決定哪些面需要寬帶膜、哪些可用 V 膜。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure reflectance spectra at 0°, 15°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on a variable-angle accessory and compare point by point with the matrix calculation, expecting agreement within 0.05%; tabulate the chief-ray incidence-angle range on every surface of the lens design and use the angle-sensitivity table to decide which surfaces need broadband films and which can take a V-coat. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在 0° 驗證合格的 V 膜被用在 40° 入射的分光面，s 偏振殘餘反射超過 1.5%，系統的偏振相關損耗與鬼影同時超標；厚度控制僅 ±5% 的製程生產 V 膜，批次中心波長散佈 ±27 nm，一半的產品在雷射波長上反射率超過 0.3%。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A V-coat verified at 0° used on a surface at 40° incidence leaves more than 1.5% s-polarized residual, failing polarization-dependent loss and ghost limits together; producing V-coats with only ±5% thickness control scatters batch centre wavelengths by ±27 nm so half the parts exceed 0.3% at the laser line.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在分光光度計的可變角附件上以 s、p 偏振片量 0°、15°、30°、45° 的反射率光譜，與矩陣計算逐點比較，差異應在 0.05% 內；把鏡頭設計中每個面的主光線入射角範圍列表，對照角度敏感度表決定哪些面需要寬帶膜、哪些可用 V 膜。
knowledge.textEn: Measure reflectance spectra at 0°, 15°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on a variable-angle accessory and compare point by point with the matrix calculation, expecting agreement within 0.05%; tabulate the chief-ray incidence-angle range on every surface of the lens design and use the angle-sensitivity table to decide which surfaces need broadband films and which can take a V-coat.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入射角、偏振與厚度公差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。
在分光光度計的可變角附件上以 s、p 偏振片量 0°、15°、30°、45° 的反射率光譜，與矩陣計算逐點比較，差異應在 0.05% 內。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited.
Measure reflectance spectra at 0°, 15°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on a variable-angle accessory and compare point by point with the matrix calculation, expecting agreement within 0.05%.
quiz.explanation: 在分光光度計的可變角附件上以 s、p 偏振片量 0°、15°、30°、45° 的反射率光譜，與矩陣計算逐點比較，差異應在 0.05% 內；把鏡頭設計中每個面的主光線入射角範圍列表，對照角度敏感度表決定哪些面需要寬帶膜、哪些可用 V 膜。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure reflectance spectra at 0°, 15°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on a variable-angle accessory and compare point by point with the matrix calculation, expecting agreement within 0.05%; tabulate the chief-ray incidence-angle range on every surface of the lens design and use the angle-sensitivity table to decide which surfaces need broadband films and which can take a V-coat. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與厚度公差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在 0° 驗證合格的 V 膜被用在 40° 入射的分光面，s 偏振殘餘反射超過 1.5%，系統的偏振相關損耗與鬼影同時超標；厚度控制僅 ±5% 的製程生產 V 膜，批次中心波長散佈 ±27 nm，一半的產品在雷射波長上反射率超過 0.3%。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A V-coat verified at 0° used on a surface at 40° incidence leaves more than 1.5% s-polarized residual, failing polarization-dependent loss and ghost limits together; producing V-coats with only ±5% thickness control scatters batch centre wavelengths by ±27 nm so half the parts exceed 0.3% at the laser line. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：公差分析要把製程厚度散佈、折射率散佈與使用角度範圍一起放進蒙地卡羅，算出平均反射率的分佈，而不是只看設計點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tolerance analysis must put the process thickness spread, index spread and the range of use angles together into a Monte-Carlo run and report the distribution of average reflectance, not just the design point.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在 0° 驗證合格的 V 膜被用在 40° 入射的分光面，s 偏振殘餘反射超過 1.5%，系統的偏振相關損耗與鬼影同時超標；厚度控制僅 ±5% 的製程生產 V 膜，批次中心波長散佈 ±27 nm，一半的產品在雷射波長上反射率超過 0.3%。
knowledge.textEn: A V-coat verified at 0° used on a surface at 40° incidence leaves more than 1.5% s-polarized residual, failing polarization-dependent loss and ghost limits together; producing V-coats with only ±5% thickness control scatters batch centre wavelengths by ±27 nm so half the parts exceed 0.3% at the laser line.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入射角、偏振與厚度公差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在 0° 驗證合格的 V 膜被用在 40° 入射的分光面，s 偏振殘餘反射超過 1.5%，系統的偏振相關損耗與鬼影同時超標。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。
optionsEn: A V-coat verified at 0° used on a surface at 40° incidence leaves more than 1.5% s-polarized residual, failing polarization-dependent loss and ghost limits together.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface.
quiz.explanation: 在 0° 驗證合格的 V 膜被用在 40° 入射的分光面，s 偏振殘餘反射超過 1.5%，系統的偏振相關損耗與鬼影同時超標；厚度控制僅 ±5% 的製程生產 V 膜，批次中心波長散佈 ±27 nm，一半的產品在雷射波長上反射率超過 0.3%。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A V-coat verified at 0° used on a surface at 40° incidence leaves more than 1.5% s-polarized residual, failing polarization-dependent loss and ghost limits together; producing V-coats with only ±5% thickness control scatters batch centre wavelengths by ±27 nm so half the parts exceed 0.3% at the laser line. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合」與「規格換算、耐久等級與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration" and "Specification conversion, durability class and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蒸鍍的膜厚與表面相對於蒸氣流的傾角有關，近似隨 cosφ 下降，陡峭透鏡的邊緣會比中心薄；增透膜的最低點因此在邊緣向短波移動，殘餘反射率沿口徑變化。夾具設計用傾斜的鏡片座、遮罩或把鏡片放在行星轉架的特定半徑來補償，或把設計中心波長略向長波偏移讓邊緣落回波段內。整合到鏡頭時還要處理膠合面（膠的折射率接近玻璃，反射率只有萬分之幾，不需鍍膜）、邊緣塗黑以吸收內反射，以及雷射系統中增透膜的損傷門檻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Evaporated thickness depends on the surface tilt relative to the vapour stream, falling roughly as cosφ, so the rim of a steep lens receives less than the centre; the antireflection minimum therefore shifts to shorter wavelengths at the rim and the residual varies across the aperture. Fixture design compensates with tilted lens seats, masks or placement at a chosen planetary radius, or the design centre is biased slightly to longer wavelengths so the rim falls back into band. Integration into the lens also handles cemented interfaces, where the cement index is close to glass and reflectance is only a few parts in ten thousand with no coating needed, edge blackening to absorb internal reflections, and, in laser systems, the damage threshold of the antireflection film. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：邊緣法線與蒸氣流夾角 φ = 30° 的透鏡，邊緣厚度 ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 倍中心厚度，即薄 13%；550 nm V 膜在邊緣的最低點移到約 480 nm，550 nm 的殘餘反射率由 0.18% 升到 0.72%（矩陣計算）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a lens whose rim normal makes φ = 30° with the vapour stream, rim thickness ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 of centre, 13% thin; the 550 nm V-coat's minimum at the rim moves to about 480 nm and the 550 nm residual rises from 0.18% to 0.72% (matrix calculation).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合
knowledge.titleEn: Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration
knowledge.text: 蒸鍍的膜厚與表面相對於蒸氣流的傾角有關，近似隨 cosφ 下降，陡峭透鏡的邊緣會比中心薄；增透膜的最低點因此在邊緣向短波移動，殘餘反射率沿口徑變化。夾具設計用傾斜的鏡片座、遮罩或把鏡片放在行星轉架的特定半徑來補償，或把設計中心波長略向長波偏移讓邊緣落回波段內。
knowledge.textEn: Evaporated thickness depends on the surface tilt relative to the vapour stream, falling roughly as cosφ, so the rim of a steep lens receives less than the centre; the antireflection minimum therefore shifts to shorter wavelengths at the rim and the residual varies across the aperture. Fixture design compensates with tilted lens seats, masks or placement at a chosen planetary radius, or the design centre is biased slightly to longer wavelengths so the rim falls back into band.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration" is correct?
options: 透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。
蒸鍍的膜厚與表面相對於蒸氣流的傾角有關，近似隨 cosφ 下降，陡峭透鏡的邊緣會比中心薄；增透膜的最低點因此在邊緣向短波移動，殘餘反射率沿口徑變化。
增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。
optionsEn: Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface.
Evaporated thickness depends on the surface tilt relative to the vapour stream, falling roughly as cosφ, so the rim of a steep lens receives less than the centre.
An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough.
quiz.explanation: 蒸鍍的膜厚與表面相對於蒸氣流的傾角有關，近似隨 cosφ 下降，陡峭透鏡的邊緣會比中心薄；增透膜的最低點因此在邊緣向短波移動，殘餘反射率沿口徑變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Evaporated thickness depends on the surface tilt relative to the vapour stream, falling roughly as cosφ, so the rim of a steep lens receives less than the centre; the antireflection minimum therefore shifts to shorter wavelengths at the rim and the residual varies across the aperture. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：邊緣法線與蒸氣流夾角 φ = 30° 的透鏡，邊緣厚度 ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 倍中心厚度，即薄 13%；550 nm V 膜在邊緣的最低點移到約 480 nm，550 nm 的殘餘反射率由 0.18% 升到 0.72%（矩陣計算）。膠合面：n = 1.52 與 n = 1.56 的玻璃以 n = 1.54 的膠黏合，各界面 R ≈ [(0.02)/(3.06)]² ≈ 4×10⁻⁵，遠低於任何增透膜。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a lens whose rim normal makes φ = 30° with the vapour stream, rim thickness ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 of centre, 13% thin; the 550 nm V-coat's minimum at the rim moves to about 480 nm and the 550 nm residual rises from 0.18% to 0.72% (matrix calculation). Cemented interface: glasses of n = 1.52 and 1.56 bonded with n = 1.54 cement reflect R ≈ [(0.02)/(3.06)]² ≈ 4×10⁻⁵ at each interface, far below any antireflection film. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一片透鏡的中心與邊緣以小光斑反射率附件各量一次，比較最低點波長的位移與 cosφ 模型；在夾具不同半徑放平面見證片，繪出厚度對位置的曲線，調整傾角或遮罩直到邊緣位移小於 3%；鏡頭組裝後量整體穿透率與鬼影，核對整合預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the lens centre and rim with a small-spot reflectance accessory and compare the minimum-wavelength shift with the cosφ model; place flat witnesses at several fixture radii, plot thickness against position and adjust tilt or masks until the rim shift is below 3%; after assembly measure total transmission and ghosts to close the integration budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 邊緣法線與蒸氣流夾角 φ = 30° 的透鏡，邊緣厚度 ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 倍中心厚度，即薄 13%；550 nm V 膜在邊緣的最低點移到約 480 nm，550 nm 的殘餘反射率由 0.18% 升到 0.72%（矩陣計算）。膠合面：n = 1.52 與 n = 1.56 的玻璃以 n = 1.54 的膠黏合，各界面 R ≈ [(0.02)/(3.06)]² ≈ 4×10⁻⁵，遠低於任何增透膜。
knowledge.textEn: For a lens whose rim normal makes φ = 30° with the vapour stream, rim thickness ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 of centre, 13% thin; the 550 nm V-coat's minimum at the rim moves to about 480 nm and the 550 nm residual rises from 0.18% to 0.72% (matrix calculation). Cemented interface: glasses of n = 1.52 and 1.56 bonded with n = 1.54 cement reflect R ≈ [(0.02)/(3.06)]² ≈ 4×10⁻⁵ at each interface, far below any antireflection film.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration", which statement holds?
options: 增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。
同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。
邊緣法線與蒸氣流夾角 φ = 30° 的透鏡，邊緣厚度 ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 倍中心厚度，即薄 13%。
optionsEn: An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant.
A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited.
For a lens whose rim normal makes φ = 30° with the vapour stream, rim thickness ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 of centre, 13% thin.
quiz.explanation: 邊緣法線與蒸氣流夾角 φ = 30° 的透鏡，邊緣厚度 ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 倍中心厚度，即薄 13%；550 nm V 膜在邊緣的最低點移到約 480 nm，550 nm 的殘餘反射率由 0.18% 升到 0.72%（矩陣計算）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a lens whose rim normal makes φ = 30° with the vapour stream, rim thickness ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 of centre, 13% thin; the 550 nm V-coat's minimum at the rim moves to about 480 nm and the 550 nm residual rises from 0.18% to 0.72% (matrix calculation). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同一片透鏡的中心與邊緣以小光斑反射率附件各量一次，比較最低點波長的位移與 cosφ 模型；在夾具不同半徑放平面見證片，繪出厚度對位置的曲線，調整傾角或遮罩直到邊緣位移小於 3%；鏡頭組裝後量整體穿透率與鬼影，核對整合預算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the lens centre and rim with a small-spot reflectance accessory and compare the minimum-wavelength shift with the cosφ model; place flat witnesses at several fixture radii, plot thickness against position and adjust tilt or masks until the rim shift is below 3%; after assembly measure total transmission and ghosts to close the integration budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：陡峭非球面以平放的夾具鍍 V 膜，邊緣最低點偏到 480 nm，在雷射波長邊緣環帶反射率 0.7%，形成環狀鬼影；或在膠合面上多鍍增透膜，反而因膠與膜的折射率差增加反射並造成膠合應力。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A steep asphere coated flat in the fixture gets its rim minimum at 480 nm, a 0.7% rim annulus at the laser wavelength and a ring ghost; adding an antireflection film to a cemented interface raises reflection through the index step between cement and film and stresses the bond.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一片透鏡的中心與邊緣以小光斑反射率附件各量一次，比較最低點波長的位移與 cosφ 模型；在夾具不同半徑放平面見證片，繪出厚度對位置的曲線，調整傾角或遮罩直到邊緣位移小於 3%；鏡頭組裝後量整體穿透率與鬼影，核對整合預算。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the lens centre and rim with a small-spot reflectance accessory and compare the minimum-wavelength shift with the cosφ model; place flat witnesses at several fixture radii, plot thickness against position and adjust tilt or masks until the rim shift is below 3%; after assembly measure total transmission and ghosts to close the integration budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration"?
options: 在同一片透鏡的中心與邊緣以小光斑反射率附件各量一次，比較最低點波長的位移與 cosφ 模型。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。
optionsEn: Measure the lens centre and rim with a small-spot reflectance accessory and compare the minimum-wavelength shift with the cosφ model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 在同一片透鏡的中心與邊緣以小光斑反射率附件各量一次，比較最低點波長的位移與 cosφ 模型；在夾具不同半徑放平面見證片，繪出厚度對位置的曲線，調整傾角或遮罩直到邊緣位移小於 3%；鏡頭組裝後量整體穿透率與鬼影，核對整合預算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the lens centre and rim with a small-spot reflectance accessory and compare the minimum-wavelength shift with the cosφ model; place flat witnesses at several fixture radii, plot thickness against position and adjust tilt or masks until the rim shift is below 3%; after assembly measure total transmission and ghosts to close the integration budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 陡峭非球面以平放的夾具鍍 V 膜，邊緣最低點偏到 480 nm，在雷射波長邊緣環帶反射率 0.7%，形成環狀鬼影；或在膠合面上多鍍增透膜，反而因膠與膜的折射率差增加反射並造成膠合應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A steep asphere coated flat in the fixture gets its rim minimum at 480 nm, a 0.7% rim annulus at the laser wavelength and a ring ghost; adding an antireflection film to a cemented interface raises reflection through the index step between cement and film and stresses the bond. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整合到鏡頭時還要處理膠合面（膠的折射率接近玻璃，反射率只有萬分之幾，不需鍍膜）、邊緣塗黑以吸收內反射，以及雷射系統中增透膜的損傷門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Integration into the lens also handles cemented interfaces, where the cement index is close to glass and reflectance is only a few parts in ten thousand with no coating needed, edge blackening to absorb internal reflections, and, in laser systems, the damage threshold of the antireflection film.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 陡峭非球面以平放的夾具鍍 V 膜，邊緣最低點偏到 480 nm，在雷射波長邊緣環帶反射率 0.7%，形成環狀鬼影；或在膠合面上多鍍增透膜，反而因膠與膜的折射率差增加反射並造成膠合應力。
knowledge.textEn: A steep asphere coated flat in the fixture gets its rim minimum at 480 nm, a 0.7% rim annulus at the laser wavelength and a ring ghost; adding an antireflection film to a cemented interface raises reflection through the index step between cement and film and stresses the bond.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
陡峭非球面以平放的夾具鍍 V 膜，邊緣最低點偏到 480 nm，在雷射波長邊緣環帶反射率 0.7%，形成環狀鬼影。
增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A steep asphere coated flat in the fixture gets its rim minimum at 480 nm, a 0.7% rim annulus at the laser wavelength and a ring ghost.
An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough.
quiz.explanation: 陡峭非球面以平放的夾具鍍 V 膜，邊緣最低點偏到 480 nm，在雷射波長邊緣環帶反射率 0.7%，形成環狀鬼影；或在膠合面上多鍍增透膜，反而因膠與膜的折射率差增加反射並造成膠合應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A steep asphere coated flat in the fixture gets its rim minimum at 480 nm, a 0.7% rim annulus at the laser wavelength and a ring ghost; adding an antireflection film to a cemented interface raises reflection through the index step between cement and film and stresses the bond. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 規格換算、耐久等級與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, durability class and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算」如何決定增透膜設計與沉積的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget” determines the key performance of “Antireflection coating design and deposition”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增透膜的規格應寫成「在指定波段與角度範圍內的平均與最大反射率」，並註明單面或雙面、基板折射率、偏振，以及耐久等級：依 ISO 9211 或軍規的磨耗、附著、濕熱與鹽霧序列。驗收時用塗黑背面的見證片量反射率，並把每面的實測值代回系統模型計算鏡頭穿透率與主要鬼影，與系統預算比較。交接資料包括各面的膜型（V 膜或寬帶）、設計波長、見證片光譜、耐久測試結果與批號，使鏡頭裝配與雷射系統端能追溯每個面的狀態與清潔方式限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An antireflection specification should read as average and maximum reflectance within a stated band and angle range, with single- or double-sided, substrate index, polarization and durability class per ISO 9211 or military abrasion, adhesion, humidity and salt-fog sequences. Acceptance measures witnesses with blackened backs and feeds each surface's measured value back into the system model to compute lens transmission and the main ghosts against the system budget. The handoff lists each surface's film type (V-coat or broadband), design wavelength, witness spectrum, durability results and batch number so lens assembly and laser-system users can trace every surface's state and cleaning limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：十片鏡頭、二十面，其中十六面鍍寬帶膜平均 0.25%，四面陡峭面因邊緣效應取 0.5%：穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942，再乘玻璃內部吸收 0.98 得 0.92，若系統預算要求 ≥ 0.90 則合格。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A ten-element lens with twenty surfaces, sixteen coated broadband at 0.25% average and four steep surfaces taken at 0.5% for rim effects: transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942, times 0.98 for internal glass absorption gives 0.92, passing a system budget of ≥ 0.90.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 規格換算、耐久等級與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Specification conversion, durability class and handoff
knowledge.text: 增透膜的規格應寫成「在指定波段與角度範圍內的平均與最大反射率」，並註明單面或雙面、基板折射率、偏振，以及耐久等級：依 ISO 9211 或軍規的磨耗、附著、濕熱與鹽霧序列。驗收時用塗黑背面的見證片量反射率，並把每面的實測值代回系統模型計算鏡頭穿透率與主要鬼影，與系統預算比較。
knowledge.textEn: An antireflection specification should read as average and maximum reflectance within a stated band and angle range, with single- or double-sided, substrate index, polarization and durability class per ISO 9211 or military abrasion, adhesion, humidity and salt-fog sequences. Acceptance measures witnesses with blackened backs and feeds each surface's measured value back into the system model to compute lens transmission and the main ghosts against the system budget.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「規格換算、耐久等級與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specification conversion, durability class and handoff" is correct?
options: 增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。
一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。
增透膜的規格應寫成「在指定波段與角度範圍內的平均與最大反射率」，並註明單面或雙面、基板折射率、偏振，以及耐久等級：依 ISO 9211 或軍規的磨耗、附著、濕熱與鹽霧序列。
optionsEn: An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough.
One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall.

An antireflection specification should read as average and maximum reflectance within a stated band and angle range, with single- or double-sided, substrate index, polarization and durability class per ISO 9211 or military abrasion, adhesion, humidity and salt-fog sequences.
quiz.explanation: 增透膜的規格應寫成「在指定波段與角度範圍內的平均與最大反射率」，並註明單面或雙面、基板折射率、偏振，以及耐久等級：依 ISO 9211 或軍規的磨耗、附著、濕熱與鹽霧序列。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An antireflection specification should read as average and maximum reflectance within a stated band and angle range, with single- or double-sided, substrate index, polarization and durability class per ISO 9211 or military abrasion, adhesion, humidity and salt-fog sequences. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 規格換算、耐久等級與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, durability class and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：十片鏡頭、二十面，其中十六面鍍寬帶膜平均 0.25%，四面陡峭面因邊緣效應取 0.5%：穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942，再乘玻璃內部吸收 0.98 得 0.92，若系統預算要求 ≥ 0.90 則合格。最亮鬼影來自兩個 0.5% 的面：2.5×10⁻⁵，相對未鍍膜的 1.8×10⁻³ 下降 72 倍，符合雜散光預算 ≤ 5×10⁻⁵。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A ten-element lens with twenty surfaces, sixteen coated broadband at 0.25% average and four steep surfaces taken at 0.5% for rim effects: transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942, times 0.98 for internal glass absorption gives 0.92, passing a system budget of ≥ 0.90. The brightest ghost comes from two 0.5% surfaces: 2.5×10⁻⁵, 72 times below the uncoated 1.8×10⁻³ and within a stray-light budget of ≤ 5×10⁻⁵. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以第二台分光光度計複測見證片，差異需小於 0.05%；核對規格表每一項（波段、角度、偏振、耐久等級）都有對應量測紀錄；把見證片做完整耐久序列後再量一次光譜，確認平均反射率變化小於 0.1%，並把整支鏡頭的穿透率實測值與預算表並列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-measure witnesses on a second spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within 0.05%; check that every specification line (band, angle, polarization, durability class) has a matching measurement record; run the witnesses through the full durability sequence and re-measure, confirming the average reflectance changes by less than 0.1%, and place the measured lens transmission beside the budget table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 十片鏡頭、二十面，其中十六面鍍寬帶膜平均 0.25%，四面陡峭面因邊緣效應取 0.5%：穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942，再乘玻璃內部吸收 0.98 得 0.92，若系統預算要求 ≥ 0.90 則合格。最亮鬼影來自兩個 0.5% 的面：2.5×10⁻⁵，相對未鍍膜的 1.8×10⁻³ 下降 72 倍，符合雜散光預算 ≤ 5×10⁻⁵。
knowledge.textEn: A ten-element lens with twenty surfaces, sixteen coated broadband at 0.25% average and four steep surfaces taken at 0.5% for rim effects: transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942, times 0.98 for internal glass absorption gives 0.92, passing a system budget of ≥ 0.90. The brightest ghost comes from two 0.5% surfaces: 2.5×10⁻⁵, 72 times below the uncoated 1.8×10⁻³ and within a stray-light budget of ≤ 5×10⁻⁵.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「規格換算、耐久等級與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specification conversion, durability class and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 十片鏡頭、二十面，其中十六面鍍寬帶膜平均 0.25%，四面陡峭面因邊緣效應取 0.5%：穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942，再乘玻璃內部吸收 0.98 得 0.92，若系統預算要求 ≥ 0.90 則合格。
半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。
分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。
optionsEn: A ten-element lens with twenty surfaces, sixteen coated broadband at 0.25% average and four steep surfaces taken at 0.5% for rim effects: transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942, times 0.98 for internal glass absorption gives 0.92, passing a system budget of ≥ 0.90.
A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design.
The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 十片鏡頭、二十面，其中十六面鍍寬帶膜平均 0.25%，四面陡峭面因邊緣效應取 0.5%：穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942，再乘玻璃內部吸收 0.98 得 0.92，若系統預算要求 ≥ 0.90 則合格。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A ten-element lens with twenty surfaces, sixteen coated broadband at 0.25% average and four steep surfaces taken at 0.5% for rim effects: transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942, times 0.98 for internal glass absorption gives 0.92, passing a system budget of ≥ 0.90. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 規格換算、耐久等級與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, durability class and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以第二台分光光度計複測見證片，差異需小於 0.05%；核對規格表每一項（波段、角度、偏振、耐久等級）都有對應量測紀錄；把見證片做完整耐久序列後再量一次光譜，確認平均反射率變化小於 0.1%，並把整支鏡頭的穿透率實測值與預算表並列。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-measure witnesses on a second spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within 0.05%; check that every specification line (band, angle, polarization, durability class) has a matching measurement record; run the witnesses through the full durability sequence and re-measure, confirming the average reflectance changes by less than 0.1%, and place the measured lens transmission beside the budget table. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格只寫「R < 0.5%」而未指明波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向交貨合格，鏡頭在 420 nm、35° 的面上殘餘反射 2%，藍光鬼影超標；缺少耐久等級，軟質 MgF₂ 膜被客戶以乾布擦拭後刮花。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A specification reading only R < 0.5% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while a surface used at 420 nm and 35° leaves 2% residual and a blue ghost over budget; without a durability class a soft MgF₂ film is scratched when the customer wipes it with a dry cloth.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以第二台分光光度計複測見證片，差異需小於 0.05%；核對規格表每一項（波段、角度、偏振、耐久等級）都有對應量測紀錄；把見證片做完整耐久序列後再量一次光譜，確認平均反射率變化小於 0.1%，並把整支鏡頭的穿透率實測值與預算表並列。
knowledge.textEn: Re-measure witnesses on a second spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within 0.05%; check that every specification line (band, angle, polarization, durability class) has a matching measurement record; run the witnesses through the full durability sequence and re-measure, confirming the average reflectance changes by less than 0.1%, and place the measured lens transmission beside the budget table.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規格換算、耐久等級與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specification conversion, durability class and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以第二台分光光度計複測見證片，差異需小於 0.05%。
增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Re-measure witnesses on a second spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within 0.05%.
Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle.
quiz.explanation: 以第二台分光光度計複測見證片，差異需小於 0.05%；核對規格表每一項（波段、角度、偏振、耐久等級）都有對應量測紀錄；把見證片做完整耐久序列後再量一次光譜，確認平均反射率變化小於 0.1%，並把整支鏡頭的穿透率實測值與預算表並列。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Re-measure witnesses on a second spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within 0.05%; check that every specification line (band, angle, polarization, durability class) has a matching measurement record; run the witnesses through the full durability sequence and re-measure, confirming the average reflectance changes by less than 0.1%, and place the measured lens transmission beside the budget table. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 規格換算、耐久等級與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, durability class and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格只寫「R < 0.5%」而未指明波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向交貨合格，鏡頭在 420 nm、35° 的面上殘餘反射 2%，藍光鬼影超標；缺少耐久等級，軟質 MgF₂ 膜被客戶以乾布擦拭後刮花。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A specification reading only R < 0.5% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while a surface used at 420 nm and 35° leaves 2% residual and a blue ghost over budget; without a durability class a soft MgF₂ film is scratched when the customer wipes it with a dry cloth. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料包括各面的膜型（V 膜或寬帶）、設計波長、見證片光譜、耐久測試結果與批號，使鏡頭裝配與雷射系統端能追溯每個面的狀態與清潔方式限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff lists each surface's film type (V-coat or broadband), design wavelength, witness spectrum, durability results and batch number so lens assembly and laser-system users can trace every surface's state and cleaning limits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 規格只寫「R < 0.5%」而未指明波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向交貨合格，鏡頭在 420 nm、35° 的面上殘餘反射 2%，藍光鬼影超標；缺少耐久等級，軟質 MgF₂ 膜被客戶以乾布擦拭後刮花。
knowledge.textEn: A specification reading only R < 0.5% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while a surface used at 420 nm and 35° leaves 2% residual and a blue ghost over budget; without a durability class a soft MgF₂ film is scratched when the customer wipes it with a dry cloth.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「規格換算、耐久等級與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specification conversion, durability class and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。
規格只寫「R < 0.5%」而未指明波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向交貨合格，鏡頭在 420 nm、35° 的面上殘餘反射 2%，藍光鬼影超標。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall.
A specification reading only R < 0.5% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while a surface used at 420 nm and 35° leaves 2% residual and a blue ghost over budget.
quiz.explanation: 規格只寫「R < 0.5%」而未指明波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向交貨合格，鏡頭在 420 nm、35° 的面上殘餘反射 2%，藍光鬼影超標；缺少耐久等級，軟質 MgF₂ 膜被客戶以乾布擦拭後刮花。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A specification reading only R < 0.5% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while a surface used at 420 nm and 35° leaves 2% residual and a blue ghost over budget; without a durability class a soft MgF₂ film is scratched when the customer wipes it with a dry cloth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高反射雷射鏡片
summary: 雷射鏡片與一般高反射膜的差別在於損耗以 ppm 計、功率以損傷門檻計：本課從 1 − R = T + A + S 的損耗帳出發，分析四分之一波堆內的駐波場與損傷起點、超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷、離子束濺鍍與退火對吸收的要求，再用光腔衰盪、光熱吸收與 ISO 21254 損傷測試驗證，最後處理高功率熱效應、安裝污染與規格交接。
summaryEn: A laser mirror differs from an ordinary high reflector in that loss is counted in ppm and power in damage threshold: starting from the loss ledger 1 − R = T + A + S, the course analyses the standing-wave field and damage origin inside a quarter-wave stack, superpolished substrates and nodular defects, ion-beam sputtering and annealing requirements for absorption, then verifies with cavity ring-down, photothermal absorption and ISO 21254 damage testing, and finishes with high-power thermal effects, mounting contamination and specification handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
