knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「損傷門檻測試、縮放律與安全係數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Damage-threshold testing, scaling laws and safety factor" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把 10 ns 的證書門檻直接套用到 300 fs 雷射，飛秒損傷由能隙而非熱擴散決定，實際門檻只有換算值的幾十分之一，鏡片在首次滿功率時損傷。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。
optionsEn: Applying a 10 ns certificate to a 300 fs laser, where damage is set by band gap rather than thermal diffusion, overestimates the threshold by tens of times and the mirror fails at first full power.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance.
quiz.explanation: 把 10 ns 的證書門檻直接套用到 300 fs 雷射，飛秒損傷由能隙而非熱擴散決定，實際門檻只有換算值的幾十分之一，鏡片在首次滿功率時損傷；或以平均能量密度而非高斯峰值做比較，把安全係數高估一倍。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染」與「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination" and "Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移；基板熱導率越高、光斑越大，溫升越小。安裝時的夾持力會在面形上壓出像散，所以用三點運動學或撓性座並控制扭矩。污染是壽命殺手：鏡面吸附的碳氫化合物在紫外或高功率下碳化，形成吸收中心並降低門檻，真空或密閉腔內必須控制除氣材料並維持潔淨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power; higher substrate conductivity and larger spots reduce the rise. Clamping forces during mounting press astigmatism into the figure, so three-point kinematic or flexure mounts with controlled torque are used. Contamination is the lifetime killer: adsorbed hydrocarbons carbonise under ultraviolet or high power, forming absorption centres and lowering the threshold, so outgassing materials in sealed or vacuum cavities must be controlled and cleanliness maintained. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染
knowledge.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination
knowledge.text: 連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移；基板熱導率越高、光斑越大，溫升越小。安裝時的夾持力會在面形上壓出像散，所以用三點運動學或撓性座並控制扭矩。
knowledge.textEn: Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power; higher substrate conductivity and larger spots reduce the rise. Clamping forces during mounting press astigmatism into the figure, so three-point kinematic or flexure mounts with controlled torque are used.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination" is correct?
options: 鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。
連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移。
雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。
optionsEn: Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance.

Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power.
A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number.
quiz.explanation: 連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移；基板熱導率越高、光斑越大，溫升越小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power; higher substrate conductivity and larger spots reduce the rise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。10 kW 入射、A = 10 ppm → P_abs = 0.1 W；熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、w = 2 mm：ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K；表面凸起 ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm，反射波前變形約 30 nm ≈ λ/35。改用 κ = 400 W/(m·K) 的銅基板，ΔT ≈ 0.05 K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w). With 10 kW incident and A = 10 ppm, P_abs = 0.1 W; for fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K) and w = 2 mm, ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K; the surface bump ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm, a reflected-wavefront distortion of about 30 nm ≈ λ/35. A copper substrate with κ = 400 W/(m·K) gives ΔT ≈ 0.05 K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較；安裝前後各量一次面形，相減得到夾持像散並調整扭矩直到小於 λ/50；以表面分析或在線監測吸收的時間趨勢判斷污染累積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model; measure figure before and after mounting, subtract to obtain clamping astigmatism and adjust torque until it is below λ/50; judge contamination build-up from surface analysis or the time trend of in-line absorption.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。10 kW 入射、A = 10 ppm → P_abs = 0.1 W；熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、w = 2 mm：ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K；表面凸起 ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm，反射波前變形約 30 nm ≈ λ/35。改用 κ = 400 W/(m·K) 的銅基板，ΔT ≈ 0.05 K。
knowledge.textEn: The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w). With 10 kW incident and A = 10 ppm, P_abs = 0.1 W; for fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K) and w = 2 mm, ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K; the surface bump ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm, a reflected-wavefront distortion of about 30 nm ≈ λ/35. A copper substrate with κ = 400 W/(m·K) gives ΔT ≈ 0.05 K.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination", which statement holds?
options: 雷射損傷總是從鏡片最外面的表面開始。
鍍膜完成後膜層性質就固定了，退火只是可有可無的額外步驟。
高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。
optionsEn: Laser damage always starts at the outermost surface of the mirror.
Film properties are fixed once deposition ends, so annealing is an optional extra.
The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w).
quiz.explanation: 高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較；安裝前後各量一次面形，相減得到夾持像散並調整扭矩直到小於 λ/50；以表面分析或在線監測吸收的時間趨勢判斷污染累積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model; measure figure before and after mounting, subtract to obtain clamping astigmatism and adjust torque until it is below λ/50; judge contamination build-up from surface analysis or the time trend of in-line absorption. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical; an outgassing adhesive inside the cavity raises surface absorption from 2 ppm to 30 ppm within three months and the output power declines week by week.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較；安裝前後各量一次面形，相減得到夾持像散並調整扭矩直到小於 λ/50；以表面分析或在線監測吸收的時間趨勢判斷污染累積。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model; measure figure before and after mounting, subtract to obtain clamping astigmatism and adjust torque until it is below λ/50; judge contamination build-up from surface analysis or the time trend of in-line absorption.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination"?
options: 在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
分光光度計測到 99.99% 就證明鏡片損耗只有 100 ppm。
optionsEn: Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A spectrophotometer reading of 99.99% proves the mirror loses only 100 ppm.
quiz.explanation: 在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較；安裝前後各量一次面形，相減得到夾持像散並調整扭矩直到小於 λ/50；以表面分析或在線監測吸收的時間趨勢判斷污染累積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model; measure figure before and after mounting, subtract to obtain clamping astigmatism and adjust torque until it is below λ/50; judge contamination build-up from surface analysis or the time trend of in-line absorption. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical; an outgassing adhesive inside the cavity raises surface absorption from 2 ppm to 30 ppm within three months and the output power declines week by week. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：污染是壽命殺手：鏡面吸附的碳氫化合物在紫外或高功率下碳化，形成吸收中心並降低門檻，真空或密閉腔內必須控制除氣材料並維持潔淨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Contamination is the lifetime killer: adsorbed hydrocarbons carbonise under ultraviolet or high power, forming absorption centres and lowering the threshold, so outgassing materials in sealed or vacuum cavities must be controlled and cleanliness maintained.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。
knowledge.textEn: A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical; an outgassing adhesive inside the cavity raises surface absorption from 2 ppm to 30 ppm within three months and the output power declines week by week.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。
雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical.
A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number.
quiz.explanation: 鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical; an outgassing adhesive inside the cavity raises surface absorption from 2 ppm to 30 ppm within three months and the output power declines week by week. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。驗收以衰盪與光熱量測為準，並設保護帶。系統端把每片鏡的損耗代入腔的往返損耗，計算精細度與腔內功率增益，確認與設計一致。交接資料含鍍膜批號、見證片衰盪紀錄、損傷證書、退火紀錄與基板來源，使未來任何一片鏡的異常都能回溯到製程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits. Acceptance relies on ring-down and photothermal measurements with a guard band. The system side enters each mirror's loss into the cavity round-trip loss to compute finesse and intracavity power build-up and checks them against the design. The handoff holds the coating run number, witness ring-down records, damage certificate, annealing record and substrate origin, so any later anomaly in any mirror can be traced to its process. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴；若某片鏡 S 升到 13 ppm，ℓ = 40 ppm，F 降到 1.6×10⁵。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴; if one mirror's S rises to 13 ppm, ℓ = 40 ppm and F falls to 1.6×10⁵.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。驗收以衰盪與光熱量測為準，並設保護帶。
knowledge.textEn: A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits. Acceptance relies on ring-down and photothermal measurements with a guard band.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。
多加幾對膜層就能讓雷射鏡的損耗無限趨近於零。
雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。
optionsEn: A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number.
Adding more layer pairs drives a laser mirror's loss arbitrarily close to zero.

A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits.
quiz.explanation: 雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴；若某片鏡 S 升到 13 ppm，ℓ = 40 ppm，F 降到 1.6×10⁵。衰盪驗收保護帶：規格 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm、量測不確定度 1 ppm，則判定門檻為 24 ppm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴; if one mirror's S rises to 13 ppm, ℓ = 40 ppm and F falls to 1.6×10⁵. Ring-down guard band: with a specification of 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm and 1 ppm measurement uncertainty, the pass threshold is 24 ppm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴；若某片鏡 S 升到 13 ppm，ℓ = 40 ppm，F 降到 1.6×10⁵。衰盪驗收保護帶：規格 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm、量測不確定度 1 ppm，則判定門檻為 24 ppm。
knowledge.textEn: Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴; if one mirror's S rises to 13 ppm, ℓ = 40 ppm and F falls to 1.6×10⁵. Ring-down guard band: with a specification of 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm and 1 ppm measurement uncertainty, the pass threshold is 24 ppm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴。
只要膜層夠好，基板的粗糙度與清潔度無關緊要。
分光光度計測到 99.99% 就證明鏡片損耗只有 100 ppm。
optionsEn: Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴.
With a good enough film the substrate's roughness and cleanliness do not matter.
A spectrophotometer reading of 99.99% proves the mirror loses only 100 ppm.
quiz.explanation: 兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴；若某片鏡 S 升到 13 ppm，ℓ = 40 ppm，F 降到 1.6×10⁵。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴; if one mirror's S rises to 13 ppm, ℓ = 40 ppm and F falls to 1.6×10⁵. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment. Check that every specification line has a matching measurement record and that the damage certificate's pulse width and wavelength match the use conditions or have been properly scaled. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格表寫「R > 99.99%、高損傷門檻」而沒有分項與測試條件，供應商以分光光度計與未註明脈寬的門檻交貨，腔的精細度只達設計的四分之一且鏡片在滿功率下損傷，雙方無法釐清責任。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A sheet reading R > 99.99% and high damage threshold without itemised terms or test conditions is met with a spectrophotometer reading and an unspecified-pulse threshold; the cavity reaches a quarter of the designed finesse, the mirror fails at full power and responsibility cannot be assigned.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。
knowledge.textEn: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment. Check that every specification line has a matching measurement record and that the damage certificate's pulse width and wavelength match the use conditions or have been properly scaled.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準。
損傷門檻是鏡片的固定材料常數，與脈寬、波長和光斑無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses.
The damage threshold is a fixed material constant independent of pulse width, wavelength and spot size.
quiz.explanation: 把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格表寫「R > 99.99%、高損傷門檻」而沒有分項與測試條件，供應商以分光光度計與未註明脈寬的門檻交貨，腔的精細度只達設計的四分之一且鏡片在滿功率下損傷，雙方無法釐清責任。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A sheet reading R > 99.99% and high damage threshold without itemised terms or test conditions is met with a spectrophotometer reading and an unspecified-pulse threshold; the cavity reaches a quarter of the designed finesse, the mirror fails at full power and responsibility cannot be assigned. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料含鍍膜批號、見證片衰盪紀錄、損傷證書、退火紀錄與基板來源，使未來任何一片鏡的異常都能回溯到製程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff holds the coating run number, witness ring-down records, damage certificate, annealing record and substrate origin, so any later anomaly in any mirror can be traced to its process.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: 偏振光學元件製作
summary: 本課以消光比與延遲量兩個核心指標貫穿偏振元件的製作：先用 Malus 定律與雙折射建立規格的物理意義，再分別處理石英波片的定向、研磨至延遲量與零級複合結構、方解石 Glan 稜鏡的全反射幾何、奈米線柵與 MacNeille 薄膜偏振分光器、Fresnel 菱體的消色差延遲，接著用 Sénarmont 與消光比量測建立誤差預算，最後處理應力雙折射安裝與規格交接。
summaryEn: Two figures of merit, extinction ratio and retardance, run through this course on fabricating polarization optics: Malus's law and birefringence give the specifications physical meaning, then quartz-waveplate orientation, polishing to retardance and compound zero-order construction, the total-internal-reflection geometry of calcite Glan prisms, nanowire-grid and MacNeille thin-film beam splitters and the achromatic retardance of the Fresnel rhomb are treated in turn, followed by Sénarmont and extinction-ratio metrology for the error budget, stress-birefringence-free mounting and specification handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 複合零級石英四分之一波片練習（633 nm）：Δn = 0.0091，零級厚度差 d = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm，以兩片約 700 µm 的石英片光軸交叉組合。延遲量公差 λ/300 對應厚度差公差 633/(300×0.0091) ≈ 0.23 µm；拋光速率 0.1 µm/min 時公差窗約 2 分鐘，必須以 Sénarmont 回授停機，Sénarmont 讀數 0.05° 給 λ/3600 的量測不確定度。使用條件：波長 ±0.5 nm → 零級敏感度 4×10⁻⁴ 波/nm → 2×10⁻⁴ 波；溫度 ±5 K → 2.4×10⁻⁵ 波/K → 1.2×10⁻⁴ 波；入射角 ±2° → 2.5×10⁻⁴ 相對 → 6×10⁻⁵ 波；安裝應力控制在 36 kPa 以下 → λ/1000 = 1×10⁻³ 波。總預算 RSS ≈ √(3.3² + 0.2² + 0.12² + 0.06² + 1²)×10⁻³ ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ 波 ≈ λ/290，符合 λ/250 的系統需求。若改用單片 10 級波片，光僅波長項就達 0.016 波/nm × 0.5 = 8×10⁻³ 波（λ/125），溫度項 5×10⁻³ 波，RSS ≈ λ/100，不合格。搭配的 Glan–Taylor 稜鏡消光比 10⁵:1，與 0.3° 的旋轉角控制合併後隔離度 ≈ 44 dB。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Compound zero-order quartz quarter-wave plate exercise at 633 nm: Δn = 0.0091, zero-order thickness difference d = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm, built from two quartz plates of about 700 µm with crossed axes. A λ/300 retardance tolerance corresponds to a thickness-difference tolerance of 633/(300×0.0091) ≈ 0.23 µm; at a polish rate of 0.1 µm/min the tolerance window lasts about 2 minutes, so the stop is driven by Sénarmont feedback, whose 0.05° readout gives λ/3600 measurement uncertainty. Operating terms: wavelength ±0.5 nm with zero-order sensitivity 4×10⁻⁴ waves/nm → 2×10⁻⁴ waves; temperature ±5 K at 2.4×10⁻⁵ waves/K → 1.2×10⁻⁴ waves; incidence ±2° → 2.5×10⁻⁴ relative → 6×10⁻⁵ waves; mounting stress held below 36 kPa → λ/1000 = 1×10⁻³ waves. Total RSS ≈ √(3.3² + 0.2² + 0.12² + 0.06² + 1²)×10⁻³ ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ waves ≈ λ/290, meeting a λ/250 system requirement. A single 10th-order plate instead would have a wavelength term alone of 0.016 waves/nm × 0.5 = 8×10⁻³ waves (λ/125) and a temperature term of 5×10⁻³ waves, RSS ≈ λ/100, failing. The matching Glan–Taylor prism at 10⁵:1 combined with 0.3° rotation control gives isolation ≈ 44 dB. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類」與「雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes" and "Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「交叉偏振片與消光比」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 線偏振光通過透射軸夾角 θ 的理想偏振片後強度為 I = I₀cos²θ，這是 Malus 定律；真實偏振片以消光比 ER = T_max/T_min 描述，它由材料的二向吸收、晶體的全反射幾何或薄膜的 Brewster 條件決定。元件類別與消光比的典型範圍：拉伸聚合物片與含銀粒子玻璃 10³ 到 10⁴，鋁奈米線柵 10³ 到 10⁴ 且寬頻，薄膜分光立方體 10² 到 10³，方解石 Glan 稜鏡 10⁵ 到 10⁶。消光比規格必須連同波長、入射角與光束發散角一起給，因為這三者都會把漏光放大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交叉偏振片與消光比」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Linearly polarized light passing an ideal polarizer whose transmission axis is at angle θ emerges with I = I₀cos²θ, Malus's law; a real polarizer is described by its extinction ratio ER = T_max/T_min, set by dichroic absorption in the material, total-internal-reflection geometry in a crystal or the Brewster condition in a thin-film stack. Typical classes and ranges: stretched polymer sheet and silver-particle glass 10³ to 10⁴, aluminium nanowire grids 10³ to 10⁴ and broadband, thin-film cube splitters 10² to 10³, calcite Glan prisms 10⁵ to 10⁶. An extinction specification must always carry wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence, because all three enlarge the leakage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩片交叉偏振片的對準誤差 Δθ 造成漏光 sin²Δθ：Δθ = 1° 時 3.0×10⁻⁴（等效消光比僅 3300:1），0.5° 時 7.6×10⁻⁵，0.1° 時 3.0×10⁻⁶，0.06° 時 1.1×10⁻⁶。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A misalignment Δθ between two crossed polarizers leaks sin²Δθ: 3.0×10⁻⁴ at Δθ = 1° (an effective extinction of only 3300:1), 7.6×10⁻⁵ at 0.5°, 3.0×10⁻⁶ at 0.1° and 1.1×10⁻⁶ at 0.06°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「交叉偏振片與消光比」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類
knowledge.titleEn: Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes
knowledge.text: 線偏振光通過透射軸夾角 θ 的理想偏振片後強度為 I = I₀cos²θ，這是 Malus 定律；真實偏振片以消光比 ER = T_max/T_min 描述，它由材料的二向吸收、晶體的全反射幾何或薄膜的 Brewster 條件決定。元件類別與消光比的典型範圍：拉伸聚合物片與含銀粒子玻璃 10³ 到 10⁴，鋁奈米線柵 10³ 到 10⁴ 且寬頻，薄膜分光立方體 10² 到 10³，方解石 Glan 稜鏡 10⁵ 到 10⁶。
knowledge.textEn: Linearly polarized light passing an ideal polarizer whose transmission axis is at angle θ emerges with I = I₀cos²θ, Malus's law; a real polarizer is described by its extinction ratio ER = T_max/T_min, set by dichroic absorption in the material, total-internal-reflection geometry in a crystal or the Brewster condition in a thin-film stack. Typical classes and ranges: stretched polymer sheet and silver-particle glass 10³ to 10⁴, aluminium nanowire grids 10³ to 10⁴ and broadband, thin-film cube splitters 10² to 10³, calcite Glan prisms 10⁵ to 10⁶.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes" is correct?
options: 消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。
線偏振光通過透射軸夾角 θ 的理想偏振片後強度為 I = I₀cos²θ，這是 Malus 定律。
只要延遲量在設計波長正確，多級與零級波片的表現就一樣。
optionsEn: Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality.
Linearly polarized light passing an ideal polarizer whose transmission axis is at angle θ emerges with I = I₀cos²θ, Malus's law.
If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same.
quiz.explanation: 線偏振光通過透射軸夾角 θ 的理想偏振片後強度為 I = I₀cos²θ，這是 Malus 定律；真實偏振片以消光比 ER = T_max/T_min 描述，它由材料的二向吸收、晶體的全反射幾何或薄膜的 Brewster 條件決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Linearly polarized light passing an ideal polarizer whose transmission axis is at angle θ emerges with I = I₀cos²θ, Malus's law; a real polarizer is described by its extinction ratio ER = T_max/T_min, set by dichroic absorption in the material, total-internal-reflection geometry in a crystal or the Brewster condition in a thin-film stack. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交叉偏振片與消光比」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩片交叉偏振片的對準誤差 Δθ 造成漏光 sin²Δθ：Δθ = 1° 時 3.0×10⁻⁴（等效消光比僅 3300:1），0.5° 時 7.6×10⁻⁵，0.1° 時 3.0×10⁻⁶，0.06° 時 1.1×10⁻⁶。所以要驗證 10⁶:1 的 Glan 稜鏡，兩個元件的相對軸向必須對準到 0.06° 以內，否則量到的是對準誤差而不是元件本身。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A misalignment Δθ between two crossed polarizers leaks sin²Δθ: 3.0×10⁻⁴ at Δθ = 1° (an effective extinction of only 3300:1), 7.6×10⁻⁵ at 0.5°, 3.0×10⁻⁶ at 0.1° and 1.1×10⁻⁶ at 0.06°. Verifying a 10⁶:1 Glan prism therefore requires the two axes aligned within 0.06°, or the measurement reports the alignment error rather than the component. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在準直的單頻雷射光束中放兩片待測偏振片，用精密旋轉台以 0.01° 步進掃過消光點，記錄透射功率對角度的曲線並擬合 cos² 加常數項，常數項即為真實漏光；量測時用光阱與擋板去除雜散光，並確認偵測器在六個數量級內線性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the two polarizers in a collimated single-frequency laser beam, scan through extinction on a precision rotation stage in 0.01° steps, record transmitted power against angle and fit cos² plus a constant, the constant being the true leakage; use beam dumps and baffles to remove stray light and confirm detector linearity over six decades.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩片交叉偏振片的對準誤差 Δθ 造成漏光 sin²Δθ：Δθ = 1° 時 3.0×10⁻⁴（等效消光比僅 3300:1），0.5° 時 7.6×10⁻⁵，0.1° 時 3.0×10⁻⁶，0.06° 時 1.1×10⁻⁶。所以要驗證 10⁶:1 的 Glan 稜鏡，兩個元件的相對軸向必須對準到 0.06° 以內，否則量到的是對準誤差而不是元件本身。
knowledge.textEn: A misalignment Δθ between two crossed polarizers leaks sin²Δθ: 3.0×10⁻⁴ at Δθ = 1° (an effective extinction of only 3300:1), 7.6×10⁻⁵ at 0.5°, 3.0×10⁻⁶ at 0.1° and 1.1×10⁻⁶ at 0.06°. Verifying a 10⁶:1 Glan prism therefore requires the two axes aligned within 0.06°, or the measurement reports the alignment error rather than the component.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「交叉偏振片與消光比」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Crossed polarizers and extinction ratio” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在準直的單頻雷射光束中放兩片待測偏振片，用精密旋轉台以 0.01° 步進掃過消光點，記錄透射功率對角度的曲線並擬合 cos² 加常數項，常數項即為真實漏光；量測時用光阱與擋板去除雜散光，並確認偵測器在六個數量級內線性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place the two polarizers in a collimated single-frequency laser beam, scan through extinction on a precision rotation stage in 0.01° steps, record transmitted power against angle and fit cos² plus a constant, the constant being the true leakage; use beam dumps and baffles to remove stray light and confirm detector linearity over six decades. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用 2° 發散的 LED 光束量 Glan 稜鏡，部分光線超出全反射的接受角而直接漏過，消光比只讀到 10³:1，合格的稜鏡被判為不良；或偵測器在低功率端非線性，漏光被低估十倍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring a Glan prism with a 2° divergent LED beam lets rays beyond the total-internal-reflection acceptance angle leak straight through, reading only 10³:1 and rejecting a good prism; a detector non-linear at low power underestimates leakage tenfold.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: Malus 定律、消光比與偏振元件分類：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Malus's law, extinction ratio and polarizer classes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「交叉偏振片與消光比」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 用 2° 發散的 LED 光束量 Glan 稜鏡，部分光線超出全反射的接受角而直接漏過，消光比只讀到 10³:1，合格的稜鏡被判為不良；或偵測器在低功率端非線性，漏光被低估十倍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring a Glan prism with a 2° divergent LED beam lets rays beyond the total-internal-reflection acceptance angle leak straight through, reading only 10³:1 and rejecting a good prism; a detector non-linear at low power underestimates leakage tenfold. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：消光比規格必須連同波長、入射角與光束發散角一起給，因為這三者都會把漏光放大。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單軸晶體對平行與垂直光軸的偏振有不同折射率，厚度 d 的平板使兩個分量產生相位差 Γ = Δn·d/λ（以波數計），這就是延遲量。石英在 633 nm 的 Δn 約 0.0091，真正的零級四分之一波片只有十幾微米厚，無法獨立研磨，所以有兩種做法：多級波片把延遲量做成 m + 1/4 波（厚度數百微米），或把兩片多級片光軸交叉疊合，使厚度差等於零級厚度，稱為複合零級波片。多級波片的延遲量對波長與溫度的敏感度隨級數線性放大，這是工程選擇的核心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A uniaxial crystal has different indices for polarizations parallel and perpendicular to its optic axis, so a plate of thickness d gives the two components a phase difference Γ = Δn·d/λ in waves, the retardance. Quartz has Δn of about 0.0091 at 633 nm, so a true zero-order quarter-wave plate is only tens of micrometres thick and cannot be polished free-standing; either a multi-order plate carries m + 1/4 waves at several hundred micrometres, or two multi-order plates are stacked with crossed axes so their thickness difference equals the zero-order thickness, the compound zero-order plate. A multi-order plate's sensitivity of retardance to wavelength and temperature scales with its order, which is the core of the engineering choice. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A zero-order quarter-wave plate has d = λ/(4Δn) = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm; a 10th-order plate (10.25 waves) d ≈ 713 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要延遲量在設計波長正確，多級與零級波片的表現就一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片
knowledge.titleEn: Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates
knowledge.text: 單軸晶體對平行與垂直光軸的偏振有不同折射率，厚度 d 的平板使兩個分量產生相位差 Γ = Δn·d/λ（以波數計），這就是延遲量。石英在 633 nm 的 Δn 約 0.0091，真正的零級四分之一波片只有十幾微米厚，無法獨立研磨，所以有兩種做法：多級波片把延遲量做成 m + 1/4 波（厚度數百微米），或把兩片多級片光軸交叉疊合，使厚度差等於零級厚度，稱為複合零級波片。
knowledge.textEn: A uniaxial crystal has different indices for polarizations parallel and perpendicular to its optic axis, so a plate of thickness d gives the two components a phase difference Γ = Δn·d/λ in waves, the retardance. Quartz has Δn of about 0.0091 at 633 nm, so a true zero-order quarter-wave plate is only tens of micrometres thick and cannot be polished free-standing; either a multi-order plate carries m + 1/4 waves at several hundred micrometres, or two multi-order plates are stacked with crossed axes so their thickness difference equals the zero-order thickness, the compound zero-order plate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要延遲量在設計波長正確，多級與零級波片的表現就一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates" is correct?

單軸晶體對平行與垂直光軸的偏振有不同折射率，厚度 d 的平板使兩個分量產生相位差 Γ = Δn·d/λ（以波數計），這就是延遲量。
optionsEn: If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same.
A waveplate only needs the right thickness; a slightly off optic axis does not matter.

steps.title: 雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：零級四分之一波片 d = λ/(4Δn) = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm；10 級（10.25 波）d ≈ 713 µm。λ/300 的延遲量公差對應厚度公差 Δd = λ/(300Δn) ≈ 0.23 µm，零級與多級相同。波長敏感度 ∂Γ/∂λ ≈ −Γ/λ：零級每 nm 僅 4×10⁻⁴ 波（λ/2500），10 級則 0.016 波（λ/62）。溫度（取 dΔn/dT ≈ −1×10⁻⁶/K、α ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵/K 為教學假設）：零級約 −2.4×10⁻⁵ 波/K，10 級約 −1.0×10⁻³ 波/K，10 K 溫差就吃掉 λ/100。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A zero-order quarter-wave plate has d = λ/(4Δn) = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm; a 10th-order plate (10.25 waves) d ≈ 713 µm. A λ/300 retardance tolerance corresponds to a thickness tolerance Δd = λ/(300Δn) ≈ 0.23 µm, the same for zero- and multi-order. Wavelength sensitivity ∂Γ/∂λ ≈ −Γ/λ: only 4×10⁻⁴ waves per nm (λ/2500) for zero order but 0.016 waves (λ/62) for 10th order. Temperature (taking dΔn/dT ≈ −1×10⁻⁶/K and α ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵/K as teaching assumptions): about −2.4×10⁻⁵ waves/K for zero order and −1.0×10⁻³ waves/K for 10th order, so a 10 K change consumes λ/100. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用可調波長光源或幾條雷射線量同一片波片的延遲量，畫出延遲量對波長的斜率，由斜率反推級數並與設計核對；把波片放在溫控座上以 10 K 步進升溫量延遲量漂移，與溫度係數估計比較，確認複合零級波片的兩片厚度匹配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the same plate's retardance at a tunable source or several laser lines, plot retardance against wavelength, infer the order from the slope and check it against the design; heat the plate on a temperature-controlled mount in 10 K steps and measure the drift, comparing with the temperature-coefficient estimate to confirm that the two halves of a compound zero-order plate are thickness-matched.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 零級四分之一波片 d = λ/(4Δn) = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm；10 級（10.25 波）d ≈ 713 µm。λ/300 的延遲量公差對應厚度公差 Δd = λ/(300Δn) ≈ 0.23 µm，零級與多級相同。波長敏感度 ∂Γ/∂λ ≈ −Γ/λ：零級每 nm 僅 4×10⁻⁴ 波（λ/2500），10 級則 0.016 波（λ/62）。溫度（取 dΔn/dT ≈ −1×10⁻⁶/K、α ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵/K 為教學假設）：零級約 −2.4×10⁻⁵ 波/K，10 級約 −1.0×10⁻³ 波/K，10 K 溫差就吃掉 λ/100。
knowledge.textEn: A zero-order quarter-wave plate has d = λ/(4Δn) = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm; a 10th-order plate (10.25 waves) d ≈ 713 µm. A λ/300 retardance tolerance corresponds to a thickness tolerance Δd = λ/(300Δn) ≈ 0.23 µm, the same for zero- and multi-order. Wavelength sensitivity ∂Γ/∂λ ≈ −Γ/λ: only 4×10⁻⁴ waves per nm (λ/2500) for zero order but 0.016 waves (λ/62) for 10th order. Temperature (taking dΔn/dT ≈ −1×10⁻⁶/K and α ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁵/K as teaching assumptions): about −2.4×10⁻⁵ waves/K for zero order and −1.0×10⁻³ waves/K for 10th order, so a 10 K change consumes λ/100.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates", which statement holds?
options: 延遲量量測只需要一個偏振片和一個功率計就夠精確。
玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。
optionsEn: A zero-order quarter-wave plate has d = λ/(4Δn) = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm; a 10th-order plate (10.25 waves) d ≈ 713 µm.
A retardance measurement needs only one polarizer and a power meter to be accurate.
Glass is isotropic, so clamping it any way produces no birefringence.
quiz.explanationEn: A zero-order quarter-wave plate has d = λ/(4Δn) = 633/(4×0.0091) ≈ 17.4 µm; a 10th-order plate (10.25 waves) d ≈ 713 µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用可調波長光源或幾條雷射線量同一片波片的延遲量，畫出延遲量對波長的斜率，由斜率反推級數並與設計核對；把波片放在溫控座上以 10 K 步進升溫量延遲量漂移，與溫度係數估計比較，確認複合零級波片的兩片厚度匹配。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the same plate's retardance at a tunable source or several laser lines, plot retardance against wavelength, infer the order from the slope and check it against the design; heat the plate on a temperature-controlled mount in 10 K steps and measure the drift, comparing with the temperature-coefficient estimate to confirm that the two halves of a compound zero-order plate are thickness-matched. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了省成本在二極體雷射系統用 10 級波片，雷射波長隨溫度漂移 2 nm 使延遲量偏 λ/30，偏振態變成橢圓，下游 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度掉 10 dB；複合零級波片兩片光軸未精確交叉，殘留的多級特性讓溫度敏感度回到多級等級。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using a 10th-order plate in a diode-laser system to save cost lets a 2 nm wavelength drift with temperature shift retardance by λ/30, the polarization turns elliptical and the downstream Faraday isolator loses 10 dB; a compound zero-order plate whose two axes are not precisely crossed retains multi-order behaviour and its temperature sensitivity returns to the multi-order level.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用可調波長光源或幾條雷射線量同一片波片的延遲量，畫出延遲量對波長的斜率，由斜率反推級數並與設計核對；把波片放在溫控座上以 10 K 步進升溫量延遲量漂移，與溫度係數估計比較，確認複合零級波片的兩片厚度匹配。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the same plate's retardance at a tunable source or several laser lines, plot retardance against wavelength, infer the order from the slope and check it against the design; heat the plate on a temperature-controlled mount in 10 K steps and measure the drift, comparing with the temperature-coefficient estimate to confirm that the two halves of a compound zero-order plate are thickness-matched.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用可調波長光源或幾條雷射線量同一片波片的延遲量，畫出延遲量對波長的斜率，由斜率反推級數並與設計核對。
偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the same plate's retardance at a tunable source or several laser lines, plot retardance against wavelength, infer the order from the slope and check it against the design.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure the same plate's retardance at a tunable source or several laser lines, plot retardance against wavelength, infer the order from the slope and check it against the design; heat the plate on a temperature-controlled mount in 10 K steps and measure the drift, comparing with the temperature-coefficient estimate to confirm that the two halves of a compound zero-order plate are thickness-matched. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「石英波片的雙折射與延遲量」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Birefringence and retardance of a quartz waveplate” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了省成本在二極體雷射系統用 10 級波片，雷射波長隨溫度漂移 2 nm 使延遲量偏 λ/30，偏振態變成橢圓，下游 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度掉 10 dB；複合零級波片兩片光軸未精確交叉，殘留的多級特性讓溫度敏感度回到多級等級。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using a 10th-order plate in a diode-laser system to save cost lets a 2 nm wavelength drift with temperature shift retardance by λ/30, the polarization turns elliptical and the downstream Faraday isolator loses 10 dB; a compound zero-order plate whose two axes are not precisely crossed retains multi-order behaviour and its temperature sensitivity returns to the multi-order level. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多級波片的延遲量對波長與溫度的敏感度隨級數線性放大，這是工程選擇的核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A multi-order plate's sensitivity of retardance to wavelength and temperature scales with its order, which is the core of the engineering choice.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要延遲量在設計波長正確，多級與零級波片的表現就一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了省成本在二極體雷射系統用 10 級波片，雷射波長隨溫度漂移 2 nm 使延遲量偏 λ/30，偏振態變成橢圓，下游 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度掉 10 dB；複合零級波片兩片光軸未精確交叉，殘留的多級特性讓溫度敏感度回到多級等級。
knowledge.textEn: Using a 10th-order plate in a diode-laser system to save cost lets a 2 nm wavelength drift with temperature shift retardance by λ/30, the polarization turns elliptical and the downstream Faraday isolator loses 10 dB; a compound zero-order plate whose two axes are not precisely crossed retains multi-order behaviour and its temperature sensitivity returns to the multi-order level.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙折射、延遲量與零級／多級波片」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Birefringence, retardance and zero-order versus multi-order plates" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
波片做到正確厚度就行了，光軸方向差一點沒關係。
為了省成本在二極體雷射系統用 10 級波片，雷射波長隨溫度漂移 2 nm 使延遲量偏 λ/30，偏振態變成橢圓，下游 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度掉 10 dB。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A waveplate only needs the right thickness; a slightly off optic axis does not matter.

Using a 10th-order plate in a diode-laser system to save cost lets a 2 nm wavelength drift with temperature shift retardance by λ/30, the polarization turns elliptical and the downstream Faraday isolator loses 10 dB.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「晶體偏振元件的加工：波片與 Glan 稜鏡」與「線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fabricating crystal polarization optics: waveplates and Glan prisms" and "Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 晶體偏振元件的加工：波片與 Glan 稜鏡：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Fabricating crystal polarization optics: waveplates and Glan prisms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「晶體定向、研磨至延遲量與方解石稜鏡」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 石英波片的晶片必須切成光軸平行於表面，定向用 X 光繞射或錐光干涉圖確認到 0.1° 以內，再研磨拋光到厚度；因為延遲量對厚度的要求是 0.2 µm 等級，最後一道工序不是量厚度而是邊拋邊量延遲量，直到進入公差。複合零級波片的兩片以光學膠合或空氣間隙組合，膠合會引入應力與雷射功率限制。方解石 Glan–Taylor 稜鏡由兩塊光軸平行於入射面的方解石以空氣間隙組成，切角使尋常光在間隙全反射、非常光穿透；接受角由兩個臨界角夾出，只有幾度，材料的解理與軟度使加工與清潔都比玻璃困難。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「晶體定向、研磨至延遲量與方解石稜鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A quartz waveplate blank is cut with the optic axis parallel to the surface, the orientation verified to within 0.1° by X-ray diffraction or conoscopic interference, then lapped and polished to thickness; because the retardance demands thickness at the 0.2 µm level, the final step measures retardance while polishing rather than thickness, stopping inside tolerance. The two halves of a compound zero-order plate are optically cemented or air-spaced, cementing bringing stress and a laser-power limit. A calcite Glan–Taylor prism is two calcite pieces with optic axes parallel to the entrance face separated by an air gap, cut so the ordinary ray is totally reflected at the gap while the extraordinary ray passes; the acceptance angle lies between two critical angles and is only a few degrees, and calcite's cleavage and softness make machining and cleaning harder than glass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：方解石（589 nm）n_o = 1.658、n_e = 1.486：空氣間隙的臨界角分別為 arcsin(1/1.658) ≈ 37.1° 與 arcsin(1/1.486) ≈ 42.3°，間隙面切角取約 39.7° 使尋常光全反射而非常光穿透，內部角度餘裕約 ±2.6°，折算到空氣中約 ±4° 的接受角。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For calcite at 589 nm, n_o = 1.658 and n_e = 1.486: the air-gap critical angles are arcsin(1/1.658) ≈ 37.1° and arcsin(1/1.486) ≈ 42.3°, so the gap is cut near 39.7° to totally reflect the ordinary ray and pass the extraordinary one, leaving an internal margin of about ±2.6°, roughly ±4° of acceptance in air.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波片做到正確厚度就行了，光軸方向差一點沒關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A waveplate only needs the right thickness; a slightly off optic axis does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「晶體定向、研磨至延遲量與方解石稜鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fabricating crystal polarization optics: waveplates and Glan prisms" is correct?

quiz.explanationEn: A quartz waveplate blank is cut with the optic axis parallel to the surface, the orientation verified to within 0.1° by X-ray diffraction or conoscopic interference, then lapped and polished to thickness; because the retardance demands thickness at the 0.2 µm level, the final step measures retardance while polishing rather than thickness, stopping inside tolerance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 晶體偏振元件的加工：波片與 Glan 稜鏡：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：方解石（589 nm）n_o = 1.658、n_e = 1.486：空氣間隙的臨界角分別為 arcsin(1/1.658) ≈ 37.1° 與 arcsin(1/1.486) ≈ 42.3°，間隙面切角取約 39.7° 使尋常光全反射而非常光穿透，內部角度餘裕約 ±2.6°，折算到空氣中約 ±4° 的接受角。研磨至延遲量：拋光速率 0.1 µm/min 時，最後 0.23 µm 的公差窗只有約 2 分鐘，必須以延遲量回授停機。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For calcite at 589 nm, n_o = 1.658 and n_e = 1.486: the air-gap critical angles are arcsin(1/1.658) ≈ 37.1° and arcsin(1/1.486) ≈ 42.3°, so the gap is cut near 39.7° to totally reflect the ordinary ray and pass the extraordinary one, leaving an internal margin of about ±2.6°, roughly ±4° of acceptance in air. Polishing to retardance: at a polish rate of 0.1 µm/min the final 0.23 µm tolerance window lasts only about 2 minutes, so the stop must be driven by retardance feedback. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每片晶片拋光前以錐光干涉圖檢查光軸方向，拋光中每隔數分鐘取下用 Sénarmont 法量延遲量並記錄厚度減少量，驗證線性關係；Glan 稜鏡組裝後以旋轉台掃描入射角，量消光比隨角度的變化，確認接受角與臨界角計算一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check each blank's optic-axis direction by conoscopic interference before polishing; during polishing remove the plate every few minutes, measure retardance by the Sénarmont method and log thickness removed to verify linearity; after assembling a Glan prism, scan incidence angle on a rotation stage and measure extinction against angle to confirm the acceptance window matches the critical-angle calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.title: 晶體偏振元件的加工：波片與 Glan 稜鏡：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabricating crystal polarization optics: waveplates and Glan prisms: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「晶體定向、研磨至延遲量與方解石稜鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每片晶片拋光前以錐光干涉圖檢查光軸方向，拋光中每隔數分鐘取下用 Sénarmont 法量延遲量並記錄厚度減少量，驗證線性關係；Glan 稜鏡組裝後以旋轉台掃描入射角，量消光比隨角度的變化，確認接受角與臨界角計算一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check each blank's optic-axis direction by conoscopic interference before polishing; during polishing remove the plate every few minutes, measure retardance by the Sénarmont method and log thickness removed to verify linearity; after assembling a Glan prism, scan incidence angle on a rotation stage and measure extinction against angle to confirm the acceptance window matches the critical-angle calculation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：晶片光軸偏離表面 2°，延遲量隨入射角產生不對稱變化且在正向就偏離設計；方解石稜鏡清潔時溶劑滲入空氣間隙殘留薄膜，全反射條件被破壞，消光比從 10⁵ 掉到 10².
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A blank whose optic axis is 2° out of the surface gives asymmetric retardance against incidence angle and is off design even at normal incidence; solvent wicking into the air gap of a calcite prism during cleaning leaves a film that breaks total internal reflection and drops extinction from 10⁵ to 10².
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「晶體定向、研磨至延遲量與方解石稜鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Crystal orientation, polishing to retardance and calcite prisms” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 晶片光軸偏離表面 2°，延遲量隨入射角產生不對稱變化且在正向就偏離設計；方解石稜鏡清潔時溶劑滲入空氣間隙殘留薄膜，全反射條件被破壞，消光比從 10⁵ 掉到 10². 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A blank whose optic axis is 2° out of the surface gives asymmetric retardance against incidence angle and is off design even at normal incidence; solvent wicking into the air gap of a calcite prism during cleaning leaves a film that breaks total internal reflection and drops extinction from 10⁵ to 10². Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：方解石 Glan–Taylor 稜鏡由兩塊光軸平行於入射面的方解石以空氣間隙組成，切角使尋常光在間隙全反射、非常光穿透；接受角由兩個臨界角夾出，只有幾度，材料的解理與軟度使加工與清潔都比玻璃困難。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A calcite Glan–Taylor prism is two calcite pieces with optic axes parallel to the entrance face separated by an air gap, cut so the ordinary ray is totally reflected at the gap while the extraordinary ray passes; the acceptance angle lies between two critical angles and is only a few degrees, and calcite's cleavage and softness make machining and cleaning harder than glass.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波片做到正確厚度就行了，光軸方向差一點沒關係。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A waveplate only needs the right thickness; a slightly off optic axis does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
