steps.title: 線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋁奈米線柵以奈米壓印或干涉微影在玻璃上做出週期 100 到 150 nm、占空比約一半的鋁線，當週期遠小於波長時，電場平行線條的偏振被反射、垂直的被透射，寬頻且耐高溫，但週期必須小於波長除以基板折射率才不會產生繞射級。MacNeille 偏振分光立方體靠多層膜內每個界面都在 Brewster 角工作：p 偏振幾乎不反射而 s 偏振被四分之一波堆高反射，條件 n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) 把膜材與立方體玻璃綁在一起。Fresnel 菱體用兩次全反射各產生約 45° 的相位差，延遲量只依賴折射率，幾乎不隨波長變化，是消色差的四分之一波延遲器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An aluminium nanowire grid is made by nanoimprint or interference lithography as 100 to 150 nm pitch lines of about half duty cycle on glass; for pitch far below the wavelength the polarization parallel to the wires is reflected and the perpendicular one transmitted, broadband and heat-tolerant, but the pitch must stay below the wavelength divided by the substrate index to avoid diffracted orders. A MacNeille polarizing cube works with every interface of its multilayer at Brewster's angle: p polarization is barely reflected while s is strongly reflected by the quarter-wave stack, and the condition n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) ties the film materials to the cube glass. A Fresnel rhomb produces about 45° of phase difference at each of two total internal reflections; the retardance depends only on refractive index and hardly on wavelength, giving an achromatic quarter-wave retarder. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線柵：週期 120 nm、基板 n = 1.5 時，繞射級在 λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm 才出現，整個可見光安全。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wire grid: with 120 nm pitch and substrate n = 1.5, diffracted orders appear only for λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm, so the whole visible band is safe.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何高折射率／低折射率膜堆鍍在任何玻璃上都能當偏振分光器。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any high/low-index stack on any glass works as a polarizing beam splitter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器
knowledge.titleEn: Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders
knowledge.text: 鋁奈米線柵以奈米壓印或干涉微影在玻璃上做出週期 100 到 150 nm、占空比約一半的鋁線，當週期遠小於波長時，電場平行線條的偏振被反射、垂直的被透射，寬頻且耐高溫，但週期必須小於波長除以基板折射率才不會產生繞射級。MacNeille 偏振分光立方體靠多層膜內每個界面都在 Brewster 角工作：p 偏振幾乎不反射而 s 偏振被四分之一波堆高反射，條件 n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) 把膜材與立方體玻璃綁在一起。
knowledge.textEn: An aluminium nanowire grid is made by nanoimprint or interference lithography as 100 to 150 nm pitch lines of about half duty cycle on glass; for pitch far below the wavelength the polarization parallel to the wires is reflected and the perpendicular one transmitted, broadband and heat-tolerant, but the pitch must stay below the wavelength divided by the substrate index to avoid diffracted orders. A MacNeille polarizing cube works with every interface of its multilayer at Brewster's angle: p polarization is barely reflected while s is strongly reflected by the quarter-wave stack, and the condition n_g² = 2n_H²n_L²/(n_H² + n_L²) ties the film materials to the cube glass.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何高折射率／低折射率膜堆鍍在任何玻璃上都能當偏振分光器。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any high/low-index stack on any glass works as a polarizing beam splitter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders" is correct?
options: 任何高折射率／低折射率膜堆鍍在任何玻璃上都能當偏振分光器。
鋁奈米線柵以奈米壓印或干涉微影在玻璃上做出週期 100 到 150 nm、占空比約一半的鋁線，當週期遠小於波長時，電場平行線條的偏振被反射、垂直的被透射，寬頻且耐高溫，但週期必須小於波長除以基板折射率才不會產生繞射級。
延遲量量測只需要一個偏振片和一個功率計就夠精確。
optionsEn: Any high/low-index stack on any glass works as a polarizing beam splitter.
An aluminium nanowire grid is made by nanoimprint or interference lithography as 100 to 150 nm pitch lines of about half duty cycle on glass.
A retardance measurement needs only one polarizer and a power meter to be accurate.
quiz.explanation: 鋁奈米線柵以奈米壓印或干涉微影在玻璃上做出週期 100 到 150 nm、占空比約一半的鋁線，當週期遠小於波長時，電場平行線條的偏振被反射、垂直的被透射，寬頻且耐高溫，但週期必須小於波長除以基板折射率才不會產生繞射級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An aluminium nanowire grid is made by nanoimprint or interference lithography as 100 to 150 nm pitch lines of about half duty cycle on glass; for pitch far below the wavelength the polarization parallel to the wires is reflected and the perpendicular one transmitted, broadband and heat-tolerant, but the pitch must stay below the wavelength divided by the substrate index to avoid diffracted orders. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線柵：週期 120 nm、基板 n = 1.5 時，繞射級在 λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm 才出現，整個可見光安全。MacNeille：TiO₂/SiO₂（2.35/1.46）需 n_g = √(2×5.52×2.13/(5.52 + 2.13)) ≈ 1.75 的重火石玻璃；Al₂O₃/MgF₂（1.63/1.38）則 n_g ≈ 1.49，可用 BK7。Fresnel 菱體（BK7，54.6°）：每次全反射的延遲 δ = 2·arctan[cosθ·√(sin²θ − 1/n²)/sin²θ]，633 nm（n = 1.5151）為 45.3°，兩次 90.6°；400 nm（n = 1.5308）為 92.1°，1064 nm（n = 1.5066）為 89.7°，全波段偏離 90° 僅 −0.3° 到 +2.1°（最大約 λ/170）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wire grid: with 120 nm pitch and substrate n = 1.5, diffracted orders appear only for λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm, so the whole visible band is safe. MacNeille: TiO₂/SiO₂ (2.35/1.46) needs n_g = √(2×5.52×2.13/(5.52 + 2.13)) ≈ 1.75, a dense flint glass, whereas Al₂O₃/MgF₂ (1.63/1.38) gives n_g ≈ 1.49 and works with BK7. Fresnel rhomb (BK7, 54.6°): each total internal reflection retards by δ = 2·arctan[cosθ·√(sin²θ − 1/n²)/sin²θ], 45.3° at 633 nm (n = 1.5151) and 90.6° for two; 92.1° at 400 nm (n = 1.5308) and 89.7° at 1064 nm (n = 1.5066), a departure from 90° of only −0.3° to +2.1° (at most about λ/170) across the band. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以掃描電子顯微鏡量線柵的週期、線寬與高度，用分光光度計加偏振片量 TM 穿透與 TE 反射光譜，確認短波端沒有繞射引起的穿透率突降；對 MacNeille 立方體以 s、p 偏振分別量穿透與反射對入射角的曲線，核對 Brewster 條件的角度寬度；對菱體以多波長 Sénarmont 量延遲量，驗證消色差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure wire-grid pitch, line width and height by scanning electron microscopy and record TM transmission and TE reflection spectra with a spectrophotometer and polarizer, confirming no diffraction-induced transmission drop at the short-wavelength end; for a MacNeille cube measure s and p transmission and reflection against incidence angle to check the angular width of the Brewster condition; measure the rhomb's retardance at several wavelengths by the Sénarmont method to verify achromaticity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 線柵：週期 120 nm、基板 n = 1.5 時，繞射級在 λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm 才出現，整個可見光安全。MacNeille：TiO₂/SiO₂（2.35/1.46）需 n_g = √(2×5.52×2.13/(5.52 + 2.13)) ≈ 1.75 的重火石玻璃；Al₂O₃/MgF₂（1.63/1.38）則 n_g ≈ 1.49，可用 BK7。Fresnel 菱體（BK7，54.6°）：每次全反射的延遲 δ = 2·arctan[cosθ·√(sin²θ − 1/n²)/sin²θ]，633 nm（n = 1.5151）為 45.3°，兩次 90.6°；400 nm（n = 1.5308）為 92.1°，1064 nm（n = 1.5066）為 89.7°，全波段偏離 90° 僅 −0.3° 到 +2.1°（最大約 λ/170）。
knowledge.textEn: Wire grid: with 120 nm pitch and substrate n = 1.5, diffracted orders appear only for λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm, so the whole visible band is safe. MacNeille: TiO₂/SiO₂ (2.35/1.46) needs n_g = √(2×5.52×2.13/(5.52 + 2.13)) ≈ 1.75, a dense flint glass, whereas Al₂O₃/MgF₂ (1.63/1.38) gives n_g ≈ 1.49 and works with BK7. Fresnel rhomb (BK7, 54.6°): each total internal reflection retards by δ = 2·arctan[cosθ·√(sin²θ − 1/n²)/sin²θ], 45.3° at 633 nm (n = 1.5151) and 90.6° for two; 92.1° at 400 nm (n = 1.5308) and 89.7° at 1064 nm (n = 1.5066), a departure from 90° of only −0.3° to +2.1° (at most about λ/170) across the band.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。
消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。
線柵：週期 120 nm、基板 n = 1.5 時，繞射級在 λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm 才出現，整個可見光安全。
optionsEn: Glass is isotropic, so clamping it any way produces no birefringence.
Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality.
Wire grid: with 120 nm pitch and substrate n = 1.5, diffracted orders appear only for λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm, so the whole visible band is safe.
quiz.explanation: 線柵：週期 120 nm、基板 n = 1.5 時，繞射級在 λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm 才出現，整個可見光安全。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wire grid: with 120 nm pitch and substrate n = 1.5, diffracted orders appear only for λ < 1.5×120 = 180 nm, so the whole visible band is safe. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以掃描電子顯微鏡量線柵的週期、線寬與高度，用分光光度計加偏振片量 TM 穿透與 TE 反射光譜，確認短波端沒有繞射引起的穿透率突降；對 MacNeille 立方體以 s、p 偏振分別量穿透與反射對入射角的曲線，核對 Brewster 條件的角度寬度；對菱體以多波長 Sénarmont 量延遲量，驗證消色差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure wire-grid pitch, line width and height by scanning electron microscopy and record TM transmission and TE reflection spectra with a spectrophotometer and polarizer, confirming no diffraction-induced transmission drop at the short-wavelength end; for a MacNeille cube measure s and p transmission and reflection against incidence angle to check the angular width of the Brewster condition; measure the rhomb's retardance at several wavelengths by the Sénarmont method to verify achromaticity. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把為 BK7 設計的 MacNeille 膜堆鍍在 n = 1.75 的玻璃上，Brewster 條件不再成立，p 偏振在每個界面都有反射，消光比從 10³ 掉到 30；線柵週期做到 200 nm，藍光端出現繞射級，穿透率在 450 nm 以下崩落。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A MacNeille stack designed for BK7 deposited on n = 1.75 glass no longer meets the Brewster condition, p polarization reflects at every interface and extinction falls from 10³ to 30; a wire grid made at 200 nm pitch diffracts at the blue end and transmission collapses below 450 nm.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以掃描電子顯微鏡量線柵的週期、線寬與高度，用分光光度計加偏振片量 TM 穿透與 TE 反射光譜，確認短波端沒有繞射引起的穿透率突降；對 MacNeille 立方體以 s、p 偏振分別量穿透與反射對入射角的曲線，核對 Brewster 條件的角度寬度；對菱體以多波長 Sénarmont 量延遲量，驗證消色差。
knowledge.textEn: Measure wire-grid pitch, line width and height by scanning electron microscopy and record TM transmission and TE reflection spectra with a spectrophotometer and polarizer, confirming no diffraction-induced transmission drop at the short-wavelength end; for a MacNeille cube measure s and p transmission and reflection against incidence angle to check the angular width of the Brewster condition; measure the rhomb's retardance at several wavelengths by the Sénarmont method to verify achromaticity.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders"?
options: 以掃描電子顯微鏡量線柵的週期、線寬與高度，用分光光度計加偏振片量 TM 穿透與 TE 反射光譜，確認短波端沒有繞射引起的穿透率突降。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要延遲量在設計波長正確，多級與零級波片的表現就一樣。
optionsEn: Measure wire-grid pitch, line width and height by scanning electron microscopy and record TM transmission and TE reflection spectra with a spectrophotometer and polarizer, confirming no diffraction-induced transmission drop at the short-wavelength end.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same.
quiz.explanation: 以掃描電子顯微鏡量線柵的週期、線寬與高度，用分光光度計加偏振片量 TM 穿透與 TE 反射光譜，確認短波端沒有繞射引起的穿透率突降；對 MacNeille 立方體以 s、p 偏振分別量穿透與反射對入射角的曲線，核對 Brewster 條件的角度寬度；對菱體以多波長 Sénarmont 量延遲量，驗證消色差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure wire-grid pitch, line width and height by scanning electron microscopy and record TM transmission and TE reflection spectra with a spectrophotometer and polarizer, confirming no diffraction-induced transmission drop at the short-wavelength end; for a MacNeille cube measure s and p transmission and reflection against incidence angle to check the angular width of the Brewster condition; measure the rhomb's retardance at several wavelengths by the Sénarmont method to verify achromaticity. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋁奈米線柵、MacNeille 膜堆與 Fresnel 菱體」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Aluminium nanowire grid, MacNeille stack and Fresnel rhomb” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把為 BK7 設計的 MacNeille 膜堆鍍在 n = 1.75 的玻璃上，Brewster 條件不再成立，p 偏振在每個界面都有反射，消光比從 10³ 掉到 30；線柵週期做到 200 nm，藍光端出現繞射級，穿透率在 450 nm 以下崩落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A MacNeille stack designed for BK7 deposited on n = 1.75 glass no longer meets the Brewster condition, p polarization reflects at every interface and extinction falls from 10³ to 30; a wire grid made at 200 nm pitch diffracts at the blue end and transmission collapses below 450 nm. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Fresnel 菱體用兩次全反射各產生約 45° 的相位差，延遲量只依賴折射率，幾乎不隨波長變化，是消色差的四分之一波延遲器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A Fresnel rhomb produces about 45° of phase difference at each of two total internal reflections; the retardance depends only on refractive index and hardly on wavelength, giving an achromatic quarter-wave retarder.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何高折射率／低折射率膜堆鍍在任何玻璃上都能當偏振分光器。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any high/low-index stack on any glass works as a polarizing beam splitter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把為 BK7 設計的 MacNeille 膜堆鍍在 n = 1.75 的玻璃上，Brewster 條件不再成立，p 偏振在每個界面都有反射，消光比從 10³ 掉到 30；線柵週期做到 200 nm，藍光端出現繞射級，穿透率在 450 nm 以下崩落。
knowledge.textEn: A MacNeille stack designed for BK7 deposited on n = 1.75 glass no longer meets the Brewster condition, p polarization reflects at every interface and extinction falls from 10³ to 30; a wire grid made at 200 nm pitch diffracts at the blue end and transmission collapses below 450 nm.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「線柵、薄膜偏振分光器與菱體延遲器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wire grids, thin-film polarizing splitters and rhomb retarders" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把為 BK7 設計的 MacNeille 膜堆鍍在 n = 1.75 的玻璃上，Brewster 條件不再成立，p 偏振在每個界面都有反射，消光比從 10³ 掉到 30。
延遲量量測只需要一個偏振片和一個功率計就夠精確。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A MacNeille stack designed for BK7 deposited on n = 1.75 glass no longer meets the Brewster condition, p polarization reflects at every interface and extinction falls from 10³ to 30.
A retardance measurement needs only one polarizer and a power meter to be accurate.
quiz.explanation: 把為 BK7 設計的 MacNeille 膜堆鍍在 n = 1.75 的玻璃上，Brewster 條件不再成立，p 偏振在每個界面都有反射，消光比從 10³ 掉到 30；線柵週期做到 200 nm，藍光端出現繞射級，穿透率在 450 nm 以下崩落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A MacNeille stack designed for BK7 deposited on n = 1.75 glass no longer meets the Brewster condition, p polarization reflects at every interface and extinction falls from 10³ to 30; a wire grid made at 200 nm pitch diffracts at the blue end and transmission collapses below 450 nm. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」與「波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction" and "Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 延遲量以 Sénarmont 法量測：待測片放在 45° 的線偏振光中，其後接一片精確的四分之一波片把橢圓偏振轉回線偏振，旋轉檢偏器到消光，檢偏器轉角的兩倍就是延遲量，量測精度由旋轉台的角度讀數與消光點的判定決定；更高精度與速度用光彈調制器或旋轉補償器的偏振儀。快軸方向以同樣的消光法標定，並刻在元件邊緣。消光比量測的瓶頸不是光學而是動態範圍：10⁶:1 需要偵測器在六個數量級內線性，實務上以鎖相放大、已校正的中性密度濾片分段量測，並把雜散光底限單獨量出扣除。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Retardance is measured by the Sénarmont method: the sample sits in linearly polarized light at 45°, an accurate quarter-wave plate behind it converts the elliptical output back to linear, the analyser is rotated to extinction, and twice the analyser angle is the retardance, with accuracy set by the stage's angular readout and the extinction judgement; higher accuracy and speed come from photoelastic-modulator or rotating-compensator polarimeters. The fast-axis direction is marked by the same extinction method and engraved on the edge. The bottleneck in extinction measurement is not optics but dynamic range: 10⁶:1 needs a detector linear over six decades, so in practice lock-in detection and calibrated neutral-density filters are used in stages, with the stray-light floor measured separately and subtracted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Sénarmont：檢偏器角度讀數不確定度 0.05° 給延遲量不確定度 0.1°，即 λ/3600；若四分之一波片本身偏 λ/300（1.2°），延遲量誤差以一階近似也約 λ/300，所以補償片的品質決定量測上限。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sénarmont: an analyser angular uncertainty of 0.05° gives a retardance uncertainty of 0.1°, i.e. λ/3600; if the quarter-wave compensator itself is off by λ/300 (1.2°), the retardance error is also about λ/300 to first order, so the compensator's quality caps the measurement.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲量量測只需要一個偏振片和一個功率計就夠精確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A retardance measurement needs only one polarizer and a power meter to be accurate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction" is correct?

波片的延遲量只與厚度有關，使用條件不會改變它。
延遲量以 Sénarmont 法量測：待測片放在 45° 的線偏振光中，其後接一片精確的四分之一波片把橢圓偏振轉回線偏振，旋轉檢偏器到消光，檢偏器轉角的兩倍就是延遲量，量測精度由旋轉台的角度讀數與消光點的判定決定。

A waveplate's retardance depends only on thickness and is unchanged by operating conditions.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Sénarmont：檢偏器角度讀數不確定度 0.05° 給延遲量不確定度 0.1°，即 λ/3600；若四分之一波片本身偏 λ/300（1.2°），延遲量誤差以一階近似也約 λ/300，所以補償片的品質決定量測上限。消光比：偵測器雜訊等效功率 1 pW、輸入 10 mW，可分辨的漏光 10⁻¹⁰，但雜散光若佔 10⁻⁶ 就把上限壓在 10⁶:1。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sénarmont: an analyser angular uncertainty of 0.05° gives a retardance uncertainty of 0.1°, i.e. λ/3600; if the quarter-wave compensator itself is off by λ/300 (1.2°), the retardance error is also about λ/300 to first order, so the compensator's quality caps the measurement. Extinction: a detector noise-equivalent power of 1 pW with 10 mW input resolves leakage of 10⁻¹⁰, but a stray-light floor of 10⁻⁶ limits the measurable ratio to 10⁶:1. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已校正的參考波片（延遲量不確定度 λ/1000）檢查 Sénarmont 系統的讀值偏差；旋轉待測片 180° 再量一次，兩次差值的一半是軸向標定誤差；在消光比量測中拿掉待測件量系統本身的漏光底限，並以中性密度濾片驗證偵測器線性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the Sénarmont system's bias against a calibrated reference plate with λ/1000 retardance uncertainty; rotate the sample by 180° and re-measure, half the difference being the axis-marking error; in extinction measurement remove the sample to measure the system's own leakage floor and verify detector linearity with neutral-density filters.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Sénarmont：檢偏器角度讀數不確定度 0.05° 給延遲量不確定度 0.1°，即 λ/3600；若四分之一波片本身偏 λ/300（1.2°），延遲量誤差以一階近似也約 λ/300，所以補償片的品質決定量測上限。消光比：偵測器雜訊等效功率 1 pW、輸入 10 mW，可分辨的漏光 10⁻¹⁰，但雜散光若佔 10⁻⁶ 就把上限壓在 10⁶:1。
knowledge.textEn: Sénarmont: an analyser angular uncertainty of 0.05° gives a retardance uncertainty of 0.1°, i.e. λ/3600; if the quarter-wave compensator itself is off by λ/300 (1.2°), the retardance error is also about λ/300 to first order, so the compensator's quality caps the measurement. Extinction: a detector noise-equivalent power of 1 pW with 10 mW input resolves leakage of 10⁻¹⁰, but a stray-light floor of 10⁻⁶ limits the measurable ratio to 10⁶:1.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction", which statement holds?
options: Sénarmont：檢偏器角度讀數不確定度 0.05° 給延遲量不確定度 0.1°，即 λ/3600。
偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。
只要延遲量在設計波長正確，多級與零級波片的表現就一樣。
optionsEn: Sénarmont: an analyser angular uncertainty of 0.05° gives a retardance uncertainty of 0.1°, i.e. λ/3600.
A polarization component nominally correct at its design wavelength translates directly into system isolation.
If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same.
quiz.explanation: Sénarmont：檢偏器角度讀數不確定度 0.05° 給延遲量不確定度 0.1°，即 λ/3600；若四分之一波片本身偏 λ/300（1.2°），延遲量誤差以一階近似也約 λ/300，所以補償片的品質決定量測上限。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Sénarmont: an analyser angular uncertainty of 0.05° gives a retardance uncertainty of 0.1°, i.e. λ/3600; if the quarter-wave compensator itself is off by λ/300 (1.2°), the retardance error is also about λ/300 to first order, so the compensator's quality caps the measurement. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已校正的參考波片（延遲量不確定度 λ/1000）檢查 Sénarmont 系統的讀值偏差；旋轉待測片 180° 再量一次，兩次差值的一半是軸向標定誤差；在消光比量測中拿掉待測件量系統本身的漏光底限，並以中性密度濾片驗證偵測器線性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the Sénarmont system's bias against a calibrated reference plate with λ/1000 retardance uncertainty; rotate the sample by 180° and re-measure, half the difference being the axis-marking error; in extinction measurement remove the sample to measure the system's own leakage floor and verify detector linearity with neutral-density filters. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用品質 λ/50 的四分之一波片當 Sénarmont 補償片，所有待測片的延遲量都帶著同一個系統偏差，整批交貨後在客戶端被判超差；消光比量測未擋雜散光，10⁶:1 的稜鏡只能量到 10⁴:1。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using a λ/50 quarter-wave plate as the Sénarmont compensator stamps the same systematic bias on every measured plate and the whole delivery is rejected by the customer; extinction measured without stray-light control reads a 10⁶:1 prism as only 10⁴:1.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已校正的參考波片（延遲量不確定度 λ/1000）檢查 Sénarmont 系統的讀值偏差；旋轉待測片 180° 再量一次，兩次差值的一半是軸向標定誤差；在消光比量測中拿掉待測件量系統本身的漏光底限，並以中性密度濾片驗證偵測器線性。
knowledge.textEn: Check the Sénarmont system's bias against a calibrated reference plate with λ/1000 retardance uncertainty; rotate the sample by 180° and re-measure, half the difference being the axis-marking error; in extinction measurement remove the sample to measure the system's own leakage floor and verify detector linearity with neutral-density filters.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以已校正的參考波片（延遲量不確定度 λ/1000）檢查 Sénarmont 系統的讀值偏差。
波片做到正確厚度就行了，光軸方向差一點沒關係。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check the Sénarmont system's bias against a calibrated reference plate with λ/1000 retardance uncertainty.
A waveplate only needs the right thickness; a slightly off optic axis does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以已校正的參考波片（延遲量不確定度 λ/1000）檢查 Sénarmont 系統的讀值偏差；旋轉待測片 180° 再量一次，兩次差值的一半是軸向標定誤差；在消光比量測中拿掉待測件量系統本身的漏光底限，並以中性密度濾片驗證偵測器線性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the Sénarmont system's bias against a calibrated reference plate with λ/1000 retardance uncertainty; rotate the sample by 180° and re-measure, half the difference being the axis-marking error; in extinction measurement remove the sample to measure the system's own leakage floor and verify detector linearity with neutral-density filters. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Sénarmont 補償器與六個數量級的偵測」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sénarmont compensator and six-decade detection” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用品質 λ/50 的四分之一波片當 Sénarmont 補償片，所有待測片的延遲量都帶著同一個系統偏差，整批交貨後在客戶端被判超差；消光比量測未擋雜散光，10⁶:1 的稜鏡只能量到 10⁴:1。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using a λ/50 quarter-wave plate as the Sénarmont compensator stamps the same systematic bias on every measured plate and the whole delivery is rejected by the customer; extinction measured without stray-light control reads a 10⁶:1 prism as only 10⁴:1. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：消光比量測的瓶頸不是光學而是動態範圍：10⁶:1 需要偵測器在六個數量級內線性，實務上以鎖相放大、已校正的中性密度濾片分段量測，並把雜散光底限單獨量出扣除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bottleneck in extinction measurement is not optics but dynamic range: 10⁶:1 needs a detector linear over six decades, so in practice lock-in detection and calibrated neutral-density filters are used in stages, with the stray-light floor measured separately and subtracted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「延遲量量測只需要一個偏振片和一個功率計就夠精確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A retardance measurement needs only one polarizer and a power meter to be accurate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用品質 λ/50 的四分之一波片當 Sénarmont 補償片，所有待測片的延遲量都帶著同一個系統偏差，整批交貨後在客戶端被判超差；消光比量測未擋雜散光，10⁶:1 的稜鏡只能量到 10⁴:1。
knowledge.textEn: Using a λ/50 quarter-wave plate as the Sénarmont compensator stamps the same systematic bias on every measured plate and the whole delivery is rejected by the customer; extinction measured without stray-light control reads a 10⁶:1 prism as only 10⁴:1.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「延遲量、軸向與消光比的量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measuring retardance, axis orientation and extinction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
波片的延遲量只與厚度有關，使用條件不會改變它。
用品質 λ/50 的四分之一波片當 Sénarmont 補償片，所有待測片的延遲量都帶著同一個系統偏差，整批交貨後在客戶端被判超差。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A waveplate's retardance depends only on thickness and is unchanged by operating conditions.
Using a λ/50 quarter-wave plate as the Sénarmont compensator stamps the same systematic bias on every measured plate and the whole delivery is rejected by the customer.
quiz.explanation: 用品質 λ/50 的四分之一波片當 Sénarmont 補償片，所有待測片的延遲量都帶著同一個系統偏差，整批交貨後在客戶端被判超差；消光比量測未擋雜散光，10⁶:1 的稜鏡只能量到 10⁴:1。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a λ/50 quarter-wave plate as the Sénarmont compensator stamps the same systematic bias on every measured plate and the whole delivery is rejected by the customer; extinction measured without stray-light control reads a 10⁶:1 prism as only 10⁴:1. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「延遲量誤差預算表」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Retardance error-budget table” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波片的延遲量誤差來自五個獨立來源：製造厚度誤差、工作波長偏離設計、溫度、入射角與安裝應力。入射角的影響與傾斜方向有關：繞慢軸傾斜使延遲量減少，繞快軸傾斜使延遲量增加，量級約為 sin²θ/(2n²) 的相對變化，且隨級數放大。把每一項換算成波數後以均方根相加，與規格比較，就能判斷該用零級、複合零級還是消色差設計，以及公差該往哪一項收緊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「延遲量誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Retardance error in a waveplate comes from five independent sources: manufacturing thickness error, working wavelength away from design, temperature, incidence angle and mounting stress. The angular effect depends on tilt direction: tilting about the slow axis reduces retardance, tilting about the fast axis increases it, with a relative change of order sin²θ/(2n²), amplified by the order. Converting each term to waves and adding root-sum-square against the specification shows whether a zero-order, compound zero-order or achromatic design is needed and which tolerance to tighten. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Retardance error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Incidence angle: at θ = 5° with n ≈ 1.55 the relative change ≈ 0.0076/4.8 ≈ 1.6×10⁻³, a zero-order quarter-wave plate shifting by 4×10⁻⁴ waves (λ/2500) and a 10th-order plate by 0.016 waves (λ/62).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波片的延遲量只與厚度有關，使用條件不會改變它。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A waveplate's retardance depends only on thickness and is unchanged by operating conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「延遲量誤差預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Retardance error-budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算
knowledge.titleEn: Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget
knowledge.text: 波片的延遲量誤差來自五個獨立來源：製造厚度誤差、工作波長偏離設計、溫度、入射角與安裝應力。入射角的影響與傾斜方向有關：繞慢軸傾斜使延遲量減少，繞快軸傾斜使延遲量增加，量級約為 sin²θ/(2n²) 的相對變化，且隨級數放大。
knowledge.textEn: Retardance error in a waveplate comes from five independent sources: manufacturing thickness error, working wavelength away from design, temperature, incidence angle and mounting stress. The angular effect depends on tilt direction: tilting about the slow axis reduces retardance, tilting about the fast axis increases it, with a relative change of order sin²θ/(2n²), amplified by the order.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：波片的延遲量只與厚度有關，使用條件不會改變它。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A waveplate's retardance depends only on thickness and is unchanged by operating conditions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget" is correct?
options: 波片的延遲量誤差來自五個獨立來源：製造厚度誤差、工作波長偏離設計、溫度、入射角與安裝應力。
波片的延遲量只與厚度有關，使用條件不會改變它。
玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。
optionsEn: Retardance error in a waveplate comes from five independent sources: manufacturing thickness error, working wavelength away from design, temperature, incidence angle and mounting stress.
A waveplate's retardance depends only on thickness and is unchanged by operating conditions.
Glass is isotropic, so clamping it any way produces no birefringence.
quiz.explanation: 波片的延遲量誤差來自五個獨立來源：製造厚度誤差、工作波長偏離設計、溫度、入射角與安裝應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Retardance error in a waveplate comes from five independent sources: manufacturing thickness error, working wavelength away from design, temperature, incidence angle and mounting stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲量誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Retardance error-budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：入射角：θ = 5°、n ≈ 1.55 時相對變化 ≈ 0.0076/4.8 ≈ 1.6×10⁻³，零級四分之一波片變化 4×10⁻⁴ 波（λ/2500），10 級則 0.016 波（λ/62）。零級波片預算（633 nm）：厚度 λ/300 = 3.3×10⁻³ 波、波長 ±0.5 nm → 2×10⁻⁴、溫度 ±5 K → 1.2×10⁻⁴、入射角 ±2° → 6×10⁻⁵、安裝應力 λ/1000 = 1×10⁻³，RSS ≈ √(3.3² + 0.2² + 0.12² + 0.06² + 1²)×10⁻³ ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ 波 ≈ λ/290。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Incidence angle: at θ = 5° with n ≈ 1.55 the relative change ≈ 0.0076/4.8 ≈ 1.6×10⁻³, a zero-order quarter-wave plate shifting by 4×10⁻⁴ waves (λ/2500) and a 10th-order plate by 0.016 waves (λ/62). Zero-order plate budget at 633 nm: thickness λ/300 = 3.3×10⁻³ waves, wavelength ±0.5 nm → 2×10⁻⁴, temperature ±5 K → 1.2×10⁻⁴, incidence ±2° → 6×10⁻⁵, mounting stress λ/1000 = 1×10⁻³, RSS ≈ √(3.3² + 0.2² + 0.12² + 0.06² + 1²)×10⁻³ ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ waves ≈ λ/290. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把波片裝在雙軸旋轉台上，分別繞快軸與慢軸傾斜 ±5° 量延遲量，確認符號相反且量級與 sin²θ/(2n²) 估計一致；用實測的厚度、溫度與角度分佈重算 RSS，與量到的批內延遲量分佈比較，若實測更寬就逐項追查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount the plate on a two-axis stage and tilt ±5° about the fast and slow axes in turn, confirming opposite signs and magnitudes matching the sin²θ/(2n²) estimate; recompute the RSS from measured thickness, temperature and angle distributions and compare with the measured batch spread of retardance, tracing term by term if the real spread is wider.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Incidence angle: at θ = 5° with n ≈ 1.55 the relative change ≈ 0.0076/4.8 ≈ 1.6×10⁻³, a zero-order quarter-wave plate shifting by 4×10⁻⁴ waves (λ/2500) and a 10th-order plate by 0.016 waves (λ/62). Zero-order plate budget at 633 nm: thickness λ/300 = 3.3×10⁻³ waves, wavelength ±0.5 nm → 2×10⁻⁴, temperature ±5 K → 1.2×10⁻⁴, incidence ±2° → 6×10⁻⁵, mounting stress λ/1000 = 1×10⁻³, RSS ≈ √(3.3² + 0.2² + 0.12² + 0.06² + 1²)×10⁻³ ≈ 3.5×10⁻³ waves ≈ λ/290.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget", which statement holds?
options: 消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。
波片做到正確厚度就行了，光軸方向差一點沒關係。
optionsEn: Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality.
Incidence angle: at θ = 5° with n ≈ 1.55 the relative change ≈ 0.0076/4.8 ≈ 1.6×10⁻³, a zero-order quarter-wave plate shifting by 4×10⁻⁴ waves (λ/2500) and a 10th-order plate by 0.016 waves (λ/62).
A waveplate only needs the right thickness; a slightly off optic axis does not matter.
quiz.explanationEn: Incidence angle: at θ = 5° with n ≈ 1.55 the relative change ≈ 0.0076/4.8 ≈ 1.6×10⁻³, a zero-order quarter-wave plate shifting by 4×10⁻⁴ waves (λ/2500) and a 10th-order plate by 0.016 waves (λ/62). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「延遲量誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Retardance error-budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把波片裝在雙軸旋轉台上，分別繞快軸與慢軸傾斜 ±5° 量延遲量，確認符號相反且量級與 sin²θ/(2n²) 估計一致；用實測的厚度、溫度與角度分佈重算 RSS，與量到的批內延遲量分佈比較，若實測更寬就逐項追查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount the plate on a two-axis stage and tilt ±5° about the fast and slow axes in turn, confirming opposite signs and magnitudes matching the sin²θ/(2n²) estimate; recompute the RSS from measured thickness, temperature and angle distributions and compare with the measured batch spread of retardance, tracing term by term if the real spread is wider. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在 f/2 的會聚光束裡使用 10 級波片，光束邊緣光線傾斜 14°，延遲量在口徑內變化超過 λ/10，輸出偏振態隨位置不同，偏振成像對比大幅下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 10th-order plate used in an f/2 converging beam sees edge rays tilted 14°, retardance varies by more than λ/10 across the aperture, the output polarization changes with position and polarization-imaging contrast collapses.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把波片裝在雙軸旋轉台上，分別繞快軸與慢軸傾斜 ±5° 量延遲量，確認符號相反且量級與 sin²θ/(2n²) 估計一致；用實測的厚度、溫度與角度分佈重算 RSS，與量到的批內延遲量分佈比較，若實測更寬就逐項追查。
knowledge.textEn: Mount the plate on a two-axis stage and tilt ±5° about the fast and slow axes in turn, confirming opposite signs and magnitudes matching the sin²θ/(2n²) estimate; recompute the RSS from measured thickness, temperature and angle distributions and compare with the measured batch spread of retardance, tracing term by term if the real spread is wider.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
任何高折射率／低折射率膜堆鍍在任何玻璃上都能當偏振分光器。
把波片裝在雙軸旋轉台上，分別繞快軸與慢軸傾斜 ±5° 量延遲量，確認符號相反且量級與 sin²θ/(2n²) 估計一致。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Any high/low-index stack on any glass works as a polarizing beam splitter.
Mount the plate on a two-axis stage and tilt ±5° about the fast and slow axes in turn, confirming opposite signs and magnitudes matching the sin²θ/(2n²) estimate.
quiz.explanation: 把波片裝在雙軸旋轉台上，分別繞快軸與慢軸傾斜 ±5° 量延遲量，確認符號相反且量級與 sin²θ/(2n²) 估計一致；用實測的厚度、溫度與角度分佈重算 RSS，與量到的批內延遲量分佈比較，若實測更寬就逐項追查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount the plate on a two-axis stage and tilt ±5° about the fast and slow axes in turn, confirming opposite signs and magnitudes matching the sin²θ/(2n²) estimate; recompute the RSS from measured thickness, temperature and angle distributions and compare with the measured batch spread of retardance, tracing term by term if the real spread is wider. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延遲量誤差預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Retardance error-budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在 f/2 的會聚光束裡使用 10 級波片，光束邊緣光線傾斜 14°，延遲量在口徑內變化超過 λ/10，輸出偏振態隨位置不同，偏振成像對比大幅下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 10th-order plate used in an f/2 converging beam sees edge rays tilted 14°, retardance varies by more than λ/10 across the aperture, the output polarization changes with position and polarization-imaging contrast collapses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把每一項換算成波數後以均方根相加，與規格比較，就能判斷該用零級、複合零級還是消色差設計，以及公差該往哪一項收緊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Converting each term to waves and adding root-sum-square against the specification shows whether a zero-order, compound zero-order or achromatic design is needed and which tolerance to tighten.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波片的延遲量只與厚度有關，使用條件不會改變它。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A waveplate's retardance depends only on thickness and is unchanged by operating conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在 f/2 的會聚光束裡使用 10 級波片，光束邊緣光線傾斜 14°，延遲量在口徑內變化超過 λ/10，輸出偏振態隨位置不同，偏振成像對比大幅下降。

quiz.question: 在「波長、溫度、入射角與公差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wavelength, temperature, incidence angle and tolerance budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在 f/2 的會聚光束裡使用 10 級波片，光束邊緣光線傾斜 14°，延遲量在口徑內變化超過 λ/10，輸出偏振態隨位置不同，偏振成像對比大幅下降。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。
optionsEn: A 10th-order plate used in an f/2 converging beam sees edge rays tilted 14°, retardance varies by more than λ/10 across the aperture, the output polarization changes with position and polarization-imaging contrast collapses.

quiz.explanationEn: A 10th-order plate used in an f/2 converging beam sees edge rays tilted 14°, retardance varies by more than λ/10 across the aperture, the output polarization changes with position and polarization-imaging contrast collapses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合」與「規格換算、隔離度預算與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration" and "Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stress-free mount and cemented interface” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 任何偏振元件在安裝時受到的機械應力都會透過光彈效應產生附加雙折射，使偏振片的消光比下降、波片的延遲量偏移，而且分佈不均勻。玻璃與熔融石英的應力光學係數約 3 到 4×10⁻¹² /Pa，看似很小，但光程只要幾毫米、應力只要 1 MPa 就能造成數十奈米的延遲。因此元件用三點或撓性無應力座固定，避免彈簧壓片與過緊的螺紋環；膠合界面要選低收縮的光學膠並控制固化，雷射功率高時改用空氣間隙或光學接觸。增透膜必須針對晶體的兩個折射率設計，並把快軸刻記與安裝基準對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Any mechanical stress applied to a polarization element during mounting adds birefringence through the photoelastic effect, lowering a polarizer's extinction and shifting a waveplate's retardance, non-uniformly across the aperture. The stress-optic coefficient of glass and fused silica is only about 3 to 4×10⁻¹² /Pa, yet a path of a few millimetres under 1 MPa produces tens of nanometres of retardance. Elements are therefore held in three-point or flexure stress-free mounts rather than spring retainers or over-tightened threaded rings; cemented interfaces use low-shrinkage optical cement with controlled curing, and air spacing or optical contact replaces cement at high laser power. Antireflection films must be designed for the crystal's two indices, and the fast-axis mark aligned to the mounting datum. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stress-free mount and cemented interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：應力雙折射 Δn = C·σ：C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa、σ = 1 MPa 時 Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶，光程 L = 5 mm 的延遲 = Δn·L = 17.5 nm，在 633 nm 為 0.028 波 ≈ λ/36，比製造公差 λ/300 大八倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stress birefringence Δn = C·σ: with C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa and σ = 1 MPa, Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶, and over a path L = 5 mm the retardance = Δn·L = 17.5 nm, 0.028 waves ≈ λ/36 at 633 nm, eight times the λ/300 manufacturing tolerance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Glass is isotropic, so clamping it any way produces no birefringence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Stress-free mount and cemented interface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
