knowledge.titleEn: Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration
knowledge.text: 任何偏振元件在安裝時受到的機械應力都會透過光彈效應產生附加雙折射，使偏振片的消光比下降、波片的延遲量偏移，而且分佈不均勻。玻璃與熔融石英的應力光學係數約 3 到 4×10⁻¹² /Pa，看似很小，但光程只要幾毫米、應力只要 1 MPa 就能造成數十奈米的延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Any mechanical stress applied to a polarization element during mounting adds birefringence through the photoelastic effect, lowering a polarizer's extinction and shifting a waveplate's retardance, non-uniformly across the aperture. The stress-optic coefficient of glass and fused silica is only about 3 to 4×10⁻¹² /Pa, yet a path of a few millimetres under 1 MPa produces tens of nanometres of retardance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Glass is isotropic, so clamping it any way produces no birefringence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration" is correct?
options: 玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。
任何偏振元件在安裝時受到的機械應力都會透過光彈效應產生附加雙折射，使偏振片的消光比下降、波片的延遲量偏移，而且分佈不均勻。
偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。
optionsEn: Glass is isotropic, so clamping it any way produces no birefringence.

Any mechanical stress applied to a polarization element during mounting adds birefringence through the photoelastic effect, lowering a polarizer's extinction and shifting a waveplate's retardance, non-uniformly across the aperture.
A polarization component nominally correct at its design wavelength translates directly into system isolation.
quiz.explanation: 任何偏振元件在安裝時受到的機械應力都會透過光彈效應產生附加雙折射，使偏振片的消光比下降、波片的延遲量偏移，而且分佈不均勻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Any mechanical stress applied to a polarization element during mounting adds birefringence through the photoelastic effect, lowering a polarizer's extinction and shifting a waveplate's retardance, non-uniformly across the aperture. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stress-free mount and cemented interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：應力雙折射 Δn = C·σ：C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa、σ = 1 MPa 時 Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶，光程 L = 5 mm 的延遲 = Δn·L = 17.5 nm，在 633 nm 為 0.028 波 ≈ λ/36，比製造公差 λ/300 大八倍。要把安裝貢獻壓到 λ/1000（0.63 nm），應力必須低於 1 MPa × 0.63/17.5 ≈ 36 kPa，相當於 10 mm 直徑元件上不到 3 N 的均勻夾持力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stress birefringence Δn = C·σ: with C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa and σ = 1 MPa, Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶, and over a path L = 5 mm the retardance = Δn·L = 17.5 nm, 0.028 waves ≈ λ/36 at 633 nm, eight times the λ/300 manufacturing tolerance. Holding the mounting contribution to λ/1000 (0.63 nm) requires stress below 1 MPa × 0.63/17.5 ≈ 36 kPa, under 3 N of uniform clamping force on a 10 mm diameter element. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前後各做一次全口徑延遲量成像（偏光顯微鏡或成像偏振儀），相減得到安裝引入的延遲圖與其方向，逐步放鬆固定力直到殘留小於 λ/1000；膠合件固化後放置一週再量一次，確認收縮應力已穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image full-aperture retardance before and after mounting with a polarizing microscope or imaging polarimeter, subtract to obtain the mounting-induced retardance map and its orientation, and loosen the holding force until the residual is below λ/1000; re-measure cemented parts a week after curing to confirm shrinkage stress has stabilised.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 應力雙折射 Δn = C·σ：C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa、σ = 1 MPa 時 Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶，光程 L = 5 mm 的延遲 = Δn·L = 17.5 nm，在 633 nm 為 0.028 波 ≈ λ/36，比製造公差 λ/300 大八倍。要把安裝貢獻壓到 λ/1000（0.63 nm），應力必須低於 1 MPa × 0.63/17.5 ≈ 36 kPa，相當於 10 mm 直徑元件上不到 3 N 的均勻夾持力。
knowledge.textEn: Stress birefringence Δn = C·σ: with C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa and σ = 1 MPa, Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶, and over a path L = 5 mm the retardance = Δn·L = 17.5 nm, 0.028 waves ≈ λ/36 at 633 nm, eight times the λ/300 manufacturing tolerance. Holding the mounting contribution to λ/1000 (0.63 nm) requires stress below 1 MPa × 0.63/17.5 ≈ 36 kPa, under 3 N of uniform clamping force on a 10 mm diameter element.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration", which statement holds?
options: 只要延遲量在設計波長正確，多級與零級波片的表現就一樣。
任何高折射率／低折射率膜堆鍍在任何玻璃上都能當偏振分光器。
應力雙折射 Δn = C·σ：C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa、σ = 1 MPa 時 Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶，光程 L = 5 mm 的延遲 = Δn·L = 17.5 nm，在 633 nm 為 0.028 波 ≈ λ/36，比製造公差 λ/300 大八倍。
optionsEn: If retardance is right at the design wavelength, multi-order and zero-order plates behave the same.
Any high/low-index stack on any glass works as a polarizing beam splitter.

Stress birefringence Δn = C·σ: with C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa and σ = 1 MPa, Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶, and over a path L = 5 mm the retardance = Δn·L = 17.5 nm, 0.028 waves ≈ λ/36 at 633 nm, eight times the λ/300 manufacturing tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 應力雙折射 Δn = C·σ：C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa、σ = 1 MPa 時 Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶，光程 L = 5 mm 的延遲 = Δn·L = 17.5 nm，在 633 nm 為 0.028 波 ≈ λ/36，比製造公差 λ/300 大八倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stress birefringence Δn = C·σ: with C = 3.5×10⁻¹² /Pa and σ = 1 MPa, Δn = 3.5×10⁻⁶, and over a path L = 5 mm the retardance = Δn·L = 17.5 nm, 0.028 waves ≈ λ/36 at 633 nm, eight times the λ/300 manufacturing tolerance. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Stress-free mount and cemented interface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 安裝前後各做一次全口徑延遲量成像（偏光顯微鏡或成像偏振儀），相減得到安裝引入的延遲圖與其方向，逐步放鬆固定力直到殘留小於 λ/1000；膠合件固化後放置一週再量一次，確認收縮應力已穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image full-aperture retardance before and after mounting with a polarizing microscope or imaging polarimeter, subtract to obtain the mounting-induced retardance map and its orientation, and loosen the holding force until the residual is below λ/1000; re-measure cemented parts a week after curing to confirm shrinkage stress has stabilised. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：Glan 稜鏡以螺紋環鎖緊，應力雙折射讓消光比從 10⁵ 掉到 10³ 且隨溫度變化；UV 膠固化不均使複合零級波片中央與邊緣延遲量差 λ/50，偏振態在口徑內不一致。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A Glan prism locked by a threaded ring loses extinction from 10⁵ to 10³ through stress birefringence that also drifts with temperature; unevenly cured UV cement leaves a λ/50 retardance difference between centre and edge of a compound zero-order plate, so polarization varies across the aperture.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝前後各做一次全口徑延遲量成像（偏光顯微鏡或成像偏振儀），相減得到安裝引入的延遲圖與其方向，逐步放鬆固定力直到殘留小於 λ/1000；膠合件固化後放置一週再量一次，確認收縮應力已穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Image full-aperture retardance before and after mounting with a polarizing microscope or imaging polarimeter, subtract to obtain the mounting-induced retardance map and its orientation, and loosen the holding force until the residual is below λ/1000; re-measure cemented parts a week after curing to confirm shrinkage stress has stabilised.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration"?
options: 安裝前後各做一次全口徑延遲量成像（偏光顯微鏡或成像偏振儀），相減得到安裝引入的延遲圖與其方向，逐步放鬆固定力直到殘留小於 λ/1000。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
延遲量量測只需要一個偏振片和一個功率計就夠精確。
optionsEn: Image full-aperture retardance before and after mounting with a polarizing microscope or imaging polarimeter, subtract to obtain the mounting-induced retardance map and its orientation, and loosen the holding force until the residual is below λ/1000.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A retardance measurement needs only one polarizer and a power meter to be accurate.
quiz.explanation: 安裝前後各做一次全口徑延遲量成像（偏光顯微鏡或成像偏振儀），相減得到安裝引入的延遲圖與其方向，逐步放鬆固定力直到殘留小於 λ/1000；膠合件固化後放置一週再量一次，確認收縮應力已穩定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Image full-aperture retardance before and after mounting with a polarizing microscope or imaging polarimeter, subtract to obtain the mounting-induced retardance map and its orientation, and loosen the holding force until the residual is below λ/1000; re-measure cemented parts a week after curing to confirm shrinkage stress has stabilised. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「無應力安裝座與膠合界面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Stress-free mount and cemented interface” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: Glan 稜鏡以螺紋環鎖緊，應力雙折射讓消光比從 10⁵ 掉到 10³ 且隨溫度變化；UV 膠固化不均使複合零級波片中央與邊緣延遲量差 λ/50，偏振態在口徑內不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A Glan prism locked by a threaded ring loses extinction from 10⁵ to 10³ through stress birefringence that also drifts with temperature; unevenly cured UV cement leaves a λ/50 retardance difference between centre and edge of a compound zero-order plate, so polarization varies across the aperture. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：增透膜必須針對晶體的兩個折射率設計，並把快軸刻記與安裝基準對齊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Antireflection films must be designed for the crystal's two indices, and the fast-axis mark aligned to the mounting datum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃是各向同性的，安裝時怎麼夾都不會產生雙折射。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Glass is isotropic, so clamping it any way produces no birefringence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: Glan 稜鏡以螺紋環鎖緊，應力雙折射讓消光比從 10⁵ 掉到 10³ 且隨溫度變化；UV 膠固化不均使複合零級波片中央與邊緣延遲量差 λ/50，偏振態在口徑內不一致。
knowledge.textEn: A Glan prism locked by a threaded ring loses extinction from 10⁵ to 10³ through stress birefringence that also drifts with temperature; unevenly cured UV cement leaves a λ/50 retardance difference between centre and edge of a compound zero-order plate, so polarization varies across the aperture.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「應力雙折射、膠合與安裝整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stress birefringence, cementing and mounting integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
Glan 稜鏡以螺紋環鎖緊，應力雙折射讓消光比從 10⁵ 掉到 10³ 且隨溫度變化。
偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A Glan prism locked by a threaded ring loses extinction from 10⁵ to 10³ through stress birefringence that also drifts with temperature.
A polarization component nominally correct at its design wavelength translates directly into system isolation.
quiz.explanation: Glan 稜鏡以螺紋環鎖緊，應力雙折射讓消光比從 10⁵ 掉到 10³ 且隨溫度變化；UV 膠固化不均使複合零級波片中央與邊緣延遲量差 λ/50，偏振態在口徑內不一致。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A Glan prism locked by a threaded ring loses extinction from 10⁵ to 10³ through stress birefringence that also drifts with temperature; unevenly cured UV cement leaves a λ/50 retardance difference between centre and edge of a compound zero-order plate, so polarization varies across the aperture. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 規格換算、隔離度預算與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」如何決定偏振光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget” determines the key performance of “Polarization-optics fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 偏振元件的規格表應列出：延遲量與公差（指定波長與溫度）、快軸標記精度、消光比（指定波長、入射角、光束發散）、穿透波前、表面品質、增透膜殘餘反射、損傷門檻、工作溫度範圍與安裝方式限制。系統端把這些數值換算成系統指標，例如 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度由偏振片消光比與 45° 旋轉角誤差共同決定，兩項漏光相加後取分貝。交接資料包含晶體批次與定向紀錄、延遲量與軸向量測報告、消光比曲線與量測條件，讓系統整合者能重現驗收結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A polarization-component specification should list retardance and tolerance (at stated wavelength and temperature), fast-axis marking accuracy, extinction ratio (at stated wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence), transmitted wavefront, surface quality, antireflection residual, damage threshold, operating temperature range and mounting limits. The system side converts these into system metrics; for instance a Faraday isolator's isolation is set jointly by polarizer extinction and the error in the 45° rotation angle, the two leakages adding before conversion to decibels. The handoff carries the crystal batch and orientation record, retardance and axis measurement reports and the extinction curve with its conditions, so the integrator can reproduce the acceptance result. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：隔離度 ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Isolation ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A polarization component nominally correct at its design wavelength translates directly into system isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 規格換算、隔離度預算與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff
knowledge.text: 偏振元件的規格表應列出：延遲量與公差（指定波長與溫度）、快軸標記精度、消光比（指定波長、入射角、光束發散）、穿透波前、表面品質、增透膜殘餘反射、損傷門檻、工作溫度範圍與安裝方式限制。系統端把這些數值換算成系統指標，例如 Faraday 隔離器的隔離度由偏振片消光比與 45° 旋轉角誤差共同決定，兩項漏光相加後取分貝。
knowledge.textEn: A polarization-component specification should list retardance and tolerance (at stated wavelength and temperature), fast-axis marking accuracy, extinction ratio (at stated wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence), transmitted wavefront, surface quality, antireflection residual, damage threshold, operating temperature range and mounting limits. The system side converts these into system metrics; for instance a Faraday isolator's isolation is set jointly by polarizer extinction and the error in the 45° rotation angle, the two leakages adding before conversion to decibels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A polarization component nominally correct at its design wavelength translates directly into system isolation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「規格換算、隔離度預算與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff" is correct?
options: 偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。
消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。
偏振元件的規格表應列出：延遲量與公差（指定波長與溫度）、快軸標記精度、消光比（指定波長、入射角、光束發散）、穿透波前、表面品質、增透膜殘餘反射、損傷門檻、工作溫度範圍與安裝方式限制。
optionsEn: A polarization component nominally correct at its design wavelength translates directly into system isolation.
Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality.

A polarization-component specification should list retardance and tolerance (at stated wavelength and temperature), fast-axis marking accuracy, extinction ratio (at stated wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence), transmitted wavefront, surface quality, antireflection residual, damage threshold, operating temperature range and mounting limits.
quiz.explanation: 偏振元件的規格表應列出：延遲量與公差（指定波長與溫度）、快軸標記精度、消光比（指定波長、入射角、光束發散）、穿透波前、表面品質、增透膜殘餘反射、損傷門檻、工作溫度範圍與安裝方式限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A polarization-component specification should list retardance and tolerance (at stated wavelength and temperature), fast-axis marking accuracy, extinction ratio (at stated wavelength, incidence angle and beam divergence), transmitted wavefront, surface quality, antireflection residual, damage threshold, operating temperature range and mounting limits. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 規格換算、隔離度預算與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：隔離度 ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ)。ER = 10⁴、旋轉角誤差 Δφ = 0.5°：漏光 10⁻⁴ + 7.6×10⁻⁵ = 1.76×10⁻⁴ → 37.5 dB，不達 40 dB；ER = 10⁵、Δφ = 0.5°：8.6×10⁻⁵ → 40.6 dB 勉強合格；ER = 10⁵、Δφ = 0.3°：3.7×10⁻⁵ → 44.3 dB，留有餘裕。所以 40 dB 的隔離器需要 10⁵:1 的偏振片與 0.3° 的旋轉角控制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Isolation ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ). With ER = 10⁴ and a rotation error Δφ = 0.5°: leakage 10⁻⁴ + 7.6×10⁻⁵ = 1.76×10⁻⁴ → 37.5 dB, short of 40 dB; ER = 10⁵ and Δφ = 0.5°: 8.6×10⁻⁵ → 40.6 dB, marginal; ER = 10⁵ and Δφ = 0.3°: 3.7×10⁻⁵ → 44.3 dB with margin. A 40 dB isolator therefore needs 10⁵:1 polarizers and 0.3° rotation control. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：組裝後直接量隔離度（反向注入功率與穿透功率之比），與偏振片消光比和旋轉角誤差的預算相比較，差異超過 2 dB 時回頭檢查應力與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（波長、溫度、角度），並以第二套偏振儀抽樣複測延遲量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After assembly measure isolation directly as the ratio of reverse-injected to transmitted power and compare with the budget from polarizer extinction and rotation error; a discrepancy above 2 dB sends you back to stress and alignment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 隔離度 ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ)。ER = 10⁴、旋轉角誤差 Δφ = 0.5°：漏光 10⁻⁴ + 7.6×10⁻⁵ = 1.76×10⁻⁴ → 37.5 dB，不達 40 dB；ER = 10⁵、Δφ = 0.5°：8.6×10⁻⁵ → 40.6 dB 勉強合格；ER = 10⁵、Δφ = 0.3°：3.7×10⁻⁵ → 44.3 dB，留有餘裕。所以 40 dB 的隔離器需要 10⁵:1 的偏振片與 0.3° 的旋轉角控制。
knowledge.textEn: Isolation ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ). With ER = 10⁴ and a rotation error Δφ = 0.5°: leakage 10⁻⁴ + 7.6×10⁻⁵ = 1.76×10⁻⁴ → 37.5 dB, short of 40 dB; ER = 10⁵ and Δφ = 0.5°: 8.6×10⁻⁵ → 40.6 dB, marginal; ER = 10⁵ and Δφ = 0.3°: 3.7×10⁻⁵ → 44.3 dB with margin. A 40 dB isolator therefore needs 10⁵:1 polarizers and 0.3° rotation control.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「規格換算、隔離度預算與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 隔離度 ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ)。
波片做到正確厚度就行了，光軸方向差一點沒關係。
延遲量量測只需要一個偏振片和一個功率計就夠精確。
optionsEn: Isolation ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ).
A waveplate only needs the right thickness; a slightly off optic axis does not matter.
A retardance measurement needs only one polarizer and a power meter to be accurate.
quiz.explanation: 隔離度 ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolation ≈ −10·log₁₀(1/ER + sin²Δφ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 規格換算、隔離度預算與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 組裝後直接量隔離度（反向注入功率與穿透功率之比），與偏振片消光比和旋轉角誤差的預算相比較，差異超過 2 dB 時回頭檢查應力與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（波長、溫度、角度），並以第二套偏振儀抽樣複測延遲量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After assembly measure isolation directly as the ratio of reverse-injected to transmitted power and compare with the budget from polarizer extinction and rotation error; a discrepancy above 2 dB sends you back to stress and alignment. Check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (wavelength, temperature, angle), and re-measure sampled retardances on a second polarimeter. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格只寫「四分之一波片，633 nm」而沒有公差、級數與溫度範圍，供應商交付 10 級波片，在 40 °C 的機櫃內延遲量偏 λ/60，隔離器隔離度掉到 30 dB，雙方對「合格」各執一詞。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A specification reading only quarter-wave plate, 633 nm without tolerance, order or temperature range is met with a 10th-order plate; inside a 40 °C enclosure its retardance drifts by λ/60, isolation drops to 30 dB and both sides dispute what passed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 組裝後直接量隔離度（反向注入功率與穿透功率之比），與偏振片消光比和旋轉角誤差的預算相比較，差異超過 2 dB 時回頭檢查應力與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（波長、溫度、角度），並以第二套偏振儀抽樣複測延遲量。
knowledge.textEn: After assembly measure isolation directly as the ratio of reverse-injected to transmitted power and compare with the budget from polarizer extinction and rotation error; a discrepancy above 2 dB sends you back to stress and alignment. Check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (wavelength, temperature, angle), and re-measure sampled retardances on a second polarimeter.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規格換算、隔離度預算與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
組裝後直接量隔離度（反向注入功率與穿透功率之比），與偏振片消光比和旋轉角誤差的預算相比較，差異超過 2 dB 時回頭檢查應力與對準。
波片的延遲量只與厚度有關，使用條件不會改變它。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
After assembly measure isolation directly as the ratio of reverse-injected to transmitted power and compare with the budget from polarizer extinction and rotation error.
A waveplate's retardance depends only on thickness and is unchanged by operating conditions.
quiz.explanation: 組裝後直接量隔離度（反向注入功率與穿透功率之比），與偏振片消光比和旋轉角誤差的預算相比較，差異超過 2 dB 時回頭檢查應力與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（波長、溫度、角度），並以第二套偏振儀抽樣複測延遲量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After assembly measure isolation directly as the ratio of reverse-injected to transmitted power and compare with the budget from polarizer extinction and rotation error; a discrepancy above 2 dB sends you back to stress and alignment. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 規格換算、隔離度預算與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏振元件規格表與隔離度預算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Polarization-component specification sheet and isolation budget” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格只寫「四分之一波片，633 nm」而沒有公差、級數與溫度範圍，供應商交付 10 級波片，在 40 °C 的機櫃內延遲量偏 λ/60，隔離器隔離度掉到 30 dB，雙方對「合格」各執一詞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A specification reading only quarter-wave plate, 633 nm without tolerance, order or temperature range is met with a 10th-order plate; inside a 40 °C enclosure its retardance drifts by λ/60, isolation drops to 30 dB and both sides dispute what passed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料包含晶體批次與定向紀錄、延遲量與軸向量測報告、消光比曲線與量測條件，讓系統整合者能重現驗收結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff carries the crystal batch and orientation record, retardance and axis measurement reports and the extinction curve with its conditions, so the integrator can reproduce the acceptance result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「偏振元件只要在設計波長標稱正確，就能直接換算成系統的隔離度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A polarization component nominally correct at its design wavelength translates directly into system isolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 規格只寫「四分之一波片，633 nm」而沒有公差、級數與溫度範圍，供應商交付 10 級波片，在 40 °C 的機櫃內延遲量偏 λ/60，隔離器隔離度掉到 30 dB，雙方對「合格」各執一詞。
knowledge.textEn: A specification reading only quarter-wave plate, 633 nm without tolerance, order or temperature range is met with a 10th-order plate; inside a 40 °C enclosure its retardance drifts by λ/60, isolation drops to 30 dB and both sides dispute what passed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「規格換算、隔離度預算與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specification conversion, isolation budget and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
消光比是偏振片的固定常數，與波長、角度和光束品質無關。
規格只寫「四分之一波片，633 nm」而沒有公差、級數與溫度範圍，供應商交付 10 級波片，在 40 °C 的機櫃內延遲量偏 λ/60，隔離器隔離度掉到 30 dB，雙方對「合格」各執一詞。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Extinction ratio is a fixed constant of the polarizer independent of wavelength, angle and beam quality.
A specification reading only quarter-wave plate, 633 nm without tolerance, order or temperature range is met with a 10th-order plate.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 繞射光學元件製作
summary: 本課從 2π 相位摺疊與 M 階量化的 sinc² 效率出發，說明設計波長失諧與深度誤差如何把能量漏到零級與高階，再走過二元微影的光罩數與最小線寬、反應離子蝕刻與灰階直寫、奈米壓印複製，用輪廓儀與零級洩漏量測建立效率誤差預算，最後以混合折射繞射消色差透鏡的整合與規格交接收尾。
summaryEn: Starting from 2π phase wrapping and the sinc² efficiency of M-level quantisation, the course shows how design-wavelength detuning and depth error leak energy into the zero and higher orders, walks through mask count and minimum feature in binary lithography, reactive-ion etching, grayscale direct writing and nanoimprint replication, builds an efficiency error budget from profilometry and zero-order leakage measurement, and closes with hybrid refractive-diffractive achromat integration and specification handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 8 階繞射透鏡製作練習：熔融石英（n = 1.457）、λ₀ = 633 nm、f = 50 mm、D = 10 mm。閃耀深度 d = 633/0.457 ≈ 1385 nm，8 階的階高 ≈ 173 nm，三道光罩蝕刻 693、346、173 nm；NA ≈ 0.1，最外環帶週期 λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm，環帶數 r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395，最細線寬 ≈ 0.8 µm。效率預算：量化 sinc²(1/8) = 0.950；蝕刻速率 100 nm/min、終點偵測後階高誤差 2 nm（ε ≈ 0.15%，因子 ≈ 1.000）；第三道光罩套準 0.1 µm 的純量模型因子 0.907/0.950 ≈ 0.954；階面粗糙度與側壁 0.98；雙面增透膜後 Fresnel 因子 0.994；預測 η₁ ≈ 0.950 × 1.000 × 0.954 × 0.98 × 0.994 ≈ 0.883。驗收量測：入射 10.00 mW，第一級 8.80 mW → η₁ = 88.0%，零級 0.010 mW → η₀ = 0.10% → ε ≈ 3.3%（約 45 nm），與輪廓儀量到的總深度 1340 nm（−3.2%）一致，表示蝕刻校正應上修 3%。若改用 532 nm 使用，ε = 0.19，η₁ 再乘 0.887 只剩約 78%。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: 8-level diffractive-lens exercise: fused silica (n = 1.457), λ₀ = 633 nm, f = 50 mm, D = 10 mm. Blaze depth d = 633/0.457 ≈ 1385 nm, 8-level step ≈ 173 nm, three masks etched 693, 346 and 173 nm; NA ≈ 0.1, outermost period λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm, zone count r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395, finest feature ≈ 0.8 µm. Efficiency budget: quantisation sinc²(1/8) = 0.950; etch rate 100 nm/min with endpoint detection leaves 2 nm step error (ε ≈ 0.15%, factor ≈ 1.000); 0.1 µm overlay on the third mask gives a scalar-model factor 0.907/0.950 ≈ 0.954; step roughness and sidewalls 0.98; Fresnel factor 0.994 after double-sided antireflection; predicted η₁ ≈ 0.950 × 1.000 × 0.954 × 0.98 × 0.994 ≈ 0.883. Acceptance measurement: incident 10.00 mW, first order 8.80 mW → η₁ = 88.0%, zero order 0.010 mW → η₀ = 0.10% → ε ≈ 3.3% (about 45 nm), consistent with a profiler total depth of 1340 nm (−3.2%), so the etch calibration should be raised by 3%. Used at 532 nm instead, ε = 0.19 and η₁ is multiplied by 0.887 to about 78%. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」與「波長失諧、深度誤差與級次洩漏」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency" and "Wavelength detuning, depth error and order leakage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 純量繞射、相位量化與效率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」如何決定繞射光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase” determines the key performance of “Diffractive optical-element fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 繞射光學元件把一個連續的相位函數以 2π 為模數摺疊成薄的表面浮雕，每個週期內相位從 0 線性升到 2π，理想的閃耀（kinoform）輪廓在設計波長把全部能量送進第一繞射級。微影製作無法做出連續斜面，而是以 M 個等高階梯逼近，純量理論給出第一級效率 η = sinc²(1/M)，剩餘能量分散到其他級次。浮雕的總深度由材料折射率決定，d = λ₀/(n − 1)，階數越多越接近連續輪廓，但每多一個光罩就多一次對準與蝕刻，製程誤差也隨之累積。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diffractive optical element folds a continuous phase function modulo 2π into a thin surface relief, the phase rising linearly from 0 to 2π within each period, and an ideal blazed (kinoform) profile sends all the energy into the first diffraction order at the design wavelength. Lithography cannot make a continuous slope, so it approximates it with M equal-height steps; scalar theory gives a first-order efficiency η = sinc²(1/M), with the remainder spread over other orders. The total relief depth is set by the material index, d = λ₀/(n − 1); more levels approach the continuous profile, but every extra mask adds an alignment and an etch, and process errors accumulate accordingly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: η_M = [sin(π/M)/(π/M)]²: 0.405 for M = 2, 0.811 for 4, 0.950 for 8, 0.987 for 16, 0.997 for 32 and 1 for a continuous profile.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相位階數加倍，繞射效率就會加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling the number of phase levels doubles the diffraction efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 純量繞射、相位量化與效率
knowledge.titleEn: Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency
knowledge.text: 繞射光學元件把一個連續的相位函數以 2π 為模數摺疊成薄的表面浮雕，每個週期內相位從 0 線性升到 2π，理想的閃耀（kinoform）輪廓在設計波長把全部能量送進第一繞射級。微影製作無法做出連續斜面，而是以 M 個等高階梯逼近，純量理論給出第一級效率 η = sinc²(1/M)，剩餘能量分散到其他級次。
knowledge.textEn: A diffractive optical element folds a continuous phase function modulo 2π into a thin surface relief, the phase rising linearly from 0 to 2π within each period, and an ideal blazed (kinoform) profile sends all the energy into the first diffraction order at the design wavelength. Lithography cannot make a continuous slope, so it approximates it with M equal-height steps; scalar theory gives a first-order efficiency η = sinc²(1/M), with the remainder spread over other orders.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相位階數加倍，繞射效率就會加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling the number of phase levels doubles the diffraction efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency" is correct?
options: 相位階數加倍，繞射效率就會加倍。
繞射光學元件把一個連續的相位函數以 2π 為模數摺疊成薄的表面浮雕，每個週期內相位從 0 線性升到 2π，理想的閃耀（kinoform）輪廓在設計波長把全部能量送進第一繞射級。
繞射元件在鄰近波長的表現與設計波長幾乎相同。
optionsEn: Doubling the number of phase levels doubles the diffraction efficiency.

A diffractive optical element folds a continuous phase function modulo 2π into a thin surface relief, the phase rising linearly from 0 to 2π within each period, and an ideal blazed (kinoform) profile sends all the energy into the first diffraction order at the design wavelength.
A diffractive element performs almost the same at nearby wavelengths as at its design wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 繞射光學元件把一個連續的相位函數以 2π 為模數摺疊成薄的表面浮雕，每個週期內相位從 0 線性升到 2π，理想的閃耀（kinoform）輪廓在設計波長把全部能量送進第一繞射級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A diffractive optical element folds a continuous phase function modulo 2π into a thin surface relief, the phase rising linearly from 0 to 2π within each period, and an ideal blazed (kinoform) profile sends all the energy into the first diffraction order at the design wavelength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 純量繞射、相位量化與效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_M = [sin(π/M)/(π/M)]²：M = 2 為 0.405，4 為 0.811，8 為 0.950，16 為 0.987，32 為 0.997，連續輪廓為 1。熔融石英在 633 nm 的 n = 1.457，閃耀深度 d = 633/0.457 ≈ 1385 nm；8 階元件的實際最大深度為 d×7/8 ≈ 1212 nm，每階 ≈ 173 nm，由三道光罩分別蝕刻 693、346、173 nm 完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_M = [sin(π/M)/(π/M)]²: 0.405 for M = 2, 0.811 for 4, 0.950 for 8, 0.987 for 16, 0.997 for 32 and 1 for a continuous profile. Fused silica has n = 1.457 at 633 nm, so the blaze depth d = 633/0.457 ≈ 1385 nm; an 8-level element has an actual maximum depth of d×7/8 ≈ 1212 nm with ≈ 173 nm per step, produced by three masks etched 693, 346 and 173 nm deep. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作 2、4、8 階的同週期光柵，用 He-Ne 雷射照射並以功率計量各繞射級的功率，比較第一級效率與 sinc² 預測值；同時以輪廓儀量總深度與階高，確認深度與 λ₀/(n − 1) 的關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Make gratings of the same period with 2, 4 and 8 levels, illuminate with a He-Ne laser and measure each order's power with a power meter, comparing first-order efficiency with the sinc² prediction; measure total depth and step heights with a profilometer to confirm the relation to λ₀/(n − 1).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: η_M = [sin(π/M)/(π/M)]²: 0.405 for M = 2, 0.811 for 4, 0.950 for 8, 0.987 for 16, 0.997 for 32 and 1 for a continuous profile. Fused silica has n = 1.457 at 633 nm, so the blaze depth d = 633/0.457 ≈ 1385 nm; an 8-level element has an actual maximum depth of d×7/8 ≈ 1212 nm with ≈ 173 nm per step, produced by three masks etched 693, 346 and 173 nm deep.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 蝕刻時間一樣，深度就一樣。
效率損失可以像誤差一樣用均方根相加。
optionsEn: Equal etch time gives equal depth.
Efficiency losses add root-sum-square like random errors.
η_M = [sin(π/M)/(π/M)]²: 0.405 for M = 2, 0.811 for 4, 0.950 for 8, 0.987 for 16, 0.997 for 32 and 1 for a continuous profile.
quiz.explanationEn: η_M = [sin(π/M)/(π/M)]²: 0.405 for M = 2, 0.811 for 4, 0.950 for 8, 0.987 for 16, 0.997 for 32 and 1 for a continuous profile. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 純量繞射、相位量化與效率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 製作 2、4、8 階的同週期光柵，用 He-Ne 雷射照射並以功率計量各繞射級的功率，比較第一級效率與 sinc² 預測值；同時以輪廓儀量總深度與階高，確認深度與 λ₀/(n − 1) 的關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Make gratings of the same period with 2, 4 and 8 levels, illuminate with a He-Ne laser and measure each order's power with a power meter, comparing first-order efficiency with the sinc² prediction; measure total depth and step heights with a profilometer to confirm the relation to λ₀/(n − 1). Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把為 PMMA（n = 1.49）設計的 1292 nm 深度直接用在熔融石英上，相位深度只有 2π×0.457/0.49，不足約 7%（ε ≈ −0.067），看似小，卻把約 0.5% 的能量送進零級並在雷射系統中形成中央亮點。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using the 1292 nm depth designed for PMMA (n = 1.49) directly on fused silica gives a phase depth of only 2π×0.457/0.49, about 7% short (ε ≈ −0.067), which looks small yet sends about 0.5% of the energy into the zero order as a central hot spot in a laser system.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製作 2、4、8 階的同週期光柵，用 He-Ne 雷射照射並以功率計量各繞射級的功率，比較第一級效率與 sinc² 預測值；同時以輪廓儀量總深度與階高，確認深度與 λ₀/(n − 1) 的關係。
knowledge.textEn: Make gratings of the same period with 2, 4 and 8 levels, illuminate with a He-Ne laser and measure each order's power with a power meter, comparing first-order efficiency with the sinc² prediction; measure total depth and step heights with a profilometer to confirm the relation to λ₀/(n − 1).

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency"?
options: 製作 2、4、8 階的同週期光柵，用 He-Ne 雷射照射並以功率計量各繞射級的功率，比較第一級效率與 sinc² 預測值。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
繞射面色散太強，不可能用來做消色差透鏡。
optionsEn: Make gratings of the same period with 2, 4 and 8 levels, illuminate with a He-Ne laser and measure each order's power with a power meter, comparing first-order efficiency with the sinc² prediction.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A diffractive surface disperses too strongly to be useful for achromatic lenses.
quiz.explanation: 製作 2、4、8 階的同週期光柵，用 He-Ne 雷射照射並以功率計量各繞射級的功率，比較第一級效率與 sinc² 預測值；同時以輪廓儀量總深度與階高，確認深度與 λ₀/(n − 1) 的關係。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。

steps.title: 純量繞射、相位量化與效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把為 PMMA（n = 1.49）設計的 1292 nm 深度直接用在熔融石英上，相位深度只有 2π×0.457/0.49，不足約 7%（ε ≈ −0.067），看似小，卻把約 0.5% 的能量送進零級並在雷射系統中形成中央亮點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using the 1292 nm depth designed for PMMA (n = 1.49) directly on fused silica gives a phase depth of only 2π×0.457/0.49, about 7% short (ε ≈ −0.067), which looks small yet sends about 0.5% of the energy into the zero order as a central hot spot in a laser system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：浮雕的總深度由材料折射率決定，d = λ₀/(n − 1)，階數越多越接近連續輪廓，但每多一個光罩就多一次對準與蝕刻，製程誤差也隨之累積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The total relief depth is set by the material index, d = λ₀/(n − 1); more levels approach the continuous profile, but every extra mask adds an alignment and an etch, and process errors accumulate accordingly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相位階數加倍，繞射效率就會加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling the number of phase levels doubles the diffraction efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 波長失諧、深度誤差與級次洩漏：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavelength detuning, depth error and order leakage: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「設計波長失諧與零級洩漏」如何決定繞射光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design-wavelength detuning and zero-order leakage” determines the key performance of “Diffractive optical-element fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮雕深度只在設計波長給出 2π 相位；波長改變或深度有誤差時，相位深度變成 2π(1 + ε)，第一級效率降為 sinc²(ε)，而零級與第二級各獲得約 ε² 量級的能量。這就是繞射元件強烈色散與對深度敏感的根源：在雷射系統裡，零級洩漏表現為未被整形的中央亮點，對光束整形器與分束器而言比效率損失更致命。寬頻應用需要混合折射繞射設計或多階（harmonic）繞射元件，把深度做成多個 2π 的整數倍以在數個波長同時閃耀。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「設計波長失諧與零級洩漏」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The relief depth gives 2π of phase only at the design wavelength; when the wavelength changes or the depth is in error, the phase depth becomes 2π(1 + ε), first-order efficiency falls to sinc²(ε), and the zero and second orders each receive energy of order ε². This is the root of a diffractive element's strong dispersion and depth sensitivity: in a laser system zero-order leakage appears as an unshaped central hot spot, more damaging to beam shapers and splitters than the efficiency loss itself. Broadband use calls for hybrid refractive-diffractive designs or harmonic diffractive elements whose depth is several integer multiples of 2π so that several wavelengths blaze simultaneously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Design-wavelength detuning and zero-order leakage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A continuous profile blazed for 633 nm used at 532 nm has ε = 633/532 − 1 = 0.19 and η₁ = sinc²(0.19) ≈ 0.887; at 650 nm, ε = −0.026 and η₁ ≈ 0.998.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「繞射元件在鄰近波長的表現與設計波長幾乎相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A diffractive element performs almost the same at nearby wavelengths as at its design wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「設計波長失諧與零級洩漏」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Design-wavelength detuning and zero-order leakage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

This is the root of a diffractive element's strong dispersion and depth sensitivity: in a laser system zero-order leakage appears as an unshaped central hot spot, more damaging to beam shapers and splitters than the efficiency loss itself.

quiz.question: 關於「波長失諧、深度誤差與級次洩漏」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wavelength detuning, depth error and order leakage" is correct?
options: 繞射元件在鄰近波長的表現與設計波長幾乎相同。
只要光罩畫得出來，階數就可以隨意增加。
浮雕深度只在設計波長給出 2π 相位。
optionsEn: A diffractive element performs almost the same at nearby wavelengths as at its design wavelength.
As long as the masks can be drawn, the level count can be raised at will.

quiz.explanationEn: The relief depth gives 2π of phase only at the design wavelength; when the wavelength changes or the depth is in error, the phase depth becomes 2π(1 + ε), first-order efficiency falls to sinc²(ε), and the zero and second orders each receive energy of order ε². The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波長失諧、深度誤差與級次洩漏：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavelength detuning, depth error and order leakage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計波長失諧與零級洩漏」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Design-wavelength detuning and zero-order leakage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：為 633 nm 閃耀的連續輪廓用在 532 nm：ε = 633/532 − 1 = 0.19，η₁ = sinc²(0.19) ≈ 0.887；用在 650 nm：ε = −0.026，η₁ ≈ 0.998。深度超量 5%（ε = 0.05）：η₁ = sinc²(0.05) ≈ 0.992，零級 η₀ = sinc²(1.05) ≈ ε²/(1 + ε)² ≈ 0.0023，即 0.23% 的中央亮點；反過來，量到 η₀ = 0.1% 就代表 ε ≈ 3.3%，深度偏差約 45 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A continuous profile blazed for 633 nm used at 532 nm has ε = 633/532 − 1 = 0.19 and η₁ = sinc²(0.19) ≈ 0.887; at 650 nm, ε = −0.026 and η₁ ≈ 0.998. A 5% depth overshoot (ε = 0.05) gives η₁ = sinc²(0.05) ≈ 0.992 and a zero order η₀ = sinc²(1.05) ≈ ε²/(1 + ε)² ≈ 0.0023, a 0.23% central hot spot; conversely a measured η₀ = 0.1% implies ε ≈ 3.3%, a depth deviation of about 45 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用兩個以上的雷射波長量同一元件的第一級與零級效率，與 sinc² 曲線擬合求出實際相位深度；在設計波長下以相機記錄零級亮點的相對強度，作為深度誤差的靈敏指標並與輪廓儀深度量測交叉比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the first- and zero-order efficiencies of the same element at two or more laser wavelengths and fit the sinc² curve to extract the actual phase depth; at the design wavelength record the relative intensity of the zero-order spot with a camera as a sensitive depth-error indicator and cross-check against profilometer depth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A 5% depth overshoot (ε = 0.05) gives η₁ = sinc²(0.05) ≈ 0.992 and a zero order η₀ = sinc²(1.05) ≈ ε²/(1 + ε)² ≈ 0.0023, a 0.23% central hot spot; conversely a measured η₀ = 0.1% implies ε ≈ 3.3%, a depth deviation of about 45 nm.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Design-wavelength detuning and zero-order leakage” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用兩個以上的雷射波長量同一元件的第一級與零級效率，與 sinc² 曲線擬合求出實際相位深度；在設計波長下以相機記錄零級亮點的相對強度，作為深度誤差的靈敏指標並與輪廓儀深度量測交叉比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 注意干擾：為 1064 nm 設計的光束整形器被用在 1030 nm 的光纖雷射，ε ≈ 3.3%，零級漏光 0.1% 聚焦後在工件中心燒出一個小孔，整形出的平頂光束因此報廢。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A beam shaper designed for 1064 nm used with a 1030 nm fibre laser has ε ≈ 3.3%; the 0.1% zero-order leak focuses into a small hole at the workpiece centre and ruins the flat-top profile.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.instruction: 為 1064 nm 設計的光束整形器被用在 1030 nm 的光纖雷射，ε ≈ 3.3%，零級漏光 0.1% 聚焦後在工件中心燒出一個小孔，整形出的平頂光束因此報廢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A beam shaper designed for 1064 nm used with a 1030 nm fibre laser has ε ≈ 3.3%; the 0.1% zero-order leak focuses into a small hole at the workpiece centre and ruins the flat-top profile. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：寬頻應用需要混合折射繞射設計或多階（harmonic）繞射元件，把深度做成多個 2π 的整數倍以在數個波長同時閃耀。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「繞射元件在鄰近波長的表現與設計波長幾乎相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A diffractive element performs almost the same at nearby wavelengths as at its design wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何」與「蝕刻深度控制、灰階直寫與複製」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry" and "Etch-depth control, grayscale writing and replication": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三道光罩與最外環帶的最小線寬」如何決定繞射光學元件製作的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three masks and the minimum feature of the outermost zone” determines the key performance of “Diffractive optical-element fabrication”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 二元光學以 N 道二元光罩製作 2ᴺ 階：第一道蝕刻 d/2、第二道 d/4、第三道 d/8，每道都要與前一道的圖形套準。繞射透鏡的環帶向外越來越密，最外環帶的週期等於波長除以數值孔徑，而最細線寬是週期除以階數，這決定了需要接觸式曝光、步進機還是電子束直寫。套準誤差對效率的傷害與最細線寬成反比，週期小、階數多的元件往往因為套準而不是階數限制了效率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三道光罩與最外環帶的最小線寬」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Binary optics builds 2ᴺ levels with N binary masks: the first etches d/2, the second d/4, the third d/8, and each must be overlaid on the previous pattern. The zones of a diffractive lens grow denser outward; the outermost period equals the wavelength divided by the numerical aperture, and the finest feature is that period divided by the level count, which decides between contact exposure, a stepper or electron-beam writing. Overlay error damages efficiency in inverse proportion to the finest feature, so small-period, many-level elements are often limited by overlay rather than by level count. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three masks and the minimum feature of the outermost zone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：f = 50 mm、D = 10 mm、λ = 633 nm 的繞射透鏡：NA ≈ 0.1，最外環帶週期 Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm，環帶數 N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395；8 階的最細線寬 ≈ 0.8 µm，i 線步進機可做。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A diffractive lens with f = 50 mm, D = 10 mm and λ = 633 nm has NA ≈ 0.1, an outermost period Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm and N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395 zones; the 8-level finest feature ≈ 0.8 µm suits an i-line stepper.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要光罩畫得出來，階數就可以隨意增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the masks can be drawn, the level count can be raised at will." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「三道光罩與最外環帶的最小線寬」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Three masks and the minimum feature of the outermost zone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何
knowledge.titleEn: Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry
knowledge.text: 二元光學以 N 道二元光罩製作 2ᴺ 階：第一道蝕刻 d/2、第二道 d/4、第三道 d/8，每道都要與前一道的圖形套準。繞射透鏡的環帶向外越來越密，最外環帶的週期等於波長除以數值孔徑，而最細線寬是週期除以階數，這決定了需要接觸式曝光、步進機還是電子束直寫。
knowledge.textEn: Binary optics builds 2ᴺ levels with N binary masks: the first etches d/2, the second d/4, the third d/8, and each must be overlaid on the previous pattern. The zones of a diffractive lens grow denser outward; the outermost period equals the wavelength divided by the numerical aperture, and the finest feature is that period divided by the level count, which decides between contact exposure, a stepper or electron-beam writing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要光罩畫得出來，階數就可以隨意增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the masks can be drawn, the level count can be raised at will. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry" is correct?
options: 二元光學以 N 道二元光罩製作 2ᴺ 階：第一道蝕刻 d/2、第二道 d/4、第三道 d/8，每道都要與前一道的圖形套準。
只要光罩畫得出來，階數就可以隨意增加。
蝕刻時間一樣，深度就一樣。
optionsEn: Binary optics builds 2ᴺ levels with N binary masks: the first etches d/2, the second d/4, the third d/8, and each must be overlaid on the previous pattern.
As long as the masks can be drawn, the level count can be raised at will.
Equal etch time gives equal depth.
quiz.explanation: 二元光學以 N 道二元光罩製作 2ᴺ 階：第一道蝕刻 d/2、第二道 d/4、第三道 d/8，每道都要與前一道的圖形套準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Binary optics builds 2ᴺ levels with N binary masks: the first etches d/2, the second d/4, the third d/8, and each must be overlaid on the previous pattern. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三道光罩與最外環帶的最小線寬」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three masks and the minimum feature of the outermost zone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f = 50 mm、D = 10 mm、λ = 633 nm 的繞射透鏡：NA ≈ 0.1，最外環帶週期 Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm，環帶數 N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395；8 階的最細線寬 ≈ 0.8 µm，i 線步進機可做。若 NA = 0.5，Λ_min ≈ 1.27 µm、最細線寬 0.16 µm，必須電子束直寫。純量模型（週期 10 µm、8 階）：第三道光罩套準偏 0.1 µm 使效率由 0.950 降到 0.907，第二與第三道各偏 0.1 µm 則降到 0.838。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A diffractive lens with f = 50 mm, D = 10 mm and λ = 633 nm has NA ≈ 0.1, an outermost period Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm and N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395 zones; the 8-level finest feature ≈ 0.8 µm suits an i-line stepper. At NA = 0.5, Λ_min ≈ 1.27 µm and the finest feature 0.16 µm demand electron-beam writing. Scalar model (10 µm period, 8 levels): a 0.1 µm overlay error on the third mask lowers efficiency from 0.950 to 0.907, and 0.1 µm on both the second and third masks to 0.838. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用套準標記在顯微鏡或 SEM 下量每道光罩的實際偏移，代入純量模型預測效率，與雷射量測的第一級效率比較；量最外環帶的線寬與設計值的差異（線寬損失），確認曝光劑量與顯影沒有把最細線條吃掉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the actual offset of each mask on overlay marks under a microscope or SEM, feed it into the scalar model to predict efficiency and compare with the laser-measured first-order value; measure the line-width loss of the outermost zone against design to confirm that exposure dose and development have not eroded the finest lines.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: f = 50 mm、D = 10 mm、λ = 633 nm 的繞射透鏡：NA ≈ 0.1，最外環帶週期 Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm，環帶數 N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395；8 階的最細線寬 ≈ 0.8 µm，i 線步進機可做。若 NA = 0.5，Λ_min ≈ 1.27 µm、最細線寬 0.16 µm，必須電子束直寫。純量模型（週期 10 µm、8 階）：第三道光罩套準偏 0.1 µm 使效率由 0.950 降到 0.907，第二與第三道各偏 0.1 µm 則降到 0.838。
knowledge.textEn: A diffractive lens with f = 50 mm, D = 10 mm and λ = 633 nm has NA ≈ 0.1, an outermost period Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm and N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395 zones; the 8-level finest feature ≈ 0.8 µm suits an i-line stepper. At NA = 0.5, Λ_min ≈ 1.27 µm and the finest feature 0.16 µm demand electron-beam writing. Scalar model (10 µm period, 8 levels): a 0.1 µm overlay error on the third mask lowers efficiency from 0.950 to 0.907, and 0.1 µm on both the second and third masks to 0.838.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry", which statement holds?
options: 效率損失可以像誤差一樣用均方根相加。
f = 50 mm、D = 10 mm、λ = 633 nm 的繞射透鏡：NA ≈ 0.1，最外環帶週期 Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm，環帶數 N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395。
繞射元件的規格只需要一個效率數字。
optionsEn: Efficiency losses add root-sum-square like random errors.
A diffractive lens with f = 50 mm, D = 10 mm and λ = 633 nm has NA ≈ 0.1, an outermost period Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm and N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395 zones.
A diffractive element's specification needs only one efficiency number.
quiz.explanation: f = 50 mm、D = 10 mm、λ = 633 nm 的繞射透鏡：NA ≈ 0.1，最外環帶週期 Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm，環帶數 N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395；8 階的最細線寬 ≈ 0.8 µm，i 線步進機可做。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A diffractive lens with f = 50 mm, D = 10 mm and λ = 633 nm has NA ≈ 0.1, an outermost period Λ_min = λ/NA ≈ 6.3 µm and N = r²/(2fλ) = 25/(2×50×6.33×10⁻⁴) ≈ 395 zones; the 8-level finest feature ≈ 0.8 µm suits an i-line stepper. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三道光罩與最外環帶的最小線寬」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Three masks and the minimum feature of the outermost zone” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用套準標記在顯微鏡或 SEM 下量每道光罩的實際偏移，代入純量模型預測效率，與雷射量測的第一級效率比較；量最外環帶的線寬與設計值的差異（線寬損失），確認曝光劑量與顯影沒有把最細線條吃掉。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the actual offset of each mask on overlay marks under a microscope or SEM, feed it into the scalar model to predict efficiency and compare with the laser-measured first-order value; measure the line-width loss of the outermost zone against design to confirm that exposure dose and development have not eroded the finest lines. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用對準精度 0.5 µm 的接觸式曝光機做週期 6 µm 的 8 階透鏡，第三道光罩的 0.75 µm 線條幾乎整條套歪，效率掉到 4 階的水準，多花的兩道光罩毫無收益。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Making a 6 µm period, 8-level lens on a contact aligner with 0.5 µm overlay misplaces almost the whole 0.75 µm line of the third mask; efficiency falls to 4-level territory and the two extra masks buy nothing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用套準標記在顯微鏡或 SEM 下量每道光罩的實際偏移，代入純量模型預測效率，與雷射量測的第一級效率比較；量最外環帶的線寬與設計值的差異（線寬損失），確認曝光劑量與顯影沒有把最細線條吃掉。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the actual offset of each mask on overlay marks under a microscope or SEM, feed it into the scalar model to predict efficiency and compare with the laser-measured first-order value; measure the line-width loss of the outermost zone against design to confirm that exposure dose and development have not eroded the finest lines.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
相位階數加倍，繞射效率就會加倍。
用套準標記在顯微鏡或 SEM 下量每道光罩的實際偏移，代入純量模型預測效率，與雷射量測的第一級效率比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Doubling the number of phase levels doubles the diffraction efficiency.
Measure the actual offset of each mask on overlay marks under a microscope or SEM, feed it into the scalar model to predict efficiency and compare with the laser-measured first-order value.
quiz.explanation: 用套準標記在顯微鏡或 SEM 下量每道光罩的實際偏移，代入純量模型預測效率，與雷射量測的第一級效率比較；量最外環帶的線寬與設計值的差異（線寬損失），確認曝光劑量與顯影沒有把最細線條吃掉。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the actual offset of each mask on overlay marks under a microscope or SEM, feed it into the scalar model to predict efficiency and compare with the laser-measured first-order value; measure the line-width loss of the outermost zone against design to confirm that exposure dose and development have not eroded the finest lines. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三道光罩與最外環帶的最小線寬」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Three masks and the minimum feature of the outermost zone” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用對準精度 0.5 µm 的接觸式曝光機做週期 6 µm 的 8 階透鏡，第三道光罩的 0.75 µm 線條幾乎整條套歪，效率掉到 4 階的水準，多花的兩道光罩毫無收益。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Making a 6 µm period, 8-level lens on a contact aligner with 0.5 µm overlay misplaces almost the whole 0.75 µm line of the third mask; efficiency falls to 4-level territory and the two extra masks buy nothing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：套準誤差對效率的傷害與最細線寬成反比，週期小、階數多的元件往往因為套準而不是階數限制了效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Overlay error damages efficiency in inverse proportion to the finest feature, so small-period, many-level elements are often limited by overlay rather than by level count.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要光罩畫得出來，階數就可以隨意增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the masks can be drawn, the level count can be raised at will." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用對準精度 0.5 µm 的接觸式曝光機做週期 6 µm 的 8 階透鏡，第三道光罩的 0.75 µm 線條幾乎整條套歪，效率掉到 4 階的水準，多花的兩道光罩毫無收益。
knowledge.textEn: Making a 6 µm period, 8-level lens on a contact aligner with 0.5 µm overlay misplaces almost the whole 0.75 µm line of the third mask; efficiency falls to 4-level territory and the two extra masks buy nothing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「二元微影：光罩數、最小線寬與環帶幾何」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Binary lithography: mask count, minimum feature and zone geometry" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 用對準精度 0.5 µm 的接觸式曝光機做週期 6 µm 的 8 階透鏡，第三道光罩的 0.75 µm 線條幾乎整條套歪，效率掉到 4 階的水準，多花的兩道光罩毫無收益。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
蝕刻時間一樣，深度就一樣。
optionsEn: Making a 6 µm period, 8-level lens on a contact aligner with 0.5 µm overlay misplaces almost the whole 0.75 µm line of the third mask.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Equal etch time gives equal depth.
