workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：λ = 532 nm、直徑 D = 2 mm、f = 0.75 mm 的 TiO₂ 超穎透鏡，NA = sin(atan(1/0.75)) = 0.8。菲涅耳圈數 N = (√(R² + f²) − f)/λ = (1.25 − 0.75) mm/0.532 µm ≈ 940 圈；最外圈寬 λ/NA = 665 nm，以 250 nm 格點取樣得每圈 2.66 個超穎原子，純量估計邊緣局部效率 sinc²(1/2.66) ≈ 0.61。柱子總數 π(1000 µm)²/(0.25 µm)² ≈ 5.0×10⁷ 根。EBL 以 1000 µC/cm²、1 nA、填充率 35% 寫入需 t = 1.1×10⁻² cm² × 10⁻³ C/cm² / 10⁻⁹ A ≈ 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h。景深 λ/NA² ≈ 0.83 µm，焦點移動一個景深對應 Δλ ≈ 0.59 nm，故只適合窄線寬雷射。CD 標準差 3 nm 經 0.052 rad/nm 換算得 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.976。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a TiO₂ metalens with λ = 532 nm, diameter D = 2 mm and f = 0.75 mm has NA = sin(atan(1/0.75)) = 0.8. The number of Fresnel zones is N = (√(R² + f²) − f)/λ = (1.25 − 0.75) mm/0.532 µm ≈ 940; the outermost zone is λ/NA = 665 nm wide, sampled by 2.66 meta-atoms on a 250 nm lattice, giving a scalar local rim efficiency of sinc²(1/2.66) ≈ 0.61. The pillar count is π(1000 µm)²/(0.25 µm)² ≈ 5.0×10⁷. EBL at 1000 µC/cm², 1 nA and 35% fill takes t = 1.1×10⁻² cm² × 10⁻³ C/cm² / 10⁻⁹ A ≈ 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h. The depth of focus λ/NA² ≈ 0.83 µm, so moving the focus by one depth of focus needs only Δλ ≈ 0.59 nm, which restricts use to narrow-linewidth lasers. A 3 nm CD standard deviation through 0.052 rad/nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.976. All values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」與「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" and "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。要把平面波聚到焦距 f，相位剖面必須是 φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f)，其徑向梯度 dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ 就是廣義 Snell 定律中的面內波向量，透鏡邊緣的 sinθ 即數值孔徑 NA。相位以週期 p 的格點離散取樣，格點既要細到能解析邊緣最陡的相位斜率，又要小於基板內波長以免格點本身繞射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. To focus a plane wave at distance f the phase must follow φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f), whose radial gradient dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ is the in-plane wavevector of the generalized Snell law, and sinθ at the rim equals the numerical aperture. The phase is sampled on a lattice of pitch p that must resolve the steepest slope at the rim yet stay below the wavelength inside the substrate so that the lattice itself does not diffract. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA；Nyquist 要求 p ≤ λ/(2·NA)，λ = 532 nm、NA = 0.8 時 p ≤ 332 nm；另需 p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm 避免熔融石英內的格點繞射。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA; Nyquist requires p ≤ λ/(2·NA), i.e. p ≤ 332 nm for λ = 532 nm and NA = 0.8, and p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm avoids lattice diffraction inside fused silica.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣
knowledge.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling
knowledge.text: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。要把平面波聚到焦距 f，相位剖面必須是 φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f)，其徑向梯度 dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ 就是廣義 Snell 定律中的面內波向量，透鏡邊緣的 sinθ 即數值孔徑 NA。
knowledge.textEn: A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. To focus a plane wave at distance f the phase must follow φ(r) = −(2π/λ)(√(r² + f²) − f), whose radial gradient dφ/dr = −(2π/λ)·sinθ is the in-plane wavevector of the generalized Snell law, and sinθ at the rim equals the numerical aperture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" is correct?
options: 只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。
超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。
奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。
optionsEn: As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter.
A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer.
Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.
quiz.explanation: 超穎透鏡不靠厚度累積光程，而是在一層次波長的奈米結構上逐點指定穿透相位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A metalens does not accumulate optical path through thickness; it assigns a transmission phase point by point on a single subwavelength-structured layer. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Generalized Snell law and phase sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：最外圈局部週期 Λ = λ/NA；Nyquist 要求 p ≤ λ/(2·NA)，λ = 532 nm、NA = 0.8 時 p ≤ 332 nm；另需 p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm 避免熔融石英內的格點繞射。取 p = 250 nm，最外圈 Λ = 665 nm 只被 2.66 個超穎原子取樣。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The local period at the rim is Λ = λ/NA; Nyquist requires p ≤ λ/(2·NA), i.e. p ≤ 332 nm for λ = 532 nm and NA = 0.8, and p < λ/n_sub = 532/1.46 ≈ 364 nm avoids lattice diffraction inside fused silica. With p = 250 nm the outermost period Λ = 665 nm is sampled by only 2.66 meta-atoms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數；再以 FDTD 或 RCWA 對邊緣一個局部光柵週期算繞射效率，與 sinc²(1/N) 的純量估計比較，確認邊緣效率下降量是否在聚焦效率預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius; then simulate one local grating period at the rim with FDTD or RCWA and compare its diffraction efficiency with the scalar sinc²(1/N) estimate to confirm that the rim loss fits the focusing-efficiency budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

With p = 250 nm the outermost period Λ = 665 nm is sampled by only 2.66 meta-atoms.

steps.instruction: 用設計檔計算每個半徑的相位梯度與每週期取樣數，畫成 r 的函數；再以 FDTD 或 RCWA 對邊緣一個局部光柵週期算繞射效率，與 sinc²(1/N) 的純量估計比較，確認邊緣效率下降量是否在聚焦效率預算內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: From the layout, compute the phase gradient and samples per period as a function of radius; then simulate one local grating period at the rim with FDTD or RCWA and compare its diffraction efficiency with the scalar sinc²(1/N) estimate to confirm that the rim loss fits the focusing-efficiency budget. steps.instruction: 為了追求高 NA 而讓邊緣每週期取樣數掉到 2 以下時，外圈能量進入其他繞射級，表現為焦點周圍的環狀背景與聚焦效率隨 NA 急遽下降，而中心區量測仍看似正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: 2π phase coverage of meta-atoms: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每根 TiO₂ 奈米柱是一段截斷的介電波導，直徑決定基模有效折射率 n_eff，穿透相位約為 (2π/λ)·n_eff·h。直徑從約 80 nm 增到 200 nm 時，532 nm 波長下 n_eff 約從 1.1 升到 2.1，因此固定高度 h 的柱子只靠直徑就能掃過 2π。另一條路是幾何相位：把柱子做成半波片並旋轉角度 θ，對圓偏振光給出 φ = 2θ，覆蓋範圍天生是完整的 2π，但效率由偏振轉換率決定且會把未轉換光留在零階。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each TiO₂ nanopillar is a truncated dielectric waveguide whose diameter sets the fundamental-mode effective index n_eff, giving a transmission phase of about (2π/λ)·n_eff·h. As the diameter grows from roughly 80 nm to 200 nm at 532 nm, n_eff rises from about 1.1 to 2.1, so pillars of fixed height sweep 2π by diameter alone. The alternative is geometric phase: pillars shaped as half-wave plates and rotated by θ impart φ = 2θ to circularly polarized light, covering a full 2π by construction, but efficiency is set by the polarization-conversion ratio and unconverted light stays in the zeroth order. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相位覆蓋 Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ；Δn_eff = 1.0、h = 600 nm、λ = 532 nm 時 Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π，足以涵蓋一整圈並留餘裕；最細柱的深寬比為 600/80 = 7.5。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Phase coverage is Δφ = 2π·Δn_eff·h/λ; with Δn_eff = 1.0, h = 600 nm and λ = 532 nm, Δφ = 7.09 rad ≈ 1.13×2π, enough for a full cycle with margin; the thinnest pillar has an aspect ratio of 600/80 = 7.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: 2π phase coverage of meta-atoms: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。
knowledge.textEn: Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫。
平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically.
Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: 以 RCWA 掃描直徑 60 到 240 nm 得到相位與穿透率曲線，挑出穿透率 > 90% 且相位單調的區段做為庫；再製作同直徑的均勻柱陣列，用干涉儀量穿透相位並與模擬曲線比較，偏差應小於 0.2 rad。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sweep diameters from 60 to 240 nm in RCWA to get phase and transmittance curves, keep the monotonic segment with transmittance above 90% as the library, then fabricate uniform arrays of each diameter and measure the transmitted phase interferometrically; deviations should stay below 0.2 rad. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: 2π phase coverage of meta-atoms: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「TiO₂ 奈米柱超穎原子庫」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “TiO₂ nanopillar meta-atom library” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：另一條路是幾何相位：把柱子做成半波片並旋轉角度 θ，對圓偏振光給出 φ = 2θ，覆蓋範圍天生是完整的 2π，但效率由偏振轉換率決定且會把未轉換光留在零階。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The alternative is geometric phase: pillars shaped as half-wave plates and rotated by θ impart φ = 2θ to circularly polarized light, covering a full 2π by construction, but efficiency is set by the polarization-conversion ratio and unconverted light stays in the zeroth order.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。
knowledge.textEn: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超穎原子的 2π 相位覆蓋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "2π phase coverage of meta-atoms" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。
若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses.
A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap.
quiz.explanation: 若庫的直徑範圍只覆蓋 1.6π，相位剖面在每圈包裹處出現 0.4π 的缺口，光被散射到零階與高階，焦點效率降到五成以下且出現明顯的直射亮斑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A library covering only 1.6π leaves a 0.4π gap at every phase wrap; light scatters into the zeroth and higher orders, focusing efficiency falls below half and a bright undiffracted spot appears. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能」與「材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput" and "Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 研究階段的超穎透鏡多以 100 keV 電子束直寫定義圖形，光點約 2 nm、特徵尺寸可到 10 nm，寫場約 1 mm，場間拼接與套刻誤差在 20 nm 以內；但寫入時間與曝光面積和劑量成正比、與束流成反比，公分級透鏡需要數百小時。量產改用 248 或 193 nm DUV 步進機，一次曝光一整個 26 × 33 mm 場，解析度由 k₁·λ/NA 決定，大口徑透鏡則由多個場拼接而成。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Research metalenses are usually patterned by 100 keV electron-beam direct write with a spot near 2 nm, features down to 10 nm, write fields of about 1 mm and stitching and overlay errors under 20 nm; but write time scales with exposed area times dose divided by beam current, so a centimetre-class lens would take hundreds of hours. Production moves to 248 or 193 nm DUV steppers that expose a whole 26 × 33 mm field at once with resolution set by k₁·λ/NA, and large apertures are built by stitching several fields. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EBL 寫入時間 t = A_exp·D/I：直徑 2 mm、填充率 35% 的透鏡 A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm²，劑量 D = 1000 µC/cm²、束流 I = 1 nA 時 t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h；KrF 步進機 λ = 248 nm、NA = 0.8、k₁ = 0.35 的解析度約 110 nm，整場曝光不到 1 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EBL write time is t = A_exp·D/I: a 2 mm lens with 35% fill has A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm², and with dose D = 1000 µC/cm² and current I = 1 nA, t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h; a KrF stepper at λ = 248 nm, NA = 0.8 and k₁ = 0.35 resolves about 110 nm and exposes a whole field in under 1 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能
knowledge.titleEn: Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput
knowledge.text: 研究階段的超穎透鏡多以 100 keV 電子束直寫定義圖形，光點約 2 nm、特徵尺寸可到 10 nm，寫場約 1 mm，場間拼接與套刻誤差在 20 nm 以內；但寫入時間與曝光面積和劑量成正比、與束流成反比，公分級透鏡需要數百小時。量產改用 248 或 193 nm DUV 步進機，一次曝光一整個 26 × 33 mm 場，解析度由 k₁·λ/NA 決定，大口徑透鏡則由多個場拼接而成。
knowledge.textEn: Research metalenses are usually patterned by 100 keV electron-beam direct write with a spot near 2 nm, features down to 10 nm, write fields of about 1 mm and stitching and overlay errors under 20 nm; but write time scales with exposed area times dose divided by beam current, so a centimetre-class lens would take hundreds of hours. Production moves to 248 or 193 nm DUV steppers that expose a whole 26 × 33 mm field at once with resolution set by k₁·λ/NA, and large apertures are built by stitching several fields.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput" is correct?
options: 研究階段的超穎透鏡多以 100 keV 電子束直寫定義圖形，光點約 2 nm、特徵尺寸可到 10 nm，寫場約 1 mm，場間拼接與套刻誤差在 20 nm 以內。
電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。
只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。
optionsEn: Research metalenses are usually patterned by 100 keV electron-beam direct write with a spot near 2 nm, features down to 10 nm, write fields of about 1 mm and stitching and overlay errors under 20 nm.
Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses.
If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless.
quiz.explanation: 研究階段的超穎透鏡多以 100 keV 電子束直寫定義圖形，光點約 2 nm、特徵尺寸可到 10 nm，寫場約 1 mm，場間拼接與套刻誤差在 20 nm 以內；但寫入時間與曝光面積和劑量成正比、與束流成反比，公分級透鏡需要數百小時。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Research metalenses are usually patterned by 100 keV electron-beam direct write with a spot near 2 nm, features down to 10 nm, write fields of about 1 mm and stitching and overlay errors under 20 nm; but write time scales with exposed area times dose divided by beam current, so a centimetre-class lens would take hundreds of hours. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EBL 寫入時間 t = A_exp·D/I：直徑 2 mm、填充率 35% 的透鏡 A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm²，劑量 D = 1000 µC/cm²、束流 I = 1 nA 時 t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h；KrF 步進機 λ = 248 nm、NA = 0.8、k₁ = 0.35 的解析度約 110 nm，整場曝光不到 1 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EBL write time is t = A_exp·D/I: a 2 mm lens with 35% fill has A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm², and with dose D = 1000 µC/cm² and current I = 1 nA, t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h; a KrF stepper at λ = 248 nm, NA = 0.8 and k₁ = 0.35 resolves about 110 nm and exposes a whole field in under 1 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知的劑量與束流在測試片上寫一組 1 mm² 圖案，記錄實際寫入時間並與 A·D/I 比較，差額即台架移動與穩定時間；DUV 片則在場邊界量 SEM 影像的柱位移，確認拼接誤差小於 20 nm。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Write a set of 1 mm² test patterns with known dose and current, log the actual time and compare with A·D/I so the difference reveals stage-move and settling overhead; on DUV wafers, measure pillar displacement across field boundaries in SEM images to confirm stitching below 20 nm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EBL 寫入時間 t = A_exp·D/I：直徑 2 mm、填充率 35% 的透鏡 A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm²，劑量 D = 1000 µC/cm²、束流 I = 1 nA 時 t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h；KrF 步進機 λ = 248 nm、NA = 0.8、k₁ = 0.35 的解析度約 110 nm，整場曝光不到 1 s。
knowledge.textEn: EBL write time is t = A_exp·D/I: a 2 mm lens with 35% fill has A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm², and with dose D = 1000 µC/cm² and current I = 1 nA, t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h; a KrF stepper at λ = 248 nm, NA = 0.8 and k₁ = 0.35 resolves about 110 nm and exposes a whole field in under 1 s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput", which statement holds?
options: 超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。
EBL 寫入時間 t = A_exp·D/I：直徑 2 mm、填充率 35% 的透鏡 A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm²，劑量 D = 1000 µC/cm²、束流 I = 1 nA 時 t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h。
平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。
optionsEn: A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens.
EBL write time is t = A_exp·D/I: a 2 mm lens with 35% fill has A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm², and with dose D = 1000 µC/cm² and current I = 1 nA, t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h.
Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: EBL 寫入時間 t = A_exp·D/I：直徑 2 mm、填充率 35% 的透鏡 A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm²，劑量 D = 1000 µC/cm²、束流 I = 1 nA 時 t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h；KrF 步進機 λ = 248 nm、NA = 0.8、k₁ = 0.35 的解析度約 110 nm，整場曝光不到 1 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: EBL write time is t = A_exp·D/I: a 2 mm lens with 35% fill has A_exp = 1.1×10⁻² cm², and with dose D = 1000 µC/cm² and current I = 1 nA, t = 1.1×10⁴ s ≈ 3.1 h; a KrF stepper at λ = 248 nm, NA = 0.8 and k₁ = 0.35 resolves about 110 nm and exposes a whole field in under 1 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用已知的劑量與束流在測試片上寫一組 1 mm² 圖案，記錄實際寫入時間並與 A·D/I 比較，差額即台架移動與穩定時間；DUV 片則在場邊界量 SEM 影像的柱位移，確認拼接誤差小於 20 nm。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Write a set of 1 mm² test patterns with known dose and current, log the actual time and compare with A·D/I so the difference reveals stage-move and settling overhead; on DUV wafers, measure pillar displacement across field boundaries in SEM images to confirm stitching below 20 nm. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：EBL 的近接效應使密集區柱子過曝、孤立區欠曝，直徑在同一設計值下相差 10 nm 以上，相位庫映射失效，透鏡出現與圖形密度相關的環狀效率起伏。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: EBL proximity effects overexpose dense regions and underexpose isolated ones, so pillars of the same design diameter differ by more than 10 nm; the library mapping breaks and the lens shows ring-shaped efficiency variation tied to pattern density.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用已知的劑量與束流在測試片上寫一組 1 mm² 圖案，記錄實際寫入時間並與 A·D/I 比較，差額即台架移動與穩定時間；DUV 片則在場邊界量 SEM 影像的柱位移，確認拼接誤差小於 20 nm。
knowledge.textEn: Write a set of 1 mm² test patterns with known dose and current, log the actual time and compare with A·D/I so the difference reveals stage-move and settling overhead; on DUV wafers, measure pillar displacement across field boundaries in SEM images to confirm stitching below 20 nm.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。
用已知的劑量與束流在測試片上寫一組 1 mm² 圖案，記錄實際寫入時間並與 A·D/I 比較，差額即台架移動與穩定時間。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter.
Write a set of 1 mm² test patterns with known dose and current, log the actual time and compare with A·D/I so the difference reveals stage-move and settling overhead.
quiz.explanation: 用已知的劑量與束流在測試片上寫一組 1 mm² 圖案，記錄實際寫入時間並與 A·D/I 比較，差額即台架移動與穩定時間；DUV 片則在場邊界量 SEM 影像的柱位移，確認拼接誤差小於 20 nm。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Write a set of 1 mm² test patterns with known dose and current, log the actual time and compare with A·D/I so the difference reveals stage-move and settling overhead; on DUV wafers, measure pillar displacement across field boundaries in SEM images to confirm stitching below 20 nm. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電子束直寫與 DUV 步進機」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Electron-beam direct write and DUV stepper” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: EBL 的近接效應使密集區柱子過曝、孤立區欠曝，直徑在同一設計值下相差 10 nm 以上，相位庫映射失效，透鏡出現與圖形密度相關的環狀效率起伏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: EBL proximity effects overexpose dense regions and underexpose isolated ones, so pillars of the same design diameter differ by more than 10 nm; the library mapping breaks and the lens shows ring-shaped efficiency variation tied to pattern density. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量產改用 248 或 193 nm DUV 步進機，一次曝光一整個 26 × 33 mm 場，解析度由 k₁·λ/NA 決定，大口徑透鏡則由多個場拼接而成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Production moves to 248 or 193 nm DUV steppers that expose a whole 26 × 33 mm field at once with resolution set by k₁·λ/NA, and large apertures are built by stitching several fields.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: EBL 的近接效應使密集區柱子過曝、孤立區欠曝，直徑在同一設計值下相差 10 nm 以上，相位庫映射失效，透鏡出現與圖形密度相關的環狀效率起伏。
knowledge.textEn: EBL proximity effects overexpose dense regions and underexpose isolated ones, so pillars of the same design diameter differ by more than 10 nm; the library mapping breaks and the lens shows ring-shaped efficiency variation tied to pattern density.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「曝光：EBL 解析度與 DUV 產能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exposure: EBL resolution versus DUV throughput" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: EBL 的近接效應使密集區柱子過曝、孤立區欠曝，直徑在同一設計值下相差 10 nm 以上，相位庫映射失效，透鏡出現與圖形密度相關的環狀效率起伏。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。
optionsEn: EBL proximity effects overexpose dense regions and underexpose isolated ones, so pillars of the same design diameter differ by more than 10 nm.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless.
quiz.explanation: EBL 的近接效應使密集區柱子過曝、孤立區欠曝，直徑在同一設計值下相差 10 nm 以上，相位庫映射失效，透鏡出現與圖形密度相關的環狀效率起伏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: EBL proximity effects overexpose dense regions and underexpose isolated ones, so pillars of the same design diameter differ by more than 10 nm; the library mapping breaks and the lens shows ring-shaped efficiency variation tied to pattern density. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可見光超穎透鏡需要高折射率、低吸收的材料：TiO₂（n ≈ 2.4、k < 10⁻⁴）與 GaN 適用可見光，非晶矽在 532 nm 吸收過大但在 940 nm 近紅外幾乎無損。TiO₂ 常以原子層沉積填入電子束阻劑的孔洞，再回蝕頂層並去除阻劑，形成垂直側壁的柱子；非晶矽或 GaN 則以硬遮罩加電感耦合電漿乾蝕刻成形。側壁角度、底部殘留與柱頂圓角都會改變 n_eff，等效於直徑誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visible metalenses need high-index, low-loss materials: TiO₂ (n ≈ 2.4, k < 10⁻⁴) and GaN serve the visible, whereas amorphous silicon absorbs too strongly at 532 nm but is nearly lossless at 940 nm in the near infrared. TiO₂ is usually grown by atomic-layer deposition into holes of an electron-beam resist, then etched back and freed from resist to leave vertical pillars; amorphous silicon or GaN is shaped by inductively coupled plasma etching through a hard mask. Sidewall angle, footing and top rounding all change n_eff and act like diameter errors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：側壁偏離垂直 α 時，上下直徑差 Δd = 2·h·tanα；h = 600 nm、α = 2° 時 Δd = 41.9 nm，相當於跨越相位庫中約四個 10 nm 直徑階。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A sidewall tilted by α from vertical gives a top-to-bottom diameter difference Δd = 2·h·tanα; for h = 600 nm and α = 2°, Δd = 41.9 nm, which spans about four 10 nm diameter steps of the library.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制
knowledge.text: 可見光超穎透鏡需要高折射率、低吸收的材料：TiO₂（n ≈ 2.4、k < 10⁻⁴）與 GaN 適用可見光，非晶矽在 532 nm 吸收過大但在 940 nm 近紅外幾乎無損。TiO₂ 常以原子層沉積填入電子束阻劑的孔洞，再回蝕頂層並去除阻劑，形成垂直側壁的柱子；非晶矽或 GaN 則以硬遮罩加電感耦合電漿乾蝕刻成形。
knowledge.textEn: Visible metalenses need high-index, low-loss materials: TiO₂ (n ≈ 2.4, k < 10⁻⁴) and GaN serve the visible, whereas amorphous silicon absorbs too strongly at 532 nm but is nearly lossless at 940 nm in the near infrared. TiO₂ is usually grown by atomic-layer deposition into holes of an electron-beam resist, then etched back and freed from resist to leave vertical pillars; amorphous silicon or GaN is shaped by inductively coupled plasma etching through a hard mask.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control" is correct?
options: 只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。
可見光超穎透鏡需要高折射率、低吸收的材料：TiO₂（n ≈ 2.4、k < 10⁻⁴）與 GaN 適用可見光，非晶矽在 532 nm 吸收過大但在 940 nm 近紅外幾乎無損。
穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。
optionsEn: If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless.

Visible metalenses need high-index, low-loss materials: TiO₂ (n ≈ 2.4, k < 10⁻⁴) and GaN serve the visible, whereas amorphous silicon absorbs too strongly at 532 nm but is nearly lossless at 940 nm in the near infrared.
A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%.
quiz.explanation: 可見光超穎透鏡需要高折射率、低吸收的材料：TiO₂（n ≈ 2.4、k < 10⁻⁴）與 GaN 適用可見光，非晶矽在 532 nm 吸收過大但在 940 nm 近紅外幾乎無損。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Visible metalenses need high-index, low-loss materials: TiO₂ (n ≈ 2.4, k < 10⁻⁴) and GaN serve the visible, whereas amorphous silicon absorbs too strongly at 532 nm but is nearly lossless at 940 nm in the near infrared. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：側壁偏離垂直 α 時，上下直徑差 Δd = 2·h·tanα；h = 600 nm、α = 2° 時 Δd = 41.9 nm，相當於跨越相位庫中約四個 10 nm 直徑階。ALD 填滿最大 200 nm 孔需 ≥ 100 nm 膜厚，以 0.06 nm/cycle 計約 1,700 個循環。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A sidewall tilted by α from vertical gives a top-to-bottom diameter difference Δd = 2·h·tanα; for h = 600 nm and α = 2°, Δd = 41.9 nm, which spans about four 10 nm diameter steps of the library. Filling the largest 200 nm hole by ALD needs at least 100 nm of film, roughly 1,700 cycles at 0.06 nm per cycle. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：切片或傾斜 SEM 量側壁角與柱高，橢偏儀量 ALD 膜的折射率與消光係數，並用一片均勻柱陣列量穿透率；三者代入 RCWA 重新計算相位庫，與原設計曲線比較後決定是否需要重新映射直徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sidewall angle and pillar height by cross-section or tilted SEM, measure the ALD film index and extinction by ellipsometry, and measure transmittance on a uniform pillar array; feed all three into RCWA to recompute the library and compare with the design curve before deciding whether diameters must be remapped.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 側壁偏離垂直 α 時，上下直徑差 Δd = 2·h·tanα；h = 600 nm、α = 2° 時 Δd = 41.9 nm，相當於跨越相位庫中約四個 10 nm 直徑階。ALD 填滿最大 200 nm 孔需 ≥ 100 nm 膜厚，以 0.06 nm/cycle 計約 1,700 個循環。
knowledge.textEn: A sidewall tilted by α from vertical gives a top-to-bottom diameter difference Δd = 2·h·tanα; for h = 600 nm and α = 2°, Δd = 41.9 nm, which spans about four 10 nm diameter steps of the library. Filling the largest 200 nm hole by ALD needs at least 100 nm of film, roughly 1,700 cycles at 0.06 nm per cycle.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control", which statement holds?
options: 平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。
只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。
側壁偏離垂直 α 時，上下直徑差 Δd = 2·h·tanα。
optionsEn: A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre.
As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter.
A sidewall tilted by α from vertical gives a top-to-bottom diameter difference Δd = 2·h·tanα.

steps.title: 材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 切片或傾斜 SEM 量側壁角與柱高，橢偏儀量 ALD 膜的折射率與消光係數，並用一片均勻柱陣列量穿透率；三者代入 RCWA 重新計算相位庫，與原設計曲線比較後決定是否需要重新映射直徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sidewall angle and pillar height by cross-section or tilted SEM, measure the ALD film index and extinction by ellipsometry, and measure transmittance on a uniform pillar array; feed all three into RCWA to recompute the library and compare with the design curve before deciding whether diameters must be remapped. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：乾蝕刻選擇比不足時硬遮罩在最細柱上先耗盡，柱頂被削成錐形，細柱區（對應相位剖面的特定圈帶）穿透相位系統性偏移，焦點出現可量測的球差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When etch selectivity is insufficient the hard mask is consumed first on the thinnest pillars, tapering their tops; those pillar bands, which map to specific phase zones, shift phase systematically and the focus shows measurable spherical aberration.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 切片或傾斜 SEM 量側壁角與柱高，橢偏儀量 ALD 膜的折射率與消光係數，並用一片均勻柱陣列量穿透率；三者代入 RCWA 重新計算相位庫，與原設計曲線比較後決定是否需要重新映射直徑。
knowledge.textEn: Measure sidewall angle and pillar height by cross-section or tilted SEM, measure the ALD film index and extinction by ellipsometry, and measure transmittance on a uniform pillar array; feed all three into RCWA to recompute the library and compare with the design curve before deciding whether diameters must be remapped.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control"?
options: 切片或傾斜 SEM 量側壁角與柱高，橢偏儀量 ALD 膜的折射率與消光係數，並用一片均勻柱陣列量穿透率。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。
optionsEn: Measure sidewall angle and pillar height by cross-section or tilted SEM, measure the ALD film index and extinction by ellipsometry, and measure transmittance on a uniform pillar array.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.
quiz.explanation: 切片或傾斜 SEM 量側壁角與柱高，橢偏儀量 ALD 膜的折射率與消光係數，並用一片均勻柱陣列量穿透率；三者代入 RCWA 重新計算相位庫，與原設計曲線比較後決定是否需要重新映射直徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure sidewall angle and pillar height by cross-section or tilted SEM, measure the ALD film index and extinction by ellipsometry, and measure transmittance on a uniform pillar array; feed all three into RCWA to recompute the library and compare with the design curve before deciding whether diameters must be remapped. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ALD 填充與高深寬比乾蝕刻」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “ALD fill and high-aspect-ratio dry etch” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 乾蝕刻選擇比不足時硬遮罩在最細柱上先耗盡，柱頂被削成錐形，細柱區（對應相位剖面的特定圈帶）穿透相位系統性偏移，焦點出現可量測的球差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When etch selectivity is insufficient the hard mask is consumed first on the thinnest pillars, tapering their tops; those pillar bands, which map to specific phase zones, shift phase systematically and the focus shows measurable spherical aberration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：側壁角度、底部殘留與柱頂圓角都會改變 n_eff，等效於直徑誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sidewall angle, footing and top rounding all change n_eff and act like diameter errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 乾蝕刻選擇比不足時硬遮罩在最細柱上先耗盡，柱頂被削成錐形，細柱區（對應相位剖面的特定圈帶）穿透相位系統性偏移，焦點出現可量測的球差。
knowledge.textEn: When etch selectivity is insufficient the hard mask is consumed first on the thinnest pillars, tapering their tops; those pillar bands, which map to specific phase zones, shift phase systematically and the focus shows measurable spherical aberration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「材料、ALD 與蝕刻側壁控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Materials, ALD and etch-sidewall control" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
乾蝕刻選擇比不足時硬遮罩在最細柱上先耗盡，柱頂被削成錐形，細柱區（對應相位剖面的特定圈帶）穿透相位系統性偏移，焦點出現可量測的球差。
穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
When etch selectivity is insufficient the hard mask is consumed first on the thinnest pillars, tapering their tops.
A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測」與「色差、景深與消色差極限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement" and "Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聚焦效率定義為焦點附近（常取 3 倍 FWHM 半徑的圓）內的功率除以入射功率，必須與穿透率分開報告，因為未聚焦的零階光也會穿透。焦斑用一支 NA 高於待測透鏡的顯微物鏡放大成像到相機，以像素尺寸與放大率換算 FWHM；Strehl 比由實測峰值強度對理想 Airy 峰值的比值求得，或由 PSF 反推波前 RMS。入射光需以已知偏振與準直度照明，否則量到的是光源而非透鏡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Focusing efficiency is the power inside a circle of about three FWHM radii around the focus divided by the incident power, and must be reported separately from transmittance because undiffracted zeroth-order light is also transmitted. The spot is relayed to a camera by a microscope objective whose NA exceeds that of the lens under test, and FWHM is converted through pixel size and magnification; the Strehl ratio comes from the measured peak against the ideal Airy peak or from the wavefront RMS inferred from the PSF. Illumination must have known polarization and collimation, otherwise the source rather than the lens is being measured. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm，故針孔或積分圓取直徑約 1 µm；基板背面未鍍膜的 Fresnel 損失 R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5%，須在效率計算中扣除或鍍增透膜消除。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The diffraction-limited FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm, so the pinhole or integration circle is about 1 µm in diameter; the uncoated substrate back face loses R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5% by Fresnel reflection, which must be removed from the efficiency bookkeeping or eliminated with an AR coating.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測
knowledge.titleEn: Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement
knowledge.text: 聚焦效率定義為焦點附近（常取 3 倍 FWHM 半徑的圓）內的功率除以入射功率，必須與穿透率分開報告，因為未聚焦的零階光也會穿透。焦斑用一支 NA 高於待測透鏡的顯微物鏡放大成像到相機，以像素尺寸與放大率換算 FWHM；Strehl 比由實測峰值強度對理想 Airy 峰值的比值求得，或由 PSF 反推波前 RMS。
knowledge.textEn: Focusing efficiency is the power inside a circle of about three FWHM radii around the focus divided by the incident power, and must be reported separately from transmittance because undiffracted zeroth-order light is also transmitted. The spot is relayed to a camera by a microscope objective whose NA exceeds that of the lens under test, and FWHM is converted through pixel size and magnification; the Strehl ratio comes from the measured peak against the ideal Airy peak or from the wavefront RMS inferred from the PSF.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement" is correct?
options: 穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。
超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。
聚焦效率定義為焦點附近（常取 3 倍 FWHM 半徑的圓）內的功率除以入射功率，必須與穿透率分開報告，因為未聚焦的零階光也會穿透。
optionsEn: A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%.
A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens.

Focusing efficiency is the power inside a circle of about three FWHM radii around the focus divided by the incident power, and must be reported separately from transmittance because undiffracted zeroth-order light is also transmitted.
quiz.explanation: 聚焦效率定義為焦點附近（常取 3 倍 FWHM 半徑的圓）內的功率除以入射功率，必須與穿透率分開報告，因為未聚焦的零階光也會穿透。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Focusing efficiency is the power inside a circle of about three FWHM radii around the focus divided by the incident power, and must be reported separately from transmittance because undiffracted zeroth-order light is also transmitted. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm，故針孔或積分圓取直徑約 1 µm；基板背面未鍍膜的 Fresnel 損失 R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5%，須在效率計算中扣除或鍍增透膜消除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The diffraction-limited FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm, so the pinhole or integration circle is about 1 µm in diameter; the uncoated substrate back face loses R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5% by Fresnel reflection, which must be removed from the efficiency bookkeeping or eliminated with an AR coating. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用不含超穎結構的同批基板量穿透率做基準，再量透鏡的總穿透與焦點內功率；掃描 z 軸記錄焦斑強度曲線確認真正焦面，並以 NA 0.9 物鏡量 FWHM，與 339 nm 比較；兩種方法的效率差應小於 2%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure transmittance on a bare substrate from the same batch as a baseline, then the total transmission and in-focus power of the lens; scan z to locate the true focal plane from the peak-intensity curve, measure FWHM with an NA 0.9 objective and compare with 339 nm; the two efficiency methods should agree within 2%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm，故針孔或積分圓取直徑約 1 µm；基板背面未鍍膜的 Fresnel 損失 R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5%，須在效率計算中扣除或鍍增透膜消除。
knowledge.textEn: The diffraction-limited FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm, so the pinhole or integration circle is about 1 µm in diameter; the uncoated substrate back face loses R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5% by Fresnel reflection, which must be removed from the efficiency bookkeeping or eliminated with an AR coating.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement", which statement holds?
options: 繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm，故針孔或積分圓取直徑約 1 µm。
平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。
奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。
optionsEn: The diffraction-limited FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm, so the pinhole or integration circle is about 1 µm in diameter.
Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.
Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.
quiz.explanation: 繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm，故針孔或積分圓取直徑約 1 µm；基板背面未鍍膜的 Fresnel 損失 R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5%，須在效率計算中扣除或鍍增透膜消除。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The diffraction-limited FWHM ≈ 0.51·λ/NA = 0.51×532/0.8 ≈ 339 nm, so the pinhole or integration circle is about 1 µm in diameter; the uncoated substrate back face loses R = ((1.46 − 1)/(1.46 + 1))² ≈ 3.5% by Fresnel reflection, which must be removed from the efficiency bookkeeping or eliminated with an AR coating. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先用不含超穎結構的同批基板量穿透率做基準，再量透鏡的總穿透與焦點內功率；掃描 z 軸記錄焦斑強度曲線確認真正焦面，並以 NA 0.9 物鏡量 FWHM，與 339 nm 比較；兩種方法的效率差應小於 2%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure transmittance on a bare substrate from the same batch as a baseline, then the total transmission and in-focus power of the lens; scan z to locate the true focal plane from the peak-intensity curve, measure FWHM with an NA 0.9 objective and compare with 339 nm; the two efficiency methods should agree within 2%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用 NA 0.5 的物鏡觀察 NA 0.8 的焦斑會把 PSF 擴寬一倍以上，FWHM 與 Strehl 都被低估；若同時把零階穿透光算進焦點功率，效率又被高估，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Viewing an NA 0.8 focus with an NA 0.5 objective more than doubles the apparent PSF, underestimating FWHM and Strehl; counting zeroth-order transmission as focal power then overstates efficiency, and the two errors mask each other.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先用不含超穎結構的同批基板量穿透率做基準，再量透鏡的總穿透與焦點內功率；掃描 z 軸記錄焦斑強度曲線確認真正焦面，並以 NA 0.9 物鏡量 FWHM，與 339 nm 比較；兩種方法的效率差應小於 2%。
knowledge.textEn: Measure transmittance on a bare substrate from the same batch as a baseline, then the total transmission and in-focus power of the lens; scan z to locate the true focal plane from the peak-intensity curve, measure FWHM with an NA 0.9 objective and compare with 339 nm; the two efficiency methods should agree within 2%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度

Measure transmittance on a bare substrate from the same batch as a baseline, then the total transmission and in-focus power of the lens.
Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure transmittance on a bare substrate from the same batch as a baseline, then the total transmission and in-focus power of the lens; scan z to locate the true focal plane from the peak-intensity curve, measure FWHM with an NA 0.9 objective and compare with 339 nm; the two efficiency methods should agree within 2%. steps.title: 聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焦平面顯微成像與針孔功率計」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Focal-plane microscope and pinhole power meter” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用 NA 0.5 的物鏡觀察 NA 0.8 的焦斑會把 PSF 擴寬一倍以上，FWHM 與 Strehl 都被低估；若同時把零階穿透光算進焦點功率，效率又被高估，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Viewing an NA 0.8 focus with an NA 0.5 objective more than doubles the apparent PSF, underestimating FWHM and Strehl; counting zeroth-order transmission as focal power then overstates efficiency, and the two errors mask each other. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：入射光需以已知偏振與準直度照明，否則量到的是光源而非透鏡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Illumination must have known polarization and collimation, otherwise the source rather than the lens is being measured.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用 NA 0.5 的物鏡觀察 NA 0.8 的焦斑會把 PSF 擴寬一倍以上，FWHM 與 Strehl 都被低估；若同時把零階穿透光算進焦點功率，效率又被高估，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。

用 NA 0.5 的物鏡觀察 NA 0.8 的焦斑會把 PSF 擴寬一倍以上，FWHM 與 Strehl 都被低估。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens.
Viewing an NA 0.8 focus with an NA 0.5 objective more than doubles the apparent PSF, underestimating FWHM and Strehl.
quiz.explanation: 用 NA 0.5 的物鏡觀察 NA 0.8 的焦斑會把 PSF 擴寬一倍以上，FWHM 與 Strehl 都被低估；若同時把零階穿透光算進焦點功率，效率又被高估，兩個錯誤互相掩蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Viewing an NA 0.8 focus with an NA 0.5 objective more than doubles the apparent PSF, underestimating FWHM and Strehl; counting zeroth-order transmission as focal power then overstates efficiency, and the two errors mask each other. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 色差、景深與消色差極限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunable source and axial focal shift” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單層超穎透鏡本質上是繞射元件，焦距與波長近似成反比，f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ，與折射透鏡的色差方向相反且大得多。高 NA 時景深 λ/NA² 只有一個微米以下，所以可用頻寬極窄。要消色差必須讓每個超穎原子同時提供正確的相位與群延遲，而群延遲範圍受奈米柱高度限制在數十飛秒，因此消色差設計只在口徑數十微米的透鏡上成立，大口徑則改用多層或繞射折射混合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single-layer metalens is intrinsically diffractive: focal length scales roughly inversely with wavelength, f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ, opposite in sign and far larger than refractive chromatic aberration. At high NA the depth of focus λ/NA² is below one micrometre, so the usable bandwidth is very narrow. Achromatization requires each meta-atom to supply the correct phase and group delay together, and the group-delay range available from sub-micrometre pillars is a few tens of femtoseconds, so achromatic designs hold only for apertures of tens of micrometres while larger lenses use multilayer or hybrid refractive-diffractive schemes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tunable source and axial focal shift”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Δf ≈ −f·Δλ/λ：f = 0.75 mm、Δλ = 8 nm 時 Δf ≈ −11.3 µm，而景深 λ/NA² = 532 nm/0.64 ≈ 0.83 µm，焦點移了約 14 個景深；允許 1 個景深的頻寬僅 Δλ = λ·DOF/f ≈ 0.59 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Δf ≈ −f·Δλ/λ: for f = 0.75 mm and Δλ = 8 nm, Δf ≈ −11.3 µm, while the depth of focus λ/NA² = 532 nm/0.64 ≈ 0.83 µm, so the focus moves about 14 depths of focus; the bandwidth for one depth of focus is only Δλ = λ·DOF/f ≈ 0.59 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Tunable source and axial focal shift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 色差、景深與消色差極限
knowledge.titleEn: Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits
knowledge.text: 單層超穎透鏡本質上是繞射元件，焦距與波長近似成反比，f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ，與折射透鏡的色差方向相反且大得多。高 NA 時景深 λ/NA² 只有一個微米以下，所以可用頻寬極窄。
knowledge.textEn: A single-layer metalens is intrinsically diffractive: focal length scales roughly inversely with wavelength, f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ, opposite in sign and far larger than refractive chromatic aberration. At high NA the depth of focus λ/NA² is below one micrometre, so the usable bandwidth is very narrow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「色差、景深與消色差極限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits" is correct?
options: 單層超穎透鏡本質上是繞射元件，焦距與波長近似成反比，f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ，與折射透鏡的色差方向相反且大得多。
超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。
平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。
optionsEn: A single-layer metalens is intrinsically diffractive: focal length scales roughly inversely with wavelength, f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ, opposite in sign and far larger than refractive chromatic aberration.
A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens.
A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre.
quiz.explanation: 單層超穎透鏡本質上是繞射元件，焦距與波長近似成反比，f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ，與折射透鏡的色差方向相反且大得多。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A single-layer metalens is intrinsically diffractive: focal length scales roughly inversely with wavelength, f(λ) ≈ f₀·λ₀/λ, opposite in sign and far larger than refractive chromatic aberration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 色差、景深與消色差極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunable source and axial focal shift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δf ≈ −f·Δλ/λ：f = 0.75 mm、Δλ = 8 nm 時 Δf ≈ −11.3 µm，而景深 λ/NA² = 532 nm/0.64 ≈ 0.83 µm，焦點移了約 14 個景深；允許 1 個景深的頻寬僅 Δλ = λ·DOF/f ≈ 0.59 nm。消色差所需群延遲範圍 (√(R² + f²) − f)/c 在 R = 25 µm、f = 50 µm 時為 19.7 fs，在 R = 1 mm、f = 0.75 mm 時達 1.67 ps。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δf ≈ −f·Δλ/λ: for f = 0.75 mm and Δλ = 8 nm, Δf ≈ −11.3 µm, while the depth of focus λ/NA² = 532 nm/0.64 ≈ 0.83 µm, so the focus moves about 14 depths of focus; the bandwidth for one depth of focus is only Δλ = λ·DOF/f ≈ 0.59 nm. The group-delay range needed for achromatization, (√(R² + f²) − f)/c, is 19.7 fs for R = 25 µm and f = 50 µm but 1.67 ps for R = 1 mm and f = 0.75 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可調雷射或單色儀每 5 nm 掃一個波長，對每個波長做 z 掃描找焦面並記錄效率，將 f(λ) 與 f₀λ₀/λ 比較；斜率偏離表示超穎原子的相位色散不同於理想繞射，應回饋到庫的群延遲模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan a tunable laser or monochromator in 5 nm steps, z-scan at each wavelength to locate the focus and log efficiency, and compare f(λ) with f₀λ₀/λ; a slope deviation means the meta-atom phase dispersion differs from the ideal diffractive case and should feed back into the library's group-delay model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

The group-delay range needed for achromatization, (√(R² + f²) − f)/c, is 19.7 fs for R = 25 µm and f = 50 µm but 1.67 ps for R = 1 mm and f = 0.75 mm.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Tunable source and axial focal shift” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以可調雷射或單色儀每 5 nm 掃一個波長，對每個波長做 z 掃描找焦面並記錄效率，將 f(λ) 與 f₀λ₀/λ 比較；斜率偏離表示超穎原子的相位色散不同於理想繞射，應回饋到庫的群延遲模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan a tunable laser or monochromator in 5 nm steps, z-scan at each wavelength to locate the focus and log efficiency, and compare f(λ) with f₀λ₀/λ; a slope deviation means the meta-atom phase dispersion differs from the ideal diffractive case and should feed back into the library's group-delay model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把為 532 nm 雷射設計的透鏡接到 30 nm 頻寬的綠光 LED，焦點沿軸拉成數十微米長的色散光柱，影像對比崩潰，常被誤判為製程缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pairing a lens designed for a 532 nm laser with a 30 nm wide green LED stretches the focus into a tens-of-micrometre axial chromatic column; image contrast collapses and the result is often misread as a fabrication defect.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.
