quiz.question: 要驗證「色差、景深與消色差極限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。
以可調雷射或單色儀每 5 nm 掃一個波長，對每個波長做 z 掃描找焦面並記錄效率，將 f(λ) 與 f₀λ₀/λ 比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless.
Scan a tunable laser or monochromator in 5 nm steps, z-scan at each wavelength to locate the focus and log efficiency, and compare f(λ) with f₀λ₀/λ.
quiz.explanation: 以可調雷射或單色儀每 5 nm 掃一個波長，對每個波長做 z 掃描找焦面並記錄效率，將 f(λ) 與 f₀λ₀/λ 比較；斜率偏離表示超穎原子的相位色散不同於理想繞射，應回饋到庫的群延遲模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan a tunable laser or monochromator in 5 nm steps, z-scan at each wavelength to locate the focus and log efficiency, and compare f(λ) with f₀λ₀/λ; a slope deviation means the meta-atom phase dispersion differs from the ideal diffractive case and should feed back into the library's group-delay model. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 色差、景深與消色差極限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波長掃描光源與 z 軸焦點位移」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Tunable source and axial focal shift” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把為 532 nm 雷射設計的透鏡接到 30 nm 頻寬的綠光 LED，焦點沿軸拉成數十微米長的色散光柱，影像對比崩潰，常被誤判為製程缺陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Pairing a lens designed for a 532 nm laser with a 30 nm wide green LED stretches the focus into a tens-of-micrometre axial chromatic column; image contrast collapses and the result is often misread as a fabrication defect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要消色差必須讓每個超穎原子同時提供正確的相位與群延遲，而群延遲範圍受奈米柱高度限制在數十飛秒，因此消色差設計只在口徑數十微米的透鏡上成立，大口徑則改用多層或繞射折射混合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Achromatization requires each meta-atom to supply the correct phase and group delay together, and the group-delay range available from sub-micrometre pillars is a few tens of femtoseconds, so achromatic designs hold only for apertures of tens of micrometres while larger lenses use multilayer or hybrid refractive-diffractive schemes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把為 532 nm 雷射設計的透鏡接到 30 nm 頻寬的綠光 LED，焦點沿軸拉成數十微米長的色散光柱，影像對比崩潰，常被誤判為製程缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Pairing a lens designed for a 532 nm laser with a 30 nm wide green LED stretches the focus into a tens-of-micrometre axial chromatic column; image contrast collapses and the result is often misread as a fabrication defect.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「色差、景深與消色差極限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把為 532 nm 雷射設計的透鏡接到 30 nm 頻寬的綠光 LED，焦點沿軸拉成數十微米長的色散光柱，影像對比崩潰，常被誤判為製程缺陷。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。
optionsEn: Pairing a lens designed for a 532 nm laser with a 30 nm wide green LED stretches the focus into a tens-of-micrometre axial chromatic column.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre.
quiz.explanation: 把為 532 nm 雷射設計的透鏡接到 30 nm 頻寬的綠光 LED，焦點沿軸拉成數十微米長的色散光柱，影像對比崩潰，常被誤判為製程缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pairing a lens designed for a 532 nm laser with a 30 nm wide green LED stretches the focus into a tens-of-micrometre axial chromatic column; image contrast collapses and the result is often misread as a fabrication defect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位」與「關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment" and "Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量產超穎透鏡在 200 或 300 mm 晶圓上一次做出數千顆，整合工作包括背面增透鍍膜、保護層、切割與和影像感測器或 VCSEL 的對位。DUV 步進機的場拼接線會穿過大口徑透鏡，拼接位移等於在該線兩側加一個相位台階，其大小由局部相位梯度決定；模組對位則由透鏡傾斜造成的慧差與去中心造成的影像偏移決定公差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Production metalenses are made by the thousand on 200 or 300 mm wafers, and integration covers backside antireflection coating, protective layers, dicing and alignment to an image sensor or VCSEL. Stepper field boundaries cross a large-aperture lens, and a stitching displacement equals a phase step across that line whose size is set by the local phase gradient; module alignment tolerances come from the coma induced by lens tilt and the image shift induced by decentre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：邊緣相位梯度 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm；20 nm 的拼接位移造成 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 的波前台階，低於 Maréchal 的 λ/14 RMS 許可；若位移達 100 nm，台階為 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6，單獨就吃掉大半預算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The rim phase gradient is 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm; a 20 nm stitching displacement produces a 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 wavefront step, below the Maréchal λ/14 RMS allowance, whereas a 100 nm displacement gives 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6 and alone consumes most of the budget.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位
knowledge.titleEn: Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment
knowledge.text: 量產超穎透鏡在 200 或 300 mm 晶圓上一次做出數千顆，整合工作包括背面增透鍍膜、保護層、切割與和影像感測器或 VCSEL 的對位。DUV 步進機的場拼接線會穿過大口徑透鏡，拼接位移等於在該線兩側加一個相位台階，其大小由局部相位梯度決定；模組對位則由透鏡傾斜造成的慧差與去中心造成的影像偏移決定公差。
knowledge.textEn: Production metalenses are made by the thousand on 200 or 300 mm wafers, and integration covers backside antireflection coating, protective layers, dicing and alignment to an image sensor or VCSEL. Stepper field boundaries cross a large-aperture lens, and a stitching displacement equals a phase step across that line whose size is set by the local phase gradient; module alignment tolerances come from the coma induced by lens tilt and the image shift induced by decentre.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment" is correct?
options: 平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。
量產超穎透鏡在 200 或 300 mm 晶圓上一次做出數千顆，整合工作包括背面增透鍍膜、保護層、切割與和影像感測器或 VCSEL 的對位。
平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。
optionsEn: A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre.
Production metalenses are made by the thousand on 200 or 300 mm wafers, and integration covers backside antireflection coating, protective layers, dicing and alignment to an image sensor or VCSEL.
Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: 量產超穎透鏡在 200 或 300 mm 晶圓上一次做出數千顆，整合工作包括背面增透鍍膜、保護層、切割與和影像感測器或 VCSEL 的對位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Production metalenses are made by the thousand on 200 or 300 mm wafers, and integration covers backside antireflection coating, protective layers, dicing and alignment to an image sensor or VCSEL. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：邊緣相位梯度 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm；20 nm 的拼接位移造成 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 的波前台階，低於 Maréchal 的 λ/14 RMS 許可；若位移達 100 nm，台階為 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6，單獨就吃掉大半預算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The rim phase gradient is 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm; a 20 nm stitching displacement produces a 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 wavefront step, below the Maréchal λ/14 RMS allowance, whereas a 100 nm displacement gives 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6 and alone consumes most of the budget. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以晶圓級干涉儀或 Shack–Hartmann 量穿透波前，在拼接線位置尋找台階並換算為位移，與 SEM 直接量得的柱位移比對；模組端用 MTF 靶量各視場的 MTF，確認傾斜與去中心在公差內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the transmitted wavefront with a wafer-level interferometer or Shack–Hartmann sensor, look for a step at the stitch line, convert it to displacement and compare with pillar displacement measured directly by SEM; at module level, measure MTF across the field with a target to confirm tilt and decentre are within tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 邊緣相位梯度 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm；20 nm 的拼接位移造成 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 的波前台階，低於 Maréchal 的 λ/14 RMS 許可；若位移達 100 nm，台階為 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6，單獨就吃掉大半預算。
knowledge.textEn: The rim phase gradient is 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm; a 20 nm stitching displacement produces a 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 wavefront step, below the Maréchal λ/14 RMS allowance, whereas a 100 nm displacement gives 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6 and alone consumes most of the budget.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment", which statement holds?
options: 奈米柱越高相位控制越好，所以高度沒有上限。
只要材料折射率夠高，吸收大一點在可見光也無妨。
邊緣相位梯度 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm。
optionsEn: Taller pillars always give better phase control, so height has no upper limit.
If the index is high enough, some absorption in the visible is harmless.
The rim phase gradient is 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm.
quiz.explanation: 邊緣相位梯度 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm；20 nm 的拼接位移造成 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 的波前台階，低於 Maréchal 的 λ/14 RMS 許可；若位移達 100 nm，台階為 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6，單獨就吃掉大半預算。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The rim phase gradient is 2π·NA/λ = 2π×0.8/0.532 µm ≈ 9.45 rad/µm; a 20 nm stitching displacement produces a 0.19 rad ≈ λ/33 wavefront step, below the Maréchal λ/14 RMS allowance, whereas a 100 nm displacement gives 0.95 rad ≈ λ/6.6 and alone consumes most of the budget. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以晶圓級干涉儀或 Shack–Hartmann 量穿透波前，在拼接線位置尋找台階並換算為位移，與 SEM 直接量得的柱位移比對；模組端用 MTF 靶量各視場的 MTF，確認傾斜與去中心在公差內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the transmitted wavefront with a wafer-level interferometer or Shack–Hartmann sensor, look for a step at the stitch line, convert it to displacement and compare with pillar displacement measured directly by SEM; at module level, measure MTF across the field with a target to confirm tilt and decentre are within tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：切割後的晶粒若以黏著劑固定，固化收縮使透鏡傾斜 0.5°，高 NA 焦點出現不對稱慧差，影像單側模糊；而晶圓級量測因在切割前完成而未能攔截。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A diced die fixed with adhesive can tilt by 0.5° as the adhesive cures, producing asymmetric coma at a high-NA focus and one-sided blur; wafer-level metrology done before dicing cannot intercept it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以晶圓級干涉儀或 Shack–Hartmann 量穿透波前，在拼接線位置尋找台階並換算為位移，與 SEM 直接量得的柱位移比對；模組端用 MTF 靶量各視場的 MTF，確認傾斜與去中心在公差內。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the transmitted wavefront with a wafer-level interferometer or Shack–Hartmann sensor, look for a step at the stitch line, convert it to displacement and compare with pillar displacement measured directly by SEM; at module level, measure MTF across the field with a target to confirm tilt and decentre are within tolerance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment"?
options: 以晶圓級干涉儀或 Shack–Hartmann 量穿透波前，在拼接線位置尋找台階並換算為位移，與 SEM 直接量得的柱位移比對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。
optionsEn: Measure the transmitted wavefront with a wafer-level interferometer or Shack–Hartmann sensor, look for a step at the stitch line, convert it to displacement and compare with pillar displacement measured directly by SEM.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%.
quiz.explanation: 以晶圓級干涉儀或 Shack–Hartmann 量穿透波前，在拼接線位置尋找台階並換算為位移，與 SEM 直接量得的柱位移比對；模組端用 MTF 靶量各視場的 MTF，確認傾斜與去中心在公差內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the transmitted wavefront with a wafer-level interferometer or Shack–Hartmann sensor, look for a step at the stitch line, convert it to displacement and compare with pillar displacement measured directly by SEM; at module level, measure MTF across the field with a target to confirm tilt and decentre are within tolerance. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「DUV 場拼接線與背面增透層」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “DUV field-stitch line and backside AR layer” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 切割後的晶粒若以黏著劑固定，固化收縮使透鏡傾斜 0.5°，高 NA 焦點出現不對稱慧差，影像單側模糊；而晶圓級量測因在切割前完成而未能攔截。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A diced die fixed with adhesive can tilt by 0.5° as the adhesive cures, producing asymmetric coma at a high-NA focus and one-sided blur; wafer-level metrology done before dicing cannot intercept it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：DUV 步進機的場拼接線會穿過大口徑透鏡，拼接位移等於在該線兩側加一個相位台階，其大小由局部相位梯度決定；模組對位則由透鏡傾斜造成的慧差與去中心造成的影像偏移決定公差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stepper field boundaries cross a large-aperture lens, and a stitching displacement equals a phase step across that line whose size is set by the local phase gradient; module alignment tolerances come from the coma induced by lens tilt and the image shift induced by decentre.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平面透鏡沒有曲面，所以對傾斜與去中心不敏感。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A flat lens has no curved surface, so it is insensitive to tilt and decentre." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 切割後的晶粒若以黏著劑固定，固化收縮使透鏡傾斜 0.5°，高 NA 焦點出現不對稱慧差，影像單側模糊；而晶圓級量測因在切割前完成而未能攔截。
knowledge.textEn: A diced die fixed with adhesive can tilt by 0.5° as the adhesive cures, producing asymmetric coma at a high-NA focus and one-sided blur; wafer-level metrology done before dicing cannot intercept it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「晶圓級整合、拼接與模組對位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wafer-level integration, stitching and module alignment" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
切割後的晶粒若以黏著劑固定，固化收縮使透鏡傾斜 0.5°，高 NA 焦點出現不對稱慧差，影像單側模糊；而晶圓級量測因在切割前完成而未能攔截。
平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A diced die fixed with adhesive can tilt by 0.5° as the adhesive cures, producing asymmetric coma at a high-NA focus and one-sided blur.
Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: 切割後的晶粒若以黏著劑固定，固化收縮使透鏡傾斜 0.5°，高 NA 焦點出現不對稱慧差，影像單側模糊；而晶圓級量測因在切割前完成而未能攔截。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A diced die fixed with adhesive can tilt by 0.5° as the adhesive cures, producing asymmetric coma at a high-NA focus and one-sided blur; wafer-level metrology done before dicing cannot intercept it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包」如何決定超穎透鏡製程研究的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package” determines the key performance of “Metalens fabrication research”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超穎透鏡的品質最終由每根柱子的直徑誤差決定，因為相位庫把直徑映射成相位，直徑的隨機誤差直接變成波前的隨機誤差。交接文件必須把設計相位圖、量測的 CD 分佈、側壁角、穿透相位驗證、效率對波長曲線、PSF/MTF 與環境測試連成一條可追溯的鏈，讓製程端知道哪個參數的漂移會先讓 Strehl 低於 0.8。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The quality of a metalens is ultimately fixed by the diameter error of every pillar, because the library maps diameter to phase and random diameter error becomes random wavefront error directly. The handoff package must chain the design phase map, measured CD distribution, sidewall angle, transmitted-phase verification, efficiency-versus-wavelength curve, PSF/MTF and environmental tests into one traceable record so the process side knows which parameter drift pushes Strehl below 0.8 first. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相位庫以直徑 80→200 nm 覆蓋 2π，平均斜率 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm；關鍵尺寸標準差 3 nm 給出 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976；σ_CD = 10 nm 時 σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.76，低於 0.8 的驗收門檻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The library covers 2π over diameters 80→200 nm, a mean slope of 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm; a 3 nm CD standard deviation gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976, while σ_CD = 10 nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.76, below 0.8.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接
knowledge.text: 超穎透鏡的品質最終由每根柱子的直徑誤差決定，因為相位庫把直徑映射成相位，直徑的隨機誤差直接變成波前的隨機誤差。交接文件必須把設計相位圖、量測的 CD 分佈、側壁角、穿透相位驗證、效率對波長曲線、PSF/MTF 與環境測試連成一條可追溯的鏈，讓製程端知道哪個參數的漂移會先讓 Strehl 低於 0.8。
knowledge.textEn: The quality of a metalens is ultimately fixed by the diameter error of every pillar, because the library maps diameter to phase and random diameter error becomes random wavefront error directly. The handoff package must chain the design phase map, measured CD distribution, sidewall angle, transmitted-phase verification, efficiency-versus-wavelength curve, PSF/MTF and environmental tests into one traceable record so the process side knows which parameter drift pushes Strehl below 0.8 first.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。
只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。
超穎透鏡的品質最終由每根柱子的直徑誤差決定，因為相位庫把直徑映射成相位，直徑的隨機誤差直接變成波前的隨機誤差。
optionsEn: Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging.
As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter.
The quality of a metalens is ultimately fixed by the diameter error of every pillar, because the library maps diameter to phase and random diameter error becomes random wavefront error directly.
quiz.explanation: 超穎透鏡的品質最終由每根柱子的直徑誤差決定，因為相位庫把直徑映射成相位，直徑的隨機誤差直接變成波前的隨機誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The quality of a metalens is ultimately fixed by the diameter error of every pillar, because the library maps diameter to phase and random diameter error becomes random wavefront error directly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相位庫以直徑 80→200 nm 覆蓋 2π，平均斜率 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm；關鍵尺寸標準差 3 nm 給出 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976；σ_CD = 10 nm 時 σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.76，低於 0.8 的驗收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The library covers 2π over diameters 80→200 nm, a mean slope of 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm; a 3 nm CD standard deviation gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976, while σ_CD = 10 nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.76, below 0.8. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在晶圓中心、半徑中點與邊緣各取五個位置做 CD-SEM 統計，算出 σ_CD 並換算 Strehl 預測值，與每顆透鏡實測的 Strehl 做散佈圖；若相關性弱，表示主導誤差來自側壁角或材料折射率而非 CD，應更新預算表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take CD-SEM statistics at five sites each at wafer centre, mid-radius and edge, convert σ_CD into a predicted Strehl and plot it against the measured Strehl of each lens; weak correlation means the dominant error is sidewall angle or material index rather than CD, and the budget table must be updated.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 相位庫以直徑 80→200 nm 覆蓋 2π，平均斜率 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm；關鍵尺寸標準差 3 nm 給出 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976；σ_CD = 10 nm 時 σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.76，低於 0.8 的驗收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: The library covers 2π over diameters 80→200 nm, a mean slope of 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm; a 3 nm CD standard deviation gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976, while σ_CD = 10 nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.76, below 0.8.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 相位庫以直徑 80→200 nm 覆蓋 2π，平均斜率 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm。
電子束微影解析度高，所以也是量產超穎透鏡的最佳方法。
穿透率 95% 就代表聚焦效率 95%。
optionsEn: The library covers 2π over diameters 80→200 nm, a mean slope of 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm.
Electron-beam lithography has the best resolution, so it is also the best way to mass-produce metalenses.
A transmittance of 95% means a focusing efficiency of 95%.
quiz.explanation: 相位庫以直徑 80→200 nm 覆蓋 2π，平均斜率 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm；關鍵尺寸標準差 3 nm 給出 σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad，Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976；σ_CD = 10 nm 時 σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad，Strehl ≈ 0.76，低於 0.8 的驗收門檻。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The library covers 2π over diameters 80→200 nm, a mean slope of 2π/120 nm ≈ 0.052 rad/nm; a 3 nm CD standard deviation gives σ_φ ≈ 0.16 rad and Strehl ≈ exp(−σ_φ²) ≈ 0.976, while σ_CD = 10 nm gives σ_φ ≈ 0.52 rad and Strehl ≈ 0.76, below 0.8. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在晶圓中心、半徑中點與邊緣各取五個位置做 CD-SEM 統計，算出 σ_CD 並換算 Strehl 預測值，與每顆透鏡實測的 Strehl 做散佈圖；若相關性弱，表示主導誤差來自側壁角或材料折射率而非 CD，應更新預算表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take CD-SEM statistics at five sites each at wafer centre, mid-radius and edge, convert σ_CD into a predicted Strehl and plot it against the measured Strehl of each lens; weak correlation means the dominant error is sidewall angle or material index rather than CD, and the budget table must be updated. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時只附效率平均值而沒有 CD 地圖與側壁角，下一批製程微調後 Strehl 從 0.95 掉到 0.7，卻無法判斷是曝光劑量、蝕刻還是 ALD 折射率漂移所致。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A handoff that reports only mean efficiency without the CD map and sidewall angle leaves the next batch, after a process tweak, with Strehl falling from 0.95 to 0.7 and no way to tell whether exposure dose, etch or ALD index drifted.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在晶圓中心、半徑中點與邊緣各取五個位置做 CD-SEM 統計，算出 σ_CD 並換算 Strehl 預測值，與每顆透鏡實測的 Strehl 做散佈圖；若相關性弱，表示主導誤差來自側壁角或材料折射率而非 CD，應更新預算表。
knowledge.textEn: Take CD-SEM statistics at five sites each at wafer centre, mid-radius and edge, convert σ_CD into a predicted Strehl and plot it against the measured Strehl of each lens; weak correlation means the dominant error is sidewall angle or material index rather than CD, and the budget table must be updated.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在晶圓中心、半徑中點與邊緣各取五個位置做 CD-SEM 統計，算出 σ_CD 並換算 Strehl 預測值，與每顆透鏡實測的 Strehl 做散佈圖。
超穎透鏡很薄，所以色差比玻璃透鏡小。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Take CD-SEM statistics at five sites each at wafer centre, mid-radius and edge, convert σ_CD into a predicted Strehl and plot it against the measured Strehl of each lens.
A metalens is thin, so its chromatic aberration is smaller than a glass lens.
quiz.explanation: 在晶圓中心、半徑中點與邊緣各取五個位置做 CD-SEM 統計，算出 σ_CD 並換算 Strehl 預測值，與每顆透鏡實測的 Strehl 做散佈圖；若相關性弱，表示主導誤差來自側壁角或材料折射率而非 CD，應更新預算表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take CD-SEM statistics at five sites each at wafer centre, mid-radius and edge, convert σ_CD into a predicted Strehl and plot it against the measured Strehl of each lens; weak correlation means the dominant error is sidewall angle or material index rather than CD, and the budget table must be updated. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「CD 均勻性地圖與驗收數據包」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “CD-uniformity map and acceptance data package” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時只附效率平均值而沒有 CD 地圖與側壁角，下一批製程微調後 Strehl 從 0.95 掉到 0.7，卻無法判斷是曝光劑量、蝕刻還是 ALD 折射率漂移所致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A handoff that reports only mean efficiency without the CD map and sidewall angle leaves the next batch, after a process tweak, with Strehl falling from 0.95 to 0.7 and no way to tell whether exposure dose, etch or ALD index drifted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須把設計相位圖、量測的 CD 分佈、側壁角、穿透相位驗證、效率對波長曲線、PSF/MTF 與環境測試連成一條可追溯的鏈，讓製程端知道哪個參數的漂移會先讓 Strehl 低於 0.8。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package must chain the design phase map, measured CD distribution, sidewall angle, transmitted-phase verification, efficiency-versus-wavelength curve, PSF/MTF and environmental tests into one traceable record so the process side knows which parameter drift pushes Strehl below 0.8 first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均直徑對了就夠，直徑的散佈不影響成像。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Getting the mean diameter right is enough; diameter scatter does not affect imaging." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 交接時只附效率平均值而沒有 CD 地圖與側壁角，下一批製程微調後 Strehl 從 0.95 掉到 0.7，卻無法判斷是曝光劑量、蝕刻還是 ALD 折射率漂移所致。
knowledge.textEn: A handoff that reports only mean efficiency without the CD map and sidewall angle leaves the next batch, after a process tweak, with Strehl falling from 0.95 to 0.7 and no way to tell whether exposure dose, etch or ALD index drifted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要相位值算對，取樣格點多密並不重要。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
As long as the phase values are right, the sampling pitch does not matter.
